translations.translation: (Arambha karachi) parama karuNAmaYa asIma daYAmaYa AllAhara nAme|
yAvatIYa prazaMsA jagatsamUhera pratipAlaka AllAharai janya|
yini parama karuNAmaYa ati daYAlu|
yini pratiphala divasera mAlika|
AmarA kevala tomArai ‘ivAdAta kari evaM kevalamAtra tomArai sAhAyya prArthanA kari|
AmAderake sarala saThika patha pradarzana kara o tAra prati aTuTa thAkAra tAophIka dAna kara|
tAdera patha, yAdera prati tumi anugraha karecha| tAdera patha, yArA gayavaprApta (iYAhUdI) o pathabhraSTa (khrisTAna) naYa|
Alipha, lAma, mIma|
eTA ai (mahAna) kitAva yAte kona sandeha nei, muttAkIdera janya patha nirdeza|
yArA gAYavera prati ImAna Ane, nAmAya kAYima kare evaM Ami ye jIvanopakaraNa tAderake diYechi tA theke tArA vyaYa kare|
Ara tomAra prati yA nAyila haYeche o tomAra pUrve yA nAyila haYeche tAte tArA vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM parakAlera pratio tArA nizcita vizvAsI|
tArAi tAdera pratipAlakera hidAYAtera upara pratiSThita Ache, Ara tArAi saphalakAma|
nizcaYa yArA kupharI kareche tAderake tumi bhaYa dekhAo Ara nA dekhAo ubhaYaTAi tAdera janya samAna, tArA ImAna Anave nA|
AllAha tAdera antara o kAnera upara mohara kare diYechena, Ara tAdera cokhe Ache AvaraNa Ara tAdera janya Ache mahA zAsti|
mAnuSera madhye emana loka Ache yArA vale, ‘‘AmarA AllAhara prati evaM AkherAtera dinera prati ImAna enechi’’ kintu prakRtapakSe tArA mu’mina naYa|
tArA AllAha o mu’minaderake pratArita kare, Asale tArA nijederake chAr3A anya kAuke pratArita kare nA, kintu eTA tArA upalavdhi karate pAre nA|
tAdera antare Ache vyAdhi, ataHpara AllAha tAdera vyAdhi vAr3iYe diYechena Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti, kAraNa tArA mithyevAdI|
tAderake yakhana valA haYa, ‘pRthivIte phAsAda sRSTi karo nA’; tArA vale, ‘AmarA to saMzodhanakArI’|
mUlataH tArAi azAnti sRSTikArI, kintu tArA tA vujhate pAre nA|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ye sava loka ImAna eneche tAdera mato tomarAo ImAna Ana, tArA vale, ‘nirvodherA yemana ImAna eneche, AmarAo ki temani ImAna Anava’? Asale tArAi nirvodha, kintu tArA tA’ vujhate pAre nA|

yakhana tArA mu’minadera saMsparze Ase takhana vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’; Ara yakhana tArA nibhRte tAdera zaYatvAnadera (sardAradera) saGge milita haYa takhana vale, ‘AmarA tomAdera sAthei Achi, AmarA zudhu tAdera saGge ThATTA-tAmAzA kari mAtra’|
AllAha tAdera saGge (javAve) upahAsa karena evaM tAdera avAdhyatAYa vibhrAntera mata tAderake ghure marAra avakAza dena|
tArAi hidAYAtera vinimaYe gomarAhI kraYa kareche, kintu tAte tAdera vyavasA lAbhajanaka haYani, Ara tArA satpathaprAptao naYa|

tAdera udAharaNa, yemana eka vyakti Aguna jvAlAlo, tA yakhana tAra cAradika Alokita karala AllAha takhana tAdera jyoti apasAraNa kare dilena evaM tAderake emana ghana andhakAre phele dilena ye, tArA kichui dekhate pAYa nA|
tArA vadhira, mUka, andha; kAjei tArA (hidAYAtera dike) phire Asave nA|

athavA yemana AkAzera varSaNamukhara megha, yAte Ache gAr3ha andhakAra, vajradhvani o vidyut camaka, vajradhvanite mRtyu bhaYe tArA tAdera kAne AGgula DhukiYe deYa| AllAha kApheraderake pariveSTana kare Achena|

vidyutcamaka tAdera dRSTizakti prAYa ker3e neYa, yakhanai vidyutcamaka tAdera sAmane prakAzita haYa, takhanai tArA patha calate thAke evaM yakhana tAdera upara andhakAra cheYe yAYa, takhana tArA thamake dA~r3AYa, AllAha icche karale tAdera zravaNa o dRSTi zakti haraNa karate pAratena, AllAha sakala viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
he mAnuSa! ‘tomarA tomAdera sei pratipAlakera ivAdAta kara yini tomAderake o tomAdera pUrvavartIderake sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA muttAkI (paraheyagAra) hate pAra’|

yini tomAdera janya pRthivIke vichAnA o AkAzake chAda karechena evaM AkAza hate pAni varSaNa ka’re tadvArA tomAdera jIvikAra janya phalamUla utpAdana karena, kAjei jene vujhe kAukeo AllAhara samakakSa dA~r3a karo nA|

Ami AmAra vAndAhara prati yA nAyila karechi tAte tomAdera kona sandeha thAkale tomarA tAra mata kona sUrAha ene dAo Ara tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao, tave AllAha chAr3A tomAdera sakala sAhAyyakArIke AhavAna kara|
yadi tomarA nA pAra evaM kakSano pAraveo nA, tAhale sei Agunake bhaYa kara, yAra indhana have mAnuSa evaM pAthara, yA prastuta raYeche kApheradera janya|

yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare tAderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janya Ache jAnnAta, yAra nimnadeze nadIsamUha pravAhita| tAderake yakhanai phalamUla khete deYA have, takhanai tArA valave, AmAderake pUrve jIvikA hiseve yA deYA hato, eto tArai mato| ekai rakama phala tAderake deYA have evaM sekhAne raYeche tAdera janya pavitra saGgiNI, tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have|

nizcaYa AllAhato mazA athavA tAra ceYeo kSudra kona vastura udAharaNa dite lajjAvodha karena nA; ataeva yArA ImAnadAra tArA jAne ye, e satya tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa theke eseche, kintu yArA avizvAsI tArA vale ye, AllAha kI uddezye e udAharaNa peza karechena? (Asala vyApAra hala) tini era dvArA anekakei vibhrAnta karena, AvAra anekakei satpathe paricAlita karena| vastutaH tini phAsikadera chAr3A Ara kAukeo vibhrAnta karena nA|
yArA AllAhara saGge sudRr3ha aGgIkAra karAra para tA bhaGga kare evaM ye samparka akSuNNa rAkhAra nirdeza AllAha karechena, tA chinna kare evaM pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi kare, tArAi kSatigrasta|

tomarA AllAhake kIbhAve asvIkAra karacha? athaca tomarA chile mRta, ataHpara tini tomAderake jIvanta karechena, AvAra tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena, tArapara AvAra jIvita karavena, tArapara tA~ra dikei tomarA phire yAve|
pRthivIra savakichu tini tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena, tArapara tini AkAzera dike manosaMyoga karena evaM tA saptAkAze vinyasta karena, tini sakala viSaYe vizeSabhAve avahita|

smaraNa kara, tomAra pratipAlaka yakhana pherezatAderake valalena, ‘Ami yamIne pratinidhi sRSTi karachi’; tArA valala, ‘Apani ki sekhAne emana kAukeo paYadA karavena ye azAnti sRSTi karave o raktapAta ghaTAve? AmarAi to ApanAra prazaMsAmUlaka tAsavIha pATha o pavitratA ghoSaNA kari’| tini valalena, ‘Ami yA jAni, tomarA tA jAna nA’|
evaM tini AdAma (A.)-ke sakala vastura nAma zikSA dilena, tArapara segulo pherezatAdera sAmane upasthApana karalena evaM valalena, ‘e vastugulora nAma AmAke vale dAo, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao’|
tArA valala, ‘Apani pavitra mahAna, Apani AmAderake yA zikSA diYechena, tAchAr3A AmAdera kona jJAnai nei, nizcaYai Apani sarvajJa o prajJAmaYa’|

tini nirdeza karalena, ‘he AdAma! e jinisagulora nAma tAderake jAniYe dAo’| yakhana se e sakala nAma tAderake vale dila, takhana tini valalena, ‘Ami ki tomAderake valini ye, nabhomanDala o bhUmanDalera adRzya vastu samparke Ami nizcitabhAve avahita evaM tomarA yA prakAza kara o gopana kara, Ami tAo avagata’?
yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valalAma, AdAmake sAjadAha kara, takhana ivalIsa chAr3A sakalei sAjadAha karala, se amAnya karala o ahaGkAra karala, kAjei se kAphiradera antarbhukta haYe gela|
Ami valalAma, ‘he AdAma! tumi o tomAra strI jAnnAte vasavAsa kara evaM yekhAne yA icche khAo, kintu ei gAchera nikaTe yeYo nA, gele tomarA sImAlaGghanakArIdera madhye zAmila have’|

kintu zaYatvAna tAttheke tAdera padaskhalana ghaTAla evaM tArA du’jana yekhAne chila, tAderake sekhAna theke vera kare dila; Ami valalAma, ‘neme yAo, tomarA paraspara parasparera zatru, duniYAte kichu kAlera janya tomAdera vasavAsa o jIvikA Ache’|
tArapara AdAma (A.) tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate kichu vANI prApta hala, ataHpara AllAha tAra prati kSamA pradarzana karalena, tini atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ami valalAma, ‘tomarA sakalei ekhAna hate neme yAo, pare yakhana AmAra nikaTa hate tomAdera kAche satpathera nirdeza Asave takhana yArA AmAra satpathera anusaraNa karave tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA’|
Ara yArA kupharI karave o AmAra nidarzanaguloke asvIkAra karave, tArAi jAhAnnAmI; sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|

he vAnI isarAIla! AmAra sei anugrahake smaraNa kara, yadvArA Ami tomAderake anugRhIta karechi evaM AmAra saGge tomAdera aGgIkAra pUrNa kara, Amio tomAdera saGge AmAra aGgIkAra pUrNa karava evaM tomarA kevala AmAkei bhaYa kara|

Ara tomarA ImAna Ana sei kitAvera prati, yA tomAdera nikaTa Ache tAra pratyaYanakArI evaM tomarAi tAra prathama pratyAkhyAnakArI haYo nA evaM AmAra AYAtera vinimaYe sAmAnya mUlya grahaNa karo nA, tomarA kevala AmAkei bhaYa kara|
tomarA satyake mithyera sAthe mizrita karo nA evaM jene zune satya gopana karo nA|
tomarA nAmAya kAYima kara, yAkAta dAo evaM rukU‘kArIdera saGge rukU‘ kara|
tomarA ki mAnuSake satkarmera nirdeza dive evaM nijedera kathA bhule yAve, athaca tomarA kitAva pATha kara, tave ki tomarA vujha nA?
tomarA dhairyya o salAtera mAdhyame sAhAyya prArthanA kara, Ara tA AllAhabhIru vyaktivarga chAr3A anya sakalera kAche nizcitabhAve kaThina|
yArA nizcita vizvAsa kare ye, tAdera pratipAlakera saGge tAdera sAkSAt ghaTavei evaM tA~rai dike tArA phire yAve|
he vAnI isarAIla! AmAra sei anugrahake smaraNa kara yadvArA Ami tomAderake anugRhIta karechilAma evaM pRthivIte sakalera upare tomAderake zreSThatva diYechilAma|
tomarA sedinake bhaYa kara yedina keu kAro upakAre Asave nA evaM kArao supAriza gRhIta have nA evaM kArao nikaTa theke kSatipUraNa grahaNa karA have nA Ara tArA kona rakama sAhAyyao pAve nA|

smaraNa kara, Ami yakhana tomAderake pherAuna goSThI hate mukti diYechilAma, yArA tomAdera putra santAnake hatyA ka’re Ara tomAdera nArIderake jIvita rekhe tomAderake marmAntika yAtanA dita Ara ete tomAdera prabhura pakSa hate chila mahAparIkSA|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAdera janya sAgarake vibhakta karechilAma evaM tomAderake uddhAra karechilAma evaM pherAuna goSThIke nimajjita karechilAma Ara tomarA tA ceYe ceYe dekhachile|
yakhana mUsAra upara calliza rajanIra oYA‘dA karechilAma (kitAva pradAnera janya), tAra (prasthAnera) para tomarA takhana vAchurake upAsyarUpe grahaNa karechile, vastutaH tomarA to chile yAlima|
eraparao Ami tomAderake kSamA karechi yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami mUsAke kitAva o phurakAna diYechilAma, yAte tomarA satpatha avalamvana kara|

smaraNa kara, mUsA yakhana Apana kaomera lokake valala, ‘he AmAra kaoma! vAchurake upAsyarUpe grahaNa ka’re tomarA nijedera prati kaThina atyAcAra karecha, kAjei tomarA tomAdera sRSTikartAra nikaTa tAovAha kara evaM tomarA nijederake (niraparAdhIrA aparAdhIderake) hatyA kara, tomAdera sraSTAra nikaTa eTAi zreYa, ataHpara tini tomAdera prati kSamA pradarzana karalena, tini atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|’

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA valechile, ‘he mUsA! AmarA AllAhake sarAsari nA dekhA paryanta tomAke kakSano vizvAsa karava nA’| takhana vajra tomAderake pAkar3Ao karechila Ara tomarA nijerAi tA pratyakSa karachile|
ataHpara tomAdera mRtyura para Ami tomAderake AvAra jIvita karalAma, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

Ami megha dvArA tomAdera upara chAYA vistAra karalAma, tomAdera kAche mAnnA o sAlaoYA preraNa karalAma, (Ara valalAma)tomAderake yA dAna karechi tAtheke vaidha vastugulo khAo, Ara mUlata tArA AmAra prati kona yulama kareni, varaM tArA nijedera pratii yulama karechila|

smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami valalAma, e janapade praveza kara, sekhAne yA icche svacchande AhAra kara, dvAra diYe natazire praveza kara evaM vala; ‘kSamA cAi’| Ami tomAdera aparAdha kSamA karava evaM satkarmazIladera prati AmAra dAna vRddhi karava|
kintu yArA atyAcAra karechila tArA tAderake yA valA haYechila tAra parivarte anya kathA valala, kAjei yAlimadera prati Ami AkAza hate zAsti preraNa karalAma, kAraNa tArA satya tyAga karechila|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA (A.) tAra kaomera janya pAni prArthanA karala, Ami valalAma, ‘tomAra lAThi dvArA pAthare AghAta kara’| phale tAtheke vAraTi jharNA pravAhita hala, pratyeka gotra nija nija pAnera jAYagA cine nila,(valalAma) ‘AllAha pradatta riyka hate tomarA pAnAhAra kara evaM duSkRtikArIra mata pRthivIte phAsAda sRSTi karo nA’|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA valechile, ‘he mUsA! AmarA ekai rakama khAdye kakSano dhairya dhAraNa karava nA, kAjei tumi tomAra pratipAlakera kAche AmAdera janya du‘A kara, tini yena bhUmi hate utpAdita dravya zAka-savji, kA~kar3a, gama, masura o pe~YAja AmAdera janya utpAdana karena’| mUsA valalaH ‘tomarA ki utkRSTa vastuke nikRSTa vastura saGge vadala karate cAo, tave kona nagare praveza kara; tomarA yA cAo tA sekhAne Ache’ evaM tAderake lAJchanA o dAridrera kazAghAta karA hala o tArA AllAhara kope patita hala| tA ejanya ye, tArA AllAhara nidarzanake asvIkAra karata evaM nAvIgaNake anyAYabhAve hatyA karata| avAdhyatA o sImAlaGghana karAra janyai tAdera e pariNati haYechila|

nizcaYa yArA ImAna eneche, yArA iYAhUdI haYeche evaM khRSTAna o sAviIna- yArAi AllAha o zeSa divase vizvAsa kare o satkAja kare, tAdera janya puraskAra tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhita have nA|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAdera zapatha niya়echilAma evaM tUra parvatake tomAdera upara tule dharechilAma, valechilAma, ‘Ami yA dilAma dRDha়tAra sAthe grahaNa kara evaM tAte yA Ache tA smaraNa rekha, yena tomarA sAvadhAna haya়e calate pAra’|
erapareo tomarA mukha phiriYe nile; AllAhara anugraha o anukampA tomAdera prati nA thAkale tomarA avazyai kSatigrastadera paryAYabhukta haYe yete|
tomAdera madhye yArA zanivAra samparke sImAlaGghana karechila, tAderake tomarA avazyai jAna, Ami tAderake valechilAma, ‘tomarA ghRNita vAnare pariNata hao’|
Ami tA tAdera samasAmaYika o paravartIgaNera zikSA grahaNera janya dRSTAnta evaM muttAkIdera janya upadeza svarUpa karechi|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA (A.) svIYa sampradAYake valechila, ‘AllAha tomAderake ekaTi garu yavaha karAra Adeza dicchena’; tArA valechila, ‘tumi ki AmAdera saGge ThATTA karacho’? mUsA valala, AllAhara AzraYa nicchi, yAte Ami ajJadera antarbhukta nA hai|

tArA valala, ‘AmAdera janya tomAra pratipAlakake spaSTabhAve jAniYe dite vala tA kIrUpa’? mUsA valala, ‘AllAha valachena, tA emana eka garu yA vRddhao naYa evaM alpa vaYaskao naYa- madhya vaYasI| sutarAM yA (karate) AdiSTa haYecha, tA pAlana kara’|

tArA valala, ‘AmAdera janya tomAra pratipAlakake spaSTabhAve jAniYe dite vala, ora raM kI’? mUsA valala, ‘AllAha valachena, tA haluda varNera garu, tAra raM ujjvala gAr3ha, yA darzakaderake Ananda deYa’|
tArA valala, ‘AmAdera janya tomAra pratipAlakake spaSTabhAve jAniYe dite vala garuTi kemana? kAraNa sava garu AmAdera kAche samAna, Ara AllAha icchA karale nizcaYa AmarA pathera dizA pAva|’

mUsA valala, ‘tini valachena, tA emana eka garu yA jami cASe o kSete pAni secera janya vyavahRta haYani varaM sustha o nikhu~ta’| tArA valala, ‘ekhana tumi satya prakAza karecha’| tArA tAke yavaha karala yadio tAdera janya seTA prAYa asambhava chila|
smaraNa kara, tomarA yakhana eka vyaktike hatyA karechile evaM eke anyera prati doSAropa karachile, tomarA yA gopana karachile AllAha tA prakAza kare dilena|

Ami valalAma, ‘tAra (arthAt yavahakRta garura) kona aMza dvArA eke AghAta kara’| ebhAve AllAha mRtake jIvana dAna karena, Ara tomAderake tA~ra nidarzana dekhiYe thAkena yAte tomarA jJAnalAbha karate pAra|

eraparao tomAdera hRdaYa kaThina haYe gela, tA pAthara kiMvA tadapekSA kaThina| kataka pAtharao emana Ache ye tA hate jharNAdhArA pravAhita haYa evaM kataka erUpa ye, pheTe yAoYAra para tA hate pAni nirgata haYa| AvAra kataka emana yA AllAhara bhaYe dhvase par3e evaM tomarA yA kara AllAha se samvandhe vekheYAla nana|
tomarA ki ei AzA kara ye, tArA tomAdera kathAYa ImAna Anave? athaca tAdera ekadala AllAhara vANI zravaNa karata o vujhAra para jene zune tA vikRta karata|

yakhana tArA mu’minadera saMsparze Ase takhana vale, ‘AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karechi’| AvAra yakhana tArA nibhRte eke anyera saGge milita haYa takhana vale, ‘AllAha tomAdera kAche yA (tAorAte) vyakta karechena [muhAmmAda (sA.) samparke] tomarA ki tA tAderake vale dAo yAte era dvArA tArA tomAdera pratipAlakera sammukhe tomAdera viruddhe yukti peza karave? tomarA ki vujha nA’?
tAdera ki jAnA nei ye, yA tArA gopana rAkhe athavA prakAza kare avazyai AllAha tA jAnena?
tAdera mAjhe emana kichu nirakSara loka Ache, yAdera mithyA AkAGkSA chAr3A kitAvera kona jJAnai nei, tArA kevala alIka dhAraNA poSaNa kare|

sutarAM abhisampAta tAdera janya yArA nija hAte kitAva racanA kare evaM nikRSTa mUlya lAbhera janya vale eTA AllAhara nikaTa hate, tAdera hAta yA racanA kareche tAra janya tAdera zAsti avadhArita evaM tArA yA upArjana kare tAra janyao zAsti raYeche|

tArA vale, ‘guTi kaYeka dina chAr3A Aguna kakSano AmAderake sparza karave nA’| vala, ‘tomarA ki AllAhara nikaTa hate pratizruti niYecho ye pratizruti AllAha bhaGga karavena nA? kiMvA AllAha samparke emana kichu valacha, yA tomarA jAna nA’|
tave hA~, yArA pApa kAja kare evaM yAdera pAparAzi tAderake ghire phele tArAi jAhAnnAmI, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane o neka ‘AmAla kare tArAi jAnnAtavAsI, tArA sekhAne cirasthAYI have|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana vAnI isarAIlera zapatha niYechilAma ye, tomarA AllAha chAr3A anya kAro ‘ivAdAta karave nA, mAtA-pitA, AtmIYa-svajana, anAtha o daridradera prati sadaYa vyavahAra karave evaM mAnuSera sAthe sadAlApa karave, nAmAya kAYima karave evaM yAkAta dive| kintu alpa saMkhyaka loka chAr3A tomarA agrAhyakArI haYe mukha phiriYe nile|

Ara yakhana tomAdera zapatha niYechilAma ye, tomarA eke anyera raktapAta karave nA evaM svajanaderake svadeza hate vahiSkAra karave nA, tArapara tomarA tA svIkAra karechile Ara e viSaYe tomarAi sAkSI|

paranta tomarAi sei loka yArA paraspara nijederake hatyA karacha evaM tomAdera ekadalake svadeza theke vahiSkAra karacha, tomarA nijerA tAdera viruddhe anyAYa o sImAlaGghana kare parasparera sahayogitA karacha evaM tArA yakhana vandIrUpe tomAdera nikaTa hAjira haYa, takhana tomarA muktipaNa AdAYa kara, mUlataH tAdera vahiSkaraNai tomAdera janya chila niSiddha; tAhale ki tomarA kitAvera kichu aMzake vizvAsa kara evaM kichu aMzake pratyAkhyAna kara? ataeva tomAdera yArA emana kare tAdera pArthiva jagate lAJchanA o avamAnanA chAr3A Ara kI pratidAna hate pAre? evaM kviYAmAtera dina tArA kaThina zAstira madhye nikSipta have, Ara tArA yA kare se samparke AllAha gAphela nana|
tArAi parakAlera vinimaYe pArthiva jIvana kraYa kare| kAjei tAdera zAsti kama karA have nA evaM tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|

evaM nizcaYai Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi evaM tAra pare kramAnvaYe rasUladerake preraNa karechi, mAraiYAma putra IsAke suspaSTa pramANa diYechi evaM ‘pavitra AtmA’yoge (jivarAIlera mAdhyame) tAke zaktizAlI karechi, ataHpara yakhanai kona rasUla emana kichu eneche yA tomAdera manaHputa naYa, takhanai tomarA ahaMkAra karecha evaM kichu saMkhyakake asvIkAra karecha evaM kichu saMkhyakake hatyA karecha|
tArA dAvI karechila ye, ‘AmAdera hRdaYa AcchAdita’, varaM kupharI karAra kAraNe AllAha tAderake abhisampAta karechena, ataeva tAdera alpa saMkhyakai ImAna Ane|

tAdera kAche yA Ache, tAra samarthaka kitAva yakhana AllAhara nikaTa theke Asala, yadio pUrve kAphiradera viruddhe tArA era sAhAyye vijaYa prArthanA karata, Ara seTAke tArA cinateo pArala, tavuo yakhana tA tAdera nikaTa Asala, takhana tArA tA avizvAsa karala; sutarAM avizvAsakArIdera prati AllAhara abhisampAta|

tA katai nA nikRSTa yAra vinimaYe tArA nijedera AtmAke vikri kareche, tA ei ye, AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena, jidera vaze tArA tA pratyAkhyAna karata zudhu ejanya ye, AllAha tA~ra vAndAhadera madhya hate yAke icche anugraha karena, ataeva tArA krodhera upara krodhera pAtra hala evaM kAphiradera janyai lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tAte ImAna Ana’; tArA vale, ‘AmAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tAte AmarA vizvAsa kari’| athaca paravartI kitAvake (kuraAnake) tArA pratyAkhyAna kare, yadio tA satya evaM yA tAdera nikaTa Ache tAra samarthaka| vala, ‘yadi tomarA vizvAsI chile tave kena tomarA pUrve nAvIderake hatyA karechile’?
evaM nizcaYai mUsA tomAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANasaha eseche, tArapareo tomarA yAlima seje go-vatsake upAsyarUpe grahaNa karechile|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAdera zapatha niYechilAma evaM tUra parvatake tomAdera Urdhve tulechilAma evaM valechilAma, ‘yA dilAma tA dRr3harUpe dhAraNa kara evaM zravaNa kara’| tArA valechila, AmarA zunalAma o amAnya karalAma| kuphurIra kAraNe tAdera antare go-vatsa-prIti zikar3a ger3e vasechila| vala, ‘yadi tomarA vizvAsI hao, tave tomAdera vizvAsa yAra nirdeza deYa, tA katai nA nikRSTa’!
vala, ‘yadi AllAhara nikaTa parakAlera vAsasthAna anyaloka chAr3A kevalamAtra tomAdera janyai haYa, tAhale tomarA mRtyu kAmanA kara, yadi satyavAdI haYe thAka’|
kintu tAdera kRtakarmera janya tArA kakSano tA kAmanA karave nA evaM AllAha yAlimadera samparke khuvai avahita|

avazyai tumi tAderake ve~ce thAkAra vyApAre sakala mAnuSa emanaki muzarika apekSAo adhika lobhI dekhate pAve, tAdera pratyekei AkAGkSA kare yadi hAjAra vachara AYu deYA hata, kintu dIrghAYu tAderake zAsti hate rehAi dite pArave nA, tArA yA kare, AllAha tAra draSTA|

vala, ‘ye vyakti jivarAIlera zatru haYeche, (se rAge mare yAka) kenanA se to AllAhara hukume tomAra antare kuraAna pau~chiYe diYeche, yA era pUrvavartI kitAvera samarthaka evaM yAte ImAnadAradera janya pathanirdeza o susaMvAda raYeche’|
ye vyakti AllAhara, tA~ra pherezatAdera o tA~ra rasUlagaNera evaM jivarAIlera o mIkAilera zatru sAjave, nizcaYai AllAhao (esava) kAphiradera zatru|
evaM Ami tomAra nikaTa suspaSTa AYAta nAyila karechi, phAsikarA chAr3A anya keu tA asvIkAra kare nA|
eTA ki naYa ye tArA yakhanai kona aGgIkAra kare, takhanai tAdera kona nA kona dala sei aGgIkArake varjana kare? varaM tAdera adhikAMzai ImAna rAkhe nA|

evaM yakhana tAdera kAche AllAhara pakSa hate rasUla Asala ye edera nikaTa ye kitAva raYeche, sei kitAvera samarthaka, takhana yAderake kitAva deYA haYechila tAdera ekadala AllAhara kitAvake piThera pichane phele dila, yena tArA kichui jAne nA|

evaM sulAYamAnera rAjatvakAle zaYatvAnarA yA pATha karata, tArA tA anusaraNa karata, mUlataH sulAYamAna kupharI kareni varaM zaYatvAnarAi kuphurI karechila, tArA mAnuSake yAdu zikSA dita evaM yA vAvilera du’jana pherezatA hArUta o mArUtera upara pau~chAno haYechila evaM pherezatAdvaYa kAukeo (tA) zikhAto nA ye paryanta nA valata, AmarA parIkSA svarUpa, kAjei tumi kupharI kara nA,etadasattveo tArA ubhaYera nikaTa hate emana jinisa zikSA karato, yadvArA tArA svAmI-strIra madhye viccheda sRSTi karato, mUlataH tArA tAdera e kAja dvArA AllAhara vinA hukume kArao kSati karate pArata nA, vastutaH erA emana vidyA zikhata, yaddvArA tAdera kSati sAdhita hata Ara edera kona upakAra hata nA evaM avazyai tArA jAnata ye, ye vyakti ai kAja avalamvana karave parakAle tAra konai aMza thAkave nA, Ara yAra parivarte tArA svIYa AtmAguloke vikraYa kareche, tA katai nA jaghanya, yadi tArA jAnata!
Ara yadi tArA ImAna Anata evaM muttAkI hata tave AllAhara nikaTa zreSThatara suphala chila, yadi tArA jAnata!

he vizvAsIgaNa! tomarA ‘rA‘enA’ vale samvodhana karo nA, (yAra artha AmAdera rAkhAla) varaM tomarA valave ‘‘unayuranA’’ (arthAt AmAdera prati nekadRSTi divena!) evaM zune nAo, vastutaH avizvAsIdera janyai raYeche kaSTadAYaka zAsti|

granthadhArIdera madhye yArA avizvAsI tArA o muzarikarA eTA cAYa nA ye, tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate tomAdera prati kona kalyANa avatIrNa hoka athaca AllAha yAke icche svIYa daYAYa nirdiSTa kare nena evaM AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|
Ami kona AYAta rahita karale kiMvA bhuliYe dile, tAttheke uttama kiMvA tArai mata AYAta niYe Asi, tumi ki jAna nA ye, AllAha pratyeka vastura upara kSamatAvAna|
tumi ki jAna nA ye, AkAzamanDalI o bhUmanDalera rAjatva sei AllAharai evaM AllAha chAr3A tomAdera konao abhibhAvaka nei evaM sAhAyyakArIo nei|
tomarA ki tomAdera rasUlake temana prazna karate cAo yemana mUsAke prazna karA haYechila? ye vyakti ImAnera parivarte kupharI kare, se vyakti avazyai sarala patha hate vicyuta haYa|

granthadhArIgaNera anekei tAdera kAche satya spaSTa haYe yAoYAra parao tAdera antare poSita hiMsAra dAhane icche poSaNa kare ye, yadi tomAderake tomAdera ImAna AnAra para kupharIte phiriYe nite pArata; sutarAM tomarA kSamA kara o mArjanA kara ye paryanta nA AllAha svIYa hukuma prakAza karena, nizcaYai AllAha sakala vastura upara kSamatAvAna|

evaM tomarA nAmAya kAYima kara evaM yAkAta dAo evaM yA kichu sat kAryAvalI tomarA svIYa AtmAra janye Age pAThAve, tomarA tA AllAhara nikaTa pAve, tomarA yA kichu karacho nizcaYai AllAha tA’ dekhachena|
tArA vale, iYAhUdI evaM nAsArAgaNa chAr3A keu jAnnAte praveza karate pArave nA, oTA tAdera AkAGkSA mAtra| vala, ‘yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao, tave nijedera dalIla peza kara’|
varaM ye vyakti AllAhara kAche AtmasamarpaNa kare Ara satkarmazIla haYa, tAra janya tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa puNyaphala raYeche, tAdera kona bhaYa nei, tAdera kona duHkha nei|

Ara iYAhUdIrA vale ye, nAsArAdera mAyahAvera kona bhitti nei; nAsArArA vale ye, iYAhUdIdera mAyahAvera kona bhitti nei, athaca tArA kitAva pATha kare, ebhAve yArA kichu jAne nA tArAo odera matai vale, yAra samvandhe tArA matavirodha karache, AllAha kviYAmAtera dina tAdera madhye sei viSaYera samAdhAna karavena|

tAra ceYe var3a yAlema ke, ye vyakti AllAhara mAsajidagulote AllAhara nAma nite vAdhA deYa evaM ogulora dhvaMsa sAdhanera ceSTA kare? athaca bhaYe bhIta nA haYe tAdera janya mAsajide praveza saGgata chila nA, edera janya duniYAte Ache lAJchanA evaM parakAle tAdera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti|
pUrva pazcima AllAharai, sutarAM tomarA ye dikei mukha kara nA kena, sedikei Ache AllAhara cehArA, AllAha suvistRta, sarvajJa|
tArA vale ye, AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena, tini ati pavitra, varaM yA kichu AkAzasamUhe evaM bhU-manDale Ache samastai tA~ra, sakalai tA~ra anugata|
AllAha AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sRjanakArI, yakhana kona kAja karate manastha karena, takhana tAra janya zudhu valena, haYe yAo, takSuni tA haYe yAYa|

yArA kichu jAne nA tArA vale, kena AllAha AmAdera saGge kathA valena nA? kiMvA AmAdera nikaTa kona nirdeza kena Ase nA? ebhAve Agera lokerAo tAdera matai valata, edera antaragulo ekai rakama, Ami dRr3ha vizvAsIdera janya nidarzanAvalI pariSkArabhAve vivRta karechi|
Ami tomAke satyadvInasaha susaMvAdadAtA evaM bhaYa pradarzanakArI hiseve preraNa karechi, jAhAnnAmIdera samvandhe tomAke kona prazna karA have nA|

iYAhUdI o nAsArArA tomAra prati rAjI have nA ye paryanta nA tumi tAdera dharmera Adarza grahaNa kara| vala, ‘AllAhara dekhAno pathai prakRta supatha evaM tumi yadi jJAna AsAra pareo edera icche anuyAYI cala, tAhale tomAra janya AllAhara krodha hate rakSA karAra mata kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA’|
Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi, tArA yathAyathabhAve kitAva tilAoYAta kare, tArAi ete vizvAsa poSaNa kare Ara yArA era prati avizvAsa kare, tArAi kSatigrasta|
he vAnI isarAIla! AmAra sei anugraha smaraNa kara, yA Ami tomAdera prati karechi evaM Ami tomAderake vizvajagatera sakalera upara zreSThatva diYechi|
Ara tomarA sei dinera bhaYa kara, ye dina keu kAro kona kAje Asave nA evaM kAro pakSa hate kona kSatipUraNa grahaNa karA have nA evaM kArao supAriza phala dive nA evaM tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|

evaM smaraNa kara yakhana ivarAhImake tAra pratipAlaka katipaYa viSaYe parIkSA karalena, ataHpara se segulo pUrNa karala, takhana AllAha valalena, ‘Ami tomAke mAnavajAtira netA karachi’| ivrAhIma Araya karala, ‘Ara AmAra vaMzadhara hateo’? nirdeza hala, AmAra aGgIkArera madhye yAlimarA zAmila naYa|

evaM smaraNa kara yakhana Ami kA‘vAgRhake mAnuSera janya milanakendra evaM nirApadasthala karalAma evaM valalAma, ‘mAkAme ivarAhImake salAtera sthAna hiseve grahaNa kara’ evaM ivarAhIma o isamAIlake valechilAma, ‘AmAra gRhake tAoYAphakArI, i‘tikAphakArI evaM rukU o sAjadAhakArIdera janya pavitra rAkhave’|

smaraNa kara yakhana ivarAhIma prArthanA karechila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi e zaharake nirApadasthala kara evaM era adhivAsIdera madhye yArA AllAha o parakAlera upara ImAna Ane, tAderake phalamUla hate jIvikA pradAna kara’| nirdeza hala, ‘ye keu kupharI karave tAkeo Ami kichu dinera janya upakAra lAbha karate deva evaM tArapara tAke jAhAnnAmera Agune dAkhila karava, Ara katai nA nikRSTa tAdera pherAra jAYagA’!
Ara (smaraNa kara) yakhana ivrAhIma o isamAIla kAvAgRhera bhitti tulachila, takhana prArthanA karala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera pakSa theke kavula kara, nizcaYai tumi sarvazrotA o sarvajJAtA’|

he AmAdera pratipAlaka! ‘AmAderake tomAra anugata kara, AmAdera khAndAne ekadala sRSTi kara, yArA tomAra AjJAvaha haYa Ara AmAderake ivAdAtera niYama-kAnuna zikSA dAo evaM AmAdera aparAdha kSamA kara, nizcaYai tumi atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|

‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! edera kAche ekajana rasUla edera madhya hate preraNa kara, ye ederake tomAra AYAtagulo par3e zunAve evaM ederake kitAva o jJAna-vijJAna zikSA deve evaM ederake vizuddha karave, nizcaYa tumi kSamatAzAlI, prajJAmaYa|’
sei nirvodha chAr3A anya emana ke Ache ye millAte ivrAhIma hate phire yAve evaM nizcaYa Ami tAke pachanda karechi evaM AkherAteo se nekakAradera antargata have|
tAra pratipAlaka yakhana tAke valechilena, ‘tumi AtmasamarpaNa kara’, uttare se valala, ‘Ami sArA jagatera pratipAlakera kAche AtmasamarpaNa karalAma’|

Ara e viSaYe ivarAhIma o iYA‘kUva svIYa putragaNake antima upadeza dAna kare geche- ‘he putragaNa! AllAha e dvInake tomAdera janya pachanda karechena; kAjei tomarA musalima nA haYe mRtyuvaraNa karo nA’|

tomarA ki se samaYa upasthita chile, yakhana iYAkuvera mRtyu ese pau~chechila? takhana se tAra putraderake jijJesa karechila, ‘AmAra pare tomarA kAra upAsanA karave’? putragaNa uttara diYechila, ‘AmarA ApanAra evaM ApanAra pUrvapuruSa ivarAhIma, isamAIla o isahAkera upAsyera upAsanA karava, yini advitIYa upAsya evaM AmarA tA~rai prati Atmasamarpita|
e lokerA gata haYe geche, tAdera janya tAdera kRtakarma evaM tomAdera janya tomAdera kRtakarma evaM tAdera kRtakarma samvandhe tomAderake jijJesa karA have nA|
orA vale, ‘tomarA iYAhUdI vA nAsArA haYe yAo tAhale saThika patha pAve’| vala, ‘varaM ekaniSTha haYe ivarAhImera dharmAdarza anusaraNa kara Ara tini muzarikadera antargata chilena nA’|

tomarA vala, ‘AmarA AllAhara upara ImAna enechi evaM yA AmAdera prati nAyila karA haYeche evaM yA ivarAhIma o isamA‘Ila evaM isahAka o iYAkUva o vaMzadharadera prati avatIrNa karA haYeche evaM yA mUsA o ‘IsAke deYA haYeche Ara yA anyAnya nAvIgaNake tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate deYA haYeche (e savera pratio ImAna enechi), AmarA edera madhya hate kona ekajanera vyApAreo kona pArthakya kari nA evaM AmarA tA~rai kAche Atmasamarpita’|

sutarAM erA yadi temana ImAna Ane, yemana tomarA ImAna enecho, tAhale tArA saThika patha pAve Ara yadi asvIkAra kare, tave tArA bhedAbhede lipta, se avasthAYa tomAra janya tAdera (aniSTa hate vA~cAra janya) AllAhi yatheSTa evaM tinii sarvazrotA o sarvajJAtA|
(AmAdera dvIna) AllAhara raGe raJjita evaM AllAhara raGa apekSA Ara kAra raGa uttama have? evaM AmarA tA~rai ‘ivAdAtakArI|

vala, ‘tomarA ki AllAhara samvandhe AmAdera sAthe jhagar3A karacha? athaca tini AmAderao pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka evaM AmAdera janya AmAdera kRtakarma evaM tomAdera janya tomAdera kRtakarma evaM AmarA tA~ra prati ekaniSTha|’

tomarA ki valacha, ivarAhIma o isamAIla evaM isahAka o iYAkUva evaM tAra vaMzadhara sakalei iYAhUdI kiMvA nAsArA chila’? vala,‘ tomarAi vezI jAna nAki AllAha’? ai vyakti hate var3a yAlima Ara ke have, ye AllAhara pakSa hate Agata sAkSyake gopana kare? tomarA yA kichu karacha, AllAha se viSaYe gAphila nana|
e sava loka yArA chila, tArA gata haYe geche, tAdera janya tAdera kAmAi Ara tomAdera janya tomAdera kAmAi Ara tArA yA karata se samparke tomAderake jijJesa karA have nA|
zIghrai e nirvodherA valave, kise tAderake phiriYe dila tAdera sei kvivalA hate yA tArA anusaraNa kare Asachila| vala, pUrva evaM pazcima AllAharai, tini yAke icche sarala patha pradarzana karena|

Ara ebhAve Ami tomAderake madhyapanthI ummAta karechi, yAte tomarA lokedera upara sAkSI hao evaM nAvI tomAdera upara sAkSI haYa| Ara tumi e yAvat ye kvivalAra upara chile, tAke e uddezye kvivalA karechilAma, yAte Ami jAnate pAri ke rasUlera anusaraNa kare Ara ke pAYera bhare ulTo dike phire yAYa| AllAha yAderake hidAYAta diYechena tArA vAde anyera nikaTa eTA var3ai kaSTakara chila| Ara AllAha tomAdera ImAna vinaSTa karavena nA, nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera prati karuNAzIla, ati daYAlu|

nizcaYai Ami tomAra AkAzera dike mukha phiriYe dekhAke lakSya karechi, ye kvivalA tumi pachanda kara, Ami tomAke sedike phire yete Adeza karachi| tumi mAsajidula hArAmera dike mukha phirAo evaM tomarA yekhAnei thAka, orai dike mukha phirAo; vastutaH yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche tAdera jAnA Ache ye, kvivalAra parivartana tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate prakRtai satya evaM tArA yA kare AllAha se samparke moTei gAphila nana|

Ara yadi tumi kitAvadhArIdera sAmane samudaYa dalIla hAjira kara, tavuo tArA tomAra kvivalAra anusaraNa karave nA Ara tumio tAdera kvivalAra anusaraNakArI nao, Ara tArA eke aparera kvivalAra anusaraNakArI naYa| yadi tumi tomAra nikaTa jJAna AsAra pareo tAdera managar3A matavAdasamUhera anusaraNa kara, se avasthAYa tumio avAdhya dalerai antarbhukta have|
Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi, tArA tAke se rakamai cine, yemana cine nijera putraderake, Ara odera katakaloka jene zune satyake gopana kare thAke|
prakRta satya tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hatei (eseche), kAjei tomarA sandehakArIdera antarbhukta haYo nA|

pratyekera janyai ekaTA nirdiSTa lakSya Ache, sedikei se mukha kare| kAjei tomarA sat kAjera dike dhAvamAna hao| yekhAnei tomarA avasthAna kara, AllAha tomAdera sakalake ekatrita karavena| nizcaYai AllAha sakala vastura upara kSamatAvAna|

Ara tumi yekhAna thekei vera hao, nijera mukha mAsajide hArAmera dike pherAo, nizcaYai tA tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate pAThAno satya, vastutaH tomarA yA karacha AllAha se samparke moTei gAphila nana|

tumi yekhAna thekei vera hao, nijera mukha mAsajide hArAmera dike phirAo, tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena, nijedera mukhagulo ora dike kario, yAte tAdera madhyekAra yAlima loka chAr3A anyAnya lokedera tomAdera viruddhe kona kathA valAra nA thAke, kAjei tAderake bhaYa karo nA, AmAkei bhaYa kara, yAte Ami tomAdera prati AmAra ni‘mAta pUrNa karate pAri, yAte tomarA satya pathe paricAlita hate pAra|

yemana (tomarA AmAra ekaTi anugraha lAbha karecha ye) Ami tomAderai madhya hate tomAdera kAche ekajana rasUla pAThiYechi, ye AmAra AYAtagulo tomAderake par3e zunAYa, tomAderake zuddha kare, tomAderake kitAva o jJAna-vijJAna (sunnAta) zikSA deYa evaM tomAderake emana sava viSaYa zikSA deYa yA tomarA jAnate nA|
kAjei tomarA AmAke smaraNa kara, Amio tomAderake smaraNa karava evaM AmAra zokara karate thAka, nA-zokarI karo nA|
he mu’minagaNa! dhairya o salAtera mAdhyame sAhAyya prArthanA kara, nizcaYa AllAha dhairyazIladera saGge Achena|
Ara AllAhara pathe nihataderake mRta valo nA, varaM tArA jIvita, kintu tomarA vujha nA|
tomAderake bhaYa o kSudhA evaM dhana-sampada, jIvana o phala-phasalera kSaYa-kSati (esavera) konakichura dvArA nizcaYai parIkSA karava, dhairyazIladerake susaMvAda pradAna kara|
nizcaYai yArA vipadakAle vale thAke, ‘AmarA AllAharai Ara AmarA tA~rai dike pratyAvartanakArI’|
edera prati raYeche tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate anugraha o karuNA Ara erAi hidAYAtaprApta|

nizcaYai ‘sAphA’ evaM ‘mAraoYA’ AllAhara nidarzanagulora anyatama| kAjei ye vyakti kAvAgRhera hAjja athavA ‘umarAha karave, e du’Tora sAI karAte tAdera konai gunAha nei evaM ye vyakti svecchAYa kona sat kAja karave tAhale nizcaYa AllAha (tAra vyApAre) guNagrAhI evaM sarvajJa|

nizcaYai yArA AmAra avatIrNa kona dalIla evaM hidAYAtake lokedera janya Ami kitAvera madhye varNanA karAra pareo gopana kare, AllAha tAderake abhisampAta karena Ara abhisampAtakArIrAo tAdera prati abhisampAta kare thAke|
kintu yArA tAovAha kare evaM saMzodhana kare neYa evaM (satyake) suspaSTabhAve varNanA kare, tAdera tAovAha Ami kavula kari, vastutaH Ami atyadhika tAovAha kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYa yArA kAphira evaM kAphera avasthAtei mArA yAYa, emana lokedera prati AllAhara, pherezatAdera evaM sakala mAnuSera abhisampAta|
tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave, tAdera upara ‘AyAva hAlakA karA have nA Ara tAderake virAmao deYA have nA|
tomAdera upAsya hacchena eka AllAha, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona upAsya nei| tini parama karunAmaYa, ati daYAlu|

nizcaYai AkAzasamUha o pRthivIra sRSTira madhye, rAta o dinera vivartanera madhye, lokera upakArI dravyAdisaha samudre calAcalakArI jalayAnera madhye evaM AkAza hate AllAhara varSita sei pAnira madhye yadvArA tini pRthivIke- mare yAoYAra para AvAra jIvita karena evaM tAte sakala prakAra jIva-jantura vistAraNe evaM vAtAsera gati parivartanera madhye evaM AkAza o bhUmanDalera madhyasthale niYantrita meghapuJjera madhye vivekasampanna lokedera janya nidarzanAvalI raYeche|

Ara kona kona loka emanao Ache, ye AllAha chAr3A anyAnyake AllAhara samakakSarUpe grahaNa kare, AllAhake bhAlavAsAra mata tAderake bhAlavAse| kintu yArA mu’mina AllAhara saGge tAdera bhAlavAsA pragAr3ha evaM kI uttamai hata yadi e yAlimarA zAsti dekhAra para yemana vujhave tA yadi ekhanai vujhata ye, samasta zakti AllAharai janya evaM AllAha zAsti dAne atyanta kaThora|

smaraNa kara, yAderake anusaraNa karA hata tArA anusaraNakArIdera saGge tAdera kona samparkera kathA asvIkAra karave, tArA zAsti dekhave Ara tAdera madhyekAra yAvatIYa samparka samvandha chinna haYe yAve|

anusaraNakArIrA valave, yadi konao prakAre AmAdera phire yAvAra suyoga ghaTata, tAhale AmarAo tAdera saGge samparka chinna karatAma yemanabhAve tArA samparka chinna karala| ebhAve AllAha tAderake tAdera kAjagulo dekhAvena tAdera janya AkSeparUpe evaM jAhAnnAma hate tArA vera hate pArave nA|
ohe manuSyajAti! bhUmanDale vidyamAna vastugulo hate hAlAla uttama jinisagulo khAo evaM zAYatvanera padAGka anusaraNa kare calo nA, vastutaH se tomAdera prakAzya zatru|
se tomAderake zudhu asat evaM azlIla kAjera nirdeza deYa, Ara tomAderake nirdeza deYa AllAhara samvandhe emana kathA valAra yA tomarA jAna nA|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, tomarA ai jinisera anusaraNa kara yA AllAha nAyila karechena, takhana tArA vale, varaM AmarA tArai upara calava, yAra upara AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAdera peYechi, yadio tAdera vApa-dAdArA kichui vujhata nA evaM saThika pathe calata nA tavuo|
e kAphiradera tulanA sei vyaktira mata ye emana kichuke DAke yA hA~ka-DAka chAr3A Ara kichui zone nA, vadhira, mUka o andha; kAjei tArA vujhave nA|
he mu’minagaNa! AmAra deYA pavitra vastugulo khete thAka evaM AllAhara uddeze zokara karate thAka, yadi tomarA tA~rai ‘ivAdata kare thAka|

nizcaYa AllAha tomAdera prati hArAma karechena mRta-jIva, rakta evaM zUkarera mAMsa evaM sei jantu yAra prati AllAha chAr3A anyera nAma neYA haYeche, tave ye vyakti nirupAYa haYe par3e kintu se nApharamAna o sImAlaGghanakArI naYa, tAra upara kona gunAha nei, nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

kitAva hate AllAha yA nAyila karechena, yArA eTA gopana kare evaM era vinimaYe svalpa mUlya grahaNa kare, erA nijedera peTe ekamAtra Aguna bhakSaNa kare, odera sAthe AllAha kviYAmAtera dina kathA valavena nA evaM oderake pavitrao karavena nA; evaM odera janya Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
erA emana loka, yArA hidAYAtera vinimaYe gomarAhI evaM kSamAra vinimaYe zAsti kraYa kareche, tArA Aguna sahya karate katai nA dhairyazIla!
(tAdera prati zAstira hukuma deYA haYeche) ejanya ye, AllAhi kitAvake satyarUpe nAyila karechena Ara yArA kitAva samvandhe matabheda kareche tArA carama matabhede par3e Ache|

tomarA nijedera mukha pUrva dike kara kiMvA pazcima dike ete kona kalyANa nei varaM kalyANa Ache ete ye, kona vyakti ImAna Anave AllAha, zeSa divasa, pherezatAgaNa, kitAvasamUha o nAvIgaNera prati evaM AllAhara bhAlavAsArthe dhana-sampada AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma-misakIna, musAphira o yAcJAkArIdera evaM dAsatvajIvana hate niskRti dite dAna karave evaM nAmAya kAYima karave o yAkAta dite thAkave, oYA‘dA karAra para svIYa oYA‘dA pUrNa karave evaM abhAve, duHkha-kleze o saMkaTe dhairya dhAraNa karave, e lokerAi satyaparAYaNa Ara e lokerAi muttAkI|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera prati nihatadera kisAsa samparke Adeza deYA yAcche, svAdhIna vyaktira vadale svAdhIna, golAmera vadale golAma evaM strIlokera vadale strIloka, ataHpara yAke tAra bhAiYera pakSa hate kichu aMza mApha ka’re deYA haYa, se avasthAYa yathAyatha vidhira anusaraNa karA o satatAra saGge tAra deYa AdAYa karA vidheYa, eTA tomAdera prabhura pakSa hate bhAra lAghava o anugraha, erapara ye keu vAr3AvAr3i karave, tAra janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|
kisAsera madhye tomAdera janya jIvana nihita raYeche, yAte he jJAnI samAja! (hatyAnuSThAna hate) tomarA nivRtta thAka|

tomAderake nirdeza deYA yAcche ye, yakhana tomAdera kArao sAmane mRtyu upasthita haYa evaM sei vyakti kichu sampatti cher3e yAYa, tave se vyakti yena saGgatabhAve oYAsIYAta kare yAYa pitA-mAtA o nikaTa samparkIYadera janya, muttAkIdera janya eTA ekaTA kartavya|
ataHpara ye vyakti tA zune neYAra para oYAsIYAtera parivartana ghaTAve, tave tAra gunAha sei lokaderai prati yArA tAra parivartana ghaTAve, nizcaYa AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvajJa|

ye vyakti oYAsIYAtakArIra pakSa hate pakSapAtitvera bhaYa kare kiMvA anyAYera AzaGkA kare, ataHpara se yadi tAdera madhye miTamATa kare deYa, tave tAra konai gunAha nei, nizcaYa AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera prati royA pharaya karA haYeche, yemana tomAdera Agera lokedera prati pharaya karA haYechila, yAte tomarA muttAkI hate pAra|

(royA) nirdiSTa kaYekaTi dinera janya, ataHpara tomAdera madhye ye pIr3ita kiMvA musAphira se anya samaYa e saMkhyA pUraNa kare neve evaM zaktihInadera upara kartavya hacche phidaiYA pradAna karA, eTA ekajana misakInake annadAna karA evaM ye vyakti nijera khuzIte sat kAja karate icchuka, tAra pakSe tA Arao uttama Ara se avasthAYa royA pAlana karAi tomAdera pakSe uttama, yadi tomarA vujha|

ramAyAna mAsa- yAra madhye kuraAna nAyila karA haYeche lokedera patha pradarzaka evaM hidAYAtera suspaSTa varNanArUpe evaM satya-mithyAra pArthakyakArIrUpe, kAjei tomAdera madhye ye vyakti e mAsa pAve, se yena e mAse royA pAlana kare Ara ye pIr3ita kiMvA saphare Ache, se anya samaYa e saMkhyA pUraNa karave, AllAha tomAdera janya yA sahaja tA cAna, yA kaSTadAYaka tA cAna nA yena tomarA meYAda pUrNa karate pAra, Ara tomAderake satpathe paricAlita karAra kAraNe tomarA AllAhara mAhAtmya ghoSaNA kara, Ara yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza karate pAra|

yakhana AmAra vAndAgaNa AmAra samparke tomAra nikaTa jijJesa kare, Ami to (tAdera) nikaTei, AhavAnakArI yakhana AmAke AhavAna kare Ami tAra AhavAne sAr3A dei; sutarAM tAdera ucita AmAra nirdeza mAnya karA evaM AmAra prati ImAna AnA, yAte tArA saralapatha prApta haYa|

tomAdera janya ramAyAnera rAte tomAdera vivigaNera nikaTa gamana karA jAYiya karA haYeche, tArA tomAdera AcchAdana Ara tomarA tAdera AcchAdana| AllAha jAnatena ye, tomarA nijedera saGge pratAraNA karachile| sutarAM tini tomAderake kSamA karalena evaM tomAdera avyAhati dilena| ataeva, ekhana theke tomarA tAdera saGge sahavAsa karate pAra evaM AllAha tomAdera janya yA kichu vidhivaddha karechena tA lAbha kara evaM tomarA AhAra o pAna karate thAka ye paryanta tomAdera janya kAlo rekhA hate USAkAlera sAdA rekhA prakAza nA pAYa| tatpara rAtera Agamana paryanta royA pUrNa kara, Ara mAsajide i’tikApha avasthAYa tAdera sAthe sahavAsa karo nA| esava AllAhara Aina, kAjei egulora nikaTavartI haYo nA| AllAha mAnavajAtira janya nijera AYAtasamUha vistAritabhAve varNanA karena, yAte tArA muttAkI hate pAre|
Ara tomarA anyAYabhAve parasparera mAla grAsa karo nA evaM jAnA sattveo asat upAYe lokera mAla grAsa karAra uddeze tA vicArakera nikaTa niYe yeo nA|

lokerA tomAke natuna cA~da samparke prazna karache| vala, tA mAnuSera o hAjjera janya samaYa nirdhAraka| tomarA ye gRhera pechana dika diYe praveza kara, tAte kona puNya nei, varaM puNya Ache keu tAkaoYA avalamvana karale, kAjei tomarA (sadara) darajAgulo diYe gRhe praveza kara evaM AllAhke bhaYa karate thAka, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|
tomarA AllAhara pathe sei lokedera viruddhe yuddha kara, yArA tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karave, kintu sImA atikrama karo nA| AllAha nizcaYai sImA atikramakArIke bhAlavAsena nA|

tAderake yekhAnei pAo hatyA kara evaM tAderake vera kare dAo yekhAna theke tArA tomAderake vera kare diYeche| vastutaH phitanA hatyAra ceYeo gurutara| tomarA mAsajide hArAmera nikaTa tAdera sAthe yuddha karo nA, ye paryanta tArA tomAdera sAthe sekhAne yuddha nA kare, kintu yadi tArA tomAdera sAthe yuddha kare, tave tomarAo tAdera hatyA kara, eTAi kAphiradera pratidAna|
ataHpara yadi tArA virata haYa, tave AllAha kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

phitanA dUrIbhUta nA haoYA paryanta evaM dIna AllAhara janya nirdhArita nA haoYA paryanta tAdera viruddhe yuddha kara, ataHpara yadi tArA virata haYa tave yAlimadera upare chAr3A konao prakArera kaThoratA avalamvana jAYiya have nA|

sammAnita mAsa hacche sammAnita mAsera vinimaYe evaM pavitratA rakSAra dAYitva savAra janya samAna, kAjei ye keu tomAdera prati kaThora AcaraNa kare, tave tomarAo tAdera prati kaThora AcaraNa kara yemani kaThoratA se tomAdera prati kareche evaM AllAhke bhaYa kara evaM jene rekha, AllAha muttAkIdera saGge Achena|
tomarA AllAhara pathe vyaYa kara evaM svahaste nijederake dhvaMse nikSepa karo nA evaM kalyANakara kAja kare yAo, nizcaYai AllAha kalyANakArIderake bhAlavAsena|

AllAhara santuSTira uddezye hAjja o ‘umarAhake pUrNa kara, kintu yadi tomarA vAdhAgrasta hao, tave yA sambhava kuravAnI dive evaM kuravAnI yathAsthAne nA pau~chA paryanta nijedera mastaka munDana karo nA, tave tomAdera madhye ye pIr3ita kiMvA mAthAYa yantraNAgrasta, se royA kiMvA sadAkvAha vA kuravAnI dvArA phidaiYA dive evaM yakhana tomarA nirApada thAka, takhana ye keu ‘umarAhake hAjjera saGge miliYe upakAra lAbha karate icchuka, se yemana sambhava kuravAnI dive evaM yAra pakSe sambhava nA haYa, se vyakti hAjjera dinagulora madhye tinadina evaM gRhe pherAra para sAtadina, ei moTa dazadina royA pAlana karave| eTA sei lokera janya, yAra parivAravarga mAsajide hArAmera vAsindA naYa| AllAhake bhaYa kara Ara jene rekha, nizcaYai AllAha zAstidAne kaThora|

hAjja haYa kaYekaTi nirdiSTa mAse, ataHpara e mAsagulote ye keu hAjja karAra manastha karave, tAra janya hAjjera madhye strI sambhoga, anyAYa AcaraNa o jhagar3A-vivAda vaidha naYa evaM tomarA ye kona sat kAjai kara, AllAha tA jAnena evaM tomarA pAtheYera vyavasthA karave Ara tAkvaoYAi zreSTha pAtheYa| he jJAnI samAja! AmAkei bhaYa karate thAka|

tomAdera prati kona gunAha nei yadi tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera anugraha kho~ja kara evaM yakhana tomarA ArAphAta hate phirave takhana mAza‘Arula hArAmera nikaTa AllAhake smaraNa karave evaM tA~ke smaraNa karave yerUpa tini tomAderake zikSA diYechena, vastutaH tomarA era Age chile pathabhraSTadera antargata|
tArapara tomarA phire Asave yekhAna theke lokerA phire Ase evaM AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthI hao, nizcaYa AllAha kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|

ataHpara mahAna hAjjera karaNIYa kAryAvalI samApta karave, takhana AllAhara smaraNe mazagula hao, yemana tomarA nijedera vApa-dAdAdera smaraNe mazagula thAka, varaM tAra ceYeo vezi smaraNa kara| lokedera keu keu vale thAke- he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake e duniYAtei pradAna kara, vastutaH se AkherAte kichui pAve nA|
lokedera madhye kichu loka emana Ache, yArA vale thAke, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake duniYAteo kalyANa dAo evaM AkherAteo kalyANa dAo evaM AmAderake jAhAnnAmera AyAva hate rakSA kara|
erAi sei loka, yAdera kRtakArye tAdera prApya aMza raYeche evaM AllAha satvara hisAvagrahaNakArI|

tomarA nirdiSTa dinagulote AllAhake smaraNa karave; ataHpara ye vyakti tAr3AtAr3i ka’re du’dine cale yAYa tAra prati kona gunAha nei evaM ye vyakti adhika samaYa paryanta vilamva karave, tAra pratio gunAha nei, eTA tAra janya ye vyakti tAkaoYA avalamvana karave evaM AllAhke bhaYa karate thAkave evaM jene rekha, tomarA sakalei tA~rai dike ekatrita have|
mAnuSera madhye emana Ache, pArthiva jIvana samparkita yAra kathAvArtA tomAke camatkRta kare, Ara se vyakti tAra antare yA Ache se samparke AllAhake sAkSI rAkhe athaca se vyakti khuvai jhagar3ATe|
yakhana tomAra kAcha theke se vyakti phire yAYa, takhana dezera madhye aniSTa ghaTAte evaM zasyAdi o pazusamUhake dhavaMsa karate ceSTA kare kintu AllAha phAsAda pachanda karena nA|
yakhana tAke valA haYa, AllAhake bhaYa kara, takhana ahaGkAra tAke gunAhara dike AkarSaNa kare, jAhAnnAmai tAra janya yatheSTa Ara tA katai nA jaghanya AvAsasthala!
mAnuSera madhye emana Ache ye, AllAhara santuSTi arjane nijera prANa diYe thAke, vastutaH AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati atyadhika daYAlu|
he mu’minagaNa! isalAmera madhye pUrNabhAve praveza kara evaM zAYatvanera padAGka anusaraNa kare calo nA, nizcaYai se tomAdera prakAzya zatru|
tomAdera nikaTa suspaSTa hukuma pau~chAra pareo yadi tomAdera padaskhalana ghaTe tave jene rekha, nizcaYai AllAha mahAparAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|

erA ki ejanya apekSA karache ye, meghamAlAra chatra lAgiYe pherezatAdera saGge niYe AllAha tAdera kAche Agamana karavena, ataHpara savakichura mImAMsA haYe yAve? vastutaH sakala kArya AllAhara nikaTei phire yAYa (cUr3Anta siddhAntera janya)|
vAnI isarAIlake jijJesa kara, Ami tAderake kata suspaSTa nidarzana diYechi| kona vyakti AllAhara niYAmAta tAra nikaTa pau~chAra para parivartana karale, nizcaYai AllAha zAsti dAne kaThora|

kAphiradera nikaTa pArthiva jIvana mohanIYa karA haYeche evaM tArA muminaderake vidrUpa kare thAke, vastutaH kviYAmAtera dina muttAkIgaNa tAdera ceYe unnata avasthAYa thAkave, AllAha yAke icche aparimita riyaka diYe thAkena|

mAnuSa ekai dalabhukta chila| tArapara AllAha tAdera nikaTa nAvIgaNake preraNa karena susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe evaM tAdera mAdhyame kitAva nAyila karena satyabhAve, mAnuSadera madhye mImAMsA karAra janya ye viSaYe tArA matapArthakya karechila| etadasattveo yAderake kitAva deYA haYechila, tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa pramANAdi AsAra para pArasparika jidera kAraNei tArA matabheda sRSTi karala| ataHpara AllAha vizvAsIderake sei satya patha nijera karuNAYa dekhiYe dilena, ye samvandhe tArA matabheda karachila, AllAha yAke icche sojA patha pradarzana karena|

tomarA ki emana dhAraNA poSaNa kara ye, tomarA jAnnAte praveza lAbha karave, athaca ekhanao paryanta tomAdera Agera lokedera mata avasthA tomAdera sAmane Aseni? tAderake abhAvera tIvra tAr3anA evaM musIvata sparza karechila evaM tArA etadUra vikampita haYechila ye, nAvI o tAra saGgera mu’minagaNa citkAra kare valechila- AllAhara sAhAyya kakhana Asave? jene rekha, nizcaYai AllAhara sAhAyya nikaTavartI|

tomAke loke jijJesa karache, tArA kI vyaYa karave? vale dAo, satkAje yA-i vyaYa kara, tA tomAdera mAtA-pitA o nikaTAtmIYa, iYAtIma o abhAvagrasta musAphiradera prApya| tomarA yA kichu sat kAja kara, nizcaYai AllAha se viSaYe vizeSabhAve avahita|

tomAdera prati yuddha lipivaddha kare deYA haYeche, athaca tA tomAdera kAche apriYa kintu tomarA kona kichu apachanda kara sambhavataH tomAdera janya tA kalyANakara evaM sambhavataH kona kichu tomAdera kAche priYa athaca tA tomAdera janya akalyANakara| vastutaH AllAhi jAnena, tomarA jAna nA|

pavitra mAse lar3Ai karA samvandhe tomAke tArA jijJesa karache| vala, ete yuddha karA bhaYaGkara gunAha| pakSAntare AllAhara patha hate vAdhA dAna, AllAhara saGge kuphurI, kA‘vA gRhe yete vAdhA deYA evaM tAttheke tAra vAsindAderake vera kare deYA AllAhara nikaTa tAra ceYe adhika anyAYa| phitanA hatyA hateo gurutara anyAYa| yadi tAdera sAdhye kulAYa tArA tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karatei thAkave, ye paryanta nA tArA tomAderake tomAdera dvIna hate phiriYe nA deYa evaM tomAdera ye keu nijera dvIna hate phire yAYa, ataHpara sei vyakti kAphira avasthAYa mArA yAYa, tave emana lokera karma duniYAte evaM AkherAte vyartha haYe yAve| Ara erA agnivAsI, cirakAlai tAte thAkave|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche evaM hijarata kareche o AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche, erAi AllAhara rahamata AzA kare, AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomAke loke mada o juYA samparke jijJesa karache| vala, ‘ai du’Tote Ache bhaYaGkara gunAha evaM mAnuSera janya upakArao kintu e du’Tora pApa e du’Tora upakAra apekSA adhika’| tomAke jijJesa karache, kI tArA vyaYa karave? vala, ‘yA udvRtta’| ebhAve AllAha tomAdera prati AdezAvalI vistAritabhAve varNanA karachena, yAte tomarA cintA kara |

duniYA evaM AkhirAta samvandhe| Arao tArA tomAke iYAtImadera samvandhe jijJesa karache; vala, ‘tAdera upakAra karA uttama’ evaM yadi tAdera saGge tomarA ekatre thAka, tave tArA to tomAderai bhAi| vastutaH AllAha jAnena ke aniSTakArI Ara ke kalyANakAmI evaM AllAha yadi icche karatena, nizcaYai e viSaYe tomAderake kaThoratAra madhye nikSepa karatena, niHsandehe AllAha pravala parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|

muzarikA nArIrA ImAna nA AnA paryanta tomarA tAderake vivAha karo nA| mUlataH mu’mina krItadAsI muzarikA nArI hate uttama oderake tomAdera yatai bhAla lAguka nA kena, ImAna nA AnA paryanta muzarika puruSadera sAthe vivAha dio nA, vastutaH muzarikake tomAdera yatai bhAla lAguka nA kena, mu’mina golAma tAra ceYe uttama| orA agnira dike AhavAna kare Ara AllAha nijera anugrahe jAnnAta o kSamAra dike AhavAna karena| tini mAnuSadera janya nijera hukumagulo vistAritabhAve varNanA karachena yAte tArA zikSA grahaNa kare|

lokerA tomAke Rtu samvandhe jijJesa karache| vala, ‘tA azuci’| kAjei RtukAle strI-sahavAsa hate virata thAka evaM ye paryanta pavitra nA haYa, tAdera nikaTavartI haYo nA| tArapara yakhana pavitra have, takhana tAdera saGge sahavAsa kara, yebhAve AllAha anumati diYechena| nizcaYai AllAha taovAhkArIderake bhAlavAsena Ara pavitratA avalamvIderakeo bhAlavAsena|

tomAdera strIgaNa tomAdera zasyakSetra| sutarAM tomarA tomAdera zasyakSetre ye prakAre icche gamana kara evaM nijedera janya bhaviSyatera vandovasta kara evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM jene rekha ye, tomAderake tA~ra kAche hAjira hate have| Ara vizvAsIderake susaMvAda zuniYe dAo|
tomarA satkAja, tAkaoYA avalamvana evaM mAnuSera madhye zAnti sthApana hate virata thAkave- AllAhara nAme emana zapatha kare tAke ajuhAta kare nio nA| vastutaH AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvajJAtA|
AllAha tomAdera arthahIna zapathera janya tomAderake pAkaDa়Ao karavena nA, kintu tomAdera antarera saMkalpera janya dAya়I karavena| AllAha kSamAzIla, sahanazIla|
yArA nijedera strIdera nikaTa nA yAoYAra janya zapatha grahaNa kare, tAdera janya cAra mAsera avakAza Ache| yadi tArA (ukta samaYera madhye) phire Ase, tave nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
evaM tArA yadi tAlAka deYAra dRr3hapratyaYa grahaNa kare, tave AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvajJa|

tAlAkaprAptA nArIrA tina mAsika paryanta pratIkSA karave evaM tAdera pakSe jAYiya naYa se vastu gopana karA yA tAdera peTe AllAha sRjana karechena, yadi tArA AllAha o parakAlera prati vizvAsa rAkhe| tAdera svAmIrA tAderake ukta samaYera madhye punaH grahaNe adhika hakadAra, yadi tArA Aposa-nispatti karate cAYa evaM puruSadera upara nArIderao hAkva Ache, yemana niYama anuyAYI puruSadera nArIdera uparao hAkva Ache, avazya nArIdera upara puruSadera vizeSa maryAdA Ache evaM AllAha mahAparAkrAnta, prajJAzIla|

tAlAka dui daphA, ataHpara haYa bhAlabhAve punaH grahaNa kiMvA sadvyavahAra sahakAre vidAYa dAna evaM tomAdera pakSe tAderake deYA mAlera kichui phiriYe neYA jAYiya have nA, kintu yadi tArA ubhaYe AzaGkA kare ye tArA AllAhara nirdhArita sImArekhA rakSA kare calate pArave nA (tAhale anya vyavasthA)| ataHpara yadi tomarA (ubhaYa pakSera zAlisagaNa) AzaGkA kara ye ubhaYapakSa AllAhara AinasamUha Thika rAkhate pArave nA, tAhale ubhaYera prati kona gunAha nei yadi kona kichura vinimaYe strI nijeke mukta karate cAYa| egulo AllAhara Aina, kAjei tomarA eguloke laGghana karo nA, Ara yArA AllAhara AinasamUha laGghana karave, tArAi yAlima|

ataHpara yadi se tAke (cUr3Anta) tAlAka deYa, tave erapara sei puruSera pakSe sei strI (vivAha) hAlAla have nA, ye paryanta nA se anya kAuke svAmI hiseve grahaNa kare| ataHpara yadi se tAke tAlAka deYa, tave ubhaYera punarAYa milita haoYAte gunAha nei, yadi ubhaYera AsthA janme ye ubhaYe AllAhara AinasamUha Thika rAkhate pArave| esava AllAhara (Aina) sImAsamUha, eguloke sei lokadera janya tini varNanA karena yArA jJAnI|

yakhana tomarA strIderake tAlAka dAo evaM tAdera iddata pUrNa haYe Ase takhana haYa tAderake bhAlabhAve grahaNa kare rekhe dAo, naile bhAlabhAve vidAYa dAo, Ara vAr3AvAr3i kare tAdera kSati karAra uddeze ATake rekho nA| ye emana karave, se nijerai upara yulama kare| tomarA AllAhara AhakAmake hAsi-ThATTArUpe grahaNa karo nA evaM tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha, tA~ra kitAva o jJAnagarbha vAkyAvalI (sunnAta) yA tini tomAdera prati nAyila karechena, yaddvArA tini tomAderake upadeza dena, tA smaraNa kara Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara Ara jene rekha, nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|

yakhana tomarA strIderake tAlAka dAo, tArapara tAdera iddat pUrNa haYe yAYa, se avasthAYa tArA svAmIdera sAthe vivAha vandhane Avaddha hate cAile tAderake vAdhA dio nA yakhana tArA vaidhabhAve ubhaYe ApoSe sammata haYa| tomAdera madhye ye vyakti AllAha o zeSa dine vizvAsI tAke e upadeza deYA hacche| eTA tomAdera pakSe ati vizuddhatA o pavitratAra viSaYa evaM AllAhi vizeSarUpe jAnena, tomarA jAna nA|

ye vyakti dudhapAna kAla pUrNa karAte icchuka tAra janya mAYerA nijedera santAnaderake pUrNa du’ vatsarakAla stanya dAna karave| janakera upara dAYitva hala bhAlabhAve tAdera annavastrera vyavasthA karA| kAukeo sAdhyera atirikta hukuma deYA haYa nA, yena mAke tAra santAnera janya evaM santAnera janmadAtAke santAnera janya kaSTa deYA nA haYa evaM oYArizera pratio ekai rakama nirdeza, tatpara yadi ubhaYera sammati o yuktikrame dudha chAr3Ate icche kare, tave tAdera prati kona gunAha nei evaM yadi tomarA svIYa santAnaderake kona dhAtrI dvArA dudha pAna karAte icche kara, tave tomAdera prati kona gunAha nei, yadi tomarA yA dite cAcchile tA yathArIti AdAYa kare dAo| AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM jene rekha, tomarA yA kichui kara, nizcaYai AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|

tomAdera madhya hate yArA strIderake rekhe mArA yAve se avasthAYa strIrA nijederake cAra mAsa daza dina virata rAkhave| tArapara yakhana tAdera iddatkAla pUrNa have, takhana tomAdera nijedera samvandhe vaidhabhAve yA kichu karave tAte tomAdera kona gunAha nei| vastutaH tomarA yA kichu karacha, AllAha se viSaYe parijJAta|

tomAdera prati gunAha nei yadi tomarA kathAra izArAYa nArIderake vivAhera prastAva pAThAo, kiMvA nijedera mane gopana rAkha| AllAha avagata Achena ye, ai strIlokadera sAthe tomAdera vivAha karAra kheYAla satvarai jAgave, kintu tAdera sAthe gopana aGgIkAra karo nA, kintu vaidhabhAve kathAvArtA valate pAra evaM tomarA vivAha sampAdanera saMkalpa karo nA ye paryanta iddat pUrNa nA haYa evaM jene rekha, AllAha nizcaYai tomAdera manobhAva jJAta Achena, sutarAM tA~ke bhaYa kara evaM jene rekha, nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama sahiSNu|

tomAdera prati kona gunAha nei, yadi tomarA strIderake sparza nA ka’re, kiMvA tAdera mahara dhArya nA kare tAlAka dAo evaM tomarA strIdera janya kharacera saMsthAna karave, avasthApanna vyakti tAra sAdhyamata evaM avasthAhIna vyakti tAra sAdhyamata vidhi anuyAYI kharacapatrera vyavasthA karave, puNyavAnadera upara eTA dAYitva|

yadi tomarA tAderake sparza karAra pUrve tAlAka dAo, athaca tAdera mahara dhArya karA haYa, se avasthAYa dhAryakRta maharera ardheka, kintu yadi strIrA dAvI mApha kare deYa kiMvA yAra hAte viYera vandhana Ache se mApha kare deYa, vastutaH kSamA karAi tAkaoYAra adhika nikaTavartI evaM tomarA pArasparika sahAYatA hate vimukha haYo nA, yA kichu tomarA karacha AllAha nizcaYai tAra samyaka draSTA|
tomarA salAtera prati yatnavAna hao, vizeSa kare madhyavartI salAtera prati evaM AllAhara sAmane vinItabhAve danDAYamAna hao|
yadi tomarA bhaYa kara, tave padacArI kiMvA ArohI avasthAYai nAmAya AdAYa karave| yakhana nirudvega have, takhana AllAhake smaraNa kara yebhAve AllAha tomAderake zikSA diYechena, yA tomarA jAnate nA|

tomAdera madhye yArA vividerake rekhe mArA yAve, tArA vividera janya asiYata karave yena eka vatsarakAla suyoga-suvidhA pAYa evaM gRha hate vera ka’re deYA nA haYa, tave yadi tArA nijerAi vera haYe yAYa, tave tomAdera prati gunAha nei tArA nijedera vyApAre vaidhabhAve kichu karale; AllAha mahAzaktidhara, suvijJa|
tAlAkaprAptA nArIdera saGgatabhAve bharaNa-poSaNa karA muttAkIdera kartavya|
tomAdera janya AllAha nijera AhakAma emanabhAve vyAkhyA kare varNanA karachena, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

tumi ki sei lokadera prati lakSya karani, yArA mRtyuke er3AvAra janya nijedera ghara theke hAjAre hAjAre vera haYe giYechila, takhana AllAha tAderake valalena, ‘tomAdera mRtyu hoka’| tatpara tAderake jIvita kare uThAlena| nizcaYai AllAha lokedera prati daYAzIla kintu adhikAMza loka zokara kare nA|
tomarA AllAhara pathe yuddha kara evaM jene rekha, AllAha nizcaYai sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

emana vyakti ke Ache ye AllAhake uttama karja pradAna karave? tAhale tAra sei karjake tAra janya AllAha vahu guNa vardhita kare devena evaM AllAhai sImita o prasArita ka’re thAkena evaM tA~ra dikei tomarA phire yAve|

tumi ki mUsAra paravartI vAnI isarAIlera pradhAnadera prati lakSya karani? tArA tAdera nAvIke valechila, ‘AmAdera janya ekajana vAdazAha Thika karuna, yAte AmarA AllAhara pathe jihAda kari’| nirdeza hala, ‘emana sambhAvanA Ache ki ye, yadi tomAdera prati jihAdera hukuma deYA haYa tave tomarA jihAda karave nA’? tArA valala, ‘AmarA kI ojare AllAhara pathe jihAda karava nA, yakhana AmarA AmAdera gRha o santAnAdi hate vahiskRta haYechi’| ataHpara yakhana tAdera prati jihAdera hukuma hala, takhana tAdera alpa saMkhyaka loka chAr3A sakalei phire dA~r3Ala evaM AllAha yAlimaderake khuva bhAlabhAvei jAnena|

tAderake tAdera nAvI valala, AllAha yathArthai tAlutake tomAdera vAdazAha Thika karechena| tArA valala, ‘AmAdera upara kI prakAre tAra rAjakSamatA milate pAre yakhana tAra ceYe AmarAi rAjazaktira adhika yogyapAtra Ara tAke Arthika svacchalatAo pradAna karA haYani’! nAvI valala, AllAha tAkei tomAdera upara pachanda karechena evaM tAke jJAne o dehe samRddha karechena, AllAha yAke icche nijera rAjya dAna karena, vastutaH AllAha paryApta dAtA o prajJAmaYa|

tAdera nAvI tAderake valala, tAlutera vAdazAha haoYAra nidarzana ei ye, tomAdera nikaTa sinduka Asave, yAra madhye tomAdera pratipAlakera zAnti vANI raYeche evaM sei avaziSTa jinisa, yA mUsA o hArUna sampradAYa rekhe geche, oTA pherezatAgaNa uThiYe Anave, ete tomAdera janya nidarzana Ache yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|

ataHpara yakhana tAluta sainyasaha raoYAnA hala, valala, ‘AllAha ekaTA nadI dvArA tomAdera parIkSA karavena, mUlataH ye keu oTAra pAni pAna karave se vyakti AmAra dalabhukta naYa Ara ye tA khAve nA, se nizcaYai AmAra dalabhukta have, kintu ye eka aJjali pAni nive seo (AmAra dalabhukta)’| ataHpara ati alpa saMkhyaka chAr3A tArA sakalei tAttheke pAna karala| erapara tAluta evaM tAra sAthI mu’minagaNa nadI pAra haYe valala, ‘Aja jvAluta o tAra sainyadera sAthe yuddha karAra zakti AmAdera nei| kintu yAdera e dhAraNA chila ye, tAderake AllAhara sAmane hAjira hate have tArA valala, ‘AllAhara hukume vahu kSetre kSudra dala vRhat dalera upara jaYayukta haYeche’| AllAha dhairyazIladera saGge Achena|

yakhana tArA jvAluta o tAra sainyadera sammukhIna hala, takhana valala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake dhairyadhAraNera zakti dAna kara evaM AmAdera padagulo dRr3ha rekha evaM kAphira dalera upara AmAderake jaYayukta kara’|

ataHpara tArA AllAhara hukume tAderake (zatruderake) parAjita karala evaM dAUda jvAlutake katala karala evaM AllAha dAUdake rAjya o hekamata dAna karalena evaM tAke zikSA dilena yA icche| yadi AllAha mAnavajAtira ekadalake anyadala dvArA pratihata nA karatena, tAhale pRthivI viparyasta haYe yeta, kintu AllAha sarvajagatera prati kRpAlu|
esava AllAharai AYAta, yA Ami saThikabhAve tomAke par3iYe zunAcchi evaM nizcaYai tumi rasUladera antarbhukta|

e rasUlagaNa erUpa ye, tAdera madhye kAuke anya kArao upara zreSThatva diYechi| tAdera madhye keu emana Ache ye, tAdera sAthe AllAha kathA valechena evaM tAdera kAuke padamaryAdAYa ucca karechena| Ami mAraiYAmera putra IsAke suspaSTa dalIlasamUha pradAna karechi, rUhula kudusa (jivarAIla) dvArA sAhAyya karechi evaM AllAha yadi icche karatena, tAhale tAdera paravartIrA tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa dalIla pau~chAra para paraspara yuddha vigraha karata nA, kintu tArA paraspara matabheda sRSTi karala, tAdera keu keu ImAna Anala evaM keu keu kupharI karala, AllAha yadi icche karatena, tAhale tArA yuddhavigraha karata nA, kintu AllAha yA icche karena, tA-i kare thAkena|
he ImAnadAragaNa! AmAra deYA jIvikA theke kharaca kara sedina AsAra pUrve yedina kona vikraYa, vandhutva evaM supAriza kAje Asave nA| vastutaH kAphiragaNai atyAcArI|

AllAha, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona upAsya nei, tini ciraJjIva, sarvadA rakSaNAvekSaNakArI| tA~ke tandrA o nidrA sparza kare nA| AkAzamanDale o bhUmanDale yA kichu Ache, tA~rai| ke sei vyakti ye tA~ra anumati chAr3A tA~ra nikaTa supAriza kare? tini lokadera samudaYa prakAzya o aprakAzya avasthA jAnena| pakSAntare mAnuSa tA~ra jJAnera konakichui AYatta karate sakSama naYa, tini ye parimANa icche karena seTuku chAr3A| tA~ra kurasI AkAza o pRthivI pariveSTana kare Ache evaM e du’Yera rakSaNAvekSaNa tA~ke klAnta kare nA, tini ucca maryAdAzIla, mahAna|

dInera madhye javaradastira avakAza nei, nizcaYa hidAYAta gomarAhI hate suspaSTa haYe geche| kAjei ye vyakti mithye mA’vudaderake (tAgutake) amAnya karala evaM AllAhara prati ImAna Anala, nizcaYai se dRr3hatara rajju dhAraNa karala yA chinna haoYAra naYa| AllAha sarvazrotA evaM sarvajJAtA|

AllAha mu’minadera abhibhAvaka, tAderake andhakAra theke Alora dike vera kare Anena evaM kAphiradera abhibhAvaka hacche tAguta, se tAderake Alo theke andhakArera dike niYe yAYa| erAi Agunera vAsindA, erA cirakAla sekhAne thAkave|

tumi ki sei vyaktira ghaTanA samparke cintA kara ni, ye ivarAhImera saGge tAra pratipAlaka samvandhe tarka karechila, yehetu AllAha tAke rAjatva dAna karechilena| ivarAhIma tAke yakhana valala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka tinii, yini jIvita karena evaM mRtyu ghaTAna’| se valala, ‘Amio jIvita kari evaM mRtyu ghaTAi’| ivarAhIma valala, ‘AllAha sUryake pUrva dika theke udita karena, tumi tAke pazcima dika theke udita kara’| takhana sei kAphiraTi hatabhamva haYe gela| vastutaH AllAha yAlimaderake supatha dekhAna nA|

kiMvA emana vyaktira ghaTanA samparke (tumi ki cintA karani) ye eka nagara diYe emana avasthAYa yAcchila ye tA ujAr3a avasthAYa chila| se valala, ‘AllAha e nagarIke era mRtyura pare kIbhAve jIvita karavena’? takhana AllAha tAke ekaza’ vachara mRta rAkhalena| tArapara tAke jIvita kare tulalena o jijJesa karalena, ‘tumi e avasthAYa katakAla chile’? se valala, ‘ekadina chilAma kiMvA ekadina hateo kama’| AllAha valalena, ‘varaM tumi ekaza’ vachara chile, ekSaNe tumi tomAra khAdyera o pAnIYera dike lakSya kara, eTA pace yAYani| Ara gAdhATAra dike tAkiYe dekha, Ara ete uddezya ei ye, Ami tomAke mAnuSera janya udAharaNa karava| AvAra tumi hAr3agulora dike lakSya kara, Ami kIbhAve ogulo jor3A lAgiYe dei, tArapara gozata dvArA Dheke dei| erapara yakhana tAra kAche spaSTa haYe gela, takhana se valala, ‘ekhana Ami pUrNa vizvAsa karachi ye, AllAhi sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna’|

yakhana ivarAhIma valechila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi mRtake kIrUpe jIvita karave AmAke dekhAo’| AllAha valalena, ‘tumi ki vizvAsa kara nA’? se Araya karala, ‘nizcaYai, tave yAte AmAra antaHkaraNa svasti lAbha kare (ejanya tA dekhate cAi)’| AllAha valalena, tAhale cAraTi pAkhI nAo evaM tAderake vazIbhUta kara| tArapara odera eka eka Tukaro pratyeka pAhAr3era upara rekhe dAo, ataHpara seguloke DAka dAo, tomAra nikaTa daur3e Asave| jene rekha ye, nizcaYa AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

yArA AllAhara pathe nijedera mAla vyaYa kare, tAdera (dAnera) tulanA sei vIjera mata, yAttheke sAtaTi zISa janmila, pratyeka zISe ekazata kare dAnA evaM AllAha yAke icche karena, vardhita hAre diYe thAkena| vastutaH AllAha prAcuryera adhikArI, jJAnamaYa|

yArA AllAhara pathe nijedera dhana vyaYa ka’re nijedera dAnera kathA mane kariYe deYa nA Ara (dAna grahItAke) kaSTa deYa nA, tAdera pratidAna tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa nirdhArita Ache, tAdera kona bhaYa nei, marmapIr3Ao nei|
ye dAnera para kaSTa deYA haYa tAra ceYe bhAla kathA o kSamA uttama; vastutaH AllAha abhAvamukta o parama sahiSNu|

he ImAnadAragaNa! dAnera kathA mane kariYe diYe o kaSTa diYe tomarA nijedera dAna-khaYarAtake se vyaktira nyAYa vyartha kare dio nA ye nijera dhana loka dekhAnora janya vyaYa kare thAke, athaca se AllAha o parakAle vizvAsI naYa| tAra tulanA sei masRNa pAtharera mata, yAte sAmAnya kichu mATi Ache, ataHpara pravala vRSTipAta tAke pariSkAra kare phele| tArA svIYa kRta kAryera phala kichui pAve nA; AllAha kAphiraderake pathapradarzana karena nA|

yArA AllAhara santuSTi sAdhana o nijedera mane (ImAnera) dRr3hatA sRSTira uddeze nijedera dhana vyaYa kare thAke tAdera tulanA sei vAgAnera nyAYa yA uccabhUmite avasthita, tAte muSaladhAre vRSTipAtera phale dviguNa phala dhare, yadi tAte vRSTipAta nAo haYa, tave zizira vindui yatheSTa, tomarA yA kichui kara, AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|

tomAdera keu ki pachanda kare ye, tAra emana ekaTA khejura o AGgurera vAgAna hoka, yAra nIca diYe jharNAdhArA pravAhita, tAra janya tAte sava rakama phala Ache, Ara tAra vArdhakyao samupasthita, tAra katakagulo santAna-santati Ache yArA kAjakarmera lAYeka naYa, e avasthAYa vAgAnera upara agni hAoYA vaYe gela, yAra phale seTi jvale gela? AllAha tomAdera janya nidarzanasamUha ebhAve varNanA karachena, yAte tomarA cintA kare dekha|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera upArjita uttama sampada theke evaM tomAdera janya bhUmi theke yA utpanna karechi tAttheke vyaYa kara evaM nikRSTa vastu vyaYa karAra niYata karo nA, vastutaH tomarA tA grahaNa kara nA, yadi nA tomAdera cakSu vandha kare thAka| Ara jene rekha, AllAha amukhApekSI, prazaMsita|

zaYatvAna tomAderake garIva haYe yAoYAra bhaYa dekhAYa evaM lajjAkara viSaYera nirdeza deYa evaM AllAha nija pakSa hate tomAdera sAthe kSamAra o anugrahera oYAdA karachena evaM AllAha prAcuryera adhikArI, mahAjJAnI|
yAke icche tini hikamAta dAna karena evaM ye vyakti e jJAnaprApta haYa, niHsandehe se mahAsampada prApta haYa evaM upadeza tArAi grahaNa kare, yArA jJAnI|
tomarA ye vyaYai kara kiMvA ye kona mAnat kara, AllAha nizcaYai tA jAnena kintu yAlimadera janya kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

yadi tomarA prakAzye dAna kara tave tAo uttama, Ara yadi tomarA tA gopane kara evaM tA abhAvagrastaderake dAna kara, tave tA tomAdera janya Aro uttama, adhikantu tini tomAdera kichu gunAha mocana kare devena, vastutaH yA kichu tomarA karacha, AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

tAderake Thika pathe niYe AsA tomAra dAYitva naYa, varaM AllAha yAke icche Thika pathe paricAlita karena, vastutaH tomarA yA kichu vyaYa kara, tA tomAdera nijedera janyai evaM tomarA to zudhu AllAhara santuSTira janyai vyaYa kare thAka evaM yA kichu tomarA mAla hate vyaYa karave, tomAderake tAra phala puropuri deYA have evaM tomAdera prati anyAYa karA have nA|

oTA sei abhAvagrastadera prApya yArA AllAhara pathe Avaddha Ache, dezamaYa ghure ver3Ate pAre nA, bhikSAvRtti avalamvI nA haoYAra kAraNe ajJa lokerA tAderake abhAvamukta mane kare, tAdera cehArA dekhe tumi tAderake cinate pArave| tArA lokedera kAche nAchor3a haYe bhikSA kare nA evaM tomAdera mAla hate yA kichu vyaYa karave, nizcaYai AllAha se samparke suparijJAta|
yArA nijedera mAla rAte o dine, prakAzye aprakAzye vyaYa kare thAke, tAdera janya sei dAnera saoYAva tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa raYeche evaM tAdera kona bhaYa nei, tArA cintitao have nA|

yArA sUda khAYa, tArA sei lokera mata dA~r3Ave yAke zaYatvAna sparza dvArA vehuza kare deYa, e zAsti ejanya ye, tArA vale, ‘kraYa-vikraYa sUdera matai’, athaca kAravArake AllAha hAlAla karechena evaM tini sUdake hArAma karechena| sutarAM yAra nikaTa tAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate upadezavANI pau~chala evaM se virata hala, pUrve yA (sUdera AdAna-pradAna) haYe geche, tA tArai, tAra viSaYa AllAhara jimmAYa evaM yArA AvAra Arambha karave tArAi agnira vAsindA, tArA tAte cirakAla thAkave|
AllAha sUdake vilupta karena evaM khaYarAtake vRddhi karena, AllAha akRtajJa pApIderake bhAlavAsena nA|
yArA ImAna Ane, satkAja kare, nAmAya kAYima kare evaM yAkAta AdAYa kare, tAdera janya tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa saoYAva nirdhArita Ache| tAdera kona bhaYa nei, tArA cintitao nA|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM vAkI sUda cher3e dAo, yadi tomarA ImAnadAra hao|

ataHpara yadi nA chAr3a tave AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera nikaTa hate yuddhera ghoSaNA zune lao| kintu yadi tomarA tAovAha kara, tave tomarA tomAdera mUladhana pAve, ete tomAdera dvArA atyAcAra have nA, Ara tomarAo atyAcArita have nA|
yadi se (RNa grahaNakArI) daridra haYa, tave svacchala avasthA AsA paryanta avakAza dive Ara mApha kare deYA tomAdera pakSe ati uttama, yadi tomarA jAnate!
tomarA sedinera bhaYa kara, yedina tomAderake AllAhara dike phiriYe neYA have| ataHpara pratyeka lokake tAra kRtakarmera vinimaYa deYA have evaM tArA kichumAtra atyAcArita have nA|

he vizvAsIgaNa! yakhana tomarA nirdiSTa samaYera janya dhAre kAravAra karave, takhana tA likhe rAkhave, tomAdera madhye yena kona ekajana lekhaka nyAyyabhAve likhe deYa, lekhaka yena likhate asvIkAra nA kare, yerUpa AllAha tAke zikSA diYechena, kAjei se yena likhe evaM karja-grahItA yena lekhAra viSaYavastu vale deYa evaM tAra pratipAlaka AllAhara bhaYa rAkhe evaM prApya hate yena konao prakArera kATachA~Ta nA kare| yadi karja-grahItA svalpa-vuddhi athavA durvala kiMvA lekhAra viSaYavastu valate akSama haYa, tave tAra abhibhAvaka yena lekhAra viSaYavastu nyAyyabhAve vale deYa evaM tomAdera Apana puruSa lokera madhya hate du’jana sAkSI rAkha, yadi du’jana puruSa nA pAoYA yAYa, tAhale ekajana puruSa o du’jana strI loka, yAdera sAkSya samparke tomarA rAjI Acha, eTA ejanya ye, yadi ekajana bhule yAYa tave anyajana smaraNa kariYe deve evaM yakhana sAkSIgaNake DAkA have, takhana yena (sAkSya dite) asvIkAra nA kare| choTa hoka vA var3a hoka tomarA nirdiSTa meYAdasaha likhe rAkhAke tAcchilyabhare upekSA karo nA, e likhe rAkhA AllAhara nikaTa inasApha vajAYa rAkhAra janya dRr3hatara, saThika pramANera janya sahajatara evaM tomarA yAte konao sandehe patita nA hao era nikaTavartI| kintu yadi kona saodA tomarA paraspara nagada nagada sampAdana kara, tave nA likhaleo tomAdera kona doSa nei| Ara tomarA yakhana paraspara kenAvecA kara takhana sAkSI rekha| konao lekhaka o sAkSIke yena kaSTa deYA nA haYa evaM yadi erUpa kara, tAhale tomAdera gunAha have| kAjei AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AllAha tomAderake zikSA dicchena evaM AllAha sarvaviSaYe suparijJAta|

yadi tomarA saphare thAka evaM kona lekhaka nA pAo, tAhale vandhaka rAkhAra jinisagulo anyera dakhale rAkhate have, yadi tomarA paraspara parasparake vizvAsa kara tAhale yAke vizvAsa karA haYeche se yena AmAnata phiriYe deYa evaM tAra pratipAlaka AllAhake bhaYa kare| tomarA sAkSya gopana karo nA, ye vyakti tA gopana kare, tAra antara pApI| tomarA yA kara AllAha se samparke vizeSabhAve avahita|

yA kichu AkAzasamUhe o bhUmanDale Ache, savakichu AllAharai| tomAdera antare yA Ache, tA tomarA prakAza kara kiMvA gopana kara AllAha tAra hisAva tomAdera nikaTa hate grahaNa karavena| sutarAM yAke icche tini kSamA karavena evaM yAke icche tini zAsti divena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe kSamatAvAna|

rasUla (sAH) tAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate yA tAra prati avatIrNa haYeche tAte ImAna eneche evaM mu’minagaNao| tArA savAi AllAhara upara, tA~ra pherezatAdera upara, tA~ra kitAvasamUhera upara evaM rasUlagaNera upara vizvAsa sthApana kareche, (tArA vale), ‘AmarA rasUlagaNera madhye kArao vyApAre tAratamya kari nA’ evaM tArA e kathAo vale ye, ‘AmarA zunechi evaM mene niYechi| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake kSamA kara Ara pratyAvartana tomArai dike’|

AllAha kona vyaktira upara tAra sAdhyera atirikta kichu Aropa karena nA, se bhAla yA kareche se tAra saoYAva pAve evaM svIYa manda kRtakarmera janya se nijei nigraha bhoga karave| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA yadi bhule yAi kiMvA bhula kari, tAhale AmAderake pAkar3Ao karo nA, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera Agera lokedera upara yemana guru-dAYitva arpaNa karechile, AmAdera upara temana dAYitva arpaNa karo nA; he AmAdera pratipAlaka! ye bhAra vahanera kSamatA AmAdera nei, emana bhAra AmAdera upara cApiYe dio nA, (bhula-truTi upekSA kare) AmAderake rehAi dAo, AmAderake kSamA kara evaM AmAdera prati daYA kara; tumii AmAdera pratipAlaka, kAjei AmAderake kAphiradera upara jaYayukta kara|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
AllAha, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, tini ciraJjIva sakalera rakSaNAvekSaNakArI|
tini satya sahakAre tomAra upara kitAva avatIrNa karechena, yA pUrvatana kitAvera samarthaka evaM tini tAorAta o iJjIla avatIrNa karechena |

itopUrve mAnavajAtira patha pradarzanera janya; Ara tini sei mAnadanDa nAyila karechena yA hAkva o vAtilera pArthakya dekhiYe deYa; nizcaYai yArA AllAhara AYAtera sAthe kuphurI kare, tAdera janya kaThina zAsti raYeche| AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, danDadAtA|
nizcaYai bhUmanDalera o nabhomanDalera kona jinisai AllAhara nikaTa gopana thAke nA|
tinii tomAderake mAYera peTe yebhAve icche AkRti dena, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, tini mahAzaktimAna o prajJAzIla|

tinii tomAra upara emana kitAva nAyila karechena, yAra katipaYa AYAta maulika-suspaSTa arthavodhaka, egulo hala kitAvera mUla Ara anyagulo puropuri spaSTa naYa; kintu yAdera antare vakratA Ache, tArA golayoga sRSTira uddezye evaM bhula vyAkhyAra uddezye ukta AYAtagulora anusaraNa kare yegulo puropuri spaSTa naYa| mUlata: era marma AllAha chAr3A keui jAne nA| yArA jJAne sugabhIra tArA vale ye, AmarA tAra upara ImAna enechi, e savakichui AmAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate eseche, mUlataH jJAnavAna vyaktirA chAr3A keui nasIhata grahaNa kare nA|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! sat patha pradarzanera pare tumi AmAdera antaraguloke vakra kare dio nA, AmAderake tomAra nikaTa hate rahamata pradAna kara, mUlataH tumii mahAna dAtA|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! nizcaYai tumi samudaYa mAnuSake ekadina samaveta karave, yAte konao sandeha nAi| nizcaYai AllAha aGgIkArera khelApha karena nA|
nizcaYai yArA kupharI kare tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati AllAhara sAmane kona kAje lAgave nA evaM tArAi Agunera indhana|

tAdera svabhAva pherAonI dala evaM tAdera Agera lokedera mata yArA AmAra AYAtaguloke mithyA pratipanna kareche; sutarAM AllAha tAdera gunAhera daruna tAderake pAkar3Ao karalena, AllAha zAsti dAne atyanta kaThora|
yArA kupharI kare tAderake vale dAo, ‘tomarA acirei parAjita have Ara tomAderake jAhAnnAmera dike hA~kAno have, oTA katai nA nikRSTa AvAsasthAna’!

tomAdera janya avazyai nidarzana Ache sei du’dala sainyera madhye yArA paraspara pratidvandIrUpe dA~r3iYechila (vadara prAntare)| ekadala AllAhara pathe yuddha karechila evaM aparadala chila kAphira, kAphirarA musalimaderake prakAzya cokhe dviguNa dekhachila| AllAha yAke icche svIYa sAhAyyera dvArA zaktizAlI kare thAkena, nizcaYai ete dRSTimAnadera janya zikSA raYeche|

mAnuSera kAche suzobhita karA haYeche nArI, santAna, sttapIkRta svarNa o raupyabhAnDAra, cihnayukta azvarAji, gRhapAlita pazu evaM zasyakSetra, esava pArthiva jIvanera sampada, Ara AllAha -tA~rai nikaTa raYeche uttama AzraYasthala|

vala, Ami ki tomAderake e sava hateo ati uttama kona kichura saMvAda deva? yArA muttAkI tAdera janya tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa emana vAgAna raYeche, yAra nimne nadI pravAhita, tArA tAte cirakAla thAkave Ara raYeche pavitra saGgI evaM AllAhara santuSTi, vastutaH AllAha vAndAgaNera samparke samyaka draSTA|
yArA prArthanA kare, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ImAna enechi, ataeva AmAdera gunAhasamUha kSamA kara evaM AmAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti hate rakSA kara’|
tArA dhairyazIla, satyavAdI, (AllAhara prati) AjJAvaha, (AllAhara pathe) vyaYakArI evaM zeSa rAte kSamAprArthanAkArI|

AllAha sAkSya dena ye, tini chAr3A satyikAra kona ilAha nei evaM pherezatAgaNa o nyAYanItite pratiSThita jJAnIgaNao (sAkSya dicche ye,) tini chAr3A satyikAra kona ilAha nei, tini mahAparAkrAnta, mahAjJAnI|

nizcaYa AllAhara nikaTa ekamAtra dvIna hala isalAma| vastutaH yAderake kitAva deYA haYechila tArA jJAna lAbhera para eke anyera upara prAdhAnya lAbhera janya matabheda sRSTi kareche evaM ye vyakti AllAhara nidarzanasamUhke asvIkAra karave, (se jene nika) nizcaYai AllAha hisAva grahaNe atizaYa tatpara|

ataHpara yadi (Ahale kitAva) tomAra sAthe tarka kare tave vale dAo, ‘Ami AllAhara nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karechi Ara AmAra anusArIgaNao AtmasamarpaNa kareche evaM Ahale kitAva o ummIgaNake vala, ‘tomarA ki AtmasamarpaNa karecha’? ataHpara yadi tArA AtmasamarpaNa kare tave nizcaYai tArA patha pAve Ara tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa, tave tomAra dAYitva zudhu pracAra karA| AllAha vAndAdera samparke samyaka draSTA|
yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake amAnya kare, nAvIderake anyAYabhAve hatyA kare evaM mAnuSadera madhye yArA nyAYa-nIti zikSA deYa tAderake hatyA kare, tAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAstira saMvAda dAo|
erAi tArA yAdera samudaYa ‘AmAla duniYA o AkherAte niSphala have evaM tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

tumi ki tAdera prati dRSTi nikSepa karani yAderake kitAvera aMza deYA haYechila? tAderake AllAhara kitAvera dike AhavAna karA haYechila, yAte eTA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deYa, erapara tAdera ekadala vimukhatA avalamvana kare phire yAYa|
eTA ejanya ye, tArA vale, dina kataka chAr3A jAhAnnAmera Aguna kakSano AmAderake sparza karave nA evaM tAdera kalpita dhAraNAsamUha dvInera vyApAre tAderake dho~kAYa phele rekheche|
