anantara tAdera kI dazA ghaTave, yakhana Ami tAderake sei dine ekatrita karava, ye dinaTi saMghaTita haoYAra vyApAre konai sandeha nei evaM pratyekake tAra arjita pratiphala pUrNabhAve deYA have Ara tAdera prati kona yulama karA have nA|

vala, ‘he AllAha! tumi samudaYa rAjyera mAlika, yAke icche rAjya dAna kara Ara yAra theke icche rAjya ker3e nAo evaM yAke icche sammAnita kara Ara yAke icche apadastha kara, tomArai hAte sava rakama kalyANa, nizcaYai tumi sakala vastura upara kSamatAvAna’|
tumii rAtake dinera bhitara Ara dinake rAtera bhitara DhukiYe dAo, tumii jIvitake mRta hate vera kara evaM mRtake jIvita hate vera kara Ara yAke icche vehisAva riykva dAna kara|

mu’minagaNa yena mu’minagaNa chAr3A kAphiradera saGge vandhutva nA kare, mUlataH ye emana karave AllAhara sAthe tAra kona kichurai samparka nei, tave vyatikrama hala yadi tomarA tAdera yulama hate AtmarakSAra janya satarkatA avalamvana kara| Ara AllAha tA~ra nijera samvandhe tomAderake sAvadhAna karachena evaM AllAharai dike pratyAvartana|
vala, ‘tomarA tomAdera antarera viSaYake gopana kara athavA prakAza kara, AllAha tA jAnena, Ara tini jAnena yA kichu AkAzasamUhe evaM bhUbhAge Ache; AllAha sakala vastura upara kSamatAvAna’|

ye dina pratyeka AtmA yA kichu neka ‘AmAla kareche evaM yA kichu vada ‘AmAla kareche tA vidyamAna pAve; sei AtmA kAmanA karave yadi tAra evaM ora (arthAt tAra manda karmaphalera) madhye dustara vyavadhAna hata| AllAha tA~ra nijera samparke tomAderake sAvadhAna karachena, vastutaH AllAha vAndAgaNera prati khuvai karuNAzIla|
vale dAo, ‘yadi tomarA AllAhake bhAlavAsa, tave AmAra anusaraNa kara, AllAha tomAderake bhAlavAsavena evaM tomAdera gunAhasakala kSamA karavena, vastutaH AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu’|
vala, ‘tomarA AllAhara o rasUlera AjJAvaha hao’| ataHpara yadi tArA nA mAne, tave (jene rekha) AllAha kAphiraderake bhAlavAsena nA|
nizcaYai AllAha AdAma o nUhake evaM ivarAhImera o ‘imarAnera gotrake vizvajagatera upara manonIta karechena|
erA eke anyera vaMzadhara evaM AllAha sarvazrotA o sarvajJa|

(smaraNa kara) yakhana ‘imarAnera strI Araya karechila, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra udare yA Ache, tAke Ami ekAnta tomAra uddeze utsarga karalAma, kAjei AmAra pakSa hate tA grahaNa kara, nizcaYai tumi sarvazrotA o sarvajJa|

ataHpara yakhana se tAke prasava karala, vale uThala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami kanyA prasava karechi evaM AllAha bhAla karei jAnena yA se prasava kareche; vastutaH putra kanyAra mata naYa evaM Ami tAra nAma rAkhalAma mAraiYAma evaM Ami tAke o tAra vaMzadharake vitAr3ita zaYatvAna hate tomAra AzraYe cher3e dilAma|

takhana tAra pratipAlaka tAke santuSTi sahakAre grahaNa karalena evaM tAke uttamarUpe lAlana pAlana karalena evaM yAkAriYAke tAra tattvAvadhAYaka karalena| yakhanai yAkAriYA mAraiYAmera kakSe praveza karata, tAra kAche khAdya sAmagrI dekhate peta; jijJesa karata- he mAraiYAma! ‘esava kottheke tomAra kAche Ase’? mAraiYAma valata, ‘osava AllAhara nikaTa hate (Ase)’| nizcaYai AllAha yAke icche vehisAva riyaka dAna karena|
okhAnei yAkAriYA nija pratipAlakera kAche prArthanA kare valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke tomAra pakSa hate ekaTi susantAna dAna kara| nizcaYa tumi prArthanA zravaNakArI’|

yakhana yAkAriYA ‘ivAdAta kakSe salAte danDAYamAna takhana pherezatArA tAke samvodhana kare valala: AllAha tomAke iYAhiYA’ra susaMvAda dicchena, se have AllAhara pakSa hate Agata kAlemAra satyatAra sAkSyadAtA, netA, gunAha hate virata o neka vAndAgaNera madhya hate ekajana nAvI|
yAkAriYA valala, he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra santAna have kIbhAve, Ami to vArdhakye pau~chechi evaM AmAra strIo vandhyA| tini valalena, ‘ebhAvei, AllAha yA icche karena tA-i sampanna kare thAkena’|

se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra janya kona nidarzana dAo’| tini valalena, ‘tomAra janya nidarzana ei ye, tinadina tumi izArA chAr3A lokera saGge kathA valate pArave nA evaM tomAra pratipAlakake adhika smaraNa karave evaM sakAle o sandhyAYa tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karave’|
smaraNa kara, yakhana pherezatArA valechila, ‘he mAraiYAma! AllAha tomAke veche niYechena evaM tomAke pavitra karechena, Ara tAmAma duniYAra nArIdera upara tomAke manonIta karechena’|
he mAraiYAma! ‘tumi tomAra pratipAlakera anugata hao, sAjadAha kara evaM rukU‘kArIdera saGge rukU‘ kara’|

esava adRzyera saMvAda, Ami tomAra kAche tA oYAhI dvArA pau~che dicchi| vastutaH tumi tAdera nikaTa upasthita chile nA yakhana tAdera kon vyakti mAraiYAmake lAlana-pAlana karave sei bhAgya nirNaYera janya kalama nikSepa karachila evaM tumi tAdera nikaTa upasthita chile nA, yakhana tArA (mAraiYAmera abhibhAvaka ke have tA niYe) vAdAnuvAda karachila|

(smaraNa kara) yakhana pherezatArA valala, ‘he mAraiYAma! nizcaYa AllAha tomAke tA~ra ekaTi kathAra susaMvAda dicchena| tAra nAma mAraiYAmera putra IsA-masIha, se duniYA o AkherAte sammAnita o sAnnidhya prAptadera antarbhukta have|’
‘se lokedera sAthe dolanA thAkA avasthAYa evaM vaYoHprApta avasthAYa kathA valave evaM neka vAndAdera antargata have|

mAraiYAma valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! kIbhAve AmAra putra have, athaca AmAke kona mAnava sparza kareni’| tini valalena, ‘ebhAvei’ AllAha sRjana karena yA tini icche karena, tini yakhana kichu sthira karena takhana valena, ‘‘haYe yAo’’ sutarAM tA haYe yAYa|
Ara tini tAke kitAva, hikamAta, tAorAta o iJjila zikSA devena|

‘Ara tini tAke vAnI isarAIlera nikaTa rasUla hiseve preraNa karavena’| se valave, ‘nizcaYa Ami tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate nidarzanasaha tomAdera nikaTa esechi, Ami tomAdera janya mATi dvArA pAkhIra mata ekaTA kAYA gaThana karava, ataHpara tAte phu~tkAra deva, phale AllAhara hukume tA pAkhi haYe yAve evaM AllAhara hukume Ami janmAndha o kuSTharogIke Arogya karava o AllAhara hukume mRtake jIvita karava evaM Ami tomAderake vale deva tomAdera gRhe tomarA yA AhAra kara evaM saJcaYa kare rAkha; nizcaYai e kAje tomAdera janya nidarzana raYeche, yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|’

‘(Ara Ami esechi) AmAra sAmane tAorAtera nidarzana yA raYeche tAra samarthakarUpe yena tomAdera janya kona kona jinisa hAlAla kare dei yA tomAdera prati hArAma chila evaM Ami tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate nidarzanasaha tomAdera nikaTa esechi, kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAke anusaraNa kara’|
‘nizcaYa AllAha AmAra pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka, ataeva tA~ra ‘ivAdAta kara, eTAi sarala patha’|

ataHpara ‘IsA yakhana tAdera avizvAsa anubhava karala, takhana valala, ‘keu Ache ki ye AllAhara pathe AmAra sahAYaka have’| hAoYArIgaNa valala, ‘AmarAi AllAhara sAhAyyakArI, AmarA AllAhara prati ImAna enechi evaM sAkSI thAkuna ye, AmarA AtmasamarpaNakArI’|
‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi yA avatIrNa karecha AmarA tAra upara ImAna enechi, rasUlera Anugatya svIkAra karechi, sutarAM AmAderake sAkSyadAnakArIdera madhye lipivaddha kara|’
evaM tArA kauzala karechila evaM AllAho (javAve) kauzala karechilena, AllAha kauzalIdera zreSTha|

(smaraNa kara) yakhana AllAha ‘IsAke valechilena, ‘he ‘IsA! Ami tomAra sAthe kRta oYAdA pUrNa karava (tomAke mRtyu chAr3Ai duniYA theke kavaja karava) evaM tomAke AmAra kAche uThiYe neva evaM tomAke kAphiradera hate mukta karava Ara tomAra anusaraNakArIderake kviYAmAta paryanta avizvAsIdera upara vijaYI rAkhava; ataHpara AmAra kAche tomAdera pratyAvartana, takhana Ami tomAdera madhye phAYasAlA kare deva ye viSaYe tomarA matabheda karacha|’
ataHpara yArA avizvAsI, tAderake duniYA o AkherAte kaThora zAsti deva evaM keui tAdera sAhAyyakArI nei|
pakSAntare yArA ImAna eneche evaM sat kAja kareche, tAderake tini puropuri sAoYAva dAna karavena, vastutaH AllAha yAlimaderake bhAlavAsena nA|
esava Ami tomAke par3e zunAcchi AYAtasamaSTi o jJAnagarbha vANI hate|
AllAhara nikaTa IsAra avasthA AdAmera avasthAra mata, mATi dvArA tAke gaThana kare tAke hukuma karalena, haYe yAo, phale se haYe gela|
e vAstava ghaTanA tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hatei, sutarAM tumi saMzaYakArIdera antarbhukta haYo nA|

tomAra nikaTa jJAna AsAra para ye vyakti tomAra sAthe (IsAra samvandhe) vitarka karave tAke vala, ‘Aso, AmAdera putraderake evaM tomAdera putraderake Ara AmAdera nArIderake evaM tomAdera nArIderake evaM AmAdera nijederake evaM tomAdera nijederake AhavAna kari, ataHpara AmarA muvAhalA kari Ara mithyukadera prati AllAhara abhisampAta varSaNa kari|
nizcaYai eTA prakRta ghaTanA| AllAha chAr3A anya satya ilAha nei| Ara nizcaYai AllAha mahAparAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|
tA’ sattveo yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave nizcaYai AllAha kalaha sRSTikArIdera viSaYe vizeSabhAve avahita|

vala, ‘he Ahale kitAva! emana eka kathAra dike Aso, yA AmAdera o tomAdera madhye ekai, tA ei ye, AmarA AllAha bhinna anya kAro ‘ivAdAta karava nA evaM kona kichuke tA~ra zarIka karava nA evaM AllAhake vAda diYe AmAdera madhye keu kAuke rava hiseve grahaNa karava nA| tAraparao yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tave vale dAo, tomarA e viSaYe sAkSI thAka ye, AmarA AtmasamarpaNakArI|
he Ahale kitAva! tomarA kena ivarAhIma samparke tarka karacha? tAorAta evaM iJjila to tAraparei avatIrNa haYeche, tomarA ki tAo vujha nA?

vastutaH tomarAi emana loka ye, ye samparke tomAdera kichu jJAna Ache, se viSaYe to vitarka karecha, tomarA emana viSaYe kena vitarka karacha ye viSaYe tomAdera konai jJAna nei? vastutaH AllAhi jJAta Achena, tomarA jJAta nao|
ivarAhIma nA iYAhUdI chila, nA nAsArA, varaM ekaniSTha AtmasamarpaNakArI evaM se muzarika dalera antarbhukta chila nA|
nizcaYa ivarAhImera saGge ghaniSThatAYa sei lokerAi adhika hakadAra yArA tAra anusaraNa kareche evaM ei nAvI, Ara yArA ImAna eneche, vastutaH AllAha mu’minadera abhibhAvaka|
kitAvadhArIdera ekadala cAYa yAte tomAderake pathabhraSTa karate pAre, athaca tArA nijederake chAr3A anya kAukeo pathabhraSTa kare nA, kintu tArA upalavdhi karate pAre nA|
he Ahale kitAva! kena tomarA AllAhara AYAtaguloke asvIkAra karacha, athaca tomarA nijerAi tAra sAkSI?
he Ahale kitAva! kena tomarA satyake mithyAra saGge mizrita karacha Ara jene vujhe satyake gopana karacha|

Ahale kitAvera ekaTA dala valala, yArA ImAna eneche tAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tAra upara dinera zurute tomarA ImAna Ana evaM dinera zeSe asvIkAra (kupharI) kara, haYata tArA (isalAma tyAga kare) phire Asave|

‘evaM tomAdera dvInera anusArI chAr3A Ara kAukeo vizvAsa karo nA| tAderake vale dAo, AllAhara (nirdezita) pathai ekamAtra patha; (evaM eTA AllAhara nIti ye) ekadina tomAderake yA deYA haYechila tA-i anya kAuke deYA have athavA anya lokerA tomAdera pratipAlakera sAmane tomAdera viruddhe peza karAra janya mayavuta pramANa peYe yAve| vala, ‘kalyANa AllAharai hAte, tini yAke icche tA dAna karena evaM AllAha prAcuryazAlI o sarvajJa’|
tini yAke icche nijera daYAra janya khAsa kare veche nena evaM AllAha mahA kalyANera adhikArI|

Ahale kitAvera madhye keu keu emana Ache ye, yadi tAdera nikaTa svarNera stupa gacchita rAkha, tave tomAke tA pherata deve, pakSAntare tAdera keu keu emana ye, ekaTi dinArao yadi tAdera nikaTa gacchita rAkha, tAra pechane lege nA thAkale se tomAke tA pherata deve nA, eTA ejanya ye, tArA vale, ‘nirakSaradera prati AmAdera kona dAYa-dAYitva nei’, vastutaH tArA jene zune AllAhara samparke mithye vale|
tave hyA~, ye vyakti nijera oYA‘dA pUrNa karave evaM AllAhake bhaYa kare calave, nizcaYa AllAha (ei) muttAkIderake bhAlavAsena|

nizcaYa yArA AllAhara sAthe kRta aGgIkAra evaM nijedera zapathake tuccha mUlye vikraYa kare, erA AkherAtera kona aMzai pAve nA evaM AllAha kviYAmAtera dina tAdera saGge kathA valavena nA, tAdera prati dRSTipAta karavena nA evaM tAderake pavitra karavena nA, vastutaH tAdera janya Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

edera madhye ekadala Ache yArA kitAvake jihavA dvArA vikRta kare yAte tomarA tAke kitAvera aMza vale mane kara, mUlataH tA kitAvera aMza naYa evaM tArA vale, ‘eTA AllAhara nikaTa hate avatIrNa, vastutaH tA AllAhara nikaTa hate avatIrNa naYa, tArA jene zune AllAhara prati mithyAropa kare|

kona mAnava santAnera pakSe eTA sambhava naYa ye, AllAha tAke kitAva, jJAna o nuvuoYAta dAna karena, ataHpara se lokederake vale, ‘tomarA AllAhake cher3e AmAra vAndA haYe yAo, varaM (se valave), ‘tomarA AllAhoYAlA hao; yehetu tomarA kitAva zikSA dAna kara evaM nijerAo pATha kara’|
se vyakti tomAderake valave nA ye, tomarA pherezatAderake evaM nAvIderake mA’vUdarUpe grahaNa kara, tomarA musalima haoYAra parao ki se tomAderake kupharIra nirdeza dite pAre?

(smaraNa kara) yakhana AllAha nAvIdera nikaTa hate e aGgIkAra niYechilena ye, Ami tomAderake kitAva evaM jJAna yA kichu pradAna karechi, ataHpara tomAdera kAche yA Ache tAra samarthaka kona rasUla yakhana tomAdera nikaTa Asave, takhana avazya tomarA tAra prati ImAna Anave evaM tAke sAhAyya karave| tini jijJesa karalena, ‘tomarA aGgIkAra karale to? evaM ye viSaYe Ami tomAdera nikaTa hate aGgIkAra nilAma, tomarA tA mAnale to?’ tArA valala, ‘AmarA aGgIkAra karalAma’| AllAha valalena, ‘tomarA sAkSI thAka evaM Amio tomAdera sAthe sAkSI thAkalAma’|
ataHpara yArA mukha phiriYe nive tArAi hala phAseka|
erA ki AllAhara dvIna chAr3A anya dvInera sandhAna karache? athaca AsamAna o yamIne yA Ache savai iccheYa o aniccheYa tA~rai kAche AtmasamarpaNa kareche evaM tA~rai dike sakalera pratyAvartana|

vala, ‘AmarA AllAhara upara evaM AmAdera prati o ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkuva evaM tA~ra vaMzadharera prati yA kichu avatIrNa haYeche evaM mUsA, IsA o anyAnya nAvIgaNake tA~dera pratipAlakera pakSa hate yA kichu deYA haYeche tAra upara ImAna enechi; AmarA tA~dera madhye kona pArthakya kari nA evaM AmarA tA~rai kAche Atmasamarpita|’
Ara ye vyakti isalAma vyatIta anya kona dvIna grahaNa karate cAive kakSano tAra sei dvIna kavUla karA have nA evaM AkherAte se vyakti kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|

AllAha kIrUpe sei sampradAYake supatha dekhAvena yArA ImAna AnAra para, e rasUlake satya vale svIkAra karAra para evaM tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa dalIla AsAra para kupharI kare? vastutaH AllAha yAlima kaomake patha dekhAna nA|
erAi tArA yAdera pratiphala ei ye, tAdera prati AllAhara, pherezatAdera evaM samudaYa mAnavera abhisampAta|
tArA otei cirakAla thAkave, tAdera zAsti laghu karA have nA evaM tAderake virAmao deYA have nA|
kintu erapara yArA tAovAha kare evaM nijederake saMzodhana kare tArA vyatIta| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna AnAra para kupharI karala, ataHpara tAdera kupharI ver3ei calala, tAdera tAovAha kakSano kavula karA have nA evaM e lokerAi pathabhraSTa|

nizcaYai yArA kupharI kare evaM sei kAphira avasthAYai mArA yAYa, tAdera keu pRthivI-bharA svarNao vinimaYa svarUpa pradAna karate cAile tA tAra kAcha theke kakSaNo grahaNa karA have nA| erAi tArA yAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche evaM tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|
tomarA tomAdera priYavastu kharaca nA karA paryanta kakSano puNya lAbha karave nA, yA kichu tomarA kharaca kara-nizcaYai AllAha se viSaYe khuva bhAlabhAvei avagata|

tAorAta nAyilera pUrve iYAkuva nijera upara yA hArAma karechila, tAchAr3A sakala khAdya vAnI isarAIlera janya hAlAla chila| vala, ‘tomarA tAorAta niYe eso, evaM tA pATha kara, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao’|
eraparao yArA AllAha samparke mithyAropa karave, tArA yAlima|
vala, ‘AllAha satya valechena, sutarAM tomarA ekaniSThabhAve ivarAhImera anusaraNa kara, se muzarikadera antarbhukta naYa’|
niHsandehe prathama ghara yA mAnuSera janya sthApana karA haYechila, tAto makkAYa, yA varakatamanDita evaM sArA jAhAnera janya pathapradarzaka|

tAte suspaSTa nidarzanAvalI raYeche (yemana) mAkvAme ivarAhIma(ivarAhImera dA~r3Anora jAYagA)| ye keu tAte praveza karave nirApada have| AllAhara janya ukta gharera hAjja karA lokedera upara Avazyaka yAra se paryanta pau~chAra sAmarthya Ache evaM ye vyakti asvIkAra karave, (se jene rAkhuka) niHsandehe AllAha vizva jAhAnera mukhApekSI nana|
vala, ‘he kitAvadhArIgaNa! tomarA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhake kena amAnya karacha? vastutaH tomarA yA karacha, AllAha tAra sAkSI’|

vala, he kitAvadhArIgaNa! ye vyakti ImAna eneche tAke kena AllAhara pathe vAdhA diccha, oke vakra karAra patha khu~jacha, athaca tomarAi (e pathera satyatAra) sAkSI? ematAvasthAYa AllAha tomAdera kAryAvalI samvandhe ve-khavara nana|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yadi kitAvIdera madhya hate kona dalera kathA mene nAo, tave tArA tomAdera ImAna AnAra para AvAra tomAderake kAphira vAniYe chAr3ave|

Ara tomarA kemana kare kupharI karate pAra yakhana tomAderake AllAhara AYAtasamUha par3e zunAno hacche evaM tomAdera mAjhe tA~ra rasUlao maojuda Achena? ye vyakti AllAhake sudRr3habhAve grahaNa kare, nizcaYai se sarala pathera dike paricAlita have|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara yemanabhAve tA~ke bhaYa karA ucita| tomarA musalima nA haYe kakSano maro nA|

AllAhara rajjuke samavetabhAve dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kara, paraspara vicchinna haYo nA evaM tomAdera prati AllAhara ni‘mAta smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA chile paraspara zatru, tini tomAdera antare prItira saJcAra karalena, phale tomarA AllAhara anugrahe paraspara bhAi bhAi haYe gele| tomarA agni-gahvarera prAnte chile, ataHpara AllAha tomAderake tAttheke rakSA karalena| ebhAve AllAha nijera nidarzanAvalI tomAdera kAche spaSTabhAve varNanA karena yAte tomarA saThika patha prApta hao|
tomAdera madhye emana ekaTA dala hoka, yArA kalyANera dike AhavAna kare, sat kAjera Adeza kare evaM asat kAja hate niSedha kare Ara erAi saphalakAma|
tomarA sei lokadera mata haYe yeYo nA yArA tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzana pau~chAra pare vibhakta haYeche o matabheda kareche evaM e zreNIra lokedera janya Ache mahA zAsti|

se dina kataka mukha ujjvala have Ara kataka mukha kAlo have, yAdera mukha kAlo have, (tAderake valA have), tomarA ki ImAna AnAra parao kupharI karechile? kAjei nijedera kupharIra janya zAsti bhoga karate thAka|
yAdera mukha ujjvala have, tArA AllAhara rahamatera madhye thAkave, tArA tAte cirakAla thAkave|
esava AllAhara AYAta, yA ThikabhAve Ami tomAke par3e zunAcchi evaM AllAha vizvajagatera prati yulama karate cAna nA|
yA kichu AsamAne Ache Ara yamIne Ache sava AllAharai evaM yAvatIYa viSaYAdi AllAhara dikei phire yAve|

tomarAi sarvottama ummAta, mAnavajAtira (sarvAtmaka kalyANera) janya tomAdera Avirbhuta karA haYeche, tomarA satkAjera Adeza dAo evaM asat kAja hate niSedha kara o AllAhara prati ImAna rakSA kare cala| yadi Ahale kitAva ImAna Anata, tAhale nizcaYai tAdera janya bhAla hata, tAdera madhye keu keu mu’mina evaM tAdera adhikAMzai phAseka|
sAmAnya kaSTa deYA vyatIta tArA tomAdera kona kSati karate pArave nA, Ara yadi tomAdera sAthe yuddhe lipta haYa, tave tomAderake pRSTha pradarzana karave, ataHpara tArA sAhAyyaprApta have nA|

AllAhara anukampA o mAnuSera AzraYa chAr3A yekhAnei tArA avasthAna karuka, sekhAnei tArA haYeche lAJchita, tArA AllAhara gayave pariveSTita evaM tAdera upara patita haYeche dAridrera kazAghAta| eTA ejanya ye, tArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha pratyAkhyAna karata evaM nAvIgaNake anyAYabhAve hatyA karata, eTA ejanya ye, tArA avAdhyatA evaM sImAlaGghana karata|
tArA savAi samAna naYa| Ahale kitAvadera kata loka emanao Ache yArA dvInera upara pratiSThita Ache, tArA rAtrikAle AllAhara AYAtasamUha pATha kare thAke evaM tArA sAjadAha kare thAke|
tArA AllAhara o parakAlera prati vizvAsa poSaNa kare, satkAjera Adeza deYa evaM asatkAja hate niSedha kare evaM kalyANakara kAje tatpara thAke| vastutaH tArA puNyavAnadera madhye gaNya|
tArA yA kichu satkAja karuka kona kichui pratyAkhyAna karA have nA evaM AllAha muttAkIdera viSaYe vizeSarUpe parijJAta|
yArA kupharI kare, AllAhara nikaTe tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati kakSano kona kAje Asave nA evaM tArA hacche agnira adhivAsI, tArA tAte cirakAla thAkave|

e pArthiva jIvane tArA yA vyaYa kare tAra dRSTAnta himazItala vAtAsera mata yA nijedera prati yulamakArI sampradAYera zasyakSetrake AghAta kare evaM tAke naSTa kare| mUlataH tAdera prati AllAha kona prakAra yulama karenani, varaM tArA nijerAi nijedera prati yulama kare thAke|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA tomAdera nijedera loka cher3e anya kAukeo vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA, kAraNa tArA tomAderake naSTa karate truTi karave nA, tArA kevala tomAdera durbhoga kAmanA kare, vastutaH tAdera mukheo zatrutA prakAzita haYe par3e evaM tAdera antara yA lukiYe rAkhe tA Arao bhaYaGkara, Ami tomAdera kAche tAdera lakSaNagulo spaSTa kare dilAma, yadi tomarA anudhAvana kara|

avazya tomarAi sei loka ye, tomarA tAderake mahavavata kara, kintu tArA tomAdera sAthe mahavavata rAkhe nA, uparantu tomarA sakala kitAvera pratio vizvAsa rAkha evaM yakhana tArA tomAdera saGge sAkSAt kare takhana vale ye, ‘AmarAo ImAna enechi’ evaM yakhana tArA ekAnte milita haYa takhana tomAdera prati gosvAYa nijedera AGgulera mAthA kAmar3Ate thAke| tAderake vala, ‘tomarA nijedera gosvAYa marate thAka’| vastutaH antare yA Ache AllAha tA khuva bhAlabhAvei jAnena|

yadi tomAdera kalyANa haYa, tA tAderake duHkha deYa, Ara yadi tomAdera akalyANa haYa, tAte tArA Anandita haYa, yadi tomarA dhairyazIla hao evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara tave tAdera cakrAnta tomAdera kichui kSati karate pArave nA, nizcaYa tArA yA kichu karache, AllAha tA pariveSTana kare Achena|
(smaraNa kara) yakhana tumi sakAla velAYa tomAra parijana hate vera haYe mu’minaderake yuddhera janya jAYagAYa jAYagAYa motAYena karachile, AllAha savakichui zunena, savakichui jAnena||
yakhana tomAdera madhyakAra du’dala bhIrutA prakAza karate manastha karechila, kintu AllAha ubhaYera vandhu chilena, mu’minadera ucita AllAhara upara bharasA karA|
evaM AllAha tomAdera hIna avasthAYa vAdara yuddhakSetre tomAdera sAhAyya karechena, sutarAM AllAhake bhaYa kare cala, yena tomarA zokaragujAra hate pAra|
(smaraNa kara) yakhana tumi mu’minaderake valachile, ‘tomAdera janya ki eTA yatheSTa naYa ye, tomAdera pratipAlaka tina sahasra pherezatA avataraNapUrvaka tomAdera sAhAyya karavena?’

hyA~, yadi tomarA dhairyadhAraNa kara evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara evaM tArA (arthAt zatrurA) muhUrtera madhye ekhAne tomAdera upara ese par3e, tAhale tomAdera pratipAlaka vizeSabhAve cihnita pA~ca sahasra pherezatA dvArA tomAderake sAhAyya karavena|
eTA AllAha kevalamAtra tomAdera susaMvAdera janya evaM tA dvArA tomAdera citta-prazAntira janya karechena, mUlataH sAhAyya to zudhu AllAharai nikaTa hate, yini parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|
yAte tini kAphiradera dalavizeSake dhvaMsa kare dena kiMvA lAJchita karena, phale tArA nirAza haYe pratyAvartana kare|
AllAha tAdera prati kSamAzIla havena athavA tAderake zAsti pradAna karavena- e vyApAre tomAra kichu karAra nei| kenanA tArA hacche yAlima|
AkAzasamUhe o yamIne yA kichui Ache sesava AllAharai, tini yAke icche kSamA karena evaM yAke icche zAsti pradAna karena| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA suda kheo nA kramavardhitabhAve, AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|
bhaYa kara sei Agunake, yA kAphiradera janya prastuta karA haYeche|
AllAhara o rasUlera Anugatya kara, yAte tomarA kRpAprApta hate pAra|
tomarA druta agrasara hao tomAdera pratipAlakera kSamAra dike o sei jAnnAtera dike yAra vistRti hacche AsamAnasamUha o yamInera samAna, yA muttAkIdera janya tairI karA haYeche|
yArA sacchala o asacchala avasthAYa (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kare evaM yArA krodha saMvaraNakArI evaM mAnuSera prati kSamAzIla, AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|

yArA kona pApa kAja kare phelale kiMvA nijedera prati yulama karale AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM nijedera pApera janya kSamA prArthanA kare evaM AllAha vyatIta gunAhasamUhera kSamAkArI kei vA Ache evaM tArA jene zune nijedera (pApa) kAjera punarAvRtti kare nA|

erAi tArA yAdera janya raYeche tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate kSamA evaM emana eka jAnnAta yAra nimne jharNAdhArA pravAhita, tArA tAra sthAYI adhivAsI evaM satkarmazIladera puraskAra katai nA uttama!
tomAdera pUrveo aneka sampradAYa gata haYeche, tomarA duniYA paryaTana kara, tArapara dekha, yArA mithyA va’le amAnya karechila tAdera pariNAma kI dA~r3iYeche|
eTA hacche mAnuSera janya suspaSTa varNanA evaM muttAkIdera janya hidAYAta o nAsIhAta|
tomarA hInavala o duHkhita haYo nA, vastutaH tomarAi jaYI thAkave yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|

yadi tomAderake AghAta sparza kare, anurUpa AghAta to apara pakSakeo sparza karechila| (jaYa-parAjaYera) e dinaguloke Ami mAnuSera madhye Avartita kare thAki yAte AllAha mu’minaderake cine nite pArena evaM tomAdera madhye kAuke kAuke zahIda hiseve grahaNa karate pArena, vastutaH AllAha yAlimaderake bhAlavAsena nA|
evaM (e janyeo) yena AllAha mu’minaderake saMzodhana karena o kAphiradera nizcihna karena|
tomarA ki bhevecha ye, tomarA jAnnAte praveza karave, athaca AllAha ekhana paryantao parakha karenani tomAdera madhye ke jihAda kareche Ara kArA dhairyazIla|
(zAhAdAtera) mRtyura sAkSAt lAbhera pUrve tomarA tA kAmanA karate, ekhana to tomarA tA divyadRSTite dekhale|

muhAmmAda hacche ekajana rasUla mAtra, tA~ra pUrve Arao aneka rasUla gata haYeche; kAjei yadi se mArA yAYa kiMvA nihata haYa, tave ki tomarA ulTAdike ghure dA~r3Ave? evaM ye vyakti ulTAdike phire dA~r3AYa se AllAhara konai kSati karate pArave nA evaM AllAha kRtajJaderake atizIghra vinimaYa pradAna karavena|

kona jIvai AllAhara anumati chAr3A marate pAre nA, tAra meYAda nirdhArita| ye vyakti pArthiva phala cAYa, Ami tAttheke tAke dei, Ara ye vyakti AkherAtera phala cAYa, Ami tAke tAttheke dei evaM kRtajJaderake Ami zIghrai vinimaYa pradAna karava|

kata nAvI yuddha kareche, tAdera sAthe chila vahu loka, takhana tArA AllAhara pathe tAdera upara saMghaTita vipadera janya hInavala haYani, durvala haYani, durvala, apAraga haYani, vastutaH AllAha dhairyazIladerake bhAlavAsena|

tAdera mukha hate kevala e kathAi veriYechila- ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera aparAdhagulo evaM AmAdera kAja-karme vAr3AvAr3iguloke tumi kSamA kare dAo, AmAderake dRr3hapada rekha evaM kAphiradalera upara AmAderake sAhAyya kara|’
sutarAM AllAha tAderake pArthiva suphala pradAna karalena Ara parakAlIna utkRSTa suphala| AllAha satkarmazIladerake bhAlavAsena|
he vizvAsIgaNa! yadi tomarA kAphiradera Anugatya kara tAhale tArA tomAderake pazcAddike phiriYe niYe yAve, takhana tomarA kSatigrasta haYe par3ave|
varaM AllAhi tomAdera abhibhAvaka evaM tinii sarvazreSTha sAhAyyakArI|

atisatvarai Ami kAphiradera antare bhaYa saJcAra karava, kAraNa tArA AllAhara zarIka grahaNa kareche yAra svapakSe tini konao sanada avatIrNa karenani, tAdera nivAsa have jAhAnnAma evaM yAlimadera nivAsa katai nA jaghanya!

(uhUdera raNakSetre) AllAha tomAderake svIYa oYA‘dA saThikarUpe dekhAlena, yakhana tomarA AllAhara nirdeze kAphiraderake nipAta karachile, ataHpara yakhana tomarA nijerAi (pArthiva lAbhera vaze) durvala haYe gele evaM (netAra) hukuma samvandhe matabheda karale evaM tomAderake tomAdera AkAGkSita vastu dekhAnora para tomarA avAdhya hale, tomAdera keu keu duniYAra pratyAzI hale evaM keu keu parakAla cAile, ataHpara tini tomAderake zatrudera hate phiriYe dilena tomAderake parIkSA karAra janya, AllAha avazya tomAderake kSamA karalena, vastutaH AllAha mu’minadera prati anugrahazIla|

(smaraNa kara) yakhana tomarA u~cu jamira dike uThachile evaM kArao dike phire tAkAnora mata hu~zaTuku tomAdera chila nA evaM rasUla tomAdera pazcAte theke tomAderake DAkachila| phale AllAha tomAderake kaSTera upara kaSTa pradAna karalena, yAte tomarA yA hAriYecha athavA tomAdera upara ye vipada eseche (tAra kAraNa upalavdhi karAra para bhaviSyate) tAra janya duHkhita nA hao, vastutaH tomarA yA-i kara AllAha se vyApAre vizeSabhAve avahita|

ataHpara kaSTera para AllAha tomAdera prati zAnti-tandrA preraNa karalena, yA tomAdera ekadalake Acchanna karala evaM anyadala mUrkhera mato AllAhara prati kudhAraNA poSaNa karataH nijerAi nijedera jIvanake udvegAkula kare valala, kAja-karmera vyApAre (siddhAnta grahaNera) AmAdera kichumAtra adhikAra Ache ki? vala, ‘samastai AllAhara niraGkuza adhikArabhukta’| tArA emana sava kathA antare poSaNa kare- yA tomAra kAche prakAza kare nA| tArA vale, ‘yadi matAmata pradAnera adhikAra AmAdera kichumAtrao thAkata, tAhale AmarA e sthale nihata hatAma nA’| vale dAo, ‘yadi tomarA tomAdera ghareo thAkate, tathApi yAdera bhAgye mRtyu lekhA chila, tArA tAdera e mRtyuzayyAra pAne vera haYe par3ata’| evaM ejanyao ye AllAha tomAdera antarera bhetarera viSaYagulo parIkSA karena evaM tomAdera antarastha viSaYaguloke pariSkAra karena, vastutaH AllAha sakalera antarera kathA samparke vizeSabhAve avahita|

du’dala paraspara sammukhIna haoYAra dina tomAdera madhye yArA palAYanapara haYechila, tomAdera kona kona atIta kAryakalApera janya zaYatvAna tAdera padaskhalana ghaTiYechila evaM niHsandehe AllAha tAderake kSamA karechena; nizcaYai AllAha kSamAparAYaNa, ati sahanazIla|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA, yArA kupharI kare evaM tAdera bhAi-vandhugaNa yakhana videze saphara kare kiMvA kothAo yuddhe lipta haYa tAdera samvandhe vale, ‘tArA AmAdera kAche thAkale marata nA, nihatao hata nA’| phale AllAha eTike tAdera manera anutApe pariNata kare dena, vastutaH AllAhi jIvita karena o mRtyudAna karena Ara tomarA yA kichu kara, AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|
yadi tomarA AllAhara pathe nihata hao kiMvA mRtyuvaraNa kara, tave AllAhara daYA o kSamA ati uttama tArA yA saJcaYa kare tAra ceYe|
tomarA mArA gele vA nihata hale avazyai AllAhara nikaTa tomAderake ekatrita karA have|

sutarAM AllAhara parama anugraha ye tumi tAdera upara daYArdra raYecha, evaM yadi tumi rUr3ha mejAja o kaThina hRdaYa hate tave avazyai tArA tomAra nikaTa hate sare yeta| sutarAM tAdera doSa kSamA kara evaM AllAhara kAche tAdera gunAhera janya kSamA cAo evaM kAja-karme tAdera saGge parAmarza kara, ataHpara yakhana (kona vyApAre) saMkalpavaddha hao, takhana AllAharai prati bharasA kara; nizcaYa AllAha bharasAkArIderake pachanda karena|

yadi AllAha tomAdera sAhAyya karena, tave tomAdera upara keui vijaYI hate pArave nA evaM yadi tini tomAdera sAhAyya nA karena, se avasthAYa emana ke Ache ye, tomAderake sAhAyya karave? mu’minadera AllAhara prati nirbhara karAi ucita|

kona nAvI khiYAnAta karate pAre nA, ye vyakti khiYAnAta karave, se khiYAnAtakRta vastusaha kviYAmAtera dina upasthita have, ataHpara pratyekake yA se arjana kareche tA puropuri deYA have, kArao prati kona prakAra yulama karA have nA|
ye vyakti AllAhara santuSTi anusaraNa kare, se ki AllAhara Akroze patita lokera nyAYa hate pAre? tAra nivAsa hala jAhAnnAma, Ara tA katai nA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala!
AllAhara nikaTa tAdera vibhinna maryAdA raYeche, vastutaH tArA yA kichui karache, AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|

nizcaYa AllAha mu’minadera prati atyanta anukampA pradarzana karechena, yakhana tAdera nikaTa tAdera nijasva ekajanake rasUla kare pAThiYechena, se tAderake AllAhara AYAta par3e zunAcche, tAderake parizodhana karache, tAderake kitAva o hikamAta (sunnAha) zikSA dicche, yadio tArA pUrve suspaSTa gomarAhIte chila|

kI vyApAra! tomAdera upara yakhana vipada eseche athaca tomarA to (vadara yuddhe tomAdera zatrudera) eTA apekSA dviguNa vipada ghaTiYechile, ekhana tomarA valacha, ‘eTA kotheke Asala’? (tAderake) vala, ‘oTA tomAdera nijedera nikaTa thekei eseche’, nizcaYa AllAha sakala vastura upara kSamatAvAna|
du’dala parasparera sammukhIna haoYAra dina ye vipada pau~chechila, tA AllAhara hukume ghaTechila, era uddezya chila prakRta mu’minaderake jene neYA|

Ara munAphikaderakeo jene neYA| tAderake valA haYechila; eso, ‘AllAhara pathe yuddha kara, kiMvA (kamapakSe) nijedera pratirakSAra vyavasthA kara’| takhana tArA valala, ‘yadi AmarA jAnatAma yuddha have, tAhale avazyai tomAdera anusaraNa karatAma’| tArA ai dina ImAnera ceYe kupharIrai nikaTatama chila, tArA mukhe emana kathA vale yA tAdera antare nei, yA kichu tArA gopana kare AllAha tA vizeSarUpe jJAta Achena|
yArA vase theke nijedera bhAidera samvandhe valate lAgala, AmAdera kathAmata calale tArA nihata hata nA| vala, tomarA satyavAdI hale tomAdera nijedera upara theke maraNake haTiYe dAo|
yArA AllAhara pathe nihata haYeche, tAderake mRta bheva nA, varaM tArA jIvita, tAdera pratipAlakera sAnnidhye theke tArA riyakaprApta hacche|

AllAha nija anugrahe tAderake yA diYechena tA lAbha kare tArA Anandita Ara ye sava ImAnadAra loka tAdera pechane (pRthivIte) raYe geche, ekhanao tAdera sAthe ese milita haYani, tAdera kona bhaYa o cinte nei jene tArA Anandita|
AllAhara ni‘mAta evaM anugrahera kAraNe tArA Ananda prakAza kare Ara eTA jene ye, AllAha mu’minadera sAoYAva vinaSTa karena nA|
AghAtaprApta haoYAra parao yArA AllAha evaM rasUlera DAke sAr3A diYeche tAdera madhye yArA satkAja kare o tAkaoYA avalamvana kare tAdera janya raYeche mahA pratidAna|

yAderake loke khavara diYechila ye, ekaTA var3a vAhinI tomAdera viruddhe jar3a hacche, kAjei tAderake bhaYa kara| takhana tA tAdera ImAna vRddhi kare dila evaM tArA valala, ‘AmAdera janye AllAhi yatheSTa evaM tini katai nA uttama karmavidhAYaka!’
ataHpara tArA AllAhara ni‘mAta o anugrahasaha phire Asala, konao prakAra aniSTa tAderake sparza kareni, tArA AllAhara santuSTira anusaraNa karechila evaM AllAha mahAkalyANamaYa|
e lokerA hacche zaYatvAna; tomAderake tAra vandhudera bhaYa dekhAYa, tomarA tAderake bhaYa karo nA, AmAkei bhaYa kara, yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|

yArA kupharIra dike druta dhAvamAna tArA yena tomAke marmapIr3A nA deYa| tArA kakSano AllAhara kichui kSati karate pArave nA| parakAle kona aMzai AllAha tAderake dite icche karena nA, tAdera janya Ache mahAzAsti|
yArA ImAnera vinimaYe kupharI kraYa kareche, tArA kakSano AllAhara kichumAtra aniSTa karate pArave nA, tAdera janya Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

kAphiragaNa yena kichutei e dhAraNA poSaNa nA kare ye, tAderake Ami ye avakAza diYechi tA tAdera janya maGgalajanaka; Ami tAderake zudhu ejanya avakAza dei ye, yena tAdera pApera parimANa ver3e yAYa, tAdera janya Ache lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|

asatke sat theke pRthaka nA karA paryanta tomarA ye avasthAYa Acha, AllAha mu’minaderake se avasthAYa cher3e dite pArena nA evaM AllAha tomAderake gAYivera vidhAna jJAta karena nA, tave AllAha tA~ra rAsUlagaNera madhye yAke icche veche nena, kAjei tomarA AllAha evaM tA~ra rasUlagaNera prati ImAna Ana| yadi tomarA ImAna Ana Ara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, tAhale tomAdera janya Ache mahApuraskAra|

AllAha nija anugrahe yA tAderake diYechena tAte yArA kRpaNatA kare, tArA yena mane nA kare ye, tA tAdera janya kalyANakara, varaM tA tAdera janya (khuvai) akalyANakara, tArA yAte kRpaNatA kareche, satvara kviYAmAtera dina tArai ver3i tAdera galAYa pariYe deYA have| AsamAna o yamInera svatvAdhikAra kevala AllAharai| tomarA yA kichui karacha AllAha se samparke pUrNarUpe avahita|

AllAha avazyai tAdera ukti zravaNa karechena yArA vale, ‘AllAha daridra evaM AmarA dhanI’, tArA yA vale tA Ami avazyai lipivaddha kare rAkhava evaM (tAdera) anyAYabhAve nAvIgaNake hatyA karAra viSaYaTio (lipivaddha kare rAkhava) evaM Ami valava- ‘jAhAnnAmera dahana yantraNA bhoga kara’|
eTA tomAdera Agei pAThAno kAjera vinimaYa, kAraNa AllAha svIYa vAndAgaNera prati kona prakAra yulama karena nA|

yArA va’le thAke ye, ‘AllAha AmAdera kAche aGgIkAra niYechena, yena AmarA Agune grAsa kare emana kona kuravAnI AmAdera sAmane nA dekhAno paryanta kona rasUlera prati ImAna nA Ani’| vala, ‘AmAra pUrve vahu rasUla vahu pramANasaha tomAdera nikaTa esechila evaM tomAdera kathita sei mu’jiyA niYeo (esechila)| yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao, tAhale kena tomarA tAderake hatyA karechile?’
tAraparao yadi kAphiragaNa tomAke asvIkAra kare, tave tomAra pUrveo rasUlagaNake asvIkAra karA haYechila yArA spaSTa nidarzana, aneka sahIphA evaM dIptimAna kitAva niYe esechila|

pratiTi jIvana mRtyura AsvAda grahaNa karave evaM kviYAmAtera dina tomAderake pUrNamAtrAYa vinimaYa deYA have| ye vyaktike jAhAnnAmera Aguna hate rakSA karA hala evaM jAnnAte dAkhila karA hala, avazyai se vyakti saphalakAma hala, kenanA pArthiva jIvana chalanAra vastu chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|

avazyai tomarA tomAdera dhanera o jAnera vyApAre parIkSita have evaM tomarA nizcaYai tomAdera Agera kitAvadhArIdera o muzarikadera nikaTa hate duHkhajanaka aneka kathA zunave evaM tomarA yadi dhairyadhAraNa kara Ara tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, tave avazyai tA have dRr3ha saMkalpera kAja|

(smaraNa kara) AllAha Ahale kitAvadera nikaTa theke aGgIkAra niYechilena- tomarA avazyai tA (arthAt kitAva) mAnuSera kAche spaSTabhAve varNanA karave Ara tA gopana karave nA, kintu tArA tA agrAhya karala evaM sAmAnya mUlye vikri karala, tArA yA kraYa karala se vastu katai nA manda!

tomarA e sava lokake AyAva theke surakSita mane karo nA yArA nijedera kRtakarmera janya Anandita evaM emana kAjera janya prazaMsita hate cAYa mUlataH yA tArA kareni, tAdera janya Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
vastutaH AsamAna o yamIne Ache AllAharai rAjatva evaM AllAha sakala jinisera upara kSamatAvAna|
nizcaYai AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sRSTite evaM rAtra o dinera Avartane jJAnavAnadera janya vahu nidarzana Ache|

yArA AllAhake danDAYamAna, upaviSTa evaM zAYita avasthAYa smaraNa kare thAke evaM AsamAna o yamInera sRSTira vyApAre cintA kare (o vale): ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi esava anarthaka sRSTi karani, tomAra pavitratA varNanA karachi, sutarAM AmAderake agnira zAsti hate rakSA kara|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi yAke Agune nikSepa karave, tAke avazyai tumi apamAna karave Ara yAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ekajana ghoSaNAkArIke ImAnera ghoSaNA karate zunechi ye, ‘tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera prati ImAna Ano’| se anuyAYI AmarA ImAna enechi| sutarAM he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera gunAhgulo kSamA kara evaM AmAdera theke AmAdera manda kAjagulo vidUrita kara Ara neka vAndAdera saGge zAmila kare AmAdera mRtyu ghaTAo|

‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi svIYa rasUladera mAraphata AmAderake yesava vastura oYAdA zuniYecha, tA AmAderake dAna kara evaM kviYAmAtera dina AmAderake lAJchita karo nA, nizcaYai tumi oYA‘dA khelApha kara nA|’

takhana tAdera pratipAlaka tAdera DAke sAr3A diYe valalena, tomAdera madhye puruSa hoka kiMvA nArIi hoka kona karmIrai karmaphala Ami naSTa kari nA, tomarA eke aparera aMza| sutarAM yArA hijarAta karave evaM svIYa gRha hate vitAr3ita have o AmAra pathe niryAtita have, yuddha karave o nihata have, nizcaYa Ami tAdera gunAhasamUha dUra kare deva evaM nizcaYai tAderake emana jAnnAte dAkhila karavo, yAra nIca diYe vaYe yAcche nada-nadI, AllAhara nikaTa hate puraskAra hiseve, vastutaH AllAhara nikaTei uttama vinimaYa|
deze deze kAphiradera sadambha padacAraNA tomAke yena vibhrAnta nA kare|
sAmAnya bhoga, tArapara jAhAnnAma tAdera AvAsa, Ara tA katai nA nikRSTa vizrAmasthala!

kintu yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare, tAdera janya Ache jAnnAta yAra pAdadeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita, tArA tAte cirakAla thAkave, e hala AllAhara nikaTa hate Atithya Ara AllAhara nikaTa yA Ache, tA satkarmaparAYaNadera janya ati uttama|

Ahale kitAvadera madhyekAra kichu loka niHsandehe emanao Ache, yArA AllAhara upara evaM tomAdera upara avatIrNa kitAvera evaM tAdera prati avatIrNa kitAvera upara ImAna rAkhe, tArA AllAhara prati vinaYAvanata, tArA AllAhara AYAtake tucchamUlye vikraYa kare nA, erAi tArA yAdera janya tAdera karmaphala nirdhArita raYeche tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa, AllAha hiseva grahaNe tvaritagati|
he mu’minagaNa! dhairya avalamvana kara, dRr3hatA pradarzana kara, nijedera pratirakSAkalpe pArasparika vandhana majavuta kara evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

he manuSya samAja! tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kara, yini tomAderake ekaTi mAtra vyakti hate paYadA karechena evaM tA hate tAra jor3A sRSTi karechena, ataHpara sei du’jana hate vahu nara-nArI char3iYe diYechena evaM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, yA~ra nAme tomarA paraspara parasparera nikaTa (hAkva) ceYe thAka evaM satarka thAka jJAti-vandhana samparke, nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera upara tIkSNa dRSTi rAkhena|
evaM iYAtImaderake tAdera dhana-sampada pradAna kara evaM bhAlora sAthe mandera vadala karo nA evaM tAdera mAla nijedera mAlera saGge miziYe grAsa karo nA, nizcaYa eTA mahApApa|

yadi tomarA AzaGkA kara ye, (nArI) iYAtImadera prati suvicAra karate pArave nA, tave nArIdera madhya hate nijedera pachandamata dui-dui, tina-tina o cAra-cAra janake vivAha kara, kintu yadi tomarA AzaGkA kara ye, tomarA suvicAra karate pArave nA, tAhale ekajanake kiMvA tomAdera adhInastha dAsIke; eTAi have avicAra nA karAra kAchAkAchi|
nArIderake tAdera mohara svataHsphUrta haYe deve, ataHpara tArA yadi santoSera saGge tAtheke tomAdera janya kichu cher3e deYa, tave tA tRptira saGge bhoga kara|

evaM tomarA alpa-vuddhisampannaderake nijedera mAla pradAna karo nA, yA AllAha tomAdera jIvane pratiSThita thAkAra upakaraNa karechena evaM se mAla hate tAdera anna-vastrera vyavasthA karave evaM tAdera saGge daYArdra nyAYAnuga kathA valave|

iYAtImaderake parakha kara ye paryanta nA tArA vivAhayogya haYa, yadi tAdera madhye vicAravodha lakSya kara, tave tAderake tAdera mAla phiriYe deve| tAdera vaYaHprAptira bhaYe apavyaYa kare evaM tAr3AtAr3i kare tAdera mAla kheYe phelo nA| Ara ye abhAvamukta, se yena nivRtta thAke evaM ye abhAvagrasta se nyAYasaGgatabhAve bhoga karave evaM yakhana tAdera mAla tAderake samarpaNa karave, tAdera sAmane sAkSI rAkhave; hisAva grahaNe AllAhai yatheSTa|
mAtA-pitA evaM AtmIYadera rekhe yAoYA sampattite puruSadera aMza raYeche; Ara mAtA-pitA evaM AtmIYadera rekhe yAoYA sampattite nArIderao aMza Ache, tA alpai hoka Ara vezii hoka, eka nirdhArita aMza|
(sampatti) vaNTanakAle svajana, iYAtIma evaM misakIna upasthita thAkale tAderakeo tAttheke kichu diYe deve, tAdera saGge daYArdra nyAYAnuga kathA valave|
tArA yena bhaYa kare ye, asahAYa santAna pechane cher3e gele tArAo tAdera janya cintita hata, sutarAM tArA yena AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM saGgata kathA vale|
yArA iYAtImadera mAla anyAYabhAve grAsa kare, tArA to nijedera peTe kevala agnii bhakSaNa kare, tArA zIghrai jvalanta Agune jvalave|

AllAha tomAderake tomAdera santAna-santatira (aMza) samparke nirdeza dicchena, puruSa dui nArIra aMzera samAna pAve, tave santAna-santati yadi zudhu du’jana nArIra adhika haYa tAhale tA~rA rekhe yAoYA sampattira tina bhAgera du’ bhAga pAve, Ara kevala ekaTi kanyA thAkale se ardheka pAve evaM tAra pitA-mAtA ubhaYera pratyeke rekhe yAoYA sampattira chaYa bhAgera eka bhAga pAve yadi tAra santAna thAke, Ara yadi tAra santAna nA thAke evaM tAra oYAriza mAtA-pitAi haYa, se avasthAYa tAra mAtAra janya eka tRtIYAMza, kintu tAra bhAi-vona thAkale, tAra mAtA pAve chaYa bhAgera eka bhAga, (aisava vaNTana have) tAra kRta oYAsIYAta athavA RNa parizodhera para| tomarA jAna nA tomAdera pitA evaM santAnadera madhye ke tomAdera pakSe upakArera dika diYe adhikatara nikaTavartI| (e vaNTana) AllAhara pakSa hate nirdhArita kare deYA haYeche, nizcaYa AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAzIla|

tomAdera strIdera rekhe yAoYA sampattira ardheka tomAdera janya- yadi tAdera kona santAna nA thAke Ara yadi santAna thAke, tave tomAdera janya tAdera rekhe yAoYA sampattira eka caturthAMza, tAdera kRta oYAsIYAta kiMvA RNa parizodhera para evaM tArA tomAdera rekhe yAoYA sampattira siki aMza pAve yadi tomAdera kona santAna nA thAke, Ara tomAdera santAna thAkale tAdera janya tomAdera sampattira ATa bhAgera ekabhAga- tomAdera kRta oYAsIYata kiMvA RNa parizodhera para| yadi pitA-mAtAhIna o santAnahIna kona puruSa vA nArIra zudhu vaipitreYa ekaTi bhAi vA ekaTi bhagni thAke, tave pratyekera janya cha’ bhAgera eka bhAga| yadi tArA tAra ceYe adhika haYa, tave sakalei tRtIYAMze zarIka have kRta oYAsIYAta kiMvA RNa parizodhera pare, yadi kAro janya kSatikara nA haYa, e hala AllAhara vidhAna, AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

esava AllAhara nirdhArita sImA evaM ye vyakti AllAha evaM tA~ra rasUlera anusaraNa karave, AllAha tAke jAnnAte dAkhila karavena, yAra pAdadeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita, tArA tAte ciravAsI have evaM eTA virATa sAphalya|

Ara ye vyakti AllAha evaM tA~ra rasUlera nApharamAnI karave evaM tA~ra nirdhArita sImAlaGghana karave, AllAha tAke jAhAnnAme dAkhila karavena, se tAte ciravAsI have evaM se avamAnanAkara zAsti bhoga karave|

tomAdera ye sava nArI vyabhicAra karave, tomarA tAdera viruddhe tomAdera cArajanera sAkSya grahaNa kara| yadi tArA sAkSya deYa, tave tomarA tAderake se samaYa paryanta gRhe Avaddha kare rAkhave ye paryanta nA tAdera mRtyu haYa kiMvA AllAha tAdera janya kona pRthaka patha vera karena|

tomAdera madhyekAra ye du’jana tAte lipta have, tomarA se du’janake zAsti deve, ataHpara yadi tArA tAovAha kare evaM nijederake saMzodhana kare tave tAdera vyApAre nivRtta hao, nizcaYa AllAha atizaYa tAovAha kavUlakArI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYai yArA ajJatAvazataH manda kAja ka’re vase, tatpara satvara tAovAha kare, erAi tArA yAdera tAovAha AllAha kavUla karena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, mahAvijJAnI|

emana lokedera tAovAha nisphala yArA gunAha karatei thAke, ataHpara mRtyura mukhomukhI hale vale, Ami ekhana tAovAha karachi evaM (tAovAha) tAdera janyao naYa yAdera mRtyu haYa kAphira avasthAYa| erAi tArA yAdera janya bhaYAvaha zAstira vyavasthA kare rekhechi|

he ImAnadAragaNa! jorapUrvaka nArIdera oYAriza haoYA tomAdera janya vaidha naYa Ara tAderake deYA mAla hate kichu usUla kare neYAra uddezye tAdera saGge rUr3ha AcaraNa karave nA, yadi nA tArA suspaSTa vyabhicAra kare| tAdera sAthe daYA o satatAra saGge jIvana yApana kara, yadi tAderake nA-pachanda kara, tave hate pAre ye tomarA yAke nA-pachanda karacha, vastutaH tArai madhye AllAha vahu kalyANa diYe rekhechena|

yadi tomarA eka strI vadaliYe tadasthale anya strI grahaNera icche kara evaM tAdera ekajanake agAdha sampadao diYe thAka, tavuo tAttheke kichui phiriYe nio nA| tomarA ki (strIra nAme) mithye durnAma raTiYe suspaSTa gunAha kare tA pherata neve?
kemana karei vA tomarA tA grahaNa karave yakhana tomarA eke anyera sAthe saGgata haYecha evaM tArA tomAdera nikaTa hate (vivAha vandhanera) suspaSTa pratizruti niYeche|
yAderake tomAdera pitRpuruSa viYe kareche, sesava nArIke viYe karo nA, pUrve yA haYe geche haYe geche, nizcaYai tA azlIla, ati ghRNya o nikRSTa panthA|

tomAdera prati hArAma karA haYeche tomAdera mA evaM meYe, vona, phuphu, khAlA, bhAijhi, bhAginI, dudha mA, dudha vona, zvAzur3I, tomAdera strIdera madhye yAra sAthe saGgata haYecha tAra pUrva svAmIra aurasajAta meYe yArA tomAdera tattvAvadhAne Ache, kintu yadi tAdera sAthe tomarA sahavAsa nA kare thAka, tave (tAdera vadale tAdera meYederake viYe karale) tomAdera prati gunAha nei evaM (tomAdera prati hArAma karA haYeche) tomAdera aurasajAta putrera strI evaM eka saGge du’ vonake (vivAha vandhane) rAkhA, pUrve yA haYe geche, haYe geche, nizcaYai AllAha parama kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

nArIdera madhye vivAhavandhane Avaddha nArIgaNao tomAdera janya niSiddha, kintu tomAdera adhikArabhukta dAsIdera vAde, AllAha esava vyavasthA tomAdera upara pharaya kare diYechena| tomAdera janya niSiddha nArIdera chAr3A anyAnya sakala nArIderake moharera arthera vadale vivAha vandhane Avaddha karate cAoYA tomAdera janya vaidha karA haYeche, avaidha yauna samparkera janya naYa| ataHpara tAdera madhye yAdera tomarA sambhoga karecha, tAderake tAdera dhAryakRta mohara pradAna kara| tomAdera prati konao gunAha nei mohara dhAryera parao tomarA ubhaYera sammatira bhittite moharera parimANe heraphera karale, nizcaYa AllAha savizeSa parijJAta o parama kuzalI|

tomAdera ye vyaktira svAdhInA mu’mina nArI vivAhera kSamatA nA thAke, se yena tomAdera adhInastha mu’minA dAsI vivAha kare evaM AllAha vizeSarUpe tomAdera ImAnake jAnena| tomAdera ekajana anyajana theke udbhUta, kAjei tAderake viYe kara tAdera mAlikera anumati niYe, nyAYasaGgatabhAve tAdera mahara tAderake diYe dAo, tArA have saccaritrA, vyabhicAriNI naYa, upapati grahaNakAriNIo naYa| vivAhera dUrge surakSita haoYAra para tArA yadi vyabhicAra kare, tave tAdera zAsti AjAda nArIdera ardheka; e vyavasthA tAra janya tomAdera ye vyakti (avivAhita thAkAra kAraNe) vyabhicArera bhaYa kare| dhairya dhAraNa karA tomAdera pakSe uttama evaM AllAha parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

AllAha icche karena tomAdera nikaTa savistAre varNanA karate tomAdera AgekAra lokedera niYamanIti tomAdera dekhAnora grahaNera janya, Ara tomAderake kSamA karAra janya; vastutaH AllAha suparijJAta, parama kuzalI|
AllAha tomAderake kSamA karate cAna, pakSAntare kupravRttira anusArIrA cAYa ye, tomarA (AllAhara nikaTa hate) dUre vahu dUre sare yAo|
AllAha tomAdera bhAra laghu karate cAna, kAraNa mAnuSake durvalarUpe sRSTi karA haYeche|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA anyAYabhAve eke anyera sampada grAsa karo nA, tave pArasparika sammatite vyavasAYa vaidha evaM nijedera dhvaMsa Deke eno nA kiMvA tomarA parasparake hatyA karo nA, nizcaYa AllAha tomAdera prati kRpAmaYa|
ye vyakti sImAlaGghana ka’re anyAYabhAve eTA karave, tAke Ami atisatvara agnite dagdha karava, eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|
yadi tomarA niSiddha kAjera var3a var3a gulo hate virata thAka, tAhale Ami tomAdera choTa choTa pApagulo kSamA ka’re deva evaM tomAderake eka mahAmaryAdAra sthAne praveza karAva|

tomarA tA kAmanA karo nA yA dvArA AllAha tomAdera kAuke kAro upara maryAdA pradAna karechena| puruSerA tAdera kRtakAryera aMza pAve, nArIrAo tAdera kRtakarmera aMza pAve evaM tomarA AllAhara nikaTa tA~ra anugraha kAmanA kara, nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvajJa|

mAtA-pitA o svajanadera rekhe yAoYA sampade Ami pratyeka uttarAdhikArera aMza sthira karechi evaM yAdera saGge tomAdera aGgIkAra raYeche, kAjei tAderake tAdera aMza pradAna kara, nizcaYai AllAha sarvaviSaYe pratyakSadarzI|

puruSagaNa nArIdera upara kartRtvazIla e kAraNe ye, AllAha tAdera ekake anyera upara maryAdA pradAna karechena, Ara ejanya ye, puruSerA svIYa dhana-sampada hate vyaYa kare| phale puNyavAna strIrA (AllAha o svAmIra prati) anugatA thAke evaM puruSera anupasthitite tArA tA (arthAt tAdera satItva o svAmIra sampada) saMrakSaNa kare yA AllAha saMrakSaNa karate Adeza diYechena| yadi tAdera madhye avAdhyatAra sambhAvanA dekhate pAo, tAderake sadupadeza dAo evaM tAdera sAthe zayyA vandha kara evaM tAderake (saGgatabhAve) prahAra kara, ataHpara yadi tArA tomAdera anugata haYa, tAhale tAdera upara niryAtanera vAhAnA kho~ja karo nA, nizcaYa AllAha sarvocca, sarvazreSTha|

yadi tomarA tAdera madhye anaikyera AzaMkA kara, tave svAmIra AtmIYa-svajana hate ekajana evaM strIra AtmIYa-svajana hate ekajana sAlisa niyukta kara| yadi ubhaYe mImAMsA kariYe deYAra icche kare, tave AllAha ubhaYera madhye niSpattira vyavasthA karavena, nizcaYa AllAha sava kichu jAnena, sakala kichura khavara rAkhena|

tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, kichukei tA~ra zarIka karo nA evaM mAtA-pitA, AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma abhAvagrasta, nikaTa prativezI, dUra prativezI, sAthI, musAphira evaM tomAdera AYattAdhIna dAsa-dAsIdera saGge sadvyavahAra kara, nizcaYai AllAha ai lokake bhAlavAsena nA, ye ahaMkArI, dAmbhika|

yArA kRpaNatA kare adhikantu lokederakeo kArpaNya karAra Adeza deYa evaM AllAha nija anugrahe tAderake yA diYechena tA gopana kare, (aisava) kAphiradera janya Ami lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

(Ara sesava lokakeo AllAha pachanda karena nA) yArA mAnuSake dekhAnora janya nijedera dhana-sampada kharaca kare evaM AllAha o AkhirAta divasera upara vizvAsa rAkhe nA| zaYatvAna kAro saGgI hale se saGgI katai nA jaghanya!
tAdera kI kSati hata yadi tArA AllAha o AkhirAta divasera upara ImAna Anata, Ara AllAha tAderake ye riyaka diYechena tAttheke vyaYa karata, vastutaH AllAha tAdera viSaYa khuva jJAta Achena|
AllAha aNu parimANao yulama karena nA, Ara kona puNya kAja hale tAke tini dviguNa karena evaM nijera nikaTa hateo virATa puraskAra dAna karena|
sutarAM takhana kI avasthA dA~r3Ave, yakhana Ami pratyeka ummAtera madhya hate eka ekajanake sAkSI upasthita karava evaM tomAkeo hAjira karava tAdera upara sAkSya dAnera janya|
yArA asvIkAra kareche evaM rasUla-era nApharamAnI kareche, tArA se dina kAmanA karave, hAYa! tArA yadi mATira sAthe mize yeta evaM tArA AllAha hate kona kathAi lukiYe rAkhate pArave nA|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA nezAgrasta avasthAYa salAtera nikaTavartI haYo nA yatakSaNa nA tomarA yA vala, tA vujhate pAra evaM apavitra avasthAYao (salAtera kAche yeo nA) gosala nA karA paryanta (masajide) patha atikrama karA vyatIta; evaM yadi tomarA pIr3ita hao kiMvA saphare thAka; athavA tomAdera keu zaucasthAna hate Ase athavA tomarA strI saGgama kare thAka, ataHpara pAni nA pAo, tave pavitra mATi diYe tAYAmmuma kara, Ara tA diYe tomAdera mukhamanDala o hastadvaYa mAsaha kara; AllAha nizcaYai pApa mocanakArI, kSamAzIla|
tumi ki sei lokedera prati lakSya karani, yAderake kitAvera aMza deYA haYechila? tArA nijerA pathabhraSTatAra saodA kare Ara tArA cAYa tomarAo pathabhraSTa haYe yAo|
AllAha tomAdera zatruderake bhAlabhAve jAnena, abhibhAvaka hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa evaM sAhAyyakArI hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa|

iYAhUdIdera kataka loka kathAke prakRta sthAna theke sariYe vikRta kare evaM vale, ‘AmarA zunalAma o amAnya karalAma’ evaM zuneo nA zonAra mata Ara nijedera jihavA kuJcita ka’re evaM dvInera prati doSAropa ka’re vale, ‘rAinA’ (AmAdera rAkhAla)| kintu tArA yadi valata ‘AmarA zunalAma o mene nilAma, zona evaM AmAdera prati lakSya kara, tave tA tAdera janya uttama evaM saGgata hata, kintu tAdera kupharIra kAraNe AllAha tAderake lA‘nata karechena, tArA svalpasaMkhyaka vyatIta ImAna Anave nA|

ohe yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche, Ami yA nAyila karechi, tAra upara tomarA ImAna Ana, yA tomAdera kAche yA Ache tAra samarthaka Ami tomAdera mukhaguloke vikRta kare seguloke pichanera dike phiriYe deYAra pUrve (ImAna Ana), kiMvA zanivAraoYAlAderake yemana abhisampAta karechilAma, ederakeo temani abhisampAta karAra pUrve| vastutaH AllAhara hukuma kAryakarI haYei thAke|
nizcaYa AllAha tA~ra sAthe zarIka karA kSamA karavena nA| eTA chAr3A anya sava yAke icche mApha karavena evaM ye AllAhara sAthe zarIka karala, se eka mahA apavAda Aropa karala|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yArA nijederake pavitra va’le dAvI kare? varaM AllAhi yAke icche pavitra karena| (keu prakRtai pavitratA arjana karale tA agrAhya karataH) tAdera prati sAmAnya parimANao anyAYa karA have nA|
dekha, erA AllAhara samvandhe kemana mithye racanA kare, suspaSTa gunAhera janya eTAi yatheSTa|

yArA kitAvera jJAnera ekAMza pradatta haYeche, sei lokadera prati tumi ki lakSya karani, tArA amUlaka yAdu, pratimA o tAgUtera prati vizvAsa kare evaM kAphiradera samvandhe vale ye tArA mu’minagaNera tulanAYa adhika saThika pathe raYeche|
erA sei loka, yAderake AllAha abhizApa diYechena evaM yAke AllAha abhizApa dena, tumi kakSano tAra sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
tAdera ki zAsana kSamatAYa kona aMza Ache? tA thAkale tArA lokederake tila parimANao dita nA|

kiMvA AllAha nija anugrahe lokederake yesava ni‘mAta dAna karechena, sejanya ki erA tAdera hiMsA kare, Ami ivarAhImera vaMzadharaderakeo to kitAva o hikamAta diYechilAma, tAderake suvizAla rAjyao pradAna karechilAma|
ataHpara tAdera madhye keu keu tAra upara ImAna Anala evaM tAdera madhye keu keu tAra theke mukha phiriYe rAkhala, (dagdha karAra janya) prajjvalita jAhAnnAmai yatheSTa|

yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake pratyAkhyAna kare nizcaYai Ami tAderake Agune dagdha karava, yakhana tAdera gAYera cAmar3A dagdha have, Ami sei cAmar3Ake natuna cAmar3A dvArA vadale deva yena tArA (zAstira para) zAsti bhoga kare| AllAha nizcaYai parAkramazAlI o vijJAnamaYa|

yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche nizcaYai Ami tAderake jAnnAte dAkhila karava yAra nimne jharNAdhArA pravAhita, sekhAne tArA ciravAsI have, tAte tAdera janya thAkave pavitra strI evaM Ami tAderake cira snigdha ghana chAYAYa dAkhila karava|

nizcaYai AllAha tomAderake nirdeza dicchena, hakadAradera haka tAdera kAche pau~che dite| tomarA yakhana mAnuSera mAjhe vicAra karave takhana nyAYaparAYaNatAra saGge vicAra karave| AllAha tomAderake kata uttama upadezai nA dicchena; nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhara anugata hao evaM rasUlera anugata hao evaM tomAdera madhyakAra kartRsthAnIYa vyaktigaNera; yadi kona viSaYe tomAdera madhye matabheda ghaTe, tAhale sei viSaYake AllAha evaM rasUlera (nirdezera) dike phiriYe dAo yadi tomarA AllAha evaM AkhirAta divasera prati ImAna ene thAka; eTAi uttama evaM sundaratama marmakathA|

tumi ki sei lokedera prati lakSya karani, yArA tomAdera prati avatIrNa kitAvera evaM tomAra Age avatIrNa kitAvera upara ImAna eneche vale dAvI kare, kintu tAgUtera kAche vicAraprArthI hate cAYa, athaca tAke pratyAkhyAna karAra janya tAderake nirdeza deYA haYeche, zaYatvAna tAderake pathabhraSTa kare vahudUre niYe yete cAYa|
yakhana tAderake valA haYa- tomarA AllAhara avatIrNa kitAvera evaM rasUlera dike eso, takhana tumi ai munAphikaderake dekhave, tArA tomA hate ghRNA bhare mukha phiriYe nicche|

yakhana tAdera kRtakAryera janya tAdera upara vipada Apatita have, takhana kI avasthA have? takhana tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha karate karate tomAra kAche ese valave, ‘AmarA sadbhAva o samprIti chAr3A anya kichu cAini|’
tArA sei loka, yAdera antarasthita viSaYe AllAha parijJAta, kAjei tumi tAderake upekSA kara, tAderake sadupadeza dAna kara, Ara tAderake emana kathA vala yA tAdera antara sparza kare|

Ami rasUla e uddezei preraNa karechi, yena AllAhara nirdeze tA~ra Anugatya karA haYa| yakhana tArA nijedera upara yulama karechila, takhana yadi tomAra nikaTa cale Asata Ara AllAhara kAche kSamAprArthI hata evaM rasUlao tAdera pakSe kSamA cAita, tAhale tArA AllAhake niratizaYa tAovAha kavUlakArI o parama daYAlurUpe peta|

kintu nA, tomAra pratipAlakera zapatha! tArA mu’mina have nA, ye paryanta nA tArA tAdera vivAda-visamvAdera mImAMsAra bhAra tomAra upara nyasta nA kare, ataHpara tomAra phaYasAlAra vyApAre tAdera mane kichu mAtra kuNThAvodha nA thAke, Ara tArA tAra sAmane nijederake pUrNarUpe samarpaNa kare|

yadi Ami tAdera prati pharaya kare ditAma ye tomarA nijederake hatyA kara, kiMvA nijedera deza theke veriYe yAo, tave svalpasaMkhyaka loka chAr3A keu tA pAlana karata nA, yA karate tAderake upadeza deYA haYa tA yadi tArA pAlana karata, tave tA tAdera pakSe kalyANakara hata evaM dRr3ha cittatAra kAraNa hata|
se avasthAYa avazyai Ami tAderake AmAra nikaTa hate mahApuraskAra dAna karatAma|
evaM tAderake avazyai saThika patha pradarzana karatAma|
yArA AllAha o rasUlera Anugatya kare, tArA nAvI, siddIka, zahIda evaM nekakAra lokadera saGgI have, yAdera prati AllAha ni‘mAta dAna karechena, tArA katai nA uttama saGgI!
eTA AllAhara pakSa hate anugraha, sarvajJa hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA satarkatA avalamvana kara evaM dale dale bhAga haYe kiMvA militabhAve agrasara hao|
evaM tomAdera keu keu nizcaYai pazcAte sare thAkave, ataHpara tomAdera upara kona vipada Asale se valave, ‘AllAha AmAra prati anugraha karechena ye, Ami tAdera saGge upasthita chilAma nA|’

Ara yadi tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha haYa, tave yena tomAdera o tAdera madhye kona prakArera samparka chila nA, emanibhAve avazyai vale uThave, ‘hAYa paritApa! Amio yadi tAdera saGge thAkatAma tAhale mahA sAphalya lAbha karatAma|’

sutarAM yArA AkherAtera vinimaYe pArthiva jIvana vikraYa kare tArA AllAhara pathe jihAda karuka evaM ye vyakti AllAhara pathe jihAda karave, ataHpara se nihata hoka athavA vijaYI hoka, acirei Ami tAke mahA pratiphala dAna karava|

tomAdera kI haYeche ye, tomarA AllAhara pathe evaM asahAYa nArI-puruSa Ara zizudera (rakSAra) janya lar3Ai karave nA, yArA du‘A karache- ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake e yAlima adhyUSita janapatha hate mukti dAo, tomAra pakSa hate kAukeo AmAdera vandhu vAniYe dAo evaM tomAra pakSa hate kAukeo AmAdera sAhAyyakArI kare dAo|’
ImAnadAragaNa AllAhara pathe yuddha kare Ara yArA kAphira tArA tAgutera pathe yuddha kare| kAjei tomarA zAYatvanera vandhudera viruddhe yuddha kara, zAYatvanera phandi avazyai durvala|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yAderake valA haYechila, tomarA tomAdera hAta saMyata rAkha, nAmAya kAYima kara evaM yAkAta dAo? ataHpara yakhana tAdera prati jihAda pharaya karA hala, takhana tAdera ekadala mAnuSake emana bhaYa karate lAgala yemana AllAhake bhaYa karA ucita, varaM tAra ceYeo vezI evaM valate lAgala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! kena AmAdera prati jihAda pharaya karale, AmAderake Arao kichu avasara dile nA kena?’ vala, ‘pArthiva bhoga sAmAnya, ye tAkaoYA avalamvana kare tAra janya AkhirAtai uttama, tomAdera prati vindumAtra anyAYa karA have nA|’

tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena, mRtyu tomAderake peYe vasavei, yadio tomarA suucca sudRr3ha dUrga madhye avasthAna kara| yadi tAdera kona kalyANa ghaTe, takhana tArA vale, eTA AllAhara tarapha hate| pakSAntare yadi tAdera kona akalyANa ghaTe takhana vale, ‘eTA to tomAra tarapha hate|’ vala, ‘savakichui AllAhara tarapha hate|’ e sampradAYera hala kI ye, tArA kona kathAi vujhe nA|

tomAra kona kalyANa hale tA haYa AllAhara tarapha hate evaM tomAra ye kona akalyANa hale tA haYa tomAra nijera kAraNe evaM Ami tomAke mAnuSera janya rasUlarUpe preraNa karechi, (e kathAra) sAkSI hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa|
ye rasUlera Anugatya karala, se to AllAharai Anugatya karala, keu mukha phiriYe nile (jorapUrvaka tAke satpathe AnAra janya) Ami tomAke tAdera prati pAhArAdAra kare pAThAini|

tArA mukhei Anugatya kare, kintu yakhana tomAra nikaTa theke cale yAYa, takhana tAdera madhye ekaTA dala rAtrivelA ekatrita haYe tomAra kathAra viruddhe salA parAmarza kare, AllAha tAdera rAtrikAlIna mantraNAgulo likhe rAkhachena, kAjei tAdera prati bhrukSepa karo nA, AllAhara upara bharasA kara evaM AllAhi karmavidhAYaka hiseve yatheSTa|
tArA ki kuraAnera marma viSaYe cinte-bhAvanA kare nA? yadi tA AllAha chAr3A anya kAro nikaTa hate Asata, tave tAte tArA avazyai vahu asaGgati peta|

yakhana tAdera nikaTa nirApattAra kiMvA bhaYera kona saMvAda Ase takhana tArA tA raTiYe deYa| yadi tArA tA rasUlera kiMvA tAdera madhye yArA kSamatAra adhikArI tAdera gocare Anata, tave tAdera madhya hate tathyAnusandhAnIgaNa prakRta tathya jene nita| yadi tomAdera prati AllAhara daYA o karuNA nA thAkata tave tomAdera alpa saMkhyaka chAr3A sakalei zAYatvanera anusaraNa karata|

kAjei AllAhara pathe yuddha kara, tomAke zudhu tomAra nijera janya dAYI karA have, mu’minadera udvuddha kara, hate pAre ye AllAha kAphiradera zakti saMyata karavena evaM AllAha zaktite ati pravala, zAstidAne ati kaThora|
ye vyakti bhAla kAjera janya supAriza karave, tAra janya tAte (sAoYAvera) aMza Ache evaM ye manda kAjera janya supAriza karave, tAra janya tAte aMza Ache, AllAha sakala viSaYe kho~ja rAkhena|

yakhana tomAderake sasammAne sAlAma pradAna karA haYa, takhana tomarA tAra ceYe uttamarUpe jaoYAvI sAlAma dAo kiMvA (kamapakSe) anurUpabhAve dAo, nizcaYai AllAha (kSudra-vRhat) sakala viSaYe hisAva grahaNakArI|
AllAha, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, tini kviYAmAta divase sakalake ekatra karavenai, ete konai sandeha nei, AllAha apekSA Ara kAra kathA adhika satya hate pAre?

tomAdera kI hala ye, munAphikadera vyApAre (kI nIti avalamvana karA have se viSaYe) tomarA du’ dale vibhakta haYe gele? vastutaH AllAha tAdera e kAryakalApera kAraNe tAderake ulTA mukhe phiriYe diYechena (isalAma theke AvAra kupharera dike)| AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karechena, tomarA ki tAke supatha dekhAte cAo? vastutaH AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra janya kakSano patha khu~je pAve nA|

tArA AkAGkSA kare ye, tArA nijerA yemana kupharI kareche, tomarAo temani kupharI kara, yAte tomarA tAdera samAna haYe yAo| kAjei tAdera madhya hate kAukeo vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA, ye paryanta tArA AllAhara pathe hijarata nA kare| yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave tAderake grephatAra kara evaM yekhAnei tAderake pAo, hatyA kara| tAdera madhya hate kona vandhu o sAhAyyakArI grahaNa karo nA|

kintu (se sava munAphika e kathAra madhye zAmila naYa) yArA tomAdera sAthe cuktivaddha kona jAtira saGge giYe milita haYa| temani (tArAo era madhye zAmila naYa) yArA tomAra kAche Ase Ara tArA jhagar3A-vivAde utsAhI naYa, tArA nA tomAdera viruddhe lar3Ai karate cAYa, nA nijera jAtira viruddhe| AllAha yadi icche karatena, tave tAderake tomAdera upara pravala kare ditena, se avasthAYa tArA nizcaYa tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karata| kAjei tArA yadi tomAdera hate sare thAke, tomAdera viruddhe yuddha nA kare o tomAdera nikaTa zAnti prastAva kare, tave AllAha tomAdera janya tAdera viruddhe konao vyavasthA avalamvanera patha rAkhenani|

acirei tomarA kataka lokake emanao pAve, yArA tomAdera kAcha thekeo nirApada thAkate cAYa, tAdera nija sampradAYa thekeo nirApada thAkate cAYa, yakhana tAderake phitanAra dike manoniveza karAno haYa takhana tAtei jar3iYe par3e| kAjei yadi tArA tomAdera zatrutA hate sare nA yAYa evaM tomAdera nikaTa zAnti prastAva nA kare evaM tAdera hasta saMvaraNa nA kare, tave tAderake grephatAra kara Ara yekhAnei pAo hatyA kara, erAi hacche sei sava loka tomAderake yAdera viruddhAcaraNera spaSTa adhikAra diYechi|

kona mu’minake hatyA karA kona mu’minera kAja naYa tave bhulavazata hate pAre, keu kona mu’minake bhulakrame hatyA karale, ekajana mu’mina dAsa mukta karA vA tAra parivAravargake raktapaNa deYA kartavya, yadi nA tArA kSamA kare deYa| yadi se tomAdera zatrupakSera loka haYa evaM mu’mina haYa tave ekajana mu’mina golAma AyAda karA kartavya, Ara yadi se emana gotrera loka haYa yAdera madhye o tomAdera madhye cukti raYeche tave tAra parivArake raktapaNa deYA evaM ekajana mu’mina golAma AyAda karA kartavya evaM ye vyakti saGgatihIna se ekAdikrame du’ mAsa royA pAlana karave| eTAi hala AllAhara nikaTa tAovAha karAra vyavasthA, AllAha mahAjJAnI, suvijJa|
ye vyakti kona mu’minake icchApUrvaka hatyA kare, tAra zAsti jAhAnnAma| yAte sthAYIbhAve thAkave, tAra upara AllAhara krodha o abhisampAta| AllAha tAra janya mahAzAsti nirdiSTa kare rekhechena|

he mu’minagaNa! yakhana tomarA AllAhara pathe yAtrA karave takhana ke vandhu Ara ke zatru tA parIkSA kare neve, keu tomAderake sAlAma karale tAke valo nA, ‘tumi mu’mina nao’, tomarA ihajagatera sampadera AkAGkSA kara, vastutaH AllAhara nikaTa tomAdera janya pracura ganImata Ache| tomarAo era pUrve e rakamai chile (arthAt tomArAo tAdera matai tomAdera ImAnake tomAdera kaoma theke gopana karate), tatpara AllAha tomAdera prati kRpA karechena, kAjei agre vizeSabhAve parIkSA kare nive; tomarA yA kichu kara, se viSaYe AllAha savizeSa avahita|

akSama naYa emana vase-thAkA mu’minarA Ara jAna-mAla dvArA AllAhara pathe jihAdakArIgaNa samAna naYa; nijedera dhana-prANa dvArA jihAdakArIderake vase-thAkA lokedera upara AllAha maryAdA diYechena| AllAha sakalera janyai kalyANera oYAdA karechena evaM mujAhidaderake vase-thAkA lokedera tulanAYa AllAha mahApuraskAra diYe maryAdA dAna karechena|
oTA AllAhara nikaTa hate padamaryAdA, kSamA o daYA; AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAvAna|

yArA nijedera AtmAra upara yulama karechila emana lokedera prANa haraNera samaYa pherezatArA tAderake jijJesa kare- ‘tomarA kon kAje nimajjita chile’? tArA vale, ‘duniYAYa AmarA durvala kSamatAhIna chilAma’, pherezatArA vale, ‘AllAhara yamIna ki prazasta chila nA yAte tomarA hijarAta karate’? sutarAM tAdera AvAsasthala have jAhAnnAma evaM tA katai nA nikRSTa pratyAvartana sthAna!
kintu ye sakala sahAYahIna puruSa, nArI o vAlaka yArA upAYa vera karate pAre nA Ara tArA pathao pAYa nA,
AzA Ache ye, AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena evaM AllAha gunAha mocanakArI, var3ai kSamAzIla|

ye vyakti AllAhara pathe hijarAta karave, se pRthivIte vahu AzraYasthala evaM prAcurya prApta have; evaM ye vyakti nijera gRha hate AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera dike hijarAta kare vera haYa, ataHpara mRtyu tAke peYe vase tAra sAoYAva AllAhara jimmAYa sAvyasta haYe geche evaM AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

yakhana tomarA deze-videze saphara kara, takhana nAmAya kasara karAte tomAdera kichumAtra doSa nei, yadi tomarA bhaYa kara ye, kAphiragaNa tomAderake vipadagrasta karave| niHsandehe kAphiragaNa to tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

evaM yakhana tumi mu’minadera mAjhe avasthAna karave Ara tAdera saGge nAmAya kAYima karave takhana tAdera ekaTi dala yena tomAra saGge dA~r3AYa evaM sazastra thAke, tAdera sAjadAha karA hale tArA yena tomAdera pazcAte avasthAna kare evaM apara ye dalaTi nAmAya AdAYa kareni tArA yena tomAra saGge nAmAya AdAYa kare evaM satarka o sazastra thAke; kAphiragaNa kAmanA kare ye, tomarA yena tomAdera astrazastra o saraJjAmera vyApAre asatarka hao, yAte tArA ekajoTe tomAdera upara jhA~piYe par3ate pAre| yadi tomAdera vRSTira kAraNe kaSTa haYa, kiMvA tomarA pIr3ita hao, tave astra rekhe dile tomAdera kona gunAha nei, kintu satarkatA avalamvana karave, AllAha kAphiradera janya avamAnanAkara zAsti prastuta kare rekhechena|

yakhana tomarA nAmAya AdAYa kare neve, takhana dA~r3iYe, vase, zuYe AllAhake smaraNa karave, ataHpara yakhana tomarA nirApada have takhana (yathAniYame) nAmAya kAYima karave| nirdiSTa samaYe nAmAya kAYima karA mu’minadera janya avazya kartavya|

e (zatru) kaomera pazcAddhAvaNe durvalatA dekhAve nA, kenanA yadi tomarA kaSTa pAo, tave tomAdera mata tArAo to kaSTa pAYa, Ara tomarA AllAha hate emana kichu AzA kara, yA tArA AzA kare nA| AllAha mahAjJAnI, vijJAnamaYa|
avazyai Ami satya sahakAre tomAra prati kitAva nAyila karechi, yena tumi yA AllAha tomAke jAniYechena, se anusAre mAnuSera madhye vicAra phAYasAlA kara evaM khiYAnatakArIdera pakSe tarka karo nA|
Ara AllAhara nikaTa kSamA cAo, nizcaYa AllAha atizaYa kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
nijedera (viveka o jJAnera) prati khiYAnatakArIdera pakSe tumi vAdAnuvAda karo nA, kAraNa AllAha ati khiYAnatakArI carama pApIke pachanda karena nA|

tArA mAnuSa hate gopana kare thAke, kintu tArA AllAha hate gopana karate pAre nA; kenanA ye samaYe tArA rAtre emana viSaYe parAmarza kare yA AllAha pachanda karena nA, takhanao tini tAdera saGgei thAkena; AllAha tAdera samudaYa kAryakalApake veSTana kare Achena|
dekha, orA sei loka yAdera pakSe pArthiva jIvane tomarA vitarka karacha kintu kviYAmAta divase tAdera pakSa hate AllAhara sammukhe ke jhagar3A karave? kiMvA ke tAdera ukIla have?
ye vyakti asatkAja kare kiMvA nijera AtmAra prati yulama kare, ataHpara AllAha hate kSamA bhikSe kare, se AllAhake ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu pAve|
evaM ye vyakti kona pApakAja kare, se nijera viruddhei tA kare, vastutaH AllAha mahAvijJAnI, prajJAmaYa|
ye vyakti kona truTi kiMvA pApa ka’re tA kona nirdoSa vyaktira upara cApiYe deYa, se to jvalanta apavAda evaM suspaSTa gunAha nijera upara cApiYe neYa|

yadi tomAra prati AllAhara karuNA evaM daYA nA hata, tave tAdera ekadala to tomAke pathabhraSTa karatei ceYechila; vastutaH tArA nijederake chAr3A anya kAuke pathabhraSTa kare nA Ara tArA tomAra kichui aniSTa karate pArave nA, kAraNa AllAha tomAra prati kitAva o hikamAta nAyila karechena evaM tumi yA jAnate nA tA tomAke zikSA diYechena evaM tomAra upara raYeche AllAhara aparisIma anugraha|

tAdera adhikAMza gopana parAmarzera madhye kona kalyANa nei, kintu kalyANa Ache ye vyakti dAna-khaYarAta athavA kona satkAjera kiMvA lokedera madhye milamizera nirdeza deYa| ye keu AllAhara santuSTi sAdhana uddeze emana kAja karave, Ami tAke mahA puraskAra dAna karava|

ye vyakti satya patha prakAzita haoYAra parao rasUlera virodhitA kare evaM mu’minadera patha vAda diYe bhinna patha anusaraNa kare, Ami tAke se pathei phirAva ye pathe se phire yAYa, Ara tAke jAhAnnAme dagdha karava, kata mandai nA se AvAsa!
nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra saGge zarIka karAke kSamA karena nA, echAr3A anya sava yAke icche mApha karena evaM ye vyakti AllAhara saGge zarIka kare, se caramabhAve gomarAhIte patita hala|
tArA AllAhake cher3e zudhu katakagulo devIrai pUjA kare, tArA kevala AllAhadrohI zAYatvanera pUjA kare|
AllAha tAke lA‘nAta karechena kAraNa se valechila, ‘Ami tomAra vAndAdera theke nirdiSTa aMzake AmAra anusArI hiseve grahaNa karava|’

tAderake avazya avazyai pathabhraSTa karava, tAderake avazya avazyai vahu pralobhana deva evaM tAderake avazya avazyai nirdeza deva, phale tArA jantu-jAnoYArera kAna chedana karave, Ami tAderake avazya avazyai nirdeza deva, phale tArA avazya avazyai AllAhara sRSTi vikRta karave| AllAhake vAda diYe ye keu zaYatvAnake abhibhAvaka hiseve grahaNa kare, se suspaSTata kSatigrasta|
se tAderake AzvAsa deYa, mithyA pralobhana deYa, vastutaH zaYatvAna tAderake ye AzvAsa deYa tA chalanA chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|
erAi tArA yAdera AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma evaM tArA tAttheke niskRti pAoYAra kona patha pAve nA|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche o neka kAja kareche avilamve Ami tAderake jAnnAte dAkhila karava; yAra pAdadeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita, tArA tAte cirakAla cirasthAYI haYe thAkave, AllAhara oYA‘dA satya, kathAYa AllAha apekSA ke vezi satyavAdI?

tomAdera vAsanA Ara Ahale kitAvadera vAsanA kona kAje Asave nA| ye vyakti kona kukarma karave, se tAra vinimaYa prApta have, se AllAha chAr3A tAra janya kona abhibhAvaka pAve nA, kona sAhAyyakArIo nA|
puruSa o nArIra madhye ye satkAja karave Ara se ImAnadArao vaTe, tAhale tArA jAnnAte praveza karave, tAdera prati tila parimANao anyAYa karA have nA|

se vyakti apekSA dvIne ke vezi uttama ye vyakti AllAhara kAche AtmasamarpaNa kare, adhikantu se satkarmazIla evaM ekaniSThabhAve ivarAhImera dvIna anusaraNa kare| AllAha ivarAhImake ekAnta vandhurUpe grahaNa karechilena|
AsamAna o yamIne yA kichu Ache sava AllAharai evaM AllAha savakichukei pariveSTana kare Achena|

lokerA tomAra kAche nArIdera samvandhe vidhAna jAnate cAcche| vale dAo, ‘AllAha tAdera samvandhe tomAderake vidhAna jAniYe dicchena sesava nArI samparke yAdera prApya tomarA pradAna kara nA athaca tAderake viYe karate cAo evaM asahAYa zizudera samparke evaM iYAtImadera prati tomAdera nyAYavicAra karA samparke yA kitAve tomAderake zunAno haYa tAo jAniYe dena|’ yA kichu sat kAja tomarA kara, tadviSaYe AllAha bhAlabhAvei jJAta|

evaM yadi kona nArI svIYa svAmI hate rUr3hatA kiMvA upekSAra AzaGkA kare, tave tArA paraspara ApoSa karale tAdera kona gunAha nei, vastutaH ApoSa karAi uttama| Ara naphas kRpaNatAra dike sahajei jhu~ke par3e, Ara yadi tomarA satkarma kara evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara tave tomarA yA kara AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

tomarA kakSano strIdera madhye samatA rakSA karate pArave nA yadio pravala icche kara, tomarA ekajanera dike sampUrNarUpe jhu~ke par3o nA evaM anyake jhuliYe rekha nA| yadi tomarA nijederake saMzodhana kara evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana kara, tave AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tArA yadi ubhaYe pRthaka haYe yAYa tave AllAha Apana prAcurya diYe pratyekake abhAvamukta kare devena, AllAha prAcuryamaYa, mahAkuzalI|

yA kichu AkAzasamUhe o bhUmanDale Ache samasta AllAharai evaM avazyai Ami tomAdera Age yAderake kitAva deYA haYechila tAderake Ara tomAderakeo Adeza diYechi ye, AllAhake bhaYa kara Ara yadi amAnya kara tave AkAzasamUhe yA Ache o bhUmanDale yA Ache tA AllAharai| AllAha abhAvamukta, atizaYa prazaMsita|
AsamAne yA Ache Ara yamIne yA Ache sava AllAharai, kAryanirvAhaka hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa|
tini icche karale he mAnuSa! tomAderake vilupta ka’re tini anya sampradAYake Anate pArena, AllAha tA karate puropuri sakSama|
ye vyakti pArthiva puraskAra kAmanA kare se jene rAkhuka ye AllAhara nikaTa ihalaukika o pAralaukika puraskAra Ache| AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

he ImAnadAragaNa! nyAYera prati supratiSTha o AllAhara janya sAkSyadAtA hao yadio tA tomAdera nijedera kiMvA mAtA-pitA evaM AtmIYagaNera viruddhe haYa, keu dhanI hoka vA daridra hoka, AllAha ubhaYerai ghaniSThatara| ataeva pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA yAte tomarA nyAYavicAra karate pAra evaM yadi tomarA vakrabhAve kathA vala kiMvA satyake er3iYe yAo tave nizcaYa tomarA yA karacha, AllAha se viSaYe sampUrNa avagata|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAha, tA~ra rasUlera, tA~ra rasUlera nikaTa tini avatIrNa karechena sei kitAvera evaM pUrve nAyilakRta kitAvera upara ImAna Ana| ye vyakti AllAhake o tA~ra pherezatAderake, tA~ra kitAvasamUhake, tA~ra rasUlagaNake evaM zeSa divasake asvIkAra kare se sImAhIna pathabhraSTatAYa patita haYa|
yArA ImAna Anala, ataHpara kupharI karala AvAra ImAna Anala AvAra kupharI karala, ataHpara kupharIte agrasara hate thAkala, AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena nA evaM pathapradarzana karavena nA|
munAphikaderake susaMvAda zuniYe dAo ye, tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|
yArA mu’minaderake cher3e kAphiraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kare tArA ki tAdera nikaTa iyayata cAYa? iyayatera savakichui AllAhara adhikAre|

kitAve tomAdera nikaTa tini nAyila karechena ye, yakhana tomarA zunave AllAhara AYAtera prati kupharI hacche evaM tAra prati ThATTA karA hacche, takhana tAdera nikaTa vaso nA ye paryanta tArA anya AlocanAYa lipta nA haYa, nacet tomarAo tAdera mata haYe yAve, nizcaYa AllAha munAphika o kAphiradera sakalakei jAhAnnAme ekatrita karavena|

tArA (arthAt munAphikarA) tomAdera vyApAre OMt pete thAke, tArA AllAhara tarapha hate tomAdera jaYalAbha hale vale AmarA ki tomAdera saGge chilAma nA? Ara yadi kAphiradera kichu vijaYa ghaTe takhana tArA vale, AmarA ki tomAdera upara vijaYI chilAma nA evaM AmarA ki tomAderake mu’minadera hate rakSA karini? ematAvasthAYa AllAha kviYAmAta divase tomAdera madhye mImAMsA kare devena evaM AllAha kakSano mu’minadera viruddhe kAphiraderake (jaYalAbhera) patha kare devena nA|

nizcaYa munAphikagaNa AllAhara saGge dho~kAvAji kare, tini tAderake dho~kAYa phele zAsti dena evaM tArA yakhana salAtera janya dA~r3AYa, takhana zaithilyabhare dA~r3AYa, loka dekhAnora janya, tArA AllAhake sAmAnyai smaraNa kare|
tArA mAjhakhAne dodulyamAna, nA edera dike, nA odera dike; vastutaH AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tumi tAra janya kakSano kona patha pAve nA|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA mu’minadera parivarte kAphiraderake tomAdera vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA, tomarA ki tomAdera nijedera viruddhe AllAhara kAche suspaSTa pramANa peza karate cAo?
munAphikarA thAkave jAhAnnAmera sarvanimna stare, tumi tAdera janya kakSano kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|

avazya tArA edera madhye zAmila naYa yArA tAovAha karave, nijederake saMzodhana karave, AllAhake majavutabhAve dhAraNa karave, Ara nijedera dvInake AllAhara janya ekaniSTha karave| takhana tArA mu’minadera saGgI hiseve gaNya have Ara AllAha acirei mu’minaderake mahA pratiphala dAna karavena|
tomarA yadi zokaragujAri kara Ara ImAna Ana tAhale tomAderake zAsti diYe AllAha kI karavena? AllAha (satkAjera var3ai) puraskAradAtA, sarvaviSaYe jJAta|
khArApa kathAra pracAra prapAgAnDA AllAha pachanda karena nA, tave yAra prati anyAYa karA haYeche (tAra kathA AlAdA), AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
tomarA yadi bhAla kAja prakAzye kara kiMvA tA gopane kara kiMvA mandake kSamA kara tave AllAhao doSatruTi mocanakArI, kSamatAra adhikArI|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUladerake asvIkAra kare Ara AllAha o rasUladera mAjhe pArthakya sRSTi karate cAYa Ara vale (rasUladera) katakake AmarA mAni Ara katakake mAni nA, Ara tArA tAra (kuphara o ImAnera) mAjha diYe ekaTA rAstA vera karate cAYa |
tArAi hala prakRta kAphira Ara kAphiradera janya Ami avamAnanAkara zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

Ara yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUladera prati vizvAsa sthApana kare Ara tAdera kAro madhye kona pArthakya kare nA, tini avazyai tAderake tAdera puraskAra dAna karavena, AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

kitAvadhArIgaNa tomAke AsamAna theke tAdera sAmane kitAva niYe Asate vale| tArA to mUsAra kAche era ceYeo var3a dAvI peza karechila| tArA valechila- AmAderake prakAzye AllAhake dekhAo| takhana tAdera anyAYa o vAr3AvAr3ira kAraNe vidyut tAdera upara AghAta henechila| ataHpara tAdera kAche spaSTa pramANa AsAra pareo tArA go-vatsake (upAsya) grahaNa karechila, tAo Ami kSamA kare diYechilAma, Ara mUsAke suspaSTa kartRtva dAna karechilAma|

tAdera nikaTa hate aGgIkAra grahaNera janya Ami tUra pAhAr3ake tAdera Urdhve tule dharechilAma, Ara tAderake valechilAma- avanata mastake (nagara) dvAre praveza kara Ara tAderake valechilAma zanivArera Aina bhaGga karo nA, Ara tAdera nikaTa theke niYechilAma pAkA pratizruti|

(tAdera prati AllAhara asantoSa neme eseche) tAdera oYA‘dA bhaGgera kAraNe, Ara AllAhara nidarzanasamUhake asvIkAra karAra kAraNe, anyAYabhAve nAvIgaNake tAdera hatyA karAra kAraNe, Ara ‘AmAdera hRdaYagulo AcchAdita’ tAdera e kathA valAra kAraNe- varaM tAdera asvIkRtira kAraNe AllAha tAdera hRdaYagulote mohara mere diYechena| ye kAraNe tAdera alpasaMkhyaka chAr3A ImAna Ane nA|
(tAdera prati AllAhara asantoSa neme eseche) tAdera kupharIra janya Ara mAraiYAmera prati tAdera gurutara apavAdapUrNa kathA uccAraNera janya|

Ara ‘AmarA AllAhara rasUla mAsIha IsA ivanu mAraiYAmake hatyA karechi’ tAdera e uktira janya| kintu tArA nA tAke hatyA kareche, nA tAke kruzaviddha kareche, kevalamAtra tAdera janya (eka lokake) tAra sadRza karA haYechila, Ara yArA e viSaYe matabheda karechila tArAo e samparke sandehe patita haYechila| zudhu amUlaka dhAraNAra anusaraNa chAr3A e vyApAre tAdera kona jJAnai chila nA| eTA nizcita satya ye, tArA tAke hatyA kareni|
varaM AllAha tAke nijera kAche uThiYe niYechena, Ara AllAha halena mahAparAkramazAlI, mahAvijJAnI|
kitAvaoYAlAdera madhye emana keu nei ye, tAra mRtyura pUrve tAra prati avazyai ImAna Anave nA, Ara kviYAmAtera dina se tAdera viruddhe sAkSya deve|
Ami iYAhUdIdera janya pavitra vastusamUha yA tAdera janya hAlAla chila, tA hArAma kare diYechi tAdera vAr3AvAr3ira kAraNe Ara vahu lokake AllAhara pathe tAdera vAdhA deYAra kAraNe|

evaM tAdera suda grahaNera kAraNe yadio tAttheke tAderake niSedha karA haYechila evaM tAdera anyAYabhAve lokedera dhana-sampada grAsa karAra kAraNe evaM Ami tAdera mAjhe yArA avizvAsI tAdera janye yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

kintu tAdera madhye yArA jJAne paripakka Ara mu’minagaNa tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche Ara tomAra pUrve yA avatIrNa haYeche tAte vizvAsa sthApana kare Ara tArA nAmAya kvAYimakArI o yAkAta AdAYakArI evaM AllAhte o zeSa dinera prati vizvAsI; ederakei Ami zIghra mahApuraskAra dAna karava|
