Ami tomAra kAche oYAhI pAThiYechi yemana nUha o tAra paravartI nAvIgaNera nikaTa oYAhI pAThiYechilAma, Ara ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkuva o tAra vaMzadhara Ara IsA, AiYUva, iunusa, hArUna o sulAYamAnera nikaTao oYAhI pAThiYechilAma Ara Ami dAUdake yAvUra pradAna karechilAma|
Ami sei rasUladera pratio oYAhI pAThiYechi yAdera samparke Ami tomAke Agei valechi, Ara aneka rasUla yAdera kathA Ami tomAke valini| Ara AllAha mUsAra sAthe kathA valechena sarAsari|
rasUlagaNa chilena susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI yAte rasUladera Agamanera para AllAhara viruddhe mAnuSera kona ayuhAtera suyoga nA thAke| AllAha halena mahAparAkramazAlI, vijJAnamaYa|
kintu AllAha sAkSya dicchena ye, yA tini nAyila karechena tA tA~ra jJAnera bhittitei nAyila karechena| pherezatArAo se sAkSya dicche Ara sAkSI hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa|
yArA kupharI kare Ara lokederake AllAhara patha hate phiriYe rAkhe tArA carama pathabhraSTatAYa pathabhraSTa haYe geche|
yArA kupharI kareche Ara vAr3AvAr3i kareche, AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena nA, tAderake kona pathao dekhAvena nA |
jAhAnnAmera patha chAr3A, yAte tArA cirakAlera janya sthAYI have, Ara eTA AllAhara janya sahaja|

he mAnuSa! rasUla tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate satya vidhAna niYe eseche, kAjei tomarA ImAna Ana, eTA tomAdera janya kalyANakara have, Ara yadi kupharI kara (tAhale jene rekha) AkAzasamUhe Ara yamIne yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara Ara AllAha halena sarvajJa, mahA kuzalI|

ohe kitAvadhArIgaNa! tomarA tomAdera dvInera vyApAre vAr3AvAr3i karo nA, Ara AllAha samvandhe satya chAr3A kichu valo nA, IsA mAsIha to AllAhara rasUla Ara tA~ra vAnI yA tini mAraiYAmera nikaTa preraNa karechilena, Ara tA~ra pakSa hate nirdeza, kAjei tomarA AllAhara prati o tA~ra rasUlagaNera prati ImAna Ano, Ara valo nA ‘tina’ (jana ilAha Ache), nivRtta hao, tA have tomAdera janya kalyANakara, AllAha to ekaka ilAha, tini pavitra ettheke ye, tA~ra santAna have| AsamAnasamUhe Ara yamIne yA Ache sava kichu tA~rai, Ara karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

mAsIha AllAhara vAndA haoYAke tuccha jJAna kare nA, Ara naikaTyera adhikArI pherezatArAo nA| ye tA~ra ‘ivAdAtake heYa jJAna kare Ara ahaGkAra kare, tini tAdera sakalake zIghrai tA~ra kAche ekatrita karavena|

kintu yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare AllAha tAdera puraskAra puropuri dAna karavena, Ara nija anugrahe Aro vezi devena| Ara yArA tuccha jJAna karave o ahaGkAra karave tAderake kaSTadAYaka zAsti dAna karavena| AllAha vyatIta tAdera janya tArA nA pAve kona abhibhAvaka, nA (pAve) kona sAhAyyakArI|
he mAnavamanDalI! tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAdera kAche ujjvala pramANa ese pau~cheche, Ara Ami tomAdera nikaTa suspaSTa jyoti avatIrNa karechi|

ataHpara yArA AllAhara prati ImAna Ane Ara tA~ke dRr3habhAve aA~kar3e dhare thAke, acirei tini tAderake tA~ra rahamata o anugrahera madhye dAkhila karavena evaM tA~ra dike sarala-sudRr3ha pathe paricAlita karavena|

lokerA tomAra kAche phAtAoYA jijJesa karache; vala, AllAha tomAderake pitA-mAtAhIna niHsantAna vyakti samparke phAtAoYA dicchena, kona vyakti mArA gele tAra yadi santAna nA thAke Ara tAra ekaTi vona thAke, tave rekhe yAoYA sampattira ardheka se pAve, Ara se (mRta nArI) yadi santAnahInA haYa tave tAra bhAi tAra uttarAdhikArI have, Ara du’ vona thAkale tArA tAra rekhe yAoYA sampattira du’-tRtIYAMza pAve, Ara yadi bhAi o vona du’i thAke, tave puruSa pAve du’jana nArIra samAna| AllAha suspaSTabhAve varNanA karechena yAte tomarA vibhrAntite patita nA hao| AllAha yAvatIYa vyApAre pUrNarUpe avahita|

ohe mu’minagaNa! tomarA aGgIkArasamUha pUrNa kara| tomAdera janya gRhapAlita catuspada jantu hAlAla karA hala- segulo chAr3A yegulora vivaraNa tomAderake deYA hacche, Ara iharAma avasthAYa zikAra karA avaidha| AllAha yA cAna hukuma dena|

ohe mu’minagaNa! AllAhara nidarzanAvalIra, hArAma mAsera, kA‘vAYa prerita kuravAnIra pazura evaM galadeze mAlya parihita pazura asammAna karo nA, yArA nija pratipAlakera anugraha o santuSTi lAbhera uddeze pavitra gRhera AzraYe caleche tAderao (avamAnanA) karo nA| tomarA yakhana iharAmamukta have takhana zikAra karate pAra| tomAderake yArA masajide hArAma theke vAdhA pradAna karechila, tAdera prati zatrutA tomAderake yena avazyai sImAlaGghane prarocita nA kare| satkAja o tAkvaoYAra vyApAre tomarA parasparake sahayogitA kara, pApa o sImAlaGghanera kAje parasparake sahayogitA karo nA| AllAhake bhaYa kara, AllAha zAsti dAne atyanta kaThora|

tomAdera janya hArAma karA haYeche mRtajantu, (pravAhita) rakta, zUkarera mAMsa, AllAha chAr3A anyera nAme yavahakRta pazu, Ara zvAsaruddha haYe mRta jantu, AghAte mRta jantu, upara theke patanera phale mRta, saMgharSe mRta Ara hiMsra jantute khAoYA pazu- tave jIvita peYe yA tomarA yavaha karate perecha tA vAde, Ara yA kona AstAnAYa (vA vedIte) yavaha karA haYeche, Ara juYAra tIra dvArA bhAgya nirNaYa karA (egulo tomAdera janya hArAma karA haYeche)| esavagulo pApa kAja| Aja kAphiragaNa tomAdera dvInera virodhitA karAra vyApAre puropuri nirAza haYe geche, kAjei tAderake bhaYa karo nA, kevala AmAkei bhaYa kara| Aja Ami tomAdera janya tomAdera dvInake pUrNAGga kare dilAma, tomAdera prati AmAra niAmAta pUrNa kare dilAma evaM isalAmake tomAdera dvIna hiseve kavUla kare nilAma| tave keu pApa karAra pravaNatA vyatIta kSudhAra jvAlAYa (niSiddha vastu khete) vAdhya hale AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

lokerA tomAke jijJesa karache tAdera janya kI kI hAlAla karA haYeche| vala, yAvatIYa bhAla o pavitra vastu tomAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche, Ara zikArI pazu-pakSI- yAderake tomarA zikSA diYecha yebhAve AllAha tomAderake zikSA diYechena- sutarAM tArA yA tomAdera janya dhare rAkhe tA tomarA bhakSaNa karave Ara tAte AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karave, Ara AllAhake bhaYa karave, AllAha hisAva grahaNe tvaritgati|

Aja tomAdera janya yAvatIYa bhAla o pavitra vastu hAlAla karA hala Ara yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche tAdera khAdya tomAdera janya hAlAla, Ara tomAdera khAdya tAdera janya hAlAla, saccaritrA mu’mina nArI evaM tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche tAdera saccaritrA nArI tomAdera janya hAlAla karA hala yakhana tomarA tAderake moharAnA pradAna kara, vivAhera dUrge sthAna dAnera uddezye, vyabhicArI hiseve naYa evaM gopana saGgI grahaNakArI hiseve naYa| keu ImAna amAnya karale, tAra kAryAdi niSphala have| Ara se AkherAte kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yakhana salAtera janya uThave, takhana tomAdera mukhamanDala evaM kanui paryanta hastadvaYa dhauta karave| Ara tomAdera mAthA mAseha karave evaM pA gor3Ali paryanta dhauta karave| tomarA yadi apavitra avasthAYa thAka tave vidhimata pavitratA arjana karave| Ara yadi pIr3ita hao vA saphare thAka athavA tomAdera keu yadi malatyAga kare Ase athavA yadi tomarA strIdera sAthe sahavAsa kara Ara pAni nA pAo tAhale pavitra mATi diYe tAYAmmuma karave tA diYe tomAdera mukhamanDala o hAta mAseha karave| AllAha tomAdera upara saMkIrNatA cApiYe dite cAna nA, tini tomAderake pavitra karate cAna Ara tomAdera prati tA~ra ni‘AmAta pUrNa karate cAna, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

tomAdera prati AllAhara niAmatera kathA smaraNa kara Ara tA~ra aGgIkArera kathA yA tini tomAdera nikaTa theke grahaNa karechilena yakhana tomarA valechile- AmarA zunalAma o mene nilAma| AllAhake bhaYa kara, antare yA Ache se samparke AllAha khuva bhAlabhAvei avagata Achena|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA nyAYera sAkSyadAtA hiseve AllAhara pathe dRr3habhAve danDAYamAna thAka, kona sampradAYera prati zatrutA tomAderake yena etaTA uttejita nA kare ye tomarA inasApha karA tyAga karave, suvicAra kara, eTA tAkvaoYAra nikaTavartI, tomarA yA kara se samparke AllAha sampUrNa oYAkiphahAla|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare tAdera prati AllAha oYA‘dA karechena ye, tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o mahA puraskAra|
yArA kupharI kare, Ara AmAra nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra kare tArA hala jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhara ni‘AmAtera kathA smaraNa kara yakhana ekaTi sampradAYa tomAdera viruddhe tAdera hasta uttolana karate ceYechila, takhana tini tomAdera theke tAdera hAta nivRtta karechilena| AllAhake bhaYa kara, Ara muminagaNa yena AllAharai upara bharasA kare|

AllAha vAnI isarAIlera nikaTa theke pratizruti grahaNa karechilena, Ara tAdera madhye vArajana pradhAna niyukta karechilena| Ara AllAha valechilena, Ami tomAdera saGge Achi, yadi tomarA nAmAya kAYima kara, yAkAta AdAYa kara evaM AmAra rasUlagaNera prati vizvAsa sthApana kara Ara tAderake sAhAyya-sahayogitA kara Ara AllAhake RNa dAna kara uttama RNa, tAhale Ami tomAdera pApagulo avazya avazyai dUra kare deva, Ara avazya avazyai tomAderake jAnnAte dAkhila karAva yAra nimne jharNAdhArA pravAhita| eraparao tomAdera madhye yArA kuphurI karave tArA satya saThika patha hAriYe phelave|

tAdera aGgIkAra bhaGgera kAraNe Ami tAderake lA‘nAta karechi Ara tAdera hRdaYake Aro zakta kare diYechi, tArA zavdaguloke svasthAna theke vicyuta karechila evaM tAderake deYA upadezera var3a aMza tArA bhule giYechila| tumi alpa saMkhyaka chAr3A tAderake sarvadA vizvAsaghAtakatA karate dekhate pAve| kAjei tAderake kSamA kara, mArjanA kara, AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|

Ara yArA vale ‘‘AmarA khrIsTAna’’ Ami tAdera hateo aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma| kintu tArA tAdera prati upadezera ekaTA var3a aMza bhule giYechila| kAjei Ami kiYAmAta paryanta tAdera parasparera madhye zatrutA o vidveSa jiiYe diYechi| tArA yA karachila acirei AllAha tA tAderake jAniYe divena|

he kitAvadhArIgaNa! tomAdera kAche AmAra rasUla ese geche, se tomAderake aneka viSaYa varNanA kare kitAva theke yA tomarA gopana karate Ara aneka viSaYa upekSA kare| tomAdera nikaTa AllAhara pakSa hate jyoti o spaSTa kitAva eseche|

AllAha tadvArA tAderake zAnti o nirApattAra pathe paricAlita karena yArA tA~ra santuSTi anusandhAna kare evaM nija anumatikrame tini tAderake andhakAra hate vera kare Alora dike niYe Asena Ara tAderake sarala saThika pathe paricAlita karena|

tArA kupharI kareche yArA vale mAsIh ivane mAraiYAmai AllAha| vala, mAsIha ivane mAraiYAma, Ara tAra mA evaM pRthivIte yArA Ache sakalake dhvaMsa karate cAile AllAhara viruddhe kAro etaTuku kSamatA Ache ki? AsamAnasamUhe Ara pRthivIte o edera madhye yA kichu Ache sava AllAharai mAlikAnAdhIna| tini yA icche sRSTi karena| AllAh sakala viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

iYAhUdI o nAsArArA vale, AmarA AllAhara putra o tA~ra priYapAtra| vala, tAhale tomAdera pApera janya AllAha tomAderake zAsti dena kena? varaM tini yAdera sRSTi karechena tomarA tAdera antargata mAnuSa, tini yAke icche kSamA karena, yAke icche zAsti dena, AkAzasamUha o pRthivI Ara edera madhye yA Ache savakichura sArvabhaumatva AllAharai janya, Ara pratyAvartana tA~rai pAne|

ohe Ahale kitAva! rasUla preraNe viratira para tomAdera kAche AmAra rasUla ese spaSTabhAve tomAdera nikaTa varNanA kare dicche yAte tomarA valate nA pAra ye, AmAdera kAche kona susaMvAdadAtA o sAvadhAnakArI Agamana kareni| ekhana tAi susaMvAdadAtA o sAvadhAnakArI ese geche| Ara AllAha hacchena sakala viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra sampradAYake valechila, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA tomAdera prati AllAhara ni‘YAmAta smaraNa kara ye, tini tomAdera madhye nAvI karechena evaM tomAderake vAdazAha karechena Ara tomAderake tini emana kichu diYechena yA vizvabhuvane anya kAuke denani|
he AmAra sampradAYa! tomAdera janya ye pavitra bhUmi AllAha nirdiSTa karechena tAte praveza kara Ara pazcAte ghure dA~r3io nA, tA karale dhvaMse patita have|
tArA valala, he mUsA! okhAne atyanta zaktidhara eka sampradAYa Ache, tArA okhAna theke vera nA haoYA paryanta AmarA okhAne praveza karava nA, tArA yadi vera haYa tAhalei AmarA praveza karava|

yArA (AllAhake) bhaYa karachila tAdera madhye du’jana loka yAderake AllAha anugraha karechilena valala, tAdera darajAYa hAnA dAo, Dhukalei tomarA jaYI haYe yAve| tomarA mu’mina hale AllAhara upara bharasA kara|
tArA valala, he mUsA! tArA okhAne yaddina thAkave taddina AmarA okhAne kakSano praveza karava nA, kAjei tumi Ara tomAra pratipAlaka yAo Ara yuddha kara, AmarA ekhAnei vase railAma|
se valala, ‘‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra Ara AmAra bhAiYera upara chAr3A kAro upara AmAra kSamatA nei, kAjei ei vidrohI sampradAYa theke AmAderake pRthaka kare dina|
AllAha valalena, tave tA calliza vachara paryanta tAdera janya niSiddha hala, udabhrAntera mata tArA yamIne ghure ver3Ave, kAjei ei avAdhya sampradAYera janya hA-hutAza karo nA|

AdAmera du’putrera khavara tAderake saThikabhAve jAniYe dAo| ubhaYe yakhana ekaTi kare kuravAnI hAjira karechila takhana tAdera ekajanera nikaTa hate kavUla karA hala| anyajanera nikaTa hate kavUla karA hala nA| se valala, Ami tomAke avazya avazyai hatyA karava| anyajana valala, ‘AllAha kevala muttAkIdera kuravAnI kavUla karena,
AmAke hatyA karAra janya tumi AmAra dike hAta vAr3Aleo Ami tomAke hatyA karAra janya tomAra dike hAta vAr3Ava nA, Ami vizva jagatera pratipAlaka AllAhake bhaYa kari|
Ami cAi tumi AmAra o tomAra pApera vojhA vahana kara Ara agnivAsI haYe yAo, anyAYakArIdera eTAi pratidAna|’
ataHpara tAra AtmA tAke bhrAtRhatyAra kAje prarocita karala| phalataH se tAke hatyA karala evaM kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe gela|

tArapara AllAha ekaTi kAka pAThAlena, se mATi khanana karate lAgala, se tAra bhAiYera lAza kIbhAve gopana karave tA dekhAnora janya| se valala, dhika AmAke! Ami ei kAkaTira matao hate pAralAma nA yAte AmAra bhAiYera lAza gopana karate pAri? tAi se anutapta hala|

e kAraNei Ami vAnI isarAIlera janya vidhAna diYechilAma ye, ye vyakti mAnuSa hatyA kiMvA yamIne santrAsa sRSTira kAraNa vyatIta kAuke hatyA karave se yena tAmAma mAnuSakei hatyA karala| Ara ye mAnuSera prANa vA~cAlo, se yena tAmAma mAnuSake vA~cAlo| tAdera kAche AmAra rasUlagaNa suspaSTa pramANa niYe esechila, eraparao tAdera adhikAMzai pRthivIte vAr3AvAr3ii karechila|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera viruddhe yuddha kare Ara yamIne vizRGkhalA char3iYe ver3AYa tAdera zAsti hala ei ye, tAderake hatyA karA have athavA kruzaviddha karA have athavA tAdera hAta pA viparIta dika theke keTe phelA have, athavA tAderake deza theke nirvAsita karA have| e hala tAdera janya duniYAte lAJchanA, Ara tAdera janya AkherAte raYeche mahAzAsti|
(tave e zAsti) tAdera janya naYa yArA tomAdera AYatve AsAra pUrve tAovA karave| jene rekha, AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he ImAnadAragaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara, tA~ra naikaTya anusandhAna kara evaM tA~ra pathe jihAda kara yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

yArA kupharI kareche duniYAYa yA kichu Ache sava yadi tAdera haYa evaM Aro samaparimANao haYa kviYAmAta divasera zAsti theke paritrANera muktipaNa hiseve, tavuo tA tAdera theke grahaNa karA have nA; tAdera janya Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tArA Aguna theke veriYe Asate cAive, kintu tArA tAttheke vera hate pArave nA, tAdera janya Ache sthAYI zAsti|
Ara cora o coranI tAdera hAta keTe dAo, tAdera kRtakarmera phala svarUpa, AllAhara pakSa theke dRSTAntamUlaka zAsti| AllAha halena mahAparAkrAnta, mahAvijJAnI|
kintu anyAYa karAra para keu tAovA karale evaM (nijeke) saMzodhana karale, AllAha tAra prati kSamAdRSTi karena, AllAha halena var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tumi ki jAna nA AllAha, AkAzasamUha o yamInera sArvabhaumatva tA~rai, yAke icche tini zAsti dena, yAke icche kSamA karena, AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

he rasUla! kupharIra vyApAre tAdera pratiyogitA yena tomAke duHkha nA deYa, yArA mukhe vale ImAna enechi kintu tAdera antara ImAna Aneni| Ara yArA iYAhUdI, tArA mithyA kathA zunate vizeSa pAradarzI, tArA tomAra kathAgulo anya sampradAYera svArthe kAna pete zone yArA tomAra nikaTa (kakhano) Aseni, erA AllAhara kitAvera zavdaguloke prakRta artha hate vikRta kare| tArA vale, tomarA e rakama nirdezaprApta hale mAnave, Ara tA nA hale varjana karave| vastuta AllAhai yAke phitanAYa phelate cAna, tAra janya AllAhara kAche tomAra kichui karAra nei| orA hala sei loka, yAdera antarAtmAke AllAha pavitra karate cAna nA| tAdera janya duniYAte Ache lAJchanA, Ara tAdera janya AkherAte Ache mahA zAsti|

tArA vezivezi mithye zunate AgrahI, hArAma bhakSaNakArI, tArA yadi tomAra kAche Ase tAhale (icche hale) tAdera vivAda nispatti kara natuvA asvIkAra kara| asvIkAra karale tArA tomAra konai kSati karate pArave nA| yadi vicAra phAYasAlA kara tAhale inasAphera sAthe tAdera vicAra phAYasAlA kara, AllAh nyAYaparAYaNaderake bhAlavAsena|
erA tomAke kIbhAve vicAraka mAnate pAre yakhana tAdera mAjhei tAorAta vidyamAna Ache, tAra bhitara AllAhara vidhAna Ache, era pareo tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, vastuta tArA mu’minai naYa|

Ami tAorAta avatIrNa karechilAma, tAte chila saThika pathera dizA o Alo| anugata nAvIgaNa era dvArA iYAhUdIderake phAYasAlA dita| daraveza o AlimarAo (tAi karata) kAraNa tAderake AllAhara kitAvera rakSaka karA haYechila Ara tArA chila era sAkSI| kAjei mAnuSake bhaYa karo nA, AmAkei bhaYa kara, Ara AmAra AYAtake nagaNya mUlye vikraYa karo nA| AllAha yA nAyila karechena, se anuyAYI yArA vicAra phAYasAlA kare nA tArAi kAphira|

Ami tAdera janya tAte vidhAna diYechilAma ye, jAnera vadale jAna, cokhera vadale cokha, nAkera vadale nAka, kAnera vadale kAna, Ara dA~tera vadale dA~ta| Ara jakhamera vadale anurUpa jakhama| keu kSamA kare dile tAte tArai pApa mocana have| AllAha yA nAyila karechena se anuyAYI yArA vicAra phAYasAlA kare nA tArAi yAlima|

tAdera pazcAte mAraiYAma putra ‘IsAke pAThiYechilAma tAdera sAmane tAorAta kitAvera yA kichu chila tAra satyatA pratipAdanakArI hiseve| tAke iJjila diYechilAma, yAte chila satya pathera dizA o Alo, evaM ihA pUrvavartI kitAva tAorAtake satyAYanakArI evaM muttAkIdera janya saThika pathera dizA o nAsIhAta|
iJjilera anusArIgaNa yena AllAha tAte ye vidhAna diYechena tadanuyAYI vicAra phaYasAlA kare| AllAha yA nAyila karechena tadanuyAYI yArA vicAra phAYasAlA kare nA tArAi phAsika|

Ara Ami satya vidhAnasaha tomAra prati kitAva nAyila karechi yA pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhera satyAYanakArI o saMrakSaka| kAjei mAnuSadera madhye vicAra phAYasAlA kara AllAha yA nAyila karechena tadanusAre, Ara tomAra kAche ye satyavidhAna eseche tA cher3e diYe tAdera kheYAla khuzira anusaraNa karo nA| Ami tomAdera pratyekera janya ekaTi zarIYAta o ekaTi karmapatha nirdhAraNa karechi| AllAha icche karale tomAderake eka ummAta karatena| kintu tini tomAderake yA diYechena sei vyApAre tini tomAdera parIkSA karate cAna| kAjei tomarA satkarme agragAmI hao, tomAdera sakalera pratyAvartana AllAhara dikei| ataHpara tomarA ye viSaYe matabheda karachile, se samvandhe tini tomAderake avahita karavena|

Ara tumi tAdera madhye vicAra phaYasAlA kara AllAha yA nAyila karechena tadanuyAYI, tAdera kheYAla khuzira anusaraNa karave nA| Ara tAdera theke satarka thAka tArA yena AllAha tomAra prati yA nAyila karechena tAra kona kichu theke tomAke phetanAYa nA phelate pAre| yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tave jene rekha, AllAha tAdera kona kona pApera kAraNe tAderake zAsti dite cAna, mAnuSadera adhikAMzai prakRtapakSe satya tyAgI|
tArA ki jAhilI yugera Aina vidhAna cAYa? dRr3ha vizvAsI sampradAYera janya Aina-vidhAna pradAne AllAha hate ke vezI zreSTha?

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA iYAhUda o nAsArAderake vandhu hiseve grahaNa karo nA, tArA eke aparera vandhu| tomAdera madhye keu tAderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karale se tAderai antarbhukta have| AllAha yAlimaderake satpathe paricAlita karena nA|

yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tumi tAderake dekhave tArA tAdera (arthAt iYAhUdI, nAsArA muzarikadera) daur3e giYe valave, AmAdera bhaYa haYa AmarA vipadera cakkare par3e nA yAi| haYato AllAha vijaYa dAna karavena kiMvA nijera pakSa hate emana kichu divena yAte tArA tAdera antare yA lukiYe rekhechila tAra kAraNe lajjita have|
mu’minagaNa valave, erA ki tArAi yArA AllAhara nAme zakta kasama kheYe valata ye, tArA avazyai tomAdera saGge Ache| tAdera kRtakarma nisphala haYe geche, yAra phale tArA kSatigrasta haYeche|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera madhya hate keu tAra dvIna hate phire gele satvara AllAha emana eka sampradAYake niYe Asavena yAderake tini bhAlavAsena Ara tArAo tA~ke bhAlavAsave, tArA mu’minadera prati komala Ara kAphiradera prati kaThora have, tArA AllAhara pathe yuddha karave, kona nindukera nindAke tArA bhaYa karave nA, eTA AllAhara anugraha- yAke icche tini dAna karena evaM AllAha prAcuryera adhikArI, sarvajJa|
tomAdera vandhu kevala AllAha, tA~ra rasUla o mu’minagaNa yArA nAmAya kAYima kare, yAkAta AdAYa kare evaM AllAhara kAche avanata haYa|
ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rasUla evaM ImAnadAragaNake vandhurUpe grahaNa karave (se dekhate pAve ye) AllAhara dalai vijaYI have|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deYA haYechila tAdera madhye yArA tomAdera dvInake hAsi-tAmAsA o khelAra vastu hiseve grahaNa kare tAderake evaM kAphiraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|
tomarA yakhana salAtera janya AhavAna jAnAo takhana tArA seTike tAmAzA o khelAra vastu hiseve grahaNa kare| eTA ejanya ye, tArA hala nirvodha sampradAYa|

vala, ‘ohe kitAvadhArI sampradAYa! tomarA e chAr3A anya kAraNe AmAdera prati rAgAnvita nao ye, AmarA AllAhara prati evaM AmAdera prati Ara AmAdera pUrve yA nAyila haYechila tAra prati ImAna enechi, tomAdera adhikAMzai to hacche phAsika|’

vala, Ami tomAderake ki era ceYe khArApa kichura saMvAda deva yA AllAhara nikaTa pratidAna hiseve Ache? (Ara tA hala) yAke AllAha lA‘nAta karechena, yAra upara tini krodhAnvita haYechena, yAdera katakake tini vAnara o zukare pariNata karechena Ara yArA tAgutera ‘ivAdAta kareche tArAi savaceYe nikRSTa mAnera loka evaM sarala satya patha hate savaceYe vicyuta|
yakhana tArA tomAdera kAche Ase takhana vale ‘‘AmarA ImAna enechi’’| vAstave tArA kupharI niYei praveza kare, kupharI niYei veriYe yAYa, tArA yA lukiYe rAkhe AllAha se samparke pUrNarUpe avagata|
tAdera anekakei tumi pApa, zatrutA Ara hArAma bhakSaNera pratiyogitAYa vyasta dekhate pAve| tArA yA kare tA katai nA nikRSTa!
daraveza o purohitagaNa tAderake pApera kathA valA hate evaM hArAma bhakSaNa theke niSedha kare nA kena? tArA yA kare tA katai nA nikRSTa!

iYAhUdIrA vale, AllAhara hAta Avaddha, tAdera hAtai Avaddha, tAdera (pralApa) uktira kAraNe tArA haYeche abhizapta, varaM AllAhara ubhaYa hAta prasArita, yebhAve icche karena dAna karena, tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAra nikaTa yA avatIrNa haYeche tA tAdera anekera sImAlaGghana o kupharI avazya avazyai vAr3iYe dive, Ara kviYAmAta avadhi Ami tAdera parasparera madhye zatrutA o vidveSa sRSTi kare diYechi| yakhanai tArA yuddhera Aguna prajjvalita kare, AllAha tA nibhiYe dena, Ara tArA duniYAYa phAsAda char3iYe ver3AYa, AllAha phAsAda sRSTikArIdera pachanda karena nA|
granthadhArIrA yadi ImAna Anato Ara tAkaoYA avalamvana karata tAhale Ami tAdera pApa avazyai mocana kare ditAma Ara tAderake niAmate bharA jAnnAte avazyai dAkhila karatAma|

tArA yadi tAorAta iJjila Ara tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa theke yA tAdera prati avatIrNa haYeche tAra niYama-vidhAna pratiSThita karata, tAhale tAdera upara theke Ara tAdera pAYera nIca theke AhArya peta| tAdera madhye ekaTi satyapanthI dala Ache, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai yA kare tA khArApa|

he rasUla! tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa theke yA tomAra prati avatIrNa haYeche tA pracAra kara, yadi nA kara tAhale tumi tA~ra vArtA pau~chAnora dAYitva pAlana karale nA| mAnuSera aniSTa hate AllAhi tomAke rakSA karavena, AllAha kAphira sampradAYake kakSano satpatha pradarzana karavena nA|

vala, he granthadhArIgaNa! tomarA tAorAta, iJjila Ara tomAdera ravera nikaTa hate yA tomAdera prati nAyila haYeche tAra vidhi-vidhAna pratiSThita nA karA paryanta tomarA kona bhittira uparai danDAYamAna nao| tomAra ravera nikaTa hate yA tomAra prati avatIrNa haYeche tA tAdera anekera sImAlaGghana Ara kupharI avazya avazyai vRddhi karave| kAjei kAphira sampradAYera janya tumi Aphasosa karo nA|
yArA ImAna eneche Ara yArA iYAhUdI haYeche Ara sAviYI sampradAYa Ara nAsArA, ye keu AllAha Ara AkhirAta divasera prati ImAna Anave Ara satkAja karave, tAdera janya kona bhaYa nei, cintA-bhAvanA nei|

Ami vAnI isarAIlera nikaTa hate aGgIkAra niYechilAma Ara tAdera kAche rasUlagaNake pAThiYechilAma| yakhanai kona rasUla tAdera kAche emana kichu niYe eseche yA tAdera manaHputa naYa, takhana katakake tArA amAnya kareche Ara katakake hatyA kareche|

tArA bhevechila tAdera kona viparyaYa have nA ejanya tArA andha o vadhira haYe giYechila| ataHpara AllAha tAdera prati kSamA dRSTi karalena| tArapara tAdera anekei punarAYa andha o vadhira haYe gela| tArA yA kare AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|

tArA avazyai kupharI kareche yArA vale, mAraiYAma putra mAsIhai hacchena AllAha| mAsIha to valechila, he vAnI isarAIla! tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara yini AmAra pratipAlaka evaM tomAderao pratipAlaka| ye vyakti AllAhara saGge aMzIsthApana kare tAra janya AllAha avazyai jAnnAta hArAma kare diYechena Ara tAra AvAsa hala jAhAnnAma| yAlimadera janya kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

tArA avazyai kupharI kareche yArA vale AllAha tina janera madhye ekajana, kAraNa eka ilAha chAr3A Ara kona satyikAra ilAha nei| tArA yA valache tA theke tArA yadi nivRtta nA haYa, tAhale tAdera madhye yArA kupharI kareche tAderake yantraNAdAYaka AyAva grAsa karavei|
tArA ki AllAhara nikaTa tAovA karave nA, tA~ra kAche kSamA cAive nA, AllAha to halena var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

mAraiYAma putra ‘IsA rasUla chAr3A kichui chila nA| tAra pUrve Aro rasUla atIta haYe geche, tAra mA chila satyapanthI mahilA, tArA ubhaYei khAvAra kheta; lakSya kara tAdera kAche (satyera) nidarzanasamUha kemana suspaSTabhAve tule dharachi Ara eTAo lakSya kara ye, kIbhAve tArA (satya hate) viparIta dike cale yAcche|
vala, tomarA AllAhake vAda diYe ki emana kichura ‘ivAdAta karacha yAdera nA Ache kona kSati karAra kSamatA, Ara nA Ache upakAra karAra| Ara AllAha tini halena sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

vala, he kitAvadhArIgaNa! tomarA tomAdera dvIna samvandhe anyAYabhAve vAr3AvAr3i karo nA, Ara sei sampradAYera kheYAla khuzira anusaraNa karo nA yArA itopUrve pathabhraSTa haYe geche, anekake pathabhraSTa kareche Ara sojA patha theke vicyuta haYe geche|

vAnI isarAIlera madhye yArA kupharI karechila tAderake dAUda o mAraiYAma putra IsAra mukhe (uccArita kathAra dvArA) abhizApa deYA haYeche| eTA ei kAraNe ye tArA amAnya karechila Ara tArA chila sImAlaGghanakArI|
tArA ye sava asatkarma karata tAttheke eke anyake niSedha karata nA| tArA yA karata tA katai nA nikRSTa!

tAdera anekake tumi emana lokedera saGge vandhutva karate dekhave yArA kupharI kare| tAdera AtmA tAdera janya Age yA pAThiYeche tA katai nA nikRSTa yAra janya AllAhara gosvA tAdera upara patita haYeche Ara tArA cirasthAYI ‘AyAve nimajjita have|
tArA yadi AllAhara, nAvIra o tAra prati yA nAyila haYeche tAra upara ImAna Anato tave tAderake (arthAt kAphiraderake) vandhurUpe grahaNa karata nA, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai phAsika|

yArA ImAna eneche tAdera prati mAnuSera madhye iYAhUda o muzarikaderake tumi avazyai savaceYe vezi zatrutAparAYaNa dekhate pAve, Ara yArA vale ‘‘AmarA nAsArA’’ tAderake tumi yArA ImAna eneche tAdera janya vandhutve nikaTatara dekhate pAve, kenanA tAdera madhye ‘ivAdAtakArI ‘Alima o saMsAra virAgI Ache Ara tArA ahaMkArao kare nA|

rasUlera prati yA avatIrNa haYa tArA yakhana tA zune, tumi dekhave, satyake cinate pArAra kAraNe takhana tAdera cakSu azrusikta haYe uThe| tArA vale, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ImAna enechi, kAjei tumi AmAderake sAkSIdAtAdera tAlikAbhUkta kara|
AmAdera kI haYeche ye, AmarA AllAhte evaM ye satyavidhAna AmAdera nikaTa eseche tAte ImAna Anava nA, Ara AmarA pratyAzA kari ye, AmAdera pratipAlaka AmAderake satkarmazIladera antarbhukta karavena|
tAdera e kathAra kAraNe AllAha tAderake jAnnAta dAna karavena, yAra taladeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita, tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave, Ara eTAi hala satkarmazIladera puraskAra|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtaguloke pratyAkhyAna karave o mithyA jAnave, tArA have jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|
ohe ImAnadAragaNa! pavitra vasturAji yA AllAha tomAdera janya hAlAla kare diYechena seguloke hArAma kare nio nA Ara sImAlaGghana karo nA, avazyai AllAha sImAlaGghanakArIdera bhAlavAsena nA|
ye samasta hAlAla o pavitra jIvikA AllAha tomAderake diYechena segulo bhakSaNa kara, ye AllAhara prati tomarA ImAna enecha tA~ke bhaYa kara|

tomAdera arthahIna zapathera janya AllAha tomAderake pAkar3Ao karavena nA, kintu vujhe sujhe ye sava zapatha tomarA kara tAra janya tomAderake pAkar3Ao karavena| (e pAkar3Ao theke avyAhatira) kAphaphArA hala daza jana misakinake madhyama mAnera khAdyadAna yA tomarA tomAdera strI parivArake khAiYe thAka, athavA tAderake vastradAna athavA ekajana krItadAsa muktakaraNa| Ara egulo karAra yAra sAmarthya nei tAra janya tina dina royA pAlana| egulo hala tomAdera zapathera kAphaphArA yakhana tomarA zapatha kara| tomarA tomAdera zapatha rakSA karave| AllAha tA~ra AYAtasamUha tomAdera janya viSadabhAve varNanA karena yAte tomarA zokara AdAYa kara|
he vizvAsIgaNa! mada, juYA Ara mUrtI o bhAgya nirdhAraka tIra ghRNita zaYatAnI kAja, tomarA tA varjana kara, yAte tomarA sAphalyamanDita hate pAra|
mada Ara juYAra mAdhyame zaYatAna to cAYa tomAdera mAjhe zatrutA Ara vidveSa sRSTi karate, AllAhara smaraNa Ara nAmAya theke tomAderake vAdhA dite| kAjei tomarA ki esava theke virata thAkave?

tomarA AllAhake mene cala Ara tA~ra rasUlake mene cala Ara (manda theke) satarka thAka Ara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo, tAhale jene rekha AmAra rasUlera dAYitva hala suspaSTabhAve (AmAra vANI) pau~che deYA|

yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkarma kare tArA pUrve yA kheYeche tAra janya tAdera upara kona pApa nei yadi tArA (hArAma theke) virata thAke, Ara ImAna Ane o satkAja kare, ataHpara sAvadhAnatA avalamvana kare Ara ImAnera upara thAke, ataHpara AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM satkAja kare| AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|

ohe ImAnadAragaNa! AllAha tomAderake kaThina parIkSAra sammukhIna karavena (muharima avasthAYa) zikArera vyApAre yA tomAdera hAta Ara varzAra nAgAlera bhitara ese yAYa, eTA jene neYAra janya ye adRzye thekeo ke AllAhake bhaYa kare| (suspaSTabhAve jAnAno haYeche) eraparao yArA sImAlaGghana kare tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

ohe vizvAsIgaNa! iharAma avasthAYa tomarA zikAra hatyA karo nA| jene vujhe tomAdera keu tA hatyA karale tAra vinimaYa hacche anurUpa gRhapAlita jantu| ye vyApAre tomAdera madhyera nyAYaparAYaNa du’jana loka phAYasAlA kare deve, tA kA‘vAte kuravAnIra janya pAThAte have| kiMvA tAra kAphaphArA hala kaYekajana misakinake khAdya dAna athavA tadanurUpa royA pAlana, yena se svIYa kRtakarmera phala bhoga kare, pUrve yA haYe geche AllAha tA kSamA karechena; keu (pApakAja) punarAYa karale AllAha tAra nikaTa hate pratizodha grahaNa karavena| AllAha mahA parAkramazAlI, pratizodha grahaNe pUrNa sakSama|

samudrera zikAra o tA bhakSaNa tomAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche, tomAdera Ara sapharakArIdera bhogera janya| iharAma avasthAYa thAkA paryanta sthalera zikAra tomAdera janya hArAma karA haYeche| AllAhake bhaYa kara yA~ra kAche tomAderake ekatrita karA have|

pavitra kvA‘vAgRhake AllAha tomAdera janya (jIvane) pratiSThAra upakaraNa kare diYechena, Ara hArAma mAsa, kuravAnIra uddeze kvA‘vAYa prerita pazu evaM tAke cihnita karAra galAra mAlAkeo| eTA ejanya yAte tomarA jAnate pAra ye, yA kichu AsamAnasamUhe Ache Ara yA kichu yamIne Ache, AllAha tA jAnena, Ara AllAha sakala viSaYe savaceYe vezi avahita|
jene rekha ye, zAsti dAne AllAha atyanta kaThora Ara AllAha halena var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
(AllAhara vANI) pau~che deYA chAr3A rasUlera upara dAYitva nei| tomarA yA prakAza kara Ara gopana kara, AllAha tA jAnena|
vala, apavitra Ara pavitra samAna naYa, yadio apavitra vastura prAcurya tomAke AkRSTa kare| kAjei he jJAnI sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA emana viSaYe prazna karo nA, yA tomAdera kAche prakAza karA hale tA tomAderake kaSTa dive| ye kAle kuraAna nAyila hacche se samaYa yadi osava viSaYe prazna kara tave tA tomAdera janya prakAza kare deYA have| (e paryanta yA karecha) AllAha tA kSamA karechena, Ara AllAha halena var3ai kSamAzIla, parama sahiSNu|
tomAdera pUrve eka sampradAYa (arthAt iYAhUdIrA) tA jijJesa karechila ata:para (tA amAnya kare) tArA kAphire pariNata haYechila|
AllAha nA nirdiSTa karechena vAhIrAh, nA sAivAh, nA oYAsIlAh, nA hAma varaM yArA kupharI kareche tArAi AllAhara nAme mithyA Aropa kare, tA~dera adhikAMzai nirvodha|

tAderake yakhana valA haYa AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tAra dike o rasUlera dike eso (takhana) tArA vale, AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSake yA karate dekhechi (ye patha o panthA avalamvana karate dekhechi) AmAdera janya tAi yatheSTa| yadio tAdera pitRpuruSarA kichui jAnata nA evaM saThika pathaprApta chila nA (tavuo ki tArA tAdera pathei calave)?

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera dAYitva tomAdera upara| yakhana tomarA satyapatha prApta haYecha takhana yArA pathabhraSTa haYe geche tArA tomAdera kona kSati karate pArave nA| tomAdera sakalera pratyAvartana AllAhara dike, ataHpara tomarA yA karachile se samparke tomAderake jAniYe deYA have|

he vizvAsIgaNa! tomAdera kAro mRtyu upasthita hale yakhana osiYAta karave takhana tomAdera madhya hate du’jana nyAYaparAYaNa lokake sAkSI karave, Ara saphararata avasthAYa mRtyura musivata upasthita hale tomAdera chAr3A anyadera theke du’jana sAkSI rAkhave| (sAkSIdera satyatA samparke) tomAdera sandeha hale salAtera para tAderake rekhe deve Ara tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha karave ye, AmarA kona kichura vinimaYe sAkSya vikraYa karava nA, yadio se AmAdera AtmIYa haYa, Ara AllAhara oYAste kRta sAkSya gopana karava nA, karale pApIdera madhye gaNya haYe yAva|

yadi jAnA yAYa ye, tArA pApe jar3iYe par3eche, tave tAdera sthale anya du’jana sei lokedera madhya hate dA~r3Ave, yAdera svatva pUrvera du’jana sAkSI naSTa karate ceYechila| tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valave ye, AmAdera sAkSya avazyai tAdera sAkSya apekSA adhika satya (Ara AmarA AmAdera sAkSyadAnera vyApAre) sImAlaGghana karini, karale AmarA avazya yAlimadera madhye gaNya haYe yAva|

e panthAYa vezi sambhAvanA Ache ye, loke ThikabhAve sAkSyadAna karave, kiMvA antataHpakSe tArA e bhaYa avazyai karave ye, tAdera kasama karAra para apara kona kasama dvArA tAdera prativAda karA nA haYa| AllAhake bhaYa kara Ara zona; AllAha satya parityAgakArI sampradAYake saThika pathe paricAlita karena nA|
AllAha ye dina rasUlagaNake ekatrita karavena; ataHpara valavena, tomAderake kI javAva deYA haYechila| tArA valave, AmarA kichui jAni nA, tumii sakala gopana tattva jAna|

yakhana AllAha valena, ‘‘he ‘IsA vina mAraiYAma! tumi tomAra prati Ara tomAra mAYera prati AmAra ni‘mAtera kathA smaraNa kara| Ami tomAke rUhula kuddusa (jivarAIla) diYe zaktizAlI karechi, tumi dolanAYa thAkA avasthAYa Ara pUrNa vaYaseo mAnuSera sAthe kathA valecha| smaraNa kara Ami tomAke kitAva, hikamAta, tAorAta o iJjila zikSA diYechilAma| tumi AmAra anumatikrame mATi dvArA pAkhIra mata AkRti gaThana karate Ara tAte phu~ka dite takhana tA AmAra hukume pAkhI haYe yeta, janmAndha Ara kuSTha vyAdhigrasta vyaktike tumi AmAra hukume Arogya karate, smaraNa kara AmAra hukume tumi mRtake jIvita karate, smaraNa kara yakhana Ami tomAra theke vAnI isarAIlake nivRtta rekhechilAma yakhana tumi tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzanAdi niYe Asale, takhana tAdera madhye yArA kupharI karechila tArA valala- "eTA to spaSTa yAdu chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|"
smaraNa kara yakhana Ami hAoYArIderake hukuma karechilAma ye, AmAra prati Ara AmAra rasUlera prati ImAna Ana; tArA valechila, AmarA ImAna AnalAma Ara tumi sAkSI theka ye, AmarA musalima|

(smaraNa kara) yakhana hAoYArIrA valechila, he ‘IsA ivanu mAraiYAma! ApanAra pratipAlaka ki AmAdera nikaTa AsamAna theke khAJcA bharti khAdya pAThAte pAravena? se valechila, tomarA yadi mu’mina haYe thAka tAhale AllAhake bhaYa kara|

tArA valechila, AmarA cAi ye AmarA tAttheke kichu khAva, tAte AmAdera antara paritRpti lAbha karave, Ara AmarA jAnate pArava ye, Apani AmAderake satya valechena, Ara se vyApAre AmarA sAkSI haYe thAkava|

‘IsA ivanu mAraiYAma valechila, he AllAha! AmAdera pratipAlaka AmAdera nikaTa AsamAna theke khAdya bharti khAJcA preraNa kara yA AmAdera prathama theke zeSa sakala vyaktira janya Anandera vyApAra have Ara have tomAra theke ekaTA nidarzana| Ara AmAderake jIvikA dAna kara; tumii sarvottama riyakadAtA|
AllAha valalena, Ami tomAdera kAche tA nAyila karava, ataHpara tomAdera keu kupharI karale Ami tAke emanabhAve zAsti pradAna karava, ye zAsti Ami vizvajagatera kAuke deini|

smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha IsA ivanu mAraiYAmake valalena, tumi ki lokederake valechile, AllAhake cher3e AmAke Ara AmAra mAtAke ilAha vAniYe nAo|’ (uttare) se valechila, ‘pavitra mahAna tumi, emana kathA valA AmAra zobhA pAYa nA ye kathA valAra kona adhikAra AmAra nei, Ami yadi tA valatAma, seTA to tumi jAnatei; AmAra antare kI Ache tA tumi jAna kintu tomAra antare kI Ache tA Ami jAni nA, tumi avazyai yAvatIYa gopanIYa tattva samparke pUrNarUpe oYAkephahAla|

tumi AmAke ye vyApAre nirdeza karecha tA chAr3A Ami tAderake anya kichui valini, (tA ei) ye, tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara yini AmAra o tomAdera pratipAlaka, Ara tAdera kAja karmera vyApAre sAkSI chilAma yaddina Ami tAdera mAjhe chilAma, ataHpara yakhana tumi AmAke uThiYe nile, takhana tumii chile tAdera kAryakalApera tattvAvadhAYaka, Ara tumi hale pratyeka vyApAre sAkSI|
tumi yadi tAderake zAsti dAo tave tArA to tomArai vAndAha Ara yadi tAderake kSamA kara tumi to mahAparAkrAnta mahAprajJAra adhikArI|’

AllAha valavena, Ajakera dine satyapanthIdera satyapanthA upakAra dive, tAdera janya raYeche jAnnAta yAra taladeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita, tAte tArA sthAYI haYe cirakAla thAkave, AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa haYechena Ara tArAo tA~ra prati santuSTa| eTAi hala mahA sAphalya|
AsamAnasamUhera Ara yamInera Ara edera mAjhe yA kichu Ache tAra sArvabhaumatva AllAharai, Ara tini sakala viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

samasta prazaMsA AllAhara janya yini AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena Ara sRSTi karechena andhakAra o Alo, etadasattveo yArA kupharI kareche tArA (anyake) tAdera pratipAlakera samakakSa dA~r3a kariYeche|

yini mATi theke tomAderake sRSTi karechena ataHpara (tomAdera jIvanera janya) ekaTi nirdiSTa meYAda nirdhArita karechena, echAr3A ArekaTi nirdhArita meYAda Ache (ye samparkita jJAna Ache) tA~ra kAche, kintu tomarA sandehai kare calecha|
AsamAnasamUha Ara yamIne tinii AllAha, tomAdera gopana viSaYAdi Ara tomAdera prakAzya viSaYAdi samparke tini jAnena, Ara tini jAnena yA tomarA upArjana kara|
tAdera ravvera nidarzanAvalI hate emana kona nidarzana tAdera kAche Ase nA yA theke tArA mukha phiriYe neYa nA|
(ekhana) ye satya tAdera kAche eseche tArA tA asvIkAra kareche| zIghrai tAdera kAche se khavara Asave ye samparke tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa karata|

tArA ki lakSya kare nA tAdera pUrve Ami kata janagoSThIke dhvaMsa kare diYechi, tAderake duniYAYa (emanabhAve) pratiSThita karechilAma ye zakti-pratiSThA tomAderake deYA haYani, tAdera janya pracura vRSTipAta ghaTiYechilAma, tairi karechilAma nadI yA tAdera nimnadeza diYe pravAhita hata, ataHpara tAdera pApera kAraNe tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechi Ara tAdera pare natuna janagoSThIra utthAna ghaTAlAma|
Ami yadi tomAra upara kAgaje lekhA kitAva nAyila karatAma Ara tA tArA tAdera hAte sparza karata, tAhale avizvAsIrA avazyai valata eTA spaSTa yAdu chAr3A Ara kichu nA|
Ara tArA vale, AmAdera kAche pherezatA pAThAno haYa nA kena? Ami yadi pherezatA pAThAtAma tAhale (yAvatIYa vyApAre) cUr3Anta phAYasAlAi to haYe yeta, ataHpara tAderake Ara avakAza deYA hata nA|
Ara Ami yadi tAke pherezatA karatAma tave tAke mAnuSera AkRti viziSTai karatAma, Ara tAderake avazyai golakadhA~dhAYa phele ditAma yemana dhA~dhA~Ya tArA ekhana par3eche|
tomAra pUrveo rasUladerake ThATTA-vidrUpa karA haYeche, ataHpara yA niYe tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa karata tAi tAderake pariveSTana kare phelala|
vala, duniYAYa paribhramaNa kara, ataHpara dekha satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera pariNAma kI dA~r3iYechila|

vala, AsamAne Ara yamIne yA Ache tA kAra? vala, AllAharai| daYA karA tini tA~ra janya kartavya sthira kare niYechena, tini kiYAmAta divase tomAdera savAike ekatrita karavena, ete kona sandeha nei| yArA nijerAi nijedera kSati kareche tArA ImAna Anave nA|
rAte (andhakAre) Ara dine (AloYa) yA vAsa kare tA tA~rai, tini halena sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

vala, Ami ki AsamAna yamInera sRSTikartA AllAhake vAda diYe anyake abhibhAvaka vAniYe neva, athaca tinii khAoYAna, tA~ke khAoYAno haYa nA, vala AmAke Adeza karA haYeche Ami yena AtmasamarpaNakArIdera prathama hai, Ara tumi kichutei muzarikadera madhye zAmila have nA|
vala, yadi Ami AmAra ravera avAdhya hai, tave Ami var3a (bhaYAvaha) dinera zAstira bhaYa kari|
se dina yAke (zAsti theke) rakSA karA have tAke to var3a anugraha karA have| Ara eTAi have suspaSTa sAphalya|
AllAha tomAra kona kSati karate cAile tini chAr3A keu tA sarAte pArave nA| Ara tini yadi tomAra kalyANa karate cAna, tave to sava kichui karAra tA~ra kSamatA raYeche|
tini tA~ra vAndAdera upara ekacchatra niYantraNakArI, tini halena prajJAmaYa, sarvaviSaYe oYAkiphahAla|

vala, sAkSye savaceYe var3a viSaYa konaTi? vala, AllAha AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI| Ara e kuraAna AmAra prati nAyila karA haYeche yAte Ami tAra sAhAyye tomAderake Ara yAdera kAche tA pau~chave tAderake satarka kari| tomarA ki emana sAkSya dite pAra ye, AllAhara saGge anya ilAhao Ache? vala, Ami emana sAkSya dei nA, vala tini to eka ilAha Ara tomarA ye tA~ra aMzIdAra sthApana kara, tA theke Ami sampUrNa mukta|
Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi tArA tAke (arthAt nAvIke) temani cine yemana cine tAdera nijedera santAnaderake, yArA nijedera AtmAra dhvaMsa sAdhana kareche, tArA ImAna Anate pArave nA|
tAra theke var3a yAlima Ara ke Ache ye AllAha samparke mithye racanA kare athavA tA~ra nidarzanasamUhake pratyAkhyAna kare? yAlimarA kakSano saphalakAma have nA|
smaraNa kare se dinake, ye dina Ami tAdera savAike ekatrita karava Ara yArA ziraka karechila tAderake valava- yAderake tomarA AmAra zarIka mane karate tArA kothAYa?
takhana tArA e kathA valA chAr3A Ara kona phitanA sRSTi karate pArave nA ye, AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAhara kasama! AmarA muzarika chilAma nA|
lakSya kara tArA nijedera samparke kemana mithye kathA valave, Ara tArA michemichi yA udbhAvana karechila tA nisphala haYe yAve|

tAdera madhye kataka loka Ache yArA tomAra dike kAna pAte| tAdera antarera upara Ami pardA Dhele diYechi yAte tArA upalavdhi karate nA pAre, tAdera kAne Ache vadhiratA, samasta nidarzana dekhaleo tArA tAte ImAna Anave nA, emanaki yakhana tArA tomAra kAche Ase tomAra sAthe vitarka kare| kAphiragaNa vale eTA to pUrvekAra lokedera galpa-kAhinI chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|
tArA tA (zonA) theke anyadera virata kare, Ara nijerAo tAttheke dUre sare thAke, tArA nijerAi nijedera dhvaMsa sAdhana kare kintu se vodha tAdera nei|

yadi tumi dekhate yakhana tAderake jAhAnnAmera kinArAYa dA~r3a karAno have takhana tArA valave hAYa! AmAderake yadi AvAra (pRthivIte) pAThAno hata, tAhale AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalIke mithye mane karatAma nA, Ara AmarA mu’minadera antarbhukta hatAma|

varaM(Asala vyApAra hala) Age (duniYAte) tArA (mithyera AvaraNe) yA gopana kare rAkhata ekhana tA tAdera kAche prakAza karA haYeche Ara tAderake (pRthivIte) phiriYe deYA hale tArA AvAra tA-i karave yA karate tAderake niSedha karA haYeche, nizcaYa tArA hala mithyuka|
tArA vale, AmAdera duniYAra jIvana chAr3A Ara kona jIvana nei, AmAderake AvAra (jIvita kare) uThAno have nA|

tumi yadi dekhate yakhana tAderake tAdera pratipAlakera sAmane dA~r3a karAno have, takhana tini valavena, (tomarA ekhana ye paristhitira sammukhIna haYecha) tA ki satya naYa? tArA valave, AmAdera ravera kasama tA satya| tini valavena, tomarA kupharI karechile tAra janya ekhana zAsti bhoga kara|

yArA AllAhara sAkSAtake mithye jenechila tArA kSatigrasta haYe geche| emanaki yakhana kiYAmAta haThAt tAdera kAche hAjira have takhana tArA valave, hAYa AkSepa! AmarA e vyApAre avahelA karechilAma| tArA tAdera piThe tAdera pApera vojhA vahana karave| dekha, tArA yA vahana karave tA katai nA nikRSTa!
duniYAra jIvana khela-tAmAzA chAr3A Ara kichui nA| yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare tAdera janya parakAlera jIvanai ati kalyANamaYa, tavuo ki tomAdera vodhadaYa have nA?
tArA yA vale tA tomAke kaSTa deYa eTA Ami avazyai bhAlabhAve avagata, kenanA tArA to tomAke mithye mane kare nA, prakRtapakSe yAlimarA AllAhara AYAtakei pratyAkhyAna kare|

tomAra pUrveo rasUlagaNake mithye mane karA haYeche kintu tAderake mithye mane karA evaM kaSTa deYA sattveo tArA dhairyadhAraNa kareche, yatakSaNa nA tAdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya eseche| AllAhara oYAdAra parivartana haYa nA, nAvIgaNera kichu saMvAda to tomAra nikaTa pau~chechei|

tAdera upekSA yadi tomAra kAche kaThina vale mane haYa tAhale pArale bhUgarbhe sur3aGgera kiMvA AkAze ArohaNera janya si~r3ira sandhAna kara ata:para tAdera kAche (natuna) nidarzana hAjira kara| AllAha icche karale tAdera sakalake satpathe ekatra karatena| kAjei tumi mUrkhadera mata haYo nA|
yArA zone zudhu tArAi DAke sAr3A deYa| Ara mRtake AllAha AvAra jIvita karavena; ataHpara tA~ra dikei tAderake phiriYe neYA have|
tArA vale, tAra kAche tAra ravera nikaTa hate kona nidarzana nAyila haYa nA kena? vala, avazyai AllAha nidarzana avatIrNa karate sakSama| kintu tAdera adhikAMza lokai avagata naYa|

bhUpRSTe vicaraNazIla emana kona jIva nei, Ara du’DAnA sahayoge uDDaYanazIla emana kona pAkhi nei yArA tomAdera mata ekaTi ummAta naYa| (lAohe mAhphuya athavA Ala-kuraAna) kitAve Ami kona kichui vAda deini| ataHpara tAdera pratipAlakera kAche tAderake ekatrita karA have|
yArA AmAra AYAtake mithye jAne tArA vadhira o muka| tArA Ache gabhIra andhakAre, AllAha yAke cAna pathabhraSTa kare dena, Ara yAke cAna saThika pathe sthApana karena|

vala, tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, tomAdera upara yadi AllAhara zAsti ese par3e kiMvA tomAdera upara kviYAmAta ese yAYa tAhale ki tomarA AllAha chAr3A anya kAuke DAkave? (vala nA) tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao|
varaM (emana avasthAYa) tomarA ekamAtra tA~kei Deke thAka, ataHpara icche karale tini tA dUra kare dena yAra janya tomarA tA~ke DAka Ara tomarA yAderake tA~ra aMzIdAra vAnAo tAdera kathA bhule yAo|
tomAra pUrve Ami aneka jAtira kAche rasUla pAThiYechi, kintu tAdera avAdhyatAra kAraNe) abhAva anaTana Ara duHkha-kleza diYe tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilAma yAte tArA vinIta haYa|

AmAra zAsti yakhana tAdera upara par3ala takhana tArA vinaYa namratA avalamvana karala nA kena? varaM tAdera antara Aro zakta haYe gela, Ara tArA yA karachila zaYatAna seguloke tAdera janya (khuva bhAla kAja hiseve) suzobhita kare diYechila|

tAderake ye nAsIhAta karA haYechila tArA yakhana tA bhule gela, takhana Ami tAdera janya yAvatIYa ni‘AmAtera darajA khule dilAma; parizeSe, tAderake yA deYA hala tAte tArA yakhana Anande mete uThala, haThAt kare tAderake dhare vasalAma| takhana (yAvatIYa kalyANa theke) tArA nirAza haYe gela|
ataHpara yArA yulama karechila tAdera zikar3a keTe deYA hala, Ara samasta prazaMsA vizvajagatera pratipAlakera janya|

(he rAsUla) vala, tomarA ki bheve dekhecha AllAha yadi tomAdera zravaNazakti Ara darzana zakti ker3e nena, Ara tomAdera antare mohara lAgiYe dena, tAhale AllAha chAr3A Ara ke ilAha Ache segulo tomAderake phiriYe deve? lakSya kara Ami AmAra (zakti-kSamatAra) nidarzanaguloke kemana vizadabhAve varNanA kari kintu tA sattveo tArA mukha phiriYe neYa|
vala, tomarA ki cintA kare dekhecha, yadi tomAdera kAche Akasmika vA prakAzye AllAhara zAsti neme Ase tAhale yAlima sampradAYa chAr3A Ara ke dhvaMsa have?
Ami to rasUladerake kevala susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI kare pAThiYechi, ataHpara (rasUlera Anugatya kare) yArA ImAna Ane o nijeke saMzodhana kare tAdera nei kona bhaYa, nei tAdera kona duHkha|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithye mane kare, zAsti tAderake sparza karave, kenanA tArA nApharamAnIte lipta chila|

vala, Ami tomAderake vali nA ye, AmAra kAche AllAhara dhana-bhAnDAra Ache, Ara Ami adRzyera khavarao jAni nA| Ara Ami tomAderake e kathAo vali nA ye, Ami pherezatA, AmAra prati yA avatIrNa karA haYa tAchAr3A (anya kichura) Ami anusaraNa kari nA| vala, andha Ara cokhaoYAlA ki samAna, tomarA ki cintA kare dekha nA?

tumi tA diYe (arthAt kuraAna diYe) tAderake satarka kara yArA bhaYa kare ye, tAderake tAdera pratipAlakera dike ekatrita karA have, yini chAr3A tAdera janya kona abhibhAvaka nei evaM supArizakArI nei- yAte tArA saMyata haYe cale|

yArA tAdera pratipAlakera santuSTi lAbhera uddezye sakAla-sandhyAYa tA~ke DAke tAderake (arthAt tomAra nikaTa samAgata garIva mu’minaderake) tumi dUre sariYe dio nA| tAdera kona ‘AmAlera janya tomAke kona javAvadihi karate have nA, Ara tomAra kona ‘AmAlera janyao tAderake kona javAvadihi karate have nA, kAjei tumi yadi tAderake arthAt (garIva mu’minaderake) dUre sariYe dAo tave tumi yAlimadera madhye gaNya have|

Ara ebhAvei Ami tAdera ekadalake anyadalera mAdhyame parIkSA karechi yAte tArA vale, erA ki sei loka AmAdera madhye yAderake AllAha anugraha karechena, AllAha ki tA~ra kRtajJa vAndAhadera samparke adhika avagata nana?

AmAra AYAte vizvAsI lokerA yakhana tomAra kAche Ase takhana tAderake vala, ‘‘tomAdera prati sAlAma’’| tomAdera pratipAlaka daYA-rahamAtera nIti nijera prati avadhArita kare niYechena Ara tA hacche yadi tomAdera kona vyakti nA jene anyAYa pApa kare, ataHpara tAovAha kare o nijeke saMzodhana kare, tAhale AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|
ebhAvei Ami AmAra AYAtaguloke suspaSTabhAve varNanA kari yAte aparAdhIdera patha pariSkArarUpe prakAza peYe yAYa|

vala, tomarA AllAhake vAda diYe yAderake DAko, tAdera ivAdata karate AmAke niSedha karA haYeche| vala, Ami tomAdera khoza-kheYAlera anusaraNa kari nA, tA karale Ami pathabhraSTa haYe yAva, se avasthAYa Ami Ara hidAYAtaprAptadera antarbhukta thAkate pArava nA|

vala, Ami AmAra pratipAlakera nikaTa theke pAoYA eka ujjvala pramANera upara pratiSThita; athaca tomarA tA mithye mane karecha| yA tomarA khuva tAr3AtAr3i pete cAo (arthAt AllAhara AyAva) tA AmAra AYatte nei| hukuma vA kartRtvera mAlikAnA AllAha chAr3A kAro kAche nei| tinii satyakathA varNanA karena, Ara tinii sarvottama phAYasAlAkArI|
vala, tomarA yA tAr3AtAr3i cAccha tA yadi AmAra kAche thAkata tAhale AmAra Ara tomAdera madhye ye vyApAra tAra phAYasAlA haYe yeta, anyAYakArIdera samparke AllAha khuvabhAvei avahita|

samasta gAYavera cAvikAThi tA~ra kAche, tini chAr3A Ara keu tA jAne nA, jale-sthale yA Ache tA tini jAnena, emana ekaTA pAtAo par3e nA yA tini jAnena nA| yamInera gahIna andhakAre kona zasya dAnA nei, nei kona bhejA o zukano jinisa yA suspaSTa kitAve (likhita) nei|

tinii rAtrikAle tomAdera AtmAke niYe nena, Ara dinera velA yA tomarA kara tA tini jAnena| ataHpara dinera velA tini tomAdera jAgiYe dena, yAte jIvanera nirdiSTakAla pUrNa haYa| ataHpara tA~ra pAnei tomAdera pratyAvartana, ataHpara tini tomAdera nikaTa varNanA kare devena yA tomarA karachile|

tini tA~ra vAndAhadera upara pUrNa kartRtvazIla, Ara tini tomAdera upara rakSaka niyukta karena| ataHpara tomAdera kAro mRtyura samaYa upasthita hale AmAra preritagaNa (pherezatArA) tAra mRtyu ghaTAYa| nijedera kartavya pAlane tArA vindumAtra truTi kare nA|
ataHpara tAderake tAdera prakRta pratipAlakera nikaTa phiriYe neYA have| sAvadhAna! kartRtva tA~rai, Ara tini hisAva grahaNe sarvApekSA tvaritagati|

vala, vinItabhAve Ara saMgopane yakhana tA~ke DAka takhana jala-sthalera andhakAra hate ke tomAderake rakSA kare| (vipade par3ale valate thAka) ettheke tumi yadi AmAderake rakSA kara tAhale AmarA avazyai kRtajJadera antarbhukta hava|
vala, AllAhai tomAderake etheke Ara samasta vipada theke rakSA karena, ataHpara tomarA tA~ra aMzI sthira kara|

vala, tini tomAdera upara theke athavA padatala theke ‘AyAva pAThAte (sakSama) athavA tomAderake dale dale vibhakta karAra mAdhyame ekadalake anyadalera saMghAta saMgharSa o hiMsA hAnAhAnira AsvAda grahaNa karAte sakSama| lakSya kara, Ami nidarzanAvalI kemana vistArita varNanA karachi yAte tArA upalavdhi karate pAre|
tomAra kaoma tA (arthAt ‘AyAvake) mithye mane karache kintu tA prakRta satya| vala, Ami tomAdera karmavidhAYaka nai|
pratyeka (bhaviSyat) vANIra (satyarUpe prakAzita haoYAra) janya ekaTA samaYa nirdhArita karA Ache Ara tA tomarA zIghrai jAnate pArave|

yakhana tumi dekha AmAra AYAta niYe tArA upahAsapUrNa AlocanA karache takhana tAdera theke sare par3a ye paryanta tArA anya viSaYera AlocanAYa pravRtta nA haYa| Ara yakhana zaYatvAna tomAke (AllAhara ei nAsIhAta) bhuliYe deYa takhana smaraNa haYe gelei yAlima sampradAYera saGge Ara vasave nA|
tAdera kona kAjera hiseva deYAra dAYa-dAYitva muttAkIdera upara nei| kintu upadeza deYA kartavya yAte orAo tAkaoYA avalamvana kare|

yArA tAdera dvInake khelA tAmAzA vAniYe niYeche Ara pArthiva jIvana yAderake pratArita kareche tumi tAderake varjana kara| Ara tA (arthAt kuraAna) diYe tAderake upadeza dAo yAte keu svIYa kRtakarmera kAraNe dhvaMsa nA haYa, AllAha chAr3A tAra kona abhibhAvaka nei evaM kona supArizakArI nei, (muktira) vinimaYe sava kichu dite cAileo tA tAra theke grahaNa karA have nA, orAi tArA yArA tAdera kRtakarmera janya dhvaMsa have, tAdera janya Ache phuTanta garama pAnIYa Ara mahA zAsti, yehetu tArA kupharIte lipta chila|

vala, AllAhake vAda diYe AmarA ki emana kichuke DAkava yA AmAdera upakArao kare nA, apakArao kare nA? AllAha AmAderake hidAYAta dAnera para AmarA ki pichane phire yAva tAra mata zaYatvAna yAke vibhrAnta kare diYeche Ara duniYAYa se ghure marache| athaca tAra saGgI sAthIrA tAke saThika pathera dike DAka diYe valache, edike eso| vala, AllAhara hidAYAtai hacche satyikArera hidAYAta, vizvajagatera pratipAlakera kAche AtmasamarpaNa karAra janyai AmAderake Adeza deYA haYeche|
Arao (AdiSTa haYechi) nAmAya kAYima karate Ara tA~ke bhaYa karate Ara tini halena (sei sattvA) yA~ra kAche tomAderake samaveta karA have|

tini AsamAna Ara yamInake satyikArabhAve sRSTi karechena (khelA-tAmAzAra janya naYa)| Ara yakhanai tini valavena, (kiYAmAta) ‘hao’, takhanai tA haYe yAve, tA~ra kathAi prakRta satya| yedina siGgAYa phutkAra deYA have sedina kartRtva thAkave tA~rai hAte| adRzya o dRzya samvandhe oYAkephahAla, tini hikamAtaoYAlA, savakichura vyApAre tini savizeSa jJAta|

Ara (smaraNa kara) yakhana ivarAhIma tAra pitA Ajarake valechila, Apani ki mUrtiguloke ‘ilAha’rUpe grahaNa karechena, Ami to ApanAke Ara ApanAra jAtike spaSTabhAve pathabhraSTatAYa nimajjita dekhachi|
ebhAve Ami ivarAhImake AkAza o pRthivI rAjyera vyavasthApanA dekhiYechi yAte se nizcita vizvAsIdera antarbhukta hate pAre|

rAtera A~dhAra yakhana tAke Acchanna karala takhana se nakSatra dekhate pela, (takhana) valala, eTAi hacche AmAra pratipAlaka| kintu yakhana tA astamita hala, se valala, yA astamita haYe yAYa tAra prati AmAra kona anurAga nei|

ataHpara se yakhana candrake ujjvala haYe uThate dekhala takhana valala, eTA hacche AmAra pratipAlaka| kintu yakhana tA astamita hala takhana se valala, AmAra pratipAlaka yadi AmAke saThika pathera dizA nA dena tAhale Ami avazyai pathabhraSTa sampradAYera antarbhukta haYe yAva|

ataHpara yakhana se sUryake ati ujjvala haYe udita hate dekhala takhana valala, eTAi hacche AmAra pratipAlaka, eTAi hacche sava theke var3a| ataHpara yakhana tA astamita hala takhana se valala, he AmAra jAtira lokerA! tomarA yeguloke (AllAhara) aMzIdAra sthira kara segulora sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei|
Ami ekaniSTha haYe tA~ra dike AmAra mukha phiriYe nicchi yini AkAzamanDalI Ara pRthivIke sRSTi karechena| Ara Ami muzarikadera antarbhukta nai|

tAra jAti tAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda karala| se valala, tomarA AllAhara vyApAre AmAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda karacha athaca tini AmAke satpatha dekhiYechena| tomarA yAderake tAra aMzIdAra sthira kara Ami tAderake bhaYa kari nA| avazya AllAha yadi kichu icche karena (tave se kathA AlAdA)| pratiTi vastu samparke AmAra pratipAlakera jJAna parivyApta, tomarA ki tA vujhave nA?

tomarA yAderake (AllAhara) aMzIdAra sthira karecha Ami tAderake kIbhAve bhaYa karate pAri, yekhAne tomarA AllAhara aMzIdAra vAniYe nite bhaYa kara nA ye samparke AllAha kona pramANai nAyila karenani| nirApattA lAbhera vyApAre (e) du’Ti dalera madhye konaTi vezi hakadAra? vala, yadi tomAdera jAnA thAke|
yArA ImAna eneche Ara yulama (arthAt ziraka) dvArA tAdera ImAnake kaluSita kareni, nirApattA lAbha tArAi karave Ara tArAi hala saThika pathaprApta|
e hala AmAra yukti-pramANa yA Ami ivarAhImake diYechilAma tAra kAomera vipakSe, Ami yAke icche maryAdAYa unnIta kari| tomAdera pratipAlaka nizcaYai hikamAtaoYAlA,sarvajJa|

Ami tAke dAna karechilAma isahAka Ara iYAkUva; tAdera pratyekake sat patha dekhiYechilAma, Ara era pUrve nUhake sat patha dekhiYechilAma Ara tAra vaMzadhara theke dAUda, sulAimAna, AiUva, iusupha, mUsA o hArUnake (sat patha dekhiYechilAma), sat karmazIladera Ami ebhAvei puraskRta kare thAki|
Ara yAkAriYA, iYAhaiYA, ‘IsA o iliYAsa- erA savAi satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|
Ara isamAIla, Ala iYAsA‘A, iunusa o lUta- edera pratyekake Ami vizvajagate jAtisamUhera upara zreSThatva dAna karechilAma|
tAdera pitRpuruSa, vaMzadhara o bhrAtRvarga theke tAderake veche niYechi Ara satya-saThika pathe paricAlita karechi|
e hacche AllAhara hidAYAta, tini tA~ra vAndAhaderake theke yAke icche hidAYAta karena, tArA yadi ziraka karata tave tAdera sava kRtakarma vinaSTa haYe yeta|

erA tArAi yAderake Ami kitAva, hikamAta o navuota dAna karechilAma, ekhana yadi tArA (arthAt vidharmIrA) eguloke mene nite asvIkAra kare tAhale Ami egulora bhAra emana sampradAYera kAche soparda karechi yArA (arthAt mu’minarA) egulora asvIkArakArI have nA|

orA hala tArA yAderake AllAha hidAYAta dAna karechilena, tumi tAdera patha anusaraNa kara; vala, era janya (arthAt vANI pau~che deYAra janya) Ami tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA| eTA sArA duniYAra mAnuSera janya upadeza vANI|

tArA AllAhake yathAyatha maryAdA dite pAreni yakhana tArA e kathA valeche ye, AllAha kona mAnuSera kAche kona kichui avatIrNa karenani| vala, tAhale ai kitAva ke avatIrNa karechilena yA niYe esechilena mUsA, yA chila mAnuSera janya AlokavartikA o saThika pathera dikadizArI, kAgajera pRSThAYa yA tomarA prakAza kara Ara vezira bhAgai gopana kara, yAra sAhAyye tomAderake jAniYe deYA haYeche yA tomarAo jAnate nA, tomAdera vApa-dAdArAo jAnata nA? vala, (mUsAra prati ai kitAva) AllAhi (nAyila karechilena), ataHpara tAderake tAdera nirarthaka AlocanAYa matta haYe thAkate dAo|

Ara [ekhana yA muhAmmAda (sA.)-era prati nAyila karA haYeche] e kitAva varakate bharapura, tAdera kAche ye kitAva Ache tAra satyatA pratipAdanakArI, Ara tA makkA o tAra catuSpArzavastha elAkAra lokederake satarka karAra janya prerita| yArA AkherAte vizvAsa kare tArA ete vizvAsa kare, Ara tArA tAdera salAtera hiphAyAta kare|

tAra theke var3a yAlima Ara ke ye AllAha samparke mithye kathA racanA kare athavA vale, AmAra prati oYAhI nAyila haYa; yadio tAra kAche kichui avatIrNa haYa nA| Ara ye vale: AllAha yA nAyila karena Ami zIghrai tAra anurUpa nAyila karava| hAYa! yadi tumi ai yAlimaderake dekhate pete yakhana tArA mRtyu yantraNAYa chaTaphaTa karate thAkave, Ara pherezatArA hAta vAr3iYe diYe valave, tomAdera jAnaguloke vera kare dAo, Aja tomAderake avamAnanAkara AyAva deYA have yehetu tomarA AllAha samparke emana kathA valate yA prakRta satya naYa Ara tA~ra nidarzanagulora vyApAre auddhatya pradarzana karate|

(kviYAmAtera dina AllAha valavena) tomarA AmAra nikaTa temanai niHsaGga avasthAYa hAjira haYecha yemanabhAve Ami tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechilAma, tomAderake yA (ni‘mAtarAji) dAna karechilAma tA tomarA tomAdera pechane phele rekhe esecha, Ara tomAdera sAthe sei supArizakArIgaNakeo dekhachi nA yAdera samparke tomarA dhAraNA karate ye tomAdera kArya uddhArera vyApAre tAdera aMza Ache| tomAdera madhyekAra samparka ekevArei chinna haYe geche, Ara tomarA ye sava dhAraNA karate se sava akAryakara pramANita haYeche|
AllAhai hacchena zasya dAnA o vIja vidIrNakArI, tini mRta theke jIvantake vera karena evaM jIvanta theke mRtake| ei hacchena AllAha; satpatha theke tomarA kothAYa cale yAccha?
tini USAra unmeSa ghaTAna, tini rAta sRSTi karechena zAnti o ArAmera janya, sUrya o candra vAniYechena gaNanAra janya| esava mahAparAkramazAlI sarvajJAtA kartRka nirdhArita|

tini tomAdera janya nakSatrarAji sRSTi karechena yAte tomarA segulora sAhAyye jale sthale andhakAre pathera dizA lAbha karate pAra| Ami AmAra nidarzanaguloke jJAnIdera janya vizadabhAve varNanA kare diYechi|

tini tomAderake ekaTi prANa hate sRSTi karechena, tArapara pratyekera janya ekaTA avasthAna sthala Ache Ara ekaTi Ache tAke gacchita rAkhAra jAYagA| jJAna-vuddhi sampanna lokedera janya Ami AmAra AYAtaguloke vizadabhAve varNanA kare diYechi|

tinii AkAza theke vRSTi varSaNa karena ataHpara tA dvArA Ami sakala prakAra udbhida udagata kari, ataHpara tA theke savuja pAtA udgata kari, ataHpara tA theke ghana sanniviSTa zasyadAnA utpanna kari, khejura gAchera mocA theke jhulanta kA~di nirgata kari, AGgurera vAgAna sRSTi kari, Ara sRSTi kari jAYatuna o DAlima, segulo ekai rakama evaM vibhinna rakamao| lakSya kara tAra phalera prati yakhana gAche phala Ase Ara phala pAke| esavera bhitare mu’mina sampradAYera janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|
tArA jvInake AllAhara aMzIdAra sthira kare athaca tAderake tinii sRSTi karechena, tArA nA jene nA vujhe AllAhara janya putra-kanyA sthira kare, tAdera esava kathA hate tini pavitra o mahAna|
tini AkAzamanDalI o yamInera udbhAvaka, kIbhAve tA~ra santAna hate pAre yehetu tA~ra kona saGgINIi nei, sava kichu to tinii sRSTi karechena, Ara pratiTi jinisa samparke tini pUrNa jJAna rAkhena|
ei halena tomAdera pratipAlaka, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, sava kichura sraSTA; kAjei tomarA tA~rai ‘ivAdAta kara, tini samasta viSaYera rkamavidhAYaka|
dRSTi tAra nAgAla pAYa nA varaM tinii sakala dRSTi nAgAle rAkhena, tini atizaYa sUkSNadarzI, sava viSaYe oYAkiphahAla|

tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa theke (antarera) Alo ese pau~cheche, ye loka (ei Alo diYe) dekhave tAte tAra nijerai kalyANa have, Ara ye andha thAkave, tAra akalyANa tAra ghAr3ei par3ave| (vANI pau~che deYAra dAYitva diYe AmAke pAThAno haYeche) Ami tomAderake pAhArA deYAra janya dAYitvapApta haini|

ebhAvei Ami nidarzanaguloke vAra vAra nAnAbhAve varnanA kari| yAra phale tArA (arthAt avizvAsIrA) vale, tumi (esava kathA anyera kAcha theke) zikhe niYecha, vastuta Ami jJAnI lokadera janya tA suspaSTabhAve vivRta kari|
tumi tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa theke ye oYAhI pAo tAra anusaraNa kara, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, tumi muzarikadera dika theke mukha phiriYe nAo|

AllAha icche karale tArA AllAhara aMzI sthira karata nA, (Asala zikSA tAderake jAniYe deYA haYeche, ekhana tArA mAnuka vA nA mAnuka) Ami tomAke tAdera upara pAhArAdAra pAThAYani (jora kare AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kariYe neYAra janya), Ara tumi tAdera pakSa theke karmasampAdanakArIo nao|

(ohe muminagaNa!) AllAhake vAda diYe yAderake tArA DAke tomarA tAderake gAli dio nA, kenanA tArA tAdera ajJatAprasUta zatrutAra vazavartI haYe AllAhake gAli deve| Ara ebhAvei Ami pratyeka jAtira janya tAdera kAryakalApake tAdera dRSTite cAkacikyamaYa kare diYechi, ataHpara tAdera pratyAvartana (ghaTave) tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa, takhana tini tAderake jAniYe divena yA kichu tArA karato|

tArA AllAhara nAme kaThina zapatha kare vale- tAdera nikaTa yadi kona nidarzana Asata tave tArA avazyai tA~ra prati ImAna Anata| vala, nidarzana (AnAra vyApAraTi) hala AllAhara ikhatiYArabhukta| nidarzana Asaleo tArA ye ImAna Anave nA, e kathA kIbhAve tomAderake vujhAno yAve?
Ara Amio edera antara o dRSTisamUhake (anya dike) phiriYe deva, Ara tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAra ghUrNipAke andhera mata ghure marAra suyoga deva|

Ami yadi tAdera kAche pherezatA avatIrNa karatAma Ara mRtarA tAdera sAthe kathA valata Ara Ami tAdera sAmane yAvatIYa vastu hAjira kare ditAma tavuo AllAhara icche vyatIta tArA ImAna Anata nA, mUlataH tAdera adhikAMzai ajJatApUrNa kAja kare|

ebhAve Ami pratyeka nAvIra janya mAnuSa Ara jvIna zaYatAnadera madhya hate zatru vAniYe diYechi, pratAraNA karAra uddezye tArA eke aparera kAche cittAkarSaka kathAvArtA vale| tomAra pratipAlaka icche karale tArA tA karata nA, kAjei tAderake Ara tAdera mithye carcAke upekSA kare cala|

tAra dike (arthAt cittAkarSaka pratAraNAra dike) se sava lokera antara AkRSTa hate dAo yArA AkherAtera prati ImAna Ane nA, Ara tAtei tAderake santuSTa thAkate dAo Ara ye pApakAja tArA karate cAYa tA tAderake karate dAo|

vala, Ami ki AllAha chAr3A anyake vicAraka mAnava, yakhana tini sei (sattA) yini tomAdera nikaTa kitAva nAyila karechena, yA vizadabhAve vivRta| Ami yAderake (pUrve) kitAva diYechilAma tArA jAne ye, tA satyatA sahakAre tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate avatIrNa haYeche| kAjei kichutei tumi sandeha poSaNakArIdera madhye zAmila haYo nA|
satyatA o inasAphera dika diYe tomAra pratipAlakera vANI paripUrNa| tA~ra vANI parivartana karAra keu nei| Ara tini halena sarvazrotA o sarvajJa|

tumi yadi pRthivIra adhikAMza lokera anusaraNa kara tAhale tArA tomAke AllAhara patha hate vicyuta kare phelave, tArA to kevala AndAja-anumAnera anusaraNa kare cale, tArA mithyAcAra chAr3A kichu kare nA|
tomAra ravva khuva bhAla karei jAnena ke tA~ra patha theke bhraSTa haYe geche Ara tini hidAYAtaprAptadera samparkeo sarvAdhika avahita|
kAjei ye pazu yaveha karAra samaYa AllAhara nAma neYA haYeche tA tomarA khAo yadi tA~ra nidarzanAvalIte tomarA vizvAsI haYe thAka|

tomAdera kI haYeche ye, yAte AllAhara nAma neYA haYeche tA tomarA khAve nA? tomAdera janya yA hArAma karA haYeche tA tomAdera janya vizadabhAve vAtale deYA haYeche, tave yadi tomarA nirupAYa hao (tave tataTuku niSiddha vastu khete pAra yAte prANe vA~cate pAra), kintu aneka lokai ajJAnatAvazataH tAdera kheYAla khuzI dvArA avazyai (anyaderake) pathabhraSTa kare, tomAra pratipAlaka sImAlaGghanakArIdera samparke savaceYe vezi avagata|
tomarA prakAzya o gopana pApa varjana kara, yArA pApa arjana kare tArA tAdera arjanera yathocita pratiphala pAve|

yAte (yavaha karAra samaYa) AllAhara nAma neYA haYani tA tomarA moTei khAve nA, tA hacche pApAcAra, zAYatvanerA tAdera vandhuderake tomAdera saGge tarka-jhagar3A karAra janya prarocita kare; yadi tomarA tAdera kathA mAnya kare cala tAhale tomarA avazyai muzarika haYe yAve|

ye vyakti mRta chila, tAke Ami jIvita karalAma, tAra janya Alora vyavasthA karalAma yAra sAhAyye se mAnuSera mAjhe calApherA kare, se ki tAra mata ye andhakAre nimajjita, yAttheke se kakSano veriYe Asate pArave nA| eTA ejanya ye, kAphirarA yA karache tA tAdera janya cAkacikyamaYa kare deYA haYeche|

ebhAve Ami pratyeka janapade sekhAnakAra aparAdhI pradhAnaderake cakrAntajAla vistAra karAra suyoga diYechi, kintu e cakrAntera phA~de tArA nijerAi patita haYa, kintu seTA tArA upalavdhii karate pAre nA|

yakhana tAdera kAche kona nidarzana Ase takhana tArA vale, ‘AmarA kakSano vizvAsa karava nA yatakSaNa nA AmAderake tA deYA haYa yA AllAhara rasUlagaNake deYA haYechila| (nirvodherA e AvadAra karaleo) AllAha khuva bhAlabhAvei jAnena tA~ra risAlAtera dAYitva kothAYa dite have, aparAdhIrA zIghrai tAdera cakrAntera pratiphala hiseve AllAhara pakSa hate lAJchanA o kaThina zAstira sammukhIna have|

AllAha yAke satpatha dekhAte cAna, tAra antarake isalAmera janya khule dena, Ara yAke pathabhraSTa karate cAna tAra antarake saMkIrNa saMkucita kare dena, (tAra janya isalAma mAnya karA emani kaThina) yena se AkAze ArohaNa karache| yArA ImAna Ane nA tAdera upara AllAha ebhAve lAJchanA cApiYe dena|
athaca (isalAmera) e pathai tomAra pratipAlakera sarala-saThika patha, yArA nAsIhAta grahaNa kare Ami tAdera janya nidarzanAvalI vizadabhAve vivRta kare diYechi|
tAdera janya tAdera pratipAlakera kAche Ache zAntidhAma, tinii tAdera pRSThapoSaka ejanya ye tArA (saThika) ‘AmAla karechila|

yedina tAdera savAike ekatrita karA have, (sedina AllAha valavena) he jvina samAja! tomarA mAnava samAjera upara khuva vAr3AvAr3i karecha| mAnava samAjera madhya theke tAdera vandhurA valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA paraspare parasparera nikaTa hate lAbhavAna haYechi Ara AmarA AmAdera nirdhArita samaYe pau~che gechi yA tumi AmAdera janya nirdhArita karechile| AllAha valavena, jAhAnnAmai hala tomAdera vAsasthAna, tAra madhyei have tomAdera ciravAsa, tave AllAha yadi anyarUpa icche karena (tave tAi have)| tomAra pratipAlaka kuzalI evaM sarvajJa|
ebhAvei Ami (parakAle) yAlimaderake parasparera saGgI vAniYe deva sei upArjanera vinimaYe yA tArA (duniYAte paraspare eka saGge mile) karachila|

(AllAha jijJesa karavena) he jvina o mAnava samAja! tomAdera kAche tomAdera madhya hate ki rasUlagaNa Asenani yArA tomAdera kAche AmAra AYAta varNanA karata Ara e dinera sAthe ye sAkSAt ghaTave se vyApAre tomAderake bhaYa pradarzana karata? tArA valave, AmarA AmAdera viruddhe sAkSya dicchi; mUlataH e duniYAra jIvana tAderake pratArita kareche, tArA nijedera viruddhe sAkSya deve ye tArA kAphira chila|
eTA ejanya ye AllAha kona janapadake dhvaMsa karena nA anyAYabhAve evaM (satyapatha konaTi Ara bhulapatha konaTi se samparke) yakhana tArA thAke anavahita|
pratyekake tAra ‘AmAla anuyAYI maryAdA deYA have Ara tArA yA kare se vyApAre tomAra pratipAlaka ve-khavara nana|

tomAra pratipAlaka amukhApekSI, atyanta daYAzIla| tini icche karale tomAderake apasArita karavena evaM yAke icche tomAdera sthalAbhiSikta karavena yemana tini tomAderake anya sampradAYera vaMza hate sRSTi karechena|
yA ghaTave vale tomAderake oYAdA deYA haYeche tA ghaTavei, tA vyartha kare deYAra kSamatA tomAdera nei|

vala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA tomAdera (dharmIYa) avasthAne theke yA karacha kare yAo, Amio AmAra kAja karachi, tomarA zIghrai jAnate pArave kalyANamaYa pariNati kAra have| yAlimagaNa kakhanao saphalakAma haYa nA|

AllAha ye zasya o gavAdi pazu sRSTi karechena tAttheke tArA AllAhara janya ekaTA aMza nirdiSTa kare Ara tArA tAdera dhAraNAmata vale e aMza AllAhara janya, Ara e aMza AmAdera devadevIdera janya| ye aMza tAdera devadevIdera janya tA AllAhara nikaTa pau~che nA, kintu ye aMza AllAhara tA tAdera devadevIdera nikaTa pau~che| katai nA nikRSTa ei lokadera phAYasAlA!

Ara ebhAve tAdera devadevIrA vahu muzarikadera cokhe nijedera santAna hatyAke AkarSaNIYa kare diYeche tAderake dhvaMsa karAra janya evaM tAdera dvInake sandehapUrNa karAra janya| AllAha yadi icche karatena tave tArA tA karate pArata nA, kAjei tAderake cher3e dAo, tArA tAdera mithye niYe magna thAkuka|

tArA tAdera dhAraNA anusAre vale, ei ei gavAdi pazu o phasala surakSita| AmarA yAra janya icche karava se chAr3A keu egulo khete pArave nA| e sava tAdera kalpita| kataka gavAdi pazura piThe car3A niSiddha karA haYeche, kataka gavAdi pazu yavaha karAra samaYa tArA AllAhara nAma neYa nA, (esava vAdhA-niSedha) AllAhara prati mithye racanA svarUpa kare thAke| esava mithye racanAra pratiphala tini zIghrai tAderake pradAna karavena|

tArA Aro vale, esava gavAdi pazura garbhe yA Ache tA AmAdera puruSadera janya nirdiSTa, Ara AmAdera strIlokadera janya niSiddha, kintu tA (arthAt garbhasthita vAccA) yadi mRta haYa tave sakalera tAte aMza Ache| tAdera ei mithye racanAra pratiphala acirei tini tAderake devena, tini var3ai hikamAtaoYAlA, sarvajJa|

yArA mUrkhera mata nA jene tAdera santAnadera hatyA kareche Ara AllAhara nAme mithye kathA vAniYe neYAra mAdhyame AllAhara deYA jIvikAke hArAma kare niYeche, tArA nizcitarUpe kSatigrasta haYeche| tArA pathabhraSTa haYe geche Ara tArA kasminakAleo hidAYAtaprApta chila nA|

Ara tini (AllAha) yini latAgulma viziSTa Ara latA-viziSTa naYa emana udyAnarAji, khejura gAcha o vibhinna svAdera khAdyazasya, ekai dharanera o AlAdA dharanera yAYatuna o DAlima sRSTi karechena| yakhana phala dhare takhana phala khAo, Ara phasala tolAra dina (nirdhArita ozara o anirdhArita dAnera mAdhyame) haka AdAYa kara, apacaYa karo nA, nizcaYa tini apacaYakArIdera pachanda karena nA|

gavAdi pazura madhye kataka Ache bhAravAhI Ara kataka Ache gozata o AcchAdanera sAmagrI dAnakArI, AllAha tomAderake ye riykva diYechena tAttheke bhakSaNa kara Ara zAYatvanera padAGka anusaraNa karo nA, se tomAdera kholAkhuli duzamana|

(nara-mAdI cAra) jor3AYa ATa prakAra, meSera du’Ti, chAgalera du’Ti| vala, tini ki nara du’Ti hArAma karechena, nA mAdI du’Ti kiMvA mAdI du’Tira garbhe yA Ache tA? e samparkita jJAnera bhittite javAva dAo yadi tomarA satyavAdI haYe thAka|

Ara uTera du’Ti, Ara garura du’Ti| vala, edera nara du’Ti ki tini hArAma karechena, nA mAdI du’Ti athavA mAdI du’Tira garbhe yA Ache tA? tomarA ki takhana upasthita chile yakhana AllAha e rakama nirdeza diYechilena? ye vyakti mAnuSaderake pathabhraSTa karAra uddezye kona rakama ‘ilama chAr3Ai AllAhara samvandhe mithye racanA kare tAra theke var3a yAlima Ara ke hate pAre? vastutaH AllAha yAlima sampradAYake hidAYAta dAna karena nA|

vala, AmAra prati ye oYAhI karA haYeche tAte mAnuSa yA AhAra kare tAra kichui niSiddha pAi nA mRta, pravahamAna rakta o zUkarera mAMsa chAr3A| kAraNa tA apavitra athavA AllAha chAr3A anyera nAme yavaha karA phAsikI kAja| tave ye vyakti nirupAYa haYe par3e kintu se nApharamAna o sImAlaGghanakArI naYa, tAhale tomAra pratipAlaka var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

yArA iYAhUdI haYeche tAdera janya Ami yAvatIYa tIkSNadhAra nakhayukta pazu hArAma karechilAma Ara tAdera janya garu-chAgalera carvio hArAma karechilAma, egulora piThera kiMvA nAr3ibhur3ira vA hAr3era sAthe lege thAkA carvi chAr3A| tAdera avAdhyatAra zAsti ebhAve tAderake diYechilAma, Ami avazyai satya kathA valachi|

ataHpara yadi tArA tomAke mithye mane kare tave tAderake vala, tomAdera pratipAlaka prazasta daYAra mAlika, (kintu tAovA nA kare aparAdhIi theke gele) tave aparAdhI sampradAYera upara hate tA~ra zAsti rada haYa nA|

yArA ziraka kareche tArA valave, AllAha icche karale AmarA ziraka karatAma nA, Ara AmAdera pitRpuruSarAo karata nA, Ara kona kichui (AmAdera upara) hArAma kare nitAma nA, ebhAve tAdera Agera lokerAo satyake mithye gaNya karechila, avazeSe tArA AmAra zAsti AsvAdana karechila| vala, tomAdera kAche ki prakRta jJAna Ache, thAkale tA AmAdera kAche peza kara, tomarA to kevala dhAraNA-anumAnera anusaraNa kare calecha, tomarA to mithyAcArai kare yAccha|
cUr3Anta satya-nirbhara pramANa to AllAhara kAche Ache, AllAha yadi cAitena tAhale tini avazyai tomAdera sakalake satyapathe paricAlita karatena|

vala, AllAha ye eTA hArAma karechena se vyApAre yArA sAkSya deve tAderake hAjira kara| tArA sAkSya dileo tumi tAdera sAthe sAkSya dio nA| yArA AmAra AYAtaguloke amAnya kare, Ara yArA AkherAte vizvAsa kare nA Ara tAdera pratipAlakera samakakSa dA~r3a karAYa tumi kakSano tAdera kheYAlakhuzira anusaraNa karo nA|

vala, ‘eso, tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera janya yA niSiddha karechena tA par3e zonAi, tA ei ye, tA~ra sAthe kona kichuke zarIka karo nA, pitA-mAtAra saGge sadvyavahAra kara, daridratAra bhaYe tomAdera santAnadera hatyA karo nA, Amii tomAderake Ara tAderake jIvikA diYe thAki, prakAzya vA gopana kona azlIlatAra kAcheo yeYo nA, AllAha ye prANa haraNa karA hArAma karechena tA nyAYa saGgata kAraNa chAr3A hatyA karo nA| e samparke tini tomAderake nirdeza dicchena yAte tomarA cintA- bhAvanA kare kAja kara|

(iYAtImarA) vaYaHprApta nA haoYA paryanta kalyANa sAdhanera uddezya chAr3A iYAtImadera sampattira nikaTavartI haYo nA| parimApa o ojana nyAYasaGgatabhAve pUrNa kara, Ami kona vyaktira upara sAdhyera atirikta dAYitva cApiYe dei nA, yakhana kathA valave takhana inasAphapUrNa kathA valave- nikaTAtmIYadera samparke haleo, Ara AllAhara saGge kRta oYAdA pUrNa kara| esava vyApAre tini nirdeza dicchena yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

Ara eTAi AmAra saThika sarala patha, kAjei tomarA tAra anusaraNa kara, Ara nAnAna pathera anusaraNa karo nA, karale tA tomAderake tA~ra patha theke vicchinna kare phelave| ebhAve tini tomAderake nirdeza dicchena yAte tomarA tA~ke bhaYa kare yAvatIYa pApa theke ve~ce calate pAra|

ataHpara (tomarA avagata hao ye) Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma yAra mAdhyame Ami AmAra ni‘YAmAta pUrNa kare diYechilAma tAdera janya yArA uttama kAja kare, tAte chila yAvatIYa viSaYera vizada vivaraNa, (tA chila) saThika pathera dizArI o daYA svarUpa yAte tArA tAdera pratipAlakera saGge sAkSAtera vyApAre vizvAsa sthApana kare|
Ara e kitAva yA Ami avatIrNa karalAma tA varakatamaYa, kAjei tA mAnya kara, Ara AllAhake bhaYa kare cala, yAte tomAdera upara daYA varSita haYa|
yAte tArA nA valate pAre ye kitAva to zudhu AmAdera pUrvera du’dala (iYAhUdI o khrIsTAna) era upara avatIrNa haYechila Ara AmarA jAnatAma nA orA kI par3ata Ara par3Ata|

athavA tomarA nA valate pAra ye AmAdera upara yadi kitAva avatIrNa hata tAhale AmarA tAdera ceYe vezi hidAYAtaprApta hatAma| tAi ekhana tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke suspaSTa pramANa, hidAYAta o rahamata eseche| ataHpara ye vyakti AllAhara (e sava) AYAtasamUhake mithye mane ka’re tAttheke mukha phiriYe neve tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke Ache? AmAra AYAtasamUha theke yArA mukha phiriYe neYa, tAderake acirei Ami tAdera mukha phiriYe neYAra kAraNe nikRSTatama zAsti pradAna karava|

tArA ki ei apekSAYa Ache ye, tAdera kAche pherezatArA Asave athavA tomAra pratipAlaka (svaYaM) Asavena kiMvA tomAra ravera kichu nidarzana Asave (takhana tArA ImAna Anave)? ye dina tomAra ravera kataka nidarzana ese yAve se dina ai vyaktira ImAna kona suphala dive nA ye pUrve ImAna Aneni vA ImAnera mAdhyame kalyANa arjana kareni| vala, tomarA apekSA kara (tAhale dekhate pAve tomAdera kupharIra pariNAma kI dA~r3AYa), AmarAo apekSAYa thAkalAma (AmAdera puraskAra prApti o tomAdera pariNati dekhAra janya)|

yArA nijedera (pUrNa pariNata) dvInake khanDe khanDe vibhakta kare niYeche Ara (Apana Apana aMza niYe) dale dale bhAga haYe geche tAdera kona kAjera sAthe tomAra kona samparka nei| tAdera vyApAraTi puropuri AllAhara ikhatiYArabhukta| (samaYa halei) tini tAderake jAniYe devena tAdera kRtakarma samparke|
ye vyakti satkarma karave tAra janya Ache daza guNa puraskAra, Ara ye vyakti asatkAja karave tAke zudhu kRtakarmera tulya pratiphala deYA have, tAdera upara atyAcAra karA have nA|
vala, AmAke AmAra ravva sarala saThika pathe paricAlita karechena (yA) supratiSThita dvIna, ekaniSTha ivarAhImera patha| se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|
vala, AmAra nAmAya, AmAra yAvatIYa ‘ivAdAta, AmAra jIvana, AmAra maraNa (sava kichui) vizvajagatera pratipAlaka AllAhara janyai (nivedita)|
tA~ra kona zarIka nei, AmAke erai nirdeza deYA haYeche Ara Amii sarvaprathama AtmasamarpaNakArI|

Ami ki AllAhake cher3e anya pratipAlaka tAlAza karava? (athaca prakRtapakSe) tinii sava kichura pratipAlaka| pratyeka vyakti yA arjana kare tAra janya se nijei dAYI have| kona bhAravahanakArIi anyera gunAhera bhAra vahana karave nA| avazeSe tomAdera pratyAvartana sthala tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTei, takhana tini tomAderake jAniYe devena ye sakala viSaYe tomarA matabhede lipta chile (se sava viSaYe prakRta satya konaTi)|

tinii tomAderake pRthivIte parasparera sthalAbhiSikta vAniYechena, maryAdAYa tomAdera katakake katakera upare sthAna diYechena, Ami tomAderake yA diYechi ogulora mAdhyame tomAderake parIkSA karAra janya, tomAra rava to zAsti dAne druta (vyavasthA grahaNa karena) Ara tini avazyai var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Alipha, lAma, mIma, sAda|

eTi ekaTi kitAva yA tomAra upara nAyila karA haYeche, e vyApAre tomAra antare yena kona prakAra kuNThAvodha nA haYa, (eTA nAyila karA haYeche amAnyakArIderake) era dvArA bhaYa pradarzanera janya evaM mu’minaderake upadeza pradAnera janya|
tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tomarA tA mAnya kare cala, tA~ke chAr3A (anyadera) abhibhAvaka mAnya karo nA, tomarA khuva sAmAnya upadezai grahaNa kara|
Ami kata janapadake dhvaMsa kare diYechi| AmAra zAsti tAdera nikaTa esechila haThAt rAtrivelA kiMvA dupura velA tArA yakhana vizrAma nicchila|
AmAra zAsti yakhana tAdera upara esechila takhana e kathA valA chAr3A tArA Ara kona dhvani uccAraNa karate pAreni ye, ‘‘avazyai AmarA yAlima chilAma’’|
ataHpara yAdera nikaTa rasUla pAThAno haYechila Ami avazyai tAderake jijJesa karava Ara rasUlagaNakeo (AllAhara vANI pau~che deYA samparke) avazyai jijJesa karava|
ataHpara paripUrNa jJAnera bhittite tAdera nikaTa tAdera samasta kAhinI avazyai jAniYe deva, kenanA Ami to moTei anupasthita chilAma nA|
sedinera ojana have Thika Thika| phale yAdera pAllA bhArI have tArA saphalakAma have|
yAdera pAllA hAlakA have tArA hala yArA nijederake kSatigrasta kareche, kAraNa tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake pratyAkhyAna karechila|
Ami tomAderake yamIne pratiSThita karechi; Ara sekhAne tomAdera janya jIvikAra vyavasthA karechi tomarA khuva sAmAnyai kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

Ami to tomAderake sRSTi karechi, ataHpara tomAdera AkRti diYechi, ataHpara pherezatAdera nirdeza dilAma AdAmake sAjadAha karAra janya| takhana ivalisa chAr3A savAi sijadA karala| se sijadAkArIdera antarbhukta hala nA|
(AllAha) valalena, ‘Ami nirdeza deYAra pareo kise toke sAjadAha theke nivRtta rAkhala?’ se valala, ‘Ami tAra ceYe uttama, AmAke sRSTi karecha Aguna theke Ara tAke sRSTi karecha kAdA theke|’
tini valalena, ‘neme yA ekhAna theke, era bhitare theke ahaGkAra karave tA hate pAre nA, ataeva veriYe yA, adhamadera mAjhe tora sthAna|’
se valala, ‘tAhale yedina savAi (duniYA cher3e) uThave sedina paryanta AmAke samaYa dAo|’
tini valalena, nizcaYai tui nikRSTadera antarbhukta
se valala, yehetu tAra kAraNei (patha theke) AmAke chu~r3e phele diYecha, kAjei Ami avazyai tomAra sarala pathe mAnuSadera janya OMt pete thAkava|
