tArapara Ami tAdera sAmane diYe, tAdera pechana diYe, tAdera DAna diYe, tAdera vAma diYe, tAdera kAche avazyai Asava, tumi tAdera adhikAMzakei zokara AdAYakArI pAve nA|
tini valalena, dhikRta Ara vitAr3ita haYe ekhAna theke veriYe yA, tAdera madhye yArA toke mAnya karave tomAdera savAike diYe Ami avazyai jAhAnnAma bharti karava|
‘Ara, he AdAma! tumi o tomAra strI jAnnAte vAsa karate thAka, du’jane yA pachanda haYa khAo Ara ei gAchera kAche yeo nA, tAhale yAlimadera dale zAmila haYe yAve|’

ataHpara zaYatvAna tAderake kumantraNA dila tAdera lajjAsthAna prakAza karAra janya yA tAdera parasparera nikaTa gopana rAkhA haYechila; Ara valala, ‘tomAderake tomAdera ravva e gAchera nikaTavartI hate ye niSedha karechena tAra kAraNa echAr3A Ara kichui naYa ye (nikaTavartI hale) tomarA du’jana pherezatA haYe yAve kiMvA (jAnnAte) sthAYI haYe yAve|’
se zapatha kare tAdera valala, ‘Ami tomAdera satyikArera hitAkAGkSI|’

ebhAve se dho~kA diYe tAdera adhaHpatana ghaTiYe dila| yakhana tArA gAchera phalera svAda nila, takhana tAdera gopanIYa sthAna parasparera nikaTa prakAzita haYe gela, tArA jAnnAtera pAtA diYe nijederake DhAkate lAgala| takhana tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake Deke valalena, ‘Ami ki tomAderake e gAchera kAche yete niSedha karini Ara valini- zaYatvAna hacche tomAdera ubhaYera kholAkhuli duzamana?’
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA nijedera prati anyAYa kare phelechi, yadi tumi AmAderake kSamA nA kara Ara daYA nA kara tAhale AmarA avazya avazyai kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe yAva|’
tini valalena, ‘tomarA neme yAo, tomarA eke anyera zatru, pRthivIte tomAdera avasthAna o jIvikA thAkave ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYera janya|’
valalena, ‘okhAne tomarA jIvana yApana karave, okhAnei tomAdera mRtyu have, Ara tAthekei tomAderake vera karA have|’

he AdAma santAna! Ami tomAderake poSAka-paricchada diYechi tomAdera lajjAsthAna AvRta karAra janya evaM zobhA vardhanera janya| Ara tAkaoYAra pozAka hacche sarvottama pozAka| oTA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera madhye ekaTi yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

he AdAma santAna! zaYatvAna yena tomAderake kichutei phitanAYa phelate nA pAre yemanabhAve tomAdera pitA-mAtAke (Adama o hAoYAke) jAnnAta theke vera karechila| se tAdera parasparake lajjAsthAna dekhAnora janya tAdera deha hate poSAka khuliYe phelechila| se Ara tAra sAthIrA tomAderake emanabhAve dekhate pAYa ye tomarA tAderake dekhate pAo nA| yArA ImAna Ane nA tAdera janya Ami zaYatvAnake abhibhAvaka vAniYe diYechi|

tArA yakhana kona azlIla kAja kare takhana tArA vale- ‘AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake e kAjai karate dekhechi, Ara AllAha AmAderake esava kAja karAra Adeza diYechena|’ vala, ‘AllAha azlIlatAra nirdeza dena nA, AllAhara samvandhe tomarA ki emana kathA valacha yA tomarA jAna nA?’

vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka nyAYaparAYaNatAra nirdeza diYechena’, Ara pratyeka salAte tomAdera lakSya o manoyogake (tA~ra prati) nivaddha kara, tA~ra Anugatye vizuddha-citta haYe tA~ke DAka| yebhAve tomAderake prathame sRSTi karA haYeche (tomAdera mRtyura para AvAra jIvita haYe) sebhAvei tomarA phire Asave|

ekadalake tini saThika patha dekhiYechena, Ara anya dalera prati gomarAhI nirdhArita haYeche, tArA AllAhake vAda diYe zaYatvAnaderake tAdera abhibhAvaka kare niYeche Ara mane karache ye tArA saThika pathe Ache|
he AdAma santAna! pratyeka salAtera samaYa tomarA sAjasajjA grahaNa kara, Ara khAo, pAna kara kintu apacaYa karo nA, avazyai tini apacaYakArIderake pachanda karena nA|

vala, ‘ye sava saundarya-zobhAmanDita vastu o pavitra jIvikA tini tA~ra vAndAdera janya sRSTi karechena ke tA hArAma karala’? vala, ‘se sava hacche ImAnadAradera janya duniYAra jIvane vizeSataH kviYAmAtera dine| ebhAve Ami jJAnI sampradAYera janya nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAve vivRta kari|’

vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka avazyai prakAzya o gopana azlIlatA, pApa, anyAYa, virodhitA, AllAhara aMzIdAra sthira karA ye vyApAre tini kona pramANa nAyila karenani, Ara AllAha samparke tomAdera ajJatAprasUta kathAvArtA niSiddha kare diYechena|
pratiTi jAtira janya samaYa nirdhArita Ache| tAdera nirdhArita samaYa yakhana ese yAve takhana eka muhUrtakAla pazcAt-agra have nA|

he AdAma santAna! tomAdera kAche tomAderai madhye theke yakhana rasUlagaNa Ase yArA tomAdera kAche AmAra AYAtaguloke vizadabhAve vyAkhyA kare, takhana yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare Ara nijederake saMzodhana kare neYa, tAdera kona bhaYa nei, tArA cintita have nA|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtaguloke asvIkAra karave Ara segulora vyApAre auddhatya dekhAve, tArAi hala jAhAnnAmera vAsindA, tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave|

tAttheke var3a yAlima Ara ke Ache ye AllAha samparke mithye racanA kare athavA tA~ra AYAtaguloke asvIkAra kare? kitAve likhita (duniYAte tAdera janya) nirdiSTa aMza tAdera kAche pau~chave, ye paryanta nA AmAra prerita pherezatA tAdera jAna kavaja karAra janya tAdera kAche Asave| tArA (arthAt pherezatArA) jijJesa karave, ‘AllAha chAr3A yAderake tomarA AhavAna karate tArA kothAYa’? tArA valave, ‘tArA AmAdera theke udhAo haYe geche’ Ara tArA nijedera viruddhe sAkSya dive ye tArA kAphira chila|

AllAha valavena, ‘tomAdera Age jvina o mAnuSera madhye yArA jAhAnnAme praveza kareche, tAdera mAjhe praveza kara|’ yakhanai ekaTi dala praveza karave, takhana tArA anyadalake abhisampAta karave| avazeSe savAi yakhana tAra bhitara ekatrita have, takhana pratyekaTi paravartI dala Agera dala samparke valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! orAi AmAderake pathabhraSTa kareche, kAjei oderake Agune dviguNa zAsti dAo|’ AllAha valavena, ‘pratyekera zAsti dviguNa karA haYeche (nijerA pathabhraSTa haoYAra janya evaM anyadera pathabhraSTa karAra janya) kintu tomarA jAna nA|’
tAdera pUrvavartI dala (Agera jenArezana) paravartI dalake (parera jenArezanake) valave, ‘AmAdera ceYe tomAdera vezi kona maryAdA nei, kAjei tomAdera kRtakarmera janya zAstio svAda grahaNa kara|’

yArA AmAra AYAtaguloke asvIkAra kare Ara e vyApAre auddhatya prakAza kare tAdera janya AkAzera darajAgulo unmukta have nA Ara tArA jAnnAte praveza karave nA-yatakSaNa nA sU~cera chidre uTa praveza kare| ebhAvei Ami aparAdhIderake pratiphala diYe thAki|
tAdera janya have jAhAnnAmera vichAnA, Ara upare bhA~jera para bhA~ja karA agnira AcchAdana| Ara ebhAvei Ami yAlimaderake pratiphala diYe thAki|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkAja kare- Ami kAro upara sAdhyera atirikta dAYitva cApiYe deinA- tArA have jAnnAtera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA have sthAYI|

tAdera antara theke hiMsA-vidveSa dUra kare deva, tAdera pAdadeze nirjhariNI pravAhita have, Ara tArA valave, yAvatIYa prazaMsA AllAhara yini AmAderake e patha dekhiYechena, AmarA kichutei patha petAma nA yadi nA AllAha AmAderake patha dekhAtena| AmAdera pratipAlakera rasUlagaNa prakRta satya niYei esechilena| tAderake AhavAna kare jAnAno have- ‘tomarA (duniYAte) ye ‘AmAla karate tAra phale tomarA e jAnnAtera uttarAdhikArI haYecha|’

jAnnAtavAsIrA jAhAnnAmavAsIderake samvodhana kare valave ye, ‘AmAderake AmAdera pratipAlaka ye oYA‘dA diYechilena tA AmarA Thika Thika peYechi| Ara tomarAo ki tomAdera pratipAlakera oYA‘dA Thika mata peYecha?’ tArA valave, ‘hA~’| takhana ekajana ghoSaNAkArI tAdera mAjhe ghoSaNA karave ye, yAlimadera upara AllAhara abhizApa
yArA AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare Ara tAke vA~kA karate cAYa, Ara tArA parakAla asvIkArakArI|

ubhaYa dalera mAjhe Ache pardA Ara A‘rAphe (jAnnAta o jAhAnnAmera madhyavartI aMza) kichu loka thAkave yArA pratyeka lokake tAra cihna dvArA cinate pArave (ye se jAnnAtera vAsindA nA jAhAnnAmera)| jAnnAtavAsIderake Deke tArA valave, ‘tomAdera prati sAlAma’| tArA (A‘rAphavAsIrA) takhanao jAnnAte praveza kareni kintu tArA AzA karache|
yakhana tAdera dRSTi agnivAsIdera dike ghuriYe deYA have takhana tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake yAlimadera saGgI karo nA|’
A‘rAphavAsIrA yAderake cihna dekhe cinate pArave tAderake Deke valave, ‘tomAdera dalavala Ara garva-ahaGkAra kona kAje Asala nA|’

erAi (arthAt jAnnAtavAsIrA) ki ai sava loka yAdera vyApAre tomarA zapatha kare valate ye AllAha tAdera prati kona daYA dekhAvena nA| (Aja ederakei valA hala) tomarA jAnnAte praveza kara, tomAdera kona bhaYa nei, tomarA duHkhitao have nA|

jAhAnnAmIrA jAnnAtIdera Deke valave, ‘AmAderake kichu pAni Dhele dAo kiMvA AllAha tomAderake ye riyak diYechena tAttheke kichu dAo|’ tArA valave, ‘AllAha e du’To kAphiradera janya niSiddha kare diYechena|’

‘yArA tAdera dvInake khelA-tAmAzA vAniYe niYechila Ara duniYAra jIvana yAderake pratArita karechila|’ kAjei Ajakera dine tAderake Ami bhule yAva yebhAve tArA e dinera sAkSAtke bhule giYechila evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare calechila|
Ami avazyai tAdera kAche eka kitAva ene diYechilAma yA chila pUrNa jJAnera bhittite vizadabhAve vivRta yA chila vizvAsI sampradAYera janya saThika pathera dizArI o rahamata svarUpa|

tArA ki tAra pariNAmera apekSA karache (kAphiraderake ye pariNAmera vyApAre e kitAva khavara diYeche) yakhana tAra (khavara deYA) pariNAma ese yAve takhana pUrve yArA era kathA bhule giYechila tArA valave, AmAdera pratipAlakera rasUlagaNa to prakRta satya niYei esechila, ekhana kona supArizakArI Ache ki yArA AmAdera janya supAriza karave athavA AmAderake (pRthivIte) phire yete deYA have ki yAte AmarA ye ‘AmAla karachilAma tattheke bhinnatara ‘AmAla kari? tArA nijederake kSatigrasta kare pheleche, Ara tArA ye mithye racanA karata tAo tAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe geche|

tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAha yini chaYa dine AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena, ataHpara Araze samunnata haYechena| dinake tini rAtera pardA diYe Dheke dena, tArA eke anyake drutagatite anusaraNa kare evaM sUrya, candra, tArakArAji tA~rai AjJAvaha| jene rekha, sRSTi tA~ra, hukumao (calave) tA~ra, varakatamaYa AllAha vizvajagatera pratipAlaka|
tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakake vinaYera saGge evaM gopane AhavAna kara, tini sImAlaGghanakArIderake pachanda karena nA|
zAnti-zRGkhalA sthApita haoYAra para pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karo nA, Ara tA~ke bhaYa-bhIti o AzA-bharasA niYe DAkate thAka, AllAhara daYA to (sava samaYa) tAdera nikaTe Ache yArA sat kAja kare|

tini tA~ra rahamatera pUrve susaMvAdera ghoSaka hiseve vAYu preraNa karena, ataHpara yakhana tA meghera bhArI vojhA vahana kare, takhana Ami tAke mRta bhUkhanDera dike tAr3iYe niYe yAi, yAttheke Ami pAni varSaNa kari, ataHpara tAttheke Ami sarvaprakAra phala utpanna kari| ebhAvei Ami mRtake jIvita kari yAte tomarA zikSA grahaNa kara|

utkRSTa bhUmi tAra pratipAlakera nirdeze vRkSalatA utpAdana kare, Ara nikRSTa yamIna theke kaThina parizrama nA karale kichui utpanna haYa nA| ebhAvei Ami AYAtagulo vAravAra vivRta kari kRtajJa sampradAYera janya|

Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera nikaTa pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera kona ilAha nAi|’ (tomarA AllAhara nirdeza amAnya karale) mahAdine Ami tomAdera janya zAstira AzaGkA kari|
tAra sampradAYera pradhAnagaNa valechila, ‘AmarA nizcitabhAve tomAke prakAzya gomarAhIte nimajjita dekhachi|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAte kona vibhrAnti nei, varaM Ami vizvajagatera pratipAlakera pakSa hate prerita rasUla|’
Ami tomAdera kAche AmAra pratipAlakera vANI pau~che dicchi Ara tomAderake nAsIhAta karachi, Ara Ami AllAhara nikaTa hate (emana sava viSaYa) jAni yA tomarA jAna nA|

‘tomarA ki e viSaYe vismaYa prakAza karacha ye tomAdera madhyekAra ekajana lokera nikaTa tomAdera janya tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate upadeza vANI eseche tomAderake satarka karAra janya yAte tomarA tAkvaoYA avalamvana kare AllAhara rahamataprApta hate pAra|’

kintu tArA tAke (mithyevAdI mane kare) asvIkAra karala| ataHpara Ami tAke Ara tAra saGge naukAYa yArA chila tAderake vA~ciYe dilAma Ara AmAra AYAtaguloke yArA asvIkAra karechila tAderake DuviYe mAralAma| tArA chila eka andha sampradAYa|

Ara ‘Ada jAtira kAche (pAThiYechilAma) tAdera bhAi hUdake| se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera anya kona ilAha nei, tomarA ki tAkvaoYA avalamvana karave nA?’
tAra jAtira pradhAnagaNa- yArA imAna Anate asvIkAra karechila, valala, ‘tumi nizcitai nirvuddhitAYa Duve Acha, Ara AmarA mane kari tumi mithyevAdI|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAra mAjhe kona nirvuddhitA nei, varaM Ami vizvajagatera pratipAlakera prerita rasUla|’
‘Ami tomAdera kAche AmAra pratipAlakera vANI pau~che dicchi, Ara Ami tomAdera vizvasta kalyANakAmI|

tomarA ki Azcarya haccha ye, tomAderai madhye ekajana lokera upara tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate upadeza eseche tomAderake sAvadhAna karAra uddeze| Aro smaraNa kara tini tomAderake nUhera kaomera para tAdera sthalAbhiSikta karechena Ara daihika gaThane adhikatara valiSTha karechena, kAjei AllAhara anugrahera kathA smaraNa kara yAte tomarA sAphalyamanDita hate pAra|’

tArA valala, ‘tumi ki AmAdera kAche ejanya esecha yAte AmarA eka AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kari Ara AmAdera pitRpuruSagaNa yAra ‘ivAdAta karata tA tyAga kari? kAjei tumi yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale AmAderake ye jinisera oYAdA karacha (bhaYa dekhAccha) tA niYe eso|’

se valala, ‘tomAdera upara tomAdera pratipAlakera asantoSa o krodha neme eseche| tAhale tomarA ki AmAra saGge emana katakagulo nAma samparke vitarka karacha yegulora nAmakaraNa tomarA Ara tomAdera vApa-dAdArAi kareche ye samparke AllAha kona pramANa nAyila karenani? tAhale tomarA apekSA kara, Amio tomAdera saGge apekSamAna thAkalAma|’
AmAra karuNAYa Ami tAke o tAra saGgI-sAthIderake rakSA karalAma Ara AmAra nidarzanAvalIke yArA asvIkAra karechila evaM ImAna Aneni tAdera mUla utpATana karalAma|

Ami sAmuda jAtira kAche tAdera bhAi sAlihake pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera kona ilAha nei| tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate suspaSTa pramANa eseche| eTi hala AllAhara uTanI, tomAdera janya nidarzana, tAke AllAhara yamIne care khete dAo, manda uddezye eke sparza karave nA, karale pIr3AdAYaka zAsti tomAderake grAsa karave|

smaraNa kara, ‘Ada jAtira pare tini tomAderake tAdera sthalAbhiSikta karechena Ara tomAderake yamIne vasati dAna karechena, tomarA tAra samatale prAsAda nirmANa karacha Ara pAhAr3a keTe ghara tairi karacha, kAjei AllAhara anugrahera kathA smaraNa kara, pRthivIte phAsAda sRSTi kara nA|

tAra jAtira garvita pradhAnagaNa aisava lokaderake valechila yAderake durvala kare rAkhA haYechila, yArA tAdera madhye ImAna enechila- ‘‘tomarA ki jAna ye sAliha tAra pratipAlaka kartRka prerita? tArA valechila, ‘tini ye vANI niYe prerita haYechena tAte AmarA vizvAsI’|
yArA ahaGkAra karechila tArA valechila, ‘tomarA yAte vizvAsa karecha AmarA tA asvIkAra karachi|’

ataHpara tArA uSTrITike mere phelala evaM tAdera pratipAlakera spaSTa virodhitA kare calala Ara valala, ‘he sAliha! tumi yadi rasUla haYei thAka tAhale tA niYe eso AmAderake yAra oYAdA karacha (bhaYa dekhAccha)|’
ataHpara bhUmikampa tAderake haThAt pAkar3Ao karala Ara tArA tAdera gharagulote mukha thuvar3e par3e raila|

Ara sAliha e kathA vale tAderake parityAga karala ye, he AmAra sampradAYa! ‘Ami tomAdera kAche AmAra pratipAlakera vANI pau~che diYechi, Ara tomAderake sadupadeza diYechi kintu sadupadeza dAnakArIderake tomarA pachanda kara nA|’
Ara Ami lUtake pAThiYechilAma| yakhana se tAra jAtike valechila, ‘tomarA emana nirlajjatAra kAja karacha yA vizvajagate tomAdera pUrve kona ekajanao kareni|’
tomarA yauna tAr3anAYa strIdera vAda diYe puruSadera nikaTa gamana karacha, tomarA haccha eka sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa|
tAra jAtira e chAr3A Ara kona javAva chila nA ye, ‘tomAdera janapada theke ederake vera kare dAo, erA emana loka yArA khuva pavitra hate cAYa|’
ataHpara Ami tAke Ara tAra parivAra-parijanake rakSA karalAma kintu tAra strI chAr3A, kenanA se chila pechane avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta|
tAdera upara eka pAtharera vRSTi varSiYe dilAma| tArapara dekha, aparAdhIdera pariNati kI haYechila!

Ami mAdaiYAnavAsIdera kAche tAdera bhAi zu‘AYavake pAThiYechilAma| (se valechila) ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera kona ilAha nei, tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa theke tomAdera kAche to spaSTa nidarzana ese geche, kAjei mApa o ojana saThikabhAve kara, lokederake tAdera prApya viSaYe kSatigrasta karo nA, pRthivIra saMzodhanera para tAte viparyaYa sRSTi kara nA, eTAi tomAdera janya kalyANakara yadi tomarA satyii mu’mina haYe thAka|’

‘yArA ImAna eneche tAderake bhaYa dekhAnora janya Ara AllAhara patha theke vAdhA deYAra janya pratiTi pathe pAhArA vasio nA, Ara tAte (arthAt AllAhara sahaja-sarala pathe) vakratA anusandhAna kara nA|’ smaraNa kara, ‘tomarA saMkhyAYa alpa chile, ataHpara AllAha tomAderake saMkhyAdhikya kare diYechena| lakSya kara, viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pariNati kI haYechila|’

‘Ami yA niYe prerita haYechi tAte yadi tomAdera ekadala ImAna Ane Ara ekadala ImAna nA Ane, tAhale dhairya dhAraNa kara ye paryanta nA AllAha AmAdera Ara tomAdera mAjhe mImAMsA kare dena, tini halena sarvottama mImAMsAkArI|’

tAra jAtira uddhata sardAragaNa valala, ‘ohe zu‘AYava! AmarA tomAke Ara tomAra saGge yArA ImAna eneche tAderake AmAdera janapada theke vera kare devai, athavA tumi AmAdera dharmavizvAse avazyai phire Asave|’ se valala, ‘AmarA yadi tAte rAjI nA hai tavuo?’

AllAha yakhana AmAderake tomAdera dharmavizvAsa theke rakSA karechena, takhana yadi AmarA tAte phire yAi, tAhale to AmarA AllAhara prati mithyAropa kare phelava| AmarA tAte phire yete pAri nA AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAhara icche vyatIta| pratiTi viSaYa samparke AmAdera pratipAlakera jJAna parivyApta, AmarA AllAharai prati nirbhara kari| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! ‘tumi AmAdera Ara AmAdera jAtira madhye saThikabhAve phAYasAlA kare dAo Ara tumi hale sarvottama mImAMsAkArI|’
tAra jAtira yArA kupharI karechila sei pradhAnagaNa valala, ‘tomarA yadi zu‘AYavera kathA mene nAo tAhale tomarA kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe yAve|’
ataHpara bhUmikampa tAderake haThAt AghAta hAnala Ara tArA tAdera gharavAr3ite upur3a haYe par3e raila|
yena zu‘AYavake asvIkArakArIrA sekhAne konadina vasavAsa kareni| yArA zu‘AYavake mithyA pratipanna karechila tArA kSatigrasta haYe gela|

se tAderake tyAga karala Ara valala, ‘he AmAra jAtira lokerA! Ami tomAdera kAche AmAra pratipAlakera prerita vANI pau~che diYechi, Ara tomAderake sadupadeza diYechi, kAjei Ami kAphira jAtira janya kI kare AkSepa karate pAri|’
Ami kona janapade emana kona nAvIi pAThAini yekhAnakAra adhivAsIderake abhAva-anaTana Ara duHkha-kaSTa kazAghAta kareni yAte tArA namratA o kAtaratA prakAza kare|

ataHpara Ami dUrAvasthAke sacchalatA diYe vadale dilAma Ara zeSa paryanta tArA prAcurye ver3e gela Ara valala, ‘AmAdera pitRpuruSera uparao e rakama sukha-duHkhera dina Asata|’ ataHpara Ami tAderake haThAt pAkar3Ao karalAma athaca tArA Tera karateo pArala nA|

janapadagulora lokerA yadi ImAna Anata Ara tAkvaoYA avalamvana karata tAhale Ami tAdera janya AsamAna Ara yamInera kalyANa unmukta kare ditAma kintu tArA (satyake) pratyAkhyAna karala| kAjei tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma|
janapadera lokerA ki nijederake nirApada mane karache ye AmAra zAsti tAdera upara patita have nA rAtera velA yakhana tArA ghumiYe thAkave?
athavA janapadera lokerA ki nijederake nirApada mane karache ye AmAra zAsti tAdera upara prakAzya divAloke Asave nA yakhana tArA khelAdhUlAYa matta thAkave?
tArA ki AllAhara kauzala theke nirbhaYa haYe geche? nizcita kSatigrasta sampradAYa chAr3A AllAhara kauzala hate keu nirbhaYa hate pAre nA|

yArA kona dezera uttarAdhikAra lAbha kareche sekhAnakAra (Agera) adhivAsIdera para, tArA ki e zikSA lAbha kare nA ye, Ami tAderake tAdera pApera kAraNe pAkar3Ao karate pAri Ara tadera antare sIla lAgiYe dite pAri yAte tArA kichui zunave nA?

esava janapadera kichu vivaraNa tomAke jAnAlAma| tAdera kAche to tAdera rasUlagaNa spaSTa pramANa niYe esechila, kintu yehetu tArA AgebhAgei pratyAkhyAna kare diYechila ejanya Ara ImAna Anate prastuta chila nA| ebhAve AllAha kAphiradera antare sIla lAgiYe dena|
tAdera adhikAMzakei Ami pratizruti pAlanakArI pAini, varaM adhikAMzake phAsikai peYechi|

tAdera pare Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzanAvalI sahakAre phira‘Aona o tAra pradhAnadera kAche pAThiYechilAma| kintu se savera prati tArA anyAYa AcaraNa pradarzana kare| lakSya kara, tArapara viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pariNati kemana haYechila!
mUsA valechila, he phira‘Aona! Ami vizvajagatera pratipAlakera pakSa theke prerita rasUla|

AmAra janya avazya karaNIYa ei ye, Ami prakRta satya chAr3A AllAhara samvandhe kichu vali nA, tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate spaSTa pramANa sahakAre tomAdera kAche esechi| kAjei vAnI isarAIlake AmAra saGge pAThiYe dAo|
phiraAuna valala, nidarzana niYei tumi yadi ese thAka, tAhale satyavAdI hale tumi tA peza kara|
se tAra lAThi nikSepa karala Ara takhana tA ekaTA prakAzya ajagara haYe gela|
Ara se tAra hAta (vagala theke) Tene vera karala, takhana tA darzakadera dRSTite sAdA ujjvala haYe dekhA dila|
phira‘Aona goSThIra pradhAnarA valala, nizcaYa se vijJa yAdukara|’
‘se cAYa tomAderake vera kare dite tomAdera deza theke| ekhana tomAdera parAmarza kI?’
tArA valala, ‘tAke o tAra bhAike avakAza dAo, Ara nagare nagare saMgrAhaka pAThiYe dAo’|
tArA tomAra kAche sava var3a var3a yAdukarake niYe Asave|
yAdukararA phiraAunera nikaTa ese valala, AmarA yadi vijaYI hai, tave AmAdera janya puraskAra Ache to?
se valala, hA~, tomarA avazyai (AmAra) naikaTyalAbhakArIdera madhye zAmila have|
tArA valala, ‘he mUsA! tumii ki (prathame yAdu) chu~r3ave, nA AmarAi chu~r3ava?’
se valala, ‘tomarAi chu~r3a’| yakhana tArA vAna chu~r3ala takhana lokajanera cokha yAdugrasta haYe gela, tArA bhIta santrasta haYe par3ala| tArA var3ai sAMghAtika eka yAdu dekhAla|
Ami mUsAra kAche oYAhI karalAma, ‘tomAra lAThi chu~r3e dAo’| takhana tA tAdera alIka vastuguloke grAsa karate zuru karala|
prakRta satya prakAza haYe gela, tArA yA sAjiYechila tA nisphala haYe gela|
tArA sekhAne parAjita hala Ara lAJchita avasthAYa phire gela|
Ara yAdukararA sAjadAYa luTiYe par3ala|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA vizvajagatera pratipAlakera prati ImAna AnalAma|
mUsA Ara hArUnera pratipAlakera prati|’

phira‘Aona valala, ‘Ami hukuma deYAra Agei tomarA tAra prati ImAna Anala? avazyai eTA tomAdera Sar3ayantra yeTA nagare vase tomarA pAkiYecha, era vAsindAdera vahiskRta karAra uddeze| era pariNAma zIghrai Tera pAve|
tomAdera hAta pA guloke viparIta dika theke avazyai Ami keTe deva, tArapara tomAdera savvAike zUle car3Ava|
tArA valala, AmarA avazyai AmAdera pratipAlakera dike pratyAvartana karava|

tumi AmAdera upara pratizodha niccha zudhu e kAraNe ye, AmAdera kAche yakhana AmAdera pratipAlakera nidarzana eseche takhana AmarA tAte vizvAsa sthApana karechi| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake dhairya o dRr3hatA avalamvanera guNe abhiSikta kara Ara musalamAna hiseve AmAdera mRtyu dAna kara|

phira‘Aona goSThIra saradAragaNa valala, ‘Apani ki mUsA Ara tAra jAtira lokederake yamIne viparyaYa sRSTi karAra janya cher3e devena Ara devena ApanAke Ara ApanAra mA‘vUdaderake varjana karate?’ se valala, ‘Ami tAdera putra santAnaderake hatyA karava Ara tAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhava, AmarA tAdera upara apratirodhya|’

mUsA tAra sampradAYake valala, ‘tomarA AllAhara sAhAyya kAmanA kara Ara dhairya avalamvana kara, yamInera mAlika halena AllAha, tini tA~ra vAndAhadera madhya hate yAke icche karavena tAra uttarAdhikArI vAnAvena, kalyANamaYa pariNAma hacche muttAkIdera janya|’

tArA valala, ‘AmAdera nikaTa tomAra AsAra pUrveo AmAderake jvAlAtana karA haYeche Ara tomAra AsAra pareo|’ se valala, ‘satvara tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera duzamanake dhvaMsa karavena Ara tomAderake deze pratinidhitva dAna karavena, ataHpara tini dekhavena tomarA kemana ‘AmAla kara|’
Ami phira‘AonI goSThIke durbhikSa Ara phala-phasalera kSaYa-kSati diYe pAkar3Ao karechilAma yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

tArA sudinera mukha dekhale valata, ‘eTAi to AmAdera prApya|’ Ara yakhana tArA durdine patita hata takhana mUsA Ara tAra saGgI-sAthIderake alakSuNe vale doSAropa karata| prakRtapakSe tAdera mandabhAgya to AllAhara hAte nivaddha, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai tA jAne nA|
tArA valala, ‘AmAderake yAdugrasta karAra janya tumi ye kona nidarzanai niYe Asa nA kena, AmarA kichutei tomAte vizvAsa karava nA|’
ataHpara Ami tAdera upara plAvana, paGgapAla, ukuna, vyAGa o raktera vipada pAThiYechilAma suspaSTa nidarzana hiseve, kintu tArA auddhatya prakAza karala| tArA chila eka aparAdhI jAti|

yakhana tAdera upara kona vAlA-musivata Asata takhana tArA valata, ‘he mUsA! tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa AmAdera janya prArthanA jAnAo ye mate tini tomAra sAthe aGgIkAra karechena, yadi AmAdera theke vipada dUra kare dAo tAhale AmarA avazyai tomAte ImAna Anava Ara vAnI isarAIlake avazyai tomAra sAthe pAThiYe deva|’
ataHpara yakhana tAdera upara theke vipada sariYe ditAma ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta yA tAderake pUrNa karate hata, takhana tArA aGgIkAra bhaGga karata|
takhana Ami tAdera upara pratizodha nilAma Ara tAderake samudre DuviYe mAralAma kenanA tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake asvIkAra karechila Ara e vyApAre tArA chila cintA-bhAvanAhIna|

Ara Ami durvala kare rAkhA lokederake sei yamInera pUrvera Ara pazcimera uttarAdhikArI vAniYe dilAma yAte Ami kalyANa nihita rekhechi| ebhAve vAnI isarAIlera vyApAre tAdera dhairya dhAraNera kAraNe tomAra pratipAlakera kalyANamaYa aGgIkAra pUrNa hala Ara phira‘Aona o tAra lokajanera gauravamaYa kAja o sundara prAsAdaguloke dhvaMsa kare dilAma|

vAnI isarAIlake Ami samudra pAra kariYe dilAma, ataHpara tArA emana eka jAtira nikaTa elo yArA chila pratimA pUjArI| mUsAra lokajana valala, he mUsA! AmAdera janyao ‘kona devatA vAniYe dAo yemana tAdera devatA Ache| mUsA valala, tomarA hale emana eka sampradAYa yArA mUrkhadera mato AcaraNa kare|’
esava loka yAte matta Ache tA dhvaMsa haYe yAve Ara tArA ye sava kAja karache tA sava vAtila|
se valala, ‘Ami ki AllAha chAr3A tomAdera janya anya ilAha khu~java athaca tini tomAderake vizvajagatera upara prAdhAnya diYechena?’

smaraNa kara, Ami tomAderake phira‘AonI goSThI theke rakSA karechi yArA tomAderake kaThina AyAve DuviYe rekhechila, yArA tomAdera chele santAnaguloke hatyA karachila Ara tomAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhachila, ete tomAdera janya chila tomAdera ravera pakSa hate eka kaThina parIkSA|

Ami mUsAra janya (sinAi parvatera upara) triza rAtri nirdhAraNa karalAma| ataHpara Aro daza (vAr3iYe) diYe (sei samaYa) pUrNa karalAma| ebhAve tAra pratipAlakera nirdhArita calliza rAtri pUrNa hala| mUsA tAra bhAi hArUnake valala, ‘AmAra anupasthitite AmAra sampradAYera janya tumi AmAra pratinidhitva kara, saMzodhana kara, viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera anusaraNa karo nA|’

mUsA yakhana AmAra nirdhArita samaYe Asala, Ara tAra ravva tAra saGge kathA valalena, takhana se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke dekhA dAo, Ami tomAke dekhava’| tini valalena, ‘tumi AmAke kakSano dekhate pAve nA, varaM tumi pAhAr3era dike tAkAo, yadi tA nija sthAne sthira thAkate pAre tAhale tumi AmAke dekhate pAve|’ ataHpara tAra pratipAlaka yakhana pAhAr3e nija jyoti vicchurita karalena, takhana tA pAhAr3ake cUrNa-vicUrNa kare dila Ara mUsA caitanya hAriYe par3e gela| yakhana cetanA phire pela, takhana se valala, ‘pavitra tomAra sattvA, Ami anuzocanA bhare tomAra pAnei phire elAma, Ara Ami prathama ImAna Anachi|’

tini valalena, ‘he mUsA! Ami AmAra risAlAta (yA tomAke diYechi) o AmAra vAkya (yA tomAra saGge valechilAma tAra) dvArA sakala lokera madhya theke tomAke nirvAcita karechi| kAjei yA tomAke diYechi tA grahaNa kara Ara zokara AdAYakArIdera antarbhukta hao|

Ami tAra janya phalake likhe dilAma sakala viSaYa saMkrAnta nAsIhAta Ara sakala viSaYe spaSTa vyAkhyA (Ara tAke valalAma) egulo zakta hAte dhara, tomAra lokajanake Adeza dAo egulo uttama panthAYa mAnya kare calate| zIghrai Ami tomAderake (AllAhara nirdeza amAnya kare dhvaMsastupe pariNata) phAsikadera vAsasthAna dekhAva|

yArA anyAYabhAve pRthivIte ahaGkAra kare ver3AYa Ami zIghrai tAdera dRSTike AmAra nidarzana hate phiriYe deva| tArA AmAra nidarzana dekhaleo tAte vizvAsa karave nA| tArA satyapatha dekhaleo tAke patha hiseve grahaNa karave nA| tArA vakra patha dekhale tAke patha hiseve grahaNa karave| tAra kAraNa hala tArA AmAra nidarzanaguloke mithye vale ur3iYe diYeche Ara egulora vyApAre tArA chila ekevAre cintA bhAvanAhIna|
yArA AmAra nidarzanaguloke Ara AkherAtera sAkSAtke mithye jene asvIkAra kare tAdera ‘AmAlagulo nisphala| tArA yA karata se anuyAYI pratiphala chAr3A tArA kI Ara AzA karate pAre?

mUsAra anupasthitite tAra jAtira lokerA tAdera alaGkArera sAhAyye go-vatsera ekaTA avaYava tairi karala yA garura nyAYa ‘hAmvA’ AoYAja karata| tArA ki dekhala nA ye tA tAdera saGge kathA vale nA, Ara tAderake pathao dekhAYa nA| kintu tA sattveo tArA tAke mA‘vUda hiseve grahaNa karala| tArA chila yAlima|

ataHpara yakhana tArA anutapta hala Ara vujhate pArala ye tArA pathahArA haYe geche, tArA valala, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka yadi AmAdera upara daYA nA karena Ara AmAderake kSamA nA karena tAhale AmarA avazyai kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe yAva|’

tArapara mUsA yakhana kSobha Ara krodha niYe tAra lokajanera kAche phire ela takhana valala, ‘AmAra anupasthitite tomarA kata nikRSTabhAvei nA AmAra pratinidhira dAYitva pAlana karecha! tomAdera pratipAlakera nirdeza lAbhera Agei tomarA tAr3Ahur3o kare vasale?’ ataHpara se phalakagulo chu~r3e phele dila, Ara nija bhAiYera mAthAra cula dhare nijera kAche Tene niYe Asala| hArUna valala, ‘he AmAra mAYera peTera bhAi! lokerA AmAke durvala kare diYechila Ara AmAke hatyA karate udyata haYechila, kAjei AmAra vyApAre duzamanaderake Anandita haoYAra suyoga dio nA Ara AmAke yAlima sampradAYera madhye gaNya karo nA|’
mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke Ara AmAra bhAike kSamA kara, Ara AmAderake tomAra rahamatera madhye dAkhila kara, tumii sarvAdhika var3a daYAvAna|’
yArA go-vatsake (mA‘vUda hiseve) grahaNa kareche, pArthiva jIvane tAdera upara tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa theke rAga o lAJchanA patita have| mithyA racanAkArIderake AmarA ebhAvei zAsti diYe thAki|
Ara yArA asat kAja kare, ataHpara tAovAha kare Ara ImAna Ane tAhale e savera para tomAra pratipAlaka avazyai var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
mUsAra krodha yakhana ThAnDA hala takhana se phalakagulo uThiYe nila, segulora lekhAYa chila aisava lokedera janya patha nirdeza Ara rahamata yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare|

mUsA tAra jAtira sattara jana lokake vAchAi karala AmAra nirdhArita samaYe upasthita haoYAra janya| yakhana bhUmikampa tAdera upara AghAta hAnala takhana se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi icche karale to ederake Ara AmAkeo Agei dhvaMsa kare dite pArate! AmAdera madhyekAra nirvodherA yA kareche tAra janya ki tumi AmAderake dhvaMsa kare deve? oTA to kevala tomAra parIkSA, yAke cAo taddvArA pathabhraSTa kara, Ara yAke cAo satya pathe paricAlita kara, tumi AmAdera prati daYA kara, tumii to savaceYe vezI kSamAzIla|’

‘AmAdera janya e duniYAra kalyANa likhe dAo Ara parakAleo| AmarA tomAra dikei pratyAvartana karachi|’ AllAha valalena, ‘zAsti to Ami yAke icche dei, Ara AmAra rahamata sava viSaYe parivyApta Ara tA Ami tAdera janya likhe diva yArA tAkvaoYA avalamvana karave, yAkAta dive Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIte vizvAsI have|’

yArA prerita ummI nAvIke anusaraNa karave yA tAdera kAche rakSita tAorAta o inajIle tArA likhita pAve| se tAderake satkAjera nirdeza deYa, asat kAja karate niSedha kare, pavitra vastusamUha tAdera janya hAlAla kare, apavitra vastugulo tAdera janya niSiddha kare, tAdera theke gurubhAra sariYe deYa Ara sei zRGkhala (hAlAla-hArAmera vAnoYATa vidhi-niSedha) yAte chila tArA vandI| kAjei yArA tAra prati ImAna Ane, tAke sammAna pradarzana kare, tAke sAhAyya-sahayogitA kare Ara tAra upara avatIrNa Alora anusaraNa kare, tArAi hacche saphalakAma|

vala, he mAnuSa! Ami tomAdera sakalera janya AllAhara rasUla, (sei AllAhara) yini AkAzasamUha Ara pRthivIra rAjatvera mAlika, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, tinii jIvita karena Ara mRtyu Anena| kAjei tomarA ImAna Ana AllAhara prati o tA~ra prerita sei ummI vArtAvAhakera prati ye nije AllAhara prati o tA~ra yAvatIYa vANIra prati vizvAsa kare, tomarA tA~ra anusaraNa kara yAte tomarA saThika patha pete pAra|
mUsAra sampradAYera madhye eka dala loka Ache yArA satya vidhAna anuyAYI (anyake) patha dekhAYa Ara satya vidhAna anuyAYI inasApha kare|

Ami tAderake vAraTi gotre vA jAtite vibhakta karechilAma| mUsAra jAtira lokerA yakhana tAra kAche pAni cAila takhana Ami mUsAra prati oYAhI avatIrNa karalAma ye, tomAra lAThi diYe pAthare AghAta kara| era phale tAttheke vAraTi jharNA utsArita hala| pratyeka gotra tAdera pAni pAnera sthAna cine nila, tAderake meghera chAYAYa AzraYa dilAma, tAdera upara Ami mAnnA o sAlaoYA avatIrNa karalAma Ara valalAma, ‘tomAderake Ami ye jIvikA diYechi tAttheke pavitra vastugulo AhAra kara|’ (kintu tArA AmAra nirdeza amAnya kare) AmAra prati kona yulama kareni, prakRtapakSe tArA nijedera uparai yulama karachila|

smaraNa kara, tAderake yakhana valA haYechila- ‘‘ei janapade vAsa kara, yekhAne icche AhAra kara Ara vala ‘(AmAderake) kSamA kara’, avanata mastake dvAre praveza kara, (tAhale) tomAdera truTigulo kSamA kare deva, Ara nekakAra lokaderake atirikta Aro deva|’’
kintu tAdera madhyekAra yAlima lokerA tAderake valA kathAke vadale phelalo| kAjei tAdera upara AkAza theke AyAva pAThAlAma, sImAlaGghane tAdera lipta thAkAra kAraNe|

tAderake jijJesa kara ai janavasati samparke yA samudrera upakUle vidyamAna chila| tArA zanivArera sImAlaGghana karechila| zanivAra pAlanera dina mAchagulo prakAzyataH tAdera nikaTe Asata| Ara yedina zanivArera anuSThAna thAkata nA sedina segulo Asata nA| eTA hata ejanya ye, tArA avAdhyatAYa lipta thAkAra kAraNe tAderake parIkSAYa phele diYechilAma|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tAdera ekadala valechila- ‘tomarA emana lokaderake kena nAsIhAta karacha yAderake AllAha dhvaMsa karavena athavA kaThina zAsti divena’| nAsIhAtakArIgaNa valechila, ‘tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa (dAYitva pAlana nA karAra) abhiyoga theke mukta haoYAra janya Ara tArA yAte tAkvaoYA avalamvana kare|’

ye upadeza tAderake deYA hacchila tArA yakhana tA bhule gela takhana yArA manda kAja theke (anyaderake) niSedha karata tAderake rakSA karalAma| Ara yAlimaderake kaThina AyAve pAkar3Ao karalAma yehetu tArA avAdhyatAYa lipta chila|
yakhana tArA carama dhRSTatA dekhiYe ai kAjagulo karate thAkala yA karate tAderake niSedha karA haYechila, takhana tAdera uddezye valalAma, ‘ghRNita apamAnita, vAnare rUpAntarita haYe yAo’|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka ghoSaNA karalena ye, Ami avazyai kviYAmAta paryanta vAnI isarAIlera upara emana lokaderake pAThAva yArA tAderake kaThina zAsti dite thAkave, tomAra pratipAlaka to zAstidAne khuvai tatpara, Ara tini (manda parityAgakArIdera janya) avazyai var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

pRthivIte Ami tAderake nAnA dale vibhakta kare diYechilAma, tAdera madhye kichu dala chila sat, kataka dala anya rakama evaM sukha Ara dukha diYe tAderake parIkSA karechilAma yAte tArA (AllAhara nirdezera pathe) phire Ase|

tAdera pare (pApiSTha) vaMzadharagaNa tAdera sthalAbhiSikta haYe kitAvera uttarAdhikArI haYa yArA duniYAra nikRSTa svArtha grahaNa kare Ara vale, ‘(AmarA yA kichui kari nA kena) AmAderake kSamA karA have’| Ara duniYAra svArtha tAdera sAmane Asale AvAra tA grahaNa kare neYa| (tAorAta) kitAve ki tAdera nikaTa theke e aGgIkAra neYA haYani ye tArA AllAha samvandhe prakRta satya chAr3A valave nA? tArA to ai kitAve yA Ache tA pATha kareo thAke| yArA tAkvaoYA avalamvana kare tAdera janya parakAlera AvAsai uttama, tomarA ki vujhave nA?
yArA kitAvake zaktabhAve A~kar3e dhare, nAmAya pratiSThA kare, Ami (esava) satkarmazIladera karmaphala kakhano vinaSTa kari nA|

smaraNa kara, Ami yakhana pAhAr3ake vAnI isarAIladera upara tule dharalAma tA yena ekaTA sAmiYAnA| tArA bhAvala, oTA tAdera upara vujhi patita have| (emata avasthAYa tAderake valalAma) ‘tomAderake yA dilAma tA zaktabhAve dhAraNa kara Ara tAte yA Ache tA mane rekha, yAte tomarA tAkvaoYA lAbha karate pAra’|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka Adama santAnadera pRSTha hate tAdera vaMzadharadera vera karalena Ara tAderakei sAkSI vAniYe jijJesa karalena, ‘Ami ki tomAdera pratipAlaka nai?’ tArA valala, ‘hyA~; e vyApAre AmarA sAkSya dicchi|’ (eTA ejanya karA haYechila) yAte tomarA kviYAmAtera dina nA vala ye, ‘e samparke AmarA ekevArei ve-khavara chilAma’|

athavA tomarA e kathA nA vala ye, ‘pUrve AmAdera pitR-puruSarAi ziraka kareche Ara tAdera pare AmarA tAderai santAnAdi (yA karate dekhechi tAi karachi) tAhale bhrAnta pathera anusArIrA yA kareche tAra janya ki Apani AmAderake dhvaMsa karavena?’
ebhAve Ami nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAve vivRta karachi, Ara haYata tArA (AmAra pathe) phire Asave|

tAderake ai lokera saMvAda par3e zonAo yAke Ami AmAra nidarzanasamUha pradAna karechilAma| kintu se seguloke er3iYe yAYa| ataHpara zaYatvAna tAke anusaraNa kare, phale se pathabhraSTadera dale zAmila haYe yAYa|

Ami icche karale AmAra nidarzanera mAdhyame tAke avazyai uccatara maryAdA ditAma| kintu se duniYAra pratii jhu~ke par3ala Ara tAra pravRttira anusaraNa karala| tAi tAra dRSTAnta hala kukurera dRSTAntera mata| yadi tumi tAra upara vojhA cApAo tAhale jibha vera kare hA~pAte thAke evaM tAke cher3e dileo jibha vera kare hA~pAte thAke| eTAi hala ai sampradAYera udAharaNa yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithye mane kare amAnya kare| tumi e kAhinI zuniYe dAo yAte tArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|
ye sampradAYa AmAra AYAtaguloke mithye mane kare pratyAkhyAna kare Ara nijedera upara yulama karate thAke tAdera udAharaNa katai nA manda!
AllAha yAke hidAYAta karena sei hidAYAta lAbha kare, Ara yAke pathabhraSTa karena tArAi haYa kSatigrasta|

Ami vahu saMkhyaka jvIna Ara mAnuSake jAhAnnAmera janya sRSTi karechi, tAdera hRdaYa Ache kintu tA diYe upalavdhi kare nA, tAdera cokha Ache kintu tA diYe dekhe nA, tAdera kAna Ache kintu tA diYe zone nA, tArA jantu-jAnoYArera mata, varaM tAra ceYeo pathabhraSTa, tArA ekevAre ve-khavara|
sundara yata nAma savai AllAhara janya| kAjei tA~ke DAka ai sava nAmera mAdhyame| yArA tAra nAmera madhye vikRti ghaTAYa tAderake parityAga kara| tArA yA karache tAra phala tArA zIghra pAve|
Ami yAderake sRSTi karechi tAdera madhye ekadala Ache yArA saThikabhAve patha nirdeza deYa, Ara tAra mAdhyamei suvicAra kare|
yArA AmAra AYAtaguloke pratyAkhyAna kare Ami tAderake dhApe dhApe emanabhAve dhvaMsera dike niYe yAi ye, tArA Terao karate pAre nA|
Ami tAderake avakAza o suyoga dei, AmAra kuzalI vyavasthApanA atyanta mayavuta|
tArA ki cintA-bhAvanA kare nA se tAdera saGgI (AmAra rasUla) to ummAda naYa, se to prakAzya eka satarkakArI|

tArA ki AsamAna-yamInera rAjatve Ara AllAha ye sava vastu sRSTi karechena tAte kichui dekhe nA? tArA ki cintA kare nA ye haYata tAdera jIvanera meYAda nikaTei ese geche? erapara tArA kona vANIra upara ImAna Anave?
AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra janya kona hidAYAta nei| tini tAderake tAdera vidrohI bhUmikAYa vibhrAnta haYe ghurapAka khete cher3e dena|

tArA tomAke kviYAmAta samparke jijJesa kare kakhana tA saMghaTita have| vala, ‘e viSaYe jJAna raYeche AmAra pratipAlakera nikaTa| tini chAr3A keu prakAza karate pAre nA kakhana tA ghaTave| AsamAna o yamIne tA have var3a eka kaThina dina| AkasmikabhAve tA tomAdera upara ese par3ave|’ lokerA tomAke e samparke emanabhAve jijJesa karache yena tumi Agraha sahakAre eTAra kho~je vyasta Acha| vala, ‘e viSaYera jJAna to zudhu AllAharai nikaTa Ache| kintu (e satyaTA) adhikAMza lokai jAne nA|’

vala, AllAha yA icche karena tA chAr3A AmAra nijera bhAla vA manda karAra kona kSamatA AmAra nei| Ami yadi adRzyera khavara jAnatAma tAhale nijera janya aneka vezi phAYadA hAsila kare nitAma, Ara kona prakAra akalyANai AmAke sparza karata nA| yArA ImAna Anave Ami sei sampradAYera prati satarkakArI o susaMvAdadAtA chAr3A anya kichu nai|

tinii tomAderake eka vyakti hate sRSTi karechena Ara tAttheke tAra jor3A sRSTi karechena yAte se tAra kAche zAnti pAYa| yakhana se strIra sAthe saGgata haYa takhana se laghu garbhadhAraNa kare Ara tA niYe calApherA kare| garbha yakhana bhArI haYe yAYa takhana ubhaYe tAdera pratipAlaka AllAhake Deke vale, ‘yadi tumi AmAderake (gaThana o svabhAve) bhAla santAna dAna kara tAhale AmarA kRtajJa thAkava|’

yakhana tini tAderake sarvAGga-sundara santAna dAna karena, takhana tArA tAderake yA deYA haYa tAte anyake AllAhara zarIka gaNya kare| tArA yAderake zarIka gaNya kare AllAha tAdera theke aneka Urdhve|
tArA ki emana kichuke zarIka kare yArA kichui sRSTi kare nA? varaM tAderakei sRSTi karA haYeche|
tArA nA pAre tAderake (arthAt tAdera ‘ivAdAtakArIderake) sAhAyya karate, nA pAre nijederake sAhAyya karate|
tomarA tAderake yadi satyapathe calAra janya DAka, tArA tomAdera anusaraNa karave nA| tAderake DAka kiMvA cupacApa thAka, tomAdera janya ubhaYai samAna|
AllAha chAr3A yAderake tomarA DAka tArA tomAdera matai vAndAh| (Thika Ache) tAderake DAkate thAka, tomarA yadi satyavAdI haYe thAka tAhale tArA tomAdera DAke sAr3A dika|

tAdera ki pA Ache yA diYe tArA calApherA kare? tAdera ki hAta Ache yA diYe tArA dhare? tAdera ki cokha Ache yA diYe tArA dekhe? tAdera ki kAna Ache yA diYe tArA zone? vala, tomarA yAderake AllAhara zarIka karacha tAderake AhavAna kara, Ara AmAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra kara evaM AmAke avakAza dio nA|
AllAhai halena AmAra abhibhAvaka yini kitAva avatIrNa karechena, Ara tinii satkarmazIladera abhibhAvakatva kare thAkena|
ke (arthAt AllAhake) chAr3A yAderake tomarA DAka, tArA tomAderake sAhAyya karAra kona kSamatA rAkhe nA, pAre nA nijederakeo sAhAyya karate|
tAderake yadi saThika pathera dike DAka, tArA zone nA, tumi dekha ye tArA tomAra dike tAkiYe Ache kintu Asale tArA kichui dekhate pAYa nA|
kSamAzIlatAra nIti avalamvana kara, satya-saThika kAjera Adeza dAo Ara jAhiladerake er3iYe cala|
zaYatvAna yadi uskAni diYe tomAke prarocita karate cAYa tAhale AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA kara, tini halena sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
yArA tAkvaoYA avalamvana kare zAYatvanera sparze tAdera mane kumantraNA jAgale tArA AllAhake smaraNa kare, takhana tAdera ImAna-cakSu khule yAYa|
kintu tAdera (arthAt zAYatvanera) saGgI-sAthIrA (kAphira o munAphikvarA) tAderake bhrAnta pathe niYe yAYa Ara e vyApAre ceSTAra kona truTi kare nA|

yakhana tumi tAdera kAche kona nidarzana hAjira kara nA, takhana tArA vale, tumi nijei ekaTA nidarzana veche nAo nA kena? vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate AmAra prati yA oYAhI karA haYa Ami to tArai anusaraNa kari| eTA tomAdera ravevara pakSa hate mu’mina sampradAYera janya ujjvala Alo, hidAYAta o rahamata|’
yakhana kuraAna pATha karA haYa takhana tomarA tA manoyogera saGge zravaNa kara Ara nIravatA vajAYa rAkha yAte tomAdera prati rahama karA haYa|
tomAra pratipAlakake mane mane vinaYera saGge bhaYa-bhIti sahakAre anuccasvare sakAla-sandhyAYa smaraNa kara Ara udAsInadera dalabhukta haYo nA|
yArA tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache tArA tA~ra ‘ivAdAta karAra vyApAre auddhatya prakAza kare nA, tArA tA~ra mahimA ghoSaNA kare Ara tA~ra janya sAjadAhaYa avanata haYa| [sAjadAha]

tArA tomAke yuddhe prApta sampada samparke jijJesa karache| vala, ‘yuddhe prApta sampada hacche AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera; kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara Ara nijedera samparkake suSThu sundara bhittira upara pratiSThita kara| tomarA yadi mu’mina haYe thAka tave tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kara|’

mu’mina to tArAi AllAhara kathA Alocita halei yAdera antara ke~pe uThe, Ara tAdera kAche yakhana tA~ra AYAta paThita haYa, takhana tA tAdera ImAna vRddhi kare Ara tArA tAdera pratipAlakera upara nirbhara kare|
tArA nAmAya kvAYima kare, Ara Ami tAderake ye jIvikA diYechi tAttheke vyaYa kare|
esava lokerAi hala prakRta mu’mina| edera janya edera pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache nAnAna maryAdA, kSamA Ara sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
(tArA yemana prakRta mu’mina) Thika temani prakRtabhAvei tomAra pratipAlaka tomAke tomAra ghara hate vera kare enechilena yadio mu’minadera ekadala tA pachanda kareni|
satya spaSTa haoYAra parao tArA tomAra saGge vAdAnuvAde lipta haYechila, (tAdera avasthA dekhe mane hacchila ye,) tArA yena ceYe ceYe dekhachila ye, tAderake mRtyura dike tAr3iYe neYA hacche|

smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha tomAderake pratizruti diYechilena ye, du’Ti dalera madhye ekaTi tomarA pAve, Ara tomarA ceYechile yena nirastra dalaTi tomarA lAbha kara Ara AllAha ceYechilena tA~ra vANI dvArA satyake satyarUpe pratiSThita karate Ara kAphiradera jar3a keTe dite|
yAte tini satyake satya hiseve pratiSThita karena Ara mithyeke mithye pramANita karena, yadio tA pApIdera kAche pachandanIYa naYa|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa sAhAyya prArthanA karachile takhana tini tomAderake javAva dilena, ‘Ami tomAderake eka hAjAra pherezatA diYe sAhAyya karava yArA para para Asave|’

Ara AllAha ye eTA karechilena tAra uddezya tomAderake susaMvAda dAna chAr3A anya kichu naYa Ara yAte era mAdhyame tomAdera antara prazAnti lAbha kare| kenanA, sAhAyya to ekamAtra AllAhara nikaTa thekei Ase| AllAha to mahAparAkramazAlI, mahAvijJAnI|

smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha tA~ra nikaTa hate prazAnti dhArA hiseve tomAderake tandrAYa Acchanna karechilena, AkAza hate tomAdera upara vRSTidhArA varSaNa karechilena tomAderake tA diYe pavitra karAra janya| tomAdera theke zaYatvAnI paMkilatA dUra karAra janya, tomAdera dilake majavuta karAra janya Ara tA diYe tomAdera pAYera bhita zakta karAra janya|

smaraNa kara yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka pherezatAdera prati oYAhI pAThiYechilena, ‘Ami tomAdera saGgei Achi; ataeva mu’minaderake tomarA dRr3hapada rekha’| acirei Ami kAphiradera dile bhIti saJcAra karava, kAjei tAdera skandhe AghAta hAna, AghAta hAna pratyekaTi AGgulera gi~Te gi~Te|
era kAraNa hala, tArA AllAha o rasUlera virodhitA kare Ara yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera virodhitA karave (tAdera jene rAkhA darakAra) AllAha zAstidAne var3ai kaThora|
eTAi tomAdera zAsti, ataeva tAra svAda grahaNa kara, kAphiradera janya Ache Agunera (jAhAnnAmera) zAsti|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yakhana yoddhA-vAhinIrUpe kAphiradera sammukhIna hao, takhana tAderake pRSThapradarzana karave nA|

emana dine yuddhe kauzala avalamvana vA nija dalera saGge milita haoYAra uddezya chAr3A keu tAderake pRSThapradarzana karale se to AllAhara gajave pariveSTita haYe par3ala, jAhAnnAmai tAra ThikAnA Ara tA katai nA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala|

(Asala vyApAra hala) tomarA tAderake hatyA karani, varaM AllAhai tAderake hatyA karechena, tumi yakhana nikSepa karachile tAto tumi nikSepa karani, varaM AllAhai nikSepa karechilena yAte tini mu’minaderake eka sundaratama parIkSAYa saphalatAra saGge uttIrNa karate pArena| AllAha halena sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
AmAra e vyavasthA tomAdera janya, (Ara kAphiradera samparke kathA ei ye) AllAha kAphiradera Sar3ayantrake akejo kare dena|

(ohe kAphiragaNa!) tomarA mImAMsA cAcchile, mImAMsA to tomAdera kAche ese geche; Ara yadi tomarA (anyAYa theke) virata hao, tave tA tomAdera janyai kalyANakara, tomarA yadi AvAra (anyAYa) kara, Amio AvAra zAsti diva, tomAdera dala-vAhinI saMkhyAYa adhika haleo tomAdera kona upakAre Asave nA evaM AllAha to mu’minadera saGge Achena|
ohe vizvAsIgaNa! AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kara evaM Adeza zonAra para tA amAnya kara nA|
tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA yArA valechila, ‘AmarA zunalAma’; prakRtapakSe tArA zoneni|
AllAhara nikaTa savaceYe nikRSTa jIva hacche yArA (hakva kathA zunAra vyApAre) vadhira evaM (hakva kathA valAra vyApAre) vovA, yArA kichui vojhe nA|

AllAha yadi dekhatena ye, tAdera madhye kona bhAla guNa nihita Ache tave tini tAderake zunavAra tAophIka ditena| Ara (guNa nA thAkA avasthAYa) tini yadi tAderake zunate ditena tAhale tArA upekSA kare mukha phiriYe nita|

ohe vizvAsIgaNa! tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera DAke sAr3A dAo yakhana tomAderake DAkA haYa (emana viSaYera dike) yA tomAdera mAjhe jIvana saJcAra kare, Ara jene rekha ye AllAha mAnuSa o tAra antarera mAjhe prativandhaka haYe yAna Ara tomAderake tA~ra kAchei ekatrita karA have|
satarka thAka sei zAsti hate yA vizeSabhAve tomAdera yAlima lokederakei Akramana karave nA| Ara jene rekha ye AllAha zAstidAne khuvai kaThora|

smaraNa kara se samaYera kathA yakhana tomarA chile saMkhyAYa alpa, duniYAte tomAderake durvala hiseve gaNya karA hata| tomarA AzaGkA karate ye, mAnuSerA tomAdera kakhana nA haThAt dhare niYe yAYa| emana avasthAYa tini tomAderake AzraYa dilena, tA~ra sAhAyya diYe tomAderake zaktizAlI karalena, uttama jIvikA dAna karalena yAte tomarA (tA~ra nirdeza pAlanera mAdhyame) kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA jene vujhe AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera saGge vizvAsaghAtakatA karo nA, Ara ye viSaYe tomarA AmAnAta prApta haYecha tAteo vizvAsa bhaGga karo nA|
jene rekha, tomAdera dhana-sampada Ara santAna- santati hacche parIkSAra sAmagrI mAtra| (e parIkSAYa yArA uttIrNa have tAdera janya) AllAhara nikaTa raYeche mahApuraskAra|

ohe ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yadi AllAhake bhaYa kara tAhale tini tomAderake bhAla o mandera madhye pArthakya karAra zakti pradAna karavena, tomAdera doSa-truTi dUra kare divena, tomAderake kSamA karavena, AllAha var3ai anugrahazIla|

smaraNa kara, sei samaYera kathA yakhana kAphiragaNa tomAke vandI karAra kiMvA hatyA karAra kiMvA deza theke vera kare deYAra janya Sar3ayantra kare| tArA cakrAnta kare Ara AllAhao kauzala karena| AllAhai hacchena sarvazreSTha kauzalI|
tAdera kAche yakhana AmAra AYAta pATha karA haYa takhana tArA vale, ‘zunalAma to, icche karale e rakama kathA AmarAo valate pAri, egulo to Age kAlera kecchA kAhinI chAr3A Ara kichui nA|’

smaraNa kara, yakhana tArA valechila, ‘he AllAha! eTA yadi tomAra nikaTa theke (prerita) satya (dvIna) haYa tAhale AmAdera upara AsamAna theke pAthara varSaNa kara, kiMvA AmAdera upara kona yantraNAdAYaka zAsti niYe eso|’
tumi tAdera mAjhe thAkA avasthAYa AllAha tAderake zAsti divena nA evaM yakhana tArA kSamA prArthanA karate thAkave erUpa avasthAYao AllAha tAderake zAsti divena nA|

AllAha ye tAderake zAsti divena nA e vyApAre ojara peza karAra janya tAdera kAche kI Ache yakhana tArA (mAnuSaderake) mAsajidula hArAma-era pathe vAdhA dicche? tArA to ora (prakRta) mutAoYAllI naYa, muttAkIrA chAr3A keu tAra mutAoYAllI hate pAre nA, kintu tAdera adhikAMza loka e samparke avagata naYa|
AllAhara gharera nikaTa tAdera nAmAya hAta tAli mArA Ara ziza deYA chAr3A Ara kichui nA, (esava aparAdhe lipta vyaktiderake valA have) ‘‘AyAva bhoga kara yehetu tomarA kupharIte lipta chile’’|

ye sava loka satyake mene nite asvIkAra kareche tArA AllAhara patha hate (lokederake) vAdhA deYAra janya tAdera dhana-sampada vyaYa kare thAke, tArA tA vyaYa karatei thAkave, ataHpara eTAi tAdera duHkha o anuzocanAra kAraNa have| pare tArA parAjitao have| yArA kupharI kare tAderake (avazeSe) jAhAnnAmera pAne ekatrita karA have|

yAte AllAha pavitra theke apavitrake AlAdA kare dena, ataHpara apavitradera ekake anyera upara rAkhavena, sakalake stupIkRta karavena; ataHpara ei samaSTike jAhAnnAme nikSepa karavena| erAi hala sarvasvAnta|

yArA kupharI kare tAderake vala, ‘tArA yadi nivRtta haYa tAhale tArA pUrve yA kareche tA kSamA karA have, Ara yadi (kupharIra) punarAvRtti kare, tAhale Agera lokedera (prati anusRta) nItira dRSTAnta to atItera pAtAtei Ache|’

tAdera viruddhe yuddha cAliYe yAo ye paryanta nA phitanA (kuphara o ziraka) khatama haYe yAYa Ara dvIna puropuribhAve AllAhara janya haYe yAYa| ataHpara tArA yadi virata haYa tAhale tArA (nyAYa vA anyAYa) yA kare AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|
Ara tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale jene rekha ye, AllAhai tomAdera abhibhAvaka, katai nA uttama abhibhAvaka! katai nA uttama sAhAyyakArI!

tomarA jene rekha ye, yuddhe yA tomarA lAbha kara tAra eka-paJcamAMza hacche AllAha, tA~ra rasUla, rasUlera AtmIYasvajana, iYAtIma, misakIna o musAphiradera janya yadi tomarA AllAhara upara Ara cUr3Anta phAYasAlAra dina arthAt du’pakSera (musalamAna o kAphera vAhinIra) milita haoYAra dina Ami yA AmAra vAndAhara upara avatIrNa karechilAma tAra upara vizvAsa kare thAka| Ara AllAha halena sakala viSaYera upara kSamatAvAna|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA upatyakAra nikaTa prAnte chile Ara tArA chila dUrera prAnte Ara uTera ArohI kAphelA (AvU suphaiYAnera netRtve kurAizera sampada saha kAphelA) chila tomAdera apekSA nimnabhUmite| yadi tomarA yuddha karAra vyApAre parasparera madhye pUrvei siddhAnta grahaNa karate, tavuo yuddha karAra e siddhAnta tomarA avazyai rakSA karate pArate nA (tomAdera durvala avasthAra kAraNe), yAte AllAha se kAja sampanna karate pArena yA chila pUrvei sthirIkRta, yena yAke dhvaMsa hate have se yena suspaSTa dalIlera bhittite dhvaMsa haYa Ara yAke jIvita thAkate have seo yena suspaSTa dalIlera bhittite jIvita thAke| AllAha nizcaYai sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

smaraNa kara, AllAha tomAke svapnera mAdhyame tAdera saMkhyAke alpa kare dekhiYechilena, yadi tini tAdera saMkhyAke tomAra nikaTa vezi kare dekhAtena tAhale tomarA avazyai sAhasa hAriYe phelate Ara yuddhera viSaYa niYe avazyaijhagar3A zuru kare dite| kintu AllAhi tomAderake rakSA karechilena, antare yA Ache se samparke tini khuvai bhAlabhAve avahita|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA parasparera sammukhIna haYechile takhana tini tomAdera cokhe tAderake svalpa saMkhyaka dekhiYechilena evaM tAdera cokhe tomAderake svalpa saMkhyaka dekhiYechilena sei vyApAraTi sampanna karAra janya yA chila pUrva sthirIkRta| yAvatIYa viSaYa (avazeSe) AllAharai nikaTa phire Ase|
he ImAnadAragaNa! yakhana tomarA kona vAhinIra sammukhIna have takhana avicala thAkave Ara AllAhake vezi vezi smaraNa karave, yAte tomarA sAphalya lAbha karate pAra|

AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kara, paraspare jhagar3A vivAda karo nA, tA karale tomarA sAhasa hAriYe phelave, tomAdera zakti-kSamatA vilupta have| Ara dhairya dhAraNa karave, AllAha dhairyazIladera saGge Achena|

tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA yArA garva ahaGkArasaha loka dekhAnora janya evaM AllAhara pathe vAdhA deYAra janya nijedera ghara hate vera haYechila, tArA yA kichui karuka nA kena, AllAha tAderake ghire rekhechena|

smaraNa kara, yakhana zaYatvAna tAdera kAryakalApake tAdera dRSTite khuvai cAkacikyamaYa kare dekhiYechila Ara tAderake valechila, ‘Aja tomAderake parAjita karate pAre mAnuSera mAjhe emana keui nAi, Ami tomAdera pAzei Achi|’ ataHpara dala du’Ti yakhana parasparera dRSTira gocare Asalo takhana se pichane sare par3ala Ara valala, ‘tomAdera sAthe AmAra konai samparka nei, Ami to dekhi (kAphiradera viruddhe yuddha karAra janya AllAhara nAyilakRta pherezatA) yA tomarA dekhate pAo nA, Ami avazyai AllAhake bhaYa kari kenanA AllAha zAstidAne atyanta kaThora|’

smaraNa kara, munAphikvarA Ara yAdera antare roga Ache tArA vale, ‘ei lokaguloke tAdera dvIna dho~kAYa phele diYeche’| (kintu Asala vyApAra hala) keu yadi AllAhara upara bharasA kare tAhale AllAha to pravala parAkrAnta, mahAvijJAnI|
tumi yadi dekhate yakhana pherezatArA kAphiradera prANavAYu nirgata karache takhana tAdera mukhe Ara piThe prahAra karache Ara valache agnite dagdha haoYAra yantraNA bhoga kara|
eTA hala tAi yA tomAdera hastagulo (arjana kare) Age pAThiYeche kenanA AllAha to tA~ra vAndAhadera prati atyAcArI nana|

phira‘Aonera lokajana o tAdera Agera lokedera matai orA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIke pratyAkhyAna kareche, kAjei tAdera pApera kAraNe AllAha tAderake pAkar3Ao karechena| nizcaYai AllAha zaktimAna, zAstidAne atyanta kaThora|

eTA ejanya ye, AllAha kona sampradAYera nikaTa deYA tA~ra avadAnake parivartana karena nA yatakSaNa nA tArA nijerAi (tAdera karmanItira mAdhyame) tA parivartana kare| nizcaYai AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

phiraAunera lokajana o tAdera Agera lokedera matai tArA tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanaguloke mithyA jenechila| kAjei tAdera pApera kAraNe Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechilAma Ara phiraAunera lokajanake DuviYe merechilAma| erA savAi chila yAlima|
yArA kupharI kare AllAhara nikaTa tArAi nikRSTatama jIva, ataHpara Ara tArA ImAna Anave nA|
tAdera madhye (vizeSabhAve nikRSTa tArA) tumi yAdera saGge cuktite Avaddha hao, ataHpara tArA se cukti pratyekavAra bhaGga kare Ara tArA (AllAhake) bhaYa kare nA|

yuddhe tomarA yadi tAderake vAge peYe yAo tAhale odera pechane yArA odera sAthI-saGgI Ache tAdera theke oderake emanabhAve chinna-vicchinna kare phelave yAte mane rAkhAra mata tArA ekaTA zikSA peYe yAYa|

Ara yadi tumi kona sampradAYera cukti bhaGgera AzaGkA kara tAhale (tAdera cuktike) tAdera prati nikSepa kara yAte samAna samAna avasthA virAjita haYa| AllAha nizcaYai (oYAdA-cukti-pratizruti) bhaGgakArIdera pachanda karena nA|
yArA kupharI kare tArA yena eTA dhAraNA nA kare ye tArA prAdhAnya lAbha kare niYeche, tArA mu’minaderake kakSano parAjita karate pArave nA|

Ara tAderake mukAvAlA karAra janya yathAsAdhya zakti o azva-vAhinI sadA prastuta rAkhave yadvArA tomarA bhaYa dekhAte thAkave AllAhara zatru Ara tomAdera zatruke, Ara tAdera chAr3Ao anyAnyaderakeo yAderake tomarA jAna nA kintu AllAha tAderake jAnena| tomarA AllAhara pathe yA kharaca kara tAra puropuri pratidAna tomAderake deYA have, Ara tomAdera sAthe kakSano yulama karA have nA|
tArA yadi sandhira dike jhu~ke, tumio tAra dike jhu~ke par3a, Ara AllAhara upara nirbhara kara, nizcaYai tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
Ara tArA yadi tomAke dho~kA deYAra niYyAta kare, sekSetre AllAhai tomAra janya yatheSTa| tini to tA~ra sAhAyya o mu’minadera dvArA tomAke zaktizAlI karechena|

tini tAdera hRdaYaguloke prItira vandhane jur3e diYechena| duniYAYa yA kichu Ache tAra savaTuku kharaca karaleo tumi tAdera antaraguloke prItira Dore vA~dhate pArate nA, kintu AllAha tAdera madhye vandhana sRSTi kare diYechena, tini to pravala parAkrAnta, mahAvijJAnI|
he nAvI! AllAhai tomAra Ara tomAra anusArI ImAnadAradera janya yatheSTa|

he nAvI! yuddhera vyApAre mu’minaderake udvuddha kara| tomAdera madhye vizajana dhairyazIla thAkale tArA du’za janera upara jaYI have evaM tomAdera madhye (airUpa) ekaza’ jana thAkale tArA ekahAjAra kAphirera upara vijaYI have| kenanA tArA hacche emana loka yArA (nyAYa-anyAYa samparke) kona vodha rAkhe nA|

(tave) ekhana AllAha tomAdera dAYitvabhAra kamiYe diYechena| AllAha to jAnena ye tomAdera bhitara durvalatA raYe geche, kAjei tomAdera mAjhe yadi ekaza’ jana dhairyazIla haYa tave tArA du’za janera upara vijaYI have| Ara yadi tomAdera mAjhe eka hAjAra (ai rakama) loka pAoYA yAYa tAhale tArA AllAhara hukume du’hAjAra lokera upara jaYI have| Ara AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe (Achena)|

kona nAvIra janya eTA saThika kAja naYa ye, deze (AllAhara duzamanaderake) puromAtrAYa parAbhUta nA karA paryanta tAra (hAte) yuddha-vandI thAkave| tomarA duniYAra svArtha cAo Ara AllAha cAna AkhirAta (era sAphalya), AllAha pravala parAkrAnta, mahAvijJAnI|
AllAhara lekhana yadi pUrvei lekhA nA hata tAhale tomarA yA (muktipaNa hiseve) grahaNa karecha tajjanya tomAdera upara mahAzAsti patita hata|
ekSaNe, yuddhe gAnImAta hiseve yA tomarA lAbha karecha tA bhoga kara, tA vaidha o pavitra| AllAhake bhaYa kare calo, nizcaYai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|

he nAvI! tomAdera hAte ye sava yuddhavandI Ache tAderake vala, ‘AllAha yadi tomAdera antare bhAla kichu dekhena tAhale tomAdera kAcha theke (muktipaNa) yA neYA haYeche tAttheke uttama kichu tomAderake tini dAna karavena Ara tomAderake kSamA kare devena| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|’

Ara yadi tArA tomAra sAthe khiYAnAta karAra icche kare (tave seTA asambhava kichu naYa, kAraNa era thekeo gurutara ye) tArA pUrve AllAhara sAthe khiYAnAta kareche, kAjei AllAha tAderake tomAra adhIna kare diYechena| AllAha sarvaviSaYe vizeSabhAve avagata, sarvazreSTha prajJAvAna|

yArA ImAna eneche, hijarAta kareche, nijedera mAla diYe jAna diYe AllAhara rAstAYa jihAda kareche Ara yArA tAderake AzraYa diYeche, sAhAyya kareche, erA paraspara parasparera vandhu| Ara yArA ImAna eneche kintu hijarAta kareni tArA hijarAta nA karA paryanta tAdera pRSThapoSakatA karAra kona dAYa-dAYitva tomAra upara nei, tave tArA yadi dvInera vyApAre tomAdera sAhAyya cAYa tAhale tAderake sAhAyya karA tomAdera kartavya, tave tAdera viruddhe naYa yAdera saGge tomAdera maitrI cukti raYeche| tomarA yA kara AllAha tA dekhena|
Ara yArA kupharI kare tArA eke aparera vandhu| yadi tomarA tA nA kara (arthAt tomarA paraspara parasparera sAhAyye egiYe nA Asa) tAhale duniYAte phitanA o mahAviparyaYa dekhA dive|

yArA ImAna eneche, hijarAta kareche, AllAhara rAstAYa jihAda kareche Ara yArA tAderake AzraYa diYeche, sAhAyya-sahayogitA kareche- tArAi prakRta ImAnadAra| tAdera janya Ache kSamA Ara sammAnajanaka jIvikA|

yArA pare ImAna eneche, hijarAta kareche Ara tomAdera sAthe milita haYe jihAda kareche, esava loka tomAderai madhye gaNya| kintu AllAhara vidhAne rakta samparkIYagaNa paraspara parasparera nikaTa agragaNya| AllAha sakala viSaYe savaceYe vezI avagata|
muzarikadera madhyekAra yAdera saGge tomarA sandhicukti karechile tAdera sAthe AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera pakSa hate samparkacchedera ghoSaNA deYA hala|
ataHpara (he kAphiragaNa!) cAra mAsa tomarA yamIne (icche mata) calApherA kare nAo; Ara jene rekha ye, tomarA AllAhake nata karate pArave nA, AllAhi satya pratyAkhyAnakArIderake lAJchita karavena|

AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera pakSa hate var3a hAjjera dine mAnuSadera kAche ghoSaNA deYA hala ye AllAha muzarikadera sAthe samparkahIna evaM tA~ra rasUlao| kAjei ekhana yadi tomarA tAovAha kara, tAte tomAderai bhAla have, Ara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale jene rekha ye, tomarA AllAhake hIna-durvala karate pArave nA, Ara yArA kupharI kare caleche tAderake bhaYAvaha zAstira susaMvAda zuniYe dAo|

kintu muzarikadera madhye yArA tomAdera saGge cukti rakSAra vyApAre vindumAtra truTi kareni, Ara tomAdera viruddhe kAuke sAhAyyao kareni, tAdera sAthe nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta cukti pUrNa kara| avazyai AllAha muttAkIdera bhAlavAsena|

tArapara (ei) niSiddha mAsa atikrAnta haYe gele muzarikaderake yekhAne pAo hatyA kara, tAderake pAkar3Ao kara, tAderake gherAo kara, tAdera apekSAYa pratyeka ghA~Tite ot pete vase thAka| kintu tArA yadi tAovAha kare, nAmAya pratiSThA kare, yAkAta AdAYa kare, tAhale tAdera patha cher3e dAo, nizcaYai AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

muzarikadera keu yadi tomAra kAche AzraYa prArthanA kare tave tAke AzraYa dAo yAte se AllAhara vANI zonAra suyoga pAYa; tArapara tAke tAra nirApada jAYagAYa pau~che dAo| eTA ejanya karate have ye, erA emana eka sampradAYa yArA (bhAla-manda, satya-mithyA samparke) ajJa|

AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera saGge muzarikadera cukti kI kare kAryakara thAkate pAre? avazya aisava loka chAr3A yAdera saGge tomarA mAsajidula hArAmera nikaTa cuktivaddha haYechile; tArA yaddina tomAdera saGge cukti Thika rAkhe, tomarAo tAdera saGge kRta cuktite dRr3ha thAka| nizcaYai AllAha muttAkIdera bhAlavAsena|

kIbhAve (cukti thAkate pAre) yadi tArA tomAderake parAjita karate pAre tAhale tArA tomAdera saGge nA AtmIYatAra maryAdA deYa, Ara nA oYAdA-aGgIkArera; tArA tAdera mukhera kathAYa tomAderake santuSTa rAkhate cAYa kintu tAdera antara tA asvIkAra kare, tAdera adhikAMzai satyatyAgI aparAdhI|
AllAhara AYAtake tArA (duniYAvI svArthe) ati tuccha mUlye vikri kare diYeche, AllAhara pathe (mAnuSadera calAra kSetre) prativandhakatA sRSTi kareche| tArA yA kare katai nA jaghanya se kAja|
kona ImAnadAra vyaktira vyApAre tArA nA kona AtmIYatAra maryAdA deYa, Ara nA kona oYAdA-aGgIkArera| erA hala sei loka yArA sImAlaGghanakArI|
ekhana yadi tArA tAovAha kare, nAmAya pratiSThA kare, yAkAta AdAYa kare tAhale tArA tomAdera dvInI bhAi| jJAna-vuddhisampanna lokedera janya Ami spaSTa kare nidarzana vale dilAma|

tArA yadi cukti karAra para tAdera zapatha bhaGga kare Ara tomAdera dInera viruddhe kaTukti kare, tAhale kAphiradera netRvRndera viruddhe lar3Ai kara, zapatha vale kona jinisa tAdera kAche nei, (kAjei zakti praYoga kara) yAte tArA (zaYatvAnI kAryakalApa theke) nivRtta haYa|

tomarA sei sampradAYera viruddhe lar3Ai kena karave nA yArA tAdera pratizruti bhaGga kareche, yArA rasUlake deza theke vera kare deYAra Sar3ayantra karechila? prathame tArAi tomAderake AkramaNa karechila| tomarA ki tAderake bhaYa kara? tomarA yAke bhaYa karave tAra savaceYe vezi hakadAra halena AllAha yadi tomarA mu’mina haYe thAka|
tAdera viruddhe lar3Ai kara, tomAdera hAta diYei AllAha tAderake zAsti divena, tAderake apamAnita karavena, tAdera viruddhe tomAderake sAhAyya karavena Ara mu’minadera prANa ThAnDA karavena|
tini tAdera manera jvAlA nibhiYe divena, AllAha yAke cAivena tAovAha karAra tAophIka divena, Ara AllAha halena sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomarA ki mane kara ye, tomAderake emanii cher3e deYA have ye paryanta AllAha jene nA nevena tomAdera madhye kArA tA~ra pathe jihAda kareche, Ara AllAha, tA~ra rasUla o mu’minadera chAr3A anya kAuke vandhu o abhibhAvaka hiseve grahaNa karena ni? tomarA yA kara se samparke AllAha vizeSabhAve avahita|

muzarikadera eTA kAja naYa ye, tArA AllAhara mAsajidera rakSaNAvekSaNakArI sevaka have yakhana tArA nijerAi nijedera kupharIra sAkSya deYa, tAdera samasta kAja varavAda haYe geche, jAhAnnAmei tArA have cirasthAYI|

AllAhara mAsajidera AvAda to tArAi karave yArA AllAha o zeSa divasera prati ImAna Ane, nAmAya pratiSThA kare, yAkAta AdAYa kare Ara AllAha chAr3A anya kAuke bhaYa kare nA| AzA karA yAYa, tArAi have saThika pathaprAptadera antarbhukta|

hAjIderake pAni pAna karAno Ara mAsajide hArAmera AvAda karAke ki tomarA tAdera kAjera samAna mane kara yArA AllAha o zeSa dine vizvAsa kare Ara AllAhara pathe jihAda kare? AllAhara dRSTite erA samAna naYa| (yArA bhrAntapathe AllAhara santuSTi khu~je emana) yAlima sampradAYake AllAha satpathe paricAlita karena nA|
yArA ImAna Ane, hijarAta kare, Ara nijedera jAna-mAla diYe AllAhara pathe jihAda kare, AllAhara nikaTa tAdera virATa maryAdA raYeche, erAi hala saphalakAma|
tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake susaMvAda dicchena tA~ra daYA o santuSTira, Ara jAnnAtera yekhAne tAdera janya Ache sthAYI sukha-sAmagrI|
yekhAne tArA ciradina thAkave| AllAhara kAchei to raYeche mahApuraskAra|
he vizvAsIgaNa! tomarA tomAdera pitA Ara bhAiderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA yadi tArA ImAnera ceYe kupharIkei vezi bhAlavAse| tomAdera madhye yArA tAderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kare, tArAi yAlima|

vala, ‘yadi tomAdera pitArA, Ara tomAdera santAnerA, Ara tomAdera bhAiYerA, Ara tomAdera strIrA, Ara tomAdera goSThIra lokerA Ara dhana-sampada yA tomarA arjana karecha, Ara vyavasA tomarA yAra mandAra bhaYa kara, Ara vAsasthAna yA tomarA bhAlavAsa (esava) yadi tomAdera nikaTa priYatara haYa AllAha, tA~ra rasUla o tA~ra pathe jihAda karA hate, tAhale apekSA kara yatakSaNa nA AllAha tA~ra cUr3Anta phaYasAlA tomAdera kAche niYe Asena|’ Ara AllAha avAdhya AcaraNakArIderake saThika patha pradarzana karena nA|

vastutaH AllAha tomAderake vahu yuddha kSetre sAhAyya karechena Ara hunAYanera yuddhera dina, tomAdera saMkhyAra Adhikya tomAderake garve mAtoYArA kare diYechila, kintu tA tomAdera kona kAje Aseni, yamIna suprazasta haoYA satveo tA tomAdera nikaTa saMkIrNai haYe giYechila, Ara tomarA pichana phire pAliYe giYechile|

tArapara AllAha tA~ra rasUlera upara, Ara mu’minadera upara tA~ra prazAntira amiYadhArA varSaNa karalena, Ara pAThAlena emana eka senAvAhinI yA tomarA dekhate pAoni, Ara tini kAphiraderake zAsti pradAna karalena| ebhAvei AllAha kAphiraderake pratiphala diYe thAkena|
eraparao AllAha yAra janya icche karavena tAke kSamAra dRSTite dekhavena, AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

ohe vizvAsIgaNa! muzarikarA hala apavitra, kAjei e vacharera para tArA yena mAsajide hArAmera nikaTa nA Ase| tomarA yadi daridratAra bhaYa kara, tave AllAha icche karale acirei tA~ra anugrahera mAdhyame tomAderake abhAva-mukta kare devena| nizcaYai AllAha sarvajJa, mahAvijJAnI|

yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche tAdera madhye yArA AllAhara prati ImAna Ane nA, Ara zeSa dinera pratio nA, Ara AllAha o tA~ra rasUla yA hArAma karechena tAke hArAma gaNya kare nA, Ara satya dvInake nijedera dvIna hiseve grahaNa kare nA tAdera viruddhe yuddha kara ye paryanta nA tArA vazyatA sahakAre svecchAYa TyAksa deYa|

iYAhUdIrA vale, ‘uyAYara AllAhara putra| Ara nAsArArA vale, ‘mAsIha AllAhara putra| esava tAdera mukhera kathA| ete tArA tAdera pUrvekAra kAphiradera kathArai anukaraNa kare| AllAha tAderake dhvaMsa karuna! kemanabhAve tArA satya patha theke dUre chiTake par3eche|

AllAhake vAda diYe tArA tAdera ‘Alima Ara daravezaderake rava vAniYe niYeche; Ara mAraiYAma-putra mAsIhakeo| athaca tAderake eka ilAha vyatIta (anyera) ‘ivAdAta karAra Adeza deYA haYani| tini vyatIta satyikArera kona ilAha nei, pavitratA Ara mahimA tA~rai, (vahu Urdhve tini) tArA yAderake (tA~ra) aMzIdAra gaNya kare tAttheke|
tArA tAdera mukhera phu~tkAre AllAhara Aloke nibhiYe dite cAYa, kintu AllAha tA hate divena nA, tini tA~ra Aloke pUrNa nA kare chAr3avena nA, yadio kAphiragaNa tA apachanda kare|
tini tA~ra rasUlake hidAYAta Ara saThika dvInasaha pAThiYechena yAvatIYa dvInera upara eke vijaYI karAra janya yadio muzarikagaNa apachanda kare|

he vizvAsIgaNa! avazyai ‘Alima o daravezadera anekei bhuYo karmakAnDera mAdhyame mAnuSadera sampada grAsa kare thAke Ara AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare| yArA svarNa o raupya jamA kare Ara AllAhara pathe tA vyaYa kare nA tAderake bhaYAvaha zAstira susaMvAda dAo|

yedina jAhAnnAmera Agune tA uttapta karA have Ara tA diYe tAdera kapAle, pArzvadeze o piThe dAga deYA have, (Ara tAderake valA have) ‘eTA hala, yA tomarA nijedera janya stupIkRta karechile, kAjei yA jamA karachile tAra svAda grahaNa kara|’

AsamAna-yamIna sRSTira dina thekei AllAhara kitAve (lauha mAhaphuje) mAsagulora saMkhyA hala vAra| tAra madhye cAraTi niSiddha mAsa| eTA hala supratiSThita dvIna| kAjei ai samaYera madhye nijedera upara yulama karo nA| muzarikadera viruddhe sarvAtmakabhAve yuddha kara, yemana tArA tomAdera viruddhe sarvAtmakabhAve yuddha kare| jene rekha, AllAha avazyai muttAkIdera saGge Achena|

niSiddha mAsake pichiYe deYA kupharIra upara Areka kupharI kAja, yA dvArA kAphiraderake pathabhraSTa karA haYa| eka vachara tArA ekaTi mAsake hAlAla kare, Areka vachara ai mAsaTike hArAma kare yAte AllAhara hArAma karA mAsagulora saMkhyA pUrNa karA yAYa| ebhAve tArA AllAhara hArAma karA mAsaguloke hAlAla kare neYa| tAdera khArApa kAjagulo tAdera kAche AnandadAYaka| AllAha kAphira sampradAYake saThika patha dekhAna nA|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera haYeche kI ye, yakhana tomAderake AllAhara pathe vera haoYAra nirdeza deYA haYa takhana tomarA Aro jore mATi kAmar3e dhara| tomarA ki AkherAtera sthale duniYAra jIvanakei vezi pachanda kara? AkherAtera tulanAYa pArthiva jIvanera bhoga sAmagrI to ati sAmAnya|

tomarA yadi yuddhAbhiyAne vera nA hao, tAhale tomAderake bhaYAvaha zAsti deYA have, Ara tomAdera sthale anya sampradAYake AnA have (athaca) tomarA tA~ra konai kSati karate pArave nA| AllAha sakala viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

yadi tomarA tAke [arthAt rasUla (sA.)-ke] sAhAyya nA kara (tAte konai paroYA nei) kAraNa AllAha to tAke sei samaYa sAhAyya karechena yakhana kAphirarA tAke vera kare diYechila, se chila du’janera dvitIYajana yakhana tArA du’jana guhAra madhye chila, yakhana se tAra saGgIke valachila, ‘cintA karo nA, AllAha AmAdera saGge Achena’| takhana AllAha tAra prati tA~ra prazAnti varSaNa karalena Ara tAke emana senAvAhinI diYe zaktizAlI karalena tomarA yA dekhate pAoni, Ara tini kAphiradera mukhera vulike gabhIra nIce phele dilena| Ara AllAhara vANIi raYeche sarvocca| AllAha halena pravala parAkrAnta, mahAvijJAnI|

yuddhAbhiyAne veriYe par3a, avasthA hAlakAi hoka Ara bhArIi hoka (astra kama thAkuka Ara vezi thAkuka) Ara AllAhara rAstAYa tomAdera mAla diYe Ara tomAdera jAna diYe jihAda kara, eTAi tomAdera janya sarvottama, tomarA yadi jAnate!

duniYAvI kona svArtha thAkale Ara yAtrA sahaja hale tArA avazyai tomAra sAthe yeta| kintu patha tAdera kAche dIrgha o bhArI mane haYeche| acirei tArA AllAhara nAme halapha kare valave, ‘AmarA yadi pAratAma tAhale avazyai tomAdera saGge vera hatAma|’ Asale tArA nijerAi nijederake dhvaMsa karache, Ara AllAha jAnena ye, tArA avazyai mithyevAdI|
AllAha tomAke mApha karuna| kArA satya valeche tA spaSTa nA hatei Ara mithyAvAdIderake tumi nA cinei kena tumi tAderake avyAhati diYe dile?

yArA AllAhaYa o zeSa dine vizvAsa kare tArA tAdera mAla diYe Ara jAna diYe jihAda karA theke avyAhati pAoYAra janya tomAra kAche anumati prArthanA kare nA| muttAkIdera samparke AllAha khuvai avagata Achena|
tomAra kAche avyAhati prArthanA tArAi kare yArA AllAh o zeSa divase vizvAsa kare nA, yAdera antara sandehapUrNa, kAjei tArA tAdera sandehera madhye ghurapAka khAcche|

(yuddhAbhiyAne) vera haoYAra tAdera yadi icchei thAkata tave tArA sejanya avazyai prasttati nita| kintu tAdera abhiyAne gamanai AllAhara pachanda naYa, kAjei tini tAderake pazcAte phele rAkhena Ara tAderake valA haYa, ‘yArA (niskriYa haYe) vase thAke tAdera sAthe vase thAka’|

tArA yadi tomAdera saGge vera hata tAhale vizRGkhalA chAr3A Ara kichui vAr3Ata nA Ara tomAdera mAjhe phitanA sRSTira uddezye tomAdera mAjhe chuTAchuTi karata, Ara tomAdera mAjhe tAdera kathA zunAra loka Ache| AllAha yAlimadera samparke khuva bhAlabhAvei avahita Achena|
Ageo tArA phitanA sRSTi karate ceYeche Ara tomAra aneka kAja naSTa kareche yatakSaNa nA prakRta satya ese hAjira hala Ara AllAhara vidhAna prakAzita haYe gela yadio ete tArA chila nAkhoza|

tAdera mAjhe emana loka Ache yArA vale, ‘AmAke avyAhati dina, AmAke parIkSAYa phelavena nA|’ jene rekha, tArA to phitanAte par3ei Ache| vastutaH jAhAnnAma kAphiraderake cAradika theke ghirei rekheche|
tomAra maGgala hale tA tAderake manokaSTa deYa, Ara tomAra upara vipada Asale tArA khuzira saGge e kathA valate valate sare par3e ye, ‘AmarA Agei sAvadhAnatA avalamvana karechilAma|’
vale dAo, ‘AllAha AmAdera janya yA nirdiSTa kare diYechena tAchAr3A anya kichui AmAdera ghaTave nA, tinii AmAdera rakSaka, Ara AllAhara uparai mu’minadera bharasA karA darakAra|’

vala, ‘tomarA AmAdera janya ye jinisera apekSA karacha tA du’To bhAlora ekaTi chAr3A Ara kichui nA (zAhAdAta kiMvA vijaYa) Ara AmarA apekSA karachi ejanya ye, AllAha nijei tomAderake zAsti dena athavA AmAdera hAta diYe deYAna| kAjei apekSAYa thAka, AmarA tomAdera sAthe apekSAYa thAkalAma|’
vala, ‘svecchAYa dAna kara Ara anicchAYa, tomAdera theke kakSano tA grahaNa karA have nA; tomarA hale eka phAsika sampradAYa|’

tAdera kAcha theke artha sAhAyya grahaNa niSiddha karAra kAraNa e chAr3A Ara kichu naYa ye tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake asvIkAra kare, salAte Asale Ase zaithilyabhare Ara dAna karaleo kare anicchA niYe|
kAjei tAdera dhana-sampatti Ara santAna-santati yena tomAra cokha dhA~dhiYe nA deYa, osava diYei AllAha duniYAte oderake zAsti dite cAna Ara kAphira avasthAtei yena tAdera jAna vAhira haYa|
tArA AllAhara nAme kasama kare vale ye, tArA tomAderai madhyera loka, tArA kakSano tomAdera madhyera loka naYa, prakRtapakSe tArA bhIta-santrasta loka|
tArA pAliYe giYe AzraYa neYAra jAYagA pele kiMvA giriguhA vA Dhuke thAkAra mata jAYagA pele sekhAnei tArA kSipragatite chuTe yeta|
tAdera madhye emana loka Ache yArA sadAkvAha (vaNTanera) vyApAre tomAra prati doSAropa kare, tAttheke deYA hale khuzi haYa, Ara tAttheke nA deYA hale sAthe sAthe kSuvdha haYe par3e|

AllAha o tA~ra rasUla tAderake yA diYechena tArA yadi tAte santuSTa thAkata Ara valata, ‘AmAdera janya AllAhai yatheSTa, acirei AllAha anugraha kare AmAderake divena Ara tA~ra rasUlao, AmarA AzA bharasA niYe AllAhara dikei ceYe thAki|’

sadAkvAha hala phakIra, misakIna o tatsaMzliSTa karmacArI o yAdera mana jaYa karA uddezya tAdera janya, dAsamukti o RNagrastadera janya, AllAhara pathe (vyaYera janya) Ara musAphirera janya| eTA AllAha kartRka nirdhArita pharaya| Ara AllAha halena sarvajJa, mahAvijJAnI|

tAdera mAjhe emana lokao Ache yArA nAvIke kaSTa deYa Ara vale tini kAna kathA zunena| vala, ‘tomAdera yAte bhAlo Ache se tAi zone’| se AllAhaYa vizvAsa rAkhe, Ara mu’minaderakeo vizvAsa kare, Ara tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche tAdera janya rahamata| aparapakSe AllAhara rasUlake yArA kaSTa deYa tAdera janya raYeche bhaYAvaha ‘AyAva|
tomAderake khuzi karAra janya tArA tomAdera sAmane AllAhara nAme kasama kare| tArA yadi mu’mina haYe thAke tave kAuke khuzi karate cAile AllAha o tA~ra rasUlai era savaceYe vezi hakadAra|
tArA ki jAne nA ye, ye vyakti AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera virodhitA kare tAra janya Ache jAhAnnAmera Aguna yekhAne se have cirasthAYI? Ara eTA khuvai lAJchanAra vyApAra|
munAphikarA bhaYa pAYa tAdera manera kathA prakAza kare tAdera vyApAre kona sUrAha nAyila haYe yAYa nAki| vala, ‘ThATTA karate thAka, tomarA ye vyApAre bhaYa pAo, AllAha tA prakAza kare divena’|
tAderake jijJesa karale tArA jora diYei valave, ‘AmarA hAsya rasa Ara khela-tAmAzA karachilAma|’ vala, ‘AllAha, tA~ra AYAta o tA~ra rasUlake niYe tomarA vidrUpa karachile?’
oyara pezera ceSTA karo nA, ImAna AnAra para tomarA kupharI karecha| tomAdera madhyekAra kona dalake kSamA karaleo anyaderake zAsti deva, kAraNa tArA aparAdhI|

munAphika puruSa Ara munAphika nArI sava eka rakama, tArA anyAYa kAjera nirdeza deYa Ara sat kAja karate niSedha kare, (AllAhara pathe vyaYa karAra vyApAre) hAta guTiYe rAkhe, tArA AllAhake bhule geche, tAi tinio tAderake bhule gechena| munAphikarAi to phAsika|

AllAha munAphika puruSa, munAphika nArI o kAphiradera janya jAhAnnAmera Agunera oYA‘dA diYechena, tAte tArA ciradina thAkave, tA-i tAdera janya yatheSTa| tAdera upara Ache AllAhara abhizApa, Ara Ache tAdera janya sthAYI ‘AyAva|

(tomAdera kAja-kAravAra) tomAdera Agera lokedera matai, yArA chila tomAdera ceYe adhika zaktira adhikArI, Ara dhana-mAla Ara santAna-santatiteo tomAdera ceYe adhika samRddhizAlI, tAdera prApya aMza tArA bhoga kare geche, ekhana tomarAo tomAdera prApya aMza bhoga kara yemana tomAdera Agera lokerA tAdera prApya aMza bhoga kareche, Ara tomarA anarthaka kathAvArtAYa lipta Acha yemana tArA anarthaka kathAvArtAYa lipta chila, erAi hala tArA duniYA o AkherAte yAdera kAja-karma nisphala haYe geche, Ara tArAi kSatigrasta|

tAdera kAche ki tAdera Agera lokadera saMvAda Aseni, nUhera jAti, ‘Ada, sAmUda, ivrAhImera sampradAYa evaM mAdYyAnera adhivAsIvRnda Ara ulTe deYA nagarasamUhera? tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa spaSTa nidarzana niYe esechila, AllAha tAdera upara yulama karenani, Asale (tArAi tAdera anyAYa kAryakalApera mAdhyame) nijedera AtmAra upara yulama karechila|

mu’mina puruSa Ara mu’mina nArI paraspara parasparera vandhu, tArA satkAjera nirdeza deYa, anyAYa kAja theke niSedha kare, nAmAya kvAYima kare, yAkAta deYa, AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kare| tAdera pratii AllAha karuNA pradarzana karavena| AllAha to pravala parAkrAnta, mahA prajJAvAna|

mu’mina puruSa Ara mu’mina nArIra janya AllAha aGgIkAra karechena jAnnAtera yAra nimnadeza diYe jharNAdhArA pravAhita, tAte tArA ciradina thAkave, Ara jAnnAte cirasthAYI uttama vAsagRhera; Ara savaceYe var3a (yA tArA lAbha karave tA) hala AllAhara santuSTi| eTAi hala virATa sAphalya|
he nAvI! kAphira o munAphikadera viruddhe yuddha kara, tAdera prati kaThoratA avalamvana kara, tAdera vAsasthAna hala jAhAnnAma, Ara tA katai nA nikRSTa AzraYasthala!

tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha kare vale ye tArA (anyAYa) kichu valeni, kintu tArA to kupharI kathA valeche Ara isalAma grahaNa karAra parao kupharI kareche| tArA Sar3ayantra karechila kintu tAte saphala haYani, tAdera e pratizodha spRhAra kAraNa echAr3A Ara kichu chila nA ye AllAha karuNAvazataH o tA~ra rasUla tAderake sampadazAlI kare diYechena| ekhana yadi tArA anuzocanAbhare e patha theke phire Ase tave tA tAdera janyai kalyANakara| Ara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tave AllAha tAderake duniYA o AkherAte bhaYAvaha zAsti divena| pRthivIte rakSaka Ara sAhAyyakArI hiseve kAuke tArA pAve nA|
tAdera madhyekAra kichuloka AllAhara saGge oYA‘dA karechila, ‘yadi tini AmAderake tA~ra anugraha hate dAna karena tave AmarA avazyai dAna karava Ara avazyai sat lokadera madhye zAmila thAkava|’
ataHpara AllAha yakhana tAderake svIYa karuNAra dAne dhanya karalena, takhana tArA dAna karAra vyApAre kArpaNya karala Ara ve-paroYAbhAve mukha phiriYe nila|
pariNAme AllAhara saGge kRta tAdera oYAdA bhaGgera kAraNe evaM mithyAcAre lipta thAkAra kAraNe tAdera antare munAphikI vaddhamUla kare dilena; ai dina paryanta yedina tArA tA~ra sAthe sAkSAt karave|
tArA ki jAne nA ye, AllAha tAdera gopana kathAvArtA Ara gopana parAmarza samparke avahita Achena Ara AllAha to yAvatIYa adRzya samparke savaceYe vezi avagata Achena|

mu’minadera madhye yArA mukta haste dAna kare, tAderake yArA doSAropa kare Ara sImAhIna kaSTe dAnakArIderake yArA vidrUpa kare AllAha tAderake javAve vidrUpa karena Ara tAdera janya raYeche bhaYAvaha zAsti|

tumi tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kara vA nA kara (ubhaYai samAna), tumi tAdera janya sattara vAra kSamA prArthanA karaleo AllAha kakSano tAderake kSamA karavena nA| eTA ejanya ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera sAthe kuphurI kareche| Ara AllAha phAsika lokaderake saThika patha pradarzana karena nA|

(tAvuka abhiyAne) yArA pichane theke giYechila tArA rasUlera virodhitAYa vase thAkAtei Ananda prakAza karechila Ara tAdera dhana-sampada o jAna diYe AllAhara pathe jihAda karate tArA apachanda karechila| tArA valechila, ‘garamera madhye abhiyAne verio nA’| vala, ‘jAhAnnAmera Agunai tApe pracanDatama’| tArA yadi vujhata!
tArA yena kama hAse evaM vezI kA~de, tArA ye (pApa) kAmAi karache tAra phalasvarUpa|
