AllAha yadi tomAke tAdera kona dalera kAche phiriYe niYe Asena Ara yadi tArA (tomAra saGge) abhiyAne vera havAra janya anumati prArthanA kare takhana valave, ‘AmAra sAthe kakSano vera hate pArave nA Ara kakSano AmAra saGge giYe zatrura viruddhe lar3ate pArave nA, tomarA prathamavArei niskriYa haYe vase thAkAkei vezi pachanda kare niYecho, kAjei (ekhana) picha-par3Adera sAthei vase thAka’|

tAdera keu mArA gele tumi kakSano tAdera janya (jAnAyAra) nAmAya par3ave nA, Ara tAdera kavarera pAze danDAYamAna have nA| tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera saGge kuphurI kareche Ara vidrohI pApAcArI avasthAYa tAdera mRtyu haYeche|
tAdera mAladhana Ara santAna-santati tomAra yena cokha dhA~dhiYe nA deYa, duniYAte AllAha se sava diYei tAderake zAsti deYAra icche karena Ara kAphira avasthAYa yena tAdera prANavAYu nirgata haYa|

yakhana kona sUrAha avatIrNa karA haYa ye, ‘AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana kara Ara tA~ra rasUlera saGge theke jihAda kara’- takhana zakti-sAmarthya sampanna lokerA tomAra nikaTa avyAhati prArthanA kare Ara vale, ‘AmAderake rehAi dina, yArA (ghare) vase thAke AmarA tAdera saGgei thAkava|’
tArA pichane (ghare vase) thAkA strIlokadera sAthe thAkAkei pachanda kare, tAdera hRdaYake sIla kare deYA haYeche, kAjei tArA kichui vujhate pAre nA|
kintu rasUla Ara tAra sAthe yArA ImAna eneche tArA tAdera mAla diYe evaM jAna diYe jihAda kare| yAvatIYa kalyANa to tAderai janya| saphalakAma to tArAi|
AllAha tAdera janya jAnnAta prastuta kare rekhechena yAra nimnadeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita yAte tArA cirakAla thAkave| eTAi hala virATa saphalatA|

veduinadera madhyeo ojara-Apatti pezakArIrA ese avyAhatira Avedana jAnAlo| yArA (nijedera ImAna thAkAra vyApAre) AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera nikaTa mithyA valechila tArAo pichane raYe gela| tAdera (arthAt veduinadera) madhye yArA kuphurI kareche zIghrai eka bhaYaGkara ‘AyAva tAderake pAkar3Ao karave|

durvalera upara, pIr3itera upara Ara vyaYa karAra mata kona samvala yAdera nei tAdera upara kona abhiyoga nei, yadi tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati vizvasta haYe thAke| sat karmaparAYaNadera viruddhe abhiyoga utthApana karAra kona suyoga nei, Ara AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tAdera viruddheo kona abhiyoga nei yArA tomAra kAche yakhana vAhana cAoYAra janya esechila takhana tumi valechile, ‘Ami to tomAdera janya kona vAhana pAcchi nA’| takhana tArA phire gela, Ara se samaYa tAdera cokha theke azru jhare par3achila- e duHkhe ye, vyaYa vahana karAra mata kona kichu tAdera chila nA|

abhiyoga to tAdera viruddhe yArA sampadazAlI haoYA sattveo (yuddhe yAoYA hate) tomAra kAche avyAhati prArthanA karechila, yArA ghare vasA thAkA (strI lokadera) saGge thAkatei pachanda karechila, AllAha tAdera hRdaYake sIla kare diYechena Ara ejanya (kise nijedera kalyANa Ache Ara kise akalyANa) tA tArA jAne nA|

tomarA tAdera kAche (yuddha zeSe) phire Asale tArA tomAdera kAche ojara peza karave| vala- ojara peza karo nA, tomAderake AmarA kakSano vizvAsa karava nA| AllAha tomAdera khavara AmAdera kAche jAniYe diYechena| AllAha o tA~ra rasUla avazyai tomAdera kAjakarmera prati dRSTi rAkhavena| ataHpara dRzya o adRzya samparke yini jJAta tA~ra kAche tomAderake phiriYe neYA have, ataHpara tomarA yA karate se samparke tini tomAdera jAniYe divena|

tomarA tAdera kAche phire Asale tArA tomAdera nikaTa AllAhara nAme zapatha karave yAte tomarA tAderake upekSA kara| kAjei tomarA tAderake upekSA kara, tArA apavitra, tAdera vAsasthAna jAhAnnAma, tArA yA kareche eTAi tAra nyAyya prApya|
tArA tomAdera kAche zapatha karave yAte tomarA tAdera upara khuzi haYe yAo, kintu tomarA tAdera upara khuzi haleo, AllAha avAdhya sampradAYera prati santuSTa havena nA|

veduIna AravarA kuphurI Ara munAphikIte savaceYe kaThora, Ara AllAha tA~ra rasUlera prati yA avatIrNa karechena tAra sImArekhAra vyApAre ajJa thAkAra tArA adhika upayukta, Ara AllAha sarvajJa, mahA prajJAvAna|

kataka veduIna yA tArA AllAhara pathe vyaYa kare tAke jarimAnA vale gaNya kare Ara tomAdera duHkha musivatera janya apekSA karate thAke, mandera cakra tAderakei ghire dharuka| Ara AllAha to sava kichui zunena, sava kichu jAnena|

kataka veduIna AllAhate o zeSa divase vizvAsa kare Ara tArA yA AllAhara pathe vyaYa kare tAke tArA AllAhara naikaTya o rasUlera du‘A lAbhera mAdhyama mane kare, satyii tA tAdera (AllAhara) naikaTya lAbhera mAdhyama, acirei AllAha tAderake tA~ra rahamAtera madhye praviSTa karavena, avazyai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|

muhAjira o AnasAradera madhye yArA prathama sArira agraNI Ara yArA tAderake yAvatIYa satkarme anusaraNa kareche, AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa Ara tArAo tA~ra prati santuSTa, tAdera janya tini prastuta kare rekhechena jAnnAta yAra taladeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| eTAi hala mahAna saphalatA|

tomAdera catuSpArzve kataka veduIna hala munAphika, Ara mAdInAvAsIdera keu keu munAphikIte anar3ha, tumi tAderake cena nA, Ami tAderake cini, Ami tAderake dviguNa zAsti deva, (kSudhA vA nihata haoYA evaM kavarera zAsti) ataHpara tAderake mahA zAstira pAne phiriYe AnA have|

Ara anya kataka loka tAdera aparAdha svIkAra kareche, tArA ekaTi sat kAjera sAthe ArekaTi manda kAjake mizrita kareche, AzA karA yAYa AllAha tAdera tAovA kavula karavena, avazyai AllAha ati kSamAzIla, atIva daYAlu|

tAdera sampada theke sadAkAha grahaNa karave yAte tA diYe tAderake pavitra o parizuddha karate pAra| tumi tAdera janya du‘A karave, vastutaH tomAra du‘A tAdera janya svastidAYaka, Ara AllAha savakichu zonena sava kichu jAnena|
tArA ki jAne nA ye, AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera (anuzocanApUrNa) kSamAprArthanA kavula kare thAkena Ara sadAkAha grahaNa karena| Ara AllAhai to tAovAha kavUlakArI, ati daYAlu|

vala, tomarA Amala karate thAka| acirei AllAha tomAdera AmAlera prati lakSya rAkhavena evaM tA~ra rasUla o mu’minagaNao (lakSya rAkhave), Ara acirei tomAderake dRzya o adRzyera parijJAtAra dike phiriYe AnA have, Ara tini takhana tomarA ye Amala karachile tA tomAdera jAniYe divena|
Ara kataka AllAhara phAYasAlAra apekSAYa thAkala, tini tAderake zAsti divena athavA tAdera tAovAha kavUla karavena; AllAha sarvajJa, var3ai prajJAmaYa|

Ara yArA mAsajida tairI kareche kSatisAdhana, kuphurI Ara mu’minadera madhye vibheda sRSTira uddezye, Ara ye vyakti itopUrve AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera viruddhe yuddha kareche tAra ghA~Ti hiseve vyavahArera nimitte, tArA avazya avazyai zapatha karave ye, AmAdera uddezya sat vyatIta naYa| AllAha sAkSya dicchena ye tArA avazyai mithyAvAdI|

tumi ora bhitare kakSano dA~r3Ave nA| prathama dina thekei ye mAsajidera bhitti tAkaoYAra upara pratiSThita, tomAra dA~r3Anora janya seTAi adhika upayukta, sekhAne emana sava loka Ache yArA pavitratA lAbha karate bhAlavAse, Ara AllAha pavitratA lAbhakArIdera bhAlavAsena|

ke uttama ye tAra bhitti AllAhabhIrutA o AllAhara santuSTira upara sthApana kare se, nA ai vyakti ye tAra bhitti sthApana kare patanommukha ekaTi dhasera kinArAYa yA tAke niYe jAhAnnAmera Agune dhase par3ave? AllAha yAlimadera saThika pathe paricAlita karena nA|
tAdera tairi gharaTi tAdera antare sadA-sarvadA sandehera udreka kare yAve ye paryanta nA tAdera hRdaYagulo chinna bhinna haYe yAYa| AllAha sarvajJa, mahA prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYa AllAha mu’minadera kAcha theke tAdera jAna Ara mAla kine niYechena kAraNa tAdera janya (vinimaYe) Ache jAnnAta| tArA AllAhara pathe yuddha kare| ataHpara (duzamanadera) hatyA kare evaM (nijerA) nihata haYa| e oYA‘dA tA~ra upara avazyai pAlanIYa yA Ache tAorAta, iJjila o kuraAne| AllAhara ceYe Ara ke vezI nija oYA‘dA pAlanakArI? kAjei tomarA ye kraYa vikraYa sampanna karecha tAra janya Anandita hao, Ara eTAi hala mahAna saphalatA|

tArA anuzocanAbhare (AllAhara dike) pratyAvartanakArI, ‘ivAdAtakArI, AllAhara prazaMsAkArI, royA pAlanakArI, ruku‘kArI, sAjadAhakArI, satkAjera Adeza dAnakArI, anyAYa kAja hate niSedhakArI, AllAhara nirdhArita sImA saMrakSaNakArI, kAjei (esava) mu’minaderake susaMvAda dAo|
nAvI o mu’minadera janya zobhanIYa naYa muzarikadera janya kSamA prArthanA karA, tArA AtmIYa-svajana haleo, yakhana eTA tAdera kAche suspaSTa ye, tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

ivarAhImera pitAra janya kSamA prArthanAra vyApAraTi kevalamAtra tAra pratizruti rakSArthe yA se tAra pitAke diYechila| kintu yakhana eTA tAra kAche spaSTa haYe gela ye, se AllAhara zatru, takhana se tAra theke samparka chinna karala; ivarAhIma chila ati komala hRdaYa, sahiSNu|

AllAha kona sampradAYake hidAYAta dAnera para tAderake gumarAha karena nA ye paryanta nA tini tAdera kAche spaSTa kare dena kon viSaYe tAderake tAkaoYA avalamvana karate have| AllAha halena sarva viSaYe sarvAdhika avahita|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra rAjatva AllAharai, tinii jIvana dAna karena Ara tinii mRtyu ghaTAna| AllAha chAr3A tomAdera nei kona abhibhAvaka, nei kona sAhAyyakArI|

AllAha anugraha karechena nAvIra prati, evaM muhAjira o AnasAradera prati yArA saMkaTakAle tAke anusaraNa karechila| emanaki tAdera madhye kichu lokera antara ve~ke yAoYAra upakrama haoYAra pareo AllAha tAderake kSamA kare diYechilena| tini tAdera prati var3ai snehazIla, var3ai daYAlu|

Ara (tini anugraha karalena) ai tinajanera pratio yArA (tAvukera yuddhe aMzagrahaNa karA theke) pichane theke giYechila [kA‘va ivane mAlika, murArA ivane rAvI‘A o hilAla ivane umAiYyA (rAyi|)] tA~rA anuzocanAra Agune emani dagdhIbhUta haYechilena ye] zeSa paryanta pRthivI tAra pUrNa vistRti niYeo tAdera prati saMkucita haYe giYechila Ara tAdera jIvana durviSaha haYe uThala Ara tArA vujhate pArala ye, AllAha chAr3A tAdera kona AzraYasthala nei tA~ra pathe phire yAoYA vyatIta| ataHpara tini tAdera prati anugraha karalena yAte tArA anuzocanAYa tA~ra dike phire Ase| AllAha atizaYa tAovAha kavUlakArI, var3ai daYAlu|
ohe vizvAsIgaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM satyapanthIdera arntabhukta hao|

mAdInAvAsI o tAra catuSpArzvastha veduInadera janya ucita naYa AllAhara rasUlera (saGga vAda diYe) pechane theke yAoYA Ara nijedera jIvanake tA~ra jIvanera ceYe priYa jJAna karA| kenanA emana kakSano have nA ye, tArA AllAhara pathe tRSNA, daihika kleza o kSudhA bhoga karave, Ara kAphiradera krodha udrekakArI kona padakSepa grahaNa karave Ara zatrudera nikaTa theke kichu lAbha karave Ara tAra vinimaYe tAdera janya kona neka ‘AmAla lekhA have nA (avazyai lekhA have)| nizcaYa AllAha satkarmazIladera pratiphala vinaSTa karena nA|

Ara eTAo have nA ye, tArA kama vA vezI mAla (AllAhara pathe) kharaca karave Ara (jihAde) tArA kona upatyakA atikrama karave athaca tA tAdera nAme lekhA have nA (avazyai lekhA have) yAte AllAha tAderake tAdera kAjera utkRSTa pratidAna dite pArena|

mu’minadera sakalera ekasaGge abhiyAne vera haoYA Thika naYa| tAdera pratyeka dala theke ekaTi aMza kena vera haYa nA yAte tArA dvIna samparke jJAnera anuzIlana karate pAre evaM phire AsAra para tAdera sampradAYake satarka karate pAre yAte tArA (asadAcaraNa) theke virata haYa?
he mu’minagaNa! ye sava kAphira tomAdera nikaTavartI tAdera viruddhe yuddha kara, yAte tArA tomAdera madhye dRr3hatA dekhate pAYa, Ara jene rekha ye, AllAha muttAkIdera saGge Achena|

yakhanai kona sUrAha nAyila haYa takhana tAdera kataka loka (vidrUpa kare) vale- ‘‘ete tomAdera kAra ImAna vRddhi hala?’’(munAphikarA jene rAkhuka) yArAi ImAna eneche tAdera ImAna vRddhi haYa Ara tArA ete Anandita haYa|
Ara yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tAdera nApAkIra upara Aro nApAkI vAr3iYe deYa (pratiTi natuna sUrA), Ara tAdera mRtyu haYa kAphira avasthAYa|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, prati vacharai tAderake ekavAra vA du’vAra parIkSAYa phelA haYa; tArapareo tArA tAovAo kare nA, Ara zikSAo grahaNa kare nA|

yakhanai kona sUrAha nAyila haYa takhanai tArA paraspare cokha cAoYA-cAoYi kare Ara (iGgite jijJesa kare) ‘tomAderake keu dekhache nA to?’’ ataHpara tArA cupisAre sare par3e| AllAha tAdera antarake (satya patha theke) phiriYe diYechena, kenanA tArA emanai eka sampradAYa yArA vujhe nA|

tomAdera madhya thekei tomAdera nikaTa ekajana rasUla esechena, tomAderake yA kichu kaSTa deYa tA tAra nikaTa khuvai kaSTadAYaka| se tomAdera kalyANakAmI, mu’minadera prati karuNAsikta, var3ai daYAlu|
e sattveo yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale vale dAo- AllAhi AmAra janya yatheSTa, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, tA~ra uparai Ami bharasA kari, tini halena mahAna Arazera mAlika|
Alipha-lAma-ra, egulo mahA vijJAnamaYa granthera AYAtasamUha|

mAnuSera kAche ki eTA Azcaryera viSaYa ye, Ami tAderai madhyekAra ekajana lokera kAche oYAhI pAThiYechi ye, lokadera satarka kare dAo, Ara yArA ImAna Ane tAderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janya tAdera pratipAlakera kAche Ache mahA maryAdA, (kintu) kAphirarA vale, ‘e vyakti to prakAzya yAdukara’|

nizcaYai tomAdera pratipAlaka halena AllAha yini AkAzamanDalI Ara pRthivIke chaYa dine sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tini Araze samunnata haYechena| tini yAvatIYa viSaYAdi paricAlanA karena| tA~ra anumati prApti chAr3A supAriza karAra keu nei| inii halena AllAha, tomAdera pratipAlaka| kAjei tomarA tA~rai ‘ivAdAta kara, tomarA ki upadeza grahaNa karave nA?

tA~ra kAchei tomAdera sakalera pratyAvartana| AllAhara oYA‘dA nizcita satya| tini sRSTira sUcanA karena, pare tinii AvAra sRSTi karavena yAte tini- yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche- tAderake pUrNa inasAphera sAthe pratidAna dite pArena| Ara yArA kuphurI kareche tAdera janya Ache ati uttaptapAnIYa o vedanA dAYaka zAsti, yehetu tArA satya pratyAkhyAna karata|

tini sUryake karechena tejodIpta, Ara candrake karechena AlokamaYa Ara tAra (hrAsa vRddhira) mAnayilasamUha saThikabhAve nirdhAraNa karechena yAte tomarA vatsara guNe (samaYera) hisAva rAkhate pAra| AllAha eTA anarthaka sRSTi karenani, tini nidarzanaguloke vizadabhAve varNanA karena jJAnI sampradAYera janya|
nizcaYai rAta o dinera Avartane, Ara AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra mAjhe AllAha yA sRSTi karechena tAte muttAkI sampradAYera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
yArA AmAra saGge sAkSAt lAbhera AzA rAkhe nA, evaM duniYAra jIvana niYei santuSTa thAke Ara tAtei nizcinta haYa evaM yArA AmAra nidarzanagulo hate ekevAre udAsIna,
tAdera AvAsa hala jAhAnnAma tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe|
yArA ImAna Ane Ara sat ‘AmAla kare, tAdera pratipAlaka tAdera ImAnera vadaulate tAderake satpathe paricAlita karavena| ni‘mAtarAji dvArA paripUrNa jAnnAte, tAdera pAdadeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita have|

tAra bhitare tAdera du’A have, ‘‘pavitra tumi he AllAha’’| Ara sekhAne tAdera abhivAdana have ‘‘zAnti’’, Ara tAdera du‘Ara sarvazeSa kathA have ‘‘samasta prazaMsA jagatsamUhera pratipAlaka AllAhara janya’’|

mAnuSera apakarmera zAsti hiseve AllAha yadi mAnuSera akalyANa karAra vyApAre drutatA avalamvana karatena yataTA drutatAra saGge tArA (duniYAra) kalyANa pete cAYa, tave tAdera kAja karAra avakAza kavei nA khatama kare deYA hata, (kintu AllAha tA karena nA)| kAjei yArA AmAra sAkSAtera AzA rAkhe nA, tAderake Ami tAdera avAdhyatAYa dizehArA haYe ghure ver3Anora avakAza dei|

mAnuSake yakhana duHkha kleza sparza kare, takhana tArA zuYe, vase o dA~r3iYe AmAke DAkate thAke| ataHpara yakhana Ami tAra duHkha kleza dUra kare dei, takhana se emanabhAve cale yAYa, mane haYa yena tAke duHkha-kleza sparza karAra kAraNe se AmAke kakhanai DAkeni| ebhAvei yArA sImAlaGghana kare tAdera janya tAdera kAjakarmaguloke cAkacikyamaYa vAniYe deYA haYeche|

tomAdera pUrvekAra vahu janagoSThIke Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi yakhana tArA vAr3AvAr3ite lipta haYechila, tAdera kAche rasUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzanasamUha niYe esechila, kintu tArA Adau ImAna Aneni| ebhAvei Ami aparAdhIderake (pApera) pratidAna diYe thAki|
ataHpara tAdera para Ami tomAderake pRthivIte tAdera sthalAbhiSikta karechi eTA dekhAra janya ye, tomarA kI rakama ‘AmAla kara|

yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAtagulo tAdera kAche paThita haYa, takhana yArA AmAra sAkSAtera AzA rAkhe nA tArA vale, ‘eTA vAde anya ArekaTA kuraAna Ana kiMvA oTAke vadalAo’| vala, ‘‘AmAra nijera icchemata oTA vadalAno AmAra kAja naYa, AmAra kAche yA oYAhI karA haYa Ami kevala seTArai anusaraNa kare thAki| Ami AmAra pratipAlakera avAdhyatA karale eka ati var3a vibhISikAra dine Ami zAstira bhaYa kari’’|

vala, ‘‘AllAhara icche hale Ami tomAdera kAche tA tilAoYAta karatAma nA, Ara AllAhao tomAderake tAra khavara ditena nA| Ami to era pUrve ekaTA dIrgha samaYa tomAdera mAjhe ativAhita karechi, tA sattveo tomarA ki vujhave nA?
tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke hate pAre ye mithyA racanA ka’re AllAhara nAme cAliYe deYa athavA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake mithyA vale ghoSaNA kare; nizcitai aparAdhIrA sAphalya lAbha karate pAre nA|

Ara tArA AllAhake cher3e ‘ivAdAta kare emana kichura yA nA pAre tAdera kona kSati karate, Ara nA pAre kona upakAra karate| Ara tArA vale, ‘‘ogulo AmAdera janya AllAhara kAche supArizakArI’’| vala, ‘‘tomarA ki AllAhake emana kichura saMvAda dite cAo, yA tini avagata nana, nA AkAzamanDalIte Ara nA yamIne? mahAna pavitra tini, tomarA yA kichuke tA~ra zarIka gaNya kara tAttheke tini vahu Urdhve|

mAnuSa chila eka ummatabhukta| pare tArA matabheda sRSTi karala| tomAra pratipAlaka pUrvei yadi siddhAnta grahaNa nA karatena, tAhale ye viSaYe tArA matabheda karache tAra mImAMsA avazyai kare deYA hata|

tArA vale, ‘‘tA~ra pratipAlakera pakSa theke tA~ra kAche kona nidarzana avatIrNa haYa nA kena?’’ edera javAve vale dAo, ‘‘adRzya jagatera ekacchatra mAlika halena AllAha, kAjei tomarA apekSA kara (evaM bhaviSyate kI haYa dekha), Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSamAna thAkalAma|

duHkha kaSTa mAnuSake sparza karAra para Ami yakhana tAderake anugraha AsvAdana karate dei, takhana tArA AmAra nidarzanagulora vyApAre kuTa kauzalera AzraYa neYa| vala, ‘kauzala grahaNe AllAha halena kSipragatisampanna, tomarA ye sava kUTacAla grahaNa kara AmAra pherezatAgaNa tA lipivaddha kare rAkhe|’

tini tomAderake jale o sthale bhramaNa karAna| emanaki yakhana tomarA naukAYa ArohaNa kare anukUla hAoYAra tAle Amoda AhalAde saphara karate thAka, takhana jhar3o hAoYA AghAta hAne Ara cAradika theke taraGga dheYe Ase, Ara tArA mane kare ye, tArA taraGgamAlAYa pariveSTita haYe par3eche| takhana tArA vizuddha Anugatye AllAhake Deke vale, ‘tumi yadi ettheke AmAderake paritrANa dAo tAhale avazya avazyai AmarA zukaragujAra vAndAdera antarbhukta haYe yAva|’

ataHpara yemanai tini tAderake vA~ciYe dena, takhana tArA anyAYabhAve yamIne vidrohI AcaraNa zuru kare deYa| ohe mAnuSa! tomAdera e vidroha to (prakRtapakSe) tomAdera nijederai vipakSe, asthAYI duniYAra Ananda sAmagrI mAtra| ataHpara AmAra kAchei tomAdera pratyAvartana have, takhana Ami tomAderake jAniYe deva tomarA yA kichu karachile|

duniYAra jIvanera dRSTAnta hacche yemana AkAza theke Ami pAni varSaNa kari yAra saMsparze ghana sanniviSTa bhUmi jAta udbhida utpanna haYa| yAttheke bhakSaNa kare mAnuSa Ara jIvajantu| avazeSe yamIna yakhana sonAlIrUpa dhAraNa kare Ara zobhAmanDita haYa, Ara tAra mAlikagaNa bhAvate thAke ye, ogulo tAdera hAtera muThoYa takhana rAtrikAle kiMvA dinera velA AmAra nirdeza ese par3e Ara Ami ogulo emanabhAve dhvaMsa kare dei mane haYa yena gatakAla sekhAne kona kichui chila nA| ebhAve Ami AmAra nidarzanaguloke vizadabhAve varNanA kari ai sampradAYera janya yArA cintAbhAvanA kare vujhate ceSTA kare|
AllAha tomAderake zAntira kendrabhUmira dike AhavAna jAnAna Ara yAke tini cAna saThika pathe paricAlita karena|

yArA kalyANakara kAja kare tAdera janya raYeche kalyANa evaM Aro atirikta (puraskAra), kalaMka o lAJchanA tAdera mukhamanDalake malina karave nA, tArAi hala jAnnAtera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA thAkave cirakAla|

pakSAntare yArA manda kAja kare, tArA tAdera manda kAjera zAsti pAve kAjera anupAte evaM apamAna tAderake AcchAdita karave, AllAhara (zAsti) hate keui tAderake rakSA karate pArave nA- yena tAdera mukhamanDalake AcchAdita kare deYA haYeche gAr3ha andhakAra rAtrira Tukaro diYe; tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, tArA tAra madhye cirakAla thAkave|

sedina Ami tAdera savAike ekatrita kare yArA ziraka karechila tAderake valava, ‘‘tomarA evaM tomarA yAderake zarIka karechile tArA nija nija jAYagAYa thAka|’’ Ami tAderake paraspara theke pRthaka kare deva Ara tArA yAderake zarIka karechila tArA valave, ‘tomarA to AmAdera ‘ivAdAta karate nA|’
ekhana AllAhai AmAdera Ara tomAdera mAjhe sAkSI hiseve yatheSTa, AmarA tomAdera ‘ivAdAtera vyApAre sampUrNa vekhavara chilAma|’

sekhAne pratiTi AtmA tAra pUrvakRta kAja (era phalAphala) dekhate pAve| tAderake tAdera prakRta abhibhAvaka AllAhara nikaTa phiriYe AnA have, Ara tAdera racita sakala mithyA tAdera theke vilIna haYe yAve|

tAdera jijJesa kara, ‘AkAza Ara yamIna hate ke tAdera jIvikAra vyavasthA kare? kiMvA zravaNazakti o darzanazakti kAra mAlikAnAdhIna? Ara mRta theke jIvitake ke vera karena Ara ke mRtake jIvita theke vera karena? yAvatIYa viSaYera zAsana o niYantraNa kAra adhInastha?’ tArA vale uThave, ‘‘AllAha’’| tAhale tAderake vala, ‘tavuo tomarA tAkvaoYAha avalamvana karave nA?’
tinii AllAha, tomAdera prakRta pratipAlaka| prakRta satyera para gumArAhI chAr3A Ara kI thAkate pAre? tomAderake konadike ghurAno hacche?
ebhAve satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera vyApAre tomAra pratipAlakera kathA satya sAvyasta haYeche ye, tArA ImAna Anave nA|

vala ‘‘tomarA yAderake zarIka kara tAdera madhye emana keu Ache ki ye sRSTira sUcanA kare evaM tAra punarAvartanao ghaTAte pAre?’’ vala ‘‘AllAhai sRSTira sUcanA karena evaM tAra punarAvartana ghaTAna|’’ tAhale kIbhAve tomarA vicyuta haYe yAccha (satya patha theke)?

vala ‘‘tomarA yAderake zarIka kara tAdera keu ki satyera patha dekhAte pAre?’’ vala, ‘AllAhai satyera patha dekhAna|’ tave yini satya pathe paricAlita karena Anugatya lAbhera tinii vezi hAkadAra, nA ki sei yAke patha nA dekhAle patha pAYa nA? tomAdera haYeche kI? tomarA kIbhAve siddhAnta niccha?
tAdera adhikAMzai kevala dhAraNAra anusaraNa kare, satyera mukAvAlAYa dhAraNA kona kAje Ase nA| tomarA yA kara se samparke AllAha sarvAdhika avagata|

e kuraAna AllAha chAr3A anya kAro racita naYa| uparantu tA pUrve yA nAyila haYechila tAra samarthaka Ara vistArita vyAkhyAkRta kitAva, ete kona sandeha nei, jagatsamUhera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate (nAyilakRta)|

tArA ki e kathA vale ye, se [arthAt muhAmmAda (sA.)] eTA racanA kareche? vala, tAhale tomarAo era mata ekaTA sUrAha (racanA kare) niYe eso Ara AllAhake vAda diYe yAke pAra tAke Deke nAo yadi tomarA satyavAdI haYe thAka [ye muhAmmAda (sAH)-i tA racanA karechena]|

varaM ye viSaYa tAdera jJAnera sImAra madhye Ase nA, Ara yAra pariNAma phala ekhanao upasthita haYani tA tArA asvIkAra kare| ebhAve tAdera pUrvavartI lokerAo mithyA mane ka’re amAnya karechila| ekhana dekha, ei yAlimadera pariNati kI haYeche!
edera kichu loka ete vizvAsa kare Ara kataka ete vizvAsa kare nA| tomAra pratipAlaka ei phAsAda sRSTikArI lokadera samparke savaceYe vezi avahita|

yadi tArA tomAke mithyA jene amAnya ka’re tAhale vala, ‘AmAra kAjera janya Ami dAYI, Ara tomAdera kAjera janya tomarA dAYI, Ami yA kari tAra dAYa-dAYitva theke tomarA mukta, Ara tomarA yA kara tAra dAYa-dAYitva theke Ami mukta|’
edera madhye keu keu tomAra kathA zunAra bhAna kare| tAhale tumi ki vadhirake zunAve, tArA nA vujhaleo?
tAdera madhye keu keu tomAra dike tAkAYa, tumi ki andhake patha dekhAve, tArA nA dekhaleo?
avazyai AllAha mAnuSadera prati kona yulama karena nA, kintu mAnuSa nijedera prati yulama ka’re thAke|

ye dina tAderake ekatrita karA have (sedina tArA mane karave ye) dinera eka muhUrtera vezi tArA (duniYAte) avasthAna kareni| tArA parasparake cinate pArave| yArA AllAhara sAkSAtke asvIkAra kare tArA kSatigrasta haYeche Ara tArA kakhanai saThika pathaprApta chila nA|

Ami tAderake ye pariNatira bhaYa dekhiYechi tAra kichu aMza Ami yadi tomAke dekhiYe dei, kiMvA (tAra pUrvei) tomAke yadi uThiYe dei, (avasthA yeTAi hoka nA kena) tAdera pratyAvartana to AmAra kAchei, (sarvopari) tArA yA kichu karache AllAha hacchena tAra sAkSI|
pratyeka jAtira janya (pAThAno haYeche) ekajana rasUla| tAdera rasUla yakhana eseche takhana nyAYaparAYaNatAra saGge tAdera mAjhe phAYasAlA karA haYeche| tAdera prati kona yulama karA haYani|
tArA vale, ‘‘tomarA satyavAdI hale (vala to) ei pratizruti kakhana satya haYe dekhA dive?’’

vala, ‘AllAhara icche vyatIta AmAra nijerao kona kSati vA lAbha karAra kSamatA nei|’ pratyeka sampradAYera janya ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYa nirdhArita Ache| tAdera sei nirdiSTa samaYa cale Asale tArA eka muhUrtao Aga-pAcha karate pArave nA|
vala, ‘tomarA ki cintA kare dekhecha yadi tA~ra ‘AyAva haThAt kare rAte vA dine tomAdera upara ese par3e (tAhale to tomAdera karAra kichui nei) aparAdhIrA tAra konaTA tAr3Ahur3o kare Anate cAYa?
tAhale oTA vAstave ghaTe yAoYAra parai ki tomarA tAte vizvAsa karate cAo? (ghaTe yAoYAra para valA have) ‘ekhana, (vizvAsa karale) eTAra janya tomarA tAr3Ahur3o karachile!’
avazeSe yAlimaderake valA have- ‘sthAYI zAstira svAda grahaNa kara, tomarA yA kichu upArjana karechile tAra pratiphala chAr3A tomAdera Ara kI deYA yete pAre!
tArA tomAra kAche jAnate cAYa (tumi yA valacha) segulo ki prakRtai saThika? vala-‘hA~, AmAra ravera kasama! tA ekavArei satya| tomarA tA vAnacAla karate pArave nA|

yulama kareche emana pratyekei duniYAte yA kichu Ache yadi tA sava tAra hata tave se vinimaYe tA pradAna kare ‘AyAva hate vA~cate cAita| tArA yakhana ‘AyAva pratyakSa karave takhana manera duHkha-tApa gopana karave| nyAYaparAYaNatAra saGge tAdera vyApAre phAYasAlA karA have| tAdera prati kona prakAra yulama karA have nA|
jene rekha, AsamAnasamUha Ara yamIne yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara| jene rekha, AllAhara oYA‘dA satya, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa (e sakala viSaYa) jAne nA|
tini jIvana dAna karena, tinii mRtyu dena, Ara tA~ra dikei tomarA phire yAve|
he mAnuSa! tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa theke tomAdera kAche eseche nAsIhAta Ara tomAdera antare yA Ache tAra nirAmaYa, Ara mu’minadera janya saThika pathera dizA o rahamAta|
vala, AllAhara anugraha o daYAra vadaulate (tA eseche), ejanya tArA Anandita hoka| tArA yA stupIkRta karache tAra ceYe tA (arthAt hidAYAta o rahamAtapUrNa kuraAna) uttama|

vala-tomarA ki bheve dekhecha AllAha ye riyaka tomAdera janya pAThiYechena, tomarA tAra katakaguloke hArAma Ara katakake hAlAla kare niYecha| vala, AllAha ki tomAderake era anumati diYechena? nA tomarA AllAhara upara mithyA apavAda diccha?

yArA AllAhara prati mithyoropa kare, kiYAmAtera dina (AllAha tAdera saGge ye vyavahAra karavena se) samparke tAdera kI dhAraNA? AllAha to mAnuSadera upara var3ai anugrahazIla, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai AllAhara zokara kare nA|

tumi ye avasthAtei thAka nA kena, Ara tumi kuraAna theke yA kichui tilAoYAta kara nA kena, Ara ye ‘AmAlai tomarA kara nA kena, Ami tomAdera upara raYechi pratyakSadarzI, yakhana tomarA tAte pUrNarUpe manoniveza kara| emana aNu parimANa vA tAttheke choTa vA tAttheke var3a vastu nA Ache pRthivIte, Ara nA Ache AsamAne yA tomAra pratipAlakera dRSTira Ar3Ale Ache| tA (lekhA) Ache eka suspaSTa kitAve|
jene rekha! AllAhara vandhudera kona bhaYa nei Ara tArA duHkhitao have nA|
yArA ImAna Ane Ara tAkaoYA avalamvana kare
tAdera janya susaMvAda duniYAra jIvane Ara AkherAteo| AllAhara kathAra kona heraphera haYa nA, eTAi hala virATa sAphalya|
odera kathA yena tomAke duHkha nA deYa, yAvatIYa sammAna AllAharai janya, tini sava kichui zonena, sava kichu jAnena|

jene rekha! yA kichu AsamAnasamUhe Ache Ara yArA yamIne Ache savAi AllAhara| (e avasthAYa) yArA AllAhake vAda diYe (tAdera managar3A) zarIkadera DAke tArA kisera anusaraNa kare? tArA dhAraNA-anumAna chAr3A anya kichurai anusaraNa kare nA, Ara tArA zudhu mithyAi vale|

tinii tomAdera janya rAta vAniYechena yena tomarA tAte zAnti lAbha karate pAra, Ara dina sRSTi karechena (sava kichu) dekhAra janya| avazyai ete nidarzana Ache ai sampradAYera janya yArA (manoyoga diYe) zone|

orA vale-‘‘AllAha putra grahaNa karechena’’| mahAna pavitra tini, tini kAro mukhApekSI nana, AsamAnasamUhe o yamIne yA Ache savai tA~ra mAlikAnAdhIna, (AllAha putra grahaNa karechena) e vyApAre tomAdera kAche kona pramANa nei, tAhale tomarA ki AllAha samparke emana kathA valacha ye viSaYe tomAdera konai jJAna nei?
vala ‘‘yArA AllAha samparke mithye racanA kare, tArA kakSano kalyANa pAve nA|
duniYAte Ache tAdera janya sAmAnya bhogyavastu, ataHpara AmAra kAchei have tAdera pratyAvartana, takhana tAdera kuphurIra kAraNe tAderake Ami kaThina ‘AyAva AsvAdana karAva|

tAderake nUhera kAhinI par3e zonAo| yakhana se tAra sampradAYake valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAra avasthiti Ara AllAhara AYAtasamUha dvArA tomAdera prati AmAra upadeza dAna yadi tomAdera nikaTa asahya mane haYa (tAte AmAra kona paroYA nei) kAraNa Ami bharasA kari AllAhara upara| tomarA tomAdera zarIkaderake niYe sammilitabhAve siddhAnta grahaNa kara, pare tomAdera siddhAntera vyApAre tomAdera mAjhe yena aspaSTatA nA thAke, ataHpara AmAra upara tA kAryakara kara Ara AmAke kona avakAzai dio nA|

Ara yadi tomarA (AmAra AhavAna theke) mukha phiriYe nAo (tAte AmAra kona kSati have nA), Ami to tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAcchi nA, AmAra pArizramika Ache kevala AllAharai nikaTa, AmAke AtmasamarpaNakArIdera madhye zAmila haoYArai Adeza deYA haYeche|

kintu tArA tAke mithye vale amAnya karala| takhana Ami tAke Ara tAra saGge yArA naukAYa chila tAderake rakSA karalAma Ara tAderake (pRthivIte) uttarAdhikArI vAnAlAma, Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithye va’le amAnya karechila tAderake DuviYe mAralAma| ekhana dekha yAderake satarka karA haYechila (tArA satarka nA haoYAYa) tAdera kI pariNAma ghaTechila|

nUhera para Ami rasUladerake tAdera sampradAYera kAche pAThiYechilAma, tArA tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzana niYe esechila| kintu pUrve tArA mithye jene pratyAkhyAna karAYa pare Ara ImAna Anate prastuta haYani| sImAlaGghanakArIdera hRdaYe ebhAvei Ami mohara lAgiYe dei|
tAdera para Ami mUsA o hArUnake AmAra nidarzana sahakAre phira‘Aona o tAra pradhAnadera nikaTa pAThiYechilAma| kintu tArA ahaGkAra kare, tArA chila eka aparAdhI sampradAYa|
ataHpara AmAra nikaTa theke yakhana tAdera kAche prakRta satya ese par3ala, takhana tArA valala, ‘‘eTA to avazyai suspaSTa yAdu’’|
mUsA valala, ‘‘prakRta satya samparke tomarA (e rakama) kathA valacha yakhana tA tomAdera kAche ese geche| eTA ki yAdu? yAdukararA mukti pAve nA|’’

tArA valala, ‘‘tomarA ki AmAderake ai patha theke sariYe deYAra janya esecha AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake ye pathera upara peYechi Ara ejanya ye yamIne tomAdera du’janera prAdhAnya pratiSThita haYa? AmarA tomAdera kathA moTei mene neva nA|’’
phira‘Aona valala, ‘‘sakala pAradarzI yAdukaradera AmAra kAche niYe eso’’|
yAdukararA yakhana ese gela, takhana mUsA tAderake valala, ‘‘nikSepa kara tomarA yA nikSepa karave’’|
tArA yakhana nikSepa karala, takhana mUsA valala, ‘‘tomarA yA niYe esecha tAto yAdu, AllAha ekhanai tA vyartha kare devena, AllAha vizRGkhalAkArIdera kAjake saMzodhana karena nA’’|
AllAha tA~ra vANIra sAhAyye prakRta satyake pratiSThita karavenai, aparAdhIdera kAche tA yatai aprItikara hoka nA kena|

mUsAra upara tAra jAtira madhya hate guTikaYeka loka vyatIta keu ImAna Aneni phira‘Aona o tAra pradhAnadera niryAtanera bhaYe| vAstavikai phira‘Aona duniYAte khuvai uddhata chila, Ara se chila avazyai sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarbhukta|
mUsA valechila, ‘‘he AmAra jAtira lokerA! tomarA yadi AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana kare thAka tAhale tomarA tA~rai upara bharasA kara yadi tomarA AtmasamarpaNakArI hao’’|
takhana tArA valala, ‘‘AmarA AllAhara uparai bharasA kari, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake yAlima jAtira atyAcArera pAtra karo nA,
Ara tomAra anugrahe AmAderake kAphira sampradAYa theke rakSA kara|’’

Ami mUsA Ara tAra bhAiYera prati oYAhI karalAma ye, ‘‘misare tomAdera sampradAYera janya ghara tairi kara Ara tomAdera gharaguloke ‘ivAdAta gRha kara, Ara nAmAya pratiSThA kara evaM mu’minaderake susaMvAda dAo’’|

mUsA valala, ‘‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi phira‘Aona Ara tAra pradhAnaderake e pArthiva jagate cAkacikya Ara dhana sampada dAna karecha Ara era dvArA he AmAdera ravava! tArA mAnuSake tomAra patha theke vicyuta karache, he AmAra pratipAlaka! tAdera sampada dhvaMsa kare dAo, Ara tAdera hRdaYake kaThina kare dAo, yAte tArA bhaYAvaha ‘AyAva dekhAra pUrva paryanta ImAna Anate sakSama nA haYa (yehetu tArA vAra vAra AllAhara nidarzana dekheo satya dvInera zatrutAYa aTala haYe Ache)|
AllAha tA‘AlA javAva dilena, ‘‘tomAdera du’janera du‘A kavUla karA hala, kAjei tomarA majavuta haYe thAka, Ara tomarA kakSano tAdera patha anusaraNa karo nA yArA kichui jAne nA|

Ami vAnI isarAIlake samudra pAra kariYe nilAma Ara phira‘Aona o tAra sainya sAmanta auddhatya o sImAlaGghana ka’re tAdera pechane chuTala, ataHpara yakhana se Duvate zuru karala takhana se valala, ‘Ami ImAna Anachi ye, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei yA~ra prati vAnI isarAIla ImAna eneche, Ara Ami AtmasamarpaNakArIdera antarbhukta|’
‘‘ekhana (ImAna Anacha), Age to amAnya karecha Ara phAsAdakArIdera antarbhukta thekecha|
Aja Ami tomAra dehake rakSA karava yAte tumi tomAra paravartIdera janya nidarzana hate pAra|’ adhikAMza mAnuSai AmAra nidarzanAvalI samparke nizcitai udAsIna|’’

Ami vAnI isarAIlake maryAdApUrNa AvAsasthale pratiSThita karechilAma Ara tAderake uttama riyaka diYechilAma| ataHpara tAdera kAche (AllAhara prerita) saThika jJAna AsAra pUrva paryanta tArA matabheda kareni| tArA ye viSaYe matabheda karechila kiYAmAta divase tomAra pratipAlaka avazyai tA mImAMsA kare divena|

Ami tomAra prati yA avatIrNa karechi tAte yadi tumi sandeha poSaNa kara tAhale tomAra pUrve theke yArA kitAva pATha kare Asache tAderake jijJesa kara| tomAra kAche tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa theke prakRta satya eseche| kAjei tumi kakSano sandeha poSaNakArIdera madhye zAmila haYo nA|
Ara tumi kakSano tAdera madhye zAmila haYo nA yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake mithye jene amAnya kare, tAhale tumi kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe yAve|
tAdera samparke tomAra pratipAlakera vAkya satya pramANita haYeche ye, tArA ImAna Anave nA,
emanaki tAdera kAche pratyekaTi nidarzana Asaleo- ye paryanta nA tArA bhaYAvaha zAsti pratyakSa karave|

emana kona janapadera dRSTAnta Ache ki ye tArA (zAsti dekhAra para) ImAna Anala Ara tAdera ImAna upakAre Asala- ekamAtra iunusera sampradAYa chAr3A? tArA yakhana ImAna Anala, takhana Ami duniYAra jIvane tAdera theke hInatAvyaJjaka ‘AyAva sariYe dilAma, Ara ekaTA nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta tAderake jIvana upabhoga karAra suyoga dilAma|
tomAra pratipAlaka icche karale duniYAra samasta loka avazyai ImAna Anata, tAhale ki tumi ImAna AnAra janya mAnuSadera upara javaradasti karave?
AllAhara anumati vyatireke keu ImAna Anate pArave nA, Ara yArA viveka vuddhi khATAYa nA, AllAha tAdera upara gumarAhI cApiYe dena|
vala ‘‘AsamAnasamUha Ara yamIne yA kichu Ache tAra dike ceYe dekha, yArA ImAna Ane nA tAdera janya nidarzanAvalI Ara bhaYa-bhIti pradarzana kona kAje Ase nA|
tave tArA ki tAdera pUrve ye sava dinagulo ghaTe geche se rakama ghaTA chAr3A anya kichura apekSA karache? vala, ‘‘tAhale apekSA kara, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSamAna thAkalAma|’’
avazeSe Ami AmAra rasUladerake Ara mu’minaderake rakSA kari, ebhAve mu’minaderake rakSA karA AmAra kartavya|

vala, ‘‘he mAnuSa! AmAra dvIna samparke yadi tomAdera kona sandeha thAke tAhale jene rekha, tomarA AllAhake vAda diYe yAra ‘ivAdAta kara, Ami tAdera ‘ivAdAta kari nA, varaM Ami AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kari yini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAna, Ara Ami AdiSTa haYechi mu’minadera antarbhukta haoYAra janya|
Ara AmAke eo Adeza deYA haYeche ye, tumi dvInera dike tomAra mukha pratiSThita kara ekaniSThabhAve, Ara tumi kakSano muzarikadera madhye zAmila haYo nA|
Ara AllAhake vAda diYe AhavAna karo nA emana kichuke yA nA pAre tomAra kona upakAra karate, Ara nA pAre kSati karate; yadi tumi tA kara tAhale tumi yAlimadera madhye zAmila haYe yAve|

AllAha yadi tomAke kaSTa dite cAna tAhale tini chAr3A tA dUra karAra keu nei, Ara AllAha yadi tomAra kalyANa karate cAna, tAhale tA~ra anugraha rada karAra keu nei| tini tA~ra vAndAhadera madhye yAke cAna anugraha diYe dhanya karena| tini var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

vala, ‘‘he mAnuSa! tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAdera kAche prakRta satya ese pau~cheche| ataHpara ye saThika patha avalamvana karave, se nijera kalyANera janyai saThika patha dharave| Ara yArA pathabhraSTa have tArA pathabhraSTa have nijederai kSati karAra janya, Ami tomAdera haYe kAja uddhAra kare deYAra keu nei|
tomAra nikaTa ye oYAhI avatIrNa karA haYeche tumi tAra anusaraNa kara Ara tumi dhairyya avalamvana kara ye paryanta nA AllAha phAYasAlA pradAna karena| vastutaH tinii halena sarvottama phAYasAlAkArI|
Alipha, lAma, rA; eTA emana ekaTA grantha, era AYAtagulo sudRr3ha, ataHpara savistAre vyAkhyAkRta mahAjJAnI, sarvajJera nikaTa hate|
(eTA zikSA deYa) ye, tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro ‘ivAdAta karave nA, Ami avazyai tA~ra pakSa hate tomAdera janya bhaYa pradarzanakArI o susaMvAdadAtA|

(eTA zikSA deYa) ye, tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa kSamA cAo, Ara anuzocanAbhare tA~ra dikei phire eso, tAhale tini ekaTA nirdiSTa kAla paryanta tomAderake uttama jIvana sAmagrI bhoga karate divena, Ara anugraha lAbhera yogya pratyeka vyaktike tini tA~ra anugraha dAne dhanya karavena| Ara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale Ami tomAdera upara var3a eka kaThina dinera ‘AyAvera AzaGkA karachi|
tomAdera pratyAvartana AllAhara kAchei, Ara tini sava kichui karate sakSama|

lakSya kara, erA nijedera vuka ghuriYe neYa yAte tArA tA~ra (arthAt AllAhara) theke lukiYe thAkate pAre| sAvadhAna! erA yakhana kApar3a diYe nijerA nijederake Dheke neYa, takhana tArA yA gopana kare Ara prakAza kare tini tA jAnena| tAdera manera gabhIre yA Ache se viSaYe tini savaceYe vezi avahita|

yamIne vicaraNazIla emana kona jIva nei yAra jIvikAra dAYitva AllAhara upara nei, tini jAnena tAdera thAkAra jAYagA kothAYa Ara kothAYa tAderake (mRtyura para) rAkhA haYa, sava kichui Ache suspaSTa lipikAYa|

Ara tinii AsamAnasamUha Ara yamInake cha’dine sRSTi karechena| itopUrve tA~ra Araza chila pAnira upara| (sRSTi karechena) tomAderake parIkSA karAra uddeze ye, tomAdera madhye ‘AmAlera kSetre kArA zreSTha| tumi yadi vala, ‘‘mRtyura para tomAderake avazya avazyai AvAra uThAno have, tAhale kAphirarA avazyai valave ye, eto suspaSTa yAdu|

Ami yadi nirdiSTa samaYera janya tAdera theke zAsti vilamvita kari, tAhale tArA avazya avazyai valave ye, ‘kise oTAke ATake rAkhala? sAvadhAna! emana dina tAdera kAche Asave yA tAdera theke keu phiriYe dite pArave nA, Ara yA niYe tArA ThATTA vidrUpa karachila tAi tAderake ghire phelave|
Ami yadi mAnuSake AmAra pakSa theke rahamata AsvAdana karAi ataHpara tA tAra theke chiniYe nei, takhana se avazyai hatAza o akRtajJa haYe par3e|
Ara yadi tAra upare AsA duHkha kaSTera para tAke ni‘mAtera svAda AsvAdana karAi, takhana se avazya avazyai valave, ‘AmAra dUravasthA keTe geche’| takhana se Anande utphulla haYa, haYe par3e ahaGkArI|
kintu yArA dhairyazIla o neka ‘AmAlakArI tArA orakama naYa| Ara erAi hala yAdera janya Ache kSamA o virATa pratidAna|

tumi ki tomAra prati yA oYAhI karA haYeche tAra kichu aMza parityAga karate cAo Ara tomAra mana saMkucita karate cAo tAdera e kathA valAra kAraNe ye ‘‘tAra kAche dhanabhAnDAra avatIrNa haYa nA kena, kiMvA tAra kAche pherezatA Ase nA kena?’’ tumi to kevala bhaYa pradarzanakArI, yAvatIYa kAja paricAlanAra dAYitva AllAhara|

tArA ki vale ‘‘se [arthAt muhAmmAda (sA.)] oTA racanA kareche? vala, ‘‘tAhale tomarA era mata dazaTi sUrAha racanA kare Ana, Ara (e kAje sAhAyya karAra janya) AllAhake vAda diYe yAke DAkate pAra Deke nAo yadi tomarA satyavAdI haYei thAka |

tArA yadi tomAdera DAke sAr3A nA deYa tAhale jene nAo ye, AllAhara jJAna anusArei tA avatIrNa haYeche| Aro jene rAkha ye, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei| tAhale ekhana ki tomarA AtmasamarpaNa karave?
yArA e duniYAra jIvana Ara tAra zobhA saundarya kAmanA kare, tAderake ekhAne tAdera karmera puropuri phala Ami diYe dei, Ara tAte tAdera prati kona kamati karA haYa nA|
kintu AkherAte tAdera janya Aguna chAr3A kichui nAi, ekhAne yA kichu tArA kareche tA niSphala haYe geche, Ara tAdera yAvatIYa kAjakarma vyartha haYe geche|

tAhale ye loka tAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke spaSTa pramANera upara Ache evaM tA~ra pakSa hate eka sAkSI oTA par3e zonAcche (se ki avizvAsIdera samAna hate pAre?) Ara tAra pUrve patha pradarzaka o rahamata svarUpa esechila mUsAra kitAva| orAi tAte (arthAt kuraAne) vizvAsI| yArAi eTAke asvIkAra karave, jAhAnnAmai hala tAdera pratizruta sthAna| kAjei e samparke tumi kona prakAra sandehe nipatita haYo nA| eTA tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke Agata prakRta satya, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa vizvAsa kare nA|

yArA AllAha samparke mithyA racanA kare tAdera theke var3a yAlima Ara ke hate pAre? tAderake tAdera pratipAlakera sAmane upasthita karA have Ara sAkSIrA sAkSya dive ye, ei lokarAi tAdera ravvera viruddhe mithyA valechila| zune rekha! AllAhara abhizApa sei yAlimadera upara
yArA AllAhara patha hate lokederake phiriYe rAkhe Ara tAke vakra karate cAYa, Ara tArA AkhirAtake asvIkAra kare|
duniYAte tArA AllAhake akSama kare dite pArata nA, Ara AllAha chAr3A tAdera kona sAhAyyakArIo chila nA, tAdera zAsti dviguNa karA have| tArA nA zunate pArata, Ara nA dekhate pArata|
erA sei loka yArA nijederake nijerAi kSatigrasta kareche, Ara tArA yA kichu racanA karechila tA tAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe geche|
ete kona sandeha nei ye AkherAte erAi savaceYe kSatigrasta|
nizcaYa yArA ImAna Ane, satkarma kare Ara tAdera ravevara kAche vinIta, tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI, tArA sekhAne sthAYI have|
du’zreNIra lokera dRSTAnta hala yemana ekajana hala andha o vadhira, anyajana cakSuSmAna o zravaNazIla, e du’jana ki tulanAYa samAna hate pAre? eraparao ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave nA|
Ami nUhake tAra kAomera kAche pAThiYechilAma| (se valechila) Ami tomAdera janya ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI,
ye, tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro ‘ivAdAta karo nA, anyathAYa Ami AzaGkA karachi ye, tomAdera upara ekadina vedanAdAYaka ‘AyAva Asave|

jaoYAve tAra jAtira pradhAnagaNa- yArA avizvAsI chila tArA valala, ‘AmarA tomAke AmAdera mata mAnuSa chAr3A anya kichu dekhachi nA, Ara prakAzyataH AmAdera hIna adhama lokagulo chAr3A tomAra patha avalamvana karate dekhachi nA, AmAdera upara tomAra kona prAdhAnyao dekhachi nA, varaM AmarA tomAderaka mithyuka valei mane kari|’

se valala, ‘‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA cintA-bhAvanA kare dekha, Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate prApta suspaSTa pramANera upara pratiSThita thAki Ara tini tA~ra pakSa theke AmAke anugraha pradAna kare thAkena yA tomAdera dRSTi theke gopane rAkhA haYeche, ematAvasthAYa tA grahaNa karAra vyApAre Ami ki tomAderake vAdhya karate pAri yakhana tomarA tA apachanda kara?

he AmAra jAtira lokerA! Ami e kAje tomAdera kAche kona dhana-sampada cAi nA, AmAra pArizramika Ache kevala AllAhara kAche| Ara mu’minadera tAr3iYe deYA AmAra janya zobhanIYa naYa, tArA tAdera pratipAlakera sAkSAt avazyai lAbha karave, kintu Ami dekhachi tomarA emana eka jAti yArA mUrkhera AcaraNa karacha|
he AmAra jAtira lokerA! Ami yadi ei lokaderake tAr3iYe dei tAhale AmAke AllAhara pAkar3Ao theke ke vA~cAve? tavuo ki tomarA upadeza nive nA?

Ami to tomAderake e kathA valachi nA ye, AmAra kAche AllAhara dhana-bhAnDArasamUha Ache| Ara Ami adRzyera khavarao jAni nA| Ara Ami e kathAo vali nA ye, Ami pherezatA| Ami e kathAo vali nA ye, tomAdera cokha ye sava lokake avajJA kare, AllAha kakSano tAdera kalyANa karavena nA| tAdera antare kI Ache AllAhi tA vezI jAnena| (e rakama kathA valale) Ami to yAlimadera zAmila haYe yAvo|
tArA valala, ‘he nUha! tumi AmAdera sAthe jhagar3A karecha, khuva vezi vezi jhagar3A karecha, ekhana yAra bhaYa AmAderake dekhAccha tA AmAdera kAche niYe eso, yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|’
nUha valala, ‘‘AllAhai tA tomAdera kAche niYe Asavena yadi tini cAna, tomarA vyartha karate pArave nA|
Ami tomAdera kona kalyANa karate cAileo AmAra kalyANa kAmanA tomAdera kona upakAre Asave nA yadi AllAha tomAderake pathahArA karate cAna| tinii tomAdera rava, Ara tA~ra kAchei tomarA phire yAve|’’
tArA ki vale ye, e lokai e sava racanA kareche? vala, Ami yadi tA racanA kare thAki, tAhale AmAra aparAdhera dAYitva AmAra upara| tomarA ye aparAdha karecha tAttheke Ami mukta|
nUhera kAche oYAhI pAThAno haYechila ye, yArA ImAna eneche tArA chAr3A tomAra sampradAYera Ara kona loka kakSano ImAna Anave nA, kAjei tArA yA karache tAra janya tumi hA-hutAza karo nA|
ataeva AmAra paryavekSaNera adhIne Ara AmAra oYAhI anusAre tumi naukA tairi kara, Ara yArA vAr3AvAr3i kareche tAdera vyApAre AmAra kAche kona Avedana karo nA, tArA avazyai Duvave|

nUha naukA tairi karachila, Ara yakhanai tAra jAtira pradhAna vyaktirA tAra nikaTa diYe yAcchila, tArA tAke ThATTA karachila| se valala, ‘tomarA yadi AmAderake ThATTA kara, tAhale AmarAo tomAderake (bhaviSyate) ThATTA karava yemanabhAve tomarA (ekhana) ThATTA karacha,
tomarA (zIghrai) jAnate pArave kAra upara lAJchanAkara ‘AyAva Ase Ara kAra upara Ase sthAYI ‘AyAva|

zeSe yakhana AmAra nirdeza ese gela, Ara tandura (pAnite) uthale uThala, Ami valalAma, ‘pratyeka zreNIra yugalera du’Ti tAte tule nAo Ara tomAra parivAra parijanake, tAdera chAr3A yAdera vyApAre Agei ghoSaNA deYA haYeche| Ara yArA ImAna eneche tAderakeo (tule nAo)| tAra saGge ImAna enechila khuva alpa kaYekajanai|
nUha valala, ‘ete ArohaNa kara, AllAhara nAme era gati o era sthiti, AmAra pratipAlaka avazyai var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|’

parvata sadRza taraGgamAlAra madhya diYe tA tAderake niYe vaYe calala| takhana nUha tAra putrake- ye tAdera theke AlAdA haYe giYechila- DAka diYe valala, ‘he AmAra putra! AmAdera saGge ArohaNa kara, kAphiradera saGge theka nA|

se (arthAt nUhera putra) valala, ‘Ami ekSuNi pAhAr3e AzraYa neva yA AmAke pAni theke rakSA karave|’ nUha valala, ‘Aja AllAhara hukuma theke kona kichui rakSA karate pArave nA, avazya AllAha yAra prati daYA karavena se rakSA pAve|’ ataHpara Dheu tAdera du’janAra mAjhe Ar3Ala karala Ara se Duve yAoYA lokedera madhye zAmila haYe gela|

ataHpara valA hala, ‘he yamIna! tomAra pAni gile phela, Ara he AkAza, thAma|’ ataHpara pAni yamIne vase gela, kArya samApta hala, naukA judI parvate ese bhir3ala, Ara valA hala- ‘yAlima lokerA dhvaMsa hoka!’
nUha tAra pratipAlakake AhavAna jAnAla| se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra putra to AmAra parivArabhukta, Ara tomAra o‘YAdA satya Ara tumi vicArakadera sarvazreSTha vicAraka|’

tini valalena, ‘ohe nUha! se to tomAra parivArera loka naYa, tAra AcAra AcaraNa asat, kAjei ye viSaYe tomAra kona jJAna nei se viSaYe AmAra kAche Avedana karo nA, Ami tomAke upadeza dicchi, tumi yena mUrkhadera madhye zAmila nA hao|

se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! ye viSaYe AmAra kona jJAna nei se viSaYe prazna karA hate Ami tomAra kAche AzraYa cAcchi| yadi tumi AmAke kSamA nA kara Ara AmAra prati daYA nA kara tAhale Ami kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe yAva|’

valA hala, ‘he nUha! tumi neme par3a, AmAra pakSa hate zAnti o varakata tomAra prati Ara tomAra saGgIdera madhye aneka dalera prati, Ara e chAr3A anya lokedera Ami jIvana upabhoga karate deva, (kintu) pare AmAra nikaTa hate marmAntika ‘AyAva tAderake sparza karave|’
e sava hala adRzyera khavara yA tomAke oYAhI dvArA jAniYe dicchi, yA era pUrve nA tumi jAnate, nA tomAra jAtira lokerA jAnata| kAjei dhairya dhara, zubha pariNati muttAkIdera janyai nirdiSTa|

Ara ‘Ada jAtira nikaTa tAdera bhAi hUdake pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera Ara kona ilAha nei| tomarA to zudhu mithye vAniYe niYecha|
he AmAra sampradAYa! era vinimaYe Ami tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAi nA| AmAra pArizramika to tA~ra jimmAYa yini AmAke sRSTi karechena, tavuo ki tomarA jJAna-vuddhi khATAve nA?

he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA tomAdera ravevara kAche kSamA prArthanA kara, ataHpara anuzocanAbhare tA~ra dikei phire yAo, tini tomAdera janya pracura vRSTi varSaNa karavena, tomAdera zaktike Aro zakti diYe vAr3iYe divena, Ara aparAdhI haYe mukha phiriYe nio nA|
tArA valala, ‘he hUda! tumi AmAdera kAche kona suspaSTa pramANa niYe Asani, Ara tomAra kathAYa AmarA AmAdera upAsyaguloke tyAga karate pAri nA, AmarA tomAte vizvAsI nai|

AmarA e kathAi vali ye, tomAra upara AmAdera kona upAsyera azubha chAYA par3eche|’ se valala, ‘Ami AllAhake sAkSI rAkhachi Ara tomarAo sAkSI hao ye, tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAke tA~ra zarIka kara tAra sAthe Ami puropuri samparkahIna|
tA~ke (AllAha) vyatIta tomarA savAi mile AmAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra kara Ara AmAke ekaTuo avakAza dio nA|
Ami nirbhara kari AllAhara upara yini AmAra Ara tomAdera rava, emana kona jIva nei yAra katRtva tA~ra hAte naYa, nizcaYai AmAra rava sarala pathera upara pratiSThita|

eraparao yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe lao (tave jene rekha), AmAke yA diYe tomAdera kAche pAThAno haYeche Ami to tomAdera kAche tA pau~che diYechi, ekhana AmAra pratipAlaka tomAdera sthale anya sampradAYake niYe Asavena Ara tomarA tA~ra konai kSati karate pArave nA| AmAra pratipAlaka sava kichura rakSaNAvekSaNakArI|
AmAra nirdeza yakhana ese gela, takhana Ami hUdake Ara tAra saGge yArA ImAna enechila tAderake AmAra daYAYa rakSA karalAma, Ara tAderake vA~ciYe nilAma eka kaThina ‘AyAva hate|

ei hala ‘Ada, tArA tAdera pratipAlakera AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karechila, Ara tAdera rasUladerake amAnya karechila, pratyeka pravala parAkrAnta, satya-dvInera duzamanera nirdezera tArA anusaraNa karechila|
e duniYAte tAdera pichane lA‘nata raYeche, Ara kiYAmAtera dineo| jene rekha, ‘Ada jAti tAdera pratipAlakake asvIkAra karechila| jene rekha! dhvaMsa karA haYechila ‘Adake yArA chila hUdera sampradAYa|

Ami sAmUda jAtira kAche tAdera bhAi sAlihake pAThiYechilAma| se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera Ara kona ilAha nei, tinii tomAderake mATi theke paYadA karechena, Ara tAtei tomAderake pratiSThita karechena, kAjei tA~ra kAche tomarA kSamA prArthanA kara, Ara tA~ra pAnei phire eso, AmAra pratipAlaka to ati nikaTe, Ara tini AhavAne sAr3AdAnakArI|’

tArA valala, ‘‘he sAliha! era pUrve tumi to AmAdera mAjhe chile AzA-AkAGkSAra pAtra, tumi ki AmAderake sei mA‘vUdadera ‘ivAdAta karate niSedha karacha AmAdera pitR puruSarA yAra ‘ivAdAta karata? tumi AmAderake ye dike DAkacha se samparke AmarA vibhrAntikara saMzaYe par3e Achi|

sAliha valala, ‘‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA ki cintA kare dekhecha, yadi Ami AmAra pratipAlakera suspaSTa pramANera upara thAki Ara tA~ra pakSa theke AmAke anugraha karA haYa, ematAvasthAYa Ami yadi tAra avAdhya hai tAhale AllAhara (‘AyAva) theke AmAke ke rakSA karave? tomarA to kevala AmAra kSatii vAr3iYe dite cAo|

he AmAra jAtira lokerA! eTA AllAhara uSTrI, tomAdera janya ekaTA nidarzana| eke AllAhara yamIne cale phire kheYe ver3Ate dAo, eke kona prakAra kaSTa dio nA, nacet zIghrai tomAderake ‘AyAva pAkar3Ao karave|’
kintu tArA uSTrITira pAgulo keTe phelala| takhana se tAderake valala, ‘tomarA tomAdera ghare tinaTi dina jIvana upabhoga kare nAo, eTA emana eka o‘YAdA yA mithye hate pAre nA|’

ataHpara AmAra hukuma yakhana Asala takhana Ami sAliha Ara tAra saGge yArA ImAna enechila tAderake AmAra daYAYa vA~ciYe nilAma Ara se dinera lAJchanA hate rakSA karalAma| tomAra pratipAlaka tinii to zaktizAlI, pratApazAlI|
yArA yulama karechila eka pracanDa zavda tAderake AghAta hAnala, Ara tArA nija nija gRhe natajAnu haYe par3e raila-
yena tArA sekhAne kona dinai vAsa kareni| jene rekha, sAmudajAti tAdera pratipAlakake amAnya karechila| jene rekha, sAmUdake (rahamAta theke) dUre nikSepa karA haYechila|
AmAra prerita pherezatAgaNa ivarAhImera kAche susaMvAda niYe esechila| tArA ese valala ‘‘tomAra prati sAlAma! seo valala, ‘tomAdera pratio sAlAma!’ anativilamve se bhunA karA vAchura niYe Asalo|

yakhana se dekhala tAdera hAta tAra (arthAt khAvArera) dike pau~chateche nA, se tAdera samparke sandigdha hala Ara tAdera vyApAre bhIti anubhava karala| tArA valala, ‘bhaYa peYo nA, AmAderake pAThAno haYeche lUtera sampradAYera prati|’
(ivarAhImera) strI dA~r3iYechila, se hese phelala| takhana Ami tAke isahAkera Ara isahAkera para iYA‘kUvera susaMvAda dilAma|
se valala, ‘hAYa AmAra kapAla! santAna have AmAra, Ami to ati vur3i Ara AmAra ei svAmIo vRddha, eto eka Azcarya vyApAra|’
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara kAje tumi Azcarya haccha, ohe (ivarAhImera) parivAravarga! tomAdera upara raYeche AllAhara daYA o varakatasamUha, tini var3ai prazaMsita, var3ai mahAna|’
pare yakhana ivarAhImera AtaGka dUra hala, Ara tAra kAche susaMvAda Asala, takhana se lUta jAtira vyApAre AmAra sAthe jhagar3A karala|
avazyai ivarAhIma chila var3ai sahiSNu, komala hRdaYa Ara AllAhamukhI|
‘he ivarAhIma! etheke tumi nivRtta hao, tomAra pratipAlakera nirdeza ese geche, tAdera prati zAsti Asavei yA rada havAra naYa|
AmAra prerita vArtAvAhakagaNa yakhana lUtera kAche Asalo, tAdera Agamane se ghAvar3e gela| (tAderake rakSAYa) nijeke asamartha mane karala, Ara valala, ‘Aja var3ai vipadera dina|

tAra kaomera lokerA hur3amur3a kare tAra kAche chuTe Asalo, Age thekei tArA e rakama asat kAje abhyasta chila| se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! ei AmAra (nijera vA jAtira) kanyArA Ache, tArA tomAdera janya adhika pavitra (yadi tomarA viYe kara), kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, AmAra mehamAnadera vyApAre AmAke lajjita karo nA, tomAdera madhye ki bhAla mAnuSa ekaTio nei?’
tArA valala, ‘tomAra to jAnAi Ache ye, tomAra (nijera vA jAtira) kanyAdera AmAdera kona darakAra nei, AmarA kI cAi tAto tumi avazyai jAna|’
se valala, ‘tomAderake damana karAra kSamatA AmAra yadi thAkata! athavA kona majavuta AzraYe yadi AzraYa nite pAratAma!’

AguntukarA valala, ‘he lUta! AmarA tomAra pratipAlaka prerita vArtAvAhaka, tArA tomAra kAche kakSano pau~chate pArave nA, kAjei kichuTA rAta vAkI thAkate tumi tomAra parivAra-parijana niYe veriYe par3a, tomAdera keu yena pichanera dike nA tAkAYa| kintu tomAra strI (tomAdera saGgI hate pArave nA) tArao tAi ghaTave, anyadera yA ghaTave| sakAla hala tAdera (zAsti AsAra) nirdhArita samaYa, sakAla ki nikaTavartI naYa?’
tArapara AmAra nirdeza yakhana ese gela, takhana Ami sei janapadake upara nIca kare ulTe dilAma, Ara tAdera upara stare stare pAkAno mATira prastara varSaNa karalAma|
ye prastara khanDera pratiTii tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa cihnita chila| yAlimadera janya e zAsti vezI dUrera vyApAra naYa|

Ara mAdaiYAnavAsIdera kAche Ami tAdera bhAi zu‘AYavake pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera kona satya ilAha nei, Ara mApe o ojane kama dio nA, Ami tomAderake bhAla avasthAtei dekhachi| kintu Ami tomAdera janya zAstira AzaGkA karachi se dinera yedina tomAderake caturdika theke ghire dharave|
he AmAra sampradAYa! mApa o ojana inasAphera saGge pUrNa karo, lokaderake tAdera prApya kama dio nA, Ara yamIne phAsAda sRSTi kare ver3io nA|
AllAhara anumodita udvRtta (arthAt lAbha) tomAdera janya uttama, yadi tomarA mu’mina hao, Ami tomAdera paryavekSaka nai|’

tArA valala, ‘he zu‘AYava! tomAra ivAdata ki tomAke ei hukuma deYa ye, AmAdera pitRpuruSa yAra ‘ivAdAta karata AmarA tA parityAga kari vA AmAdera dhana-sampadera vyApAre AmAdera icche (mAphika vyaYa karA) varjana kari, tumi to dekhachi var3ai dhairyazIla, bhAla mAnuSa|’

se valala, ‘he AmAra jAtira lokerA! tomarA ki bheve dekhecha yadi Ami AmAra pratipAlakera spaSTa pramANera upara pratiSThita haYe thAki Ara tini AmAke tA~ra pakSa theke uttama riyaka diYe thAkena (tAhale Ami kIbhAve tomAdera anyAYa kAjera saGgI hate pAri?), Ami tomAderake ye kAja karate niSedha kari seTA tomAdera prati viruddhAcaraNa karAra icchAYa naYa, Ami to sAdhyamata saMzodhana karate cAi, AmAra kAjera sAphalya to AllAharai pakSa hate, Ami tA~ra uparai nirbhara kari, Ara tA~ra dikei mukha kari|

he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAra saGge virodha tomAderake yena kichutei emana kAje udvuddha nA kare yAte tomAdera upara emana vipada Ase yemana vipada esechila nUhera jAtira kiMvA hUdera jAtira kiMvA sAlihara jAtira upara| Ara lUtera jAtira avasthAna to tomAdera theke moTei dUre naYa|
tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara, ataHpara tA~rai nikaTa tAovAha kara| AmAra pratipAlaka to parama daYAlu, var3ai bhAlavAsA poSaNakArI|’

tArA valala, ‘he zu‘AYava! tumi yA vala tAra aneka kathAi AmarA vujhi nA, AmarA AmAdera madhye tomAke avazyai durvala dekhachi, tomAra gotra nA thAkale AmarA tomAke avazyai pAthara nikSepa ka’re mere phelatAma, AmAdera upara tomAra kona kSamatAi nei|

se valala, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! AmAra svajanarA ki tomAdera kAche AllAhara ceYeo pravala! tomarA to tA~ke sampUrNataH pechane phele rekhecha, tomarA yA karacha AmAra pratipAlaka tA sava kichui avagata|’

he AmAra sampradAYa! ‘tomarA nija nija avasthAne theke kAja karate thAka, Amio AmAra kAja karate thAki, tomarA acirei jAnate pArave kAra upara Asave lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti Ara ke mithyevAdI| kAjei tomarA apekSAYa thAka, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSAYa thAkalAma|’

AmAra hukuma yakhana Asalo, takhana Ami AmAra daYAYa zu‘AYava Ara tAra saGge yArA ImAna enechila tAderake vA~ciYe dilAma| Ara yArA yulama karechila tAderake eka pracanDa zavda AghAta hAnala yAra phale tArA nijedera gRhe natajAnu haYe par3e raila|
(emanabhAve) yena tArA sekhAne konadinai vasavAsa kareni| jene rekha, mAdaiYAnavAsIderake dUre nikSepa karA hala, yemanabhAve dUre nikSepa karA haYechila sAmUdajAtike|
Ami mUsAke pAThiYechilAma AmAra nidarzana Ara spaSTa pramANa sahakAre
phira‘Aona Ara tAra pradhAnadera kAche, kintu tArA phira‘Aonera hukumai mene nila, Ara phira‘Aonera hukuma satya nirbhara chila nA|
kviYAmAtera dina se tAra sampradAYera purobhAge thAkave Ara tAderake jAhAnnAme niYe yete netRtva deve, katai nA nikRSTa e avataraNa sthala yAte tArA upanIta have|
e duniYAteo abhizApa tAdera pechane chuTache Ara kviYAmAtera dineo| kata nikRSTai nA se puraskAra yA tAderake deYA have|
e hala janapadasamUhera kichu khavarAdi yA Ami tomAra nikaTa varNanA karalAma, tAdera kataka ekhanao dA~r3iYe Ache Ara kataka kartita phasalera dazA prApta haYeche|

Ami tAdera upara yulama karini varaM tArAi nijedera upara yulama karechila, kintu tomAra pratipAlakera hukuma yakhana ese gela, takhana AllAhake vAda diYe tArA yesava ilAhake DAkata ogulo tAdera konai kAje Asala nA, tArA dhvaMsa chAr3A kichui vRddhi karate pArala nA|
tomAra pratipAlakera pAkar3Ao e rakamai haYe thAke yakhana tini pAkar3Ao karena kona janapadake yakhana tArA yulame lipta thAke| avazyai tA~ra pAkar3Ao bhaYAvaha, var3ai kaThina|
ete avazyai nidarzana Ache tAra janya ye AkherAtera zAstike bhaYa kare| eTA emana dina, ye dinera janya sava mAnuSake ekatrita karA have, eTA hAyira haoYAra dina|
Ami ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYera janya tAke vilamvita kari mAtra|
se dina yakhana Asave takhana tA~ra anumati chAr3A keu mukha khulate pArave nA, tAdera keu have hatabhAgA, Ara keu have saubhAgyavAna|
yArA hatabhAgA have tArA jAhAnnAme yAve, sekhAne tAdera janya Ache hA-hutAza Ara Arta cItkAra|

sekhAne tArA sthAYI have cirakAlera janya ye paryanta AkAzasamUha o pRthivI vidyamAna thAkave yadi nA tomAra pratipAlaka anya kichu icche karena| tomAra pratipAlaka avazyai karate sakSama yA tini karate cAna|
Ara yArA saubhAgyavAna have, tArA jAnnAte sthAYI have ye paryanta AkAzasamUha o pRthivI vidyamAna thAkave, yadi nA tomAra pratipAlaka anya rakama icche karena| e hala eka avyAhata puraskAra|

kAjei tArA yegulora ‘ivAdAta kare segulora vyApAre sandehe patita haYo nA| tArA yegulora ‘ivAdAta kare segulo tA chAr3A Ara kichui naYa yegulora ‘ivAdAta pUrve tAdera pitRpuruSarA karata, Ami avazyai tAdera prApya aMza tAderake pUrNa mAtrAtei deva, konai kamati karA have nA|

itopUrve Ami mUsAkeo kitAva diYechilAma, kintu tAteo matavirodha karA haYechila| tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke ekaTi kathA yadi Agei vale deYA nA hata, tAhale tAdera mAjhe avazyai phAYasAlAi ka’re deYA hata, e vyApAre tArA avazya sandehapUrNa saMzaYe par3e Ache|
ete sandeha nei ye, tomAra pratipAlaka pratyekakei tAdera ‘AmAlera pratiphala avazya avazyai puropuri dAna karavena, tArA yA kare se viSaYe tini pUrNa oYAkiphahAla|
kAjei tumi o tomAra sAthe yArA (AllAhara dike) tAovA kareche sudRr3ha haYe thAka AllAha yebhAve tomAke Adeza diYechena, Ara sImAlaGghana karo nA| tomarA yA kichu kara tini tA bhAlabhAvei dekhena|
tomarA yAlimadera prati jhu~ke par3o nA, tAhale Aguna tomAderake sparza karave, Ara takhana AllAha chAr3A keu tomAdera abhibhAvaka thAkave nA, ata:para tomAderake sAhAyyao karA have nA|
tumi nAmAya pratiSThA kara dinera du’ prAnta samaYe Ara kichuTA rAta ativAhita haoYAra para, pUNyarAji avazyai pAparAzike dUra kare deYa, eTA tAdera janya upadeza yArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
tumi dhairya dhara, kAraNa AllAha satkarmazIla lokadera karmaphala kakhanao vinaSTa karena nA|

tAhale tomAdera pUrva yugera lokadera madhye emana satkarmazIla kena haYani yArA yamIne viparyaYa sRSTi karA hate vAdhA dita? emana loka kamai chila Ara tAderake Ami vA~ciYe niYechilAma| yAlimarA to tAderake deYA sAmagrIra sukha svAcchandyei lipta thAkato Ara tArA chila aparAdhI|
tomAra pratipAlaka emana nana ye, tini anyAYabhAve kona janapada dhvaMsa karavena ematAvasthAYa ye, tAra adhivAsIrA sadAcArI|
tomAra pratipAlaka cAile mAnuSake avazyai eka jAti karate pAratena, kintu tArA matabheda karatei thAkave|

tave tomAra pratipAlaka yAdera prati daYA karena tArA (matavirodha karave) nA| ei uddezyei tini tAderake sRSTi karechena, Ara tomAra pratipAlakera e vANI pUrNa havei ye, Ami jAhAnnAmake jvina Ara mAnuSa diYe avazya avazyai bhare deva|

rasUladera ye sava saMvAdasamUha Ami tomAra kAche varNanA karalAma, era dvArA Ami tomAra dilake mayavuta karachi, ete tumi prakRta satyera jJAna lAbha karave Ara mu’minadera janya eTA upadeza o smAraka|
yArA ImAna Ane nA tAderake vala, ‘tomarA nijedera mata o pathe theke kAja kare yAo, AmarA (AmAdera) kAja karachi|
Ara tomarA apekSA kara, AmarAo apekSAYa thAkalAma|’

AsamAnasamUha o yamInera adRzyera jJAna kevala AllAharai raYeche| sakala viSaYai (cUr3Anta siddhAntera janya) tA~ra kAche phire yAYa, kAjei tumi tA~rai ‘ivAdAta kara, Ara tA~ra uparai nirbhara kara, tomarA yA kichu karacha, se samparke tomAra pratipAlaka moTei ve-khavara nana|
Alipha, lAma-rA, egulo suspaSTa kitAvera AYAtasamUha|
Ami tA avatIrNa karechi, AravI bhASAra kuraAna, yAte tomarA bhAlabhAve vujhate pAra|
Ami tomAra kAche sarvottama kAhinI varNanA karachi, e kuraAna tomAra kAche oYAhI yoge pAThiYe, yadio era pUrve tumi nA-jAnA lokadera madhyei zAmila chile|
smaraNa kara, iusupha yakhana tAra pitAke valechila, ‘he AvvAjAna! Ami (svapne) dekhechi egAraTi tArakA Ara sUrya o candra; dekhalAma tArA AmAke sAjadAha karache|’
tAra pitA valalena, ‘he AmAra putra! tomAra svapnera kathA tomAra bhAidera kAche varNanA karo nA| yadi kara tAhale tArA tomAra viruddhe cakrAnta karave| zAitvAna to mAnuSera prakAzya duzamana|

(svapne yemana dekhecha) ebhAve tomAra pratipAlaka tomAke manonIta karavena, tomAke svapnera vyAkhyA zikSA divena evaM tini tA~ra anugraha tomAra prati Ara iYA‘kUva parivArera prati pUrNa karavena yebhAve tini tA pUrve tomAra pitR-puruSa ivarAhIma o isahAkera prati pUrNa karechilena, nizcaYai tomAra ravva sarvajJa, var3ai prajJAvAna|’
iusupha Ara tAra bhAidera ghaTanAYa satya sandhAnIdera janya avazyai nidarzanAvalI Ache|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tArA (vaimAtreYa bhAigaNa) valAvali karachila, ‘nizcaYai iusupha Ara tAra (sahodara) bhAi AmAdera pitAra kAche AmAdera ceYe vezi priYa, athaca AmarA puro ekaTA dala, AmAdera pitA spaSTa bhulera madhye Achena|
tomarA iusuphake hatyA kare phela kiMvA tAke kona bhUmite phele Asa, tAhale tomAdera pitAra dRSTi tomAdera pratii nivaddha have, tAra para tomarA (tAovAha kare) bhAla loka haYe yAve|
tAdera ekajana valala, tomarA iusuphake hatyA karo nA, tomAderake yadi kichu karatei haYa varaM tAke kona andha kUpe phele dAo, kona yAtrIdala tAke uThiYe niYe yAve|’
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera AvvAjAna! kI vyApAra, Apani iusuphera vyApAre AmAderake vizvAsa karena nA kena, athaca AmarA avazyai tAra kalyANakAmI|
tAke AgAmIkAla AmAdera saGge pAThiYe dina, se Amoda karave Ara khelave, AmarA tAra puropuri dekhAzunA karava|’
pitA valala, ‘tomarA ye tAke niYe yAve seTA AmAke avazyai kaSTa deve Ara Ami bhaYa karachi ye, nekar3e vAgha tAke kheYe phelave, Ara takhana tAra samparke tomarA ve-kheYAla haYe thAkave|’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA ekaTA dala thAkate tAke yadi nekar3e vAghe kheYe phele, tAhale to AmarA apadArthai vane yAvo|’

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAke niYe gela, Ara tAke andha kUpe phelAra vyApAre mataikye pau~chala, ematAvasthAYa Ami iusuphake oYAhI karalAma- eka samaYa Asave yakhana tumi tAderake tAdera e karmera kathA avazya avazyai vyakta karave|’ athaca tArA (arthAt iusuphera bhAiYerA) moTei Tera pAve nA|
rAtera prathama prahare tArA tAdera pitAra kAche kA~date kA~date Asala|

tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera AvvAjAna! AmarA daur3era pratiyogitA karachilAma, Ara iusuphake AmarA AmAdera jinisapatrera kAche rekhe giYechilAma, takhana tAke nekar3e vAghe kheYe phelala, kintu Apani to AmAdera kathA vizvAsa karavena nA, AmarA satyavAdI haleo|’

tArA tAra jAmAYa michemichi rakta mAkhiYe niYe esechila| pitA valala, ‘nA, varaM tomAdera pravRtti tomAderake ekaTA kAhinI vAnAte udvuddha kareche| Thika Ache, Ami puropuri dhairya dhAraNa karava, tomarA yA vAniYecha se vyApAre AllAhai AmAra AzraYasthala|’

sekhAne ekaTA kAphelA Asalo| tArA tAdera pAni saMgrahakArIke pAThAlo| se tAra pAnira vAlati nAmiYe dila| se valala, ‘kI khuzira khavara! e ye dekhachi eka vAlaka!’ tArA tAke paNya dravya jJAne lukiYe dila, Ara tArA yA karachila se samparke AllAha khuvai avahita|
tArA tAke svalpa mUlye- mAtra kaYaTi dirahAmera vinimaYe vikri kare dila, tArA chila tAke tuccha jJAnakArI!

misarera ye loka tAke kraYa karechila, se tAra strIke valala, ‘tAra thAkAra suvyavasthA kara, sambhavataH se AmAdera upakAre Asave kiMvA tAke AmarA putra hiseveo grahaNa kare nite pAri|’ ebhAve Ami iusuphake se deze pratiSThita karalAma tAke svapna vyAkhyAra kichu jJAna zikSA deYAra janya| AllAha tA~ra kAjera vyApAre pUrNa kartRtvazIla| kintu adhikAMza lokai (tA) jAne nA|
yakhana se tAra paripUrNa yauvane pau~chala, takhana tAke vicAra-vuddhi o jJAna dAna karalAma, Ami satkarmazIladerake ebhAvei pratidAna diYe thAki|

ye mahilAra ghare se chila, se (mahilATi) tAra theke asat karma kAmanA karala| se darajAgulo vandha kare dila Ara valala, ‘eso’| se (iusupha) valala, ‘Ami AllAhara AzraYa nicchi| tini AmAra ravva, tini AmAra thAkAra vyavasthA kata uttama karechena, yAlimarA kakSano sAphalya lAbha karate pAre nA|

sei mahilA tAra prati Asakta haYechila Ara se (iusupha)o tAra prati Asakta haYei yeta yadi se tAra pratipAlakera nidarzana nA dekhata| Ami tA dekhiYechilAma tAke asat karma o nirlajjatA theke sariYe rAkhAra uddezye, se chila vizuddha-hRdaYa vAndAdera antarbhukta|

tArA ubhaYe darajAra dike daur3a dila Ara strIlokaTi pichana hate tAra jAmA chi~r3e phelala| e samaYa strIlokaTira svAmIke tArA du’jane darajAra kAche pela| mahilATi valala, ‘ye tomAra parivArera sAthe apakarma karate cAYa tAke jele pAThAno athavA bhaYAvaha zAsti chAr3A upayukta danDa kI Ara deYA yete pAre?’

se (iusupha) valala, ‘se-i AmA hate asat karma kAmanA kareche’| takhana mahilATira parivArera eka sAkSI sAkSya dila- ‘yadi tAra jAmA sammukha dika theke che~r3A haYe thAke, tave mahilATi satya valeche Ara se mithyAvAdIdera antarbhukta|
Ara yadi tAra jAmA pechana hate che~r3A haYe thAke, tave mahilATi mithye valeche Ara se satyavAdIdera antarbhukta|’
svAmI yakhana iusuphera jAmATi pechana hate che~r3A dekhate pela, takhana se valala, ‘e sava hala tomAdera nArIdera chalanA, tomAdera kUTa kauzala var3ai kaThina|
ohe iusupha! tumi vyApAraTA upekSA kara, Ara ohe nArI! tumi tomAra aparAdhera janya kSamA cAo, prakRtapakSe tumii aparAdhI|’
nagarIra kataka mahilA valala, ‘AyIyera strI tAra yuvaka krItadAsera prati AkRSTa haYe par3eche, bhAlavAsA tAke unmAda kare pheleche, AmarA nizcitai tAke prakAzya bhrAntite nipatita dekhachi|’

mahilATi yakhana tAdera cakrAntera kathA jAnate pArala, takhana tAderake Deke pAThAla Ara tAdera janya helAna diYe vasAra vyavasthA karala, Ara tAdera pratyekake ekaTA kare churi dila| ataHpara iusuphake valala, ‘odera sAmane veriYe eso|’ yakhana tArA tAke dekhala, vismaYe abhibhUta haYe gela Ara nijedera hAta keTe phelala, Ara valala, ‘AllAha AmAdera rakSA karuna, e to mAnuSa naYa, eto eka sammAnita pherezatA|’

mahilATi valala, ‘e hala sei yAra vyApAre tomarA AmAke bhatrsanA karacha, Amii to tAke bhulAte ceSTA karechi, kintu se nijeke niSpApa rekheche, Ami tAke ye Adeza kari tA yadi se nA kare, tAhale tAke avazyai kaYeda karA have, Ara se hIna lokadera antarbhukta have|’

se (iusupha) valala, ‘he AmAra ravva! tArA AmAke ye dike DAkache tAra ceYe jelakhAnA AmAra kAche adhika priYa| tumi yadi AmA hate tAdera apakauzala sariYe nA dAo tA hale Ami tAdera prati AkRSTa haYe par3ava, Ara ajJadera dale zAmila haYe yAva|’
takhana tAra pratipAlaka tAra DAke sAr3A dilena Ara tAra theke tAdera kUTa kauzala apasArita karalena, tini sava kichu zunena, sava kichu jAnena|
nidarzanavalI dekhAra para tAdera mane hala ye, kichu dinera janya tAke avazya avazyai kArAruddha karate have|

tAra saGge du’yuvakao kArAgAre praveza karechila| tAdera ekajana valala, ‘Ami svapne dekhalAma ye Ami mada tairi karachi|’ anyajana valala, ‘Ami svapne dekhalAma, Ami mAthAYa ruTi vahana karachi Ara pAkhI tAttheke khAcche| AmAderake era vyAkhyA vale dAo, AmarA dekhachi tumi ekajana satkarmazIla loka|’

se (iusupha) valala, ‘tomAderake ye khAvAra deYA haYa tA AsAra Agei Ami tomAderake tAra vyAkhyA jAniYe deva| AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke ye jJAna dAna karechena eTA sei jJAnerai aMza| ye sampradAYa AllAhate vizvAsa kare nA Ara AkherAte avizvAsI, Ami tAdera niYama nIti parityAga karechi|

Ami AmAra pUrvapuruSa ivarAhIma, isahAka o iYA‘kUvera Adarzera anusaraNa kari| AllAhara sAthe kona kichuke zarIka karA AmAdera kAja naYa| eTA AmAdera prati o mAnuSera prati AllAhara anugraha, kintu adhikAMza lokai zokara kare nA|
he AmAra jelera saGgIdvaYa! bhinna bhinna pratipAlaka bhAlo, nA mahAparAkramazAlI eka AllAha?

tA~ke vAda diYe tomarA yAra ‘ivAdAta karacha tA katakagulo nAma chAr3A Ara kichui naYa, ye nAmagulo tomarA Ara tomAdera pitR puruSarA rekhecha| e vyApAre AllAha kona pramANa nAyila karenani| AllAha chAr3A kona vidhAna dAtA nei| tini Adeza karechena ye, tomarA tA~ke chAr3A Ara kAro ‘ivAdAta karave nA, eTAi saThika dvIna, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai tA jAne nA|

he AmAra jelera saGgIdvaYa! tomAdera du’janera ekajana tAra prabhuke mada pAna karAve Ara anyajanake zUle deYA have, Ara pAkhI tAra mastaka Thukare khAve| tomarA du’jana ye samparke jAnate ceYecha tAra phAYasAlA haYe geche|’

tAdera du’janera madhye ye jana mukti pAve va’le se (iusupha) mane karala tAke valala, ‘tomAra prabhura kAche AmAra samparke valio|’ kintu zaYatAna tAke tAra prabhura kAche iusuphera kathA ullekha karate bhuliYe dila| phale iusupha veza kaYeka vachara kArAgAre ATaka theke gela|

rAjA valalena, ‘Ami svapne dekhalAma sAtaTi hRSTapuSTa gAbhI, sAtaTi jIrNazIrNa gAbhI tAderake khAcche| (Ara dekhalAma) sAtaTi savuja sateja zISa Ara anya sAtaTi zukano| ohe sabhASadagaNa! AmAra kAche tomarA AmAra svapnera vyAkhyA kara yadi tomarA vyAkhyA karate pAra|’
tArA valala, ‘eto aspaSTa (arthahIna) svapnera kathA, Ara AmarA e dharanera svapna vyAkhyAYa abhijJa nai|’
du’janera madhye ye jana jela theke mukti peYechila Ara dIrghakAla para yAra smaraNa hala se valala, ‘Ami tomAderake tAra vyAkhyA vale deva, tave tomarA AmAke (jelakhAnAYa iusuphera kAche) pAThAo|

se valala, ‘he satyavAdI iusupha! sAtaTi hRSTapuSTa gAbhI, yAderake khAcche jIrNazIrNa sAtaTi gAbhI Ara sAtaTi savuja sateja zISa Ara anyagulo zukano| (AmAderake era vyAkhyA jAniYe dAo) yAte Ami tAdera kAche phire yete pAri Ara tArA jene nite pAre|’
se (iusupha) valala, ‘sAta vachara tomarA eka nAgAr3e cASa karave, ataHpara yakhana phasala kATave takhana tomarA ye sAmAnya parimANa khAve tA vAde ziSa sameta saMrakSaNa karave|
erapara Asave sAtaTi kaThina vachara| e samaYera janya pUrve yA tomarA saJcaYa karechile tA loke khAve, kevala sei alpaTuku vAde yA tomarA saJcaYa karave|
era para Asave ekaTA vachara yakhana mAnuSera janya pracura vRSTipAta have Ara mAnuSa pracura bhogavilAsa karave|’

rAjA valala, ‘tomarA tAke (iusuphake) AmAra kAche niYe eso|’ dUta yakhana tAra kAche Asalo takhana iusupha valala, ‘tomAra prabhura kAche phire yAo evaM tAke jijJesa kara, sei mahilAdera vyApAraTi kI yArA tAdera hAta keTe phelechila? AmAra pratipAlaka avazyai tAdera kauzala samparke avagata|’

rAjA mahilAdera jijJesa karala- ‘tomarA yakhana iusuphake bhulAte ceSTA karechile takhana tomAdera kI haYechila?’ tArA valala, ‘AllAha AmAderake rakSA karuna! AmarA tAra mAjhe kona doSa dekhate pAini|’ AyIyera strI valala, ‘ekhana satya prakAzita haYe par3eche, Amii tAke bhulAte ceSTA karechilAma, nizcaYai se chila satyavAdI|’

(iusupha valala) ‘AmAra uddezya ei ye, se (arthAt AyIya) yena jAnate pAre ye, tAra anupasthitite Ami tAra prati vizvAsaghAtakatA karini Ara AllAha vizvAsaghAtakadera kauzalake avazyai saphala hate dena nA|’
(se valala), ‘Ami nijeke doSamukta mane kari nA, naphas to manda kAje prarocita karatei thAke, AmAra pratipAlaka yAra prati daYA karena se chAr3A| AmAra pratipAlaka var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|’

rAjA valalena, ‘tAke AmAra kAche niYe eso, Ami tAke AmAra janya vizeSabhAve nirdiSTa kare neva|’ ataHpara se (iusupha) yakhana tAra sAthe kathA valala, takhana rAjA valala, ‘Aja tumi AmAdera kAche khuvai maryAdAzIla o vizvasta hiseve parigaNita|’
se (iusupha) valala- ‘AmAke dezera dhana-bhAnDArera dAYitva dina, Ami uttama rakSaka o yatheSTa jJAnera adhikArI|’

ebhAve Ami iusuphake se deze pratiSThita karalAma| dezera yekhAne icche se nijera sthAna kare nite pArata, Ami yAke cAi AmAra rahamAta diYe dhanya kari, Ami satkarmazIladera karmaphala kakSano vinaSTa kari nA|
Ara AkherAtera karmaphala tAdera janya avazyai uttama yArA ImAna Ane Ara tAkaoYA avalamvana kare kAja karate thAke|
iusuphera bhAiYerA Asala evaM tAra kAche hAyira hala| se tAderake cinate pArala, kintu tArA tAke cinate pArala nA|

se yakhana tAdera dravya sAmagrIra vyavasthA kare dila takhana se valala, ‘tomarA tomAdera sat bhAike AmAra kAche niYe Asave, tomarA ki dekhacha nA, Ami kIbhAve pAtra bhare dei, Ara Ami uttama atithi sevaka|
tomarA yadi tAke nA niYe Aso tAhale AmAra kAche tomAdera janya kona zasya varAdda have nA, Ara AmAra kAcheo Asate pArave nA|’
tArA valala- ‘e vyApAre AmarA tAra pitAke rAyI karAte ceSTA karava Ara AmarA tA karavai|’

se (iusupha) tAra khAdemaderake valala, ‘tArA ye paNyamUlya diYeche tA tAdera mAla patrera madhye gopane rekhe dAo, yAte tArA tAdera parivAravargera kAche phire giYe tA jAnate pAre, tAhale tArA AvAra Asave|’

tArapara yakhana tArA tAdera pitAra kAche phire gela takhana valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA! AmAdera janya zaSyera varAdda niSiddha karA haYeche, kAjei AmAdera bhAike AmAdera saGge pAThiYe dina, yAte AmarA zasyera varAdda pete pAri, AmarA avazyai tAra hiphAyAta karava|’
(pitA) valala, ‘Ami ki tAra vyApAre tomAderake temani vizvAsa karava itopUrve yemana tomAderake tAra bhAiYera vyApAre vizvAsa karechilAma? AllAhai uttama saMrakSaka Ara tinii sarvazreSTha daYAlu|’

tArA yakhana tAdera mAla-patra khulala takhana dekhate pela ye, tAderake tAdera paNyamUlya phiriYe deYA haYeche| tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera AvvAjAna! AmarA Ara kI cAi| ei dekhuna, AmAdera paNyamUlya AmAderake phiriYe deYA haYeche, AmarA AmAdera parivArera janya (Aro) khAdya Anava, AmAdera bhAiYera hiphAyAtao karava, Aro eka uTa-vojhAi mAla vezi Anava, e parimANa sahajei pAoYA yAve|’

(pitA) valala- ‘Ami tAke tomAdera sAthe kichutei pAThAvo nA yatakSaNa nA tomarA AllAhara nAme zapatha kara ye, tomarA tAke AmAra kAche niYe Asavei yadi nA tomAderake ekayoge ghire phelA haYa|’ ataHpara tArA yakhana tAra kAche pratijJA karala takhana se valala, ‘AmarA ye kathA valachi AllAhai tAra sAkSI o abhibhAvaka|’

pitA valala, ‘he AmAra santAnerA! tomarA eka dvAra diYe (misare) praveza kara nA, varaM bhinna bhinna darajA diYe praveza karave (mAnuSera sandeha kiMvA kudRSTi er3Anora janya)| Ami AllAhara hukumera viruddhe tomAdera konai upakAra karate pArava nA| AllAha chAr3A hukuma dAtA keu nei, Ami tA~ra uparai nirbhara kari, yArA nirbhara karate cAYa, tArA tA~ra upara nirbhara karuka|’

tAdera pitA yebhAve Adeza karechila yakhana tArA sebhAve praveza karala, takhana AllAhara hukumera viruddhe tA tAdera kona kAje Asala nA| tave iYA‘kuva tAra manera ekaTA abhiprAYa pUrNa karechila mAtra| AmAra deYA zikSAra vadaulate avazyai se chila jJAnavAna, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa prakRta vyApAra samparke avagata naYa|
yakhana tArA iusuphera kAche hAjira hala, takhana se tAra sahodara bhAike nijera kAche rAkhala| Ara valala, ‘Amii tomAra bhAi, kAjei orA yA karata tAra janya duHkha karo nA|’

ataHpara iusupha yakhana tAdera rasadapatra prastuta kare dila, takhana se tAra sahodara bhAiYera rasadapatrera bhitara pAna pAtraTi rekhe dila| takhana eka ghoSaka ghoSaNA dila, ‘he kAphelAra loka! tomarA nizcaYai cora|’
tArA tAdera dike phire valala, ‘tomAdera kI hAriYeche?’
tArA valala- ‘AmarA rAjAra pAna pAtra hAriYechi, (tAdera pradhAna vyakti valala) ye tA ene dite pArave tAra janya Ache eka uTa-vojhAi mAla| Ara Amii e vyApAre pratijJAvaddha|
iusuphera bhAiYerA valala, ‘AllAhara zapatha! tomarA to jAna AmarA e deze azAnti sRSTi karate Asini, Ara AmarA corao nai|’
rAjakarmacArIrA valala, ‘tomarA mithyevAdI hale ye curi kareche tAra zAsti kI have?’
tArA valala, ‘tAra zAsti hala yAra mAlera bhitara oTA pAoYA yAve tAkei dhare rAkhA have| sImAlaGghanakArIderake AmarA ebhAvei zAsti diYe thAki|’

ataHpara iusupha tAra nija bhAiYera mAlapatra tallAzira Age anyadera mAla tallAzi zuru karala| ataHpara seTi tAra nija bhAiYera mAlapatra theke vera karala| ebhAve Ami iusuphera janya parikalpanA karechilAma| rAjAra Aina anuyAYI se tAra sahodara bhAike ATaka karate pArata nA-AllAhara icche vyatIta| Ami yAra janya icche kari maryAdA ucca kari, pratyeka jJAnIra upare Achena ekajana sarvajJa|

iusuphera bhAiYerA valala, ‘se yadi curi kare thAke (tave tA asambhava naYa, kenanA) era pUrve tAra sahodara bhAio curi karechila| takhana iusupha e vyApAraTi tAra manei gopana rAkhala, tA tAdera kAche prakAza karala nA| se (mane mane) valala- tomAdera avasthAna to Aro nikRSTatama, tomarA yA valacha se samparke AllAha khuva bhAlabhAvei avagata|
tArA valala, ‘he ‘AyIya! era pitA Achena yini khuvai vRddha, kAjei tAra sthale AmAdera ekajanake rAkhuna, AmarA to ApanAke var3ai sadAcArI lokadera antarbhukta dekhachi|’
se valala, ‘yAra kAche AmAdera mAla peYechi tAke chAr3A anyake dharAra kAja theke AllAhara pAnAha cAcchi, tA karale AmarA yAlima hiseve parigaNita hava|’

yakhana tArA iusuphera nikaTa theke nirAza haYe gela takhana tArA nirjane giYe parAmarza karala| tAdera madhye vaYase savAra var3a bhAiTi valala, ‘tomarA ki jAna nA ye, tomAdera pitA tomAdera theke AllAhara nAme zapatha grahaNa karechena, Ara era pUrveo tomarA iusuphera vyApAre (tomAdera kartavya pAlane) vyartha haYecha, kAjei Ami kichutei ekhAna theke nar3avo nA yatakSaNa nA AmAra pitA AmAke anumati divena kiMvA AllAha AmAra vyApAre kona nirdeza divena, kenanA tini halena sarvottama phAYasAlAkArI|

tomarA tomAdera pitAra kAche phire yAo, giYe vala, ‘he AmAdera pitA! ApanAra chele curi kareche| AmarA yeTuku jAni tArai cAkSuSa vivaraNa dicchi, cokhera Ar3Alera ghaTanA tattvAvadhAna karAra kSamatA AmAdera nei|
AmarA ye janapade chilAma tAra vAsindAdera jijJesa karuna Ara ye kAphelAra saGge AmarA esechi tAderakeo, AmarA avazyai satyavAdI|’

i‘YAkuva valala, ‘nA, varaM tomarA nijerAi ekaTA kAhinI sAjiYe niYe esecha, kAjei dhairya dhAraNai AmAra janya zreYa, sambhavataH AllAha tAderake ekatre AmAra kAche ene devena| tini halena sarvajJa, var3ai prajJAmaYa|’
tini tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nilena Ara valalena, ‘iusuphera janya var3ai paritApa|’ zoke duHkhe tAra du’cokha sAdA haYe giYechila, Ara se asphuTa manastApe bhugachila|
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara zapatha! Apani iusuphera smaraNa tyAga karavena nA yatakSaNa nA Apani mumUrSu havena kiMvA Apani mRtyuvaraNa karena|
se valala, ‘Ami AmAra duHkha vedanA AllAhara kAchei nivedana karachi, Ara Ami AllAhara nikaTa hate yA jAni, tomarA tA jAna nA|
he AmAra chelerA! tomarA yAo, giYe iusupha Ara tAra bhAiYera kho~ja khavara lao, AllAhara rahamAta theke nirAza haYo nA, kenanA kAphira sampradAYa chAr3A AllAhara rahamAta hate keu nirAza haYa nA|’

yakhana tArA iusuphera daravAre upasthita hala, tArA valala, ‘he AyIya! AmAderake Ara AmAdera parivAravargake vipade ghire dhareche, Ara AmarA svalpa pu~ji niYe esechi, AmAderake pUrNa ojanera zaSya dina Ara AmAderake dAna khAYarAta karuna| AllAha dAnazIladerake puraskRta karena|’
se valala, ‘tomarA ki jAna tomarA iusupha Ara tAra bhAiYera saGge kemana vyavahAra karechile, yakhana tomarA ajJa-mUrkha chile?’

tArA valala, ‘tAhale tumii ki iusupha?’ se valala, ‘Amii iusupha Ara eTA hala AmAra bhAi| AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha karechena| ye vyakti tAkaoYA avalamvana kare Ara dhairyadhAraNa kare emana satkarmazIladera karmaphala AllAha kakSano vinaSTa karena nA|’
tArA valala, ‘AllAhara kasama! AllAha tomAke AmAdera upara maryAdA diYechena, AmarAi chilAma aparAdhI|’
se valala, ‘Aja tomAdera viruddhe AmAra konai abhiyoga nei, AllAha tomAderake mApha karuna! tini halena sarvazreSTha daYAlu|’
tomarA AmAra e jAmATi niYe yAo Ara tA AmAra pitAra mukhamanDale rAkha, tini dRSTizaktisampanna haYe uThavena, Ara tomAdera parivArera savAike AmAra kAche niYe eso|’
