yAtrIdala yakhana (misara theke) veriYe par3ala emana samaYe tAdera pitA (vAr3Ira lokajanake) valala, ‘tomarA AmAke vaYovRddha dizehArA mane nA karale (tomarA jene rAkha) Ami avazyai iusuphera ghrANa pAcchi|’
vAr3Ite upasthita vyaktirA valala, ‘AllAhara kasama! tumi to sei tomAra purano vibhrAntitei Acha dekhachi|’

susaMvAdadAtA yakhana ese hAyira hala, takhana se jAmATi i‘YAkuvera mukhamanDalera upara rAkhala, tAte se dRSTizakti phire pela| se valala, ‘Ami ki tomAdera valini ye, Ami AllAhara nikaTa hate yA jAni tA tomarA jAna nA|’
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pitA! AmAdera gunAhasamUha mAphira janya prArthanA karuna| AmarAi chilAma aparAdhI|’
se valala, ‘zIghrai Ami AmAra ravera kAche tomAdera kSamAra janya prArthanA jAnAva, tini to var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|’
tArA yakhana iusuphera kAche upasthita hala, se tAra pitA-mAtAke nijera kAche sthAna dila evaM valala, ‘AllAhara iccheYa pUrNa nirApattAYa misare praveza karuna|’

se tAra pitA-mAtAke siMhAsane uThiYe nila Ara sakale tAra sammAne sAjadAhaYa jhu~ke par3ala| iusupha valala, ‘he pitA! e-i hacche AmAra se Agera dekhA svapnera vyAkhyA| AmAra ravva eke satye pariNata karechena, tini AmAra prati anugraha karechena ye, tini AmAke kaYedakhAnA theke vera kare enechena| Ara zAitvAna AmAra Ara AmAra bhAidera madhye vibheda sRSTi karAra parao tini ApanAderake maru aJcala theke ekhAne (misare) ene diYechena| AmAra ravva yA karate icche karena tA sUkSNa upAYe vAstavAYita kare thAkena, tini var3ai vijJa, var3ai prajJAmaYa|

‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke rAjatva dAna karecha, Ara AmAke svapnera vyAkhyA zikhiYecha| AsamAna yamInera sRSTikartA! tumii duniYAYa Ara AkherAte AmAra abhibhAvaka, tumi musalima avasthAYa AmAra mRtyu dAna karo evaM AmAke satkarmazIladera antarbhukta karo|’
adRzya jagatera khavara theke eTA tomAke oYAhI kare jAnAlAma| Sar3ayantra karAra samaYa yakhana tArA tAdera kAje joTavaddha haYechila takhana tumi to tAdera kAche chile nA|
tumi yata pravala Agraha bharei cAo nA kena, mAnuSadera adhikAMzai ImAna Anave nA|
tumi tAra janya tAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAccha nA, eTA to vizvajagatera sakalera janya upadeza mAtra|
AsamAne Ara yamIne vahu nidarzana Ache yegulora upara diYe tArA (pratiniYata) atikrama kare kintu esava kichu theke tArA avajJA karache|
adhikAMza mAnuSa AllAhate vizvAsa kare, kintu sAthe sAthe zirakao kare|
tArA ki nizcinta ye, AllAhara sarvagrAsI ‘AyAva tAdera upara ese par3ave nA? kiMvA haThAt kviYAmAta tAdera upara ese par3ave nA yA tArA Terao pAve nA?
vala, ‘eTAi AmAra patha, AllAhara pathe AhavAna jAnAcchi, Ami o AmAra anusArIrA, spaSTa jJAnera mAdhyame| AllAha mahAna, pavitra; Ami kakSano muzarikadera madhye zAmila hava nA|

tomAra pUrve janapadavAsIdera madhye yAdera kAche oYAhI karatAma tArA puruSa mAnuSa vyatIta chila nA| tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa karataH dekhe nA ye, tAdera pUrvavartI lokedera pariNAma kI haYechila? yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, nizcitai paralokera ghara tAdera Aro uttama, tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?

(he nAvI! tomAra pUrveo emana ghaTeche ye,) zeSa paryanta rasUlagaNa nirAza haYeche, Ara lokerA mane kareche ye, tAderake mithye kathA valA haYeche, takhana tAdera (rAsUladera) kAche AmAra sAhAyya ese pau~cheche, ebhAvei Ami yAke icche rakSA kari| aparAdhI sampradAYa theke AmAra zAsti kakSano phiriYe neYA haYa nA|

edera kAhinIsamUhe vodhazaktisampanna mAnuSadera janya zikSaNIYa viSaYa Ache| e kuraAna kona mithye racanA naYa, varaM tAdera pUrve Agata kitAvera pratyaYanakArI Ara yAvatIYa viSaYera vistArita viraraNe samRddha, Ara mu’mina sampradAYera janya pathera dizArI o rahamAta|
Alipha-lAma-mIma-ra, egulo kitAvera AYAtasamUha, Ara tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa theke tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tA prakRta satya, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai ImAna Ane nA|

AllAhai stambha chAr3Ai AkAzamanDalIke Urdhve tule rekhechena, yA tomarA dekhacha, ataHpara tini Araze samunnata haYechena tinii sUrya o candrake niYamera vandhane vazIbhUta rekhechena, pratyekei nirdiSTa samaYera janya gatizIla Ache| yAvatIYa viSaYa tinii niYantraNa karena, tini nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA karena yAte tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera saGge sAkSAtera vyApAre dRr3ha vizvAsI hate pAra|

tinii yamInake vichiYe diYechena Ara tAte parvata o nadInAlA saMsthApita karechena, Ara tAte sakala prakArera phala jor3AYa jor3AYa sRSTi karechena| tini divasera upara rAtera AvaraNa Tene dena| cintAzIla sampradAYera janya ete avazyai nidarzanAvalI raYeche|

yamIne Ache vibhinna bhUkhanDa yA paraspara saMlagna, Ache AGgurera vAgAna, zasya kSeta, khejura gAcha- ekai mUla hate udgata Ara ekai mUla theke udagata naYa- yadio ekai pAnite sikta| khAoYAra svAde edera katakake katakera upara zreSThatva diYechi| jJAnI sampradAYera janya ete avazyai nidarzanAvalI raYeche|

tumi yadi vismaYavodha kara tave vismaYakara hala tAdera kathAH ‘AmarA yakhana mATite pariNata hava takhana ki AmAderake natunabhAve AvAra sRSTi karA have?’ tArA hala sei loka yArA tAdera pratipAlakake asvIkAra kare, edera galAYa Ache lohAra zikala, Ara erA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave|

kalyANera Age Age akalyANa niYe AsAra janya tomAra nikaTa tArA tAr3Ahur3A karache, edera pUrve era vahu dRSTAnta atIta haYeche| mAnuSa sImAlaGghana karaleo tomAra pratipAlaka tAdera prati avazyai kSamAzIla Ara tomAra pratipAlaka avazyai zAstidAneo kaThora|

yArA kuphurI kareche tArA vale, ‘tAra kAche tAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate kona nidarzana avatIrNa haYa nA kena?’ tumi to zudhu satarkakArI, Ara pratyeka sampradAYera janya raYeche ekajana saThika patha pradarzanakArI|
AllAha jAnena pratiTi nArI yA garbhe vahana kare, pratyeka garbhe yA kame vA vAr3e tAo, pratiTi jinisa tA~ra kAche Ache parimANa mata|
gopana o prakAzya samparke tini jJAta, tini mahAna, sarvocca|
tomAdera keu kathA gopana kare vA prakAza kare, keu rAte lukiYe thAke vA dine prakAzye calApherA kare, savAi tA~ra kAche samAna|

mAnuSera sAmane o pechane pAhArAdAra niyukta Ache yArA AllAhara hukuma motAveka tAke rakSaNAvekSaNa kare| AllAha kona sampradAYera avasthA parivartana karena nA yatakSaNa nA tArA nijerAi tAdera avasthA parivartana kare| AllAha kona sampradAYera akalyANa karate cAile tA rada karAra keu nei, Ara tini chAr3A tAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei|
tinii tomAderake dekhAna vidyut bhItikara o AzA saJcAraka| tinii uttolita karena megha, (pravRddhira) vRSTite bhArAkrAnta|

vajranAda tA~rai bhaYe tA~ra prazaMsA varNanA kare Ara pherezatArAo| tini garjanakArI vajra preraNa karena Ara tA diYe yAke icche AghAta karena, Ara tArA AllAha samparke vitanDAYa lipta haYa| athaca tini var3ai zaktizAlI|

satyikAra AhavAna-prArthanA tA~rai prApya, yArA tA~ke chAr3A anyake DAke, tArA tAderake konai javAva deYa nA| tArA hala ai lokera mata, ye tAra mukhe pAni pau~chave bheve pAnira dike hAta prasArita kare deYa, athaca se pAni tAra mukhe kakSano pau~chave nA| kAphiradera AhavAna niSphala vyatIta naYa|
AsamAne Ara yamIne yA kichu Ache icchAYa vA anicchAYa sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAhara prati sAjadAhaYa avanata haYa Ara tAdera chAYAguloo| [sAjadAha]

vala, AkAza o yamInera pratipAlaka ke? vala, AllAha| vala, tomarA ki tA~ke vAda diYe emana abhibhAvaka grahaNa karecha yAdera nijedera kona lAbha-lokasAna karAra kSamatA nei| vala, andha o cakSuSmAna ki samAna? kiMvA andhakAra Ara Alo ki samAna? kiMvA tArA ki AllAhara aMzIdAra vAniYeche tAderake yArA tA~ra sRSTira mata sRSTi kareche, ye kAraNe sRSTi tAdera kAche samAna mane haYeche? vala, AllAha savakichura sRSTikartA, tini eka, mahA pratApazAlI|

tini AkAza theke vRSTi varSaNa karena yAra phale upatyakAgulo parimitabhAve plAvita haYa, plAvaNe uparibhAge phenA jame uThe, Ara e rakama phenA jame uThe yakhana alaGkAra o taijasapatra vAnAnora janya segulo Agune galAno haYa| ebhAve AllAha prakRta satya o mithyAra dRSTAnta varNanA kare thAkena| phenA khar3akuTora mata ur3e yAYa, Ara yA mAnuSera janya upakArI tA yamIne sthitizIla haYa| ebhAve AllAha dRSTAnta diYe (mAnuSake vujhiYe) thAkena|

yArA tAdera pratipAlakera DAke sAr3A deYa tAdera janya Ache (yAvatIYa) kalyANa| yArA tA~ra DAke sAr3A deYa nA, tArA yadi duniYAte yA kichu Ache ye savera mAlika haYa evaM Aro ata parimANao tAdera haYa, nijedera muktira vinimaYe tA savai tArA dite cAive, tAdera hisAva have var3ai kaThina, tAdera AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma, Ara tA katai nA nikRSTa ThikAnA!
ye vyakti jAne ye, tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa theke tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tA satya, se ki ai vyaktira samAna ye andha? vuddhimAna lokerAi upadeza grahaNa kare thAke
yArA AllAhake deYA tAdera o‘YAdA rakSA kare Ara pratizruti bhaGga kare nA|
tArA se sava samparka samvandha vahAla rAkhe yA vahAla rAkhAra janya AllAha nirdeza diYechena| tArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare evaM bhaYAvaha hisAva nikAzake bhaYa pAYa|

tArA tAdera pratipAlakera cehArA (santuSTi) kAmanAYa dhairya dhAraNa kare, nAmAya pratiSThA kare, Ara Ami tAderake ye jIvikA diYechi tAttheke gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare| tArA anyAYake nyAYa dvArA pratirodha kare| parakAlera ghara prApti edera janyai nirdiSTa|

tA hala sthAya়I jAnnAta, tAte tArA praveza karave| Ara tAdera pitR puruSa, svAmI-strI o santAnAdira madhye yArA satkarma kareche tArAo| Ara pherezatArA sakala darajA diya়e tAdera kAche hAjira haya়e saMvardhanA jAnAve (ei vale ye)-
‘‘tomAdera prati zAnti varSita hoka, kAraNa tomarA dhairyadhAraNa karechile| katai nA uttama parakAlera ei ghara!’’

Ara yArA AllAhara sAthe zakta o‘YAdA karAra para tA bhaGga kare, AllAha yA vahAla rAkhAra nirdeza diYechena tA chinna kare, Ara yamIne azAnti sRSTi kare, tAdera prati abhizApa, tAdera janya Ache atizaYa manda AvAsasthala|

AllAha riyaka samprasArita karena yAra janya icche karena, Ara yAra janya cAna sImita parimANe dena| tArA pArthiva jIvane Anande mete Ache athaca AkherAtera tulanAYa duniYAra jIvana ati nagaNya vastu|

satya pratyAkhyAnakArIrA vale, ‘tAra kAche tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate kona nidarzana avatIrNa haYa nA kena?’ vala, ‘AllAha yAke icche gumarAha karena, Ara ye tA~ra abhimukhI tAke satya pathe paricAlita karena|’
tArAi ImAna Ane evaM AllAhara smaraNe tAdera antara prazAnti lAbha kare| jene rekha, AllAhara smaraNera mAdhyamei dilera satyikArera prazAnti lAbha karA yAYa|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare, saubhAgya tAderai, uttama pariNAma tAdera janyai|

(pUrve yemana pAThiYechilAma) ebhAvei Ami tomAke emana eka sampradAYera kAche pAThiYechi yAra pUrve aneka sampradAYa gata haYe geche, yAte tumi tAdera kAche telAoYAta kara yA Ami tomAra prati oYAhI kari, tavuo tArA daYAmaYa AllAhake asvIkAra kare| vala, ‘tini AmAra pratipAlaka, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, Ami tA~ra uparai nirbhara kari Ara tinii pratyAvartanasthala|’

kuraAna diYe parvatake yadi gatizIla karA yeta, kiMvA yamInake dIrNa karA yeta kiMvA tA diYe mRta mAnuSake kathA valAno yeta (tavuo tArA tAte vizvAsa karata nA)| (Alaukika kichu karA mAnuSera sAdhyAtIta) varaM samasta kichui AllAhara kSamatAbhukta| yArA ImAna eneche tArA ki jAne nA ye, AllAha icche karale sakala mAnuSake sat pathe paricAlita karate pAratena| yArA kuphurI kare tAdera kAryakalApera kAraNe tAdera upara kona nA kona vipada Asatei thAke kiMvA tAdera gharera AzepAzei nAyila hate thAke, yatakSaNa nA AllAhara o‘YAdA pUrNa haYa| nizcaYai AllAha oYAdAra vyatikrama karena nA|

tomAra Ageo vahu rasUlake ThATTA-vidrUpa karA haYechila, takhana Ami kAphiraderake (icchemata kAja cAliYe yAoYAra) avakAza diYechilAma, avazeSe tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilAma| kemana (bhaYAvaha) chila AmAra zAsti!

pratyeka prANIra upArjanera prati yini dRSTi rAkhena (tini ki tAdera akSama ilAhadera mata?) athaca tArA AllAhara zarIka nirdiSTa kare rekheche| vala, ‘tAdera nAma vala (yAderake tomarA AllAhara aMzIdAra mane kara), tomarA ki pRthivIra emana kona saMvAda tA~ke dite cAo yA tini jAnena nA| nAki egulo kevala kathAra pradarzanI? prakRta vyApAra hala, kAphiradera nikaTa tAdera kalA kauzalake AkarSaNIYa kare deYA haYeche Ara tAderake sat patha theke virata rAkhA haYeche| AllAha yAke gumarAha karena tA~ke patha dekhAnora keu nei|
duniYAra jIvane tAdera janya Ache zAsti, Ara AkherAtera zAsti avazyai Aro vezi kaThina| AllAhara zAsti theke vA~cAnora tAdera keu nei|

muttAkIderake ye jAnnAtera oya়A‘dA deya়A haya়eche tAra dRSTAnta ei ye, tAra taladeza diya়e jharNAdhArA pravAhita, tAra phalaphalAdi cirasthAya়I Ara tAra chAya়Ao| yArA tAkoya়A avalamvana kare tAdera pariNAma have ei| Ara kAphiradera pariNati have jAhAnnAmera Aguna|

Ami yAderake kitAva diYechilAma tArA tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tAte utphulla, kintu kataka dala tAra kona kona kathA mAne nA| vala, ‘Ami AllAhara ‘ivAdAta karAra janya evaM tA~ra sAthe kona kichu zArIka nA karAra janya nirdezaprApta haYechi, Ami tA~ra dikei AhavAna jAnAi, Ara AmAra pratyAvartana tA~ra dikei|

ebhAve Ami eke vidhAnarUpe nAyila karechi AravI bhASAYa| tomAra kAche jJAna AsAra pareo tumi yadi tAdera khAhezera anusaraNa kara, tave AllAhara mokAvAlAYa tomAra kona abhibhAvaka thAkave nA, thAkave nA kona rakSAkArI|

Ami tomAra pUrveo rasUlagaNake pAThiya়echilAma, Ara tAderake diya়echilAma strI o santAnAdi, AllAhara hukuma vyatIta nidarzana hAjira karAra zakti kona rasUlera nei| yAvatIya় viSaya়era nirdiSTa samaya় lipivaddha Ache|
AllAha yA icche karena nizcihna kare dena Ara yA icche pratiSThita rAkhena, ummula kitAva tA~ra nikaTai rakSita|

Ami tAderake ye zAsti deYAra oYA‘dA karechi tAra kichu yadi tomAke dekhAi kiMvA (dekhAnora pUrvei) tomAra mRtyu ghaTAi, (ubhaYa avasthAtei) tomAra dAYitva hala pracAra kare deYA, Ara hiseva neYAra kAja hala AmAra|
tArA ki dekhe nA Ami tAdera janya yamInake cAra dika theke saMkIrNa kare Anachi? AllAha hukuma dena, tA~ra hukuma pechane Thele deve emana keu nei| hiseva grahaNera vyApAre tini khuvai drutagati|
odera Age yArA chila tArAo cakrAnta karechila, yAvatIYa cakrAnta AllAhara AYattAdhIna| tini jAnena pratyeka vyakti kI kAmAi karache| Ara kAphiragaNa acirei jAnate pArave bhAla pariNAma kAdera janya|
kAphirarA vale, ‘tumi AllAhara prerita nao|’ vala, ‘AmAra o tomAdera mAjhe sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa evaM yAdera kitAvera jJAna Ache tArAo|’
Alipha-lAma-ra, ekaTA kitAva yA tomAra prati avatIrNa karechi yAte tumi mAnuSake tAdera pratipAlakera nirdeze andhakAra theke niYe Asate pAra Alora dike- mahAparAkramazAlI prazaMsitera pathe|
AllAha- AsamAnasamUhe yA kichu Ache Ara pRthivIte yA kichu Ache, savai tA~ra mAlikAnAdhIna| kintu kAphiradera janya Ache kaThina zAstira durbhoga|
yArA AkherAtera tulanAYa duniYAra jindigIke zreYa jJAna kare, yArA AllAhara patha theke (lokaderake) virata rAkhe Ara tAte vakratA AnAra AkAGkSA poSaNa kare| erA gomarAhIte vahu dUre cale geche|

Ami kona rasUlakei tAra jAtira bhASA chAr3A pAThAini yAte tAdera kAche spaSTabhAve (AmAra nirdezagulo) varNanA karate pAre| ataHpara AllAha yAke icche pathahArA karechena, Ara yAke icche saThika patha dekhiYechena, tini var3ai parAkrAnta, vijJAnamaYa|

Ara avazyai Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzanasamUha diYe pAThiYechilAma Ara valechilAma, tomAra jAtike andhakAra theke Alote vera kare Ana, Ara tAderake AllAhara hukume ghaTita atItera ghaTanAvalI diYe upadeza dAo| ete pratyeka parama sahiSNu o parama kRtajJa vyaktira janya avazyai nidarzanasamUha raYeche|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra sampradAYake valechila, ‘tomarA tomAdera prati AllAhara ni‘mAtera kathA smaraNa kara yakhana tini tomAderake phira‘AonI goSThI theke rakSA karechilena yArA tomAderake jaghanya rakamera zAstite piSTa karachila| tomAdera putraderake tArA hatyA karata Ara tomAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhata| eTA chila tomAdera janya AllAhara pakSa hate eka kaThina parIkSA|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAdera pratipAlaka ghoSaNA karena, yadi tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara tAhale Ami avazyai tomAdera janya (AmAra ni‘YAmAta) vRddhi kare deva, Ara yadi tomarA akRtajJa hao (tave jene rekha, akRtajJadera janya) AmAra zAsti avazyai kaThina|
mUsA valechila, tomarA Ara duniYAra sakala loka yadi akRtajJa hao (tAte kichui yAYa Ase nA) kAraNa AllAha amukhApekSI, prazaMsita|

tomAdera pUrvekAra lokedera khavara ki tomAdera kAche pau~cheni? nUha, ‘Ada Ara sAmUda sampradAYera, Ara tAdera paravartIdera; tAdera samparke AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA| rasUlagaNa tAdera kAche spaSTa nidarzanAsamUha niYe esechila, takhana tArA nijedera mukhe hAta cepe dharala Ara valala, ‘ye jinisa diYe tomAderake pAThAno haYeche tA AmarA asvIkAra kari Ara ye viSaYera prati tomarA AmAderake AhavAna jAnAccha se samparke AmarA vibhrAntikara sandehera madhye raYechi|’

tAdera rasUlagaNa valechila, ‘AllAha samparke sandeha? yini AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sRSTikartA, tini tomAderake DAkachena tomAdera aparAdha mArjanA karAra janya Ara ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta tomAderake avakAza deYAra janya|’ tArA valala, ‘tumi AmAderai mata mAnuSa vai to nao, AmAdera pUrvapuruSarA yAra ‘ivAdAta karata tAttheke AmAderake tumi vAdhA dite cAo, tAhale tumi (tomAra dAvIra svapakSe) AmAdera kAche suspaSTa pramANa upasthita kara|

tAdera rasUlagaNa tAderake valechila, ‘yadio AmarA tomAdera matai mAnuSa vyatIta nai, kintu AllAha tA~ra vAndAhadera madhye yAra upara icche anugraha karena| AllAhara hukuma chAr3A tomAdera kAche kona pramANa upasthita karA AmAdera kAja naYa| mu’minadera ucita AllAharai upara bharasA karA|

AmarA AllAhara upara bharasA karava nA kena, tinii to AmAderake patha dekhiYechena, tomarA AmAderake ye klezai dAonA kena, AmarA tAte avazya avazyai dhairya dhAraNa karava, Ara bharasAkArIdera AllAharai upara bharasA karA ucita|

kAphiragaNa tAdera rasUladera valechila, ‘AmarA tomAderake AmAdera deza theke avazya avazyai vera kare deva, anyathAYa tomAderake avazya avazyai AmAdera dharmamate phire Asate have|’ ematAvasthAYa rasUladera prati tAdera pratipAlaka e marme oYAhI karalena ye, ‘Ami yAlimaderake avazya avazyai dhvaMsa karava|

Ara tAdera pare tomAderake avazya avazyai yamIne punarvAsita karava| e (zubha) saMvAda tAdera janya yArA AmAra sAmane ese dA~r3Anora vyApAre bhaYa rAkhe Ara AmAra zAstira bhaYa dekhAnote zaMkita haYa|’
tArA (arthAt kAphirarA) cUr3Anta vijaYera phAYasAlA kAmanA karechila, kintu (AllAha o tA~ra rasUladera virodhitA karAra kAraNe) pratyeka uddhata sImAlaGghanakArI vyartha haYe gela|
edera janya paravartIte Ache jAhAnnAma, Ara ederake pAna karAno have galita pu~ja|
se tA khuva kaSTa kare gilate ceSTA karave, Ara khuva kamai gilate pArave| mRtyu yantraNA tAra kAche caturdika theke Asave kintu se marave nA, erapara tAra janya thAkave eka kaThina ‘AyAva|

yArA tAdera pratipAlakake asvIkAra kare tAdera ‘AmAlera dRSTAnta hala sei chAiYera mata yA jhar3era dine vAtAsa pracanDa vege ur3iYe niYe yAYa| nijedera upArjanera kichui tArA kAje lAgAte pAre nA| eTAi ghora gumarAhI|
tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAha yathAyatha niYama vidhAnasaha AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena, tini cAile tomAderake sariYe divena Ara eka natuna sRSTi niYe Asavena|
eTA AllAhara janya kaThina kichu naYa|

tArA sakale AllAhara nikaTa upasthita have| takhana yArA ahaGkAra karechila tAderake durvalarA valave, AmarA to tomAderai anusArI chilAma, kAjei ekhana AllAhara zAstira kona kichu AmAdera theke tomarA dUra karate pAra ki?’ tArA valave, ‘AllAha AmAderake satyapathe paricAlita karale AmarAo avazyai tomAderake satya patha dekhAtAma| ekhana AmarA dhairyahArA hai kiMvA dhairyadhAraNa kari du’Toi AmAdera janya samAna, AmAdera kona niSkRti nei|’

vicAra-phAYasAlA sampanna hale zaYatvAna valave, ‘AllAha tomAdera janya ye oYA‘dA karechilena tA chila satya oYA‘dA| Ara Amio tomAderake oYA‘dA diYechilAma, kintu Ami tAra khelApa karechi, tomAdera upara AmAra konai prabhAva chila nA, Ami kevala tomAderake AhavAna jAniYechilAma Ara tomarA AmAra AhavAne sAr3A diYechile| kAjei tomarA AmAke tiraskAra karo nA, varaM nijederakei tiraskAra kara, ekhAne nA Ami tomAdera phariYAda zunate pAri, nA tomarA AmAra phariYAda zunate pAra| itopUrve tomarA ye AmAke (AllAhara) zarIka karechile Ami tA asvIkAra karachi| yAlimadera janya Ache bhaYAvaha zAsti|’

yArA ImAna Ane Ara sat kAja kare tAderake jAnnAte dAkhila karA have yAra taladeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita| sekhAne tArA tAdera pratipAlakera anumatikrame cirakAla thAkave| sekhAne tAderake zAntira vArtA diYe saMvardhanA jJApana karA have|
tumi ki dekha nA kIbhAve AllAha dRSTAnta upasthApana karena? utkRSTa vAkyera tulanA utkRSTa gAchera nyAYa yAra mUla sudRr3habhAve sthApita Ara zAkhA-prazAkhA AkAzapAne vistRta|
tAra pratipAlakera hukume tA sava samaYa phala dAna kare| mAnuSadera janya AllAha dRSTAnta varNanA karena yAte tArA zikSA grahaNa kare|
manda vAkya manda vRkSera saGge tulanIYa, bhUpRSThera uparibhAgei yAke mUla theke upar3e phelA haYeche, yAra kona sthAYitva nei|
yArA ImAna eneche tAderake AllAha supratiSThita vANIra avalamvane duniYAra jIvane o AkherAte pratiSThita rAkhavena Ara yAlimaderake AllAha dhvaMsa kare devena| tini yA icche karena tAi karena|
tumi ki tAdera vyApAre cintA kara nA yArA AllAhara anugrahera vinimaYe akRtajJatAra nIti avalamvana kare Ara tAdera jAtike dhvaMsera ghare nAmiYe Ane|
(tA hala) jAhAnnAma, tAte tArA praveza karave, vasavAsera e jAYagA katai nA nikRSTa!
Ara tArA (anyake) AllAhara samakakSa sthira kare tA~ra patha theke vipathagAmI karAra uddezye| vala, ‘bhoga kare nAo, zeSa paryanta jAhAnnAmei tomAderake phire yete have|

AmAra vAndAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche tAderake vala nAmAya pratiSThA karate Ara ye jIvikA Ami tAderake diYechi tAttheke gopane o prakAzye vyaYa karate- sedina AsAra pUrve yedina nA calave kona kenA-vecA Ara nA kona vandhutva|

tinii AllAha yini AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena, tini AkAza hate pAni varSaNa karena yA diYe nAnA prakAra phalaphalAdi janme tomAdera jIvikAra janya| tini nauyAnaguloke tomAdera niYantraNAdhIna kare diYechena, yAte segulo tA~ra nirdeze samudre calAcala kare Ara tini nadIguloke tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena|
tini sUrya o candrake tomAdera kAje lAgiYe rekhechena, tArA anugata haYe nija pathe calache| Ara tini rAta o dinake tomAdera kAje lAgiYe rekhechena|

tini tomAderake se sava kichui diYechena yA tomarA ceYecha (tomarA tomAdera praYojanIYa sava kichui peYecha) Ara tomarA AllAhara anugraha gaNanA karate cAile kakSano tAra saMkhyA nirdhAraNa karate pArave nA| mAnuSa avazyai var3ai yAlima, var3ai akRtajJa|
smaraNa kara, ivarAhIma yakhana valechila, ‘he AmAra ravva! tumi e nagarIke nirApada kara Ara AmAke Ara AmAra santAnaderake pratimA pUjA theke rakSA kara|

he AmAra pratipAlaka! e (pratimA)-gulo vahu saMkhyaka mAnuSake pathabhraSTa kareche| kAjei (pratimAguloke vAda diYe) yArA AmAke anusaraNa karave tArA AmAra dalabhukta| Ara ye AmAra avAdhya have sekSetre tumi to var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Ami AmAra santAnadera ekAMzake zasyakSetahIna upatyakAYa tomAra sammAnita gharera nikaTa punarvAsita karalAma| he AmAra pratipAlaka! tArA yAte nAmAya kAYima kare| kAjei tumi mAnuSera antarake tAdera prati anurAgI kare dAo Ara phala-phalAdi diYe tAdera jIvikAra vyavasthA kara yAte tArA zukariYA AdAYa kare|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi to jAna yA AmarA gopana kari Ara yA prakAza kari, AsamAna o yamInera kona vastui AllAha hate gopana nei|
yAvatIYa prazaMsA AllAhara yini AmAra vArdhakya avasthAYa AmAke isamAIla o isahAkake dAna karechena, AmAra pratipAlaka avazyai AhavAna zravaNakArI|
he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke nAmAya pratiSThAkArI vAnAo Ara AmAra santAnaderakeo, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAra prArthanA kavUla kara|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! hisAva grahaNera dina AmAke, AmAra pitA-mAtAke Ara mu’minaderake kSamA kare dio,
yAlimarA yA karache se vyApAre tomarA AllAhake kakSano udAsIna mane kara nA| tini tAderake sedina paryanta Dhila dicchena yedina bhaYe AtaGke cakSu sthira haYe yAve|
AtaGkita haYe mAthA tule pAlAte thAkave, dRSTi tAdera nijedera pAne phire Asave nA, Ara tAdera dila ur3e yAve|

kAjei mAnuSake satarka kara sedinera vyApAre yedina tAdera upara ‘AyAva Asave| yArA yulama karechila tArA takhana valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake alpadinera janya samaYa dAo, AmarA tomAra AhavAne sAr3A diva Ara rasUladera kathA mene calava|’ (takhana tAderake valA have) tomarA ki pUrve zapatha kare valani ye, tomAdera kakSano patana ghaTave nA?

athaca tomarA sei lokagulora vAsabhUmite vasavAsa karachile yArA nijedera prati yulama karechila Ara tomAderake spaSTa kare dekhiYe deYA haYechila Ami tAdera saGge kemana vyavahAra karechilAma| Ara Ami vahu udAharaNa Tene tomAderake vujhiYeo diYechilAma|
tArA ye cakrAnta karechila tA chila satyii bhaYAnaka, kintu tAdera cakrAnta AllAhara dRSTira bhitarei chila, yadio tAdera cakrAntagulo emana chila nA ye, tAte parvatao Tale yeta|
(avasthA yatai pratikUla hoka nA kena) tumi kakSano mane kara nA ye, AllAha tA~ra rasUlagaNake deYA oYA‘dA khelApa karavena, AllAha mahA pratApazAlI, pravala pratizodha grahaNakArI|
yedina e pRthivI vadale giYe anya eka pRthivIte rUpAntarita have Ara AsamAnasamUhao (vadale yAve), Ara mAnuSa samusthApita have eka o apratirodhya AllAhara sammukhe|
sedina tumi aparAdhIderake dekhave zRGkhale tAdera hAta pA zakta kare vA~dhA|
tAdera pozAka have AlakAtarAra Ara Aguna tAdera mukhamanDala Acchanna karave|
(eTA karA have ejanya) yAte AllAha pratyeka vyaktike tAra kRtakarmera pratiphala dite pArena| AllAha to hisAva grahaNe khuvai drutagati|
eTA mAnuSadera janya ekaTA vArtA yAra dvArA tAderake satarka karA hacche Ara yAte tArA jAnate pAre ye, tini eka ilAha Ara yAte vuddhimAna mAnuSerA upadeza lAbha kare|
Alipha-lAma-ra, egulo kitAvera evaM suspaSTa kuraAne AYAtasamUha|
emana ekaTA samaYa Asave yakhana kAphiragaNa AkSepa kare valave, ‘hAYa, AmarA yadi musalima haYe yetAma!’
cher3e dAo oderake, orA khete thAka Ara bhoga karate thAka, Ara (mithye) AzA oderake udAsInatAYa DuviYe rAkhuka, zIghrai orA (odera ‘AmAlera pariNati) jAnate pArave|
Ami ye janapadakei dhvaMsa karechi tAdera janya chila likhita ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYa|
kona jAtii tAdera nirdiSTa kAlake agra-pazcAt karate pAre nA|
tArA vale, ‘ohe ai vyakti yAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa haYeche! tumi to avazyai pAgala|
tumi satyavAdI hale AmAdera nikaTa pherezatAdera hAjira karacha nA kena?’
yathAyatha kAraNa chAr3A Ami pherezatA pAThAi nA, pAThAle kAphiraderake Ara kona avakAza deYA have nA|
nizcaYa Amii kuraAna nAyila karechi Ara avazyai Ami tAra saMrakSaka|
tomAra pUrvavartI jAtigulora kAcheo Ami rasUla pAThiYechilAma|
tAdera kAche emana kona rasUla Aseni yAke tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa kareni|
ebhAve Ami e rakama AcaraNa pApIdera antare vaddhamUla kare dei|
tArA era prati ImAna Anave nA, pUrvavartI lokederao e niYama-nIti cale eseche|
yadi tAdera janya AkAzera darajA khule deYA hata, Ara tArA tAte uThate thAkata,
tArA avazyai valata, ‘AmAdera cokhake vA~dhiYe deYA haYeche, varaM AmAdera upara yAdu karA haYeche|’
Ami AkAze graha-nakSatra sRSTi karechi Ara darzakadera janya tA susajjita kare diYechi|
Ara pratyeka abhizapta zaYatvAna theke seguloke surakSita kare diYechi|
kintu keu curi kare (khavara) zunate cAile ujjvala agnizikhA tAra pazcAddhAvaNa kare|
Ara pRthivI, Ami seTAke vichiYe diYechi Ara tAte parvatarAji saMsthApita karechi Ara tAte sakala vastu udagata karechi yathAyatha parimANe|
Ara tAte tomAdera jIvana dhAraNera vyavasthA karechi Ara tAderao yAdera riyakadAtA tomarA nao|
emana kona jinisai nei yAra bhAnDAra AmAra kAche nei, kintu Ami segulo AmAra jJAna motAveka nirdiSTa parimANe saravarAha kare thAki|
Ami vRSTi-saJcArI vAtAsa preraNa kari, ataHpara AsamAna theke pAni varSaNa kari Ara tA tomAdera pAna karAi, tomarA tAra sTora kIpAra nao|
Amii jIvana dei Ara mRtyu ghaTAi Ara Amii cUr3Anta uttarAdhikArI|
tomAdera madhyekAra yArA pUrve gata haYe geche Ami tAderake jAni Ara pare yArA Asave tAderakeo jAni|
avazyai tomAra pratipAlaka tini savavAike ekatrita karavena, tini mahAvijJAnI, sarvajJa|
Ami kAla zuSka ThanaThane mATira gAr3A theke mAnuSake sRSTi karechi|
era pUrve Ami jvInake Agunera lelihAna Aguna theke sRSTi karechi|
smaraNa kara yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka pherezatAderake valechilena, ‘Ami kAla zuSka ThanaThane mATira kAdA theke mAnuSa sRSTi karachi|
Ami yakhana tAke pUrNa mAtrAYa vAniYe deva Ara tAte AmAra pakSa hate rUha phu~ke deva, takhana tomarA tAra prati sAjadAYa par3e yeo|
takhana pherezatArA savAi sAjadAha karala|
ivalIsa vAde, se sAjadAhkArIdera dalabhukta hate asvIkRti jAnAla|
AllAha valalena, ‘he ivalIsa! tomAra kI hala ye tumi sAjadAhakArIdera dalabhukta hale nA?’
ivalIsa valala, ‘AmAra kAja naYa mAnuSake sAjadAh karA yAke tumi pacA kardamera ThanaThane gAr3A theke sRSTi karecha|’
tini valalena, ‘veriYe yAo ekhAna theke, kAraNa tumi hale abhizapta|
vicAra divasa paryanta tomAra upara thAkala lA‘nata|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! punarutthAna divasa paryanta AmAke samaYa dina|’
tini valalena, ‘tomAke samaYa deYA hala
sedina paryanta yAra nirdiSTa kSaNa AmAra jAnA Ache|’

se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! yehetu Apani AmAke bhrAntapathe Thele dilena, kAjei Amio pRthivIte mAnuSera kAche pApakAjake avazya avazyai suzobhita kare dekhAva Ara tAdera savAike avazya avazyai vibhrAnta karava|
kintu tAdera madhye ApanAra vAchAi karA vAndAhadera chAr3A|’
tini valalena- (AmAra vAchAi karA vAndArA ye pathe calache) eTAi AmAra kAche pau~chAra sarala sojA patha|
AmAra prakRta vAndAhdera upara tomAra kona Adhipatya calave nA, tomAke yArA anusaraNa kare sei vibhrAntarA chAr3A|
Ara tAdera savAra janya avazyai oYA‘dAkRta sthAna hacche jAhAnnAma|
tAra sAtaTA darajA Ache| pratyeka darajAra janya tAdera madhye zreNI nirdiSTa Ache|’
avazyai muttAkIrA thAkave jAnnAte Ara nirjhariNIgulora madhye|
tAderake valA have, ‘pUrNa zAnti o nirApattAra sAthe tomarA ete praveza kara|’
tAdera antara theke Ami vidveSa dUrIbhUta karava, tArA bhrAtRvandhane Avaddha haYe Asane mukhomukhI samAsIna have|
kona klAnti tAderake sparza karave nA, Ara sekhAna theke tArA kakhanao vahiSkRtao have nA|
AmAra vAndAhaderake saMvAda dAo ye, Ami var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|
Ara AmAra zAsti- tA var3ai bhaYAvaha zAsti|
tAderake ivarAhImera mehamAnera kAhinI jAniYe dAo|
tArA yakhana tAra kAche upasthita hala takhana tArA valala, ‘tomAra prati sAlAma|’ takhana se valala, ‘tomAdera dekhe AmarA zaMkita|’
tArA valala, ‘zaMkA karo nA, AmarA tomAke eka jJAnI putrera sukhavara dicchi|’
se valala, ‘vArdhakya yakhana AmAke sparza kareche takhana tomarA AmAke sukhavara diccha| AcchA, tomAdera sukhavaraTA kI?’
tArA valala, ‘tomAke AmarA prakRtai susaMvAda dicchi| kAjei tumi nirAzadera antarbhukta haYo nA|’
se valala, ‘pathabhraSTarA chAr3A Ara ke tAra pratipAlakera rahamAta theke nirAza haYa?’
se valala, ‘he AllAhara preritarA! tomarA kon kAje Agamana karecha?’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA eka aparAdhI jAtira viruddhe prerita haYechi|
tave lUtera parivAra vAde, tAdera savAike AmarA avazyai rakSA karava|
tave tAra strIke naYa, AmarA (AllAhara nirdezakrame) tAra janya nirdhArita kare diYechi ye, se pechane theke yAoYA lokedera madhye zAmila thAkave|’
AllAhara preritarA yakhana lUta parivArera nikaTa Asala,
se valala, ‘ApanAderake to aparicita loka mane hacche|’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA tA-i niYe esechi ye vyApAre e lokerA sandehe patita chila|
tomAra kAche AmarA satya niYei esechi, Ara AmarA avazyai satyavAdI|

kAjei kichuTA rAta thAkate tumi tomAra parivAravargake niYe veriYe par3a Ara tumi tAdera pechane pechane calate thAka| tomAdera keu yena pechane phire nA tAkAYa varaM yekhAne yete valA hacche cale yAo|’
Ami lUtake e siddhAnta jAniYe dilAma ye, sakAla hate nA hatei samUle dhvaMsa karA have|
zaharera lokerA Ananda sahakAre (lUtera ghare) upasthita hala|
lUta valala, ‘erA AmAra mehamAna, kAjei tomarA AmAke lAJchita karo nA|
tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, AmAke lajjita karo nA|’
tArA valala, duniYAvyApI viSaYa niYe kathA valate AmarA ki tomAke niSedha karini?’
(lUta (A.)) valala, ‘tomarA yadi kichu karatei cAo tAhale ei AmAra (jAtira) kanyArA Ache|’
tomAra jIvanera zapatha he nAvI! tArA unmatta nezAYa AtmahArA haYe par3echila|
sUryodaYera samaYe eka pracanDa dhvani tAdera upara AghAta hAnala|
Ara Ami se janapadake ulTe (upara-nIca) kare dilAma Ara tAdera upara pAkAno mATira prastara varSaNa karalAma|
ete avazyai antardRSTisampanna lokedera janya aneka nidarzana raYeche|
eTi mAnuSera calAcala pathera pAzei vidyamAna|
mu’minadera janya ete var3ai nidarzana raYeche|
Ara AYakAhavAsIrAo avazyai yAlima chila|
kAjei tAdera upara pratizodha niYechilAma, e du’To janapadai prakAzya pathera upara avasthita|
hijara-era lokerAo rasUladerake amAnya karechila|
Ami tAderake AmAra nidarzanAvalI diYechilAma kintu tAttheke tArA mukha phiriYei rekhechila|
tArA pAhAr3a khodAi karataH ghara tairi kare nijederake nirApada bhAvata|
ataHpara eka sakAle pracanDa dhvani tAdera upara AghAta hAnala|
tAdera upArjana tAdera kona kAje Asala nA|
Ami AsamAnasamUha, yamIna Ara e du’Yera mAjhe yA kichu Ache prakRta uddezya chAr3A sRSTi karini| kviYAmAta avazyai Asave, kAjei uttama panthAYa (tAderake) er3iYe yAo|
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka tini sarvasraSTA, sarvajJa|
Ami tomAke diYechi punaH punaH AvRtta sapta AYAta Ara mahA kuraAna|

tumi duniYAra dravya sAmagrIra prati cokha tule tAkio nA yA Ami tAdera vibhinna lokedera diYechi| (tArA bhula cintA o bhula karmera mAdhyame nijedera bhaYAvaha pariNAma Deke Anache, ematAvasthAYa) tAdera janya tumi duHkha karo nA, Ara mu’minadera janya tomAra (anukampAra) DAnA mele dAo|
Ara vale dAo, ‘Ami to spaSTa bhASAYa satarkakArI mAtra|’
ye dharanera satarkIkaraNa pAThAno haYechila (AllAhara kitAvake) vibhaktakArI (iYAhUdI o khrIsTAna)dera upara|
yArA kuraAnake (nijedera kheYAla khuzimata) bhAga bhAga kare pheleche (yeTA icche mAnache, yeTA icche amAnya karache)|
ataeva zapatha tomAra ravvera! tAdera savavAike avazya avazyai Ami jijJesa karava |
tArA yA karache se samparke|
kAjei tomAke ye viSaYera hukuma deYA haYeche tA jore zore prakAzye pracAra kara, Ara muzarikadera theke mukha phiriYe nAo|
(sei) ThATTA-vidrUpakArIdera viruddhe tomAra janya Amii yatheSTa
yArA AllAhara sAthe anyakeo ilAha vAniYe niYeche, (kAjei zirakera pariNati kI) zIghrai tArA jAnate pArave|
Ami jAni, tArA ye sava kathA-vArtA vale tAte tomAra mana saMkucita haYa|
kAjei prazaMsA sahakAre tumi tomAra pratipAlakera pavitratA ghoSaNA kara, Ara sAjadAhakArIdera dalabhukta hao|
Ara tomAra ravvera ‘ivAdAta karate thAka tomAra sunizcita kSaNera (arthAt mRtyura) Agamana paryanta|
AllAhara nirdeza ese geche, ataeva era janya tAr3Ahur3o karo nA| tini mahAna pavitra, tArA yAke zarIka sAvyasta kare tAttheke tini vahu Urdhve|

tini tA~ra e rUhake (ohI) ye vAndAhara upara cAna svIYa nirdezakrame pherezatAdera mAdhyame avatIrNa karena (ei marme ye) tomarA satarka kara ye, Ami chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, kAjei AmAke bhaYa kara|
tini (vizeSa uddezya sAdhanera nimitte) prakRtabhAvei AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena, tArA yAke AllAhara aMzIdAra gaNya kare tAttheke tini vahu Urdhve|
tini zukra-kITa theke mAnuSa sRSTi karechena athaca se prakAzya jhagar3ATe seje vasala|
tini catuspada jantu sRSTi karechena evaM tAte tomAdera janya Ache (zIta) nivAraka Ara vahu upakAritAo, Ara segulo theke tomarA AhAra kara|
tomarA garvabhare saundarya anubhava kara yakhana tomarA sandhyAvelA seguloke vAr3Ira pAne hA~kiYe Ana Ara sakAla velA vicaraNera janya pAThAo|
Ara egulo tomAdera bhAra vojhA vahana ka’re emana sthAna paryanta niYe yAYa, prANAntakara kleza chAr3A yekhAne tomarA pau~chate pArate nA, tomAdera pratipAlaka avazyai var3ai daYArdra, var3ai daYAlu|
tini ghor3A, khaccara o gardabha sRSTi karechena yAte tomarA ogulote ArohaNa karate pAra Ara zobhA-saundaryera janyao; tini paYadA karena aneka kichu yA tomAdera jAnA nei|
AllAharai dAYitve raYeche sarala pathapradarzana| pathagulora madhye vA~kA pathao Ache| tini yadi icche karatena tAhale avazyai tomAdera sakalakei saThika patha pradarzana karatena|
tini AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karena yAte Ache tomAdera janya pAnIYa Ara tAte janme vRkSa latA yA tomAdera pazuguloke khAoYAo|
tini tA diYe tomAdera janya janmAna zasya, yAYatUna, khejura, AGgura evaM sarvaprakAra phala| ete cintAzIla mAnuSadera janya nidarzana raYeche|
tinii rAta o dinake tomAdera upakAre niYojita karechena| Ara suruja o cA~dakeo; evaM tArakArAjio tA~rai nirdeze niYantrita; vivekasampanna lokedera janya ete avazyai vahu nidarzana raYeche|
Ara tini tomAdera janya yamIne vibhinna raM-era vasturAji sRSTi karechena| ete ai samasta lokedera janya nizcitabhAve nidarzana Ache yArA upadeza grahaNa karate cAYa|

tinii samudrake kalyANe niYojita rekhechena yAte tomarA tAttheke tAjA gozata khete pAra, Ara tAttheke tomarA ratnarAji saMgraha karate pAra yA tomarA alaMkAra hiseve paridhAna kara| Ara nauyAnaguloke tomarA dekhate pAo DheuYera vuka cire tAte calAcala kare, yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha tAlAza karate pAra Ara zokara AdAYa karate pAra|
tini yamIne sudRr3ha parvata saMsthApita karechena yAte yamIna tomAderake niYe Andolita nA haYa, Ara saMsthApita karechena nadI nirjhariNI Ara patha yAte tomarA pathera sandhAna pete pAra|
Ara dika-dizA pradAnakArI cihnasamUha; Ara tArakArAjira sAhAyyeo tArA pathanirdeza lAbha kare|
yini sRSTi karena tini ki tAra mata ye sRSTi kare nA? tave ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave nA?
tomarA AllAhara ni‘mAtasamUhake gaNanA karale tAra saMkhyA nirNaYa karate pArave nA; AllAha avazyai var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|
AllAha jAnena tomarA yA gopana kara Ara yA tomarA prakAza kara|
tArA AllAha chAr3A anya yAderake DAke tArA kichui sRSTi kare nA, tArA (nijerAi) sRSTa|
tArA prANahIna, jIvita naYa, tAdera konai cetanA nei kave tAderake (punarjIvita kare) uThAno have|
tomAdera ilAha halena eka ilAha| kAjei yArA AkherAte vizvAsa kare nA, tAdera antara satya-asvIkArakArI Ara tArA ahaMkArI|
ete kona sandeha nei ye, AllAha jAnena yA tArA gopana kare Ara yA prakAza kare, tini ahaGkArIderake bhAlavAsena nA|
tAderake yakhana valA haYa, ‘tomAdera pratipAlaka kI nAyila karechena’ takhana tArA vale- ‘pUrvavartIdera kalpa-kAhinI’|

yAra phale kviYAmAta divase tArA vahana karave nijedera pApera vojhA pUrNa mAtrAYa, Ara (AMzika) tAderao pApera vojhA yAderake tArA gumarAha kareche nijedera ajJatAra kAraNe| hAYa, tArA yA vahana karave tA katai nA nikRSTa!

tAdera pUrve yArA chila tArAo cakrAnta karechila| phale AllAha tAdera imArAtake mUla theke utpATita karechilena Ara upara theke chAda tAdera upara bheGge par3ala, Ara tAdera prati zAsti patita hala emana dika hate yA tArA etaTuku Tera pAYani|

ataHpara kviYAmAta dine tini tAderake apamAnita karavena Ara valavena, ‘AmAra aMzIdArarA kothAYa yAdera samparke tomarA (ImAnadAradera saGge) vAka-vitanDA karate?’ yAderake (duniYAYa) jJAna deYA haYechila tArA valave, ‘Aja apamAna Ara durbhAgya to kAphiradera janya

pherezatArA yAdera mRtyu ghaTAYa nijedera prati yulama karA avasthAYa|’ ataHpara tArA AtmasamarpaNa ka’re valave, ‘AmarA to kona khArApa kAja karatAma nA|’ (pherezatArA javAva dive) ‘varaM, tomarA yA karachile AllAha se viSaYe khuva bhAlabhAvei avagata|
kAjei jAhAnnAmera darajAYa praveza kara, sekhAne tomAderake cirakAla thAkate have, dAmbhikadera avAsasthala katai nA manda!’

muttAkIdera yakhana valA haYa, ‘tomAdera pratipAlaka kI avatIrNa karechena?’ tArA vale, ‘yA kichu utkRSTa (tA-i avatIrNa karechena)|’ yArA satkarma kare tAdera janya e duniYAte Ache kalyANa, Ara tAdera parakAlera ghara to nizcitai kalyANakara| muttAkIdera AvAsasthala katai nA uttama!
(tA hala) sthAYI jAnnAta yAte tArA praveza karave, tAra nimnadeza diYe jharNAdhArA pravAhita, tArA yA icche karave sekhAne tAdera janya tA-i Ache- AllAha muttAkIderake ebhAvei puraskRta karena|
pherezatA yAdera mRtyu ghaTAYa pavitra avasthAYa ei va’le ye, ‘tomAdera upara zAnti varSita hoka, tomarA ye ‘AmAla karate tAra phala hiseve jAnnAte praveza kara|’

tArA ki ei apekSAYa Ache ye, pherezatArA tAdera kAche Asave kiMvA tomAra pratipAlakera phAYasAlA ese par3ave? tAdera pUrvavartIrAo e rakamai karata| AllAha tAdera prati kona yulama karenani varaM tArA nijerAi nijedera prati yulama karata|
kAjei tAdera ‘AmAlera manda pariNati tAdera upara Apatita hala Ara ye viSaYake tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa karata tA-i tAderake ghire phelala|

muzarikarA vale, ‘AllAha icche karale tA~ke vAda diYe anya kona kichura ‘ivAdAta AmarAo karatAma nA, Ara AmAdera pitRpuruSarAo nA, Ara tA~ra hukuma chAr3A kona kichuke hArAma gaNyao karatAma nA| tAdera pUrvavartIrAo e rakamai karata| (tArA rasUladera kathA amAnya karale rasUladera to Ara kichui karAra nei, kAraNa) spaSTabhAve pau~che deYA chAr3A rasUladera upara ki kona dAYitva Ache?

pratyeka jAtira kAche Ami rasUla pAThiYechi (e saMvAda diYe) ye, AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara Ara tAgutake varjana kara| ataHpara AllAha tAdera madhye katakake satpatha dekhiYechena, Ara katakera upara avadhArita haYeche gumarAhI, ataeva yamIne bhramaNa kare dekha, satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera pariNati kI ghaTechila!
tumi yadi tAdera hidAYAtera janya lAlAYita hao tave (jene rekhe ye) AllAha tAke satpatha dekhAna nA yAke tini vipathagAmI hate cher3e dena Ara tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

tArA AllAhara nAme zakta kasama kheYe vale, ‘yAra mutyR ghaTe AllAha tAke punarAYa jIvita karavena nA|’ avazyai karavena, eTA to ekaTA pratizruti yA pUraNa karA tA~ra dAYitva, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai tA jAne nA|
(tAderake punarjIvita karA have) yArA e vyApAre matabheda karechila tAdera kAche spaSTa kare deYAra janya, Ara kAphiragaNa yAte jAnate pAre ye, tArA chila mithyevAdI|
kona viSaYe Ami icche karale vali, ‘haYe yAo’, phale tA haYe yAYa|

yArA atyAcArita haoYAra parao AllAhara pathe hijarAta kareche, Ami tAderake avazya avazyai e duniYAte uttama AvAsa dAna karava, Ara AkherAtera puraskAra to avazyai savaceYe var3a| hAYa, tArA yadi jAnata!
(AkherAtera ai puraskAra tAdera janya) yArA dhairyadhAraNa kare Ara tAdera pratipAlakera upara nirbhara kare|
Ami tomAra pUrve puruSa mAnuSa vyatIta pAThAini yAdera kAche Ami oYAhI karatAma| tomarA yadi nA jAna tAhale tomarA AllAhara kitAva samparke yArA avagata tAderake jijJesa kara

(atItera rasUladerake pAThiYechilAma) spaSTa pramANAdi Ara kitAva diYe; Ara ekhana tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa karachi mAnuSake spaSTabhAve vujhiYe deYAra janya yA tAdera prati avatIrNa karA haYeche Ara yAte tArA cintA-bhAvanA kare|

yArA (isalAmera viruddhe) kUTa-kauzala karache tArA ki nirbhaYa haYe geche ye, AllAha tAderake yamIne dhvasiYe divena nA, athavA tAdera kAche zAsti ese par3ave nA emana dika theke yA tArA etaTukuo Tera pAve nA
kiMvA tAdera calApherAra bhitarei tini tAderake pAkar3Ao karavena nA, ataHpara tArA to tA vyartha kare dite pArave nA|

athavA tini tAderake pAkar3Ao karavena nA yakhana tArA Asanna musIvAtera cintAYa bhIta-santrasta haYe thAkave, (Asala kathA hala AllAha mAnuSake khuvai avakAza diYe thAkena) kenanA tomAdera pratipAlaka avazyai ati daYArdra, var3ai daYAlu|
tArA ki AllAhara sRSTi karA jinisera dike lakSya kare nA, yAra chAYA AllAhara prati sAjadAra avasthAYa DAne-vAme patita haYa, Ara tArA vinaYa prakAza kare?
AkAzasamUha o pRthivIte yata jIva-jantu pherezatArA, samastai AllAhake sAjadAha kare; tArA ahaGkAra kare nA|
tArA tAdera upare AllAhake bhaYa kare Ara tArA tA-i kare yA tAderake Adeza deYA haYa| [sAjadAha]
AllAha valalena, ‘tomarA du’ ilAha grahaNa karo nA, tini to eka ilAha; kAjei AmAke- kevala AmAkei bhaYa kara|’
AkAzasamUha Ara yamIne yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai, Ara dvIna sadA-sarvadA ekAntabhAve tA~rai janya| tAhale tomarA ki AllAha chAr3A anya kAuke bhaYa karave?
ye ni‘mAtai tomarA peYecha tAto AllAhara nikaTa hatei| Ara yakhana duHkha-kaSTa tomAderake sparza kare, takhana tA~ra kAchei tomarA Akula Avedana jAnAte thAka|
ataHpara yakhana tini tomAdera theke duHkha-kaSTa dUra kare dena, takhana tomAdera ekadala tAdera pratipAlakera saGge anyake zarIka kare vase
Ami tAderake yA diYechi tAdera nA-zokari karAra janya| ataeva tomarA bhoga kare nAo, zIghrai tomarA jAnate pArave|

Ara Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi tAra ekAMza tArA ai savera janya nirdhArita kare yAdera samparke tArA kichui jAne nA| AllAhara zapatha! tomAdera ei mithye udbhAvana samparke tomAderake avazya avazyai jijJesa karA have
Ara tArA kanyA santAnaguloke AllAhara janya nirdhArita kare, tini (tAttheke) pavitra mahAna, Ara tArA nijedera janya (nirdhArita kare) yA tAdera AkAGkSA haYa|
tAdera kAuke yakhana kanyA santAnera susaMvAda deYA haYa, takhana tAra mukha kAlo haYe yAYa Ara se antarjvAlAYa pur3ate thAke|

lajjAYa se mAnuSa theke mukha lukAYa khArApa saMvAda pAoYAra kAraNe| se cintA kare ye apamAna mAthAYa kare tAke rekhe deve, nA tAke mATite pu~te phelave| hAYa, tArA yA siddhAnta kare tA katai nA jaghanya!
yArA AkherAte vizvAsa kare nA, khArApa upamA tAdera janya| mahottama upamA sava AllAhara janya, tini halena pratApAnvita, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha yadi mAnuSake tAdera sImAlaGghanera janya pAkar3Ao karatena, tAhale yamInera upara kona prANIkei tini rehAi ditena nA| kintu tini ekaTA nirdiSTa kAla paryanta tAderake samaYa dena| tAdera samaYa ese gele eka muhUrtao agra-pazcAt karA haYa nA|

tArA AllAhara janya tA-i nirdhAraNa kare yA (nijedera janya) apachanda kare, Ara tAdera jihavA mithyA vale ye, kalyANa tAderai janya| kona sandeha nei ye, tAdera janya Ache Aguna Ara sarvaprathama tAderakei sekhAne jaladi pau~che deYA have|

AllAhara kasama! tomAra pUrve Ami vahu jAtira kAche rasUla pAThiYechilAma, kintu zaYatvAna tAdera kAche tAdera kAryakalApake zobhanIYa kare diYechila, Ara Aja se-i tAdera abhibhAvaka, tAdera janya raYeche bhaYAvaha zAsti|

Ami tomAra prati kitAva ejanya nAyila karechi yAte tumi se sakala viSaYa spaSTa kare dite pAra ye viSaYe tArA matabheda karechila, Ara (e kitAva) vizvAsI sampradAYera janya pathapradarzaka o rahamAta svarUpa|
AllAha AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karena, ataHpara tAra dvArA yamInake tAra mRtyura para punarAYa jIvita karena| ete ai sampradAYera janya vahu nidarzana Ache yArA lakSya kare zune|
tomAdera janya gavAdi pazuteo avazyai zikSA nihita Ache| tomAderake pAna karAi odera peTera govara Ara raktera mAjha theke vizuddha dugdha yA pAnakArIdera janya khuvai upAdeYa|
Ara khejura o AGgura phala theke tomarA mada o uttama khAdya prastuta kara, jJAnI sampradAYera janya ete avazyai vahu nidarzana raYeche|
tomAra pratipAlaka maumAchira prati elahAma karechena ye, pAhAr3e, vRkSe Ara u~cu cAle vAsA tairi kara|

ataHpara pratyeka phala theke AhAra kara, ataHpara tomAra pratipAlakera (zikhAno) sahaja paddhati anusaraNa kara| era peTa theke raM-veraM era pAnIYa vera haYa| ete mAnuSera janya Ache Arogya| cintAzIla mAnuSera janya ete avazyai nidarzana Ache|

AllAhi tomAderake paYadA karechena, ataHpara tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena| tomAdera kAuke akarmaNya vaYase phiriYe deYA haYa, yAte jJAna lAbha karAra pareo Ara kona kichura jJAna thAke nA| AllAha sarvazreSTha jJAnI, sarvApekSA zaktimAna|

riyakera vyApAre AllAha tomAdera madhye kAuke kAro upara prAdhAnya diYechena| yAderake prAdhAnya deYA haYeche tArA tAdera riyaka theke tAdera adhInastha cAkara- golAmaderake emanabhAve phiriYe deYa nA, yAte ekSetre tArA samAna haYe yAYa| (athaca tArA nAnAna kichuke AllAhara aMzIdAra vAniYe oguloke AllAhara samAna kare phelache) tAhale ki tArA AllAhara anugraha asvIkAra kare?

AllAha tomAdera svajAtira madhya hatei tomAdera jor3A sRSTi karechena Ara tomAdera janya tomAdera jor3A theke putra-pautrAdi vAniYechena Ara tomAderake utkRSTa riyaka diYechena| tavuo ki tArA bhittihIna vAtila jinisera upara ImAna poSaNa karave Ara AllAhara anugrahake tArA asvIkAra karave?
Ara AllAhake vAda diYe ‘ivAdAta karave anyera yArA AkAza o yamIna theke tAdera janya riyaka deYAra mAlika naYa, Ara tArA e kAje sakSamao naYa|
kAjei kAro sAthe AllAhara tulanA dio nA| AllAha jAnena, Ara tomarA jAna nA|

AllAha dRSTAnta dicchenaH anyera mAlikAnAbhukta eka dAsa ye kona kichu karArai kSamatA rAkhe nA| Ara eka loka yAke Ami AmAra pakSa hate uttama jIvikA dAna karechi Ara tAttheke se gopane prakAzye dAna kare, (e) du’jana ki samAna? samasta prazaMsA AllAharai janya, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

AllAha Aro dRSTAnta dicchena du’vyaktira tAdera ekajana hala vovA, kona kichui karate sakSama naYa| tAra manivera upara se ekaTA vojhA, tAke yekhAnei pAThAno hoka nA kena, kona kalyANai se niYe Asave nA| se ki ai vyaktira samAna ye inasAphera nirdeza deYa Ara sarala sudRr3ha pathe pratiSThita?
AkAzasamUha o yamInera adRzyera jJAna kevala AllAharai Ache| kviYAmAtera vyApAra to cokhera palakera mata varaM tAtthekeo druta| AllAha sava kichu karatei sakSama|
AllAha tomAderake tomAdera mAYera peTa theke vera karena, tomarA kichui jAnate nA| tini tomAderake zonAra zakti, dekhAra zakti Ara antara dAna karechena yAte tomarA zokara AdAYa karate pAra|
AkAzera zUnyaloke niYantrita pAkhIgulora prati ki tArA lakSya kare nA? AllAha chAr3A keu tAderake sthira rAkhe nA, ete mu’mina sampradAYera janya avazyai vahu nidarzana raYeche|

AllAha tomAdera gRhaguloke tomAdera ArAma zAntira jAYagA vAniYe diYechena| tini pazura cAmar3A theke tomAdera janya emana gRhera vyavasthA karechena yA tomarA hAlakAvodha kara tomAdera bhramaNakAle kiMvA avasthAnakAle| tini ogulora pazama, loma Ara cula theke tomAdera paridheYa o vyavahArya sAmagrIra vyavasthA karechena yA tomarA kichukAla paryanta kAje lAgAo|

AllAha yA sRSTi karechena tAttheke tomAdera janya chAYAra vyavasthA karechena, pAhAr3a-parvate tomAdera Atmagopanera jAYagA vAniYechena| tini tomAdera janya pozAka diYechena yA tomAderake tApa theke rakSA kare| Ara diYechena emana pozAka yA tomAderake saMghAtera samaYa rakSA kare| ebhAve tini tomAdera janya tA~ra ni‘mAtasamUha pUrNa karena yAte tomarA tA~ra prati AtmasamarpaNa kara|
eraparao yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tave (jorapUrvaka tAderake saThika pathe AnA tomAra dAYitva naYa) tomAra dAYitva kevala spaSTabhAve vANI pau~che deYA|
tArA AllAhara ni‘mAtake cinate pAre, kintu tA sattveo segulo agrAhya kare, tAdera adhikAMzai akRtajJa|

(sedina kI avasthA have) yedina Ami pratyeka sampradAYa theke ekajana sAkSI dA~r3a karAva Ara kAphiraderake (kona ayuhAta peza karAra) anumati deYA have nA, Ara kSamA prArthanA karArao suyoga deYA have nA|
sImAlaGghanakArIrA yakhana ‘AyAva pratyakSa karave tAdera theke takhana tA kamAno have nA, Ara tAderake samaYa-suyogao deYA have nA|

muzarikarA yAderake AllAhara zArIka vAniYechila tAderake yakhana dekhave takhana tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera ravva! erAi hala AmAdera zArIka mA‘vUda tomAke vAda diYe yAderake AmarA DAkatAma|’ takhana e kathAke tAdera dikei chu~r3e phele diYe tAdera sei mA‘vUdarA valave, ‘tomarA avazyai mithyevAdI|’
sedina tArA AllAhara nikaTa kholAkhuli AtmasamarpaNa karave, Ara tArA ye sava mithye udbhAvana karechila tA tAdera nikaTa hate hAriYe yAve|
yArA AllAhake asvIkAra kare Ara AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare, Ami tAdera zAstira upara zAsti vRddhi karava, kAraNa tArA phAsAda sRSTi karata|

sedina Ami pratyeka ummAta theke tAdera nijederai madhya hate ekajana sAkSI dA~r3a karAva, Ara (tomAra) ei lokadera vyApAre sAkSyadAtA hiseve (he muhAmmAda!) Ami tomAke Anava| Ami tomAra prati e kitAva nAyila karechi yA pratyekaTi viSaYera suspaSTa vyAkhyA, satya pathera nirdeza, rahamAta Ara AtmasamarpaNakArIdera janya susaMvAda svarUpa|

AllAha nyAYa-vicAra, sadAcaraNa o AtmIYaderake deYAra hukuma dicchena, Ara tini niSedha karachena azlIlatA, apakarma Ara vidroha theke| tini tomAderake upadeza diYechena yAte tomarA zikSA grahaNa kara|

tomarA paraspara aGgIkAre Avaddha hale AllAhara aGgIkAra pUrNa karave, nijedera aGgIkAra pAkA-pokhata karAra para tA bhaGga karo nA, yehetu tomarA AllAhake nijedera upara sAkSI vAniYe niYecha, tomarA yA kara AllAha se samparke oYAkephahAla|

tomarA emana nArIra mata haYo nA ye tAra sUtAguloke zakta kare pAkAnora para nijei tAra pAka khule Tukaro Tukaro kare deYa| tomarA tomAdera zapathaguloke pArasparika vyApAre dho~kA-pratAraNAra hAtiYAra hiseve vyavahAra kara yena ekadala Areka dala apekSA vezi phAYadA lAbha karate pAre| AllAha kevala era dvArA tomAderake parIkSA karena| AllAha kviYAmAtera dina avazya avazyai spaSTa kare divena ye viSaYe tomarA matabheda karate|

AllAha icche karale tomAderake avazyai eka ummAta kare ditena, kintu tini yAke icche gumarAh karena, Ara yAke icche saThika pathapradarzana karena| tomarA yA kara se samparke avazya avazyai tomAderake jijJAsAvAda karA have|

tomarA tomAdera nijedera zapathaguloke paraspara dho~kA-pravaJcanAra upAYa hiseve grahaNa karo nA, tA karale dRr3habhAve pratiSThita haoYAra para pA AvAra pichale yAve, Ara AllAhara pathe vAdhA deYAra kAraNe tomarA manda pariNati bhoga karave, Ara tomAdera janya thAkave kaThina zAsti|
tomarA AllAhara saGge kRta oYA‘dA nagaNya mUlye vikraYa karo nA| AllAhara nikaTa yA Ache tomAdera janya tA-i uttama- tomarA yadi jAnate!
tomAdera kAche yA Ache tA zeSa haYe yAve, Ara AllAhara kAche yA Ache tA Tike thAkave| AmarA avazya avazyai dhairyazIladerake tArA yA kare tAra ceYe uttama pratidAna deva|
puruSa Ara nArIdera madhye ye keu satkAja karave Ara se mu’minao, tAke Ami avazya avazyai uttama jIvana dAna karava Ara tAderake avazya avazyai tArA yA kare tAra ceYe uttama pratiphala dAna karava|
tumi yakhani kuraAna pATha karave takhana abhizapta zaYatvAna theke AllAhara nikaTa AzraYa cAive|
yArA ImAna eneche tAdera upara tAra kona prabhAva khATe nA, Ara tArA tAdera pratipAlakera upara nirbhara kare|
tAra prabhAva kevala tAdera uparai khATe yArA tAke abhibhAvaka hiseve grahaNa kare Ara yArA tAke AllAhara zarIka kare|

Ami yakhana eka AYAtera vadale anya AYAta nAyila kari- Ara AllAha bhAlabhAvei jAnena, yA tini nAyila karena- takhana ei lokerA vale, ‘tumi to mithyA racanAkArI|’ prakRta vyApAra ei ye, e samparke tAdera adhikAMzerai kona jJAna nei|

vala, ‘e kuraAna tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke ruhula kudUsa (jivarIla) Thika ThikabhAve nAyila karechena ImAnadAraderake dRr3habhAve pratiSThita rAkhAra janya evaM musalimadera hidAYAta o susaMvAda dAnera janya|’

Ami jAni, tArA vale, ‘eka mAnuSa tAke [arthAt muhAmmAda (sA.)-ke] zikhiYe deYa|’ athaca duSTavuddhi praNodita haYe tArA ye lokaTira kathA valache tAra bhASA to anArava, aparapakSe kuraAnera bhASA hala spaSTa AravI|
yArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIte vizvAsa kare nA, AllAha tAderake saThika pathe paricAlita karena nA, Ara tAdera janya Ache bhaYAnaka zAsti|
yArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhe vizvAsa kare nA, tArAi mithye racanA kare Ara tArAi mithyAvAdI|

kona vyakti tAra ImAna grahaNera para AllAhake avizvAsa karale evaM kupharIra janya tAra hRdaYa khule dile tAra upara AllAhara gayava patita have Ara tAra janya Ache mahA zAsti, tave tAra janya naYa yAke (kupharIra janya) vAdhya karA haYa athaca tAra dila ImAnera upara avicala thAke|
era kAraNa ei ye, tArA AkhirAta apekSA duniYAra jIvanake vezi bhAlavAse, Ara AllAha ImAna pratyAkhyAnakArIderake saThika patha dekhAna nA|
erA ai sava loka AllAha yAdera antara, kAna Ara cokhe mohara mere diYechena Ara tArA ve-kheYAla, udAsIna|
ete kona sandehai nei ye, AkherAte kSatigrasta erAi have|

avazyai tomAra pratipAlaka tAdera janya yArA niryAtita haoYAra para hijarAta kare, ataHpara jihAda kare, ataHpara dhairyadhAraNa kare, e savera para tomAra pratipAlaka avazyai var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|
sedina pratyeka loka nijera pakSe yukti peza karave Ara pratyeka vyaktike tAra kRtakarmera pratiphala pUrNamAtrAYa deYA have, tAdera prati kona yulama karA have nA|

AllAha eka janavasatira dRSTAnta peza karachena yA chila nirApada, cintA-bhAvanAhIna| savakhAna theke sekhAne Asata jIvana dhAraNera paryApta upakaraNa| ataHpara se janapada AllAhara ni‘mAtarAjira kuphurI karala, ataHpara AllAha tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe kSudhA o bhaYa-bhItira musIvAta tAderake AsvAdana karAlena|
tAdera kAche tAdera madhya hatei rasUla esechila kintu tArA tAke mithyA mane ka’re pratyAkhyAna karala, takhana zAsti tAderake pAkar3Ao karala yakhana tArA chila sImAlaGghane lipta|
kAjei AllAha tomAderake ye sakala vaidha pavitra riyaka diYechena tA tomarA khAo Ara AllAhara anugrahera zukariYA AdAYa kara yadi tomarA prakRtai tA~ra vandegI karate icchuka hao|

AllAha tomAdera janya hArAma karechena mRta jIva, rakta, zUkarera mAMsa Ara yA yaveha karAra samaYa AllAha chAr3A anyera nAma neYA haYeche| kintu keu icchAkRtabhAve avAdhya nA haYe o sImAlaGghana nA ka’re nitAnta nirupAYa (haYe esava khete vAdhya) hale AllAha to var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

tomAdera jihavA theke mithye kathA veroYa valei tomarA AllAhara prati mithyAropa karAra janya emana kathA valo nA ye, eTA hAlAla, Ara eTA hArAma| yArA AllAha samparke mithye udbhAvana kare, tArA kakSano kalyANa lAbha karate pAre nA|
(esava mithyAcAre lAbha haYa) sAmAnya bhogera vastu, ataHpara tAdera janya Ache bhaYAvaha zAsti|
Ara yArA iYAhUdI haYechila Ami tAdera prati hArAma karechilAma yA Ami tomAra kAche pUrvei ullekha karechi| Ami tAdera upara kona yulama karini, kintu tArA nijerAi nijedera prati yulama karata|

tomAra pratipAlaka tAdera janya yArA ajJatAra kAraNe khArApa kAja kare, ataHpara tAovAha kare o nijedera ‘AmAla saMzodhana kare, tomAra pratipAlaka tAdera janya avazyai var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|
ivarAhIma chila AllAhara prati vinaYAvanata ekaniSTha eka ummAta, Ara se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|
se chila AllAhara ni‘mAtarAjira janya zokaraguyAra| AllAha tAke veche niYechilena Ara tAke sarala saThika patha dekhiYechilena|
Ami tAke duniYAte kalyANa dAna karechilAma, Ara AkherAteo se avazyai satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|
ataHpara tomAra prati oYAhI karachi ye, tumi ekaniSTha ivarAhImera matAdarza anusaraNa kara; Ara se to muzarikadera dalabhukta chila nA|

‘zanivAra pAlana’ to tAdera upara cApiYe deYA haYechila yArA era niYama pAlane matabheda karechila| ye viSaYe tArA matabheda karata tomAra pratipAlaka kviYAmAtera dina se viSaYe avazyai tAdera madhye phAYasAlA kare devena|

jJAna-vuddhi Ara uttama upadezera mAdhyame tumi (mAnuSake) tomAra pratipAlakera pathe AhavAna jAnAo Ara lokedera sAthe vitarka kara emana panthAYa yA ati uttama| tomAra pratipAlaka bhAlabhAvei jAnena ke tA~ra patha cher3e gumarAha haYe geche| Ara ke saThika pathe Ache tAo tini vezi jAnena|

yadi tomarA pratizodha grahaNa karate cAo tave tataTuku pratizodha grahaNa kara yataTuku anyAYa tomAdera upara karA haYeche| Ara yadi tomarA dhairya dhAraNa kara tave dhairyadhAraNakArIdera janya avazyai tA uttama|
tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara, tomAra dhairya to kevala AllAha vyatIta naYa, odera kAryakalApe tumi duHkhita haYo nA, Ara odera Sar3ayantra karAra kAraNe antare kuNThAvodha karo nA|
yArA tAkvaoYA avalamvana kare Ara satkarmazIla, AllAha to tAderai saGge Achena|

pavitra o mahIYAna tini yini tA~ra vAndAhake rAtera velA bhramaNa kariYechena mAsajidula hArAma theke mAsajidula AkasA paryanta, yAra cArapAzake Ami kalyANamaYa karechi| tAke AmAra nidarzanAvalI dekhAnora janya, tini sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
Ara Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma Ara seTAke karechilAma isarAIla vaMzIYadera janya satyapathera nirdezaka| (tAte nirdeza diYechilAma) ye, AmAke chAr3A anyake karma niYantA grahaNa karo nA|
(tomarA to) tAdera santAna! yAderake Ami nUhera saGge naukAYa vahana kareYechilAma, se chila eka zukaragujAra vAndA|
Ami kitAvera mAdhyame vAnI isarAIlake jAniYe diYechilAma ye, tomarA avazya avazyai pRthivIra vuke du’ du’vAra viparyaYa sRSTi karave Ara avazya avazyai atyadhika garve phule uThave|

ataHpara yakhana du’Tira madhye prathamaTira samaYa ese upasthita hala, takhana Ami tomAdera viruddhe pAThiYe dilAma AmAra vAndAderake yArA chila yuddhe ati zaktizAlI, tArA (tomAdera) gharera koNAYa koNAYa Dhuke par3ala, Ara satarkavANI pUrNa hala|
ataHpara Ami tomAderake tAdera upara vijaYa dAna karalAma Ara tomAderake dhana-sampada Ara santAnAdi diYe sAhAyya karalAma, tomAderake janavale vahuguNa vAr3iYe dilAma|

tomarA bhAla kAja karale nijedera kalyANera janyai tA karave, Ara yadi tomarA manda kAja kara, tAo karave nijederai janya| ataHpara yakhana dvitIYa pratizruti pUraNera samaYa Asalo, (takhana Ami tomAdera zatruderake zakti dilAma) yena tArA tomAdera cehArA vikRta kare deYa, Ara mAsajide (AkasAYa) Dhuke par3e yebhAve tArA sekhAne prathamavAra Dhuke par3echila, Ara tAdera sammukhe yA par3e tAke sampUrNarUpe dhvaMsa kare deYa|

(eraparao) haYato tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera prati daYA karavena, kintu yadi tomarA (tomAdera pUrvakRta pApera) punarAvRtti kara, tave Amio (pUrve deYA zAstira) punarAvRtti karava| ImAna pratyAkhyAnakArIdera janya Ami jAhAnnAmake kArAgAra vAniYe rekhechi|
nizcaYai e kuraAna sei patha dekhAYa yA sojA o supratiSThita, Ara yArA sat kAja kare sei mu’minaderake susaMvAda deYa ye, tAdera janya raYeche mahA puraskAra|
Ara (tA saMvAda deYa ye) yArA AkherAte ImAna Ane nA, tAdera janya Ami bhaYaGkara ‘AyAva prastuta kare rekhechi|
mAnuSa (tAra nirvuddhitAra kAraNe kalyANakara bheve) akalyANa prArthanA kare yemanabhAve kalyANa prArthanA karA ucita| mAnuSa var3ai tAr3Ahur3AkArI|

Ami rAta Ara dinake du’To nidarzana vAniYechi| Ami rAtera nidarzanaTike jyotihIna karechi, Ara dinera nidarzanaTike karechi AloYa ujjvala yAte tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera anugraha anusandhAna karate pAra Ara yAte vacharera saMkhyA Ara hisAva jAnate pAra; Ami sakala viSaYa vistAritabhAve vyAkhyA kare diYechi|

Ami pratyeka lokera bhAgya tAra kA~dhei jhuliYe rekhechi (arthAt tAra bhAgyera bhAla-mandera kAraNa tAra nijera madhyei nihita Ache) Ara kviYAmatera dina tAra janya Ami eka kitAva vera karava yAke se unmukta avasthAYa pAve|
(tAke valA have) ‘pATha kara tomAra kitAva, Aja tomAra hisAva neYAra vyApAre tumii yatheSTa|’

ye saThika pathe calave se tAra nijera kalyANera janyai saThika pathe calave, Ara ye gumarAha have tAra gumarAhIra pariNAma tAra nijera uparei par3ave| kona vojhA vahanakArI anyera vojhA vahana karave nA| Ami ‘AyAva dei nA yatakSaNa ekajana rasUla nA pAThAi|

Ami yakhana kona janavasatike dhvaMsa karate cAi takhana tAdera sacchala vyaktiderake Adeza kari (AmAra Adeza mene calAra janya)| kintu tArA avAdhyatA karate thAke| takhana se janavasatira prati AmAra ‘AyAvera phAYasAlA sAvyasta haYe yAYa| takhana Ami tA sampUrNarUpe vidhvasta kare dei|
nUhera para vahu vaMzadhArAke Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi, vAndAdera pApakAjera khavara rAkhA Ara lakSya rAkhAra janya tomAra pratipAlakai yatheSTa|
ye keu nagada nagada pete cAYa tAke Ami ekhAnei jaladi kare diYe dei yAke yA dite icche kari, avazeSe tAra janya jAhAnnAma nirdhAraNa kari| tAte se jvalave dhikRta o rahamAta vaJcita avasthAYa|
Ara ye vyakti AkhirAta kAmanA kare Ara tAra janya ceSTA kare yatakhAni ceSTA karA darakAra Ara se mu’minao, erAi hala tArA yAdera ceSTA sAdhanA sAdare gRhIta have|
tomAra pratipAlakera dAna theke Ami ederake Ara oderake sakalakei sAhAyya kare thAki, tomAra pratipAlakera dAna to vandha haoYAra naYa|
lakSya kara, Ami tAdera katakake anyadera upara kIbhAve zreSThatva diYechi, Ara AkhirAta to nizcaYai maryAdAYa sarvocca o guNe sarvottama|
AllAhara sAthe anya kona ilAha sAvyasta karo nA, karale tiraskRta hatabhAgya haYe par3e thAkave|

tomAra pratipAlaka hukuma jAri karechena ye, tini chAr3A anya kAro ‘ivAdAta karo nA, Ara pitA-mAtAra saGge sadvyavahAra karo| tAdera ekajana vA tAdera ubhaYe yadi tomAra jIvaddazAYa vArdhakye upanIta haYa, tave tAderake virakti vA avajJAsUcaka kathA valo nA, Ara tAderake bhatrsanA karo nA| tAdera sAthe sammAnajanaka kathA vala|
tAdera janya sadaYabhAve namratAra vAhu prasArita kare dAo Ara vala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tAdera prati daYA kara yemanabhAve tArA AmAke zaizave lAlana pAlana karechena|’
tomAdera pratipAlaka khuva bhAla karei jAnena tomAdera antare kI Ache| tomarA yadi satkarmazIla hao, tave yArA vAra vAra tA~ra dike phire Ase tini to tAdera prati parama kSamAzIla|
Ara AtmIYa-svajanake tAdera prApya adhikAra dAo evaM misakIna o musAphiraderakeo, Ara apavyaYe apacaYa karo nA|
apacaYakArIrA zaYatAnera bhAi Ara zaYatAna to tAra pratipAlakera prati nA-zokara|

tumi yadi tAderake (arthAt abhAvI AtmIYa, misakIna o musAphiraderake) pAza kATAte cAo ejanya ye, tumi ekhanao nijera janya tomAra pratipAlakera anugraha lAbhera sandhAne vyApRta yA tumi pratyAzA kara, ematAvasthAYa tAdera saGge namrabhAve kathA vala|
tomAra hAtake tomAra galAra sAthe ve~dhe dio nA, Ara tA ekevAre prasArita kareo dionA, tA karale tumi tiraskRta o niHsva haYe vase par3ave|
tomAra pratipAlaka yAra janya icche riyak prazasta karena, yAra janya icche sImita karena, tini tA~ra vAndAdera samparke oYAkiphahAla, pratyakSadarzI|
daridratAra bhaYe tomarA tomAdera santAnaderake hatyA karo nA| Amii tAderake riyaka dei Ara tomAderakeo, tAdera hatyA mahApApa|
Ara yinA-vyabhicArera kAcheo yeo nA, tA hacche azlIla kAja Ara ati jaghanya patha|

yathAyatha kAraNa chAr3A AllAha yAke hatyA karA niSiddha karechena tAke hatyA karo nA| kAuke anyAYabhAve hatyA karA hale Ami tAra uttarAdhikArIke adhikAra diYechi (kisAsa dAvI karAra vA kSamA kare deYAra) kAjei se yena hatyAra vyApAre sImAlaGghana nA kare, kAraNa tAke to sAhAyya karA haYeche (Aina-vidhAna diYe)|
iYAtIma vaYoprApta nA haoYA paryanta tAra sampadera kAcheo yeYo nA sat uddezya vyatIta| Ara oYA‘dA pUrNa kara, oYA‘dA samparke avazyai jijJAsAvAda karA have|
mApa deYAra samaYa mApa pUrNamAtrAYa karave, Ara ojana karave truTihIna dA~r3ipAllAYa| eTAi uttama nIti Ara pariNAmeo tA utkRSTa|
Ara se viSaYera pechane chuTo nA, ye viSaYe tomAra kona jJAna nei| kAna, cokha Ara antara- egulora sakala viSaYe avazyai jijJAsAvAda karA have|
yamIne garvabhare calApherA karo nA, tumi kakSano yamInake vidIrNa karate pArave nA, Ara uccatAYa parvatera nyAYa hateo pArave nA|
egulora madhye ye samasta viSaYa manda, tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa tA ghRNita|

esava sei hikamAtera antarbhukta yA tomAra pratipAlaka tomAra prati oYAhI karechena| AllAhara saGge apara kona ilAha sthira karo nA, karale tumi nindita o yAvatIYa kalyANa vaJcita haYe jAhAnnAme nikSipta have|

tAhale ki (he kAphiragaNa!) tomAdera janya tomAdera pratipAlaka santAna nirvAcita karechena, Ara nijera janya pherezatAdera madhya hate kanyA grahaNa karechena? vAstavikai tomarA var3a bhaYAnaka kathA valacho|
Ami e kuraAne nAnAbhAve (viSaYAvalI) vyAkhyA karechi yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare, kintu tA tAdera (satya hate) palAYanera manovRttii vRddhi kareche|
vala- tA~ra saGge yadi Aro ilAha thAkata yemana tArA vale, tAhale tArA avazyai Arazera mAlikera nikaTa pau~chAra janya pathera sandhAna karata|
tini pavitra o ati ucca, tArA yA vale tAttheke aneka aneka Urdhve|

sAta AsamAna, yamIna Ara egulora mAjhe yA Ache sava kichui tA~ra mahimA ghoSaNA kare| emana kona jinisai nei yA tA~ra prazaMsAsaha pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare nA| kintu tomarA vujhate pAra nA kIbhAve tArA tA~ra mahimA ghoSaNA kare| tini parama sahiSNu, var3ai kSamAparAYaNa|
tumi yakhana kuraAna pATha kara takhana Ami tomAra Ara yArA AkherAte vizvAsa kare nA tAdera mAjhe ekaTA adRzya pardA sthApana ka’re diYechi|

Ara Ami tAdera antarera upara eka AvaraNa diYe diYechi yAte tArA kuraAna vujhate nA pAre, Ara tAdera kAne sRSTi karechi vadhiratA| Ara yakhana tumi kuraAne tomAra pratipAlakera ekatvera ullekha kara, takhana tArA (satya theke) pAliYe pichane mukha ghuriYe neYa|

Ami bhAla karei jAni tArA kAna lAgiYe kI zune yakhana tArA tomAra kathA kAna lAgiYe zune| Ara yakhana tArA gopane paraspara AlocanAYa vase takhana yAlimarA vale, ‘tomarA to kevala eka yAdugrasta lokera anusaraNa kare calecha|’
lakSya kara, tArA tomAra samparke kemana sava udAharaNa dicche! yAra phale tArA pathahArA haYe geche Ara tArA kakSano patha pAve nA|
tArA vale, ‘kI! AmarA hADDi Ara dhUlA-mATite pariNata haoYAra para ki eka natuna sRSTirUpe utthita hava?’
vala, ‘tomarA yadi pAthara kiMvA lohAo haYe yAo,

athavA emana kichu yA tomAdera dhAraNAYa (jIvita haoYA) khuvai kaThina (tavuo tomAderake uThAno have)|’ tArA valave, ‘ke Ache emana ye AmAderake punarAYa jIvane phiriYe Anave?’ vala, ‘tinii yini tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechena|’ takhana tArA (ThATTAra chale) tomAra sAmane mAthA nAr3ave Ara valave, ‘seTA kakhana ghaTave?’ vala, ‘hate pAre seTA zIghrai ghaTave|’
ye dina tini tomAderake DAkavena Ara tomarA tA~ra prazaMsA karate karate tA~ra DAke sAr3A dive Ara tomarA dhAraNA karave ye, tomarA khuva alpa samaYai avasthAna karechile|
AmAra vAndAderake valate vala emana kathA yA khuvai uttama| zaYatAna mAnuSera mAjhe jhagar3A-vibheda-vizRGkhalA sRSTi kare, zaYatAna hala mAnuSera prakAzya duzamana|

tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAderake khuva bhAla ka’rei jAnena| tini icche karale tomAdera prati anugraha karavena, Ara icche karale tomAderake zAsti devena; Ami tomAke (he nAvI!) tAdera kAjakarmera janya dAYitvazIla kare pAThAini|
AsamAna Ara yamIne yArA Ache tomAra pratipAlaka tAderake bhAla ka’rei jAnena| Ami nAvIgaNera katakake anyadera upara maryAdA dAna karechi Ara dAUdake diYechi yAvUra|
vala, ‘tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAderake ilAha mane kara tAderake DAka, (DAkaleo dekhate pAve) tArA tomAdera duHkha-vedanA dUra karate vA vadalAte sakSama naYa|

tArA yAderake DAke tArA nijerAi to tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa pau~chAra patha anusandhAna kare ye, ke tA~ra adhika nikaTavartI hate pArave, Ara tA~ra daYA pratyAzA kare evaM tA~ra zAstike bhaYa kare| tomAra pratipAlakera zAsti to bhaYa karAra matai|
emana kona janavasati nei yAke Ami kviYAmAta dinera pUrve dhvaMsa karava nA kiMvA tAke kaThina zAsti diva nA, eTA (AllAhara) kitAve lipivaddha Ache|

Ami nidarzana preraNa karA hate ejanya virata thAki ye, pUrvera lokerA tA mithyA mane ka’re pratyAkhyAna karechila| Ami sAmUda jAtira nikaTa uSTrI pAThiYechilAma eka pratyakSa nidarzana hiseve kintu tArA tAra prati yulama karala; bhaYa pradarzanera uddezyei kevala Ami nidarzana pAThiYe thAki|

smaraNa kara, Ami tomAke valechilAma ye, tomAra ravava mAnuSaderake ghire rekhechena| Ami tomAke (mi’rAjera mAdhyame) ye dRzya dekhiYechi tA evaM kuraAne ullekhita abhizapta (jAkkuma) gAchaTio mAnuSaderake parIkSA karAra janya (ye kArA tA vizvAsa ka’re nekakAra haYa Ara kArA tA avizvAsa ka’re pApI haYa)| Ami tAderake bhaYa dekhAi o sAvadhAna kari, kintu tAte tAdera carama avAdhyatAi vRddhi pAYa|

smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami pherezatAgaNake valechilAma, ‘AdAmake sAjadAha kara takhana ivaliza chAr3A savAi tAke sAjadAha karala| se valechila, ‘Ami ki tAke sAjadAha karava yAke tumi mATi theke paYadA karecha?’

se valala, ‘Apani ki vyApAraTA kheYAla karechena ye, Apani e vyaktike AmAra upara sammAna dicchena! Apani yadi AmAke kviYAmAtera dina paryanta samaYa dena, tAhale Ami alpa kichu vAde tAra vaMzadharaderake avazya avazyai AmAra kartRtvAdhIne ene phelava|’
AllAha valalena, ‘yAo, tAdera madhye yArA tomAke mene calave, jAhAnnAmai have tomAdera sakalera pratiphala, pUrNa pratiphala|

tAdera madhye tumi yAke pAra uske dAo tomAra kathA diYe, tomAra azvArohI Ara padAtika vAhinI diYe tumi AkramaNa cAlAo, Ara tAdera dhana-sampada o santAnAdite bhAga vasiYe dAo (yathecchabhAve sampada upArjana o vyaYa karAra parAmarza diYe Ara santAna kAmanA o pratipAlane AllAhara vidhAna laGghanera upadeza diYe) Ara tAderake pratizruti dAo|’ zaYatAna tAderake ye pratizruti deYa tAto chalanA chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|
‘AmAra vAndAhadera vyApAra hala, tAdera upara tomAra kona Adhipatya calave nA|’ karma sampAdane tomAra pratipAlakai yatheSTa|
tomAdera (prakRta) pratipAlaka to tinii, yini samudre tomAdera janya susthirabhAve nauyAna paricAlanA karena, yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra, tini tomAdera prati var3ai daYAlu|

samudre yakhana vipada tomAderake peYe vase, takhana tA~ke chAr3A anya yAderake tomarA (upAsya bheve) AhavAna kara tArA (takhana tomAdera mana theke) hAriYe yAYa| ataHpara tini yakhana tomAderake sthale ene vA~ciYe dena, takhana tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo| mAnuSa hala var3ai akRtajJa|

tomarA ki nirbhaYa haYe gecha ye tini tomAderake sthalabhAgei yamInera madhye dhvasiYe divena nA, kiMvA tomAdera upara zilA varSaNakArI jhar3o hAoYA pAThAvena nA? ematAvasthAYa tomAdera rakSAkArI kAuke tomarA pAve nA|

tomarA ki bhaYahIna haYe gecha ye, tini tomAderake ArekavAra samudre niYe yAvena nA Ara tomAdera upara pracanDa jhar3o hAoYA pAThAvena nA Ara tomAdera akRtajJatAra kAraNe tomAderake DuviYe devena nA? takhana tomarA AmAra viruddhe kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|

Ami AdAma santAnake sammAnita karechi, tAdera janya jale sthale yAnavAhanera vyavasthA karechi, tAderake pavitra riyaka diYechi Ara Ami tAderake AmAra adhikAMza sRSTira upara maryAdAYa zreSThatva dAna karechi|

smaraNa kara, yedina Ami sakala sampradAYake tAdera netAsaha DAkava, ataHpara yAderake tAdera ‘AmalanAmA DAna hAte deYA have, tArA tAdera ‘AmAlanAmA pATha karave (Anandacitte) Ara tAdera prati etaTuku yulama karA have nA|
ye vyakti ekhAne (satya patha dekhAra vyApAre) andha, se AkherAteo have andha, Ara saThika patha theke adhika vicyuta|

Ami tomAra prati ye oYAhI karechi tAttheke tomAke padaskhalita karAra janya tArA ceSTAra kona truTi kareni yAte tumi AmAra samvandhe tAra (arthAt nAyilakRta oYAhIra) viparIte mithyA racanA kara, tAhale tArA tomAke avazyai vandhu vAniYe nita|
Ami tomAke dRr3ha pratiSThita nA rAkhale tumi tAdera dike kichu nA kichu jhu~kei par3ate|
tumi tA karale Ami tomAke e duniYAYa dviguNa Ara parakAleo dviguNa ‘AyAvera svAda AsvAdana karAtAma| se avasthAYa tumi tomAra janya AmAra viruddhe kona sAhAyyakArI pete nA|
tArA tomAke yamIna theke utkhAta karate ceYechila yAte tArA tomAke tAttheke vera kare dite pAre, sekSetre tArA ekhAne tomAra pare khuva alpakAlai Tike thAkata|
tomAra pUrve Ami AmAra ye sava rasUla pAThiYechilAma tAdera kSetre eTAi chila niYama Ara tumi AmAra niYamera kona parivartana dekhate pAve nA|

sUrya pazcime Dhale par3Ara samaYa hate rAtrira gAr3ha andhakAra paryanta nAmAya pratiSThA kara, Ara phAjarera salAte kuraAna pATha (karAra nIti avalamvana kara), nizcaYai phAjarera salAtera kuraAna pATha (pherezatAgaNera) sarAsari sAkSya haYa|
Ara rAtrira kichu aMze tAhAjjuda par3a, oTA tomAra janya naphala, zIghrai tomAra pratipAlaka tomAke prazaMsita sthAne unnIta karavena|

vala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke (yekhAnei) praveza karAo, (seTA kara) satya o sammAnera praveza, Ara AmAke (yekhAna hatei) vera kara, (seTA kara) satya o sammAnera vahirgamana, Ara tomAra nikaTa hate AmAke eka sAhAyyakArI zakti dAna kara|
vala, ‘satya ese geche Ara mithyA vilupta haYeche, mithyA to vilupta haoYArai|’
Ami kuraAna hate (kramazaH) avatIrNa kari yA mu’minadera janya Arogya o rahamAta, kintu tA yAlimadera kSatii vRddhi kare|
Ami yakhana mAnuSera prati anugraha varSaNa kari takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa, Ara ahaGkAre dUre sare par3e; kintu yakhana amaGgala tAke sparza kare takhana se nirAza haYe yAYa|
vala, ‘pratyekei svIYa rIti-panthA anuyAYI kAja kare| ekhana tomAra ravavai bhAla jAnena ke calAra pathe adhikatara saThika pathe Ache|
tomAke tArA rUha samparke jijJesa kare| vala, ‘rUha hacche AmAra pratipAlakera hukumera antarbhukta (ekaTi hukuma)| e samparke tomAke ati sAmAnya jJAnai deYA haYeche|’
icche karale Ami tomAra prati yA oYAhI karechi tA ker3e nite pAratAma, se avasthAYa tumi AmAra viruddhe tomAra janya kona kArya sampAdanakArI pAve nA
tomAra pratipAlakera daYA chAr3A| tomAra prati tA~ra anugraha (satyii) virATa|
vala, ‘e kuraAnera mata ekakhAnA kuraAna AnAra janya yadi samagra mAnava Ara jvIna ekatrita haYa tavuo tArA tAra mata Anate pArave nA, yadio tArA paraspara parasparake sAhAyya o sahayogitA kare|’
Ami e kuraAne mAnuSera janya yAvatIYa dRSTAnta vistAritabhAve varNanA karechi, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai ImAna grahaNa karate asvIkAra kare kevala kupharii karala|
tArA vale, ‘AmarA tomAra prati kakSano ImAna Anava nA ye paryanta tumi AmAdera janya yamIna theke jharNAdhArA pravAhita nA karave|
kiMvA (yatakSaNa nA) tomAra khejura o AGgurera vAgAna have yAra phA~ke phA~ke tumi jharNA pravAhita karave ajasra dhArAYa|
athavA (yatakSaNa nA) tumi AkAzake Tukaro Tukaro kare AmAdera upara phelave yemana tumi vale thAka (ye tA ghaTave) kiMvA AllAha Ara pherezatAgaNake sarAsari AmAdera sAmane ene deve|

kiMvA (yatakSaNa nA) tomAra ekaTA svarNakhacita gRha have kiMvA tumi AsamAne ArohaNa karave| Ara tomAra e ArohaNakeo AmarA kakSano vizvAsa karava nA yatakSaNa nA tumi AmAdera prati eka kitAva avatIrNa karave yA AmarA pATha karava|’ vala, ‘Ami AmAra pratipAlakera mahimA o pavitratA ghoSaNA karachi, Ami ekajana mAnuSa rasUla chAr3A ki anya kichu?
mAnuSera kAche yakhana pathera nirdeza Ase takhana tAderake ImAna Anate tAdera e kathA chAr3A anya kichui virata rAkhe nA ye, ‘AllAha ki mAnuSake rasUla vAniYe pAThiYechena?’
vala, ‘duniYAte yadi pherezatAgaNera vasavAsa hata yArA nizcinte nirApade calApherA karata, tAhale avazyai Ami tAdera kAche pherezatA rasUla pAThAtAma|’
vala, ‘AmAra o tomAdera mAjhe AllAhara sAkSyai yatheSTa, tini tA~ra vAndAdera samparke puropuri oYAkiphahAla, Ara tini sarvadraSTA|’

AllAha yAke saThika pathe paricAlita karena se pathaprApta Ara yAderake tini pathabhraSTa karena, tumi kakSano tAdera janya tA~ke chAr3A anya kAuke abhibhAvaka pAve nA| kviYAmAtera dina Ami tAderake ekatrita karava tAdera mukhera bhare andha, vovA o vadhira avasthAYa| tAdera AvAsa hacche jAhAnnAma| yakhanai tAra Aguna nisteja haYe Asave, Ami tAdera janya agnira dahana zakti vRddhi kare deva|

eTAi tAdera pratiphala, kenanA tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha pratyAkhyAna karechila Ara valechila, ‘yakhana AmarA hADDi o cUrNa dhUlAYa pariNata hava takhanao ki AmAderake natuna eka sRSTira AkAre AvAra uThAno have?’

tArA ki lakSya kare nA ye AllAha- yini AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena- tini tAdera mata mAnuSa (punarAYa) sRSTi karate sakSama| tini tAdera janya ekaTA sunirdiSTa samaYa sthira karechena, yAte konai sandeha nei| kintu yAlimarA amAnya kare kevala kupharii karala|
vala, ‘tomarA yadi AmAra pratipAlakera rAhamAtera bhAnDArera mAlika haYe yete, tavuo kharaca haYe yAvAra bhaYe tomarA tA avazyai dhare rAkhate|’ vAstavikai mAnuSa var3ai saMkIrNa-citta|

Ami mUsAke naYaTi spaSTa nidarzana diYechilAma| vAnI isarAIlake jijJesa kare dekha, yakhana se tAdera (arthAt phira‘Aona o tAra pradhAnadera) nikaTa Asala takhana phira‘Aona tAke valala, ‘ohe mUsA! Ami tomAke avazyai yAdugrasta mane kari|’
mUsA valala, ‘tumi to jAna ye, esava cokha-khule-deYA nidarzana AsamAnasamUha o yamInera pratipAlaka chAr3A anya keu avatIrNa kareni, he phira‘Aona! Ami to tomAke mane kari eka dhvaMsaprApta loka|’
ataHpara phiraAuna tAderake duniYA theke sariYe dite cAila| takhana Ami tAke Ara tAra saGgI-sAthIdera savvAike DuviYe mAralAma|
erapara Ami vAnI isarAIlake valalAma, ‘tomarA yamInera upara vasavAsa kara, ataHpara yakhana pratizruta kviYAmAta Asave takhana Ami tomAderake saMmizrita dalavale hAjira karava|’
e kuraAnake Ami satyatA sahakAre nAyila karechi Ara satyatA sahakArei tA nAyila haYeche| Ami tomAke zudhu susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI hiseve pAThiYechi|
Ami e kuraAnake bhAge bhAge vibhakta karechi yAte tumi theme theme mAnuSake tA pATha kare zunAte pAra, kAjei Ami tA kramazaH nAyila karechi|
vala, ‘tomarA kuraAne vizvAsa kara kiMvA vizvAsa nA kara, itopUrve yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche tAderake yakhana kuraAna pATha kare zunAno haYa, takhana tArA adhomukhe sAjadAhaYa luTiYe par3e|’
Ara tArA vale, ‘AmAdera ravva mahAna, pavitra; AmAdera ravvera o‘YAdA avazyai pUrNa have|
tArA kA~date kA~date adhomukhe sAjadAhaYa luTiYe par3e Ara tA tAdera vinaYa o namratA vAr3iYe deYa|[sAjadAha]

vala, ‘tomarA AllAha nAme DAko vA rahamAna nAme DAko, ye nAmei tA~ke DAko nA kena (savai bhAla) kenanA sakala sundara nAmai to tA~ra|’ tomAra salAte svara ucca karo nA, Ara tA khuva nIcuo karo nA, e du’Yera madhyavartI patha avalamvana kara|

vala, ‘sakala prazaMsAi AllAhara yini santAna grahaNa karena nA, yA~ra zAsana-kartRtve kona aMzIdAra nei, durdazAgrasta haoYA theke vA~cAra janya yA~ra kona abhibhAvakera praYojana haYa nA| ataeva pUrNa zreSThatve tA~ra zreSThatva ghoSaNA kara|
sakala prazaMsA AllAhara janya yini tA~ra vAndAdera prati kitAva nAyila karechena, Ara tAte kona vakratAra avakAza rAkhenani|

(tini seTAke karechena) satya, spaSTa o akATya tA~ra kaThina zAsti samparke satarka karAra janya| Ara yArA satkAja kare sei mu’minaderake susaMvAda deYAra janya ye, tAdera janya Ache uttama pratiphala|
tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave|
Ara tAderake satarka karAra janya yArA vale, ‘AllAha putra grahaNa karechena|’
e samparke tAdera kona jJAna nei, Ara tAdera pitR-puruSaderao chila nA| tAdera mukha theke vera haYa var3ai sAMghAtika kathA| tArA yA vale tA mithye chAr3A kichui naYa|
tArA e vANIte (kuraAne) vizvAsa nA karAra kAraNe mane hacche (he nAvI!) tumi tAra duHkhe tomAra nijera jAna vinAza kare deve|
yamInera upara yA kichu Ache Ami seguloke tAra zobhA-saundarya karechi yAte Ami mAnuSake parIkSA karate pAri ye, ‘AmAlera kSetre kArA uttama|
Ami avazyai tAra upara yA Ache tA vRkSalatAhIna zukano dhUlA mATite pariNata karava|
tumi ki mane kara ye, guhA o rakImera adhivAsIrA chila AmAra nidarzanagulora madhye vismaYakara?
yuvakarA yakhana guhAYa AzraYa grahaNa karala takhana tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi tomAra nikaTa hate AmAderake rahamata dAna kara Ara AmAdera vyApAraTi suSThubhAve sampAdana kara|’
ataHpara Ami tAderake guhAYa ghumanta avasthAYa kaYeka vachara rekhe dilAma|

pare tAderake jAgrata karalAma eTA jAnAra janya ye, (guhAvAsIrA Ara yAdera yuge tArA jAgrata haYechila se yugera lokerA e) du’Ti dalera madhye konaTi tAdera avasthAnakAlera saThika hisAva karate pAre|

Ami tAdera saThika vRttAnta tomAra kAche varNanA karachi| tArA chila kaYekajana yuvaka, tArA tAdera pratipAlakera upara ImAna enechila Ara Ami tAdera hidAYAta (ImAnI cetanAke) vRddhi kare diYechilAma|
