Ara tAdera dila mayavuta kare diYechilAma yakhana tArA (muzarika rAjA o tAra anusArIdera viruddhe) dA~r3iYe gela takhana valala, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka to tinii yini AsamAnasamUha yamInera pratipAlaka| AmarA kakSano tA~ke tyAga kare anya kona ilAhake DAkava nA| yadi AmarA DAki tAhale mahA aparAdhera kathAi valA have|

AmAdera jAtira ei lokerA tA~ra parivarte vahu ilAha grahaNa kareche, tArA tAdera ilAhadera vyApAre suspaSTa dalIla pramANa peza kare nA kena? tAra theke var3a yAlima Ara ke hate pAre ye AllAha samparke mithyA racanA kare?

ekhana yehetu tomarA tAdera theke Ara tArA AllAha chAr3A yegulora ‘ivAdAta kare tAdera theke samparka chinna kare niYecha, takhana cala, guhAYa giYe AzraYa grahaNa kara| tomAdera janya tomAdera pratipAlaka tA~ra kalyANa vistAra karavena Ara tomAdera kAja-karmake phaladAYaka kare devena|’

tumi dekhate pete sUrya udaYera samaYa tAdera guhA hate DAna dike hele yeta, Ara yakhana tA astamita hata takhana tA tAdera theke vAma dike neme yeta, Ara tArA chila guhAra abhyantare vizAla catvare| e hacche AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera anyatama| AllAha yAke satpatha dekhAna se saThikapathaprApta Ara yAke tini pathahArA karena, tAra janya tumi kakSano satpathera dizA dAnakArI abhibhAvaka pAve nA|

tumi mane karave ye tArA sajAga, athaca tArA chila ghumanta, Ami tAdera DAne vAme pArzva parivartana karAtAma| Ara tAdera kukuraTi chila guhAdvArera sammukhe tAra sAmanera pA du’Ti prasArita kare| tumi yadi tAderake tAkiYe dekhate tAhale avazyai pechana phire pAliYe yete, Ara avazyai tAdera bhaYe AtaGkita haYe par3ate|

Ara tAdera ei avasthAYa Ami tAderake jAgrata karalAma yAte tArA parasparake jijJAsAvAda kare| tAdera ekajana valala, ‘tomarA ka’ddina thAkale?’ tArA valala, ‘AmarA ekadina kiMvA ekadinera kichu aMza haYato raYechi|’ (zeSe) tArA (savAi) valala, ‘tomAdera pratipAlakai bhAla jAnena tomarA katakAla raYecha| ekhana tomAdera ekajanake tomAdera ei mudrA niYe zahare pAThiYe dAo| se yena dekhe uttama khAvAra konaTi Ara tAtheke tomAdera janya kichu khAvAra niYe Ase| se yena vuddhimattAra saGge kAja kare, Ara tomAdera vyApAre keu yena konakramei Tera nA pAYa|
yadi tArA tomAdera kathA jene phele tAhale tArA tomAderake pAthara mere hatyA karave kiMvA tomAderake tAdera dharme phiriYe nive, se avasthAYa tomarA kakSano kalyANa lAbha karate pArave nA|’

Ami ebhAve tAdera vyApAraTA lokederake oYAkiphahAla kare dilAma yAte tArA jAnate pAre ye, AllAhara oYA‘dA satya, Ara kviYAmAtera dina samparke kona sandeha nei| yakhana tArA (arthAt nagaravAsIrA) nijedera kartavya samparke nijedera madhye vAdAnuvAda karachila, (kataka) valala, ‘tAdera upara saudha nirmANa kara|’ tAdera pratipAlaka tAdera samparke bhAla jAnena| tAdera kartavyakarma samparke yAdera matAmata prAdhAnya lAbha karala tArA valala, ‘AmarA tAdera upara avazya avazyai mAsajida nirmANa karava|’

kataka loka valave, ‘tArA chila tinajana, tAdera caturthaTi chila tAdera kukura|’ Ara kataka loka valave, ‘tArA chila pA~ca jana, tAdera SaSThaTi chila tAdera kukura’, (e kathA tArA valave) ajAnA viSaYe sandehapUrNa anumAnera bhittite| AvAra tAdera kataka loka valave, ‘tArA chila sAtajana, Ara tAdera aSTamaTi chila tAdera kukura|’ vala, ‘tAdera saMkhyA samparke AmAra pratipAlakai vezi jAnena|’ alpa kaYajana chAr3A tAdera saMkhyA samparke keu jAne nA| kAjei sAdhAraNa kathAvArtA chAr3A tAdera vyApAra niYe vitarka karo nA, Ara tAdera samparke kAro kAche kichu jijJesao karo nA|
kona viSaYa samparke kakSano vala nA ye, ‘oTA Ami AgAmIkAla karava|’

‘AllAha icche karale’ valA chAr3A| yadi bhule yAo (tave mane par3Ara saGge saGge) tomAra pratipAlakake smaraNa kara Ara vala, ‘AzA kari AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke era ceYeo satyera nikaTavartI pathe paricAlita karavena| (kenanA eka vyakti yebhAvei saThika pathe caluka nA kena, tAra ceYeo uttamabhAve patha calA yete pAre)|
Ara (kAro mate) tArA tAdera guhAYa chila tinaza’ vachara Ara kichu loka naYa vachara vAr3iYe niYeche|

vala, ‘AllAhai bhAla jAnena tArA katakAla (guhAYa) chila|’ AsamAnasamUha yamInera adRzyera jJAna tA~rai Ache, kata spaSTai nA tini dekhena, kata spaSTai nA tini zonena| tini chAr3A tAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei, tini tA~ra kartRtve kAuke aMzIdAra karena nA|

Ara tumi tomAra kAche oYAhIkRta tomAra pratipAlakera kitAva theke pATha kare zunAo, tA~ra kathA parivartana kare deve emana keu nei, Ara tA~ke chAr3A tumi kakSano anya kAuke AzraYasthala hiseve pAve nA|

tumi dRr3ha citta haYe tAdera sAthe avasthAna kara yArA sakAla-sandhyA tAdera pratipAlakake AhavAna kare tA~ra santuSTi lAbhera sandhAne| pArthiva jIvanera zobhA o cAkacikya kAmanAYa tumi tAdera theke tomAra dRSTi phiriYe nio nA| tumi tAra Anugatya kara nA yAra antarake Ami AmAra smaraNa hate udAsIna kare diYechi, ye nijera pravRttira Anugatya kare Ara yAra kAryakalApa hacche sImAlaGghanamUlaka|

Ara vale dAo, ‘satya eseche tomAdera ravvera nikaTa hate, kAjei yAra icche ImAna Anuka Ara yAra icche satyake asvIkAra karuka|’ Ami (asvIkArakArI) yAlimadera janya Aguna prastuta kare rekhechi yAra lelihAna zikhA tAderake ghire pheleche| tArA pAnIYa cAile tAderake galita zizAra nyAYa pAni deYA have yA tAdera mukhamanDala dagdha karave, katai nA nikRSTa pAnIYa! Ara katai nA nikRSTa AzraYasthala!
yArA ImAna Ane Ara sat kAja kare- ye uttamabhAve kAja kare Ami tAra karmaphala vinaSTa kari nA|

tAdera janya Ache sthAYI jAnnAta yAra nimnadeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita| sekhAne tAderake alaMkRta karA have svarNa kaMkaNe| sUkSma o gAr3ha rezamera savuja pozAka tArA paridhAna karave| tArA gadi lAgAno uccAsane helAna diYe vasave| katai nA uttama puraskAra! katai nA uttama AzraYasthala!

tumi tAdera kAche du’vyaktira dRSTAnta varNanA kara yAdera ekajanake Ami diYechilAma du’Ti AGgurera vAgAna, Ara oguloke khejura gAcha diYe ghire diYechilAma Ara o du’Tira mAjhe diYechilAma zaSyakSeta|
du’To vAgAnai phala dita, ete etaTuku truTi karata nA| e du’Yera mAjhe Ami jharNAdhArA pravAhita karechilAma|
lokaTira utpAdana chila pracura| ekadina kathAvArtA valAra samaYa se tAra prativezIke valala, ‘Ami sampade tomA hate zreSTha, Ara janavale tomA hate zaktizAlI|’
nijera prati yulama kare se tAra vAgAne praveza karala| se valala, ‘Ami dhAraNA kari nA ye, eTA konadina dhvaMsa haYe yAve|
Ami mane kari nA ye kiYAmAta have| Ara yadi AmAke AmAra pratipAlakera kAche phiriYe neYA haYai, tAhale avazya avazyai Ami parivarte Aro utkRSTa sthAna pAva|

kathAra prasaGga Tene tAra sAthI valala, ‘tumi ki tA~ke asvIkAra karacha yini tomAke mATi theke sRSTi karechena, ataHpara zukra-kITa hate, ataHpara tomAke pUrNAGga dehasampanna mAnuSa vAniYe diYechena?
(Ara AmAra vyApAre kathA hala) sei AllAhai AmAra pratipAlaka, Ami kAuke AmAra pratipAlakera zarIka karava nA|
tumi yakhana tomAra vAgAne praveza karale takhana kena valale nA, ‘AllAha yA icche karechena (tA-i haYeche), AllAha chAr3A kAro kona zakti nei| yadio tumi AmAke dhane-jane tomAra ceYe kama dekha,
sambhavataH AmAra pratipAlaka AmAke tomAra vAgAna apekSAo uttama kichu dAna karavena Ara tomAra vAgAnera upara AsamAna hate kona vipada pAThiYe divena, phale tA zUnya maYadAne pariNata have|
kiMvA tAra pAni bhU-garbhe cale yAve, phale tumi kakSano tAra kho~ja pAve nA|’

dhvaMsa tAra phala-phasalake ghire phelala Ara tAte se yA kharaca karechila tAra janya hAta malate lAgala| tA chinna bhinna avasthAYa bhUmisAt haYe giYechila| se valala, ‘hAYa, Ami yadi AmAra ravva-era sAthe kAuke zarIka nA karatAma!’
Ara AllAha chAr3A tAke sAhAyya karAra kona dalavalao chila nA, Ara se nijeo era mokAvilA karate pArala nA|
e vyApAre yAvatIYa kartRtva kSamatA sei satyikAra AllAhara janyai nirdiSTa| puraskAra dAne tinii utkRSTa, Ara saphala pariNAma dAne tinii zreSTha|

tAdera kAche duniYAra e jIvanera dRSTAnta peza kara: tA hala pAnira mata yA tini AkAza hate varSaNa karena, yA diYe yamIne gAcha-gAchar3A ghana haYe udgata haYa, ataHpara tA zukano khar3akuTAYa pariNata haYa yAke vAtAsa ur3iYe niYe yAYa| AllAha halena sakala viSaYe zaktimAna|
dhana-sampada Ara santAnAdi pArthiva jIvanera zobhA-saundarya, Ara tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa puraskAra lAbhera janya sthAYI satkAja hala utkRSTa Ara AkAGkSA poSaNera bhitti hiseveo uttama|
(sedinera kathA cintA kara) yedina Ami parvatamAlAke cAlita karava, Ara pRthivIke dekhate pAve unmukta prAntara Ara tAdera savavAike Ami ekatrita karava, kAukeo vAda deva nA|

tAderake tomAra pratipAlakera sAmane sArivaddhabhAve hAjira karA have (Ara tAderake valA have), ‘tomarA AmAra kAche esecha temanibhAve yebhAve Ami tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechilAma| kintu tomarA to dhAraNA karechile ye, AmAra kAche tomAdera sAkSAtera nirdiSTakAla Ami kakSano upasthita karava nA|’

Ara ‘AmAlanAmA hAjira karA have, Ara tAte yA (lekhe rAkhA Ache) tAra kAraNe tumi aparAdhI lokaderake dekhate pAve bhIta AtaGkita| Ara tArA valave, ‘hAYa kapAla! eTA kemana kitAva ye choTa var3a kona kAjai cher3e deYani varaM sava kichura hisAva rekheche|’ tArA yA kareche tA sAmane upasthita pAve, Ara tomAra pratipAlaka kAro prati yulama karavena nA|

smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valechilAma, ‘AdAmake sAjadAha kara|’ takhana ivaliza chAr3A tArA savAi sAjadAha karala| se chila jvInadera antarbhukta| se tAra pratipAlakera nirdeza laGghana karala| etadasattveo tomarA ki AmAke vAda diYe tAke Ara tAra vaMzadharake abhibhAvaka vAniYe niccha? athaca tArA tomAdera duzamana| yAlimadera ei vinimaYa var3ai nikRSTa!
AsamAna yamInera sRSTikAle Ami tAderake sAkSI rAkhini, Ara tAdera nijedera sRSTi (pratyakSa karAra janya)o nA, pathabhraSTakArIderake sAhAyyakArI grahaNa karA AmAra kAja naYa|

sedina tini valavena, ‘tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka mane karate tAderake DAka|’ takhana tArA tAderake DAkave, kintu tArA tAdera DAke sAr3A deve nA| Ara Ami ubhaYa dalera mAjhe rekhe deva eka dhvaMsa-gahvara|
aparAdhIrA Aguna dekhate pAve Ara mane karave ye, tAderake tAte patita hate have, kintu sekhAna theke phire yAvAra tArA konai upAYa pAve nA|
Ami e kuraAne mAnuSera (jJAna lAbhera) janya yAvatIYa dRSTAnta vizadabhAve vivRta karechi kintu mAnuSa adhikAMza viSaYei vitarkakArI|

tAdera kAche yakhana pathera nirdeza Ase takhana ImAna Anate Ara tAdera pratipAlakera kAche kSamA cAite mAnuSake e chAr3A Ara anya kichui vAdhA deYa nA ye, (tArA apekSAYa thAke ye) atItera jAtigulora saGge yA karA haYeche, kakhana tAdera saGgeo tAi karA have athavA kakhana ‘AyAvake tArA sarAsari sAmane dekhate pAve|

Ami rasUladerake pAThiYe thAki ekamAtra susaMvAdadAtA Ara satarkakArI hiseve| kintu kAphiragaNa mithyA yukti peza kare vitarka karache tA diYe satyake durvala kare deYAra uddeze, Ara tArA AmAra nidarzana o bhaYa dekhAnoke hAsi-tAmAzAra viSaYa vAniYe niYeche|

tAra theke var3a yAlima Ara ke Ache yAke tAra pratipAlakera AYAtagulo smaraNa kariYe deYA hale se tAttheke mukha phiriYe neYa Ara se pUrve kRta tAra karmera (khArApa pariNatira) kathA bhule yAYa| Ami tAdera antarera upara AvaraNa diYe diYechi yAte tArA tA (arthAt kuraAna) vujhate nA pAre, Ara tAdera kAne e~Te diYechi vadhiratA| tumi tAderake satpathe DAkaleo tArA kakSano satpatha grahaNa karave nA|

tomAra pratipAlaka kSamAzIla, daYAra AdhAra| tAdera kRtakarmera janya tini yadi tAderake pAkar3Ao karatena, tAhale tAdera upara avazyai zIghrai ‘AyAva pAThAtena, kintu tAdera saGge kRta oYA‘dAra janya Ache nirdiSTa samaYa, yAke pAza kATiYe tArA kakSano AzraYera kona jAYagA pAve nA|
ai sava janadapake Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechilAma yakhana tArA vAr3AvAr3i karechila, Ara tAdera dhvaMsa sAdhanera janya ekaTA pratizruta samaYa sthira karechilAma|
smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra saGgIke valechila, ‘dui samudrera milanasthale pau~chA nA paryanta Ami calatei thAkavo yadio vacharera para vachara calateo haYa|’
ataHpara yakhana tArA du’jane dui samudrera milana sthale pau~chala, tArA tAdera mAchera kathA bhule gela Ara seTi samudre tAra patha kare nila sur3aGgera mata|
yakhana tArA Aro egiYe gela, se tAra saGgIke valala, ‘AmAdera sakAlera khAvAra Ana, AmarA AmAdera ei saphare var3ai klAnta haYe par3echi|’

saGgITi valala, ‘Apani ki lakSya karechena, AmarA yakhana zilAkhanDe (vase) chilAma takhana Ami mAchera kathA bhule giYechilAma| seTAra kathA ApanAke valate zaYatAnai AmAke bhuliYe diYechila Ara mAchaTi vismaYakarabhAve samudre tAra rAstA kare cale giYechila|’
mUsA valala, ‘eTAi to se jAYagA yeTA AmarA khu~jachi|’ kAjei tArA tAdera pAYera cihna dhare phire gela|
takhana tArA AmAra vAndAdera eka vAndAke pela, yAra prati AmAra pakSa theke anugraha dAna karechilAma Ara AmAra pakSa theke tAke vizeSa jJAna dAna karechilAma|
mUsA tAke valala, ‘Ami ki e zarte ApanAra anusaraNa karava ye, Apani AmAke sei (vizeSa) jJAna theke zikSA devena ye jJAna ApanAke zekhAno haYeche?’
se valala, ‘Apani kichutei AmAra sAthe dhairya dhAraNa karate pAravena nA|’
Apani kIbhAve se viSaYe dhairya dhAraNa karavena yA ApanAra jJAnera AYatvera vAire?’
mUsA valala, ‘AllAha cAile AmAke dhairyazIlai pAvena, Ami ApanAra kona nirdezai laGghana karava nA|’
se valala, ‘Apani yehetu AmAra anusaraNa karatei cAna, tAhale Apani AmAke kona vyApArei prazna karavena nA yatakSaNa nA Ami nijei se samparke ApanAke vali|’

ataHpara tArA du’jane calate lAgala yatakSaNa nA tArA naukAYa uThala, ataHpara lokaTi naukAYa chidra kare dila| mUsA valala, ‘Apani ki tAra ArohIderake DuviYe deYAra janya tAte chidra karalena? Apani to eka adbhuta kAja karalena|’
se valala, ‘Ami ki ApanAke valini ye, Apani kichutei AmAra saGge dhairya dharate pAravena nA?’
mUsA valala, ‘AmAra bhulera janya AmAke pAkar3Ao karavena nA, Ara AmAra vyApAre Apani adhika kar3Akar3i karavena nA|’

tArapara tArA calate lAgala| calate calate eka vAlakake tArA dekhate pela| takhana se tAke hatyA kare phelala| mUsA valala, ‘Apani ki eka nirAparAdha jIvanake kona prakAra hatyAra aparAdha chAr3Ai hatyA kare dilena? Apani to gurutara eka anyAYa kAja kare phelalena!’
se valala, ‘Ami ki ApanAke valini ye, Apani AmAra saGge kakSano dhairya dharate pAravena nA?’
mUsA valala, ‘erapara Ami yadi kona viSaYe ApanAke jijJesa kari, tAhale Apani Ara AmAke saGge rAkhavena nA, oyara anyAYa AmAra pakSa thekei ghaTeche|’

tArapara tArA ubhaYe calate lAgala, calate calate tArA eka janapade pau~che sekhAnakAra lokedera kAche khAvAra cAila| kintu tArA tAdera du’janake Atithya pradAna karate asvIkAra karala| tArA du’jana sekhAne ekaTA deYAla dekhate pela yA par3e yAvAra upakrama haYechila| takhana se vyakti seTike supratiSThita kare dila| mUsA valala, ‘Apani icche karale era janya pArizramika nite pAratena|’
lokaTi valala, ‘ekhAnei ApanAra sAthe AmAra samparkera viccheda ghaTala| ekhana Ami ApanAke vyAkhyA jAniYe deva ye viSaYe Apani dhairya dharate pArenani|

naukATira vyApAra hala- tA chila kaYekajana garIva lokera, tArA samudre jIvikAra janya zrama karata| Ami seTAke khu~tayukta karate cAilAma, kAraNa tAdera pazcAte chila eka rAjA, se jorapUrvaka sava naukA ker3e nita|
Ara vAlakaTira vyApAra hala- tAra mAtA-pitA chila mu’mina| AmarA zaGkA karalAma ye, se tAra vidrohamUlaka AcaraNa o (AllAhara prati) kuphurI dvArA tAderake kaSTa deve|
e kAraNe AmarA cAilAma ye, tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake tAra parivarte adhika pavitra o daYA-mAYAYa adhika ghaniSTha (santAna) dAna karavena|

Ara ai deYAlaTira viSaYa hala- tA chila ai zaharera du’jana iYAtIma vAlakera| tAra nIce chila tAdera janya rakSita dhana, tAdera pitA chila eka sat vyakti| tAi tomAra pratipAlaka cAilena tArA du’jana yauvane upanIta hoka Ara tAdera gacchita dhana vera kare nika- yA hala tomAra pratipAlakera rahamata vizeSa| e sava Ami nijera pakSa theke karini| e hala se viSaYera vyAkhyA ye samparke Apani dhairya dhAraNa karate pArenani|’
tomAke tArA yulakAranAina samparke jijJesa karache| vala, ‘Ami tAra viSaYa tomAdera nikaTa kichu varNanA karava|’
Ami tAke pRthivIte Adhipatya dAna karechilAma Ara tAke sava rakamera upAYa upAdAna diYechilAma|
ekavAra se eka rAstA dharala (arthAt ekadike ekaTA abhiyAna cAlAla)|

calate calate yakhana se sUryAstera sthAne pau~chala, takhana se sUryake asvaccha jalAzaYe Duvate dekhala Ara sekhAne ekaTi jAtira lokedera sAkSAt pela| Ami valalAma, ‘he yulakAranAina! tumi tAderake zAsti dite pAra kiMvA tAdera saGge (sadaYa) vyavahArao karate pAra|’
se valala, ‘ye vyakti yulama karave Ami tAke acirei zAsti deva, ataHpara tAke tAra pratipAlakera kAche phiriYe AnA have, takhana tini tAke kaThina ‘AyAva devena|
Ara ye vyakti ImAna Anave Ara satkAja karave tAra janya Ache uttama puraskAra Ara Ami tAke sahaja kAjera nirdeza deva|
tArapara se Areka patha dharala|
calate calate se sUryodaYera sthAne pau~chala| se sUryake emana eka jAtira upara udaYa hate dekhate pela, Ami yAdera janya sUrya theke vA~cAra kona Ar3Alera vyavasthA karini|
ei hala tAdera avasthA| tAra sAmane yA chila Ami se samparke chilAma sampUrNa avahita|
erapara se Areka patha dharala|
calate calate se du’ pAhAr3era mAjhe ese pau~chala| sekhAne se eka sampradAYake dekhate pela| yArA kathAvArtA kamai vujhate pAre|
tArA valala, ‘he yulakvAranAYana! iYAjUja mA’jUja pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi karache, ataeva AmarA ki ApanAke kara deva ye, Apani AmAdera o tAdera mAjhe ekaTA vA~dha nirmANa kare devena?’
se valala, ‘AmAke AmAra pratipAlaka yA diYechena tA-i yatheSTa, kAjei tomarA AmAke zakti-zrama diYe sAhAyya kara, Ami tomAdera o tAdera mAjhe eka sudRr3ha prAcIra gar3e deva|

AmAra kAche lohAra pAta ene dAo|’ zeSa paryanta yakhana se du’pAhAr3era mAjhera phA~kA jAYagA puropuri bharATa kare dila se valala, ‘tomarA hApare dama dite thAka|’ zeSa paryanta yakhana tA Agunera mata lAla haYe gela takhana se valala, ‘Ano, Ami era upara galita tAmA Dhele deva|’
erapara tArA (arthAt iYAjUja-mA‘juja) tA atikrama karate pArave nA, Ara tA bheda karateo pArave nA|
se valala, ‘e AmAra pratipAlakera karuNA, yakhana AmAra pratipAlakera oYA‘dAra nirdiSTa samaYa Asave, takhana tini tAke dhUlisAt kare devena Ara AmAra pratipAlakera oYA‘dA satya|
Ami tAderake sedina emana avasthAYa cher3e deva ye, tArA ekadala Areka dalera upara taraGgamAlAra mata par3ave| Ara ziGgAYa phu~ka deYA have| ataHpara AmarA sava mAnuSake ekasaGge ekatrita karava|
Ami sedina jAhAnnAmake kAphiradera janya sarAsari hAyira karava|
AmAra smaraNa theke yAdera cakSu chila AvaraNe DhAkA Ara tArA zunateo sakSama chila nA|
yArA kuphurI nIti grahaNa kareche tArA ki mane kare ye, tArA AmAra parivarte AmAra vAndAhaderake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karave? Ami kAphiradera mehamAnadArira janya jAhAnnAma prastuta kare rekhechi|
vala, ‘Ami tomAderake ki saMvAda deva nijedera ‘AmAlera kSetre kArA savaceYe vezi kSatigrasta?’
tArA hala se sava loka duniYAra jIvane yAdera ceSTA sAdhanA vyartha haYe geche Ara tArA nijerA mane karache ye, tArA saThika kAjai karache|

tArA hala se sava loka yArA tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzana o tA~ra sAthe sAkSAtke amAnya kare| yAra phale tAdera yAvatIYa ‘AmAla nisphala haYe geche| kiYAmAtera dina Ami tAdera (kAjera) janya kona ojana kAYima karava nA (arthAt tAdera e sava ‘AmAla ojanayogya hiseve gaNya karA have nA)|
eTAi tAdera pratiphala-jAhAnnAma, kAraNa tArA kuphurI kareche Ara AmAra nidarzana o rasUladerake hAsi-tAmAzAra viSaYa vAniYeche|
yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkAja kare tAdera ApyAYanera janya Ache phiradAusera vAgAna|
sekhAne tArA sthAYI haYe thAkave, sekhAna theke vera haYe Ara anyatra yete cAive nA|

vala, ‘samudragulo yadi AmAra pratipAlakera kathA lekhAra janya kAli haYe yAYa, tave AmAra pratipAlakera kathA lekhA zeSa haoYAra Agei samudra avazyai niHzeSa haYe yAve, Ami yadi era sAhAyyera janya Aro anurUpa parimANa samudra niYe Asi tavuo|’

vala, ‘Ami tomAderai mata ekajana mAnuSa, AmAra nikaTa oYAhI karA haYa ye, tomAdera ilAha kevala eka ilAha| kAjei ye vyakti tAra pratipAlakera saGge sAkSAtera AzA kare, se yena sat ‘AmAla kare Ara tAra pratipAlakera ‘ivAdAte kAuke zarIka nA kare|’
kAph-hA-iYyA-‘Aina-sAda|
eTA tomAra pratipAlakera anugrahera vivaraNa tA~ra vAndAha yAkAriYyAra prati|
yakhana se tAra pratipAlakake AhavAna karechila- eka gopana AhavAne|
se valechila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra hAr3agulo durvala haYe geche, Ara vArdhakye AmAra mastaka sAdA haYe geche, he AmAra pratipAlaka! tomAke Deke Ami kakhano viphala haini|
AmAra pare AmAra svagotrIYarA (kI karave) se samparke Ami AzaGkAvodha karachi, Ara AmAra strI hala vandhyA, kAjei tumi tomAra tarapha theke AmAke ekajana uttarAdhikArI dAna kara
ye AmAra uttarAdhikArI have Ara uttarAdhikArI have iYA‘kuva parivArera; Ara he AmAra pratipAlaka! tAke karuna ApanAra santuSTira pAtra|
tini valalena, ‘he yAkAriYA! Ami tomAke ekaTi putrera zubha saMvAda dicchi yAra nAma have iYAhaiYA, pUrve e nAme Ami kAuke AkhyAYita karini|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pAlanakartA! AmAra putra have kemana kare, AmAra strI to vandhyA, Ara Ami vArdhakyera zeSa stare pau~che gechi|’
tini valalena, ‘ebhAvei have, tomAra pratipAlaka valechena, ‘eTA AmAra pakSe sahaja| itopUrve Amii tomAke sRSTi karechi yakhana tumi kichui chile nA|’
se valala, ‘he AmAra pAlanakartA! AmAra janya ekaTA cihna sthira kare dina|’ tini valalena, ‘tomAra cihna ei ye, tumi tina rAta mAnuSera saGge kathA valave nA yadio tumi kathA valate sakSama|’
ataHpara se tAra kuThari theke vera haYe tAra sampradAYera kAche gela evaM izArAYa tAderake sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAhara prazaMsA-pavitratA varNanA karate valala|
(tAra putrera kAche nirdeza Asala) ‘he iYAhiYA! e kitAva (tAorAta) sudRr3habhAve dhAraNa kara|’ Ami tAke vAlya kAlei jJAna dAna karechilAma|
Ara (diYechilAma) AmAra pakSa theke daYA-mAYA o pavitratA| se chila AllAhabhIru |
Ara pitA-mAtAra prati sadaYa, se dAmbhika, avAdhya chila nA|
tAra upara zAnti yedina se janmeche, yedina tAra mRtyu have Ara yedina se jIvanta haYe utthita have|
e kitAve (ullekhita) mAraiYAmera kAhinI varNanA kara- yakhana se tAra parivAravarga hate AlAdA haYe pUrva dike eka jAYagAYa AzraYa niYechila|

se tAdera theke (Ar3Ala karAra janya) pardA TAniYe dila| takhana Ami tAra kAche AmAra rUhke (arthAt jivarIlake) pAThiYe dilAma| takhana se (arthAt jivarIla) tAra sAmane pUrNa mAnuSera AkRti dhAraNa karala|
mAraiYAma valala, ‘Ami tomA hate daYAmaYa AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA karachi yadi tumi AllAhake bhaYa kara’ (tave AmAra nikaTa eso nA)|’
se valala, ‘Ami tomAra pratipAlaka kartRka prerita haYechi tomAke ekaTi puta-pavitra putra dAnera uddezye|’
se valala, ‘kemana kare AmAra putra hate pAre, yakhana kona mAnuSa AmAke sparza kareni, Ara Ami asatIo nai|’
se valala, ‘ebhAvei have, tomAra pratipAlaka valechena- ‘oTA AmAra janya sahaja, Ami tAke mAnuSera janya nidarzana vAnAte cAi Ara AmAra pakSa theke eka rahamata, e vyApAre siddhAnta haYe geche|’
ataHpara chele tAra garbhe Asala| takhana se tA niYe dUravartI jAYagAYa cale gela|
santAna prasavera vedanA tAke eka khejura vRkSatalera dike tAr3ita karala| se vale uThala, ‘hAYa! era Agei yadi Ami mare yetAma Ara (mAnuSera) smRti theke puropuri muche yetAma!’
nimnadika theke tAke DAka deYA hala, ‘tumi duHkha karo nA, tomAra pratipAlaka tomAra pAdadeza diYe eka nirjhariNI pravAhita kare diYechena|
khejura gAchera kAnDa dhare tumi tomAra dike nAr3A dAo, tA tomAra upara tAjA paripakka khejura patita karave|

ataHpara khAo, pAna kara Ara (tomAra) cokha jur3Ao| yadi tumi kona lokake dekhate pAo tAhale valave- Ami rahamAna AllAhara janya sAoma pAlanera mAnat karechi, kAjei Ami kona mAnuSera saGge Aja kichutei kathA valava nA|’
ataHpara se tAra santAnake vaYe niYe tAra sampradAYera kAche Asala| tArA valala, ‘he mAraiYAma! tumi to eka adbhuta jinisa niYe esecha!
ohe hArUnera vona! tomAra pitA to khArApa loka chila nA, Ara tomAra mAo chila nA kona asatI nArI|’
takhana mAraiYAma tAra chelera dike izArA karala| tArA valala, ‘AmarA kolera vAccAra saGge kIbhAve kathA valava?’
zizuTi vale uThala, ‘Ami AllAhara vAndAha, tini AmAke kitAva diYechena, Ara AmAke navI karechena|
Ami yekhAnei thAki nA kena tini AmAke varakatamaYa karechena Ara AmAke nAmAya o yAkAtera hukuma diYechena- yatadina Ami jIvita thAki|
Ara (tini AmAke karechena) AmAra mAtAra prati sadaYa, tini AmAke dAmbhika hatabhAgya karenani|
AmAra upara Ache zAnti yedina Ami janmechi, yedina AmAra mRtyu have Ara Ami yedina jIvita haYe utthita hava|’
ei hacche mAraiYAma-putra IsA, (eTAi) satya kathA ye viSaYe lokerA sandeha poSaNa kare|
santAna grahaNa karA AllAhara kAja naYa, tini pavitra, mahAna; yakhana tini kichu karAra siddhAnta karena takhana tAra janya zudhu valena, ‘haYe yAo’, Ara tA haYe yAYa|
AllAhi AmAra o tomAdera pratipAlaka, kAjei tomarA tA~rai ‘ivAdAta kara, eTAi sarala sudRr3ha patha|
ataHpara dalagulo tAdera madhye matabheda karala| kAjei sei bhaYAvaha dinera upasthitakAle kAphiradera janya dhvaMsa anivArya|
yedina tArA AmAra kAche Asave sedina katai nA spaSTabhAve tArA zunate pAve Ara dekhate pAve| kintu yAlimarA Aja spaSTa gumarAhIra madhye par3e Ache|
vipadera dina samparke tAderake satarka kare dAo yakhana vyApAra cUr3Anta karA have Ara (dekha) e samparke tArA udAsIna Ara tArA ImAna Ane nA|
yamIna Ara yamInera upara yArA Ache tAdera mAlikAnA AmArai thAkave, Ara tArA AmAra kAchei phire Asave|
e kitAve ullekhita ivarAhImera kathA smaraNa kara, se chila ekajana satyaniSTha mAnuSa, ekajana navI|
yakhana se tAra pitAke valechila, ‘he AmAra pitA! Apani kena emana jinisera ‘ivAdAta karena yA zune nA, dekhe nA, Ara ApanAra kona kAjei Ase nA?
he AmAra pitA! AmAra kAche emana jJAna eseche yA ApanAra kAche Aseni, kAjei AmAra anusaraNa karuna, Ami ApanAke sarala saThika patha dekhAva|
he AmAra pitA! Apani zaYatAnera ‘ivAdAta karavena nA, zaYatAna hacche daYAmaYera viruddhe vidrohI|
he AmAra pitA! AmAra bhaYa haYa ye, daYAmaYera ‘AyAva ApanAke dhare vasave, takhana Apani zaYatAnera vandhu haYe yAvena|’

pitA valala, ‘he ivarAhIma! tumi ki AmAra devadevIgulo theke mukha phiriYe niccha? yadi tumi virata nA hao tave Ami avazyai tomAke pAtharera AghAte mere phelava| tumi ciratare AmAra kAcha theke dUra haYe yAo|’
ivarAhIma valala, ‘ApanAra prati sAlAma, Ami AmAra pratipAlakera nikaTa ApanAra janya kSamA prArthanA karava, tini AmAra prati var3ai meheravAna|
Ami parityAga karachi ApanAderake Ara ApanArA AllAhake vAda diYe yAderake DAkena tAderake| Ami AmAra pratipAlakake DAki, AzA kari Ami AmAra pratipAlakake Deke vaJcita hava nA|’
ataHpara se yakhana tAderake Ara tArA AllAhake vAda diYe yAdera ‘ivAdAta karata tAderake parityAga karala, takhana Ami tAke dAna karalAma isahAkva Ara iYA‘kUva Ara tAdera pratyekake navI karalAma|
Ami tAderake dAna karalAma AmAra anugraha Ara satyikAra nAma-yazera suucca sukhyAti|
e kitAve ullekhita mUsAra kathA smaraNa kara, se chila vizeSabhAve manonIta, Ara ekajana rasUla o navI|
Ami tAke DAka diYechilAma tUra pAhAr3era DAna pArzva theke Ara gopane kathAvArtA valAra janya tAke nikaTavartI karechilAma|
Ara Ami svIYa anugrahe tAke dAna karechilAma tAra bhAi hArUnake, seo chila ekajana navI|
e kitAve ullekhita isamAIlera kathA smaraNa kara, se chila oYA‘dA rakSAYa (dRr3ha) satyavAdI, Ara chila ekajana rasUla o navI|
se tAra parivAravargake nAmAya o yAkAtera hukuma dita Ara se chila tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa santuSTira pAtra|
e kitAve ullekhita idarIsera kathA smaraNa kara, se chila satyaniSTha, ekajana navI|
Ami tAke ucca maryAdAYa unnIta karechilAma|

erAi hala tArA AdAma vaMzera navIgaNera madhya hate, Ara nUhera saGge yAderake (naukAYa) ArohaNa kariYechilAma tAdera madhya hate, Ara ivarAhIma o isarAIlera vaMzadharadera madhya hate yAderake Ami anugraha karechilAma, erA tAderai madhya hate, yAderake Ami pathanirdeza diYechilAma Ara veche niYechilAma, edera nikaTa daYAmaYera AYAta AvRtti karA hale tArA sAjadAYa avanata haYe kAnnAbhare luTiYe par3ata| [sAjadAha]
ataHpara tAdera para ela apadArtha paravartIrA, tArA nAmAya hArAlo, Ara lAlasAra vazavartI hala| tArA acirei dhvaMsera sammukhIna have|
tArA vAde yArA tAovAha karave, ImAna Anave Ara sat kAja karave| phale erAi jAnnAte praveza karave, edera prati etaTuku yulama karA have nA|
sthAYI jAnnAta, daYAmaYa tA~ra vAndAhke ye adRzya viSaYera pratizruti diYechena, tA~ra pratizruti avazyai pUrNa have|
sekhAne tArA zAntira sambhASaNa chAr3A kona apavAkya zunave nA| Ara sakAla-sandhyA sekhAne tAdera janya thAkave jIvana dhAraNera upakaraNa|
ei hala sei jAnnAta Ami yAra uttarAdhikArI karava AmAra vAndAhadera madhye muttAkIderake|

(pherezatAgaNa vale) ‘AmarA ApanAra pratipAlakera hukuma chAr3A avataraNa kari nA, yA AmAdera sAmane Ache, Ara yA AmAdera pechane Ache Ara e du’Yera mAjhe yA Ache tA tA~rai, ApanAra pratipAlaka kakSano bhule yAna nA|

tini AkAza, yamIna Ara e du’Yera mAjhe yA Ache tAra pratipAlaka, kAjei tumi tA~ra ‘ivAdAta kara, Ara tA~ra ‘ivAdAte niYamita o dRr3ha thAka| tumi ki tA~ra nAmera guNasampanna anya Ara keu Ache vale jAna?
mAnuSa vale, ‘kI! Ami yakhana mare yAva, AmAke takhana ki jIvita kare uThAno have?’
mAnuSa ki smaraNa kare nA ye, Ami pUrve tAke sRSTi karechi Ara se takhana kichui chila nA|
kAjei tomAra ravvera kasama! Ami tAderake avazya avazyai ekatrita karava Ara zaYatAnaderakeo| ataHpara tAderake jAhAnnAmera catuSpArzve natajAnu avasthAYa avazya avazyai hAjira karava|
ataHpara pratyeka dala hate daYAmaYera prati savaceYe avAdhyake avazya avazyai Tene vera karava|
Ara Ami avazya avazyai khuva bhAla kare jAni tAdera madhye kArA jAhAnnAme dagdha haoYAra sarvAdhika upayukta|
tomAdera madhye emana keu nei yAke jAhAnnAma atikrama karate have nA, eTA tomAra pratipAlakera anivArya phaYasAlA|
ataHpara muttAkIderake Ami rakSA karava Ara yAlimaderake tAra madhye natajAnu avasthAYa rekhe deva|
AmAra spaSTa AYAta yakhana tAdera nikaTa AvRtti karA haYa takhana kAphirarA mu’minaderake vale, ‘du’Ti dalera madhye maryAdAYa konaTi zreSTha Ara majalisa hiseve adhika uttama?’
Ami tAdera pUrve vahu mAnava vaMzake dhvaMsa karechi yArA upAYa upakaraNe Ara vAirera cAkacikye tAdera apekSA zreSTha chila|

vala, yArA gumarAhIte par3e Ache, daYAmaYa tAdera janya (razi) Dhila diYe dena, ye paryanta nA tArA dekhate pAve yAra oYA‘dA tAderake deYA hacche- tA zAstii hoka kiMvA kviYAmatai hoka|’ takhana tArA jAnate pArave maryAdAYa ke nikRSTa Ara janavale durvala|
yArA satpatha sandhAna kare AllAha tAderake adhika hidAYAta dAna karena| Ara sthAYI satkarmasamUha tomAra pAlanakartAra nikaTa sAoYAvera dika diYe zreSTha Ara pratidAna hiseveo zreSTha|
tumi ki lakSya karecha se vyaktike ye AmAra nidarzanasamUhake pratyAkhyAna kareche Ara se vale, ‘AmAke avazya avazyai sampada Ara santAnAdi deYA have|’
se ki adRzya viSaYa jene pheleche, nAki daYAmaYera nikaTa theke pratizruti lAbha kareche?
kakSano nA, tArA yA vale Ami tA likhe rAkhava Ara Ami tAra zAsti vAr3Atei thAkava, vAr3Atei thAkava|
se ye viSaYera kathA vale (tAra sampada-saraJjAma o janavalera garva kare) tA thAkave AmAra adhikAre Ara se AmAra kAche Asave niHsaGga, ekAkI|
tArA AllAhake vAda diYe anyAnya ilAha grahaNa kareche yAte tArA (arthAt ai kalpita mA‘vudagulo) tAdera janya pRSThapoSaka haYa|
kakSano nA, tArA tAdera ‘ivAdAta asvIkAra karave Ara tAdera virodhI haYe yAve|
tumi ki lakSya kara nA ye, Ami kAphiradera janya zaYatvAnake cher3e rekhechi tAderake manda karma karate prarocita karAra janya|
kAjei tAdera vyApAre tAr3Ahur3o karo nA, Ami guNe rAkhachi tAdera janya nirdiSTa (divasera) saMkhyA|
yedina muttAkIderake daYAmaYera nikaTa ekatrita karava sammAnita atithi hiseve|
Ara Ami aparAdhIderake jAhAnnAmera dike tAr3iYe niYe yAva (yebhAve pipAsArta garu vAchurake pAnira dike tAr3iYe neYA haYa)|
daYAmaYera nikaTa ye pratizruti lAbha kareche se chAr3A anya kAro supAriza karAra adhikAra thAkave nA|
tArA vale, ‘daYAmaYa santAna grahaNa karechena|’
(emana kathA va’le) tomarA to eka bhaYAnaka viSaYera avatAraNA karecha|
yAte AkAza vidIrNa haoYAra, pRthivI khanDa khanDa haoYAra Ara parvatamAlA cUrNa vicUrNa haYe patita haoYAra, upakrama haYeche|
kAraNa tArA daYAmaYera prati santAna Aropa kare|
athaca daYAmaYera mahAna maryAdAra janya eTA zobhanIYa naYa ye, tini santAna grahaNa karavena|
AkAza Ara yamIne emana keu nei ye, daYAmaYera nikaTa vAndAha haYe hAyira have nA|
tini tAderake pariveSTana kare rekhechena Ara tAderake vizeSabhAve guNe guNe rekhechena|
kiYAmAtera dina tAdera savAi tA~ra kAche Asave ekAkI avasthAYa|
yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare, daYAmaYa tAdera prati bhAlavAsA dAna karavena|
Ami tomAra bhASAYa kuraAnake sahaja karechi yAte tumi tAra sAhAyye muttAkIderake susaMvAda dite pAra Ara jhagar3ATe lokederake satarka karate pAra|
tAdera pUrve Ami kata mAnava vaMzake dhvaMsa kare diYechi, tumi tAdera ekajanakeo ki (ekhana) dekhate pAo athavA tAdera kSINatama AoYAjao ki zunate pAo?
tva-hA-|
tomAke kleza deYAra janya Ami tomAra prati kuraAna nAyila karini|
varaM tA (nAyila karechi) kevala satarkavANI hiseve ye (AllAhake) bhaYa kare tAra janya|
yini pRthivI o suucca AkAza sRSTi karechena tA~ra nikaTa hate tA nAyila haYeche|
‘Araze daYAmaYa samunnata Achena|
yA AkAzasamUhe Ache, yA yamIne Ache, yA e du’Yera mAjhe Ache Ara yA bhUgarbhe Ache sava tA~rai|
yadi tumi uccakaNThe kathA vala (tAhale jene rekha) tini gupta o tadapekSAo gupta viSaYa jAnena|
AllAha, tini vyatIta satyikArera kona ilAha nei, sundara nAmasamUha tA~rai|
mUsAra kAhinI tomAra kAche pau~cheche ki?

yakhana se Aguna dekhala (mAdiYAna theke misara yAvAra pathe), takhana se tAra parivAravargake valala, ‘tomarA ekhAne avasthAna kara, Ami Aguna dekhechi, sambhavataH Ami tAttheke tomAdera janya kichu jvalanta Aguna Anate pArava kiMvA Agunera nikaTa pathera sandhAna pAva|
tArapara yakhana ye Agunera kAche Asala, tAke DAka deYA hala, ‘he mUsA!
vAstavikai Ami tomAra pratipAlaka, kAjei tomAra jutA khule phela, tumi pavitra tuoYA upatyakAYa Acha|
Ami tomAke veche niYechi, kAjei tumi manoyoga diYe zuno yA tomAra prati oYAhI karA hacche|
prakRtai Ami AllAha, Ami chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, kAjei AmAra ‘ivAdAta kara, Ara AmAke smaraNa karAra uddezye nAmAya kAYima kara|’
kiYAmAta Asavei, Ami tA gopana rAkhate cAi, yAte pratyeka vyakti svIYa ceSTA-sAdhanA anupAte phala lAbha karate pAre|
kAjei kviYAmate ye vizvAsa kare nA evaM svIYa pravRttira anusaraNa kare, se yena tomAke tAttheke konakramei vicyuta karate nA pAre, tAhale tumi dhvaMsa haYe yAve|
‘he mUsA! tomAra DAna hAte oTA kI?’
se valala, ‘eTA AmAra lAThi, Ami ote bhara dei, era sAhAyye Ami AmAra meSapAlera janya gAchera pAtA jher3e dei Ara ete AmAra Aro aneka kAja haYa|’
AllAha valalena, ‘he mUsA! oTA nikSepa kara|’
takhana se tA nikSepa karala, amani tA sApa haYe chuTochuTi karate lAgala|
AllAha valalena, ‘oTAke dhara, bhaYa peo nA, Ami seTAke ekSuni tAra Agera rUpe phiriYe deva|
Ara tomAra hAta vagale diYe TAna, tA kSatikara naYa emana zubhrojjvala haYe vera haYe Asave- anya ArekaTi nidarzana hiseve|
yAte Ami tomAke AmAra var3a var3a nidarzanagulora kichu dekhAte pAri|
pherAunera kAche yAo, vAstavikai se sImAlaGghana kareche|’
mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra janya AmAra vakSake prazasta kare dAo
Ara AmAra janya AmAra kAjake sahaja kare dAo|
AmAra jihvAra jar3atA dUra kare dAo|
yAte tArA AmAra kathA vujhate pAre|
Ara AmAra parivAra hate AmAra janya ekajana sAhAyyakArI vAniYe dAo|
AmAra bhAi hArUnake|
tAra dvArA AmAra zakti vRddhi kara|
AmAra kAje tAke aMzIdAra kara|
yAte AmarA vezi vezi kare tomAra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karate pAri|
Ara tomAke adhika smaraNa karate pAri|
tumi to AmAdera avasthA savai dekhacha|’
tini (AllAha) valalena, ‘he mUsA! tomAra prArthanA gRhIta hala|
Ami to tomAra upara Aro ekavAra anugraha karechilAma|
yakhana Ami tomAra mAYera prati iGgita karechilAma yA oYAhIyoge jAnAno haYechila-

ye tumi mUsAke sindukera madhye rAkha| tArapara tA dariYAYa bhAsiYe dAo| ataHpara dariYA tAke pAr3e Thele deve| tAke AmAra zatru o tAra zatru uThiYe neve| Ami AmAra nikaTa hate tomAra prati bhAlavAsA Dhele diYechilAma, yAte tumi AmAra dRSTira sammukhe pratipAlita hao|’

yakhana tomAra vona giYe valala, ‘tomAderake ki vale deva ke ei zizura tattvAvadhAna o pratipAlanera bhAra neve?’ ebhAve Ami tomAke tomAra mAYera kAche phiriYe AnalAma yAte tAra cokha jur3AYa Ara se duHkha nA pAYa| Ara tumi eka lokake hatyA karechile, ataHpara Ami tomAke manovedanA theke mukti diYechi| Ami tomAke aneka parIkSA karechi| ataHpara tumi kaYeka vachara mAdiYAnavAsIdera madhye avasthAna karale, erapara he mUsA! tumi nirdhArita samaYe ese hAyira haYecha|
Ami tomAke AmAra nijera janya tairi karechi|
tumi Ara tomAra bhAi AmAra nidarzana niYe yAo Ara tomarA AmAke smaraNa karAra viSaYe zaithilya karo nA|
tomarA du’jana pherAunera nikaTa yAo, vastutaH se sImAlaGghana kareche|
tAra saGge tomarA namrabhAve kathA valave, haYato se upadeza grahaNa karave kiMvA (AllAhara) bhaYa karave|’
tArA valala, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera bhaYa hacche se AmAdera prati haThAt uttejita haYe uThave kiMvA AmAdera prati AcaraNe vAr3AvAr3i karave|’
tini valalena, ‘tomarA bhaYa karo nA, Ami tomAdera sAthei Achi, Ami (sava kichu) zuni Ara dekhi|

kAjei tomarA du’jana tAra kAche eso Ara vala- AmarA tomAra pratipAlakera rasUla, kAjei vAnI isarAIlake AmAdera saGge pAThiYe dAo, tAdera prati utpIr3ana karo nA| tomAra pratipAlakera nidarzanasahai AmarA tomAra kAche esechi, Ara zAnti varSita hoka tAdera prati yArA sat patha anusaraNa kare|
AmAdera kAche oYAhI karA haYeche ye zAsti (apekSA karache) tAra janya ye (satya) pratyAkhyAna kare Ara mukha phiriYe neYa|’
pherAuna valala, ‘he mUsA! ke tomAdera pratipAlaka?’
mUsA valala, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka tini yini sakala (sRSTa) vastuke AkRti dAna karechena, ataHpara patha pradarzana karechena|’
pherAuna valala, ‘tAhale Agera yugera lokedera avasthA kI?’
mUsA valala, ‘tAra jJAna AmAra pratipAlakera kAche (rakSita) kitAve Ache, AmAra pratipAlaka bhula karena nA, bhuleo yAna nA|’

yini tomAdera janya yamInake karechena vichAnA, Ara tAte tomAdera janya ka’re diYechena calAra patha| Ara AkAza theke tini pAni varSaNa karena Ara tA diYe Ami vibhinna latA-yugala udagata kari yAra pratyekaTi anyaTi theke AlAdA|
tomarA khAo Ara tomAdera gavAdi pazu carAo, ete vivekavAnadera janya vahu nidarzana Ache|
mATi theke Ami tomAderake sRSTi karechi, tAtei Ami tomAderake phiriYe neva, Ara tAttheke tomAderake AvAra vera karava|
Ami tAke (arthAt pherAunake) AmAra yAvatIYa nidarzana dekhiYechilAma kintu se mithye mane ka’re pratyAkhyAna kareche o amAnya kareche|
se valala, ‘he mUsA! tumi ki tomAra yAdura vale AmAderake AmAdera deza theke vera kare deYAra janya esecha?

tAhale AmarAo avazya avazyai tomAra kAche anurUpa yAdu hAyira karava, kAjei ekaTA madhyavartI sthAne AmAdera o tomAdera milita haoYAra janya ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYa nirdhAraNa kara yAra khelApha AmarAo karava nA, Ara tumio karave nA|’
mUsA valala, ‘tomAdera (saGge) oYA‘dAra nirdhArita samaYa hala utsavera dina Ara dupurera Agei mAnuSa yena pau~che yAYa|’
takhana pherAuna uThe gela, ataHpara tAra kalA-kauzala ekatra karala, tArapara phire ela|
mUsA tAderake valala, ‘hAYa tomAdera durbhAgya! tomarA AllAhara prati mithye Aropa karo nA, karale tini tomAderake bhaYAnaka zAsti dvArA dhvaMsa kare devena| ye mithye Aropa kare se-i vyartha haYa|’
takhana tArA tAdera kAja-karma niYe nijedera madhye vAdAnuvAda karala Ara tArA gopane parAmarza karala|
tArA valala, ‘e du’jana nizcitai yAdukara, tArA tAdera yAdura vale tomAderake tomAdera deza theke vera kare dite cAYa Ara tomAdera utkRSTa jIvana paddhati muche phelate cAYa|
kAjei tomarA tomAdera kalA-kauzala ekatrita kara, ataHpara sArivaddha haYe hAjira haYe yAo| Aja ye vijaYa lAbha karave, se-i (varAvara) saphala have|’
tArA valala, ‘he mUsA! tumii (prathame) nikSepa karave, nA AmarAi prathame nikSepa karava?’
mUsA valala, ‘varaM tomarAi nikSepa kara|’ takhana tAdera yAdura kAraNe mUsAra mane hala ye, tAdera razi Ara lAThigulo chuTochuTi karache|
takhana mUsA tAra mane bhIti anubhava karala|
Ami valalAma, ‘bhaYa karo nA, tumii vijaYI have|’
tomAra DAna hAte yA Ache tA nikSepa kara, tArA yA kareche eTA tA sava gile phelave, tArA yA kareche tAto kevala yAdukarera kalA-kauzala| yAdukara ye rUpa dharei Asuka nA kena, saphala have nA|’
(mUsAra spaSTa nidarzana yakhana dekhala) takhana yAdukarerA (AllAhara prati) sAjadAYa luTiYe par3ala| tArA valala, ‘AmarA hArUna o mUsAra pratipAlakera upara ImAna AnalAma|’

pherAuna valala, ‘Ami tomAderake anumati deYAra Agei tomarA tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karale? nizcaYai se tomAdera pradhAna ye tomAderake yAdu zikhiYeche| kAjei Ami avazya avazyai tomAdera hAta Ara pA viparIta dika theke keTe phelava Ara khejura gAchera zAkhAYa tomAderake avazya avazyai zUle car3Ava Ara takhana tomarA avazya avazyai jAnate pArave AmAdera madhye kAra ‘AyAva vezi zakta Ara vezi sthAYI|

tArA valala, ‘AmAdera nikaTa ye spaSTa nidarzana eseche evaM yini AmAderake sRSTi karechena tAra upara AmarA tomAke kakSano prAdhAnya deva nA| kAjei tumi yA karate cAo tAi kara| kenanA tumi kevala e pArthiva jIvanei kartRtva khATAte pAra|
AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera upara ImAna enechi yAte tini AmAdera aparAdha kSamA karena Ara ye yAdu karate tumi AmAderake vAdhya karecha tAo (kSamA karena), AllAhai sarvazreSTha o sthAYI|’
ye keu tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa aparAdhI avasthAYa hAyira have tAra janye Ache jAhAnnAma, sekhAne se nA marave, Ara nA vA~cave|
ye keu sat ‘AmAla ka’re mu’mina avasthAYa tA~ra nikaTa hAyira have, tAdera janya Ache suucca maryAdA|
sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra pAdadeze vaYe calache nirjhariNI, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| yArA nijederake pavitra kare tAdera eTAi puraskAra|

Ami mUsAke oYAhI karalAma ye, AmAra vAndAhaderake niYe rAtera velA yAtrA kara Ara tAdera janya samudrera bhitara ekaTA zukano patha vAniYe nAo| Ara pechana theke (pherAuna) dhare phelave e bhaYa karo nA, Ara (anya kona) AzaGkAo karo nA|
ataHpara pherAuna tAra sainyasAmanta niYe tAdera pichu nila, ataHpara samudra tAdera upara car3Ao hala Ara tAderake DuviYe dila|
pherAuna tAra jAtike vipathagAmI karechila evaM tAderake saThika patha dekhAYani|

he vAnI isarAIla! Ami tomAderake tomAdera zatrura kavala theke uddhAra karechilAma Ara Ami tomAderake tUra pAhAr3era DAnapAze pratizruti diYechilAma (tAorAta dAnera janya) Ara tomAdera kAche pAThiYechilAma mAnnA o sAlaoYA|

tomAderake ye riyaka diYechi tAttheke uttamagulo AhAra kara, Ara ete vAr3AvAr3i karo nA, karale tomAdera upara AmAra ‘AyAva sAvyasta haYe yAve| Ara AmAra ‘AyAva yAra upara sAvyasta haYa se to dhvaMsai haYe yAYa|
Ara ye tAovAha kare, ImAna Ane o satkAja kare Ara satpathe aTala thAke, Ami tAra janya avazyai ati kSamAzIla|
‘he mUsA! tomAra sampradAYake pechane phele (tUra pAhAr3e Asate) tumi jaladi karale kena?’
mUsA valala, ‘ei to tArA AmAra padacihna dhare Asache, Ami ApanAra kAche jaladi elAma, he AmAra pratipAlaka! yAte Apani santuSTa hana|’
tini valalena, ‘tomAra anupasthitite Ami tomAra sampradAYake parIkSA karechi Ara sAmirI tAderake gumarAh kareche|

takhana mUsA rAge-duHkhe tAra jAtira kAche phire gela| se valala, ‘he AmAra jAti! tomAdera pratipAlaka ki tomAdera saGge o‘YAdA karenani, eka uttama oYA‘dA| oYA‘dA (pUraNera samaYa Asate) ki tomAdera nikaTa sudIrgha mane haYeche, nAki tomarA ceYecha ye, tomAdera prati tomAdera pratipAlakera zAsti neme Asuka, ye kAraNe tomarA AmAra kAche deYA tomAdera oYA‘dA bhaGga karale?’

tArA valala, ‘AmAdera sAdhya thAkA paryanta AmarA tomAra prati deYA AmAdera oYA‘dA bhaGga karini, kintu AmAdera upara lokedera alaGkArera vojhA cApiYe deYA haYechila, Ara AmarA tA nikSepa karechilAma (Agune), emanibhAve sAmirIo nikSepa karechila|
takhana se (Aguna theke) go-vatsera pratikRti vera karala, mane hata seTA yena hAmvA rava karache| ataHpara tArA valala, ‘eTAi tomAdera ilAha Ara mUsArao ilAha, kintu mUsA bhule geche|’
tArA ki bheve dekhe nA ye, tA tAdera kathAra javAva deYa nA, Ara tA tAdera kona kSati vA upakAra karAra sAmarthyao rAkhe nA?

hArUna tAderake Agei valechila, ‘he AmAra jAtira lokerA! era (arthAt go-vatsera) dvArA tomAderake parIkSAYa phelA haYeche, tomAdera pratipAlaka halena daYAmaYa (AllAha), kAjei tomarA AmAra anusaraNa kara Ara AmAra kathA mAnya kara|
tArA valala, ‘AmAdera kAche mUsA phire nA AsA paryanta AmarA sadAsarvadA era sAthei saMyukta haYe thAkava|
se (mUsA) valala, ‘he hArUna! tumi yakhana dekhale ye, tArA gumarAh haYe geche takhana tomAke ke niSedha karala
AmAke anusaraNa karate? tAhale tumi ki AmAra Adeza amAnya karale?

hArUna valala, ‘he AmAra mAYera putra! AmAra dAr3i dhare Tena nA, Ara AmAra (mAthAra) cula dhareo Tena nA, Ami bhaYa karechilAma tumi valave ye, vAnI isarAIlera mAjhe tumi vibheda sRSTi karecha Ara tumi AmAra kathA pAlana karani|’
mUsA valala, ‘ekhana tomAra vyApAraTA kI, he sAmirI?’

se valala, ‘Ami dekhechi yA orA dekheni, ataHpara Ami prerita vyaktira (arthAt jivarIlera) padacihna theke eka muTha mATi nilAma, ataHpara Ami tA nikSepa karalAma (vAchurera pratikRtite)| AmAra mana AmAke e mantraNAi dila|’

mUsA valala, ‘tui dUra ha! e jIvane tora janya e zAstii thAkala ye, tui valavi- AmAke sparza karo nA, Ara tora janya ekaTA nirdiSTa oYA‘dA Ache yAra khelApha have nA| Ara tora ilAhara pAne ceYe dekha yAke tui ghire thAkati, Ami tAke avazya avazyai jvalanta Agune jvAliYe deva, Ara tAke char3iYe chiTiYe avazya avazyai sAgare nikSepa karava|’
tomAdera ilAha ekamAtra AllAha, yini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei| yAvatIYa viSaYe tA~ra jJAna parivyApta|
ebhAve pUrve yA ghaTe geche tAra kichu saMvAda Ami tomAra kAche varNanA karachi, Ara Ami AmAra nikaTa theke tomAke dAna karechi upadeza (vA kuraAna)|
ye tAttheke mukha phiriYe neve, kiYAmAtera dina se (pApera) vojhA vahana karave|
tArA e avasthAtei sthAYIbhAve thAkave, kiYAmAtera dina e vojhA tAdera janya katai nA manda have!
yedina siGgAYa phu~ deYA have Ara Ami aparAdhIderake ekatrita karava (bhaYe bhIta-santrasta) dRSTihIna avasthAYa|
tArA cupisAre nijedera madhye valAvali karave ye, (duniYAte) daza dinera vezi tomarA avasthAna karani|
Ami bhAlabhAvei jAni tArA yA vale| tAdera madhye ye uttama pathera anusArI se valave, ‘tomarA ekadinera vezi avasthAna karani|’
tArA tomAke parvatagulo samparke prazna kare| vala, AmAra pratipAlaka segulo samUle utpATita karavena evaM dhUlira nyAYa vikSipta karavena|
ataHpara tini tAke (arthAt bhUmike) masRNa samatalabhUmi kare chAr3avena|
tAte tumi dekhave nA kona vakratA o uccatA|

sedina tArA (sojAsuji) AhavAnakArIra anusaraNa karave yAra kathA edika odika have nA| daYAmaYera sammukhe sedina yAvatIYa AoYAja stavdha haYe yAve (emanabhAve) ye mRdu guJjana chAr3A tumi kichui zunave nA|
sedina kAro supAriza kona kAje Asave nA, daYAmaYa yAke anumati devena Ara yAra kathAYa santuSTa havena tAra (supAriza) vyatIta|
tAdera sammukhe o pazcAte yA Ache tA tini jAnena, tArA jJAna diYe tA~ke AYatta karate pAre nA|
ciraJjIva cirasthAYIra sammukhe sakalei have adhomukhI, Ara se vyartha have ye yulamera (pApera) bhAra vahana karave|
ye sat kAja karave mu’mina haYe, tAra avicAra vA kSatira kona AzaMkA nei|
ebhAvei Ami kuraAnake AravI bhASAYa nAyila karechi Ara tAte satarkavANI vistAritabhAve vivRta karechi yAte tArA AllAhake bhaYa kare athavA tA haYa tAdera janya upadeza|

AllAha sarvocca, prakRta adhipati, tomAra prati (AllAhara) oYAhI sampUrNa haoYAra pUrve tumi kuraAna vakSe dhAraNera vyApAre tAr3Ahur3o karo nA| Ara vala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! jJAne AmAYa samRddhi dAna karuna|’
itopUrve Ami AdAmera nikaTa theke aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma, kintu se bhule giYechila, Ami tAke dRr3ha-saMkalpa pAini|
smaraNa kara, yakhana pherezatAgaNake valechilAma, ‘tomarA AdAmake sejadA kara,’ takhana ivalisa chAr3A savAi sejadA karala, se amAnya karala|
takhana Ami valalAma, ‘he AdAma! e hacche tomAra Ara tomAra strIra duzamana| kAjei se yena kichutei tomAderake jAnnAta theke vera kare nA deYa, tAhale tomarA durdazAYa patita have|
tomAra janya (eta adhika parimANa) deYA hala ye, tumi sekhAne (arthAt jAnnAte) kSudhArtao have nA, nagnao have nA|
sekhAne tumi tRSNArtao have nA, rodeo pur3ave nA|
kintu zaYatvAna tAke kumantraNA dila| se valala, ‘he AdAma! Ami ki tomAke jAniYe deva cirasthAYI jIvanadAYI gAchera kathA Ara emana rAjyera kathA yA konadina kSaYa have nA?’

ataHpara tArA (svAmI-strI) du’jane tA (arthAt sei gAcha) theke khela takhana tAdera sAmane tAdera lajjAsthAna khule gela Ara tArA jAnnAtera gAchera pAtA diYe nijederake DhAkate lAgala| AdAma tAra pratipAlakera avAdhyatA karala, phale se pathabhrAnta haYe gela|
erapara tAra pAlanakartA tAke vAchAi karalena, tAra tAovAha kavUla karalena evaM tAke saThika pathe paricAlita karalena|

tini valalena, ‘tomarA du’jane (AdAma o ivalIsa) ekai saGge nIce neme yAo, tomarA eke aparera zatru| ataHpara AmAra nikaTa theke tomAdera kAche saThika pathera nirdeza Asave, takhana ye AmAra patha nirdeza anusaraNa karave se pathabhraSTa have nA evaM kaSTe patita have nA|
Ara ye AmAra smaraNa theke mukha phiriYe neve, tAra jIvikA have saMkIrNa Ara tAke kiYAmAtera dina utthita karava andha avasthAYa|’
se valave, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! kena AmAke andha ka’re uThAle? Ami to cakSuSmAna chilAma|’
AllAha valavena, ‘ebhAvei to AmAra nidarzanasamUha yakhana tomAra kAche esechila takhana tumi tA bhule giYechile| Ajakera dine sebhAvei tomAke bhule yAoYA hacche|
Ami ebhAvei pratiphala dei tAderake yArA sImAlaGghana kare evaM tAra pratipAlakera nidarzane vizvAsa kare nA| Ara AkhirAtera ‘AyAva avazyai savaceYe vezI kaThina o savaceYe vezI sthAYI|

eTAo ki tAderake saThika patha pradarzana karala nA ye, Ami tAdera Age kata mAnava vaMzake dhvaMsa kare diYechi yAdera vAsasthAnera bhitara diYe erA calAcala kare| vuddhimAnadera janya avazyai ete nidarzana raYeche|
tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa theke pUrva siddhAnta nA thAkale (tAdera zAsti) avazyai ese par3ata, kintu era janya nirdiSTa Ache ekaTi samaYa|

kAjei tArA yA valache tAte tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara evaM tomAra pratipAlakera prazaMsAgIti (niYamita) uccAraNa kara sUryodaYera pUrve o tA astamita haoYAra pUrve evaM tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara rAtrikAle o dinera prAntaguloYa yAte tumi santuSTa hate pAra|

tumi kakSano cokha khule tAkio nA ai sava vastura prati yA Ami tAdera vibhinna dalake pArthiva jIvane upabhogera janya saundarya svarUpa diYechi, esava diYe tAderake parIkSA karAra janya| tomAra pratipAlakera deYA riyakai hala savaceYe uttama o savaceYe vezI sthAYI|
Ara tomAra pavirAra-parijanake nAmAyera nirdeza dAo Ara tAte avicala thAka| tomAra kAche Ami riyaka cAi nA, Amii tomAke riyaka diYe thAki, uttama pariNAma muttAkIdera janya nirdiSTa|
tArA vale, ‘se tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa theke AmAdera kAche kona nidarzana niYe Ase nA kena? tAdera kAche ki Aseni spaSTa pramANa yA chila pUrvavartI (oYAhIkRta) kitAvagulote|’

era (arthAt kona nidarzana AsAra) Agei Ami yadi tAderake ‘AyAva diYe dhvaMsa kare ditAma tAhale tArA valata, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAdera kAche kena ekajana rasUla pAThAle nA? tAhale AmarA avazyai tomAra nidarzana mene calatAma AmarA apamAnita o heYa havAra Agei|

vala, (isalAmera anusArIdera pariNati dekhAra janya cArapAzera) savAi apekSA karache, kAjei tomarAo apekSA kara, tAhalei tomarA jAnate pArave ye, kArA sarala pathera pathika Ara kArA saThika pathaprApta|
mAnuSera hisAva grahaNera kAla kramazaH ghaniYe Asache kintu tArA gAphalatite mukha phiriYe rekheche|
tAdera kAche tAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate yakhanai kona natuna upadeza Ase, takhana tArA tA hAsi-tAmAzAra vastu mane karei zone|
tAdera antara thAke khelAYa magna| yAlimarA gopane parAmarza kare- eTA tomAderai mata mAnuSa chAr3A ki anya kichu? tomarA ki dekhe-zune yAdura kavale par3ave?
vala, ‘AmAra pratipAlaka AsamAna o yamIne (uccArita pratiTi) kathAi jAnena, Ara tini sava kichu zonena, sava kichu jAnena|’

tArA eo vale, ‘esava alIka svapna, nA haYa se mithye udbhAvana kareche, nA haYa se ekajana kavi| kAjei se AmAdera kAche emana nidarzana niYe Asuka yemana pUrvavartI (navI)-gaNera kAche pAThAno haYechila|
tAdera pUrve Ami ye samasta janapada dhvaMsa karechi tAdera ekaTio ImAna Aneni, tAhale erA ki ImAna Anave?
tomAra pUrve ye sava rasUla pAThiYechilAma yAdera prati Ami oYAhI karatAma tArA mAnuSai chila, tomarA yadi nA jAna tave (avatIrNa) kitAvera jJAna yAdera Ache tAderake jijJesa kara|
tAderake emana dehaviziSTa karini ye tArA khAdya kheta nA Ara tArA chila nA cirasthAYI|
ataHpara Ami tAderake deYA AmAra oYA‘dA satye pariNata karalAma| phalataH Ami tAderake evaM Aro yAderake cAilAma rakSA karalAma Ara sImAlaGghanakArIderake dhvaMsa kare dilAma|
Ami tomAdera prati nAyila karechi eka kitAva yAte tomAdera janya Ache upadeza, tomarA ki tavuo vujhave nA?
kata janapada chila yeguloke Ami puropuri dhvaMsa kare diYechi yAra adhivAsIrA chila yAlima| tAdera pare Ami anya jAti sRSTi karechi|
tArA yakhana AmAra zAsti (’ra Agamana) anubhava karala, takhana tArA tAttheke pAliYe yete (ceSTA) karala|

(pherezatArA tAderake ThATTA kare valechila) pAliYe yeYo nA, phire eso tomarA ye bhoga-vilAse matta chile tAra dike Ara tomAdera AvAsagulote, yAte tomAderake jijJAsAvAda karA yAYa (‘AyAvera rUpaTA kemana dekhale?)|
tArA valala, ‘hAYa AmAdera durbhAgya! AmarA satyii anyAYakArI chilAma|’
tAdera e ArtanAda vandha haYani yatakSaNa nA Ami tAderake karechilAma kATA zasya o nibhAno Agunera mata|
AsamAna, yamIna Ara e du’Yera madhye yA kichu Ache tA Ami khelate khelate vAnAini|
Ami yadi khelAdhUlAra vastu vAnAte cAitAma tAhale AmAra kAche yA Ache tA niYei tA karatAma, yadi AmAke karate hata!

varaM Ami satyake mithyera upara nikSepa kari, ataHpara tA mithyera mastaka cUrNa-vicUrNa kare deYa, tatkSaNAt mithye nizcihna haYe yAYa| tomarA (AllAha samparke ayathA vahu mithye kathA vAniYe niYe) yA valacha e kAraNe tomAdera janya durbhoga|

AsamAna o yamIne yArA Ache tArA tA~rai mAlikAnAdhIna, Ara yArA tA~ra sannikaTe Ache tArA garvabhare tA~ra ‘ivAdAta theke vimukha haYa nA, Ara tArA (kakSano tA~ra ‘ivAdAta karAra vyApAre) klAntivodha kare nA|
tArA rAta-dina tA~ra pavitratA ghoSaNA karate thAke, tArA kakSano zithilatA kare nA vA Agraha hArAYa nA|
tArA (arthAt muzarikarA) mATi theke (tairI) ye sava devatA grahaNa kareche tArA ki (mRtaderake) jIvita karate sakSama?

AsamAna o yamIne yadi AllAha chAr3A Aro aneka ilAha thAkata tave (AsamAna o yamIna) ubhaYai dhvaMsa haYe yeta| kAjei Arazera adhipati AllAha mahAna o pavitra se sava theke yA tArA tA~ra prati Aropa kare|
tini yA karena se vyApAre tini jijJAsita havena nA, varaM tArA jijJAsita have (tAdera kAjera vyApAre)|

nAki tArA tA~ke vAda diYe aneka ilAha grahaNa kareche? vala, ‘tomarA tomAdera pramANa ene hAyira kara| (AllAha chAr3A kona ilAha nei) eTAi AmAra sAthe yArA Ache tAdera kathA Ara AmAra pUrve yArA chila tAderao kathA, kintu tAdera (arthAt satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera) adhikAMzai prakRta satya jAne nA, yAra janya tArA mukha phiriYe neYa|
Ami tomAra pUrve emana kona rasUlai pAThAini yAra prati Ami oYAhI karini ye, Ami chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei| kAjei tomarA AmArai ‘ivAdAta kara|
tArA vale, ‘daYAmaYa santAna grahaNa karechena’, tini esava theke mahA pavitra| tArA hala tA~ra vAndAha yAderake sammAne unnIta karA haYeche|
tini kathA valAra Agei tArA (arthAt sammAnita vAndArA) kathA vale nA, tArA tA~ra nirdezei kAja kare|
tAdera sAmane Ara pechane yA Ache tA tini jAnena| tini yAdera prati khuvai santuSTa tAdera vyApAre chAr3A tArA kona supAriza kare nA| tArA tA~ra bhaYa o sammAne bhIta-santrasta|
tAdera madhye ye valave ye, ‘tini vyatIta Amii ilAha’, tAhale Ami tAke tAra pratiphala deva jAhAnnAma| yAlimaderake Ami ebhAvei puraskAra diYe thAki|
avizvAsIrA ki dekhe nA ye, AkAza Ara yamIna eka saGge saMyukta chila, ataHpara Ami ubhaYake AlAdA kare dilAma, Ara prANasampanna sava kichu pAni theke sRSTi karalAma| tavuo ki tArA ImAna Anave nA?
Ara pRthivIte Ami sthApana karechi sudRr3ha parvata yAte pRthivI tAderake niYe nar3Acar3A nA kare| Ara tAte sRSTi karechi prazasta patha yAte tArA patha pete pAre|
Ara Ami AkAzake karechi surakSita chAda, kintu e savera nidarzana theke tArA mukha phiriYe neYa|
tinii sRSTi karechena rAta o dina, sUrya Ara candra, pratyekei tAra cakrAkAra pathe sA~tAra kATache|
tomAra pUrveo Ami kona mAnuSake cirasthAYI karini| tumi yadi mArA yAo, tAhale tArA ki cirasthAYI have?
pratyeka AtmAke mRtyu AsvAdana karata have| Ami tomAderake bhAla o manda (ubhaYaTi diYe evaM ubhaYa avasthAYa phele era) dvArA parIkSA kari| AmAra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe AnA have|

kAphirarA yakhana tomAke dekhe, takhana tArA tomAke ekamAtra upahAsera pAtra hisevei gaNya kare| (Ara tArA vale) ‘ei ki sei loka ye tomAdera devatAgulora vyApAre kathA vale? athaca ei lokaguloi ‘rahamAna’ (zavdaTira) ullekhake agrAhya kare|

mAnuSake tAr3Ahur3AkArI kare sRSTi karA haYeche| zIghrai Ami tomAderake AmAra nidarzanagulo dekhAva (ye sava alaukika vyApAra vadara o anyAnya yuddhe kAphiraderake dekhAno haYechila), kAjei tomarA AmAke jaladi karate vala nA|
Ara tArA vale ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale (vala) pratizruti kakhana vAstave pariNata have?’
avizvAsIrA yadi (se samaYera kathA) jAnata yakhana tArA tAdera mukha hate agni pratirodha karate pArave nA, Ara tAdera piTha thekeo nA, Ara tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|
varaM tA tAdera upara haThAt ese yAve Ara tA tAderake hatavuddhi kare deve| ataHpara tArA tA rodha karate pArave nA, Ara tAderake avakAzao deYA have nA|
tomAra pUrveo rasUladerake ThATTA karA haYeche, ataHpara yA diYe tArA ThATTA karata tA ulTo ThATTA-vidrupai tAderake pariveSTana kare niYechila|
vala, ‘ke tomAderake rAte Ara dine rahamAna (era gayava) theke nirApada rAkhate pAre? tavuo tArA tAdera pratipAlakera smaraNa theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
tave ki tAdera emana devadevI Ache yA tAderake rakSA karave AmAra (pratirakSA) chAr3Ai? tArA to nijederakei sAhAyya karate pAre nA, Ara tArA AmAra viruddhe kona pratirakSAo pAve nA|

varaM Amii tAderake Ara tAdera pitR-puruSaderake pArthiva bhogyavastu diYechilAma Ara tAderake AYuo deYA haYechila dIrgha; tArA ki dekhache nA ye, Ami tAdera dezake cArapAzera (tAdera niYantrita) sImAnta hate saMkucita kare Anachi? eraparao ki tArA vijaYI have?’
vala, Ami tomAderake ekamAtra (AllAhara) oYAhI dvArAi satarka kari, kintu vadhirarA DAka zunave nA yakhana tAderake satarka karA haYa|
tomAra pratipAlakera gayavera ekaTA niHzvAsa yadi tAdera upara patita haYa tave tArA avazya avazyai vale uThave, ‘hAYa AmAdera durbhAgya! AmarAi to chilAma aparAdhI|’

Ara kiYAmAta divase Ami suvicArera mAnadanDa sthApana karava, ataHpara kAro prati etaTukuo anyAYa karA have nA| (karma) sariSAra dAnA parimANa haleo tA Ami hAyira karava, hisAva grahaNe Amii yatheSTa|
Ami mUsA o hArUnake (satya-mithyAra) mAnadanDa, Alo o vANI diYechilAma muttAkIdera janya|
yArA nA dekhei tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare Ara tArA kiYAmAta samparke bhIta-zaMkita|
e hacche kalyANamaYa upadeza vANI, Ami tA nAyila karechi: tavuo ki tA tomarA pratyAkhyAna karave?
Ami itopUrve ivarAhImake saThika pathe calAra jJAna dAna karechilAma Ara tAra samparke Ami khuva bhAlabhAve jAnatAma|
yakhana se tAra pitAke o tAra jAtike valala, ‘e mUrtigulo kI yAdera saGge tomarA nijederake (bhaktira vA~dhane) ve~dhe rekhecha?’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake edera pUjo karate dekhechi|
se valala, ‘tomarA raYecha spaSTa gumarAhIte, tomarA Ara tomAdera pitRpuruSarAo|’
tArA valala, ‘tumi ki AmAdera kAche prakRta satya enecha, nA tumi AmAdera saGge tAmAzA karacha?’
se valala, ‘varaM, tomAdera pratipAlaka halena AkAza o pRthivIra pratipAlaka yini oguloke sRSTi karechena, Ara e viSaYe Ami ekajana sAkSyadAtA|
kasama AllAhara! tomarA pechana phire cale gelei Ami tomAdera mUrtigulora viruddhe avazya avazyai ekaTA kauzala grahaNa karava|
tArapara se mUrtiguloke Tukaro Tukaro kare dila, ogulora var3aTi chAr3A, yAte pUjArIrA oTAra pratii manoyogI haYa|
tArA valala, ‘AmAdera mUrtigulora sAthe emanaTA ke karala? se avazyai yAlima|’
keu keu valala, ‘eka yuvakake edera samparke valate zunechi, tAke ivarAhIma valA haYa|’
tArA valala, ‘tAke niYe eso lokajanera sAmane yAte tArA sAkSI hate pAre|’
tArA valala, ‘ohe ivarAhIma! AmAdera upAsyadera sAthe tumii ki emanaTi karecha?’
se valala, ‘nA, tAdera ei var3aTAi e sava kareche, tArA yadi kathA valate pAre tave tAderake jijJesa kara|’
takhana tArA viSaYaTi niYe mane mane cintA karala evaM paraspara valAvali karala- tomarA nijerAi to anyAYakArI|
tAdera mAthA he~Ta haYe gela| (takhana tArA valala) ‘tumi to jAnai orA kathA valate pAre nA|’
se valala, ‘tAhale tomarA ki AllAhara parivarte emana kichura ‘ivAdAta kara yA nA pAre tomAdera kona upakAra karate, Ara nA pAre tomAdera kSati karate?
dhika tomAdera prati Ara AllAhara parivarte tomarA yAdera ‘ivAdAta kara tAderao prati| eraparao ki tomarA vujhave nA|
tArA valala, ‘tAke pur3iYe mAra Ara tomAdera upAsyadera sAhAyya kara- yadi tomarA kichu karatei cAo|
Ami valalAma, ‘he agni! tumi ivarAhImera janya zItala o zAntimaYa haYe yAo|’
tArA tAra viruddhe cakrAnta karechila kintu Ami tAderakei savaceYe kSatigrasta kare chAr3alAma|
Ara Ami tAke o (tAra bhrAtuSputra) lUtake uddhAra kare tAderake emana deze (arthAt philistine) niYe gelAma yA Ami vizvavAsIra janya kalyANamaYa karechi|
Ami ivarAhImake dAna karechilAma isahAka, Ara atirikta hiseve (pautra) iYA‘kuva, (tAdera) pratyekakei Ami karechilAma satkarmazIla|

Ara tAderake vAniYechilAma netA, tArA AmAra nirdeze mAnuSake saThika patha dekhAta| tAdera prati oYAhI karechilAma sat kAja karAra janya, niYamita nAmAya pratiSThA karAra o yAkAta pradAnera janya, tArA AmArai ‘ivAdAta karata|
Ara Ami lUtakeo diYechilAma vicArazakti o jJAna| Ami tAke uddhAra karechilAma sei janavasati theke yA azlIla kAje lipta chila, tArA chila eka khArApa pApAcArI jAti|
Ami tAke AmAra rAhamAtera antarbhukta karechilAma, se chila sat karmazIladera ekajana|
smaraNa kara nUhera kathA, itopUrve yakhana se (AmAke) Dekechila, takhana Ami tAra DAke sAr3A diYechilAma Ara tAke o tAra parivAravargake mahA vipada theke rakSA karechilAma|
Ara Ami tAke sei lokedera viruddhe sAhAyya karechilAma yArA AmAra AYAtake mithye vale pratyAkhyAna karechila, tArA chila eka khArApa sampradAYa, kAjei tAdera savvAike (vAne) DuviYe diYechilAma|

smaraNa kara dAUda o sulAYamAnera kathA yakhana tArA kRSikSeta samparke vicAra karachila yakhana tAte rAtera velA kona vyaktira meSa Dhuke par3echila, Ara Ami tAdera vicArakArya pratyakSa karachilAma|

Ami sulAYamAnake e viSaYera (saThika) vujha diYechilAma Ara (tAdera) pratyekake Ami diYechilAma vicArazakti o jJAna| Ami parvata o pAkhIderake dAUdera adhIna ka’re diYechilAma, tArA dAUdera sAthe AmAra mAhAtmya o pavitratA ghoSaNA karata| (esava) Amii karatAma|
Amii tAke varma nirmANa zikSA diYechilAma tomAdera upakAre tomAdera pArasparika yuddhe tomAderake rakSA karAra janya, kAjei tomarA ki kRtajJa have?

(AmAra kSamatA valei) Ami uddAma vAYuke (svAbhAvika gati sampanna) karechilAma sulAYamAnera janya| tAra nirdeza mata tA pravAhita hata sei dezera dike yAte Ami kalyANa rekhechi| Ami pratyeka viSaYa samparkei avagata chilAma|
zaYatvAnadera kataka tAra janya Duvurira kAja karata, echAr3A anya kAjao karata, Amii tAderake rakSA karatAma|
smaraNa kara AiYUvera kathA, yakhana se tAra pratipAlakake Dekechila: (ei va’le ye) Ami duHkha kaSTe nipatita haYechi, tumi to daYAludera sarvazreSTha daYAlu|

takhana Ami tAra DAke sAr3A diYechilAma Ara tAra duHkha kleza dUra kare diYechilAma| Ara tAra parivAravargake tAra kAche phiriYe diYechilAma, Ara tAdera sAthe tAdera mata Aro diYechilAma AmAra pakSa hate rahamata svarUpa Ara AmAra yArA ‘ivAdAta kare tAdera janya smAraka hiseve|
smaraNa kara isamA‘Ila, idarIsa o jula-kiphala era kathA, tAdera pratyekei chila dhairyazIla|
Ami tAderake AmAra rAhamAtera antarbhukta karechilAma, kAraNa tArA chila satkarmazIla|

smaraNa kara yun-nuna era kathA- yakhana se gosvAbhare cale giYechila, Ara bhevechila ye tAra upara AmAra kona kSamatA khATave nA| ataHpara se (samudrera) gabhIra andhakAra theke Dekechila ye, tumi chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, tomArai pavitratA, mahimA ghoSaNA karachi; vAr3AvAr3i Amii karechi|
Ami takhana tAra DAke sAr3A diYechilAma, Ara duHzcintA theke tAke mukta karechilAma| mu’minaderake Ami ebhAvei uddhAra kari|
Ara smaraNa kara yAkAriYAra kathA, yakhana se tAra pratipAlakake Dekechila: ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke santAnahIna kare rekha nA, yadio tumi uttarAdhikArIdera madhye sarvazreSTha|’

takhana Ami tAra DAke sAr3A diYechilAma Ara tAke dAna karechilAma iYAhaiYA, Ami tAra nimitte tAra strIra vandhyAtva dUra kare diYechilAma| erA sat kAje chila kSipragati, tArA AmAke DAkato AzA niYe o bhIta haYe, Ara tArA chila AmAra prati vinaYI|

smaraNa kara sei nArIra (arthAt mAraiYAmera) kathA ye tAra satItvake saMrakSaNa karechila| ataHpara Ami tAra bhitara AmAra rUha phu~ke diYechilAma Ara tAke o tAra putrake vizvajagatera janya nidarzana karechilAma|
tomAdera e sava jAtigulo ekai jAti, Ara Ami tomAdera pratipAlaka, kAjei AmArai ‘ivAdAta kara|
kintu tArA (paravartIte) nijedera kAja-karme paraspara pArthakya sRSTi kareche, tA sattveo tArA savAi AmAra kAche phire Asave|
kAjei keu yadi mu’mina haYe sat kAja kare, tave tAra praceSTA asvIkAra karA have nA, Ami tA tAra janya likhe rAkhi|
Ami ye sava janavasati dhvaMsa karechi tAdera janya eTA niSiddha karA haYeche ye tArA Ara phire Asave nA|
emanaki (takhanao tArA phire Asave nA) yakhana iYA’jUja o mA’jUjera janya (prAcIra) khule deYA have Ara tArA pratiTi pAhAr3a keTe chuTe Asave|
satya oYA‘dAra (pUrNatAra) samaYa ghaniYe Asave, takhana AtaGke kAphiradera cakSu sthira haYe yAve| (takhana tArA valave) hAYa! AmarA to e vyApAre udAsIna chilAma, nA, AmarA chilAma anyAYakArI|
tomarA (kAphirarA) Ara AllAhake vAda diYe tomarA yAdera ‘ivAdAta kara segulo jAhAnnAmera jvAlAnI| tAte tomarA praveza karave|
tArA yadi ilAha hata, tAhale tArA tAte praveza karata nA, tAte tArA savAi sthAYI haYe thAkave|
sekhAne tArA phu~piYe phu~piYe kA~dave, sekhAne kichui zunave nA|
pUrva thekei AmAra pakSa hate yAdera janya kalyANa nirdhArita Ache tAderake tAttheke (arthAt jAhAnnAma theke) vahu dUre rAkhA have|
tArA jAhAnnAmera kSINatama zavdao zunave nA, Ara tArA tAdera manera vAsanA anuyAYI cirakAla vasavAsa karave|
mahA trAsa tAderake cintAyukta karave nA, Ara pherezatAgaNa tAderake abhyarthanA jAnAve (ei kathA vale ye), ‘eTAi tomAdera dina yAra oYA‘dA tomAderake deYA haYechila|
sedina Ami AkAzake guTiYe neva yemanabhAve (likhita) kAgaja-dalIla guTiYe rAkhA haYa| yebhAve Ami prathamavAra sRSTi karechilAma, sebhAve AvAra sRSTi karava| oYA‘dA Ami karechi, tA Ami pUrNa karavai|
(era Age mUsAke) vANI deYAra para Ami yuvUre likhe diYechilAma ye, AmAra satkarmaparAYaNa vAndAhgaNai pRthivIra uttarAdhikAra lAbha karave|
nizcaYai ete (arthAt ei kuraAne) upadezavANI raYeche ‘ivAdAtakArI lokedera janya|
Ami tomAke vizvavAsIra janya pAThiYechi kevala rahamata hiseve|
vala- AmAra prati e oYAhIi karA haYeche ye, tomAdera ilAha ekamAtra ilAha, kAjei tomarA ki tA~ra nirdezera prati mAthA nata karave?
tave tArA mukha phiriYe nile vala: Ami tomAdera kAche yathAyathabhAve vANI pau~che diYechi| Ara Ami jAni nA tomAderake yAra oYA‘dA deYA haYeche tA nikaTavartI, nAki dUravartI|
tini jAnena ye kathA prakAza karA haYa Ara tini jAnena yA tomarA (tomAdera antare) lukiYe rAkha|
Ami jAni nA sambhavataH vilamvera madhye tomAdera janya raYeche parIkSA Ara kichu kAlera janya sukhabhogera suyoga|
rasUla valechila- he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi nyAyya mImAMsA kare dAo, Ara AmAdera pratipAlaka to daYAra AdhAra| tomarA (tA~ra viruddhe) ye sava kathA valacha se viSaYe tinii ekamAtra AzraYasthala|
he mAnuSa! tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kara, kiYAmAtera kampana eka bhaYAnaka jinisa|

sedina tumi dekhave pratiTi dugdhadAYinI bhule yAve tAra dugdhapoSya zizuke, Ara pratyeka garbhavatI garbhapAta kare phelave, Ara mAnuSake dekhave mAtAla, yadio tArA prakRtapakSe mAtAla naYa, kintu AllAhara zAsti var3ai kaThina (yAra kAraNe tAdera ai avasthA ghaTave)|
kataka mAnuSa jJAna chAr3Ai AllAha samvandhe vAdAnuvAda kare, Ara pratyeka avAdhya zaYatvAnera anusaraNa kare|
yAra (arthAt zaYatvAnera) samparke vidhAna karA haYeche ye, ye keu tAra saGge vandhutva gar3ave, se tAke vipathagAmI karave, Ara tAke prajjvalita agni zAstira dike paricAlita karave|

he mAnuSa! punarutthAnera vyApAre yadi tomarA sandihAna hao, tAhale (cintA kare dekha) Ami tomAderake sRSTi karechi mATi theke, ataHpara zukra hate, ataHpara jamATa rakta theke, ataHpara mAMsapinDa hate pUrNa AkRtiviziSTa vA apUrNa AkRtiviziSTa avasthAYa (AmAra zakti-kSamatA) tomAdera sAmane spaSTa kare tule dharAra janya| Ara Ami yAke icche kari tAke ekaTA nirdiSTa kAla paryanta mAtRgarbhe rAkhi, ataHpara tomAderake vera kare Ani zizurUpe, ataHpara (lAlana pAlana) kari yAte tomarA tomAdera pUrNa zaktira vaYase pau~chate pAra| tomAdera kAro kAro mRtyu ghaTAi, Ara katakake phiriYe deYA haYa niskriYa vArdhakye yAte (aneka) jJAna lAbhera pareo tAdera Ara kona jJAna thAke nA| ataHpara (Aro) tomarA bhUmike dekha zuSka, mRta; ataHpara Ami yakhana tAte pAni varSaNa kari takhana tAte prANa cAJcalya sRSTi haYa, tA Andolita o sphIta haYa, Ara tA udagata kare sakala prakAra naYanajur3Ano udbhida (jor3AYa jor3AYa)|
e rakama haYa ejanya ye, AllAha halena satya saThika, Ara tinii mRtake jIvita karena, Ara tini sakala viSaYe kSamatAvAna|
Ara kiYAmAta avazyai Asave, e vyApAre kona sandeha nei evaM yArA kavare Ache AllAha tAderake avazyai punarutthita karavena|
tavuo mAnuSera madhye emana Ache yArA jJAna, pathera dizA o kona AlokapradAnakArI kitAva chAr3Ai AllAha samparke vitarka kare|

(vitarka kare avajJAbhare) ghAr3a vA~kiYe (lokederake) AllAhara patha theke vicyuta karAra uddeze| tAra janya Ache lAJchanA e duniYAte, Ara kiYAmAtera dina tAke AsvAdana karAva (agnira) dahana yantraNA|
(valA have) tomAra hAta du’khAnA Agei yA pAThiYechila eTA tArai phala, kAraNa AllAha to tA~ra vAndAhadera prati yAlima nana|

mAnuSera madhye emana kataka Ache yArA zeSa sImAYa avasthAna kare AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kare| ataHpara tAra kalyANa hale, tA niYe se tRpta thAke, Ara kona parIkSAra sammukhIna hale se tAra pUrvera avasthAYa phire yAYa| kSatigrasta haYa se duniYAteo Ara AkhirAteo- eTAi hala spaSTa kSati|
AllAhake vAda diYe se emana kichuke DAke yA nA pAre tAra kona kSati karate Ara nA pAre kona upakAra karate, eTAi hala carama AkArera gumarAhI|
se emana kichuke DAke yAra lAbhera ceYe kSatii nikaTavartI, kata mandai nA ei abhibhAvaka, Ara kata mandai nA ei saGgI!
yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare AllAha tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra nimnadeza diYe jharNAdhArA pravAhita, AllAha yA karate cAna, tAi karena|

ye keu dhAraNA kare ye AllAha tAke (arthAt tA~ra rasUlake) kakSano duniYA o AkhirAte sAhAyya karavena nA, tAhale se AkAza paryanta ekaTA dar3i jhuliYe nika, ataHpara tA keTe dika, ataHpara se dekhuka tAra kalA-kauzala tAra rAgera kAraNa dUra kare kinA| (rasUlera duzamana nijera jhulAno dar3iTAi kATuka, kenanA se to rasUlera prati AllAhara sAhAyyera dar3iTA kakSano kATate pArave nA|)
ebhAvei Ami spaSTa nidarzanarUpe kuraAna avatIrNa karechi Ara AllAha yAke cAna saThika pathe paricAlita karena|

yArA ImAna eneche Ara yArA iYAhUdI haYeche, Ara yArA sAviYI, nAsArA, agnipUjaka o muzarika, AllAha kiYAmAtera dina edera madhye phaYasAlA kare devena (ye kArA saThika pathe Ache), kAraNa AllAha sava kichura pratyakSadarzI|

tumi ki dekha nA ye AllAhake sejadA kare yArA AkAze Ache, Ara yArA pRthivIte Ache Ara sUrya, candra, tArakArAji, parvatasamUha, vRkSarAji, jIvajantu evaM mAnuSera madhye aneke? Ara anekera prati zAsti sAvyasta haYe geche| AllAha yAke lAJchita karate cAna, tAke sammAnita karAra keu nei| AllAha yA icche karena tAi karena|[sAjadAha]

erA vivAdera du’Ti pakSa, (mu’minarA ekaTi pakSa, Ara samasta kAphirarA ArekaTi pakSa) erA edera pratipAlaka samvandhe vAdAnuvAda kare, ataHpara yArA (tAdera pratipAlakake) asvIkAra kare, tAdera janya tairi karA haYeche Agunera pozAka, tAdera mAthAra upara Dhele deYA have phuTanta pAni|
yA diYe tAdera peTe yA Ache tA o tAdera cAmar3A galiYe deYA have|
uparantu tAdera (zAstira) janya thAkave lohAra mugura|
yakhanai tArA yantraNAra coTe tAttheke veriYe Asate cAive (takhanai) tAderake tAra bhitare phiriYe deYA have, (Ara valA have, Agune) pur3Ara zAsti AsvAdana kara|

yArA ImAna Ane Ara sat kAja kare, AllAha tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra taladeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita| sekhAne tAderake alaMkRta karA have sonAra kA~kana Ara muktA diYe Ara sekhAne tAdera pozAka have rezamera|
tAderake (duniYAra jIvane) patha dekhAno haYechila pavitra vAkyera (arthAt kAlimA tAiYyevA vA Ala-kuraAnera) dike Ara tArA paricAlita haYechila tA~ra pathe yini sakala prazaMsAra dAvIdAra|

yArA kuphurI kare Ara AllAhara pathe (mAnuSera calAra kSetre) vAdhA sRSTi kare Ara mAsajide hArAme yeteo- yAke Ami karechi sthAnIYa vAsindA o anyadezavAsI sakalera janya samAna| ye tAte anyAYabhAve kona dharmadrohI kAja karAra icche kare tAke Ami AsvAdana karAva bhaYAvaha zAsti|

smaraNa kara yakhana Ami ivarAhImake (pavitra) gRhera sthAna cihnita kare diYechilAma, (takhana valechilAma) AmAra sAthe kona kichuke aMzIdAra gaNya karave nA, Ara AmAra gRhake pavitra rAkhave tAoYAphakArI, nAmAye kiYAmakArI, rUku‘kArI o sejadAkArIdera janya|
Ara mAnuSera mAjhe hAjjera ghoSaNA dAo, tArA tomAra kAche Asave pAYe he~Te, Ara sava (pathaklAnta) zIrNa uTera piThe, vahu dUrera gabhIra parvata saMkula patha veYe

yAte tArA tAdera janya (ekhAne rAkhA duniYA o AkhirAtera) kalyANagulo pratyakSa karate pAre Ara tini tAderake catuSpada jantu hate ye riyaka dAna karechena, nirdiSTa dinagulote tAra upara AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karate pAre| kAjei tomarA (nijerA) tAttheke khAo Ara duHstha abhAvIdera khAoYAo|
ataHpara tArA yena tAdera daihika aparicchannatA dUra kare, tAdera mAnat pUrNa kare Ara prAcIna gRhera tAoYApha kare|

eTAi (hAjja), ye keu AllAhara nirdhArita anuSThAnagulora sammAna karave, seTA tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa tAra janya uttama| catuSpada jantugulo tomAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche segulo chAr3A yegulora vyApAre tomAderake par3e zunAno haYeche| kAjei tomarA mUrtidera apavitratA varjana kara Ara mithye kathA parihAra kara

AllAhara prati ekaniSTha haYe tA~ra sAthe zarIka nA kare| ye keu AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare se yena AkAza theke par3e gela, Ara pAkhI tAke cho~ mere niYe gela kiMvA vAtAsa tAke ur3iYe niYe dUravartI sthAne chu~r3e phele dila|
ei (tAra avasthA), Ara ye keu AllAhara nidarzanaguloke sammAna karave se to tAra antarasthita AllAha-bhIti thekei tA karave|

ete (arthAt kuravAnIra pazute) tomAdera janya nAnAna upakAra raYeche eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta (kuravAnIra jAYagAYa pau~chA paryanta tomarA ei jantugulora dvArA upakRta hate pAra), sarvazeSe egulora kuravAnIra sthAna hacche prAcIna gharera nikaTa|

Ami pratiTi sampradAYera janya (kuravAnIra) niYama kare diYechi| tAderake catuSpada jantu hate ye riyak deYA haYeche segulora upara tArA yena AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kare, (ei vibhinna niYama-paddhatira mUla lakSya kintu eka- AllAhara nirdeza pAlana), kAraNa tomAdera upAsya ekamAtra upAsya, kAjei tA~ra kAchei AtmasamarpaNa kara Ara susaMvAda dAo sei vinItaderake-
‘AllAha’ nAmera ullekha halei yAdera antarAtmA ke~pe uThe, yArA tAdera vipadApade dhairyadhAraNa kare, nAmAya kAYima kare, Ara tAderake Ami ye riyak diYechi tAttheke tArA vyaYa kare|

Ara (kuravAnIra) uTaguloke Ami karechi AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera anyatama| tAte tomAdera janya kalyANa Ache, kAjei sArivaddhabhAve dA~r3Ano avasthAYa ogulora upara tomarA AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kara| yakhana tA pArzvabhare par3e yAYa, takhana tAtheke khAo Ara yArA (bhikSe nA ka’re) paritRpta thAke tAderake Ara yArA kAkuti minati ka’re yAcJA kare tAderakeo khAoYAo| ebhAve Ami oguloke tomAdera adhIna kare diYechi yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

AllAhara kAche ogulora nA gozata pau~che, Ara nA rakta pau~che varaM tA~ra kAche pau~che tomAdera tAkaoYA| ebhAve tini oguloke tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena yAte tomarA AllAhara zreSThatva ghoSaNA karate pAra ejanya ye, tini tomAderake saThika patha dekhiYechena, kAjei satkarmazIladerake tumi susaMvAda dAo|
AllAha mu’minaderake rakSA karena (yAvatIYa manda hate)| AllAha kona khiYAnAtakArI, akRtajJake pachanda karena nA|
yAdera viruddhe yuddha karA haYa tAderake yuddhera anumati deYA hala, kenanA tAdera prati atyAcAra karA haYeche| AllAha tAderake sAhAyya karate avazyai sakSama|

tAderake anyAYabhAve gRha theke vahiSkAra karA haYeche zudhu tAdera e kathA valAra kAraNe ye, ‘AllAha AmAdera pratipAlaka|’ AllAha yadi mAnuSadera eka dalera dvArA anya dalake pratihata nA karatena, tAhale vidhvasta haYe yeta khrISTAna saMsAratyAgIdera upAsanAlaYa, girjA o iYAhUdIdera upAsanAra sthAna Ara mAsajidasamUha yekhAne AllAhara nAma adhikahAre smaraNa karA haYa| AllAha avazyai tAke sAhAyya karena ye tA~ke sAhAyya kare, AllAha zaktimAna, parAkrAnta|

(erA hala) yAderake Ami yamIne pratiSThita karale tArA nAmAya pratiSThA kare, yAkAta pradAna kare, sat kAjera Adeza deYa o manda kAje niSedha kare, sakala kAjera zeSa pariNAma (o siddhAnta) AllAhara hAte nivaddha|
lokerA yadi tomAke asvIkAra kare tAhale (jene rekha eTA kona natuna vyApAra naYa) tAdera pUrve nUha, ‘Ada o sAmUda sampradAYao (tAdera rasUladera) asvIkAra karechila|
Ara ivarAhImera sampradAYa o lUtera sampradAYao (asvIkAra karechila)|

Ara mAdaiYAnavAsIrAo [asvIkAra karechila yArA chila zu‘AYava (AH)-era sampradAYa], Ara mUsAkeo asvIkAra karA haYechila| Ami asvIkArakArIderake samaYa- suyoga diYechilAma, ataHpara tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilAma| kata bhISaNa chila AmAke asvIkAra karAra pariNati!
Ami kata janavasatike dhvaMsa karechi yegulora adhivAsIrA chila yAlima, segulo chAdera bhare patita haYe vidhvasta haYechila, virANa haYechila kata kUpa Ara suucca sudRr3ha prAsAdarAji|
tArA ki yamIne bhramaNa kare nA? tAhale tArA hRdaYa diYe vujhate pArata, Ara tAdera kAna zunate pArata| prakRtapakSe cokha andha naYa, varaM vukera bhitara ye hRdaYa Ache tA-i andha|

tArA tomAke tAr3AtAr3i zAsti niYe Asate vale (kintu zAsti to Asave AllAhara o‘YAdA anuyAYI nirdiSTa samaYe), kenanA AllAha kakSano tA~ra oYA‘dA khelApha karena nA, tomAra pratipAlakera ekadina hala tomAdera gaNanAYa eka hAjAra vacharera samAna|

Ami kata janapadake samaYa-suyoga diYechi yakhana tArA chila anyAYa kAje lipta| ataHpara seguloke pAkar3Ao karechilAma, (pAliYe keu to kothAo yete pArave nA) kenanA (sakalera) pratyAvartana AmArai kAche|
vala, ‘he mAnuSa! Ami (prerita haYechi) tomAdera janya eka suspaSTa satarkakArIrUpe|’
kAjei yArA ImAna Anave Ara sat kAja karave tAdera janya kevala Ache kSamA Ara sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanera viruddhe ceSTA cAlAYa, segulora uddezyake vyartha karAra janya, tArAi hala jAhAnnAmera vAsindA|

Ami tomAra pUrve ye sava rasUla kiMvA navI pAThiYechi tAdera keu yakhanai kona AkAGkSA kareche takhanai zaYatvAna tAra AkAGkSAYa (prativandhakatA, sandeha-saMzaYa) nikSepa kareche, kintu zaYatvAna yA nikSepa kare AllAha tA muche dena, ataHpara AllAha tA~ra nidarzanasamUhake supratiSThita karena| kAraNa AllAha sarvajJa, sarvazreSTha hikamataoYAlA|

(tini eTA hate dena ejanya) yAte tini zaYatvAna yA miziYe diYeche tA dvArA parIkSA karate pArena tAderake yAdera antare (munAphikIra) vyAdhi Ache, yArA zakta hRdaYera| anyAYakArIrA carama matabhede lipta Ache|

(Ara aparadike) yAte, yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche tArA jAnate pAre ye, eTA tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke (prerita) satya, ataHpara tArA yena tAte vizvAsI haYa Ara tAdera antara namratAbhare tAra prati khule deYA haYa, kAraNa AllAha ImAnadAraderake avazyai saThika pathe paricAlita karena|

avizvAsIrA tAte (arthAt oYAhIte) sandeha poSaNa karA theke virata have nA yatakSaNa nA kiYAmAta Asave haThAt ka’re athavA tAdera upara zAsti ese yAve eka vandhyA dine (yA kAphiraderake kona suphala dive nA)|
kSamatA-Adhipatya sedina have AllAharai, tini tAdera mAjhe vicAra-phaYasAlA karavena| ataHpara yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare tArA thAkave ni‘mAtarAjite paripUrNa jAnnAte|
Ara yArA kuphurI kare Ara AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithye jene pratyAkhyAna kare tAdera janya Ache apamAnajanaka zAsti|
Ara yArA AllAhara pathe hijarAta kareche, ataHpara nihata haYeche, kiMvA mArA geche, AllAha tAderake avazya avazyai utkRSTa riyak dAna karavena, Ara AllAha- tini to sarvottama riyakadAtA|
tini tAderake avazya avazyai dAkhila karavena emana jAYagAYa yA peYe tArA khuvai santuSTa have, Ara AllAha nizcitai avazyai sarvajJa, parama sahiSNu|

eto hala tAdera avasthA, Ara ye vyakti AghAtaprApta hale samaparimANa pratizodha grahaNa kare, ataHpara AvAra se nipIr3ita haYa, AllAha tAke avazya avazyai sAhAyya karavena, AllAha avazyai mAphakArI kSamAzIla|

eTA ejanya ye, AllAha rAtake DhukiYe dena dine, Ara dinake DhukiYe dena rAte (duHkha vedanAra andhakAra dUra kare Anandera Alo ene dena Ara Anandita janake duHkhera aA~dhAre DuviYe dena)| Ara AllAha to sava kichu zonena, sava kichu dekhena|
ejanya ye, AllAha- tinii satya, Ara tA~ke vAda diYe tArA anya yAke DAke tA alIka, asatya, Ara AllAha, tini to sarvocca, sumahAna|
tumi ki lakSya kara nA ye, AllAha AkAza theke pAni varSaNa karena, yAra phale pRthivI savuje AcchAdita haYe yAYa, nizcaYa AllAha sUkSNadarzI, sarvaviSaYe oYAkiphahAla|
AkAza o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache savai tA~ra, Ara AllAha, tini yAvatIYa abhAva theke mukta, yAvatIYa prazaMsAra adhikArI|

tumi ki lakSya kara nA ye, pRthivIte yA kichu Ache sava tini tomAdera kalyANa-kAje lAgiYe rekhechena| Ara nauyAnagulo samudre calAcala kare tA~ra hukumei? tinii AkAzake sthira rAkhena yAte tA pRthivIte patita nA haYa tA~ra anumati chAr3A| AllAha mAnuSera prati nizcitai var3ai karuNAzIla, var3ai daYAvAna|
tinii tomAderake jIvana diYechena, ataHpara tinii tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena, ataHpara AvAra tomAderake jIvana divena| mAnuSa satyii var3ai akRtajJa|
