pratyeka sampradAYera janya Ami (‘ivAdAtera) niYama-kAnuna nirdhAraNa kare diYechi yA tArA anusaraNa kare| kAjei tArA yena e viSaYe tomAra saGge tarka vitarka nA kare| tumi (tAderake) tomAra pratipAlakera dike DAka, tumi avazyai sarala saThika pathe Acha|
tArA yadi tomAra saGge vitarka kare tAhale vala- tomarA yA kara AllAha tA bhAla karei jAnena|
AllAha kiYAmAtera dina se viSaYe tomAdera madhye mImAMsA kare divena ye viSaYe tomarA matabheda karacha|
tumi ki jAna nA ye, AllAha jAnena yA Ache AkAze Ara pRthivIte, e savai lipite (rekarDe) Ache| eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|
Ara tArA AllAhake vAda diYe emana kichuke DAke yAra samarthane tini kona dalIla pAThAnani Ara ye samparke tAdera kona jJAna nei| (esava) yAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

Ara tAdera sammukhe yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAta tilAoYAta karA haYa takhana tumi kAphiradera cehArAYa ekaTA anIhAra bhAva dekhate pAve| tAdera kAche yArA AmAra AYAta tilAoYAta kare tAderake tArA AkramaNa karate udyata haYa| vala, tAhale Ami ki tomAderake era ceYeo khArApa kichura saMvAda deva? tA hala Aguna| AllAha kAphiraderake era oYA‘dA diYechena| Ara tA katai nA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala!

he mAnuSa! ekaTA dRSTAnta peza karA hacche, seTA manoyoga diYe zona| AllAhara parivarte tomarA yAderake DAka tArA kakSano ekaTA mAchio sRSTi karate pAre nA, ejanya tArA savAi ekatrita haleo| Ara mAchi yadi tAdera kAcha theke kichu chiniYe niYe yAYa, tArA tAra theke tA uddhArao karate pAre nA, prArthanAkArI Ara yAra kAche prArthanA karA haYa ubhaYei durvala|
tArA AllAhara yathAyogya maryAdA deYa nA, AllAha nizcitai kSamatAzAlI, mahA parAkrAnta|
AllAha pherezatAgaNera madhya hate vANIvAhaka manonIta karena Ara mAnuSadera madhya hateo, AllAha sava kichu zonena, sava kichu dekhena|
tini jAnena tAdera sAmane yA Ache Ara tAdera pechane yA Ache, Ara samasta vyApAra (cUr3Anta phaYasAlAra janya) AllAhara kAche phire yAYa|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA rukU‘ kara, sejadA kara Ara tomAdera pratipAlakera ‘ivAdAta kara o satkAja kara yAte tomarA sAphalya lAbha karate pAra| [sAjadAha]

Ara AllAhara pathe jihAda kara yebhAve jihAda karA ucita| tini tomAderake veche niYechena| dvInera bhitara tini tomAdera upara kona kaThoratA cApiYe denani| eTAi tomAdera pitA ivarAhImera dvIna, AllAha tomAdera nAma rekhechena ‘musalima’ pUrveo, Ara e kitAveo (ai nAmai deYA haYeche) yAte rasUla tomAdera janya sAkSI haYa Ara tomarA sAkSI hao mAnava jAtira janya| kAjei tomarA nAmAya pratiSThA kara, yAkAta dAo Ara AllAhake A~kar3e dhara| tinii tomAdera abhibhAvaka| katai nA uttama abhibhAvaka Ara katai nA uttama sAhAyyakArI!
mu’minarA saphalakAma haYe geche|
yArA nijedera nAmAye vinaYa namratA avalamvana kare|
yArA asAra kathAvArtA er3iYe cale|
yArA yAkAta dAne sakriYa|
yArA nijedera yaunAGgake saMrakSaNa kare|
nijedera strI o mAlikAnAbhukta dAsI vyatIta, kAraNa e kSetre tArA nindA theke mukta|
edera atirikta yArA kAmanA kare tArAi sImAlaGghanakArI|
Ara yArA nijedera AmAnAta o oYAdA pUrNa kare|
Ara yArA nijedera nAmAyera vyApAre yatnavAna|
tArAi hala uttarAdhikArI|
tArA phiradAusera uttarAdhikAra lAbha karave, yAte tArA cirasthAYI have|
Ami mAnuSake mATira sArAMza theke sRSTi karechi|
ataHpara Ami tAke zukravindu rUpe eka saMrakSita AdhAre sthApana karechi|

pare Ami zukravinduke pariNata kari jamATa vA~dhA rakte, ataHpara mAMsapinDake pariNata kari hADDite, ataHpara hADDike AvRta kari mAMsa diYe, ataHpara tAke eka natuna sRSTite unnIta kari| kAjei sarvottama sraSTA AllAha katai nA mahAna!
erapara tomarA avazyai marave|
tArapara kiYAmAtera dina tomAderake punarutthita karA have|
Ami tomAdera upare sapta stara sRSTi karechi, Ami (AmAra) sRSTira vyApAre amanoyogI nai|
Ami AkAza theke parimita vRSTi varSaNa kari, ataHpara Ami tA yamIne saMrakSaNa kari Ara Ami pAnike sariYe dite avazyai sakSama|
ataHpara Ami tA diYe tomAdera janya khejura o AGgurera vAgAna sRSTi kari, ote tomAdera janya Ache paryApta phala, yAtheke tomarA khAo (Ara sukhabhoga kara)|
Ara (Ami sRSTi kari) eka vRkSa yA sinAi parvate janme, yAtheke tela utpanna haYa, Ara bhakSaNakArIdera janya rasanA tRptikara|

Ara gavAdi pazura bhitare tomAdera janya Ache avazyai zikSaNIYa dRSTAnta| tAdera peTe yA Ache tAttheke Ami tomAderake pAna karAi (dudha) Ara ote tomAdera janya Ache vahuvidha upakAra| tomarA tAtheke khAo (gozata)|
Ara ote Ara nauyAne tomarA ArohaNa kara|
Ami nUhake tA~ra sampradAYera kAche pAThiYechilAma| se valechila: ‘he AmAra jAti! tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera kona ilAha nei, tomarA ki (tA~ke) bhaYa karave nA?’

tAra sampradAYera pradhAnagaNa yArA kuphurI karechila- valechila: ‘eto tomAdera mata mAnuSa chAr3A kichui nA, se tomAdera upara prAdhAnya lAbha karate cAYa, AllAha (kAuke navIrUpe pAThAnora) icche karale to tini pherezatA pAThAtena, AmarA AmAdera pUrva puruSadera samaYe e sava kathA to zunini|’
eto emana loka yAke pAgalAmite peYeche, kAjei tAra vyApAre tomarA kichu kAla apekSA kara|
nUha valala: ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke sAhAyya kara, kAraNa tArA AmAke mithyevAdI valache|’

takhana Ami tAra kAche oYAhI pAThAlAma- AmAra dRSTira sammukhe AmAra nirdeza anuyAYI nauyAna tairi kara, ataHpara yakhana AmAra nirdeza Asave Ara ununa (pAnite) uthale uThave, takhana naukAYa tule nAo pratyeka jIvera eka eka jor3A Ara tomAra parivAravargake, tAdera madhye yAdera vipakSe pUrve siddhAnta haYe geche tAderake vAda diYe| Ara anyAYakArIdera pakSe AmAra nikaTa Avedana karo nA, tArA (vAne) Duvavei|
yakhana tumi nauyAne uThe yAve, tumi Ara tomAra saGgIrA- takhana valave: ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAharai yini AmAderake yAlima sampradAYa theke uddhAra karechena|’
Ara valo: he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke kalyANakarabhAve nAmiYe dAo, nAmAnote tumii sarvottama|
ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche (mAnuSera vujhAra janya), Ami (mAnuSake) parIkSA kari|
ataHpara tAdera para Areka mAnava vaMza (‘Ada sampradAYake) sRSTi karechilAma|
Ara tAdera mAjhe tAderai ekajanake rasUla kare pAThiYechilAma ei vale ye, tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera kona ilAha nei, tavuo ki tomarA (tA~ke) bhaYa karave nA?

kintu tAra sampradAYera pradhAnagaNa- yArA kuphurI karechila, Ara AkhirAtera sAkSAtke mithyA vale pratyAkhyAna karechila, yAderake Ami pArthiva jIvane sukha svAcchandya diYechilAma- valechila: ‘se to tomAdera mata mAnuSa chAr3A kichu naYa| tomarA yA khAo, seo tAi khAYa, tomarA yA pAna kara, seo tAi pAna kare|
tomarA yadi tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSera Anugatya kara, tAhale tomarA avazyai kSatigrasta have|
se ki tomAdera saGge ei oYA‘dA kare ye, yakhana tomarA mare yAve Ara mATi o hADDite pariNata have takhana tomAderake AvAra jIvita karA have|
dUre oTA, vahu dUre yAra oYA‘dA tomAderake deYA hacche|
AmAdera e duniYAra jIvana chAr3A kichui nei, ekhAnei AmarA mari vA~ci, AmAderake kakSano AvAra uThAno have nA|
se to emana eka vyakti ye AllAha samparke mithye vAniYe niYeche| AmarA tAke vizvAsa kari nA|’
(navI) valala: ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tArA AmAke mithyevAdI vale doSAropa karache- e vyApAre tumi AmAke sAhAyya kara|’
AllAha valalena, ‘alpa samaYera madhyei tArA anutapta have|’
ataHpara satyi satyii eka bhaYaGkara zavda tAderake AghAta karala Ara tAderake bhAgAr3e pariNata karalAma, kAjei dhvaMsa hoka pApI sampradAYa|
ataHpara tAdera pare Ami vahu jAti sRSTi karechilAma|
kona jAtii tAdera nirdiSTa kAlake agra pazcAt karate pAre nA|

erapara ekAdikrame Ami AmAra rasUladerake pAThiYechi| yakhanai kona jAtira kAche tAdera rasUla eseche, tArA tAke mithye vale pratyAkhyAna kareche, ataHpara zAsti prAptira vyApAre tArA eke anyera anusaraNa kareche, ataHpara tAderake kAhinI vAniYe dilAma| kAjei ye jAti ImAna Ane nA tArA dhvaMsa hoka!
ataHpara Ami mUsA o tAra bhAi hArUnake pAThiYechilAma nidarzana Ara suspaSTa pramANa sahakAre|
pherAuna o tAra pradhAnagaNera kAche| kintu tArA ahaMkAra karala, tArA chila eka uddhata jAti|
tArA valala, ‘AmarA ki AmAderai mata du’jana lokera prati vizvAsa sthApana karava, athaca tAdera sampradAYa AmAdera dAsa?’
tArA tAdera du’janake mithye vale pratyAkhyAna karala, phale tArA dhvaMsaprAptadera antarbhukta haYe gela|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma yAte tArA saThika patha pete pAre|
Ami mAraiYAma-putra Ara tAra mAke nidarzana karechilAma Ara tAderake svasti nirApattA o jharNA viziSTa ucca sthAne AzraYa diYechilAma|
he rasUlagaNa! pavitra vastu AhAra kara, Ara sat kAja kara, tomarA yA kara se samparke Ami pUrNarUpe avagata|
tomAdera esava ummAta to ekai ummAta, Ara Amii tomAdera pratipAlaka, kAjei AmAkei bhaYa kara|
kintu mAnuSa tAdera kartavya karmake vahudhA vibhakta kare pheleche, Ara pratyeka dalai tAdera kAche yA Ache tAi niYe Anandita|
kAjei tAderake kichukAla tAdera ajJAnatAprasUta vibhrAntite thAkate dAo|
tArA ki bheve niYeche, Ami ye tAderake dhanaizvarya o santAnAdira prAcurya diYe sAhAyya karechi
era dvArA ki tAdera kalyANa tvarAnvita karachi? nA, tArA vujhe nA|
nizcaYa yArA tAdera pratipAlakera bhaYe bhIta-santrasta haYe thAke,
yArA tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzanAvalIte vizvAsa sthApana kare,
yArA tAdera pratipAlakera saGge zarIka kare nA,
yArA tAdera dAnera vastu dAna kare Ara tAdera antara bhIta zaMkita thAke e janye ye, tAderake tAdera pratipAlakera kAche phire yete have|
erAi kalyANakAje drutagati, Ara tAte tArA agragAmI|
Ami kAuke tAra sAdhyAtIta kaSTa dei nA, Ara AmAra kAche emana eka kitAva Ache yA satya vale, Ara tAdera prati moTei yulama karA have nA|
varaM tAdera antara e viSaYe ajJAnatAYa Acchanna haYe Ache, echAr3A tAdera Aro (manda) kAja Ache yA tArA karate thAkave|
avazeSe Ami yakhana tAdera (arthAt kAphiradera) madhye vitta sampadazAlIderake zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karava, takhana tArA citkAra jur3e deve|
(valA have) ‘Aja citkAra karo nA, AmAra kAcha theke tomarA sAhAyya pAve nA|’
AmAra AYAta tomAdera kAche par3e zonAno hata, kintu tomarA gor3Alira bhare pichane ghure dA~r3Ate|
ahaMkAravazataH (kuraAna) samparke arthahIna kathA valate yemana keu rAte galpa vale|
tAhale tArA ki (AllAhara) e vANI samparke cintA-bhAvanA kare nA? kiMvA tAdera kAche emana kichu (natuna vastu) eseche yA tAdera pUrvapuruSadera kAche Aseni?
kiMvA tArA ki tAdera rasUlake cinate pAre nA ejanya tArA tAke asvIkAra karache
athavA tArA ki vale ye, se unmAda? nA, prakRtapakSe se tAdera kAche satya niYe eseche, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai satyake apachanda kare|

satya yadi tAdera icche-AkAGkSAra anusArI hata tAhale AkAza pRthivI Ara e du’Yera mAjhe yA Ache sava lanDabhanDa haYe yeta| (tAdera kAmanA-vAsanAra) viparIte Ami tAderake diYechi tAdera janya upadezavANI kintu tArA upadezavANI theke mukha phiriYe rAkhe|
athavA tumi ki tAdera kAcha theke kona pratidAna cAo? tomAra pratipAlakera pratidAnai sarvottama, Ara tinii sarvazreSTha riyakadAtA|
tumi to nizcitai tAderake sarala sudRr3ha pathera dike DAkacha|
yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA tArA sarala patha theke vicyuta haYe geche|
Ami tAdera prati daYA karaleo Ara tAdera duHkha durdazA dUra karaleo tArA tAdera avAdhyatAYa ghurapAka khete thAkave|
Ami tAderake zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karechilAma, kintu tArA tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa nata hala nA, Ara tArA kAkuti minatio karala nA|
avazeSe Ami tAdera janya kaThina zAstira darajA khule deva, takhana tArA tAte hatAza haYe par3ave|
tinii tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena kAna, cokha o antara; tomarA kRtajJatA alpai kare thAka|
tinii tomAderake pRthivIte char3iYe diYechena Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake ekatrita karA have|
tinii jIvana dena o mRtyu ghaTAna Ara dina-rAtera parivartana tA~ra dvArAi haYa, tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?
varaM tArA tAi valechila yA valechila Agera lokerA|
tArA vale- ‘AmarA yakhana mare mATi o hAr3a-hADDi haYe yAva (tArapareo ki) AmAderake Asalei AvAra uThAno have?
e viSaYe AmAderake oYA‘dA deYA haYeche Ara atIte AmAdera pUrva puruSaderakeo| esava to purano kAlera kisasA kAhinI chAr3A kichui nA|
vala: e pRthivI Ara tAra bhitare yA Ache tA kAra? (vala) yadi tomarA jAna!
tArA valave- AllAhara| vala: tavuo ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave nA?
valaH sAta AsamAna Ara mahAna Arazera mAlika ke?
tArA valaveH (egulora mAlikAnA) AllAhara| valaH tavuo ki tomarA (AllAhake) bhaYa karave nA?
valaH sava kichura ekacchatra kartRtva kAra hAte? tini (sakalake) AzraYa dena, tA~ra upara kona AzraYa dAtA nei, (vala) tomarA yadi jAna|
tArA valave (sakala kichura kartRtva) AllAhara| tAhale kemana kare tomarA yAdugrasta haYe par3acha?
kichui nA, Ami tAdera nikaTa satya pAThiYechi kintu tArA vAstavikai mithyevAdI|

AllAha kona santAna grahaNa karenani, Ara tA~ra sAthe anya kona ilAha nei, (thAkale) pratyeka ilAha Apana sRSTi niYe avazyai cale yeta, Ara avazyai eke aparera upara car3Ao hata, tArA tA~ra prati yA Aropa kare tAttheke tini kata mahAna o pavitra!
tini dRzya o adRzyera jJAnera adhikArI, tArA yA tA~ra zarIka vAnAYa, tAttheke tini vahu Urdhve|
vala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi yadi AmAke dekhAo (AmAra jIvaddazAYa) yAra pratizruti tAderake deYA haYeche,
tAhale he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke yAlima sampradAYera antarbhukta karo nA’|
Ami tAderake (zAsti pradAnera) ye oYAdA karechi tA Ami tomAke dekhAte avazyai sakSama|
mandera mukAvilA kara yA uttama tAi diYe, tArA yA vale se samparke Ami savizeSa avagata|
Ara vala: ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami zaYatvAnera kumantraNA hate tomAra nikaTa AzraYa prArthanA karachi|
Ara Ami tomAra nikaTa AzraYa prArthanA karachi, he AmAra pratipAlaka! yAte tArA AmAra kAche Asate nA pAre|’
emanaki yakhana tAdera kAro kAche mRtyu ese hAjira haYa takhana se vale: ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAke AvAra (duniYAte) pAThiYe dAo|
yAte Ami sat kAja karate pAri yA Ami karini| kakSano nA, eTA to tAra ekaTA kathAra kathA mAtra| tAdera sAmane pardA thAkave punarutthAnera dina paryanta|
ataHpara yakhana ziGgAYa phu~ deYA have sedina tAdera parasparera mAjhe AtmIYa vandhana thAkave nA| eke aparera kAche jijJesao karave nA|
yAdera (sat kAjera) pAllA bhArI have tArAi have saphalakAma|
yAdera pAllA hAlakA have tArAi orA yArA nijedera kSatisAdhana kareche, jAhAnnAme tArA cirasthAYI have|
Aguna tAdera mukhamanDala dagdha karave Ara tArA vIbhatsa cehArA niYe tAra bhitare dA~ta kaTamaTa karate thAkave|
(tAderake valA have) ‘tomAdera nikaTa ki AmAra AYAtagulo AvRtti karA hata nA? tomarA seguloke mithye jene pratyAkhyAna karechile|
tArA valave- ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! durbhAgya AmAderake parAsta karechila, Ara AmarA chilAma eka pathabhraSTa jAti|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake ettheke vera kare nAo, AmarA yadi AvAra kuphurI kari tAhale AmarA to yAlima hiseve parigaNita hava|
AllAha valavena- ‘tomarA dhikRta avasthAYa ekhAnei par3e thAka, AmAra saGge kona kathA vala nA|’
AmAra vAndAhadera ekadala valata- ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA ImAna enechi, tumi AmAderake kSamA kara, AmAdera prati daYA kara, tumi to sarvazreSTha daYAlu|’
kintu tAderake niYe tomarA hAsi tAmAzA karate emanaki tA tomAderake AmAra kathA bhuliYe diYechila, tomarA tAderake niYe hAsi-ThATTAi karate|
Aja Ami tAderake puraskRta karalAma tAdera dhairya dhAraNera kAraNe, Aja tArAi to saphalakAma|
AllAha valavena: ‘pRthivIte kaYa vachara tomarA avasthAna karechile?’
tArA valave: ‘AmarA ekadina vA eka dinera kichu aMza avasthAna karechi| ataeva tumi gaNanAkArIdera jijJesa kara|’
tini valavena: ‘tomarA alpa samaYai avasthAna karechile, tomarA yadi jAnate!
tomarA ki bhevechile ye, Ami tomAderake tAmAzAra vastu hiseve sRSTi karechi Ara tomAderake AmAra kAche phiriYe AnA have nA?
suucca mahAna AllAha yini prakRta mAlika, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, sammAnita Arazera adhipati|
ye vyakti AllAhara saGge anya ilAhakeo DAke, e vyApAre tAra kAche kona dalIla pramANa nei, ekamAtra tAra pratipAlakera kAchei tAra hisAva have, kAphiragaNa avazyai saphalakAma have nA|
kAjei vala: ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! kSamA kara o rahama kara, tumi rahamakArIdera madhye sarvazreSTha|’
ekaTi sUrAha yA Ami nAyila karechi Ara tA pharaya kare diYechi, Ara tAra bhetare Ami suspaSTa AYAta nAyila karechi, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

vyabhicAriNI o vyabhicArI tAdera pratyekake ekazata kare vetrAghAta kara| AllAhara Aina kAryakara karAra vyApAre tAdera prati daYAmAYA tomAderake yena prabhAvita nA kare, yadi tomarA AllAha o AkhirAta dinera prati vizvAsa sthApana kare thAka| ekadala mu’mina yena tAdera zAsti pratyakSa kare|
vyabhicArI viYe kare nA vyabhicAriNI vA muzarikA nArI chAr3A| Ara vyabhicAriNI- tAke viYe kare nA vyabhicArI vA muzarika puruSa chAr3A, mu’minadera janya eTA niSiddha karA haYeche|
yArA satI sAdhvI nArIra upara apavAda deYa, ataHpara cArajana sAkSI upasthita nA kare, tAderake AziTi vetrAghAta kara, Ara tAdera sAkSya kakSano grahaNa kara nA, erAi nA-pharamAna|
avazya erapara yadi tArA tAovAha kare o saMzodhita haYa, kenanA AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|

Ara yArA nijedera strIdera upara apavAda deYa, kintu nijedera chAr3A tAdera anya kona sAkSI nA thAke, e rakama pratyeka lokera sAkSya ebhAve have ye, se cAravAra AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valave ye, se avazyai satyavAdI|
Ara paJcamavAre valave ye, se yadi mithyevAdI haYa tave tAra upara AllAhara lA’nata patita have|
Ara strIra zAsti rahita have yadi se AllAhara nAme cAravAra zapatha ka’re vale ye, se (tAra svAmI) avazyai mithyevAdI|
evaM paJcamavAre vale ye, tAra svAmI satyavAdI hale tAra nijera upara AllAhara gayava patita have|
tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkale (tomarA dhvaMsa haYe yete), AllAha tAovAha grahaNakArI, var3ai hikamataoYAlA|

yArA e apavAda utthApana kareche tArA tomAderai ekaTi dala, eTAke tomAdera janya kSatikara mane kara nA, varaM tA tomAdera janya kalyANakara| tAdera pratyekera janya Ache pratiphala yataTuku pApa se kareche| Ara e vyApAre ye netRtva diYeche tAra janya Ache mahA zAsti|
tomarA yakhana eTA zunate pele takhana kena mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina strIrA tAdera nijedera loka samparke bhAla dhAraNA karala nA Ara valala nA, ‘eTA to kholAkhuli apavAda|’
tArA cArajana sAkSI hAyira karala nA kena? yehetu tArA sAkSI hAyira kareni sehetu AllAhara nikaTa tArAi mithyevAdI|
duniYA o AkhirAte tomAdera upara yadi AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkata, tave tomarA yAte tar3ighar3i lipta haYe par3echile tAra janya mahA zAsti tomAderake pAkar3Ao karata|

yakhana eTA tomarA mukhe mukhe char3Acchile Ara tomAdera mukha diYe emana kathA valachile ye viSaYe tomAdera kona jJAna chila nA, Ara tomarA eTAke nagaNya vyApAra mane karechile, kintu AllAhara nikaTa tA chila gurutara vyApAra|
tomarA yakhana eTA zunale takhana tomarA kena valale nA ye, e vyApAre AmAdera kathA valA Thika naYa| AllAha pavitra o mahAna, eTA to eka gurutara apavAda!
AllAha tomAderake upadeza dicchena tomarA Ara kakhano era (arthAt e AcaraNera) punarAvRtti karo nA yadi tomarA mu’mina haYe thAka|
AllAha tomAdera janya spaSTabhAve AYAta varNanA karachena, kAraNa tini halena sarvaviSaYe jJAnera adhikArI, var3ai hikamataoYAlA|
yArA pachanda kare ye, mu’minadera madhye azlIlatAra vistRti ghaTuka tAdera janya Ache bhaYAvaha zAsti duniYA o AkhirAte| AllAha jAnena Ara tomarA jAna nA|
tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkale (tomarA dhvaMsa haYe yete), AllAha daYArdra, var3ai daYAvAna|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA zaYatvAnera padAMka anusaraNa karo nA| keu zaYatvAnera padAMka anusaraNa karale se tAke nirlajjatA o apakarmera Adeza deve, tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkale tomAdera ekajanao kakSano pavitratA lAbha karate pArata nA| avazya yAke icche AllAha pavitra kare thAkena, AllAha sava kichu zonena, sarvaviSaYe avagata|

tomAdera madhye yArA maryAdA o prAcuryera adhikArI tArA yena zapatha nA kare ye, tArA AtmIYa-svajana, misakIna evaM AllAhara pathe hijarAtakArIderake sAhAyya karave nA| tArA yena tAderake kSamA kare o tAdera truTi-vicyuti upekSA kare| tomarA ki pachanda kara nA ye, AllAha tomAderake kSamA kare dina? AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|
yArA satI-sAdhvI, sahaja-sarala ImAnadAra nArIra prati apavAda Aropa kare, tArA duniYA o AkhirAte abhizapta Ara tAdera janya Ache gurutara zAsti|
yedina tAdera viruddhe sAkSya deve tAdera jihavA, tAdera hAta, tAdera pA- tAdera kRtakarmera vyApAre|
AllAha sedina tAderake tAdera nyAyya pAonA puropurii devena Ara tArA jAnate pArave ye, AllAhai satya spaSTa vyaktakArI|

caritrahInA nArI caritrahIna puruSadera janya, Ara caritrahIna puruSa caritrahInA nArIdera janya, caritravatI nArI caritravAna puruSera janya, Ara caritravAna puruSa caritravatI nArIra janya| lokerA yA vale tAttheke tArA pavitra| tAdera janya Ache kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA nijedera gRha chAr3A anyera gRhe praveza karo nA, anumati prArthanA evaM gRhavAsIderake sAlAma deYA vyatIta| eTAi tomAdera janya kalyANakara yAte tomarA upadeza lAbha kara|

sekhAne yadi tomarA kAuke nA pAo, tAhale tAte praveza karave nA, yatakSaNa nA tomAderake anumati deYA haYa| Ara yadi tomAderake valA haYa, ‘phire yAo, tAhale phire yAve, eTAi tomAdera janya vezi pavitra’| tomarA yA kara se samparke AllAha savaceYe vezi avagata|
se ghare keu vAsa kare nA, tomAdera mAlamAttA thAke, sekhAne praveza karale tomAdera kona pApa have nA, AllAha jAnena tomarA yA prakAza kara Ara yA tomarA gopana kara|
mu’minadera vala tAdera dRSTi avanamita karate Ara tAdera lajjAsthAna saMrakSaNa karate, eTAi tAdera janya vezi pavitra, tArA yA kichu kare se samparke AllAha khuva bhAlabhAvei avagata|

Ara ImAnadAra nArIderake vale dAo tAdera dRSTi avanamita karate Ara tAdera lajjAsthAna saMrakSaNa karate, Ara tAdera zobhA saundarya prakAza nA karate yA emanitei prakAzita haYa tA vyatIta| tAdera ghAr3a o vuka yena mAthAra kApar3a diYe Dheke deYa| tArA yena tAdera svAmI, pitA, zvazura, putra, svAmIra putra, bhAi, bhAi-era chele, vonera chele, nijedera mahilAgaNa, svIYa mAlikAnAdhIna dAsI, puruSadera madhye yauna kAmanAmukta puruSa Ara nArIdera gopana aGga samparke ajJa vAlaka chAr3A anyera kAche nijedera zobhA saundarya prakAza nA kare| Ara tArA yena nijedera gopana zobhA saundarya prakAza karAra janya sajore padacAraNA nA kare| he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhara nikaTa tAovAha kara, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

tomAdera madhye yArA vivAhahIna tAdera vivAha sampanna kara Ara tomAdera sat dAsa-dAsIderao| tArA yadi niHsva haYa tAhale AllAha tAderake nija anugrahe abhAvamukta kare devena, AllAha pracura dAnakArI, sarvaviSaYe jJAta|

yAdera viYera samvala nei tArA yena saMyama avalamvana kare yatakSaNa nA AllAha nija anugrahe tAderake abhAvamukta karena| Ara tomAdera dAsadAsIdera madhye yArA muktira janya likhita cukti pete cAYa, tAdera saGge cukti kara yadi tAte kona kalyANa Ache va’le tomarA jAna| AllAha tomAderake ye mAla diYechena tAttheke tAderake dAna kara| tomAdera dAsIrA nijedera pavitratA rakSA karate cAile tomarA pArthiva jIvanera sampadera lAlasAYa tAderake vyabhicAre vAdhya karo nA| yadi keu tAdera upara javaradasti kare tave tAdera upara javaradastira para AllAha (tAdera prati) kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tomAdera nikaTa avatIrNa karechi suspaSTa AYAta Ara tomAdera pUrve yArA atIta haYe geche tAdera dRSTAnta o muttAkIdera janya diYechi upadeza|

AllAha AsamAna o yamInera Alo, tA~ra Alora dRSTAnta hala yena ekaTi tAka- yAra bhitare Ache ekaTi pradIpa, pradIpaTi hacche kA~cera bhitare, kA~caTi yena ekaTi ujjvala nakSatra, yA prajjvalita karA haYa varakatamaYa yAYatuna gAchera tela dvArA yA pUrvadezIYao naYa, Ara pazcimadezIYao naYa| Aguna tAke sparza nA karaleo tAra tela yena ujjvalera veza nikaTavartI, Alora upare Alo| AllAha yAke icche karena svIYa Alora dike patha dekhAna| AllAha mAnuSera janya dRSTAnta peza karena, AllAha sarvaviSaYe adhika jJAta|

(e rakama Alo jvAlAno haYa) se sava gRhe (arthAt mAsajide o upAsanAlaYe) yeguloke samunnata rAkhate Ara tAte tA~ra nAma smaraNa karate AllAha nirdeza diYechena, ogulote tA~ra mAhAtmya ghoSaNA karA haYa sakAla o sandhyAYa (vAra vAra)

ai sava lokera dvArA vyavasAYa o kraYa-vikraYa yAderake tA~ra smaraNa hate vicyuta karate pAre nA, Ara nAmAya pratiSThA o yAkAta pradAna thekeo nA| tAdera bhaYa kare (kevala) sedinera yedina antara o dRSTisamUha ulTe yAve|

(tArA ebhAve AllAhara ivAdAta kare) yAte AllAha tAderake puraskRta karena tAdera uttama kAryAvalI anusAre Ara nija anugrahe Aro adhika dena, kAraNa AllAha yAra janya icche karena aparimita riyak dAna karena|

Ara yArA kuphurI kare tAdera kAjakarma hala vAlukAmaYa marubhUmira marIcikAra mata| pipAsArta vyakti seTAke pAni mane kare avazeSe se yakhana tAra nikaTe Ase, se dekhe oTA kichui nA, se sekhAne pAYa AllAhake, ataHpara AllAha tAra hisAva cukiYe dena| AllAha druta hisAva grahaNa kare thAkena|

athavA (kAphiradera avasthA) vizAla gabhIra samudre gabhIra andhakArera nyAYa, yAke Acchanna kare rekheche DheuYera upare Dheu, tAra upare megha, ekera para eka andhakArera stara, keu hAta vera karale se tA ekevArei dekhate pAYa nA| AllAha yAke Alo dAna karena nA, tAra janya kona Alo nei|

tumi ki dekha nA, tini halena AllAha, AsamAna o yamIne yArA Ache sakalei yA~ra prazaMsA gIti uccAraNa kare Ara (ur3anta) pAkhIrAo tAdera DAnA vistAra ka’re? tAdera pratyekei tAdera ‘ivAdAta o prazaMsAgItira paddhati jAne, tArA yA kare AllAha se samparke khuvai avagata|
AsamAna o yamInera rAjatvera mAlikAnA AllAhara janyai, Ara phire Asate have AllAhara kAchei|

tumi ki dekha nA AllAha meghamAlAke cAlita karena, ataHpara seguloke ekatre jur3e dena, ataHpara seguloke stupIkRta karena, ataHpara tumi tAra madhya theke pAnira dhArA vera hate dekhate pAo, ataHpara tini AkAze sthita meghamAlAra pAhAr3a theke zilA varSaNa karena, ataHpara tini yAke icche tA diYe AghAta karena Ara yAra kAcha theke icche tA sariYe nena| tAra vidyutera camaka dRSTizakti prAYa ker3e neYa|
AllAha rAta dinera Avartana ghaTAna, antardRSTi sampanna lokedera janya ete zikSaNIYa viSaYa raYeche|

AllAha pAni hate samasta jIvana sRSTi karechena| tAdera kataka peTera bhare cale, kataka du’pAYera upara cale, Ara kataka cAra pAYera upara cale| AllAha yA cAna tAi sRSTi karena| AllAha sarvaviSaYera upara sarvocca kSamatAra adhikArI|
Ami suspaSTa nidarzana avatIrNa karechi, AllAha yAke cAna sarala saThika patha pradarzana karena|
tArA vale- AmarA AllAhara prati imAna AnalAma Ara rasUlera pratio Ara AmarA mene nilAma| kintu eraparao tAdera madhyekAra ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa, tArA (prakRtapakSe) mu’mina naYa|
tAderake yakhana tAdera mAjhe phaYasAlA karAra uddeze AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera pAne AhavAna karA haYa, takhana tAdera ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa|
kintu ‘hAka’ (arthAt prApya) yadi tAdera pakSe thAke tAhale pUrNa vinaYera saGge tArA rasUlera dike chuTe Ase|
tAdera antare ki roga Ache, nA tArA sandeha poSaNa kare? nA tArA ei bhaYera madhye Ache ye AllAha o tA~ra rasUla tAdera prati anyAYa karavena? tA naYa, Asale tArA nijerAi anyAYakArI|

mu’minaderake yakhana tAdera mAjhe phaYasAlA karAra janya AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera dike DAkA haYa, takhana mu’minadera jaoYAva to ei haYa ye, tArA vale, AmarA zunalAma o mene nilAma, Ara tArAi saphalakAma|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kare, AllAhake bhaYa kare o tA~ra avAdhyatA parihAra kare cale tArAi kRtakArya|

(he navI!) tArA zakta kare kasama kheYe vale ye, tumi tAderake Adeza karale tArA avazya avazyai vera have, vala: tomarA kasama kheYo nA, svAbhAvika Anugatyai kAmya, vastutaH tomarA yA kara, AllAha se samparke sampUrNa avahita|

vala: AllAhara Anugatya o rasUlera Anugatya kara, ataHpara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe lao tAhale tAra (arthAt rasUlera) upara arpita dAYitvera janya se dAYI, Ara tomAdera upara arpita dAYitvera janya tomarAi dAYI, tomarA yadi tAra Anugatya kara tave saThika patha pAve, rasUlera dAYitva hacche spaSTabhAve (vANI) pau~che deYA|

tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkAja kare AllAha tAderake pratizruti diYechena ye tini tAderake avazyai pRthivIte khilAphAta dAna karavena yemana tAdera pUrvavartIderake tini khilAphAta dAna karechilena evaM tini tAdera dvInake avazyai kartRtve pratiSThita karavena yA tini tAdera janya pachanda karechena evaM tini tAdera bhaYa-bhItipUrNa avasthAke parivartita kare tAderake avazyai nirApattA dAna karavena| tArA AmAra ‘ivAdAta karave, kona kichuke AmAra zarIka karave nA| eraparao yArA satya pratyAkhyAna karave tArAi vidrohI, anyAYakArI|
tomarA (niYamita) nAmAya pratiSThA kara, yAkAta pradAna kara o rasUlera Anugatya kara yAte tomarA anugraha prApta hao|
tumi kAphiraderake emana mane kara nA ye, tArA pRthivIte AllAhara iccheke parAbhUta karAra kSamatA rAkhe, tAdera vAsasthAna hala Aguna; katai nA nikRSTa AzraYasthala!

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsadAsIgaNa Ara tomAdera yArA vaYa:prApta haYani tArA yena (tomAdera kAche Asate) tomAdera anumati grahaNa kare tina samaYe- phAjara nAmAyera pUrve, Ara yakhana dupure rodera pracanDatAYa tomarA tomAdera pozAka khule rAkha Ara ‘izAra nAmAyera para| e tinaTi tomAdera pozAkahIna haoYAra samaYa| e samaYagulo chAr3A anya samaYe (praveza karale) tomAdera upara Ara tAdera upara kona doSa nei| tomAdera ekake anyera kAche ghurAphirA karatei haYa| ebhAve AllAha tomAdera janya nirdeza khuvai spaSTabhAve varNanA karena, AllAha sarvajJa, var3ai hikamataoYAlA|

tomAdera zizurA yakhana vaYoHprApta have takhana tArA yena tomAdera nikaTa Asate anumati neYa, yemana tAdera vaYojyeSTharA anumati neYa| ebhAve AllAha tA~ra nirdeza khuvai spaSTabhAve varNanA karena, kAraNa AllAha sarvajJa, var3ai hikamataoYAlA|

vaYaskA nArIrA yArA viYera AzA rAkhe nA, tAdera prati kona doSa vartAve nA yadi tArA tAdera saundarya pradarzana nA ka’re tAdera (upari) pozAka khule rAkhe, tave etheke yadi tArA virata thAke tave seTAi tAdera janya uttama| AllAha sava kichu zonena, sava kichu samparke pUrNa avagata|

andhera janya doSa nei, kho~r3Ara janya doSa nei, pIr3itera janya doSa nei Ara tomAdera janyao doSa nei khAdya grahaNa karate tomAdera gRhe, kiMvA tomAdera pitRgaNera gRhe, kiMvA tomAdera mAtRgaNera gRhe, kiMvA tomAdera bhrAtAdera gRhe, kiMvA tomAdera vonedera gRhe, kiMvA tomAdera cAcAdera gRhe, kiMvA tomAdera phuphudera gRhe, kiMvA tomAdera mAmAdera gRhe, kiMvA tomAdera khAlAdera gRhe, kiMvA ai samasta gRhe, yegulora cAvi raYeche tomAdera hAte kiMvA tomAdera vizvasta vandhudera gRhe| tomarA ekatre AhAra kara kiMvA AlAdA AlAdA tAte tomAdera upara kona doSa nei| yakhana tomarA gRhe, praveza karave takhana tomarA svajanaderake sAlAma jAnAve yA AllAhara dRSTite varakatamaYa pavitra sambhASaNa| ebhAve AllAha tomAdera janya nirdezasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA karena yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

ImAnadAra to tArAi yArA ImAna Ane AllAhara upara o tA~ra rasUlera upara Ara tArA yakhana rasUlera saGge samaSTigata kAje milita haYa, takhana tAra anumati nA niYe cale yAYa nA| yArA tomAra kAche anumati prArthanA kare tArAi AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati vizvAsI| kAjei tAdera keu tAdera kona kAje yAoYAra janya tomAra kAche anumati cAile tumi tAdera yAke icche anumati dive Ara tAdera janya AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karave| AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

rasUlera DAkake tomarA tomAdera ekera prati anyera DAkera mata gaNya karo nA| AllAha tAderake jAnena yArA tomAdera madhye cupisAre sare par3e| kAjei yArA tAra Adezera viruddhAcaraNa kare tArA satarka hoka ye, tAdera upara parIkSA neme Asave kiMvA tAdera upara neme Asave bhaYAvaha zAsti|

nizcita jene rekha, AsamAna o yamIne yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara| tomarA ye avasthAYa Acha tA tini jAnena| ataHpara yedina tArA tA~ra kAche phire yAve sedina tini tAderake jAniYe devena tArA yA karata, AllAha sakala viSaYe savaceYe vezi avagata|
mahA kalyANamaYa tini yini tA~ra vAndAhara upara satya-mithyAra pArthakyakArI (kitAva) nAyila karechena yAte se vizvajagatera janya satarkakArI hate pAre|
yini yamIna o AsamAnera rAjatvera mAlika, tini kona santAna grahaNa karenani, rAjatve tA~ra kona aMzIdAra nei, tini samasta kichu sRSTi karechena, Ara seguloke yathAyatha karechena parimita anupAte|

Ara tArA tA~ke vAda diYe ilAharUpe grahaNa kareche anya kichuke yArA kichui sRSTi kare nA, varaM tArA nijerAi sRSTi haYeche| tArA kSamatA rAkhe nA nijedera kSati vA upakAra karAra Ara kSamatA rAkhe nA mRtyu, jIvana o punarutthAnera upara|
kAphirarA vale- ‘eTA mithye chAr3A Ara kichui naYa, se tA (arthAt kuraAna) udbhAvaNa kareche evaM bhinna jAtira loka e vyApAre tAke sAhAyya kareche|’ Asale tArA anyAYa o mithyera AzraYa niYeche|
tArA vale- ‘egulo pUrva yugera kAhinI yA se [arthAt muhAmmAda (sA.)] likhiYe niYeche Ara eguloi tAra kAche sakAla-sandhyA zonAno haYa|’
vala: ‘tA tinii nAyila karechena yini AsamAna-yamInera yAvatIYa gopana viSaYa avagata Achena| tini var3ai kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|
tArA vale- ‘e kemana rasUla ye khAvAra khAYa, Ara hATa-vAjAre calApherA kare? tAra kAche pherezatA avatIrNa haYa nA kena ye tAra saGge thAkata satarkakArI haYe?
kiMvA tAke dhana-bhAnDAra deYA haYa nA kena, athavA tAra janya ekaTA vAgAna haYa nA kena yAttheke se AhAra karata?’ yAlimarA vale- ‘tomarA to eka yAdugrasta lokerai anusaraNa karacha|’
dekha, tArA tomAra vyApAre kemana sava upamA peza karache! yAra phale tArA pathabhraSTa haYe geche, ataeva tArA kona kramei patha pAve nA|
mahA kalyANamaYa tini yini icche karale tomAke ogulora ceYeo utkRSTa jinisa dite pArena- vAga-vAgicA, yAra nica diYe vaYe caleche nirjhariNI, dite pArena tini tomAke prAsAdarAji|
Asale tArA kiYAmAtake asvIkAra kare, Ara yArA kiYAmAtake asvIkAra kare, tAdera janya Ami prastuta kare rekhechi jvalanta Aguna|
Aguna yakhana tAderake vahu dUravartI sthAna theke dekhave, takhana tArA zunate pAre tAra kruddha garjana o huGkAra|
yakhana tAderake eka saGge ve~dhe jAhAnnAmera kona saMkIrNa sthAne nikSepa karA have, takhana sekhAne tArA mRtyuke DAkave|
(valA have) ‘tomarA Aja eka mRtyuke Deka nA, aneka mRtyuke DAka|’
tAderake jijJesa kara- eTAi uttama nA cirasthAYI jAnnAta, muttAkIderake yAra oYAdA deYA haYeche? tAdera janya eTA have pratidAna o zeSa AvAsasthala|
sekhAne tAdera janya tA-i thAkave yA tArA icche karave| sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| eTA ekaTA oYAdA yA pUraNa karA tomAra pratipAlakera dAYitva|

yedina tini tAderake Ara AllAhake vAda diYe tArA yegulora ‘ivAdAta karata seguloke ekatra karavena, sedina tini jijJesa karavena- ‘tomarAi ki AmAra e sava vAndAhaderake pathabhraSTa karechile? nA tArA nijerAi patha theke vicyuta haYechila?’

tArA valave: ‘pavitra o mahAna tumi| AmAdera janya zobhanIYa chila nA ye tomAke vAda diYe anyAnya ilAha grahaNa karava, varaM tumi oderake Ara odera pitRpuruSaderake diYechile pArthiva bhoga sambhAra, pariNAme tArA bhule giYechila (tomAra prerita) vANI, yAra phale tArA pariNata hala eka dhvaMsaprApta jAtite|

(AllAha muzarikaderake valavena) ‘tomarA yA valate se vyApAre tArA tomAderake mithye pramANita kareche| kAjei tomarA nA pArave (tomAdera zAsti) pratirodha karate Ara nA pAve sAhAyya| tomAdera madhye ye anyAYakArI Ami tAke gurutara zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

Ami tomAra pUrve ye sava rasUla pAThiYechilAma tArA savAi khAdya grahaNa karata, Ara hATa-vAjAre calApherA karata| Ami tomAdera ekake aparera janya karechi parIkSAsvarUpa (kAuke karechi dhanI, kAuke garIva, kAuke savala, kAuke durvala, kAuke rugna, kAuke sustha), dekhi, tomarA (nija nija avasthAra upara) dhairya dhAraNa kara kinA| tomAra pratipAlaka sava kichu dekhena|

yArA AmAra sAkSAt AzA kare nA tArA vale, AmAdera kAche pherezatA nAyila karA haYa nA kena? athavA AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakake dekhate pAi nA kena? tArA nijedera antare ahaMkAra poSaNa kare Ara tArA mete uTheche gurutara avAdhyatAYa|
yedina tArA pherezatAderake dekhate pAve, aparAdhIdera janya sedina kona sukhavara thAkave nA, Ara (pherezatAgaNa valave tomAdera sukha-zAntira pathe Ache) durlaGgha vAdhA|
tArA (duniYAYa) ye ‘AmAla karechila Ami sedike agrasara hava, ataHpara tAke vAniYe deva char3Ano chiTAno dhUlikaNA (sadRza)|
sedina jAnnAtavAsIrA sthAYI vAsasthAna hiseve uttama Ara vizrAmasthala hiseve utkRSTa avasthAYa thAkave|
sedina meghamAlA saha AkAza vidIrNa have Ara pherezatAderake dhIre dhIre nIce nAmiYe deYA have|
sedina satyikArera kartRtva have daYAmaYa (AllAha)’ra evaM kAphiradera janya dinaTi have kaThina|
aparAdhI sedina svIYa hastadvaYa daMzana karate karate valave, ‘hAYa Aphasosa! Ami yadi rasUlera sAthe patha avalamvana karatAma|
hAYa AmAra durbhAgya! Ami yadi amukake vandhurUpe grahaNa nA karatAma!
se to AmAke upadeza vANI theke vibhrAnta karechila AmAra kAche tA AsAra para, zaYatvAna mAnuSera prati vizvAsaghAtaka|
rasUla valave- ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra jAtira lokerA e kuraAnake parityakta gaNya karechila|’
ebhAvei Ami pratyeka navIra janya aparAdhIdera madhya hate zatru vAniYe diYechi, patha pradarzaka o sAhAyyakArI hiseve tomAra pratipAlakai yatheSTa|

kAphirarA vale- tAra kAche puro kuraAna eka sAthe avatIrNa karA hala nA kena? Ami ebhAvei avatIrNa karechi| tomAra hRdaYake tA dvArA sudRr3ha karAra janya Ami tomAra kAche tA dhIre dhIre parikalpita stare kramazaH AvRtti kariYechi|
tomAra kAche tArA emana kona samasyAi niYe Ase nA yAra saThika samAdhAna o sundara vyAkhyA Ami tomAke dAna karini|
yAderake mukhera bhare jAhAnnAmera pAne ekatrita karA have, tArA maryAdAra kSetre savaceYe nikRSTa Ara pathera dika theke savaceYe gumarAh|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma Ara tAra sAthe tAra bhAi hArUnake Ami sAhAyyakArI vAniYechilAma|
ataHpara tAderake valechilAma, ‘tomarA sei jAtira nikaTa yAo yArA AmAra nidarzanake pratyAkhyAna kareche|’ ataHpara Ami tAderake pUrNa vidhvastite vidhvasta kare diYechilAma|
Ara nUhera jAti yakhana rasUladerake mithyAropa karala, Ami tAderake DuviYe dilAma, Ara mAnuSera janya tAderake nidarzana vAniYe dilAma| Ami yAlimadera janya bhaYAvaha zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
se rakamai Ami dhvaMsa karechi ‘Ada, sAmUda, kUpavAsI Ara tAdera madhyavartI vahu vahu vaMzadharake|
Ami tAdera pratyekera janya dRSTAnta varNanA karechilAma (yAte tArA saThika pathera sandhAna pete pAre) Ara tAdera pratyekakei sampUrNarUpe dhvaMsa kare diYechilAma (tAdera pApera kAraNe)|
tArA (arthAt kAphirarA) to se janapada diYei atikrama kare yAra upara varSita haYechila akalyANera vRSTi, tArA ki tA dekhe nA? Asale tArA punarutthAnera kathA cintA kare nA|
tArA yakhana tomAke dekhe, tArA tomAke ThATTA-vidrUpera pAtra chAr3A anya kichu gaNya kare nA, Ara vale: eTA ki sei loka AllAha yAke rasUla kare pAThiYechena?
se to AmAderake AmAdera ilAhadera theke avazyai sariYe dita yadi AmarA tAdera prati dRr3hacitta nA thAkatAma| yakhana tArA zAsti dekhave takhana jAnave ye pathera kSetre kArA adhika bhraSTa chila|
tumi ki tAke dekha nA ye tAra kheYAla khuzike ilAharupe grahaNa kareche? era pareo ki tumi tAra kAjera jimmAdAra hate cAo?
tumi ki eTA mane kara ye, tAdera adhikAMza loka zune vA vujhe? tArA pazu vai to naYa, varaM tArA saThika patha theke Aro vezi bhraSTa|

tumi ki tomAra pratipAlakake dekha nA kIbhAve tini chAYAke dIrgha karena (sUrya udaYera samaYe, ataHpara tA kramei choTa hate hate dupura velA chAYA kSudra AkRti dhAraNa kare, dupurera para AvAra chAYA dIrgha hate thAke), tini cAile chAYAke avazyai sthira rAkhate pAratena| sUryakei Ami karechi tAra (arthAt chAYAra) nirNAYaka (sUryera avasthAnera kAraNei chAYA choTa o dIrgha haYa)|
ataHpara Ami tAke nijera dike guTiYe nei, dhIre dhIre kramAgatabhAve (kAro mRtyu hale, kichu vinAza hale, kichu guTAno hale- sava kichui AllAhara dike cale yAYa)|
tinii tomAdera janya rAtake karechena AvaraNa, nidrAke karechena ArAmaprada Ara dinake karechena (nidrArUpI sAmaYika mRtyura para) AvAra jIvanta haYe uThAra samaYa|
tinii tAra (vRSTirUpI) anugrahera pUrve susaMvAda hiseve vAYu pAThiYe dena Ara Ami AkAza theke vizuddha pAni varSaNa kari|
yA diYe Ami mRta yamInake jIvita kare tuli evaM tRSNA nivAraNa kari AmAra sRSTira antargata aneka jIvajantura o mAnuSera|

Ami pAnike (sakalera praYojana meTAnora janya) tAdera mAjhe vaNTana kari yAte tArA (AllAhara anugrahera kathA) smaraNa kare, kintu mAnuSadera adhikAMzai ImAna grahaNa karate asvIkAra ka’re kevala kupharii karala|
Ami icche karale pratyeka janavasatite satarkakArI pAThAtAma| (kintu sArA vizvera janya ekajana navI pAThiYe sakalake ekai ummAta haoYAra anugraha lAbhe dhanya karechi)|
kAjei tumi kAphiradera Anugatya karo nA: Ara kuraAnera sAhAyye tAdera viruddhe saMgrAma kara- kaThora saMgrAma|
tinii samudrake du’ dhArAYa pravAhita karechena- ekaTi supeYa susvAdu ArekaTi lavaNAkta kaTu, ubhaYera mAjhe Tene diYechena eka AvaraNa- eka anatikramya vibhakti-prAcIra|
tinii pAni theke sRSTi karechena mAnuSa, ataHpara mAnuSake karechena vaMza samparkIYa o vivAha samparkIYa, tomAra pratipAlaka sava kichu karate sakSama|
tArA AllAhake vAda diYe emana kichura ‘ivAdAta kare yA nA pAre tAdera kona upakAra karate, Ara nA pAre kona kSati karate, Ara kAphira hacche tAra pratipAlakera viruddhe sAhAyyakArI|
Ami tomAke pAThiYechi kevala susaMvAdadAtA o bhaYa pradarzanakArI hiseve|
vala- ejanya Ami tomAdera kAche echAr3A kona pratidAna cAi nA ye, yAra icche se tAra pratipAlakera dike patha avalamvana karuka|
Ara tumi nirbhara kara sei ciraJjIvera upara yini maravena nA| Ara tA~ra prazaMsA o pavitratA ghoSaNA kara| tini tA~ra vAndAhadera gunAhara khavara rAkhAra vyApAre yatheSTa|

tini AsamAna, yamIna Ara e du’Yera bhitare yA Ache tA cha’dine (cha’Ti samaYa stare) sRSTi karechena, ataHpara Araze samunnata haYechena| tinii rAhamAna, kAjei tA~ra samparke tAke jijJesa kara ye e samparkita jJAna rAkhe|

tAderake yakhana valA haYa ‘rahamAna’-era uddezye sAjadAYa avanata hao, tArA vale- ‘rahamAna AvAra kI? AmAderake tumi yAkei sejadA karate valave AmarA tAkei sejadA karava nAki?’ ete tAdera avAdhyatAi ver3e yAYa| [sAjadAha]
katai nA kalyANamaYa tini yini AsamAne nakSatrarAjira samAveza ghaTiYechena Ara tAte sthApana karechena pradIpa Ara Alo vikiraNakArI candra|
Ara tinii rAta Ara dinake karechena parasparera anugAmI tAdera janya yArA upadeza grahaNa karate cAYa, athavA kRtajJatA prakAza karate cAYa|
Ara rahamAnera vAndA tArAi yArA yamIne namrabhAve calApherA kare Ara ajJa lokerA tAderake samvodhana karale tArA vale- ‘zAnti’, (AmarA vitarke lipta hate cAi nA)|
Ara tArA rAta kATAYa tAdera pratipAlakera uddezye sAjadAYa avanata o danDAYamAna avasthAYa|
Ara tArA vale: ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAdera theke jAhAnnAmera zAsti dUra kara, tAra zAsti to bhaYAvaha vipada|’
tA AvAsasthala Ara avasthAna neYAra jAYagA hiseve katai nA nikRSTa!
Ara yakhana tArA vyaYa kare takhana apavyaYa kare nA, Ara kRpaNatAo kare nA; e du’Yera madhyavartI panthA grahaNa kare|

tArA AllAhara sAthe anya kona ilAhake DAke nA| Ara yathArthatA vyatIta kona prANa hatyA kare nA yA AllAha niSiddha karechena Ara tArA vyabhicAra kare nA| Ara ye egulo kare se zAstira sAkSAt lAbha karave|
kviYAmatera dina tAra zAsti dviguNa karA have Ara se sekhAne lAJchita haYe ciravAsa karave|
tave tArA naYa yArA tAovAha karave, ImAna Anave, Ara sat kAja karave| AllAha edera pApaguloke puNye parivartita kare devena; AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|
Ara ye vyakti tAovAha kare Ara satkAja kare, se AllAhara dike pratyAvartana kare- pUrNa pratyAvartana|
Ara yArA mithye sAkSya deYa nA, Ara vehudA karmakAnDera pAza diYe atikrama karale sasammAne pAza kATiYe cale yAYa|
Ara tAderake tAdera pratipAlakera AYAta smaraNa kariYe deYA hale yArA tAra prati vadhira o andhera nyAYa AcaraNa kare nA (zuneo zune nA, dekheo dekhe nA- emana kare nA)|
Ara yArA prArthanA kare: he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake emana strI o santAnAdi dAna kara yArA AmAdera cokha jur3iYe deYa Ara AmAderake muttAkIdera netA vAniYe dAo|
ederakei tAdera dhairyadhAraNera kAraNe jAnnAtera suucca sthAna dAna ka’re puraskRta karA have| sekhAne tAderake abhyarthanA jAnAno have saMvardhanA o sAlAma jAniYe|
sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave, AvAsasthala o avasthAnasthala hiseve tA katai nA utkRSTa!

(kAphiraderake) vala: ‘tomAdera vyApAre AmAra pratipAlakera kI praYojana par3eche tomarA yadi tA~ke nA DAko? tomarA to tA~ke asvIkAra karecha, kAjei zIghrai tomAdera upara ese par3ave apratirodhya (zAsti)|
tva-sIna-mIma|
egulo suspaSTa (vA suspaSTakArI) kitAvera AYAta|
tumi haYata e duHkhe tomAra prANanAza karave ye, tArA mu’mina hacche nA|
Ami icche karale tAdera kAche AsamAna theke emana nidarzana pAThAtAma ye tAra sAmane tAdera mAthA nata haYe yeta (arthAt tArA ImAna Anate vAdhya hata)|
tAdera kAche yakhanai daYAmaYa AllAhara pakSa hate natuna kona nasIhata Ase takhanai tArA tAttheke mukha phiriYe neYa|
tArA (AllAhara vANIke) asvIkArai kareche, zIghrai tAdera kAche tAra satya udaghATita have yA niYe tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa karata|
tArA ki yamInera dike ceYe dekhe nA, Ami tAte sava dharanera utkRSTa udbhida paYadA karechi|
avazyai ete nidarzana Ache (AllAha samparke cintA ka’re ImAna AnAra janya), kintu tAdera adhikAMzai ImAna Ane nA|
nizcaYa tomAra pratipAlaka mahA parAkramazAlI, ati daYAlu|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka mUsAke DAka diYe valalena, ‘tumi yAlima sampradAYera kAche yAo,
pherAunera sampradAYera kAche| tArA ki bhaYa kare nA?
se valechila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra bhaYa hacche tArA AmAke mithye mane ka’re pratyAkhyAna karave|
Ara AmAra antara saMkucita haYe yAcche, AmAra jihvA sAvalIlabhAve kathA valate pAre nA| kAjei Apani hArUnera prati risAlAta dina|
tadupari AmAra viruddhe aparAdhera abhiyogao tAdera Ache, kAjei AmAra bhaYa hacche tArA AmAke hatyA karave|’
AllAha valalena, ‘kakSano nA, tomarA du’jane AmAra (deYA) nidarzana niYe yAo, Ami tomAdera saGge theke sava kichu zunate thAkava|
kAjei tomarA du’jane pherAunera kAche yAo Ara giYe vala ye, AmarA vizvajagatera pratipAlakera prerita rasUla|
vAnI isarAIlake AmAdera saGge pAThiYe dAo|’
pherAuna valala, ‘AmarA ki tomAke zizukAle AmAdera madhye lAlana pAlana karini? Ara tumi ki tomAra jIvanera katakagulo vachara AmAdera mAjhe kATAoni?
tumi tomAra karma yA karAra karecha (AmAdera ekajana lokake hatyA ka’re), tumi var3a akRtajJa|’
mUsA valala: ‘Ami to tA karechilAma se samaYa yakhana Ami chilAma (saThika patha samparke) ajJa|
ataHpara tomAdera bhaYe bhIta haYe Ami tomAdera theke pAliYe gelAma| ataHpara AmAra ravava AmAke prajJA dAna karalena, Ara AmAke karalena rasUladera ekajana|
tumi AmAra prati tomAra ye anugrahera kho~TA diccha tAto ei ye, tumi vAnI isarAIlake dAse pariNata karecha|’
pherAuna valala: ‘vizvajagatera pratipAlaka AvAra kI?’
mUsA valala: ‘(yini) AsamAna o yamIna o e du’Yera mAjhe yA kichu Ache sava kichura pratipAlaka- yadi tomarA niHsandehe vizvAsI hao|
pherAuna tAra cArapAzera lokederake valala- ‘tomarA zunacha to?’
mUsA valala: ‘(tini) tomAdera pratipAlaka o zuru theke pUrvavartI tomAdera vApa-dAdAderao pratipAlaka|’
(phiraAuna) valala: ‘tomAdera rasUla ye tomAdera nikaTa prerita haYeche se nizcitai pAgala|’
(mUsA) valalaH ‘(tinii) pUrva o pazcimera pratipAlaka, Ara e ubhaYa dikera mAjhe yA Ache tArao- yadi tomAdera vuddhisuddhi thAke|’
(pherAuna) valala: ‘yadi tumi AmAke vAda diYe (anya kichuke) ilAha hiseve grahaNa kara, tAhale Ami tomAke avazya avazyai kArAruddha karava|’
(mUsA) valala: ‘Ami yadi tomAra kAche kona spaSTa jinisa niYe Asi tavuo?
(pherAuna) valala: ‘tAhale tA Ano, yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|’
takhana mUsA tAra lAThi chu~r3e dila Ara sahasAi tA spaSTa eka ajagara haYe gela|
Ara mUsA (vagalera nIca diYe) nijera hAta Tene vera karala, Ara tA darzakadera sAmane jhakamaka karate lAgala|
pherAuna tAra cArapAzera pradhAnadera valala: ‘se avazyai eka dakSa yAdukara|
yAdura vale se tomAderake tomAdera deza theke vera kare dite cAYa| ekhana vala tomAdera nirdeza kI?’
tArA valala: ‘tAke o tAra bhAike (kichu samaYa) apekSAYa phele rAkhuna Ara jar3o karAra janya ghoSakaderake nagare nagare pAThiYe dina|
tArA ApanAra kAche pratyekaTi abhijJa yAdukarake niYe Asave|’
kAjei yAdukaraderake ekatrita karA hala ekaTi nirdiSTa dina kSaNera janya yA chila suvidita|
Ara janagaNake valA hala- ‘tomarA ki sammilita have?
yAte AmarA yAdukaradera (evaM tAdera pradhAna pRSThapoSaka pherAunera) dIna anusaraNa karate pAri yadi tArA vijaYI haYa|
yAdukararA yakhana Asalo, tArA pherAunake valala: ‘AmarA jaYI hale AmAderake puraskAra deYA have to?’
pherAuna valala- ‘hA~, takhana tomarA avazyai AmAra naikaTyalAbhakArIdera antarbhukta have|’
mUsA tAderake valala- ‘nikSepa kara yA tomarA nikSepa karave|’
takhana tArA tAdera razigulo o lAThigulo nikSepa karala Ara tArA valala- ‘pherAunera iyayatera zapatha! AmarA avazyai jaYI hava|’
ataHpara mUsA tAra lAThi nikSepa karala| haThAt tA tAdera alIka kIrtiguloke gilate lAgala|
takhana yAdukararA sijadAYa luTiYe par3ala|
tArA valala- ‘AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karalAma rAvvula ‘AlAmInera prati,
yini mUsA o hArunera pratipAlaka|’

pherAuna valala- ‘Ami tomAderake anumati deYAra Agei tomarA tAte vizvAsa Anale? nizcaYai se tomAdera ostAda ye tomAderake yAdu zikhiYeche| zIghrai tomarA (era pariNAma) jAnate pArave| Ami avazya avazyai tomAdera hAta-pAguloke viparIta dika theke keTe phelava Ara tomAdera savvAike avazya avazyai ‘zUle car3Ava|
tArA valala- konai kSati nei, AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera pAne pratyAvartana karava|
AmAdera ekamAtra AzA ei ye, AmAdera pratipAlaka AmAdera truTi-vicyuti kSamA karavena, kAraNa AmarA vizvAsa sthApanakArIdera madhye prathama|’
Ami mUsAke ohIyoge nirdeza dilAma AmAra vAndAderake niYe rAtrikAle vera haYe yAo, nizcaYai tomAdera pazcAddhAvana karA have|
ataHpara pherAuna zahare nagare saMgrAhaka pAThiYe dila|
(ei va’le ye) erA (vAnI isarAIlarA) kSudra ekaTi dala|
tArA AmAderake avazyai krodhAnvita kareche|
Ara AmarA avazyai sadA satarka ekaTi dala|
ebhAve Ami pherAuna goSThIke (tAdera nijederai) udyAnarAji Ara jharNAsamUha theke vahiskAra karalAma|
Ara dhanabhanDArasamUha o sammAnajanaka avasthAna theke|
ebhAvei ghaTechila, Ami vAnI isarAIlake esava kichura uttarAdhikArI kare diYechilAma|
kAjei tArA (arthAt pherAuna goSThI) sUryodaYakAle tAdera pazcAddhAvana karala|
yakhana du‘dala parasparake dekhala takhana mUsAra saGgIrA valala- ‘AmarA to dharA par3ei gelAma|’
mUsA valala- ‘kakSano nA, AmAra rava AmAra saGge Achena, zIghrai tini AmAke patha nirdeza karavena|
takhana Ami mUsAra prati oYAhI karalAma- ‘tomAra lAThi diYe samudre AghAta kara|’ phale tA vibhakta haYe pratyeka bhAga suvizAla parvatera nyAYa haYe gela|
Ami sekhAne apara dalaTike pauche dilAma|
Ara mUsA o tAra saGgI savAike uddhAra karalAma|
ataHpara apara dalaTike DuviYe mAralAma|
ete avazyai nidarzana Ache, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsa kare nA|
tomAra pAlanakartA avazyai parAkramazAlI, var3ai daYAlu|
oderake ivarAhImera vRttAnta zuniYe dAo|
yakhana se tAra pitA o tAra sampradAYake valechila- ‘tomarA kisera ivAdata kara?’
tArA valechila- ‘AmarA mUrtira pUjA kari, Ara AmarA sadA sarvadA tAderake A~kar3e thAki|’
ivarAhIma valala- ‘tomarA yakhana (tAderake) DAka takhana ki tArA tomAdera kathA zone?
kiMvA tomAdera upakAra kare athavA apakAra?’
tArA valala- ‘nA tave AmarA AmAdera pitRderake erakama karate dekhechi|’
se valala-tomarA ki bheve dekhecha tomarA kisera pUjA kare yAccha?
tomarA Ara tomAdera Agera pitRpuruSarA?
tArA savAi AmAra zatru, vizvajagatera pAlanakartA chAr3A|
tini AmAke sRSTi karechena ataHpara tinii AmAke patha dekhAna|
Ara tinii AmAke khAoYAna o pAna karAna|
Ara Ami yakhana pIr3ita hai takhana tinii AmAke Arogya karena|
yini AmAra mRtyu ghaTAvena, punarAYa AmAke jIvita karavena|
Ara yini, Ami AzA kari- kiYAmAtera dina AmAra doSa-truTi kSamA kare devena|
he AmAra pAlanakartA! AmAke prajJA dAna kara evaM AmAke satkarmazIladera arntabhukta kara|
evaM AmAke paravartIdera madhye satyabhASI kara|
evaM AmAke ni‘YAmAtapUrNa jAnnAtera uttarAdhikArIdera antarbhukta kara|
Ara tumi AmAra pitAke kSamA kara, tini to gumarAhadera arntabhukta|
evaM punarutthAna divase AmAke apamAnita karo nA|
yedina dhana-sampada o santAna-santuti kona kAje Asave nA|
kevala (sAphalya lAbha karave) se vyakti ye vizuddha antara niYe AllAhara nikaTa Asave|
Ara jAnnAtake muttAkIdera nikaTavartI karA have|
evaM pathabhraSTadera sammukhe jAhAnnAmake unmocita karA have|
Ara tAderake valA have, tomarA yAra ‘ivAdAta karate tArA kothAYa
AllAhake vAda diYe? tArA ki tomAdera sAhAyya karate pAre kiMvA tAdera nijederake sAhAyya karate pAre?
ataHpara tAderake o pathabhraSTaderake jAhAnnAme mukhera bhare nikSepa karA have|
Ara ivalIsera dalavala savAike|
sekhAne tArA vitarke lipta haYe valave,
‘AllAhara kasama! AmarA avazya spaSTa gumarAhIte chilAma|
yakhana AmarA tomAderake sarvajagatera pAlanakartAra samakakSa sthira karatAma|
aparAdhIrAi AmAderake gomarAh karechila|
kAjei AmAdera kona supArizakArI nei|
ekajana antaraGga vandhuo nei|
AmAdera yadi ekaTivAra pRthivIte phire yAoYAra suyoga hata, tAhale AmarA mu’minadera arntabhukta haYe yetAma|
ete avazyai nidarzana Ache, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai ImAna Ane nA|
tomAra pratipAlaka, tini avazyai mahA parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
nUhera kaoma rasulagaNake mithye va’le pratyAkhAna karechila|
yakhana tAdera bhrAtA nUha tAderake valechila- ‘tomarA ki bhaYa karave nA (AllAhake)?
Ami tomAdera janya (prerita) vizvasta rAsula|
kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara o AmAra anusaraNa kara|
Ami tAra janya tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA| AmAra pratidAna ekamAtra vizvajagatera pratipAlakera kAchei Ache|’
kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra anusaraNa kara|
tArA valala- ‘AmarA ki tomAra prati vizvAsa karava yakhana tomAra anusaraNa karache ekevAre nimnazreNIra lokerA|’
nUha valala- ‘tArA kI karata seTA AmAra jAnA nei|
tAdera hisAva neYA to AmAra pratipAlakera kAja, yadi tomarA vujhate!
mu’minaderake tAr3iYe deYA AmAra kAja naYa|
Ami to zudhu ekajana suspaSTa satarkakArI|’
tArA valala- ‘he nUha! tumi yadi virata nA hao, tAhale tumi nizcitai prastarAghAte nihata have|’
nUha valala- ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! AmAra sampradAYa AmAke pratyAkhAna karache|
kAjei tumi AmAra o tAdera madhye phaYasAlA ka’re dAo, Ara AmAke o AmAra saGgI mu’minaderake kSamA kara|’
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra saGge yArA chila tAderake vojhAi nauyAne rakSA karalAma|
tArapara avaziSTa savAike DuviYe dilAma|
avazyai ete nidarzana Ache, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsI naYa|
tomAra pratipAlaka, avazyai tini pravala parAkrAnta, parama daYAlu|
‘Ada sampradAYa rasUlagaNake mithye sAvyasta karechila|
yakhana tAdera bhAi hUda tAderake valala- ‘tomarA ki (AllAhake) bhaYa karave nA?
Ami tomAdera janya (prerita) eka vizvasta rasula|
kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAke mAnya kara|
Ara e janya Ami tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA, AmAra pratidAna Ache kevala vizvajagatera pratipAlakera nikaTa|
tomarA ki pratiTi uccasthAne anarthaka smRtistambha nirmANa karacha?
Ara var3a var3a prAsAda nirmANa karacha. yena tomarA ciradina thAkave?
Ara yakhana tomarA (durvala zreNIra lokadera upara) AghAta hAna, takhana AghAta hAna niSThura mAlikera mata|
kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAke mAnya kara|
bhaYa kara tA~ke yini tomAderake yAvatIYa vastu dAna karechena yA tomAdera jAnA Ache|
yini tomAderake dAna karechena gavAdi pazu o santAna-santuti|
Ara udyAnarAji o jharNAsamUha|
Ami tomAdera janya mahA divasera zAstira bhaYa karachi|’
tArA valala- ‘tumi nasIhata kara Ara nA kara, AmAdera janya du’i samAna|
esava (kathAvArtA valA) pUrvavartI lokedera abhyAsa chAr3A Ara anya kichui nA|
AmAderake zAsti deYA have nA|’
ataHpara tArA tAke mithye va’le pratyAkhyAna karala| takhana Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare dilAma| avazyai ete nidarzana raYeche, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsa kare nA|
evaM tomAra pratipAlaka, tini mahA pratApazAlI, var3ai daYAlu|
sAmUda jAti rasUlagaNake pratyAkhyAna karechila|
yakhana tAdera bhAi sAliha tAderake valechila- tomarA ki (AllAhake) bhaYa karave nA?
Ami tomAdera janya (prerita) vizvasta rasUla|
kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara o AmAke mAnya kara|
Ara ejanya Ami tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA, AmAra pratidAna to Ache ekamAtra vizvajagatera pratipAlakera nikaTa|
tomAderake ki ekhAne ye sava (bhoga vilAsa) Ache tAtei nirApade rekhe deYA have?
udyAnarAji Ara jhArNAsamUhe|
Ara zaSyakSete o phule AcchAdita (phale bhArAkrAnta) khejura vAgAne?
evaM tomarA dakSatAra sAthe pAhAr3a keTe gRha nirmANa karacha|
kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara o AmAke mAnya kara|
evaM sImAlaGghanakArIdera nirdeza mAnya kara nA|
yArA pRthivIte vizRGkhalA sRSTi kare, saMskAra kare nA|’
tArA valala- ‘tumi to kevala yAdugrastadera ekajana|
tumi AmAdera mata mAnuSa chAr3A Ara kichui nA| kAjei tumi satyavAdI hale ekaTA nidarzana hAjira kara|
sAliha valala- ‘ei ekaTi uTani, era janya Ache pAni pAnera pAlA Ara tomAdera janya Ache pAni pAnera pAlA nirdhArita dine|
aniSTa sAdhanera nimitte tAke sparza kara nA, tAhale tomAderake mahA divasera AyAva pAkar3Ao karave|
kintu tArA tAke vadha karala, phale tArA anutapta hala|
ataHpara AyAva tAderake pAkar3Ao karala| ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsa kare nA|
Ara tomAra pratipAlaka tini to mahA parAkramazAlI, var3ai daYAlu|
lUtera sampradAYa rasuladerake mithye vale pratyAkhyAna karechila|
yakhana tAdera bhAi lUta tAderake valechila- ‘tomarA ki (AllAhake) bhaYa karave nA?
Ami to tomAdera janya (prerita) ekajana vizvasta rasUla|
kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara o AmAke mAnya kara|
Ami ejanya tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA, AmAra pratidAna ekamAtra jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera nikaTa raYeche|
jagatera sakala prANIra madhye tomarAi ki puruSadera saGge upagata hao,
evaM tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera janya ye strIgaNake sRSTi karechena tAderake tyAga kara? ravaM tomarA eka sImAlaGghanakArI sampradAYa|’
tArA valala- ‘he lUta! tumi yadi virata nA hao tave tumi avazya avazyai vahiskRta have|’
lUta valala- ‘Ami tomAdera e kAjake ghRNA kari|
he AmAra pratipAlaka! tArA yA kare tA theke tumi AmAke o AmAra parivAravargake rakSA kara|’
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra parivAravargera sakalake rakSA karalAma
eka vRddhA chAr3A| se chila pechane avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta|
ataHpara anyadera sakalake puropuri dhvaMsa kare dilAma|
tAdera upara varSaNa karalAma (zAstira) vRSTi, bhaYa pradarzitadera janya e vRSTi chila katai nA manda!
nizcaYai ete nidarzana raYeche, kintu adhikAMzai vizvAsa kare nA|
tomAra pratipAlaka, tini mahA pratApazAlI, var3ai daYAlu|
vanera adhivAsIrA rasUladerake mithye vale pratyAkhyAna karechila|
yakhana zu‘AYava tAderake valechila- ‘tomarA ki (AllAhake) bhaYa karave nA?
Ami tomAdera janya (prerita) vizvasta rAsula|
kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAke mAnya kara|
e janya Ami tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA, AmAra pratidAna to raYeche ekamAtra jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera nikaTa|
mApe pUrNa mAtrAYa dAo Ara yArA mApe kama deYa tAdera antarbhukta haYo nA|
saThika dA~r3ipAllAYa ojana karave|
mAnuSake tAdera prApyavastu kama dive nA| Ara pRthivIte vizRGkhalA sRSTi karo nA|
evaM bhaYa kara tA~ke yini tomAderake evaM tomAdera pUrvavartI vaMzAvalIke sRSTi karechena|’
tArA valala- ‘tumi to kevala yAdugrastadera ekajana|
tumi AmAdera matai mAnuSa vai nao, AmarA mane kari tumi avazya mithyAvAdIdera antarbhukta|
tumi satyavAdI hale AkAzera eka Tukaro AmAdera upara phele dAo|’
zu‘AYava valala- ‘tomarA yA kara, AmAra pratipAlaka se samparke vezi avagata|’
kintu tArA tAke pratyAkhyAna karala| phale tAderake eka meghAcchanna divasera zAsti pAkar3Ao karala| tA chila eka mahA divasera ‘AyAva|
ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsa kare nA|
Ara tomAra pratipAlaka, tini avazyai mahA pratApazAlI, var3ai daYAlu|
avazyai e kuraAna jagatasamUhera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate avatIrNa|
vizvasta AtmA (jivarAIla) eke niYe avataraNa kareche
tomAra antare yAte tumi satarkakArIdera antarbhukta hao|
suspaSTa AravI bhASAYa|
pUrvavartI kitAvasamUheo nizcaYa era ullekha Ache|
eTA ki tAdera janya nidarzana naYa ye, vAnI isarAIlera panDitagaNa tA jAnata (ye tA satya)|
Ami yadi tA kona anAravera prati avatIrNa karatAma,
ataHpara se tA tAdera nikaTa pATha karata, tAhale tArA tAte vizvAsa Anata nA|
ebhAve Ami aparAdhIdera antare avizvAsa saJcAra karechi|
tArA era prati ImAna Anave nA yatakSaNa nA tArA bhaYAvaha zAsti pratyakSa kare|
kAjei tA tAdera kAche haThAt ese par3ave, tArA kichui vujhate pArave nA|
tArA takhana valave- ‘AmAderake ki avakAza deYA have?’
tArA ki AmAra zAsti druta kAmanA kare?
tumi ki bheve dekhecha Ami yadi tAderake kataka vachara bhoga vilAsa karate dei,
ataHpara tAderake ye viSaYera o‘YAdA deYA hata tA tAdera kAche ese par3e|
takhana tAdera vilAsera sAmagrI tAdera kona upakAre Asave nA|
Ami emana kona janapada dhvaMsa karini yAra janya kona bhaYa pradarzanakArI chila nA
smaraNa karAnora janya| Ami kakhano anyAYakArI nai|
zaYatvAnarA tA (arthAt kuraAna) niYe avataraNa kareni|
tArA e kAjera yogya naYa Ara tArA era sAmarthyao rAkhe nA|
tAderake eTA zonA theke avazyai dUre rAkhA haYeche|
kAjei tumi anya kona ilAhke AllAhara saGge Deka nA| DAkale tumi zAstiprAptadera antarbhukta haYe yAve|
Ara tumi satarka kara tomAra nikaTAtmIYa svajanadera
ye sakala vizvAsIrA tomAra Anugatya kare tAdera janya tumi tomAra anukampAra vAhu prasArita kara|
tArA yadi tomAra avAdhyatA kare tAhale tumi vale dAo- tomarA yA kara tAra saGge Ami samparkahIna|
Ara tumi pravala parAkrAnta parama daYAlura upara nirbhara kara;
yini tomAke dekhena yakhana tumi (nAmAyera janya) danDAYamAna hao|
Ara (tini dekhena) sAjadAkArIdera saGge tomAra calAphirA|
tini sava kichu zonena, sava kichu jAnena|
Ami ki tomAderake jAnAva kAdera nikaTa zaYatvAnarA avatIrNa haYa|
tArA avatIrNa haYa pratyekaTi carama mithyuka o pApIra nikaTa|
orA kAna pete thAke Ara tAdera adhikAMzai mithyAvAdI|
vibhrAntarAi kavidera anusaraNa kare,
tumi ki dekha nA ye, tArA prati maYadAnei udabhrAnta haYe phire?
Ara tArA yA vale tA tArA nijerA kare nA|

kintu orA vyatIta yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare Ara AllAhake khuva vezi smaraNa kare Ara niryAtita haoYAra para nijedera pratirakSAra vyavasthA kare| yAlimarA zIghrai jAnate pArave kon (mahA saMkaTamaYa) jAYagAYa tArA phire yAcche|
tA-sIna, egulo kuraAnera AYAta o suspaSTa kitAvera;
mu’minadera janya pathera dizA o susaMvAda
yArA nAmAya kAYema kare, yAkAta AdAYa kare Ara tArA AkhirAte vizvAsI|
yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA, tAdera (cokhe) tAdera karmakAnDake Ami suzobhita karechi, kAjei tArA udabhrAnta haYe ghure ver3AYa,
erAi hala yAdera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti Ara erAi AkhirAte savaceYe kSatigrasta|
nizcaYa tomAke kuraAna deYA haYeche mahAvijJa sarvajJera nikaTa hate|

smaraNa kara yakhana mUsA tAra parivAravargake valechila- ‘Ami Aguna dekhechi, kAjei Ami zIghrai sekhAna theke tomAdera janya khavara niYe Asava kiMvA tomAdera kAche jvalanta Aguna niYe Asava yAte tomarA Aguna pohAte pAra|’
ataHpara se yakhana Agunera kAche Asala takhana AoYAja hala- ‘dhanya, yArA Ache ei Alora madhye Ara tAra AzepAze, vizvajAhAnera pratipAlaka pavitra, mahimAnvita|
he mUsA! Ami mahA parAkrAnta prajJAmaYa AllAha|

tumi tomAra lAThi nikSepa kara; ataHpara yakhana se oTAke chuTAchuTi karate dekhala yena oTA ekaTA sApa, takhana se pechanera dike chuTate lAgala evaM phireo dekhala nA| (takhana valA hala) he mUsA! tumi bhaYa karo nA, nizcaYai AmAra kAche rasUlagaNa bhaYa pAYa nA|
tave ye atyAcAra kare ataHpara manda kAjera parivarte sat kAja kare, tAhale nizcaYa Ami kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

Ara tumi tomAra hAta vagale DhukAo, tA zubhra haYe vera haYe Asave doSamukta avasthAYa, tA hala pherAuna o tAra sampradAYera nikaTa niYe AsA naYaTi nidarzanera antarbhukta| nizcaYa tArA chila pApAcArI sampradAYa|
ataHpara yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra dRzyamAna nidarzana Asala, tArA valala- ‘eTA spaSTa yAdu|
tArA anyAYa auddhatyabhare nidarzanaguloke pratyAkhyAna karala yadio tAdera antara eguloke satya vale vizvAsa karechila| ataeva dekha, phAsAda sRSTikArIdera pariNati kemana haYechila!
Ami dAUda o sulAimAnake jJAna dAna karechilAma| tArA ubhaYe valechila, ‘sakala prazaMsA AllAhara yini tA~ra vahu mu’mina vAndAdera upara AmAderake maryAdA dAna karechena|’

sulAimAna dAUdera uttarAdhikArI haYechila| se valechila- ‘he mAnuSerA! AmAke pakSIkulera bhASA zikSA deYA haYeche Ara AmAderake sava kichu deYA haYeche, eTA (AllAhara pakSa hate) avazyai suspaSTa anugraha|’
sulAimAnera sAmane tAra senAvAhinIke samaveta karA hala, jvina, mAnuSa o pakSIkulake; ataHpara tAderake vibhinna vuhye vinyasta karA hala|

yakhana tArA pipIlikAra upatyakAYa Asala takhana ekaTi pipIlikA valala- ‘ohe pi~par3Ara dala! tomAdera vAsasthAne Dhuke par3a, yAte sulAimAna o tAra sainyavAhinI tAdera agocare tomAderake padapiSTa ka’re nA phele|

sulAimAna tAra kathAYa khuzite mucaki hAsala Ara valala- ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAra prati o AmAra pitAmAtAra prati ye anugraha dAna karecha tAra janya kRtajJatA prakAzera AmAke zakti dAna kara Ara yAte emana satkAja karate pAri yAte tumi santuSTa hao Ara tomAra daYAYa AmAke tomAra satkarmazIla vAndAdera antarbhukta kara|’
ataHpara sulAimAna pAkhIdera kho~ja khavara nila| se valala, kI vyApAra, hudahudake to dekhachi nA, nAki se anupasthita?
Ami tAke avazya avazyai zAsti deva kaThina zAsti kiMvA tAke avazya avazyai hatyA karava athavA se avazya avazyai AmAke tAra (anupasthitira) upayukta kAraNa darzAve|’
ataHpara hudahuda avilamve ese valala- ‘Ami yA avagata haYechi Apani tA avagata nana, Ami sAvA theke nizcita khavara niYe ApanAra kAche esechi|
Ami dekhalAma eka nArI tAdera upara rAjatva karache Ara tAke sava kichui deYA haYeche Ara tAra Ache eka virATa siMhAsana|

evaM Ami tAke Ara tAra sampradAYake dekhalAma AllAhara parivarte sUryake sejadA karate| zaYatvAna tAdera kAjake tAdera janya zobhana kare diYeche evaM tAderake satpatha theke vAdhA diYe rekheche kAjei tArA satpatha pAYa nA|
(zaYatvAna vAdhA diYe rekheche) yAte tArA AllAhake sejadA nA kare yini AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra lukkAYita vastuke prakAza karena, yini jAnena tomarA yA gopana kara Ara tomarA yA prakAza kara|
AllAha, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAh nei, (tini) mahAna ‘Arazera adhipati|’[sAjadAha]
sulAimAna valala- ‘ekhana Ami dekhava, tumi satya valecha, nA tumi mithyevAdI|
AmAra ei patra niYe yAo Ara eTA tAdera kAche arpaNa kara| ataHpara tAdera kAcha theke sare par3a tArapara dekha, tArA kI javAva deYa|’
sei nArI valala- ‘ohe sabhAsadagaNa! ei ye AmAke eka sammAnayogya patra deYA haYeche|
eTA sulAimAnera pakSa hate Ara tA ei: asIma dAtA, atIva daYAlu AllAhara nAme zuru,
AmAra prati uddhata haYo nA, anugata haYe AmAra kAche hAjira hao|
se valala, ohe sabhAsadarA! tomarA AmAra kartavya samparke AmAke siddhAnta dAo| tomAdera upasthiti vyatIta Ami kona vyApAre siddhAnta grahaNa karini|’
tArA valala- ‘AmarA zaktira adhikArI o kaThora yoddhA, kintu sindhAnta grahaNera adhikArI Apanii, kAjei cintA kare dekhuna, Apani kI Adeza karavena|’
se valala- ‘rAjArA yakhana kona janapade Dhuke takhana viparyaYa Deke Ane evaM tathAkAra sammAnita vyaktiderake apamAnita kare chAr3e Ara erAo tAi karave|
Ami tA~ra kAche upaDhaukana pAThAcchi, tArapara dekhi, dUterA kI (javAva) niYe Ase|’

ataHpara dUtarA yakhana sulAimAnera kAche Asala, sulAimAna valala- ‘tomarA ki AmAke sampada diYe sAhAyya karacha, kintu AllAha AmAke yA diYechena tA tomAderake yA diYechena tAra ceYe uttama, varaM tomarAi tomAdera upaDhaukana niYe Ananda kara|

tAdera kAche phire yAo, Ami avazya avazyai tAdera viruddhe eka senAvAhinI niYe Asava yAra mukAvAlA karAra zakti tAdera nei, Ami avazya avazyai tAderake apamAnita kare sekhAne theke vera kare deva Ara tArA have apadastha|’
sulAimAna valala- ‘he sabhAsadavarga! tArA AmAra kAche AtmasamarpaNa kare AsAra Age tomAdera madhye ke tAra siMhAsana AmAra nikaTa niYe Asave?’
eka zaktidhara jvina valala- ‘Apani ApanAra jAYagA theke uThavAra Age Ami tA ApanAra kAche ene deva, e kAje Ami avazyai kSamatAra adhikArI o AsthAbhAjana|

yAra kAche kitAvera (tAorAtera) jJAna chila se valala- ‘ApanAra dRSTi ApanAra dike phire AsAra pUrvei Ami tA ApanAra kAche ene deva|’ sulAimAna yakhana tA tAra sAmane rakSita dekhate pela takhana se valala- ‘eTA AmAra pratipAlakera anugraha, AmAke parIkSA karAra janya- Ami kRtajJatA prakAza kari, nA akRtajJa hai| ye kRtajJatA prakAza kare se nijera kalyANei kRtajJatA prakAza kare| Ara ye akRtajJa haYa (se jene rAkhuka), nizcaYai AmAra pratipAlaka abhAvamukta, maryAdAYa sarvazreSTha|’

sulAimAna valala- ‘tAra siMhAsanera AkRti vadale dAo, ataHpara AmarA dekhi, se (tAra nijera pau~chAra pUrvei AlaukikabhAve tAra siMhAsana sulAYamAnera daravAre rakSita dekhe satya) pathera dizA pAYa, nA yArA pathera dizA pAYa nA se tAdera antarbhukta|
yakhana se nArI Asala takhana tAke valA hala- ‘eTA ki tomAra siMhAsana?’ se valala, ‘eTA yena seTAi, AmAderake era Agei (ApanAra samparke) jJAna dAna karA haYeche Ara AmarA AtmasamarpaNa karechi|
AllAhara parivarte se yAra pUjA karata tAi tAke satya pathe calA theke vAdhA diYe rekhechila, se nArI chila kAphira sampradAYera antarbhukta|

tAke valA hala- ‘prAsAde praveza kara|’ yakhana se tA dekhala, se oTAke pAnira hrada mane karala evaM se tAra pAYera gochA khule phelala| sulAimAna valala- ‘eTA to svaccha kA~camanDita prAsAda| se nArI valala- he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami avazyai nijera prati yulama karechi Ara Ami sulAimAnera saGge vizvajagatera pratipAlaka AllAhara nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karachi|’
Ami sAmUda sampradAYera nikaTa tAdera bhAi sAlihake pAThiYechilAma (ei Adeza diYe ye) tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara| ataHpara tArA du’bhAga haYe giYe vitarke jar3iYe par3ala|
sAlih valala- ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA kalyANera pUrve druta akalyANa kAmanA karacha kena? tomarA kena AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara nA yAte tomarA rahamataprApta hao?’

tArA valala- AmarA tomAke Ara tomAra saGge yArA Ache tAderake akalyANera kAraNa va’le mane kari|’ se valala- ‘tomAdera akalyANa AllAhara nikaTa, varaM tomarA emana eka sampradAYa yAderake parIkSA karA hacche|’
Ara sei zahare chila naYa vyakti yArA deze phAsAda sRSTi karata Ara tArA saMzodhana karata nA|

tArA valala- ‘tomarA AllAhara nAme zapatha kara ye, tomarA rAtriyoge tAke Ara tAra parivAravargake avazya avazyai AkramaNa karave, ataHpara AmarA tAra abhibhAvakake avazya avazyai valava, AmarA tAra parivAravargera hatyAkAnDa pratyakSa karini| AmarA avazyai satyavAdI|’
tArA eka cakrAnta karechila Ara Amio eka kauzala avalamvana karechilAma, kintu tArA vujhate pAreni|
ataHpara dekha tAdera cakrAntera pariNati kemana haYechila? Amii tAderake o tAdera sampradAYake, sakalake dhvaMsa kare diYechilAma|
ei to tAdera gharadora sampUrNa ujAr3a, kAraNa tArA vAr3AvAr3i karechila| ete jJAnI sampradAYera janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|
Ara yArA ImAna enechila o (AllAhake) bhaYa karata tAderake rakSA karechilAma|
smaraNa kara lUtera kathA, se tAra sampradAYake valechila- tomarA dekhe-zune kena azlIla kAja karacha,
tomarA ki kAma Asakti miTAnora janya nArIdera vAda diYe puruSadera nikaTa gamana kara? tomarA emana eka jAti yArA mUrkhera AcaraNa karacha|
takhana tAra sampradAYera e kathA valA chAr3A Ara kona jaoYAva chila nA ye, tomAdera janapada theke lUtera parivAravargake vera kare dAo, erA emana loka yArA pavitra sAjate cAYa|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra parivAravargake rakSA karalAma, tAra strI vyatIta| Ami tAra bhAgya dhvaMsaprAptadera madhye nirdhAraNa karechilAma|
Ara Ami tAdera upara varSiYe chilAma eka bhaYaMkara vRSTi| bhIti pradarzitadera upara e vRSTi chila katai nA manda!
vala, yAvatIYa prazaMsA AllAharai janya evaM zAnti tA~ra manonIta vAndAgaNera prati| AllAha zreSTha, nA tA yAra zarIka kare tArA?

nAki tinii (zreSTha) yini sRSTi karechena AsamAnasamUha o pRthivI evaM tomAdera janya AkAza theke vRSTi varSaNa karena, ataHpara tA dvArA Ami manorama udyAnarAji udagata kari, tAra vRkSAdi udagata karAra kSamatA tomAdera nei| AllAhara sAthe anya kona ilAha Ache ki? varaM tArA hacche eka nyAYa-vicyuta sampradAYa|

nAki tinii (zreSTha) yini ei pRthivIke vAsayogya karechena Ara tAra phA~ke phA~ke nadInAlA pravAhita karechena, tAte sudRr3ha parvata saMsthApita karechena evaM du’ dariYAra mAjhe pArthakyakArI Ar3Ala sRSTi karechena; AllAhara sAthe anya kona ilAha Ache ki? varaM tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

nAki tinii (zreSTha) yini Artera AhavAne sAr3A dena yakhana se tA~ke DAke evaM duHkha-kaSTa dUra karena Ara tomAderake pRthivIra uttarAdhikArI karena? AllAhara saGge anya kona ilAh Ache ki? ati sAmAnya upadezai tomarA grahaNa kara|

nAki tinii (zreSTha) yini jala sthalera gabhIra andhakAre patha dekhAna evaM yini tA~ra (vRSTirUpI) anugrahera pUrvakSaNe zubhavArtAvAhI vAtAsa preraNa karena? AllAhara saGge anya kona ilAh Ache ki? tArA yAke (AllAhara) zarIka kare, AllAha tA theke aneka Urdhve|

nAki tinii (zreSTha) yini sRSTira sUcanA karena, ataHpara tAra punarAvRtti karena evaM yini tomAderake AsamAna o yamIna theke riyaka dAna karena? AllAhara sAthe anya kona ilAh Ache ki? vala, tomarA satyavAdI hale tomAdera pramANapaJji peza kara|
vala, AkAza o pRthivIte yArA Ache tArA keui adRzya viSaYera jJAna rAkhe nA AllAha chAr3A, Ara tArA jAne nA kakhana tAderake jIvita ka’re uThAno have|
varaM AkhirAta samparkita tAdera jJAnera sImA zeSa, varaM e vyApAre tArA sandehe Acchanna varaM e viSaYe tArA andha|
avizvAsIrA vale- AmarA Ara AmAdera pitRpuruSarA yakhana mATi haYe yAva tAraparao ki AmAderake nizcitai vera kare uThAno have?
e oYA‘dA AmAderake deYA haYeche, AmAderake evaM pUrve AmAdera pitRpuruSaderakeo; e sava pUrvakAlera kAhinI chAr3A kichui naYa|
vala, pRthivIte bhramaNa kara, ataHpara dekha aparAdhIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila|
tAdera janya duHkha kara nA, Ara tAdera cakrAntera kAraNe mane kaSTa nio nA|
tArA vale- ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI haYe thAka tAhale, e ‘oYAdA kakhana vAstavAYita have?
vala, tomarA yA pAoYAra janya tAr3Ahur3A karacha sambhavataH tAra kichu tomAdera piThera pechane ese geche|
tomAra pratipAlaka nizcaYai mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|
tomAra pratipAlaka avazyai jAnena tAdera antara yA gopana kare Ara yA prakAza kare|
AkAze Ara yamIne emana kona adRzya viSaYa nei yA suspaSTa kitAve nei|
nizcaYa e kuraAna segulora adhikAMza vivRta kare ye viSaYe vAnI isarAIla matabheda karechila|
Ara tA nizcitai mu’minadera janya saThika pathera dizArI o rahamata|
tomAra pratipAlaka tA~ra vidhAna anuyAYI tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare devena Ara tini pravala parAkrAnta, sarvajJAnera adhikArI|
kAjei tumi AllAhara upara nirbhara kara, tumi to suspaSTa satyera upara Acha|
tumi mRtaderake zunAte pArave nA, Ara vadhirakeo AhavAna zunAte pArave nA (vizeSataH) yakhana tArA piTha phiriYe cale yAYa|
Ara tumi andhakeo tAdera gumarAhI theke phiriYe AnAra janya satpatha dekhAte pArave nA| tumi kevala tAderakei zunAte pArave yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIte vizvAsa kare, kAjei tArA AtmasamarpaNa kare|

tAderake deYA pratizruti yakhana vAstave pariNata have, Ami takhana (kiYAmAta AgamaNera nirdazana hiseve) bhUmi theke tAdera janya ekaTi jantu vera karava yA tAdera saGge e kathA valave ye, mAnuSa AmAra nidarzanasamUhe vizvAsa karata nA|
yedina Ami pratyekaTi sampradAYa hate ekaTi dalake samaveta karava yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra karechila, ataHpara tAderake sArivaddha karA have|
yakhana tArA ese yAve takhana AllAha valavena- tomarA ki AmAra nidarzanake mithye vale pratyAkhyAna karechile yadio tA tomarA jJAnAYatta karate pArani; nAki tomarA anya kichu karachile?
tAderake deYA pratizruti vAstave ghaTe yAve tAdera anyAYa kAryakalApera kAraNe Ara tArA (tAdera pakSe) kona kathA valate pArave nA|
tArA ki lakSya kare nA ye, Ami rAta vAniYechi yAte tArA tAte ArAma karate pAre Ara dinake karechi Alo dAnakArI? vizvAsI sampradAYera janya avazyai ete nidarzana Ache|

Ara ye dina ziGgAYa phu~ deYA have sedina yArA AkAze Ache Ara yArA yamIne Ache tArA bhIta-santrasta haYe par3ave, tave AllAha yAdera janya icche karavena tArA vAde| savAi tA~ra kAche Asave vinaYe avanata haYe|

tumi parvataguloke dekha Ara mane kara tA acala, kintu segulo calamAna have yemana meghamAlA cale| eTA AllAhara sRSTi naipuNya, yini sava kichuke karechena yathAyatha| tomarA yA kichu kara se samparke tini sampUrNarUpe avagata|
yArA satkAja niYe upasthita have, tAdera janya Ache utkRSTatara pratidAna, sedina tArA bhIti zaGkA theke nirApada thAkave|
yArA asatkarma niYe hAjira have, tAderake mukhera bhare Agune nikSepa karA have, (Ara tAderake valA have) tomarA yA karate kevala tArai pratidAna tomAderake deYA hacche|

Ami nirdezita haYechi ei (makkA) nagarIra pratipAlakera ‘ivAdAta karAra janya yini tAke (arthAt ei nagarIke) sammAnita karechena| sakala vastu tA~rai, Ara Ami AdiSTa haYechi Ami yena (AllAhara nikaTa) AtmasamarpaNakArIdera antarbhukta hai|
Ara Ami yena kuraAna tilAoYAta kari| ataHpara ye saThika pathe calave, se nijera kalyANei saThika pathe calave| Ara keu gumarAh hale tumi vala, Ami to satarkakArIdera ekajana|
Ara vala, yAvatIYa prazaMsA AllAharai| tini zIghrai tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanagulo dekhAvena Ara tA tomarA cinate pArave| tomarA yA kara se samparke tomAra pAlanakartA amanoyogI nana|
tA-sIna-mIma,
egulo suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
Ami mUsA o phiraAunera kAhinI hate kichu tomAra kAche satyikArabhAve vivRta karachi vizvAsI sampradAya়era uddezye|

vastutaH pherAuna deze uddhata haYe giYechila Ara sekhAnakAra adhivAsIderake vibhinna zreNIte vibhakta kare tAdera ekaTi zreNIke durvala kare rekhechila, tAdera putraderake se hatyA karata Ara tAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhata; se chila phAsAda sRSTikArI|
deze yAderake durvala kare rAkhA haYechila Ami tAdera prati anugraha karAra icche karalAma, Ara tAderake netA o uttarAdhikArI karAra (icche karalAma)|
Ara (icche karalAma) tAderake deze pratiSThita karate, Ara pherAuna, hAmAna o tAdera sainya vAhinIke dekhiYe dite yA tArA tAdera (arthAt mUsAra sampradAYera) theke AzaGkA karata|

Ami mUsAra mAYera prati oYAhI karalAma ye, tAke stanya pAna karAte thAka| yakhana tumi tAra samparke AzaGkA karave, takhana tumi tAke dariYAYa nikSepa karave, Ara tumi bhaYa karave nA, duHkhao karave nA, Ami tAke avazyai tomAra kAche phiriYe deva Ara tAke rasUladera ekajana karava|
ataHpara pherAunera lokajana tAke uThiYe nila yAte se tAdera janya zatru hate o duHkhera kAraNa hate pAre| pherAuna, hAmAna o tAdera vAhinIra lokerA to chila aparAdhI|

pherAUnera strI valala- ‘e zizu AmAra o tomAra cakSu zItalakArI, tAke hatyA kara nA, se AmAdera upakAre lAgate pAre athavA tAke AmarA putra hiseveo grahaNa karate pAri Ara tArA kichui vujhate pArala nA (tAdera e kAjera pariNAma kI)|
mUsAra mAYera antara vicalita haYe uThala| se to tAra paricaYa prakAza karei phelata yadi nA Ami tAra cittake dRr3ha karatAma yAte se AsthAzIla haYa|
mUsAra mA mUsAra vonake valala- ‘tAra pichane pichane yAo|’ se dUra theke tAke dekhachila kintu tArA Tera pAYani|

Age theke Ami tAke dhAtrI-stanya pAna theke virata rekhechilAma| mUsAra vona valala- ‘Ami ki tomAderake emana ekaTA parivArera kho~ja deva yArA tAke tomAdera pakSe lAlana pAlana karave Ara tArA have tAra hitAkAGkSI|’
ebhAve Ami tAke tAra mAYera kAche phiriYe AnalAma yAte tAra cokha jur3AYa, se duHkha nA kare Ara jAnate pAre ye, AllAhara o‘YAdA satya; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa tA jAne nA|
mUsA yakhana yauvane padArpaNa karala Ara pUrNa pariNata hala, takhana Ami tAke hikamata o jJAna dAna karalAma; Ami satkarmazIladerake ebhAvei puraskRta kare thAki|

se zahare praveza karala yakhana sekhAnera lokerA asatarka avasthAYa chila| takhana se du’jana lokake saMgharSarata avasthAYa pela| ekajana tAra dalera, aparajana tAra zatrudalera| takhana tAra dalera lokaTi tAra zatrudalera lokaTira viruddhe tAra kAche sAhAyyera Avedana jAnAlo| takhana mUsA tAke ghusi mArala evaM hatyA kare phelala| mUsA valala- ‘eTA zaYatvAnera kAja| se nizcaYa prakAzya zatru, gumarAhakArI|’
se valala- ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami nijera AtmAra upara yulama karechi, ataeva AmAke kSamA kara|’ ataHpara AllAha tAke kSamA karalena, avazyai tini kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|
mUsA valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi yehetu AmAra upara anugraha karecha, kAjei Ami kakSano pApIdera sAhAyyakArI hava nA|’

zahare tAra sakAla hala bhIta-santrasta avasthAYa| haThAt se zunala ye lokaTi gatakAla tAra kAche sAhAyya ceYechila (AvAra) se sAhAyyera janya cItkAra karache| mUsA tAke valala- ‘tumi prakAzyai ekajana veokupha loka|

ataHpara mUsA yakhana ubhaYera zatruke dharate udyata hala, takhana se valala- ‘ohe mUsA! tumi ki AmAke hatyA karate cAo yebhAve gatakAla ekaTA lokake hatyA karecha, tumi to pRthivIte svecchAcArI hate cAccha, saMzodhanakArIdera madhye gaNya hate cAccha nA|’
nagarera prAnta hate eka loka chuTe Asala| se valala- ‘he mUsA! pAriSadagaNa tomAke hatyAra parAmarza karache, kAjei tumi vAire cale yAo, Ami tomAra hitAkAGkSI|
takhana mUsA bhIta-santrasta avasthAYa sekhAna theke veriYe par3ala satarkatAra saGge| se valala, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke yAlima goSThI hate rakSA kara|’
yakhana se mAdaiYAna abhimukhI hala, se valala- ‘AzA kari AmAra pAlanakartA AmAke sarala sojA patha dekhAvena|’

yakhana se mAdaiYAnera kUpera kAche pau~chala, se ekadala lokake dekhala (tAdera jantuguloke) pAni pAna karAte, tAdera chAr3A Aro du’jana strIlokake dekhala (nijedera pazuguloke) Agale rAkhate| mUsA jijJesa karala- ‘tomAdera du’janera vyApAra kI?’ tArA valala- ‘AmarA AmAdera jantuguloke pAna karAte pAri nA yatakSaNa nA rAkhAlerA (tAdera pazuguloke) sariYe nA neYa (pAni pAna karAnora para), Ara AmAdera pitA khuvai vaYovRddha|

takhana mUsA tAdera janya pazuguloke pAni pAna kariYe dila, ataHpara pechana phire chAYAYa giYe vasala, ataHpara valala- ‘he AmAra pAlanakartA! tumi AmAra prati ye anugrahai karave Ami to tArai bhikhArI|’

takhana nArIdvaYera ekajana tAra kAche salajja pade Asala| se valala- ‘AmAra pitA tomAke DAkache tumi AmAdera janya (jantuguloke) pAni pAna kariYecha tomAke tAra pratidAna deYAra janya| yakhana mUsA tAra kAche gela Ara tAra kAche sakala ghaTanA vivRta karala, se valala- tumi bhaYa karo nA, ‘tumi yAlima goSThIra theke rehAi peYe gecha|’
