strIloka du’Tira ekajana valala- ‘he pitA! pArizramikera vinimaYe tAke niyukta karuna, Apani yAderake majura niyukta karavena tAdera madhye uttama ye zaktizAlI, vizvasta|’

se valala- ‘AmAra ei kanyAdvaYera ekajanera saGge tomAra viYe deYAra Ami icche karechi ei zarte ye, tumi ATa vachara AmAra kAja kare deve, Ara yadi daza vachara pUrNa kara seTA tomAra icchedhIna, Ami tomAke kaSTe phelate cAi nA, AllAha icche karale tumi AmAke satkarmaparAYaNa pAve|’
mUsA valala- AmAra o ApanAra madhye ei cukti raila, Ami du’Ti meYAdera yeTii pUrNa kari nA kena, AmAra viruddhe kona abhiyoga karA have nA, AmarA ye kathA valachi, AllAha tAra sAkSI|

ataHpara mUsA yakhana meYAda pUrNa ka’re tAra parivAra niYe yAtrA karala, takhana se tUra parvatera dike Aguna dekhate pela| se tAra parivAravargake valala- ‘tomarA apekSA kara, Ami Aguna dekhechi, Ami tomAdera janya sekhAna theke khavara Anate pAri kiMvA jvalanta kASThakhanDa Anate pAri yAte tomarA Aguna pohAte pAra|’
mUsA yakhana Agunera kAche pau~chala takhana pavitra bhUmite avasthita upatyakAra DAna dike vRkSa theke tAke AhavAna diYe valA hala- ‘he mUsA! Amii AllAha, jagatasamUhera pAlanakartA|’

Ara (valA hala) ‘tomAra lAThi nikSepa kara|’ ataHpara yakhana se seTAke dekhala chuTAchuTi karate yena oTA ekaTA sApa, takhana pechanera dike daur3a dila, phireo tAkAla nA| (takhana tAke valA hala) ‘ohe mUsA! sAmane eso, bhaYa karo nA, tumi nirApada|’

tomAra hAta tomAra vagale rAkha, tA doSamukta jyotirmaYa haYe veriYe Asave, bhaYa theke rakSArthe tomAra hAta tomAra upara cepe dhara| e du’Ti hala pherAuna o tAra pAriSadavargera janya tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke pramANa, nizcaYa tArA pApAcArI sampradAYa|’
mUsA valala- ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami tAdera ekajanake hatyA karechi, kAjei Ami AzaGkA karachi tArA AmAke hatyA karave|’
Ara AmAra bhAi hArUna AmAra ceYe prAJjalabhASI, kAjei tAke tumi sAhAyyakArIrUpe AmAra saGge preraNa kara, se AmAke samarthana jAnAve| Ami AzaGkA karachi tArA AmAke mithye vale pratyAkhyAna karave|’

AllAha valalena- ‘Ami tomAra bhrAtAra mAdhyame tomAra hAtake zaktizAlI karava evaM tomAderake pramANapaJji dAna karava, yAra phale tArA tomAdera kAche pau~chatei pArave nA| AmAra nidarzana vale tomarA evaM tomAdera anusArIrAi vijaYI thAkave|
mUsA yakhana tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzana niYe Asala, tArA valala- eto alIka yAdu mAtra, AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera yAmAnAYa e savera kathA to zunini|
mUsA valala- ‘AmAra pratipAlaka veza bhAla ka’rei jAnena ke tA~ra nikaTa theke patha nirdeza niYe eseche evaM kAra pariNAma AkhirAte zubha have| yAlimarA kakSano sAphalya lAbha karave nA|’

phiraAuna valala- ‘he pAriSadavarga! Ami chAr3A tomAdera kona ilAha Ache vale Ami jAni nA| kAjei ohe hAmAna! tumi AmAra janya iTa por3Ao, ataHpara AmAra janya ekaTi prAsAda nirmANa kara yAte Ami mUsAra ilAhake dekhate pAri, AmAra nizcita dhAraNA ye, se ekajana mithyevAdI|’
pherAuna o tAra vAhinI akAraNe pRthivIte ahaMkAra karechila Ara tArA bhevechila ye, tAderake AmAra kAche phiriYe AnA have nA|
kAjei Ami tAke o tAra vAhinIke pAkar3Ao karalAma, ataHpara tAderake samudre nikSepa karalAma| ekhana dekha, yAlimadera pariNati kI haYechila|
Ami tAderake netA karechilAma| tArA jAhAnnAmera dike AhavAna karata, kviYAmatera dina tArA sAhAyyaprApta have nA|
e pRthivIte tAdera pechane Ami lAgiYe diYechi abhisampAta Ara kviYAmatera dina tArA have durdazAgrasta
Ami pUrvavartI aneka mAnava goSThIke dhvaMsa karAra para mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma- mAnuSera janya AlokavartikA, satyapathera nirdeza o rahamatasvarUpa yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
mUsAke yakhana Ami nirdezanAmA diYechilAma takhana tumi (tUoYA upatyakAra) pazcima prAnte chile nA, Ara chile nA tumi pratyakSadarzI|

kintu Ami aneka mAnavagoSThI sRSTi karechilAma, ataHpara tAdera aneka yuga gata haYe geche| tumi mAdaiYAnavAsIdera madhye vidyamAna chile nA tAdera kAche AmAra AYAta AvRtti karAra janya, kintu (tAdera mAjhe) rasUla preraNakArI Amii chilAma|

Ami yakhana (mUsAke) DAka diYechilAma takhana tumi tUra parvatera pAze chile nA| kintu (tomAke pAThAno haYeche) tomAra pratipAlakera rahamatasvarUpa yAte tumi emana ekaTi sampradAYake satarka karate pAra yAdera kAche tomAra pUrve satarkakArI pAThAno haYani, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

rasUla nA pAThAle tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe kona vipada hale tArA valata- ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera kAche rasUla pAThAle nA kena, pAThAle tomAra AYAtasamUhera anusaraNa karatAma Ara AmarA mu’mina haYe yetAma|’

ataHpara AmAra nikaTa theke tAdera kAche yakhana satya Asala takhana tArA valala- ‘mUsAke yA deYA haYechila tAke kena serUpa deYA hala nA? itopUrve mUsAke yA deYA haYechila tArA ki tA asvIkAra kareni?’ tArA valechila- ‘du’Toi yAdu, ekaTA ArekaTAra sahAYatAkArI| Ara tArA valechila AmarA (tAorAta o kuraAna) savai pratyAkhyAna kari|’
vala, tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tave AllAhara nikaTa hate emana kitAva niYe eso yA satyapatha nirdeza karAra vyApAre e du’ (kitAva) hate adhika utkRSTa, Ami se kitAvera anusaraNa karava|

ataHpara tArA yadi tomAra kathAYa sAr3A nA deYa tAhale jene rekha, tArA zudhu tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa kare| AllAhara patha nirdeza chAr3Ai ye nijera pravRttira anusaraNa kare, tAra ceYe adhika pathabhraSTa Ara ke Ache? AllAha yAlima sampradAYake saThika pathe paricAlita karena nA|
Ami tAdera kAche kramAgata vANI pau~che diYechi yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
era pUrve Ami yAderake kitAva diYechilAma tArA (arthAt tAdera kataka loka) tAte vizvAsa kare|
tAdera nikaTa yakhana tA AvRtti karA haYa takhana tArA vale- AmarA ete vizvAsa kari, e satya AmAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa theke (Agata), era pUrvei AmarA AtmasamarpaNakArI chilAma|
tAderake tAdera pArizramika du’vAra deYA have yehetu tArA dhairya dhAraNa kareche evaM tArA bhAla diYe mandera pratihata kare Ara Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi tAttheke tArA vyaYa kare|

tArA yakhana nirarthaka kathAvArtA zune takhana tAttheke phire thAke Ara vale- AmAdera kAjera phala AmarA pAva, tomAdera kAjera phala tomarA pAve, tomAdera prati sAlAma, ajJadera sAthe AmAdera kona praYojana nei|
tumi yAke bhAlavAsa tAke satpatha dekhAte pArave nA, varaM AllAhi yAke cAna sat pathe paricAlita karena, satpathaprAptadera tini bhAla karei jAnena|

tArA vale- ‘AmarA yadi tomAra sAthe satpathera anusaraNa kari tAhale AmarA AmAdera deza theke utkhAta hava|’ Ami ki tAdera janya eka nirApada ‘hArAma’ pratiSThita karini yekhAne sarvaprakAra phalamUlera najarAnA Ase AmAra pakSa theke riyaka svarUpa? kintu tAdera adhikAMzai tA jAne nA|

Ami kata janapadake dhvaMsa karechi yArA tAdera (bhogavilAsapUrNa) jIvane carama utkarSa sAdhana karechila| ei to tAdera vAsasthAna, tAdera para egulote khuva alpa lokai vasavAsa kareche, avazeSe Amii mAlika raYechi|

tomAra pratipAlaka kona janapada dhvaMsa karena nA, yatakSaNa nA tini tAra kendre rasUla preraNa nA karena ye tAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha AvRtti kare; Ami kona janapadake dhvaMsa kari nA yatakSaNa nA tAra vAsindArA atyAcArI haYa|
tomAderake ye sava vastu deYA haYeche tA pArthiva jIvanera bhogyavastu o tAra zobhA mAtra| Ara AllAhara nikaTa yA kichu Ache tA sarvazreSTha o cirasthAYI, tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?

Ami yAke o‘YAdA diYechi, kalyANera o‘YAdA Ara seTA se pAveo, se ki ai vyaktira samAna yAke Ami pArthiva jIvanera bhoga-sambhAra diYechi, ataHpara kviYAmatera dina tAke hAjira karA have (aparAdhIrUpe)?
sedina tAderake DAka diYe tini valavena- ‘yAderake tomarA AmAra zarIka gaNya karate tArA kothAYa?’

yAdera viruddhe abhiyoga pramANita have tArA valave- ‘he AmAdera pAlanakartA! oderake AmarA vibhrAnta karechilAma, oderake vibhrAnta karechilAma, yemana AmarA nijerA vibhrAnta haYechilAma, AmarA tomAra kAche dAYamukta hacchi (ye AmarA jora ka’re tAderake vibhrAnta karini)| erA to AmAdera ‘ivAdAta karata nA|
tAderake valA have, ‘tomAdera devatAguloke DAka, takhana tArA tAderake DAkave’| kintu tArA tAdera DAke sAr3A dive nA| tArA zAsti dekhate pAve (tAdera sAmane)| tArA yadi satpathaprApta hata!
Ara sedina AllAha tAderake DAka divena evaM valavena- ‘tomarA rasUladerake kI jaoYAva diYechile?’
se dina tAdera kathA vandha haYe yAve, ataHpara parasparake jijJAsAvAdao karate pArave nA|
kintu ye vyakti (tAra jIvane) tAovAha karechila Ara ImAna enechila Ara satkAja karechila, AzA karA yAYa se sAphalyamanDitadera antarbhukta have|
tomAra pratipAlaka yA icche sRSTi karena Ara yAke icche manonIta karena| ete tAdera kona ekhatiYAra nei, AllAha pavitra, mahAna| tArA yAke zarIka kare tAttheke tini vahu Urdhve|
tomAra pratipAlaka jAnena tAdera antara yA gopana kare Ara yA prakAza kare|
Ara tinii AllAha, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAh nei, samasta prazaMsA tA~rai- prathameo Ara zeSeo, vidhAna tA~rai, Ara tomAderake tA~ra dikei phiriYe neYA have|

tomarA ki bheve dekhecha AllAha yadi tomAdera upara rAtake kviYAmatera dina paryanta sthAYI karatena tAhale AllAha chAr3A kona ilAh Ache ki ye tomAderake Alo ene dita? tavuo ki tomarA karNapAta karave nA?

tomarA ki bheve dekhecha AllAha yadi tomAdera upara dinake kviYAmatera dina paryanta sthAYI karatena tAhale AllAha chAr3A kona ilAh Ache ki ye tomAdera janya rAtri ene dita yAte tomarA ArAma karate? tomarA ki cintA kare dekhave nA?
tinii svIYa rahamate tomAdera janya rAta o dina karechena yAte tomarA tAte ArAma karate pAra Ara tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
sedina tini tAderake DAka divena evaM valavena- ‘tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka mane karate tArA kothAYa?’

Ami pratyeka sampradAYa theke ekajana sAkSI vera kare Anava, ataHpara valava- ‘tomAdera (nirdoSitAra pakSe) pramANa hAjira kara| takhana tArA jAnate pArave ye, ilAha haoYAra adhikAra AllAharai Ara tArA yA udbhAvana karata tA tAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe yAve|

kArUna chila mUsAra sampradAYabhukta, kintu se tAdera prati uddhata AcaraNa karechila| tAke Ami emana dhanabhAnDAra diYechilAma ye, tAra cAvigulo vahana karA mAtra ekadala valavAna lokera pakSe kaSTakara chila| smaraNa kara yakhana tAra sampradAYa tAke valechila (dhanera) garva karo nA, AllAha garvitaderake bhAlavAsena nA|

AllAha tomAke yA diYechena tA diYe tumi AkhirAte (sthAYI sukhabhogera) AvAsa anusandhAna kara, Ara duniYAYa tomAra aMzera kathA bhule yeo nA, (mAnuSera) kalyANa sAdhana kara, yemana AllAha tomAra kalyANa karechena, deze viparyaYa sRSTira kAmanA kara nA, nizcaYa AllAha viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera bhAlavAsena nA|

se valala- ‘e sampada to AmAke deYA haYeche yehetu AmAra kAche jJAna Ache|’ se ki jAne nA ye, AllAha tAra pUrve aneka mAnava goSThIke dhvaMsa kare diYechena yArA zaktite tAra ceYe chila pravala Ara janasaMkhyAYa chila adhika? aparAdhIderake (tAdera aparAdha samparke mukhe) kichui jijJesa karA have nA|

kArUna zAna-zaokAtera sAthe tAra sampradAYera sAmane hAjira hala| yArA pArthiva jIvana kAmanA kare tArA vale uThala- ‘hAYa! kArUnake yA deYA haYeche AmAdera janyao yadi tA hata! satyai se mahA bhAgyavAna vyakti|’

yAderake jJAna deYA haYechila tArA valala- ‘dhika tomAdera prati, AllAhara puraskArai zreSThatara tAdera janya yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare, Ara satyapathe avicala dhairyazIla chAr3A anya keu tA prApta haYa nA|
ataHpara Ami bhUgarbhe prothita karalAma kArUnake o tAra prAsAdake| AllAhara vyatIta tAke sAhAyya karAra kona dala chila nA, Ara se nijeo nijeke rakSA karate pArala nA|

gatakAla yArA tAra maryAdAra nyAYa kAmanA karechila tArA sakale valate lAgala, ‘hAYa, AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera yAra janya icche riyaka vardhita karena Ara yAra janya icche hrAsa karena| AllAha yadi AmAdera prati anugraha nA karatena tave tini AmAderakeo bhUgarbhe prothita kare ditena| hAYa! avizvAsIrA sAphalyamanDita haYa nA|
sei AkhirAtera ghara Ami tAdera janya karechi yArA pRthivIra vuke auddhatya prakAza o viparyaYa sRSTi karate cAYa nA| zubha pariNAma AllAhabhIrudera janya|
ye keu satkarma niYe hAjira have tAra janya Ache Aro uttama pratidAna| Ara ye manda kAja niYe hAjira have tAhale yArA mandakarma kare tAderake tAdera kAja anupAtei zAsti deYA have|

yini tomAra prati kuraAna vidhivaddha karechena tini avazyai tomAke mUlabhUmite (mAkkAYa) phiriYe Anavena| vala, AmAra pratipAlaka bhAla karei jAnena ke satpathera nirdeza niYe eseche Ara ke Ache suspaSTa gumarAhIte|
tumi to pratyAzA karani ye, tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa karA have| eTA tomAra pratipAlakera rahamata vizeSa| kAjei tumi kakSano kAphiradera samarthanakArI haYo nA|
tomAra prati AllAhara AYAta nAyila haoYAra para tArA yena tomAke tAttheke kakSano vimukha nA karate pAre| tumi tomAra pratipAlakera dike AhavAna jAnAo, Ara kichutei muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
AllAhara saGge anya kona ilAhake Deko nA, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, tA~ra (sattA) chAr3A sakala kichui dhvaMsazIla| vidhAna tA~rai, Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe AnA have|
Alipha-lAma-mIma
lokerA ki mane kare ye ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’ valalei tAderake avyAhati diYe deYA have, Ara tAderake parIkSA karA have nA?
tAdera pUrve yArA chila Ami tAderake parIkSA karechilAma; ataHpara AllAha avazya avazyai jene nevena kArA satyavAdI Ara kArA mithyevAdI|
yArA manda kAja kare tArA ki bheve niYeche ye, tArA AmAra Age ver3e yAve? tAdera phaYasAlA var3ai khArApa!
ye vyakti AllAhara sAkSAtera AkAGkSA kare (se jene rAkhuka ye) AllAhara nirdhArita kAla avazyai Asave, tini sava kichu zonena, sava kichu jAnena|
ye loka (AllAhara pathe) sarvAtmaka praceSTA cAlAYa, se tAra nijera kalyANei praceSTA cAlAYa, AllAha sRSTijagata theke avazyai ve-paraoYA|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane Ara sat kAja kare, Ami avazya avazyai tAdera manda kAjaguloke muche deva, Ara tAderake avazya avazyai pratidAna deva tAdera utkRSTa kAjagulora anupAte yA tArA karata|

pitA-mAtAra prati sadvyavahAra karAra janya Ami mAnuSera prati pharamAna jAri karechi| tArA yadi tomAra upara valapraYoga kare AmAra saGge zarIka karAra janya emana kichuke ye samparke tomAra kona jJAna nei, tAhale tumi tAderake mAnya kara nA| AmAra kAchei tomAdera pratyAvartana, ataHpara Ami tomAderake jAniYe deva yA tomarA karachile|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare Ami avazya avazyai tAderake satkarmazIladera antarbhukta karava|

mAnuSera madhye kataka Ache yArA vale ‘AmarA AllAhara prati ImAna enechi|’ ataHpara tAderake yakhana AllAhara pathe kaSTa deYA haYa, takhana tArA mAnuSera utpIr3anake AllAhara ‘AyAvera mata mane kare| Ara yadi (tomAra kAche) tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke sAhAyya Ase takhana tArA avazya avazyai vale ye, ‘AmarA to (sava samaYa) tomAdera sAthei chilAma| sakala sRSTira antare kI Ache se samparke AllAha ki sarvAdhika avagata nana?
AllAha avazya avazyai jene nevena kArA ImAna eneche Ara avazya avazyai jene nevena kArA munAphika|
kAphirarA mu’minaderake vale, ‘AmAdera patha anusaraNa kara, AmarA tomAdera pApera vojhA vahana karava, mUlataH tArA tAdera pApera kichui vahana karave nA, avazyai tArA mithyevAdI|

tArA avazya avazyai tAdera nijedera pApera vojhA vahana karave, nijedera vojhAra sAthe Aro vojhA, Ara tArA ye sava mithye udbhAvana karata se samparke kviYAmata divase tArA avazya avazyai jijJAsita have|

Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera kAche pAThiYechilAma, ataHpara se paJcAza vachara kama hAjAra vachara tAdera mAjhe avasthAna karechila| ataHpara mahAplAvana tAderake grAsa karala kAraNa tArA chila sImAlaGghanakArI|
ataHpara Ami tAke o naukArohIderake rakSe karalAma Ara eTAke karalAma vizvajagatera janya nidarzana|
smaraNa kara yakhana ivarAhIma tAra sampradAYake valechila- ‘tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara Ara tA~ke bhaYa kara| eTAi tomAdera janya kalyANakara, tomarA yadi jAnate!

tomarA AllAhake vAda diYe pratimAra pUjA karacha Ara tomarA mithye udbhAvana karacha| AllAhake vAda diYe tomarA ye savagulora pUjA karacha tArA tomAderake riyaka dAnera kona kSamatA rAkhe nA, kAjei tomarA AllAhara nikaTa riyaka tAlAza kara, Ara tA~rai ‘ivAdAta kara, Ara tA~rai prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara, tomAderake tA~rai dike phiriYe neYA have|
tomarA yadi (rAsUlake) mithye vale asvIkAra kara tave tomAdera pUrvera vaMzAvalIo asvIkAra karechila, suspaSTabhAve pracAra karA vyatIta rasUlera upara kona dAYitva nei|
tArA ki lakSya kare nA ye, AllAha kIbhAve sRSTira sUcanA karena ataHpara tAra punarAvartana ghaTAna, nizcaYa eTA AllAhara janya sahaja|
vala- ‘tomarA pRthivIte bhramaNa kara, ataHpara lakSya kara kIbhAve AllAha sRSTira sUcanA karechena, ataHpara AllAha sRSTi karavena paravartI sRSTi, AllAha sakala viSaYera upara kSamatAvAna|
yAke icche tini zAsti dena Ara yAra prati icche tini rahamata varSaNa karena Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neYA have|
tomarA (AllAhake) nA pRthivIte vyartha karate pArave Ara nA AkAze, AllAha chAr3A tomAdera janya nei kona abhibhAvaka, nei kona sAhAyyakArI|
yArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIke Ara tA~ra sAkSAtke asvIkAra kare, tArA AmAra rahamata theke nirAza have Ara tAdera janya Ache bhaYAvaha zAsti|

ataHpara ivarAhImera sampradAYera e kathA valA chAr3A kona jaoYAva chila nA ye, tAke hatyA kara athavA tAke agnidagdha kara|’ ataHpara AllAha tAke agni theke rakSA karalena| ete vizvAsI sampradAYera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|

ivarAhIma valala- tomarA AllAhake vAda diYe pratimAguloke (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa karecha pArthiva jIvane tomAdera pArasparika bhAlavAsA rakSAra uddezye| ataHpara kviYAmatera dina tomAdera eke aparake asvIkAra karave Ara eke aparake abhizApa dive, tomAdera ThikAnA have jAhAnnAma Ara tomAdera thAkave nA kona sAhAyyakArI|
ataHpara lUta tAra (arthAt ivarAhImera) prati ImAna enechila| ivarAhIma valala- Ami AmAra pAlanakartAra uddezye deza tyAga karachi, tini mahAparAkrAnta, var3ai hikamataoYAlA|

Ami tAke dAna karechilAma isahAkva o iYA‘kuva, tAra vaMzadharadera janya sthira karechilAma navUoYAta o kitAva, Ara tAke pratidAna diYechilAma duniYAte, evaM AkhirAteo avazyai se satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|
smaraNa kara lUtera kathA, yakhana se tAra sampradAYake valechila- avazyai tomarA emana eka azlIla kAja karacha yA tomAdera pUrve vizvajagate keu kareni|

tomarA (kAma-tAr3ita haYe) puruSadera kAche yAo, rAhAjAni kara evaM nijedera majalise ghRNya karma kara| tAra sampradAYera e kathA valA chAr3A kona jaoYAva chila nA ye, tumi satyavAdI hale AmAdera upara AllAhara ‘AyAva niYe eso|
se valala- he AmAra pratipAlaka! phAsAda sRSTikArI sampradAYera viruddhe AmAke sAhAyya kara|
yakhana AmAra dUtagaNa (arthAt pherezatArA) ivrAhImera kAche susaMvAda niYe Asala, tArA valala- AmarA e janapadera vAsindAdera dhvaMsa karava, era adhivAsIrA to yAlima|

ivarAhIma valala- okhAne to lUta Ache| tArA valala- okhAne kArA Ache AmarA tA bhAla karei jAni, AmarA tAke Ara tAra parivAravargake avazya avazyai rakSA karava tAra strIke chAr3A, se dhvaMsaprAptadera antarbhukta|

AmAra dUtarA yakhana lUtera kAche Asala takhana se tAdera janya viSaNNa haYe par3ala evaM (tAdera rakSAra vyApAre) nijeke asahAYa mane karala| takhana tArA valala- tomarA bhaYa kara nA, duHkha kara nA, AmarA tomAke Ara tomAra parivAravargake rakSA karava tomAra strIke chAr3A, se dhvaMsaprAptadera antarbhukta|
AmarA e janapadera vAsindAdera upara AsamAnI zAsti nAyila karava, kAraNa tArA chila pApAcAre lipta|
ete Ami jJAnI sampradAYera janya eka suspaSTa nidarzana rekhe diYechi|
mAdaiYAnera vAsindAdera kAche Ami tAdera bhAi zu‘AYavake pAThiYechilAma| se valala- he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, zeSa divasake bhaYa kara, pRthivIte phAsAda sRSTi kara nA|
kintu tArA tAke mithye va’le asvIkAra karala, ataHpara mahA kampana tAderake pAkar3Ao karala Ara tArA nijedera gRhe upur3a haYe zeSa haYe gela|

(smaraNa kara) ‘Ada o sAmUda (jAtira) kathA, tAdera vAr3Ighara hatei tAdera (karuNa pariNati) samparke suspaSTarUpe tomAdera jAnA haYe geche| tAdera kAjaguloke zaYatvAna tAdera dRSTite manomugdhakara karechila| yAra phale satpathe calate tAderake vAdhA diYechila, yadio tArA chila tIkSNa dRSTira adhikArI|
(smaraNa kara) kArUna, pherAuna o hAmAnera kathA| mUsA tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzana niYe esechila, ataHpara tArA pRthivIte ahaMkAra karala, kintu tArA (AmAke pechane phele) Age ver3e yete pAreni|

odera pratyekakei Ami tAra pApera kAraNe pAkar3Ao karechilAma| tAdera kAro prati Ami pAThiYechilAma pAtharasaha jhaTikA, kAro prati AghAta henechila vajrera pracanDa AoYAja, kAuke Ami prothita karechi bhUgarbhe Ara kAuke diYechilAma DuviYe| tAdera prati AllAha kona yulama karenani, tArA nijerAi nijedera prati yulama karechila|
yArA AllAhake vAda diYe anyaderake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kareche tAdera dRSTAnta hala mAkar3asAra mata| se ghara vAnAYa, Ara gharera madhye mAkar3asAra gharai savaceYe durvala; yadi tArA jAnata!
tArA AllAhara parivarte yA kichuke DAke AllAha tA jAnena, tini mahAparAkrAnta, mahAprajJAmaYa|
e sava dRSTAnta Ami mAnuSadera janya varNanA karachi, kevala jJAnIrAi tA vujhe|
AsamAnasamUha Ara pRthivIke AllAha uddezya sAdhanera upayogI ka’re sRSTi karechena, ete vizvAsIdera janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|

tomAra prati yA oYAhI karA haYeche kitAva theke tA pATha kara Ara nAmAya pratiSThA kara; nAmAya azlIla o manda kAja hate virata rAkhe| nizcaYai AllAhara smaraNai sarvazreSTha (viSaYa)| tomarA yA kara AllAha tA jAnena|

uttama panthA chAr3A kitAvadhArIdera sAthe tarka- vitarka kara nA; tave tAdera madhye yArA vAr3AvAr3i kare tArA vAde| Ara vala, AmarA ImAna enechi AmAdera prati yA nAyila haYeche Ara tomAdera prati yA nAyila haYeche tAra upara; AmAdera ilAha o tomAdera ilAha ekai, Ara tA~ra kAchei AmarA AtmasamarpaNa karechi|

(pUrve yebhAve nAyila karechilAma) ebhAvei Ami tomAra prati kitAva (kuraAna) nAyila karechi| kAjei Ami yAderake kitAva diYechilAma tArA tAte vizvAsa kare, Ara tAderao (arthAt makkAra muzarikaderao) kataka tAte vizvAsa sthApana kare, avizvAsIrA chAr3A AmAra nidarzanAvalIke keu asvIkAra kare nA|
tumi to era pUrve kona kitAva pATha karani, Ara tumi nija hAte kona kitAva lekhani, emana hale mithyAvAdIrA sandeha poSaNa karata|
varaM yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche tAdera antare tA (kuraAna) eka suspaSTa nidarzana| anyAYakArIrA chAr3A AmAra nidarzanAvalIke keu asvIkAra kare nA
tArA vale- tAra kAche tAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate kona nidarzana avatIrNa haYa nA kena? vala, nidarzana to Ache AllAhara kAche, Ami kevala ekajana suspaSTa satarkakArI|
eTA ki tAdera janya yatheSTa (nidarzana) naYa ye, Ami tomAra prati kitAva nAyila karechi yA tAdera sammukhe pATha karA haYa, vizvAsI sampradAYera janya avazyai ete anugraha o upadeza raYeche|
vala, AmAra Ara tomAdera mAjhe sAkSI hiseve AllAhi yatheSTa, AsamAnasamUha Ara yamIne yA Ache tA tini jAnena| Ara yArA mithyAYa vizvAsa kare evaM AllAhake asvIkAra kare tArAi hala kSatigrasta|

tArA tomAke tAr3AtAr3i zAsti Anate vale| (‘AyAvera) samaYakAla yadi nA nirdhArita thAkata tave tAdera upara zAsti avazyai ese par3ata| tA tAdera upara avazya avazyai Asave AkasmikabhAve, tArA (AgebhAge) Terao pAve nA|
tArA tomAke tAr3AtAr3i zAsti Anate vale| jAhAnnAma kAphiraderake Thikai gherAo kare phelave|
sedina ‘AyAva tAderake Dheke neve tAdera upara theke Ara tAdera pAYera nIce hate| AllAha valavena- tomarA yA karate tAra svAda bhoga kara|
he AmAra vAndArA! yArA ImAna enecha, AmAra yamIna prazasta, kAjei tomarA ekamAtra AmArai ‘ivAdAta kara|
pratiTi prANa mRtyura svAda grahaNa karave, ataHpara AmAra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe AnA have|

yArA ImAna Ane Ara sat kAja kare, Ami tAderake avazya avazyai jAnnAte suucca prAsAde vAsasthAna deva yAra taladeze nadIsamUha pravAhita, tAra bhetare tArA cirakAla thAkave| satkarmazIladera pratidAna katai nA uttama!
yArA dhairyadhAraNa kare Ara tAdera pratipAlakera upara bharasA rAkhe|
emana aneka jIvajantu Ache yArA nijedera khAdya majuda rAkhe nA, AllAhai tAderake riyaka dAna karena Ara tomAderakeo| tini sava kichu zonena, sava kichu jAnena|
tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa kara- ke AsamAnasamUha o yamIna sRSTi karechena, Ara sUrya o candrake niYantraNa karechena? tArA avazya avazyai valave- AllAha| tAhale tArA kothAYa ghure ver3Acche?
AllAhi tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icche riyaka prazasta karena Ara yAra janya icche sImAvaddha karena| AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvAdhika avagata|

yadi tumi tAderake jijJesa kara- AkAza hate ke pAni varSaNa ka’re yamInake tAra mRtyura para AvAra saJjIvita karena? tArA avazya avazyai valave- AllAha| vala, samasta prazaMsA AllAhara janya| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vujhe nA|
pArthiva e jIvana krIr3A-kautuka chAr3A kichu naYa, AkhirAtera jIvanai prakRta jIvana- tArA yadi jAnata!

tArA yakhana nauyAne ArohaNa kare takhana vizuddha antaHkaraNe ekaniSTha haYe tArA AllAhake DAke| ataHpara tini yakhana tAderake nirApade sthale pau~che dena, takhana tArA (anyake AllAhara) zarIka ka’re vase|
yAra phale tAdera prati AmAra dAnake tArA asvIkAra kare Ara bhoga vilAse Duve thAke| zIghrai tArA jAnate pArave!

tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami ‘hArAma’ (makkA)-ke karechi nirApada sthAna athaca tAdera catuSpArzva theke mAnuSake chiniYe neYA haYa| tave tArA ki mithyAtei vizvAsa karave Ara AllAhara anugrahake asvIkAra karave?
tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke Ache ye AllAhara samvandhe mithye racanA kare Ara prakRta satyake asvIkAra kare yakhana tA tA~ra nikaTa theke Ase? kAphiradera AvAsa sthala ki jAhAnnAmera bhitare naYa?
Ara yArA AmAra pathe sarvAtmaka praceSTA cAlAYa tAderake Ami avazya avazyai AmAra pathe paricAlita karava| avazyai AllAha satkarmaparAYaNadera saGge Achena|
Alima-lAma-mIma|
romAnarA parAjita haYeche|
nikaTastha bhUmite, kintu tArA tAdera parAjaYera para zIghrai jaYalAbha karave|
kaYeka (tina theke naYa) vacharera madhyei; (kon kAja have) Age o (kon kAja have) pare se phaYasAlA AllAharai| sedina mu’minarA Ananda karave|
(se vijaYa arjita have) AllAhara sAhAyye| yAke icche tini sAhAyya karena, tini mahAparAkramazAlI, var3ai daYAlu|
eTA AllAhara o‘YAdA, AllAha tA~ra o‘YAdAra vyatikrama karena nA, kintu adhikAMza lokai jAne nA|
tArA pArthiva jIvanera vAhyika dika jAne, Ara tArA parakAlera khavara rAkhe nA|

tArA ki tAdera mane bheve dekhe nA ye, AllAha AkAzamanDalI, pRthivI o e du’era madhyavartI savakichu sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAve o nirdiSTa kAlera janya, kintu aneka mAnuSa tAdera pratipAlakera sAkSAte nizcitai avizvAsI|

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kare nA? tAhale tArA dekhata ye, tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kI haYechila| tArA zaktite chila edera ceYe adhika pravala| tArA yamIna cASa karata Ara tA AvAda karata edera AvAda karAra ceYe vezi| tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa spaSTa pramANa niYe esechila| ataHpara AllAha tAdera upara yulama karenani, tArA nijerAi nijedera upara yulama karechila|
ataHpara yArA manda kAja karata, tAdera pariNAma haYechila manda; kAraNa tArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra karechila Ara segulo niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata|
AllAha sRSTira sUcanA karena, ataHpara tini tAra punarAvRtti karavena, ataHpara tA~ra dikei tomAderake phiriYe AnA have|
yedina kviYAmata saMghaTita have sedina aparAdhIrA hatAza haYe par3ave|
tArA yAderake zarIka gaNya karata tAdera madhye keu tAdera janya supArizakArI sAjave nA evaM tArA tAdera zarIkaderake asvIkAra karave|
yedina kviYAmata saMghaTita have sedina mAnuSarA pRthaka haYe yAve|
ataHpara yArA ImAna eneche o sat kAja kareche tAderake jAnnAta diYe parituSTa karA have|
Ara yArA kuphurI kareche evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalI o AkhirAtera sAkSAtke asvIkAra kareche, tAderake ‘AyAvera madhye upasthita karA have|
ataeva tomarA AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara yakhana tomarA sandhyAYa upanIta hao Ara sakAle,
evaM aparAhne o yuharera samaYe; Ara AsamAnasamUhe o yamIne prazaMsA to ekamAtra tA~rai|
tinii jIvantake vera karena mRta theke Ara mRtake vera karena jIvanta theke| yamInake tinii punarAYa jIvita karena tAra mRtyura para, ebhAvei tomAderake vera karA have|
tA~ra nidarzanera madhye hala ei ye, tini tomAderake mATi theke sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tomarA ekhana mAnuSa, savakhAne char3iYe raYecha|

tA~ra nidarzanera madhye hala ei ye, tini tomAdera janya tomAdera madhya hatei tomAdera saGgiNI sRSTi karechena yAte tomarA tAra kAche zAnti lAbha karate pAra Ara tini tomAdera madhye pArasparika bhAlavAsA o daYA sRSTi karechena| era mAjhe avazyai vahu nidarzana Ache sei sampradAYera janya yArA cintA kare|
tA~ra nidarzanera madhye hala, AsamAnasamUha o yamInera sRSTi evaM tomAdera bhASA o varNera vibhinnatA| jJAnIdera janya avazyai ete Ache vahu nidarzana|
tA~ra nidarzanera madhye hala rAte o dine tomAdera ghuma evaM tomAdera (dvArA) tA~ra anugraha tAlAza karA| manoyogI lokedera janya avazyai ete Ache aneka nidarzana|

tA~ra nidarzanera madhye hala ei ye, tini tomAderake dekhAna vidyut bhIti o bharasA saJcArIrUpe, Ara tini AkAza hate pAni varSaNa karena yA diYe yamInake tAra mRtyura para AvAra jIvita karena, jJAnavuddhisampanna mAnuSadera janya avazyai ete vahu nidarzana Ache|
tA~ra nidarzanera madhye hala ei ye, AkAza o pRthivI tA~ra hukumei dA~r3iYe Ache| ataHpara tini yakhana tomAderake mATi theke uThAra janya DAka devena ekaTi DAka, takhana tomarA uThe Asave|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA Ache sava tA~rai, sakalai tA~ra prati anugata|
tinii sRSTira sUcanA karena, ataHpara tAra punarAvRtti karavena Ara tA tAra janya khuvai sahaja| AkAza o pRthivIte sarvocca dRSTAnta tA~ra janyai, tinii mahAparAkramazAlI, var3ai hikamataoYAlA|

AllAha tomAdera janya tomAdera madhya hatei ekaTA dRSTAnta peza karachenaH Ami tomAderake ye riyaka diYechi tAte tomAdera adhikArabhukta dAsadAsIrA ki aMzIdAra yAra phale tAte tomarA samAna? tomarA ki tAderake temanabhAve bhaYa kara yemana bhaYa kara tomAdera nijedera parasparake? ebhAve vodhazaktisampanna mAnuSadera janya Ami nidarzanAvalI vistAritabhAve vyAkhyA kari|
varaM sImAlaGghanakArIrA kona jJAna chAr3Ai tAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kare; kAjei AllAhai yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAke satpatha dekhAve ke? tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

kAjei dvInera prati tomAra mukhamanDala nivaddha kara ekaniSThabhAve| eTAi AllAhara prakRti, ye prakRti tini mAnuSake diYechena, AllAhara sRSTi kArye kona parivartana nei, eTAi supratiSThita dvIna, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
tA~ra abhimukhI hao, Ara tA~ke bhaYa kara, nAmAya pratiSThA kara, Ara muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
yArA nijedera dvInake vibhakta kare pheleche evaM vibhinna dale bhAga haYe geche| pratyeka dala nijedera kAche yA Ache tAi niYe ullasita|

mAnuSake yakhana duHkha-vipada sparza kare takhana tArA tAdera pratipAlakake DAke tA~ra abhimukhI haYe| ataHpara tini yakhana tAderake nija anugraha AsvAdana karAna takhana tAdera ekadala tAdera pratipAlakera aMzIdAra sAvyasta kare vase
Ami tAdera prati ye anugraha karechi tA asvIkAra karAra janya| tAhale bhoga kare nAo, zIghrai tomarA jAnate pArave!
Ami ki tAdera kAche emana kona dalIla avatIrNa karechi yA tAderake segulora kathA vale tArA yegulora zarIka kare?
Ami yakhana mAnuSake anugraha AsvAdana karAi takhana tArA tAte ullasita haYa, tArapara tAdera hAta yA Age pAThiYeche tAra phale durdazA yakhana tAderake peYe vase, takhana tArA hatAza haYe par3e|
tArA ki lakSya kare nA ye, AllAha yAra janye icche karena riyaka prazasta karena Ara (yAra janya icche) sImAvaddha karena? vizvAsI lokedera janya avazyai ete vahu nidarzana Ache|
kAjei AtmIYaderake tAdera nyAyya prApya diYe dAo Ara abhAvagrasta evaM musAphiraderakeo| yArA AllAhara cehArA (darzana) kAmanA kare, eTA tAdera janya uttama, Ara tArAi saphalakAma|

mAnuSera dhana vRddhira uddezye tomarA ye suda diYe thAka, AllAhara dRSTite tA dhana vRddhi kare nA| kintu tomarA AllAhara cehArA (santuSTi) lAbhera uddezye ye yAkAta dAo (tA vRddhi pAYa), tArAi dviguNa pratidAna lAbha kare|

AllAhi tomAderake sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tomAderake riyaka diYechena, ataHpara tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena, ataHpara tomAderake jIvita karavena| tomarA yAderake (AllAhara) aMzIdAra mAnya kara tAdera madhye keu Ache ki e savera kona kichu karate pAre? tArA yAderake aMzIdAra gaNya kare AllAha tAdera theke pavitra, vahu Urdhve|
mAnuSera kRtakarmera kAraNe jale sthale viparyaYa dekhA diYeche yAte tini tAderake tAdera kona kona kAjera zAsti AsvAdana karAna, yAte tArA (asat patha hate) phire Ase|
vala, pRthivIte paribhramaNa kara, ataHpara dekha Age yArA chila tAdera pariNAma kI haYeche| tAdera adhikAMzai chila muzarika|
kAjei tumi nijeke satya dvIne pratiSThita rAkha, AllAhara pakSa theke emana dina (kviYAmata divasa) AsAra pUrve yA kakSano pratyAhAra karA have nA| sedina mAnuSa vibhakta haYe yAve (du’bhAge)|
ye kuphurI kare sei tAra kuphurIra zAsti bhoga karave, Ara yArA satkarma kare tArA nijederai sukha saraJjAma saMgraha karache|
yAte tini svIYa anugrahabhAnDAra theke tAderake puraskRta karate pArena yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare| tini kAphiraderake bhAlavAsena nA|

tA~ra nidarzanera madhye hala ei ye, tini vAYu preraNa karena susaMvAda dAnera janya o tomAderake tA~ra anugraha AsvAdana karAnora janya| tA~ra nirdeze nauyAna cale yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha anusandhAna karate pAra Ara tA~ra prati kRtajJatA prakAza karate pAra|

tomAra pUrve Ami rasUlagaNake pAThiYechilAma tAdera nija nija jAtira nikaTa| tArA tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzana niYe esechila| ataHpara yArA anyAYa karechila Ami tAderake zAsti diYechilAma| mu’minadera sAhAyya karA AmAra dAYitva|

AllAha yini vAYu preraNa karena, ataHpara tA meghamAlAra saJcAra kare, ataHpara tini tA AkAze char3iYe dena yebhAve icche karena, ataHpara tAke khanDa vikhanDa kare dena, tArapara tumi dekhate pAo tAra mAjha theke vRSTi-pho~TA nirgata hacche, ataHpara tini tA~ra vAndAhadera madhye yAdera nikaTa tini icche karena tAdera kAche yakhana tA pau~che dena takhana tArA haYa Anandita|
yadio itopUrve tAdera prati vRSTi varSaNera pUrve tArA chila caramabhAve hatAza|
ataeva AllAhara rahamAtera phala dekhe nAo, kIbhAve tini bhUmike tAra mRtyura para jIvita karena| ebhAvei nizcaYa tini mRtake jIvita karavena, kenanA sava kichura upara tini sarvazaktimAna|
Ami yadi emana vAYu preraNa kari yAra phale tArA dekhe zasya halade haYe geche, takhana tArA avazyai akRtajJa haYe yAYa|
tumi to mRtake zunAte pArave nA, vadhirakeo zunAte pArave nA AhavAna, yakhana tArA pechana phire cale yAYa|

tumi andhaderakeo tAdera pathabhraSTatA theke phiriYe pathe Anate pArave nA| yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIte vizvAsa kare tumi kevala tAderakei zunAte pArave, kAraNa tArA (AllAhara prati) AtmasamarpaNakArI|

tini AllAha yini tomAderake (asahAYa) durvala avasthAYa sRSTi karechena, durvalatAra para diYechena zakti, zaktira para AvAra diYechena durvalatA o vArdhakya| tini yA icche karena sRSTi karena| tini sarvazreSTha jJAnI, savaceYe zaktidhara|
yedina kviYAmata saMghaTita have sedina anyAYakArIrA kasama kare valave ye, tArA mUhUrtakAlera vezi avasthAna kareni| ebhAvei tArA satya patha theke vicyuta hata|
Ara yAderake ImAna o jJAna deYA haYechila tArA valave- tomarA AllAhara kitAva mate punarutthAna divasa paryanta avasthAna karecha| eTAi hala punarutthAna divasa kintu tomarA jAnate nA|
anyAYakArIdera oyara Apatti sedina kona kAje Asave nA evaM tAderake saMzodhanerao suyoga deYA have nA|

Ami mAnuSadera janya e kuraAne yAvatIYa dRSTAnta varNanA karechi| tumi yadi tAdera kAche kona nidarzana niYe Asa tAhale kAphirarA avazya avazyai valave- tomarA mithye valA chAr3A Ara kichui karacha nA|
yAdera jJAna nei ebhAvei AllAha tAdera hRdaYa moharAGkita kare dena|
kAjei tumi dhairya dhara, AllAhara o‘YAdA satya| yArA dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhe nA, tArA yena tomAke uttejita nA karate pAre|
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
egulo hikamAte bharapura kitAvera AYAta|
satkarmazIladera janya patha nirdeza o rahamata|
yArA nAmAya pratiSThA kare, yAkAta deYa Ara tArA AkherAtera prati dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhe|
tArAi tAdera pAlanakartAra saThika pathe Ache Ara tArAi saphalakAma| (duniYA o AkherAte)
kataka mAnuSa AllAhara patha theke vicyuta karAra uddezye ajJatAvazataH avAntara kathAvArtA (gAna-vAjanA) kraYa kare Ara AllAhara pathake ThATTA-vidrUpa kare| odera janyai Ache avamAnanAkara zAsti|

yakhana tAra kAche AmAra AYAta AvRtti karA haYa, takhana se ahaMkAravazataH emanabhAve mukha phiriYe neYa yena se tA zunatei pAYani, yena tAra dui kAne vadhiratA Ache, kajei tAke bhaYAvaha zAstira susaMvAda dAo|
yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkAja kare tAdera janya Ache ni‘YAmAte bharA jAnnAta|
tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave| AllAhara o‘YAdA satya Ara tini mahAparAkramazAlI, mahAprajJAmaYa|

tini AkAzamanDalI nirmANa karechena stambha chAr3A yA tomarA dekhacha| tini pRthivIte sthApana karechena dRr3habhAve danDAYamAna parvatamAlA yAte pRthivI tomAderake niYe nar3Acar3A nA kare Ara tAte char3iYe diYechena sakala prakAra jIvajantu, Ara Amii AkAza theke pAni varSaNa kari, ataHpara tAte udgata kari yAvatIYa kalyANakara udbhida|
egulo AllAhara sRSTi| kAjei AmAke dekhAo tini chAr3A anyerA kI sRSTi kareche| varaM yAlimarA suspaSTa gumarAhIte Duve Ache|

Ami lukamAnake prajJA dAna karechilAma| (tAke valechilAma) ye, tumi AllAhara kRtajJatA prakAza kara| ye kRtajJatA prakAza kare, se tA nijera kalyANei kare| Ara keu akRtajJa hale (se jene rAkhuka ye) AllAha amukhApekSI, prazaMsita|
smaraNa kara, yakhana lukamAna tAra cheleke nasIhata ka’re valechila- he vatsa! AllAhara sAthe kona kichuke ziraka kara nA, ziraka hacche avazyai virATa yulama|

Ami mAnuSake tAra pitA-mAtAra prati sadvyavahArera nirdeza diYechi| tAra mA tAke kaSTera para kaSTa sahya kare garbhe dhAraNa kare| tAra dudha chAr3Ano haYa du’vachare, (nirdeza dicchi) ye, AmAra prati o tomAra pitAmAtAra prati kRtajJa hao| (tomAdera sakalera) pratyAvartana to AmArai kAche|

tomAra pitAmAtA yadi tomAke pIr3ApIr3i kare AmAra aMzIdAra sthira karAra janya yAra jJAna tomAra nei, tave tumi tAdera kathA mAnave nA| kintu pRthivIte tAdera sAthe sadbhAve vasavAsa karave| ye AmAra abhimukhI haYa tAra patha anusaraNa karave| ataHpara AmArai nikaTa tomAdera pratyAvartana| takhana Ami tomAderake jAniYe deva tomarA yA karachile|

he vatsa! kona vastu yadi sariSAra dAnA parimANao haYa Ara tA thAke pAtharera bhitare athavA AkAze athavA yamInera nIce, AllAha tAke ene hAjira karavena| AllAha sUkSNadarzI, sava kichura khavara rAkhena|
he vatsa! tumi nAmAya kAYima kara, sat kAjera nirdeza dAo Ara manda kAja hate niSedha kara evaM vipadApade dhairyadhAraNa kara| nizcaYa eTA dRr3ha saMkalpera kAja|
ahaMkArera vazavartI haYe tumi mAnuSake avajJA kara nA, Ara pRthivIte garvabhare calApherA kara nA, nizcaYai AllAha kona dAmbhika ahaMkArIke pachanda karena nA|
calApherAYa saMyata bhAva avalamvana kara evaM kaNThasvara nIcu kara| svarera madhye nizcaYai gAdhAra svara sarvApekSA zrutikaTu|

tomarA ki lakSya kara nA ye, yA kichu AsamAnasamUhe Ara yamIne Ache, AllAha samastai tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena evaM tomAdera prati tA~ra prakAzya o aprakAzya ni‘YAmAtasamUha paripUrNa kare diYechena? kataka mAnuSa jJAna chAr3Ai AllAha samvandhe vAka-vitanDA kare, tAdera nA Ache saThika pathera dizA, Ara nA Ache kona Aloprada kitAva|

tAderake yakhana valA haYa- AllAha yA nAyila karechena tA anusaraNa kara, takhana tArA vale- varaM AmarA tArai anusaraNa karava AmAdera pitR-puruSaderake ye patha anusaraNa karate dekhechi| zaYatvAna yadi tAderake jvalanta Agunera zAstira dike DAke, tavuo ki (tArA tArai anusaraNa karave)?
ye keu AllAhara prati AtmasamarpaNa kare Ara se satkarmazIla, se dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kare eka majavuta hAtala| yAvatIYa karma pariNAma phalera janya AllAhara dike phire yAYa|

keu kupharI karale tAra kupharI tomAke yena manokaSTa nA deYa, tAdera pratyAvartana AmAra kAchei; ataHpara Ami tAderake jAniYe deva tArA kI karata| (mAnuSera) antarasamUhe kI Ache se samparke AllAhai savaceYe vezi jAnena|
alpa samaYera janya tAderake bhoga karate deva, avazeSe tAderake gurutara zAstite (praveza karate) vAdhya karava|
yadi tumi tAderake jijJesa kara- AkAzamanDalI o yamIna ke sRSTi kareche, tArA avazya avazyai valave- AllAha| vala, yAvatIYa prazaMsA AllAhara, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
AkAzamanDalI Ara yamIne yA Ache sava AllAharai, nizcaYai AllAha, tini sakala abhAva-mukta, sakala prazaMsAra adhikArI|

duniYAra sava gAcha yadi kalama haYa Ara samudra (kAli haYa) Ara tAra sAthe Aro sAta samudra yukta haYa, tavuo AllAhara (prazaMsAra) kathA (lekhA) zeSa have nA| AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, mahAprajJAra adhikArI|
tomAdera sakalera sRSTi o punarutthAna ekajana mAnuSera (sRSTi o punarutthAnera) matai| AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAha rAtrike dine evaM dinake rAtrite praviSTa karena evaM sUrya o candrake niYantraNa karena, pratyekei vicaraNa karache nirdiSTakRta samaYa anuyAYI, tomarA yA kichu kara AllAha se samparke pUrNarUpe avahita|
esava pramANa kare ye, AllAhi satya evaM tA~ra parivarte tArA yAke DAke tA mithye| AllAha, tini to halena sarvocca, sumahAna|

tumi ki lakSya kara nA ye, nauyAnagulo AllAhara anugrahe samudre calAcala kare yAte tini tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanera kichu dekhAte pArena| ete avazyai pratyeka dhairyazIla kRtajJa vyaktira janya nidarzana raYeche|

Dheu yakhana tAderake (meghera) chAYAra mata Dheke neYa, takhana tArA AllAhake DAkate thAke tA~ra prati ekaniSTha Anugatye| ataHpara Ami yakhana tAderake uddhAra ka’re sthale ene dei, takhana tAdera kataka nyAYapUrNa AcaraNa kare| kevala mithyAcArI akRtajJa vyaktii AmAra nidarzanAvalI asvIkAra kare|

he mAnuSa! tomAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kara Ara bhaYa kara se dinera, yedina pitA tAra santAnera kona upakAra karate pArave nA| santAnao pitAra konai upakAra karate pArave nA| AllAhara o‘YAdA satya, kAjei pArthiva jIvana yena kichutei tomAderake dho~kAYa phelate nA pAre Ara pradhAna pratAraka (zaYatvAna) yena kichutei tomAderake AllAh samparke pratArita nA kare|

kiYAmatera jJAna kevala AllAhara nikaTai Ache, tinii vRSTi varSaNa karena, jarAYute kI Ache tA tinii jAnena| keu jAne nA AgAmIkAla se kI arjana karave, keu jAne nA kon jAYagAYa se marave| AllAha sarvajJa, sarvAdhika avahita|
Alipha-lAma-mIma,
e kitAva vizvajagatera pAlanakartAra nikaTa hate avatIrNa, ete kona sandeha nei|

tave tArA ki vale ye, se nijei tA racanA kareche (evaM AllAhara nikaTa theke Agata kitAva va’le mithye dAvI karache, nA tA naYa), varaM tA tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa theke (Agata) satya yAte tumi emana eka sampradAYake satarka karate pAra yAdera kAche tomAra pUrve kona sakartakArI Aseni, sambhavataH tArA saThikapatha prApta have|

AllAha yini AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI evaM e du’era mAjhe yA kichu Ache chaYa dine sRSTi karechena- ataHpara tini ‘Araze samunnata hana| tini vyatIta tomAdera janya kona abhibhAvaka nei, supArizakArIo nei| tavuo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
tini AkAza hate pRthivI paryanta kArya paricAlanA karena, ataHpara sakala viSaYAdi tA~rai kAche ekadina utthita have yAra parimApa tomAdera gaNanA anuyAYI hAjAra vachara|
emanai tini, adRzya o dRzyamAna samparke jJAta, mahAparAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
yini sava kichuke uttamarUpe sRSTi karechena, Ara mAnuSa sRSTira sUcanA karechena mATi theke|
ataHpara tini tAra vaMzadhara sRSTi karena tuccha tarala padArthera niryAsa theke|

ataHpara tini tAke sAmaJjasyapUrNa karechena Ara tAra bhitare svIYa rUha hate phu~ka diYechena, Ara tomAderake diYechena zravaNendrIYa, darzanendriYa o antaHkaraNa; kRtajJatA tomarA sAmAnyai prakAza kara|
tArA vale, kI! AmarA mATite miziYe geleo ki AmAderake AvAra natuna ka’re sRSTi karA have? varaM tArA tAdera pratipAlakera sAkSAtke asvIkAra kare|
vala, tomAdera prANa haraNera dAYitve niYojita pherezatA tomAdera prANa haraNa karave, ataHpara tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa tomAderake phiriYe AnA have|

tumi yadi dekhate yakhana aparAdhIrA tAdera pratipAlakera sAmane mAthA nIcu kare dA~r3iYe thAkave (Ara valave), he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA dekhalAma o zunalAma; kAjei AmAderake AvAra pAThiYe dina, AmarA bhAla kAja karava, AmarA (ekhana) dRr3ha vizvAsI|
Ami yadi icche karatAma tAhale pratyeka vyaktike sat pathe paricAlita karatAma| kintu AmAra (e) kathA avazyai satya pratipanna haveH Ami nizcaYai jAhAnnAmake jvina o mAnuSa miliYe pUrNa karava|
kAjei (zAstira) svAda grahaNa kara, kenanA e dinera sAkSAtke tomarA bhule giYechile, Amio tomAderake bhule gechi| tomarA cirasthAYI zAsti AsvAdana karate thAka, tomarA yA karachile tAra kAraNe|

AmAra nidarzanAvalIte kevala tArAi vizvAsa kare yAderake era dvArA upadeza deYA hale sijadAYa luTiYe par3e Ara tAdera pratipAlakera prazaMsA sahakAre tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare Ara tArA ahaMkAra kare nA|[sAjadAha]

tArA tAdera (dehera) pArzvagulo vichAnA theke AlAdA ka’re (jAhAnnAmera) bhIti o (jAnnAtera) AzA niYe tAdera pratipAlakake DAke, Ara Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi tAttheke (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kare|
kona vyaktii (ekhana) jAne nA cokha jur3Ano kI (jinisa) tAdera janya lukiYe rAkhA haYeche tAdera kAjera puraskAra hiseve|
tave ki, mu’mina vyakti pApAcArIra nyAYa (hate pAre)? tArA samAna naYa|
yArA ImAna Ane Ara sat kAja kare tAdera vAsasthAna have jAnnAta, tArA ye kAja karata tAra ApyAYana svarUpa|

Ara yArA pApAcAra kare tAdera vAsasthAna have jAhAnnAma| yakhanai tArA tAttheke veriYe Asate cAive, tAderake tAtei phiriYe deYA have, Ara tAderake valA have- tomarA agnira zAsti AsvAdana kara yA tomarA mithye va’le asvIkAra karate|
gurutara zAstira Age Ami tAderake avazya avazyai laghu zAsti AsvAdana karAvo yAte tArA (anuzocanA niYe) phire Ase|
tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke Ache yAke tAra pratipAlakera AYAtasamUha diYe upadeza dAna karA hale se tAttheke mukha phiriYe neYa? Ami aparAdhIderake zAsti deva|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, kAjei tumi tAra (arthAt Ala kuraAnera) prAptite sandehe patita haYo nA| Ami oTAke vAnI isarAIlera janya pathapradarzaka karechilAma|

Ara Ami tAdera madhya hate netA manonIta karechilAma yArA AmAra nirdeza mutAveka satpathapradarzana karata yatadina tArA dhairya avalamvana karechila Ara AmAra AYAtasamUhera upara dRr3ha vizvAsI chila|
tomAra pratipAlaka, tini kviYAmatera dina tAdera madhye phaYasAlA karavena tArA ye viSaYe matabheda karata|

eTAo ki tAderake satya patha dekhAYa nA ye, Ami tAdera pUrve kata mAnava vaMza dhvaMsa karechi yAdera vAsabhUmira upara diYe tArA (ekhana) calApherA kare? ete avazyai (AllAhara) nidarzana Ache, tavuo ki tArA zunave nA?
tArA ki lakSya kare nA ye, Ami uSara bhUmite pAni pravAhita ka’re tA diYe zaSya udagata kari yAtheke tAdera gavAdi pazu o tArA nijerA khAdya grahaNa kare, tavuo ki tArA lakSya karave nA?
Ara tArA valeH tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale vala, e phaYasAlA kakhana have?
vala, phaYasAlAra dine (sava kichu dekhAra para) kAphiradera ImAna AnaYana tAdera kona upakAra dive nA, Ara tAderake kona samaYao deYA have nA|
kAjei tumi tAderake er3iYe cala Ara (AllAhara phaYasAlAra janya) apekSA kara, tArAo (sei phaYasAlAra janya Ache) apekSamAna|
he navI (sA)! AllAhake bhaYa kara, Ara kAphira o munAphikadera Anugatya kara nA, nizcaYa AllAha sarvajJAtA, mahAprajJAmaYa|
tomAra prati tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa hate yA oYAhI karA haYa tumi tAra anusaraNa kara| tomarA yA kara se samparke AllAha pUrNarUpe avahita|
Ara tumi nirbhara kara AllAhara upara, karma sampAdane AllAhai yatheSTa|

AllAha kona mAnuSera vuke du’Ti antara sRSTi karenani| tomAdera strIdera madhye yAdera saGge tomarA jihAra kara, tini tAderake tomAdera jananI karenani, Ara tini tomAdera poSya putraderake tomAdera putra karenani, egulo tomAdera mukhera vuli, AllAhai valena satya kathA, Ara tinii dekhAna (saThika) patha|

tAderake tAdera pitR-paricaYe DAka, AllAhara kAche eTAi adhika inasAphapUrNa| Ara yadi tomarA tAdera pitR-paricaYa nA jAna, tAhale tArA tomAdera dvInI bhAi evaM tomAdera vandhu| e vyApAre tomAdera truTi-vicyuti hale tomAdera kona gunAh nei, kintu (dhartavya hala) tomAdera antarera saMkalpa| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

navI (sAH) mu’minadera nikaTa tAdera nijedera ceYe ghaniSTha, Ara tAra strIgaNa tAdera mAtA| AllAhara vidhAne mu’mina o muhAjiradera (dvInI samparka) apekSA AtmIYa-svajanagaNa paraspara parasparera nikaTa ghaniSThatara| tave tomarA tomAdera vandhu vAndhavadera prati daYA-dAkSiNya pradarzana karate cAile, karate pAra| (AllAhara) kitAve eTAi likhita|

smaraNa kara, Ami yakhana navIdera kAcha theke aGgIkAra niYechilAma Ara tomAra kAcha thekeo; Ara nUh, ivrAhIma, mUsA Ara mAraiYAma putra ‘IsA thekeo| Ami tAdera kAcha theke niYechilAma dRr3ha aGgIkAra
satyavAdIderake (arthAt navIderake) tAdera satyavAditA (arthAt AllAhara vANI pau~che deYAra kAja) samparke jijJesa karAra janya| tini kAphiradera janya prastuta kare rekhechena bhaYAvaha zAsti|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA tomAdera prati AllAhara anugrahera kathA smaraNa kara yakhana sainyavAhinI tomAdera viruddhe nikaTavartI haYechila, ataHpara Ami tAdera viruddhe pAThiYechilAma jhar3o hAoYA evaM eka (pherezatArUpI) sainyavAhinI yA tomarA dekhani| tomarA yA kara AllAha tA pratyakSakArI|

tArA yakhana tomAdera kAche esechila tomAdera upara theke Ara tomAdera nIcera dika theke, takhana tomAdera cakSu haYechila visphorita Ara prANa haYechila kaNThAgata; Ara tomarA AllAha samparke nAnA rakama (khArApa) dhAraNA poSaNa karate zuru karechile|
se samaYa mu’minagaNake parIkSA karA haYechila Ara tAderake bhISaNa kampane prakampita karA haYechila|
Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana munAphikarA evaM yAdera antare roga Ache tArA valachila- AllAha o tA~ra rasUla AmAderake ye oYA‘dA diYechena tA dho~kA chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tAdera ekadala valechila- he iYAsarivavAsI! tomarA (zatrura AkramaNera viruddhe) dA~r3Ate pArave nA, kAjei tomarA phire yAo| Ara tAdera ekadala ei vale navI (sA)ra kAche avyAhati cAcchila ye, AmAdera vAr3Ighara arakSita athaca ogulo arakSita chila nA, Asale pAliYe yAoYAi tAdera chila ekamAtra uddezya|
yadi zatrupakSa (madInA nagarIra) cAradika theke tAdera upara AkramaNa karato, ataHpara tAderake kuphurIra AhavAna karA hata, tave tArA tAi kare vasata| tAte tArA moTeo vilamva karata nA|
athaca tArA itopUrve AllAhara sAthe aGgIkAra karechila ye, tArA pRSThapradarzana karave nA| AllAhara saGge kRta oYA‘dA samparke avazyai jijJesa karA have|
vala, palAYane tomAdera konai lAbha have nA, yadi tomarA mRtyu athavA hatyA theke palAYana kara tAhale tomAderake sAmAnyai bhoga karate deYA have|

vala, tomAderake AllAha (’ra zAsti) hate ke rakSA karave tini yadi tomAdera akalyANa karate cAna athavA tomAderake anugraha karate cAna? tArA AllAhake chAr3A tAdera janya nA pAve kona abhibhAvaka, Ara nA kona sAhAyyakArI|
AllAha tomAdera madhye tAderake nizcitai jAnena kArA (yuddhe aMzagrahaNe) vAdhA sRSTikArI Ara kArA nijedera bhAiderake vale- AmAdera kAche eso| yuddha tArA sAmAnyai kare

tomAdera prati kRpaNatAra vazavartI haYe| yakhana vipada Ase takhana tumi tAderake dekhave mRtyu bhaYe acetana vyaktira nyAYa cokha ulTiYe tArA tomAra dike tAkAcche| ataHpara vipada yakhana keTe yAYa takhana dhanera lAlasAYa tArA tomAderake tIkSma vAkya-vANe viddha kare| erA ImAna Aneni| ejanya AllAha tAdera kAryAvalI nisphala kare diYechena, Ara tA AllAhara janya sahaja|

tArA mane kare sammilita vAhinI cale yAYani| sammilita vAhinI yadi AvAra ese yAYa, tAhale tArA kAmanA karave ye, yadi marucArIdera madhye theke tArA tomAdera saMvAda nite pArata! tArA tomAdera madhye avasthAna karaleo tArA yuddha sAmAnyai karata|
tomAdera janya AllAhara rasUlera madhye uttama Adarza raYeche yArA AllAha o zeSa dinera AzA rAkhe Ara AllAhake adhika smaraNa kare|

mu’minarA yakhana sammilita vAhinIke dekhala takhana tArA vale uThala- AllAha o tA~ra rasUla erai oYA‘dA AmAderake diYechilena evaM AllAha o tA~ra rasUla satya valechena| ete tAdera ImAna o Anugatyera Agrahai vRddhi pela|

mu’minadera madhye kataka loka AllAhara saGge kRta tAdera aGgIkAra satye pariNata kareche| tAdera kataka uddezya vAstavAYane (zAhAdAta varaNa) kareche Ara tAdera kataka apekSAYa Ache| tArA (tAdera saMkalpa) kakhano tila parimANa parivartana kareni|
yAte AllAha (oYA‘dAra prati) satyavAdIderake tAdera satyavAditAra puraskAra dena Ara munAphikaderake icche karale zAsti dena athavA tAderake kSamA karena| AllAha parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara AllAha kAphiraderake tAdera rAgera avasthAtei phiriYe dilena, tArA kona kalyANa lAbha karate pAreni| yuddhe mu’minadera janya AllAhai yatheSTa| AllAha sarvazaktimAna, mahAparAkramazAlI|

Ara granthadhArIdera madhya hate yArA tAderake (arthAt sammilita kAphira vAhinIke) sAhAyya karechila tAderake tini tAdera dUrga hate nAmiYe dilena evaM tAdera antare bhIti nikSepa karalena| tAdera katakake tomarA hatyA karale, Ara katakake karale vandI|

Ara tini tomAderake uttarAdhikArI kare dilena tAdera bhUmira, tAdera gharavAr3ira Ara tAdera dhana-sampadera; Ara emana eka bhUkhanDera yekhAne tomarA (ekhanao) abhiyAnai paricAlanA karani| AllAha sarvaviSaYe kSamatAvAna|
he navI (sA.)! tumi tomAra strIdera vale dAo- tomarA yadi pArthiva jIvana Ara tAra zobhAsaundarya kAmanA kara, tAhale eso, tomAderake bhogasAmagrI diYe dei evaM uttama panthAYa tomAderake vidAYa dei|
Ara tomarA yadi AllAha, tA~ra rasUla o parakAlera gRha kAmanA kara, tave tomAdera madhye yArA satkarmazIla tAdera janya AllAha mahA puraskAra prastuta kare rekhechena|
he navI patnIgaNa! tomAdera madhye keu prakAzye azlIla kAja karale tAke dviguNa zAsti deYA have| AllAhara janya eTA sahaja|
tomAdera madhye ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera anugata have Ara sat kAja karave, Ami tAke du’vAra puraskAra deva Ara tAra janya Ami sammAnajanaka riyaka prastuta rekhechi|

he navI patnIgaNa! tomarA anya nArIdera mata nao| tomarA yadi AllAhake bhaYa kara, tAhale para puruSera saGge AkarSaNIYa bhaGgite kathA valo nA, yAte yAra antare vyAdhi Ache se praluddha haYa| tomarA saGgata kathA valave|

Ara tomarA nijedera gRhe avasthAna kara, prAcIna ajJatAra yugera mata cokha jhalasAno pradarzanI kare ver3io nA| Ara tomarA nAmAya pratiSThA kara, yAkAta pradAna kara evaM AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kara| he navIra parivAra! AllAha kevala cAna tomAdera theke apavitratA dUra karate evaM tomAderake pavitra o niSkalaMka karate|
tomAdera gRhe AllAhara AYAta o hikamata theke yA pATha karA haYa tAra carcA kara| AllAha ati sUkSNadarzI, sarvaviSaYe khavara rAkhena|

musalima puruSa o musalima nArI, mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArI, anugata puruSa o anugata nArI, satyaniSTha puruSa o satyaniSTha nArI, dhairyazIla puruSa o dhairyazIla nArI, vinaYI puruSa o vinaYI nArI, dAnazIla puruSa o dAnazIla nArI, royApAlanakArI puruSa o royApAlanArI nArI, yaunAGgera surakSAkArI puruSa o yaunAGgera surakSAkArI nArI, AllAhake adhika smaraNakArI puruSa o AllAhake adhika smaraNakArI nArI- AllAha tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena kSamA o mahApratidAna|

AllAha o tA~ra rasUla kona nirdeza dile kona mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArI ukta nirdezera bhinnatA karAra kona adhikAra rAkhe nA| ye AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake amAnya kare se spaSTatai satya patha hate dure sare par3ala|

smaraNa kara, AllAha yAke anugraha karechena Ara tumio yAke anugraha karecha tAke tumi yakhana valachile- tumi tomAra strIke (vivAhavandhane) rekhe dAo evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara| tumi tomAra antare lukiYe rAkhachile yA AllAha prakAza karate cAna, tumi lokaderake bhaYa karachile, athaca AllAhai savaceYe vezi e adhikAra rAkhena ye, tumi tA~ke bhaYa karave| ataHpara yAYda yakhana tAra (yAYanAvera) saGge samparka chinna karala takhana Ami tAke tomAra saGge vivAhavandhane Avaddha kare dilAma yAte mu’minadera poSyaputrarA tAdera strIdera saGge samparka chinna karale sesava nArIke vivAha karAra vyApAre mu’minadera kona vighna nA haYa| AllAhara Adeza kAryakarI havei|
AllAha navIra janya yA vidhivaddha karechena tAra janya tA karate kona vAdhA nei| pUrve yArA atIta haYe geche tAdera kSetreo eTAi chila AllAhara vidhAna| AllAhara vidhAna sunirdhAraNe nirdhArita|
tArA (navIgaNa) AllAhara vANI pracAra karata Ara tA~ke bhaYa karata| AllAha chAr3A kAuke tArA bhaYa karata nA| (mAnuSadera) hisAva grahaNe AllAhai yatheSTa|
muhAmmAda (sAH) tomAdera madhyekAra kona puruSera pitA naYa, kintu (se) AllAhara rAsUla evaM zeSa navI| AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvajJAtA|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhake vezi vezi smaraNa kara|
Ara sakAla-sandhyAYa tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|

tini tomAdera prati tA~ra anugraha varSaNa karena, Ara tA~ra pherezatArAo (tomAdera janya) tA~ra anugraha prArthanA kare tomAderake andhakAra theke vera kare Alote AnAra janye| mu’minadera prati tini parama daYAlu|
yedina tArA AllAhara sAthe sAkSAt karave sedina tAdera abhivAdana have ‘sAlAma’| tini tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena sammAnajanaka pratidAna|
he navI (sA.)! Ami tomAke pAThiYechi (yuge yuge prerita navI rasUlagaNa ye tA~dera ummAtera kAche AllAhara vANI pau~che diYechena- e kathAra) sAkSIsvarUpa evaM susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe,
Ara AllAhara anumatikrame tA~ra pathe AhavAnakArI o Alokaprada pradIparUpe|
tumi mu’minaderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janya AllAhara nikaTa Ache vizAla anugraha|
tumi kAphira o munAphikadera kathA mAnya karo nA| tAdera yantraNAke mane sthAna dio nA, Ara nirbhara kara AllAhara upara, kAryanirvAhIrUpe AllAhi yatheSTa|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yakhana kona mu’mina nArIke vivAha kara, ataHpara tAderake sparza karAra pUrvei tAderake tAlAka dAo, takhana tAdera janya tomAderake kona iddata pAlana karate have nA yA tomarA (anyakSetrera tAlAke) gaNanA kare thAka| kAjei kichu sAmagrI tAderake dAo Ara tAderake vidAYa dAo uttama vidAYe|

he navI (sA.)! Ami tomAra janya vaidha karechi tomAra strIgaNake yAdera moharAnA tumi pradAna karecha; Ara vaidha karechi AllAha phAYa (vinA yuddhe lavdha) hiseve tomAke yA dAna karechena tAra madhya hate yArA tomAra mAlikAnAdhIna haYeche tAderake, Ara tomAra cAcAra kanyA o phuphura kanyAke, tomAra mAmAra kanyA o tomAra khAlAra kanyAke yArA tomAra saGge hijarAta kareche| Ara kona mu’mina nArI yadi navIra nikaTa nijeke nivedana kare Ara navI yadi tAke viYe karate cAYa seo vaidha, eTA mu’minadera vAda diYe vizeSabhAve tomAra janya yAte tomAra kona asuvidhe nA haYa| mu’minagaNera janya tAdera strI o dAsIdera vyApAre yA nirdhArita karechi AmAra tA jAnA Ache| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tumi tAdera yAke icche sariYe rAkhate pAra, Ara yAke icche tomAra kAche AzraYa dite pAra| Ara tumi yAke AlAdA ka’re rekhecha tAke kAmanA karale tomAra kona aparAdha nei| ete adhika sambhAvanA Ache ye, tAdera cakSu zItala thAkave, tArA duHkha pAve nA, Ara tumi tAdera sakalake yA dAo tAte tArA santuSTa thAkave| tomAdera antare yA Ache AllAha tA jAnena| AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

ataHpara Ara kona nArI tomAra janya vaidha naYa| Ara tAdera parivarte anya strI grahaNa karAo hAlAla naYa yadio tAdera saundarya tomAke camatkRta kare| tave tomAra adhikArabhukta dAsIdera vyApAre ei niYama prayojya naYa| AllAha sava viSaYera upara dRSTi rAkhena|

tomarA yArA ImAna enecha zona! navIgRhe praveza kara nA yatakSaNa nA tomAderake anumati deYA haYa khAdya grahaNera janya, (AgebhAgei ese par3a nA) khAdya prastutira janya apekSA kare yena vase thAkate nA haYa| tave tomAderake DAkA hale tomarA praveza kara| ataHpara tomAdera khAoYA hale tomarA cale yAo| kathAvArtAYa mazagula haYe yeYo nA| tomAdera e kAja navIke kaSTa deYa| se tomAderake (uThe yAoYAra janya valate) lajjAvodha kare, AllAha satya kathA valate lajjAvodha karena nA| tomarA yakhana tAra strIgaNera nikaTa kona kichu cAo, takhana pardAra Ar3Ala hate tAdera kAche cAo| eTAi tomAdera o tAdera antarera janya pavitratara| tomAdera janya AllAhara rasUlake kaSTa deYA saGgata naYa| Ara tAra mRtyura para tAra strIgaNake viYe karAo tomAdera janya kakSano vaidha naYa| AllAhara dRSTite eTA mahA aparAdha|
tomarA kona viSaYa prakAza kara athavA tA gopana kara- AllAha to sava viSaYe sarvajJa|

kona aparAdha nei (yadi navIra strIgaNa sAmane yAYa) tAdera pitRdera, tAdera putradera, tAdera bhrAtRdera, tAdera bhrAtuSputradera, tAdera bhagnIputradera, tAdera nArIdera o tAdera adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsIdera| Ara (he navIra strIgaNa!) tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, AllAha sakala jiniserai pratyakSadarzI|
AllAha navIra prati anugraha karena, tA~ra pherezatAgaNa navIra janya anugraha prArthanA kare| he mu’minagaNa! tomarAo navIra janya anugraha prArthanA kara evaM yathAyatha zraddhAbhare sAlAma jAnAo|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake kaSTa deYa, AllAha tAderake duniYA o AkhirAte abhizapta karechena Ara tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena apamAnajanaka zAsti|
Ara yArA mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArIderake kaSTa deYa tAdera kona aparAdha chAr3Ai, tArA apavAdera o suspaSTa pApera vojhA vahana kare|

he navI! tumi tomAra strIderake, tomAra kanyAderake Ara mu’minadera nArIderake vale dAo- tArA yena tAdera cAdarera kichu aMza nijedera upara Tene deYa (yakhana tArA vAr3Ira vAire yAYa), ete tAderake cenA sahajatara have evaM tAderake utyakta karA have nA| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

munAphikarA Ara yAdera antare roga Ache tArA Ara zahare gujava raTanAkArIrA yadi virata nA haYa, tave Ami avazya avazyai tAdera viruddhe tomAke tejodIpta karava, ataHpara tArA tomAra prativezI hiseve e zahare thAkate pArave nA| tave alpadinera janya thAkave
abhizapta avasthAYa; tAderake yekhAnei pAoYA yAve dharA have evaM hatyA karAra matai hatyA karA have|
yArA atIta haYe geche tAdera kSetre eTAi chila AllAhara vidhAna, tumi AllAhara vidhAne kakSano heraphera pAve nA|
loke tomAke kviYAmata samparke prazna kare| vala, tAra jJAna kevala AllAhara nikaTai Ache| kise tomAke jAnAve- sambhavataH kviYAmata nikaTei|
AllAha kAphiraderake abhizApa diYechena Ara tAdera janya jvalanta agni prastuta rekhechena|
tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave, tArA nA pAve kona abhibhAvaka, Ara nA pAve kona sAhAyyakArI|
Agune yedina tAdera mukha upur3a kare deYA have sedina tArA valave- hAYa! AmarA yadi AllAhake mAnatAma o rasUlake mAnatAma|
Ara tArA valave- he AmAdera pAlanakartA! AmarA AmAdera netAderake o AmAdera pradhAnaderake mAnya karatAma| tArAi AmAderake gumarAha karechila|
he AmAdera pAlanakartA! tAderake dviguNa zAsti dAo Ara tAderake mahA abhizApe abhizApa dAo|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA yArA mUsAke kaSTa diYechila| ataHpara tArA yA valechila AllAha tAttheke tAke nirdoSa pramANita karena| se chila AllAhara nikaTa sammAnita|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM sarala saThika kathA vala|
AllAha tomAdera janya tomAdera Amalaguloke truTimukta karavena Ara tomAdera pApaguloke kSamA kare divena| ye vyakti AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kare se sAphalya lAbha kare- mahAsAphalya|

Ami AsamAna, yamIna o parvatera prati (isalAmera vojhA vahana karAra) AmAnAta peza karechilAma| kintu tArA tA vahana karate asvIkRti jAnAla, tArA tAte AzaMkita hala, kintu mAnuSa se dAYitva nila| se var3ai anyAYakArI, var3ai ajJa|

pariNAme AllAha munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArI evaM muzarika puruSa o muzarika nArIke zAsti divena evaM mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArIke kSamA pradarzana karavena| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yAvatIYa prazaMsA AllAhara yini AkAza o pRthivIte yA Ache sava kichura mAlika| AkhirAteo prazaMsA tA~rai; tini mahA prajJAzIla, sakala viSaYe avahita|
bhUmite yA praveza kare Ara tAttheke yA vera haYa, Ara AkAza hate yA avatIrNa haYa Ara tAte yA utthita haYa tA tini jAnena| tini parama daYAlu, parama kSamAzIla|

kAphiragaNa vale- kviYAmata AmAdera nikaTa Asave nA| vala, nA, AmAra pratipAlakera zapatha! tomAdera nikaTa tA avazya avazyai Asave| tini yAvatIYa adRzyera jJAnI| tA~ra theke lukkAYita nei AkAza o pRthivIte kSudrAtikSudra anukaNA, nA tAra theke choTa Ara nA tAra theke var3a (konaTAi nei lukkAYita)| savai Ache (lAohe mAhaphuya nAmaka) eka suspaSTa kitAve|
yAte tini pratidAna dite pArena tAderake yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare, ederai janya Ache kSamA o sammAnajanaka riyaka|
yArA AmAra AYAtake vyartha karAra ceSTA cAlAYa tAderai janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka bhaYAvaha zAsti|

yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche tArA tomAra kAche tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke yA avatIrNa haYeche tAke satya vale jAne evaM (tArA Aro jAne ye) tA mahAparAkramazAlI o prazaMsita (AllAha)’ra pathe paricAlita kare|
kAphiragaNa vale- tomAderake ki AmarA emana ekajana lokera sandhAna deva ye tomAderake khavara deYa ye, tomarA chinna bhinna haYe geleo tomAderake natunabhAve sRSTi karA have?
se AllAha samparke mithye vale, nA haYa se pAgala| vastutaH yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa kare nA tArAi zAsti evaM sudUra gumarAhIte par3e Ache|

tArA ki AkAza o pRthivIte tAdera sAmane o pechane lakSya kare nA? Ami icche karale tAderakesaha bhUmi dhvasiYe deva athavA AkAzera eka Tukaro tAdera upara phele deva| pratiTi AllAha abhimukhI vAndAhara janya ete nidarzana raYeche|

Ami AmAra pakSa theke dAUdera prati anugraha karechilAma| (Ami Adeza karechilAma) he parvatamAlA! tomarA dAUdera saGge AmAra pavitratA ghoSaNA kara Ara pAkhIderakeo (e Adeza karechilAma)| Ami lohAke tAra janya narama karechilAma|
yAte tumi pUrNa mApera varma tairi karate pAra, kar3AsamUha saThikabhAve saMyukta kara Ara tomarA satkarma kara| tomarA yA kara Ami tAra pratyakSadarzI|

Ara sulAimAnera janya (Ami tAra adhIna kare diYechilAma) vAtAsake| tAra sakAlera atikramaNa chila eka mAsera patha Ara sandhyAra atikramaNa chila eka mAsera patha| Ami tAra janya galita tAmAra jharaNA pravAhita karechilAma| kataka jvina tAra sammukhe kAja karata tAra pAlanakartAra anumatikrame| tAdera ye keu AmAra nirdeza amAnya kare, tAke Ami jvalanta Agunera zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

tArA sulAimAnera icche anuyAYI tAra janya prAsAda, bhAskarya, hAuyera nyAYa vRhadAkAra pAtra evaM cullira upara sthApita vizAlAkAYa Dega nirmANa karata| (Ami valechilAma) he dAUdera santAnagaNa! tomarA kRtajJacitte kAja kare yAo| AmAra vAndAdera alpai kRtajJa|

ataHpara Ami yakhana sulAimAnera mRtyu ghaTAlAma, takhana ghuNe pokAi jvinaderake tAra mRtyu samparke avahita karala, tArA (dhIre dhIre) sulAimAnera lAThi kheYe yAcchila| yakhana se par3e gela takhana jvinerA vujhate pArala ye, tArA (nijerA) yadi adRzya viSaYa samparke avagata thAkata tAhale tAderake lAJchanAdAYaka zAstira madhye par3e thAkate hata nA|

sAvAra adhivAsIdera janya tAdera vAsabhUmite ekaTA nidarzana chila- du’To vAgAna; ekaTA DAne, ekaTA vAme| (tAderake valechilAma) tomAdera pratipAlaka pradatta riyaka bhoga kara Ara tA~ra prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara| sukha-zAntira zahara Ara kSamAzIla pAlanakartA|

kintu tArA (AllAha hate) mukha phiriYe nila| kAjei Ami tAdera viruddhe pAThAlAma vA~dha-bhAGgA vanyA, Ara Ami tAdera vAgAna du’Tike parivartita kare dilAma emana du’Ti vAgAne yAte janmita visvAda phala, jhAugAcha Ara kichu kula gAcha|
akRtajJatAbhare tAdera satya pratyAkhyAna karAra janya Ami tAderake e zAsti diYechilAma| Ami akRtajJadera chAr3A emana zAsti kAuke dei nA|

tAdera evaM ye sava janapadera prati Ami anugraha varSaNa karechilAma segulora mAjhe aneka dRzyamAna janapada sthApana kare diYechilAma evaM ogulora mAjhe samAna samAna dUratve saphara manayila kare diYechilAma| (Ara tAderake valechilAma) tomarA e sava janapade rAte Ara dine nirApade bhramaNa kara|

kintu tArA valala- he AmAdera pAlanakartA! AmAdera saphara-maJjilagulora mAjhe vyavadhAna vAr3iYe dAo| tArA nijedera prati yulama karechila| kAjei Ami tAderake kAhinI vAniYe chAr3alAma (ye kAhinI zonAno haYa) Ara tAderake chinna bhinna kare dilAma| ete pratyeka dhairyazIla kRtajJa vyaktira janya nidarzana raYeche|

tAdera vyApAre ivalIsa tAra dhAraNA satya pramANita karala (ye dhAraNA ivalIsa AllAhara nikaTa vyakta karechila ye, alpa saMkhyaka vyatIta se mAnuSaderake nijera vazIbhUta kare chAr3ave)| phale mu’minadera ekaTi dala chAr3A tArA savAi tAra anusaraNa karala|
tAdera upara zaYatvAnera kona kSamatA chila nA, tave ke AkhirAte vizvAsa kare Ara ke tAte sandeha kare, tA prakAza karAi chila AmAra uddezya| tomAra pratipAlaka sakala viSaYe hiphAyAtakArI|

vala, AllAhara parivarte tomarA yAderake (ilAha) mane karate tAderake DAka| tArA AsamAna o yamIne aNu parimANao kona kichura mAlika naYa| e du’Ye tAdera etaTuku aMza nei, Ara tAdera keu AllAhara sAhAyyakArIo naYa|

tA~ra kAche supAriza kona kAje Asave nA, tave tAdera vyatIta yAderake tini anumati devena| ataHpara tAdera (arthAt AllAhara naikaTyalAbhakArI pherezatAra kiMvA anyera janya supAriza karAra anumatiprAptadera) antara theke yakhana bhaYa dUra have takhana tArA paraspara jijJesa karave- tomAdera pAlanakartA kI nirdeza dilena? tArA valave- yA satya o nyAYa (tAra nirdezai tini diYechena), tini sarvocca, sarvazreSTha|
vala- AsamAna o yamIna hate ke tomAderake riyaka dAna karena? vala- AllAha| haYa AmarA, nA haYa tomarA avazyai satpathe paricAlita athavA spaSTa gumarAhite patita|
vala- AmAdera aparAdhera janya tomarA jijJAsita have nA, Ara tomarA yA kara tAra janya AmAderake javAvadihi karate have nA|
vala- AmAdera pAlanakartA AmAderake ekatrita karavena avazeSe tini AmAdera mAjhe satya o nyAYasaGgatabhAve phaYasAlA karavena| tini sarvazreSTha phaYasAlAkArI, sarvajJAtA|
vala- tomarA AmAke (tAderake) dekhAo yAderake tomarA tA~ra aMzIdAra jur3e diYecha| kakSano (dekhAte pArave) nA, varaM tini AllAha, mahAparAkramazAlI, mahAprajJAmaYa|
Ami tomAke samagra mAnavamanDalIra janya susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe preraNa karechi, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
tArA vale- tumi yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale vala, (tomAra zunAno) o‘YAdA kakhana vAstavAYita have?
vala- tomAdera janya Ache eka nirdhArita dina yA tomarA eka muhUrtakAlera janya vilamvita karate pArave nA, Ara tvarAnvita karateo pArave nA|

kAphiragaNa vale- AmarA e kuraAne kakSano vizvAsa karava nA, Ara tAra Agera kitAvaguloteo nA| tumi yadi dekhate! yakhana yAlimaderake tAdera pratipAlakera sammukhe dA~r3a karAno have, takhana tArA paraspara vAdAnuvAda karave| yAderake durvala ka’re rAkhA haYechila tArA dAmbhikaderake valave- tomarA nA thAkale AmarA avazyai mu’mina hatAma|
yAderake durvala ka’re rAkhA haYechila dAmbhikarA tAderake valave- tomAdera kAche satya pathera dizA AsAra para AmarA ki tomAderake tAttheke vAdhA diYechilAma? varaM tomarA nijerAi chile aparAdhI|

yAderake durvala ka’re rAkhA haYechila tArA dAmbhikadera valave- tomarAi to varaM dina-rAta cakrAnta karate| tomarA AmAderake nirdeza dite yAte AmarA AllAhake asvIkAra kari Ara tA~ra samakakSa sthira kari| yakhana tArA zAsti dekhave takhana manera anutApa manei lukiYe rAkhave, Ara Ami kAphiradera galAYa zRGkhala pariYe deva| tArA yA (duniYAte) karata tAra pratiphalai tAderake deYA have|
yakhanai kona janapade Ami satarkakArI pAThiYechi, sekhAnakAra vittavAnarA valeche tomAderake yA diYe pAThAno haYeche AmarA tA asvIkAra karachi|
tArA valata- dhana-mAla Ara vAla-vAccAYa AmarA vezi, AmarA zAstiprApta hate pAri nA|
vala- AmAra pratipAlaka yAra janya cAna riyaka prazasta karena vA sImita karena, kintu (era tAtparya) adhikAMza lokai jAne nA|

oTA nA tomAdera mAla-dhana, Ara nA tomAdera santAna-santati yA tomAderake AmAra nikaTavartI karave| tave ye keu ImAna Ane Ara satkAja kare tAderai janya Ache vahuguNa pratidAna tAdera kAjera janya| tArA suucca prAsAde nirApade thAkave|
yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha karAra janya ceSTA cAlAYa, tAderake ‘AyAve upasthita karA have|

vala- AmAra pratipAlakai tA~ra vAndAhadera madhye yAra janya icche riyaka prazasta karena, Ara yAra janya icche sImita karena| tomarA yA kichu (sat kAje) vyaYa kara, tini tAra vinimaYa devena| tinii sarvazreSTha riyakadAtA|
yedina tini tAdera savavAike ekatrita karavena, ataHpara pherezatAderake valave-orA ki ekamAtra tomAderai pUjA karata?
pherezatArA valave- pavitra mahAna tumi, tumii AmAdera abhibhAvaka, tArA naYa| varaM tArA jvinadera pUjA karata; odera adhikAMzai odera prati vizvAsI chila|
Aja tomAdera eke anyera kona lAbha vA kSati karate pArave nA| yArA yulama karechila tAderake Ami valava- tomarA jAhAnnAmera zAsti AsvAdana kara yA tomarA mithye vale asvIkAra karate|

tAdera sammukhe yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha tilAoYAta karA haYa takhana tArA vale- eTA to emana ekajana mAnuSa, ye tomAderake tomAdera pUrvapuruSa yAra ‘ivAdAta karata tAttheke vAdhA dite cAYa| tArA Aro vale ye, eTA managar3A mithye chAr3A Ara kichui naYa| satya yakhana kAphiradera nikaTa Ase takhana tArA vale- eTA to suspaSTa yAdu|
Ami tAderake (arthAt makkAra kurAYazadera) kona kitAva deini yA tArA pATha karata Ara Ami tomAra pUrve tAdera kAche kona satarkakArIo pAThAini|

tAdera pUrvavartIrAo (satyake) mithye vale asvIkAra karechila| Ami tAderake yA diYechilAma, erA tAra eka dazamAMzao pAYani| tavuo orA yakhana AmAra rasUlagaNake asvIkAra karechila takhana kata bhaYaMkara haYechila AmAra zAsti|

vala- Ami tomAderake ekaTi viSaya়e nasIhata karachiH tomarA AllAhara uddezye du’ du’jana vA eka ekajana kare dA~Da়Ao, ataHpara cintA kare dekha, tomAdera saGgI unmAda naya়| se to sAmanera kaThina zAsti samparke ekajana satarkakArI mAtra|
vala- Ami tomAdera nikaTa hate kona pArizramika cAi nA, varaM tA tomAderai janya| AmAra puraskAra Ache kevala AllAhara kAche| tini sakala viSaYe pratyakSadarzI|
vala- AmAra pratipAlaka satya chu~r3e dena (asatyake AghAta karAra janye)| (yAvatIYa) adRzya samparke tini pUrNarUpe avagata|
vala- satya ese geche, Ara mithyera natuna kare AvirbhAvao ghaTave nA, Ara tAra punarAvRttio have nA|

vala- Ami yadi gumarAha hai, tave nijera kSati karatei gumarAha hava| Ara Ami yadi sat pathe cali, tave AmAra pratipAlaka ye AmAra prati oYAhI karena tAra vadaulatei| tini sarvazrotA, (sadA) sannikaTavartI| (AhavAnakArIra DAke sAr3A dena|)
tumi yadi dekhate! yakhana tArA bhaYe kampamAna haYe par3ave, kintu tArA kona avyAhati pAve nA| ekkevAre kAchera jAYagA thekei tAderake dhare phelA have|
Ara tArA valave- (ekhana) AmarA ImAna AnalAma| kintu (ImAna yekhAne Anate hata se sthAna theke tArA to vahu dUre ese par3eche) eta dUrera jAYagA theke tArA ImAnera nAgAla pAve kIbhAve?
tArA to Agei tA pratyAkhyAna karechila| tArA adRzya viSaYa samparke vahu dUra theke (AndAja anumAne) kathA chu~r3e dita|
tAdera evaM tAdera kAmanA-vAsanAra mAjhe rekhe deYA haYeche eka prAcIra| tAdera matera o pathera lokedera kSetre pUrveo emanaTii karA haYechila| tArA chila saMzaYapUrNa sandehe patita|

yAvatIYa prazaMsA AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sRSTikartA AllAhara janya| tini dUta manonIta karena pherezatAmanDalIke, yArA dui dui vA tina tina vA cAra cAra DAnA viziSTa| tini sRSTite yA icche vRddhi karena| AllAha sakala viSaYera upara sarvazaktimAna|
AllAha mAnuSera janya tA~ra anugraha theke yA khule dena tA nivAraNa karAra keu nei| Ara tini yA vArita karena ataHpara keu tA preraNa karate pAre nA| tini mahAparAkramazAlI, mahAprajJAmaYa|

he mAnuSa! tomarA tomAdera prati AllAhara anugrahera kathA smaraNa kara| tini chAr3A kona sRSTikartA Ache ki ye tomAderake AkAza o yamIna theke riyaka dAna kare? tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, tAhale kIbhAve tomarA vipathagAmI haccha?

tArA yadi tomAke mithye vale asvIkAra kare, tAhale (tAdera e AcaraNa to kona natuna viSaya় naya়) tomAra pUrveo rasUladerake mithye vale asvIkAra karA haya়eche| (ye yA-i kichu karuka nA kena) samasta kAryakalApa (hisAva nikAzera janya) AllAhara kAche phire yAve|
he mAnuSa! AllAhara oYA‘dA satya, kAjei pArthiva jIvana kichutei yena tomAderake pratArita nA kare; Ara sei pradhAna pratAraka (zaYatvAna) yena kichutei tomAderake AllAha samparke pratArita nA kare|
zaYatvAna tomAdera zatru, kAjei tAke zatru hiseve grahaNa kara| se kevala tAra dalavalake DAke, yAte tArA jvalanta agnira saGgI haYa|
yArA kuphurI kare tAdera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti| Ara yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkAja kare tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o mahA pratiphala|

yAke tAra manda karma zobhanIYa ka’re dekhAno haYa, ataHpara se seTAke uttama mane kare (se ki tAra samAna, ye sat pathe paricAlita?) AllAha yAke icche vipathagAmI karena, Ara yAke icche saThika pathe paricAlita karena| kAjei tAdera janya AkSepa ka’re, tumi tomAra jIvanake dhvaMsa hate dio nA| tArA yA kare AllAha tA khuva bhAlabhAvei jAnena|

AllAha, yini vAYu preraNa karena, ataHpara tA megha saJcAra kare, ataHpara Ami tA nirjIva bhUkhanDera dike paricAlita kari| ataHpara Ami tA diYe mRttikAke tAra mRtyura para AvAra saJjIvita kari| ebhAvei (ghaTave) punarutthAna|

keu sammAna-sukhyAti cAile (AllAhake upekSA kare tA lAbha karA yAve nA), se jene nika yAvatIYa sammAna-sukhyAtira adhikArI halena AllAha| tA~rai dike utthita haYa pavitra kathAgulo Ara satkAja seguloke ucce tule dhare| yArA manda kAjera cakrAnta kare tAdera janya Ache kaThina zAsti| tAdera cakrAnta niSphala have|

AllAha tomAderake mATi theke sRSTi karechena, ataHpara zukra-vindu hate, ataHpara tini tomAderake karechena (svAmI-strIra) jor3A| tA~ra avagati vyatIta kona nArI garbha dhAraNa kare nA vA (tAra vojhA) hAlakA kare nA| kona dIrghAYura AYu dIrgha karA haYa nA, Ara tAra AYu kamAno haYa nA kitAvera likhana chAr3A| eTA (arthAt e savera hisAva rAkhA o tattvAvadhAna karA) AllAhara janya sahaja|

du’Ti dariYAo eka rakama naYa| ekaTi sumiSTa, susvAdu, supeYa; anyaTi lavaNAkta, visvAda| tathApi tomarA sakala (prakAra pAni) theke tAjA gozata AhAra kara Ara vera kara alaMkAra- paridhAna karAra janye| tomarA dekhate pAo nauyAnagulo DheuYera vuka cire calAcala kare yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha kho~ja karate pAra, Ara yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

tini rAtake dine DhukiYe dena, Ara dinake rAte DhukiYe dena| tini sUrya o candrake tA~ra niYantraNera adhIne (kAje niYojita) rekhechena| pratyekei nirdhArita samaYa anusAre gatizIla Ache| ei halena AllAha, tomAdera pratipAlaka| rAjatva tA~rai| tomarA tA~ra parivarte yAderake DAka tArA to khejurera aA~Ti saMlagna (atyanta pAtalA o durvala) AvaraNerao mAlika naYa|

tomarA tAderake DAkale tArA tomAdera DAka zunave nA Ara yadi zuneo, tavuo tomAdera (DAke) sAr3A dite pArave nA| Ara tomarA ye tAderake (AllAhara) aMzIdAra gaNya karate, kviYAmatera dina tA tArA asvIkAra karave| keui tomAderake sarvajJa AllAhara mata khavara jAnAte pArave nA|
he mAnuSa! tomarAi AllAhara mukhApekSI, Ara AllAha tini to abhAvahIna, prazaMsita|
tini icche karale tomAderake vilupta karate pArena, Ara eka natuna sRSTi Anate pArena|
eTA AllAhara pakSe kaThina naYa|

kona vahanakArI anyera (pApera) vojhA vaive nA| keu yadi tAra gurubhAra vaYe deYAra janya anyake DAke tave tAra kichui vaYe deYA have nA- nikaTAtmIYa haleo| tumi kevala tAderakei satarka karate pAra, yArA nA dekhei tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare Ara nAmAya pratiSThA kare| ye keu nijeke parizuddha kare se to parizuddha kare nijera kalyANei| AllAhara dikei (sakalera) pratyAvartana|
andha Ara cokhaoYAlA samAna naYa|
Ara andhakAra o Aloo (samAna naYa)|
Ara chAYA o rodao (samAna naYa)|
Ara jIvita o mRtao samAna naYa| AllAha yAke icche karena zonAna; yArA kvavare Ache tumi tAderake zonAte pAra nA|
tumi to kevala ekajana satarkakArI|
Ami tomAke satyasaha pAThiYechi susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe| emana kona sampradAYa nei yAte satarkakArI Aseni|

tArA yadi tomAke mithye va’le asvIkAra kare, (tAhale jene rekha, eTA kona natuna vyApAra naYa, kAraNa) tAdera pUrvavartIrAo (navI-rasUladerake) mithye va’le asvIkAra karechila| tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzana, likhita dalIla o Alokaprada kitAva niYe esechila|
yArA kupharI karechila, ataHpara Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilAma| kI (bhaYaMkara) chila AmAra zAsti!
tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAha AkAza hate pAni varSaNa karena, ataHpara Ami tA diYe raM veraMYera phalamUla udagata kari| pAhAr3era madhye Ache vibhinna varNera giripatha- sAdA, lAla Ara nikaSa kAlo|
temanibhAve mAnuSa, jIva-jantu Ara gRhapAlita pazudera madhyeo raYeche tAdera vibhinna raM| AllAhara vAndAhadera madhye tArAi tA~ke bhaYa kare yArA jJAnI| AllAha mahA kSamatAzAlI, parama daYAlu|

yArA AllAhara kitAva tilAoYAta kare, nAmAya pratiSThA kare Ara AllAha tAderake ye riyaka diYechena tAtheke gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare, tArA emana eka vyavasAYera AzA kare yAte kakSano lokasAna have nA|
kAraNa, tini tAderake tAdera pratiphala pUrNamAtrAYa dAna karavena evaM nija anugrahe Aro vezi divena| tini ati kSamAzIla, (bhAla kAjera) var3ai maryAdAdAnakArI|
Ami ye kitAvaTi hate tomAra prati oYAhI karechi tA satya, pUrvavartI kitAvera satyAYanakArI| AllAha tA~ra vAndAhadera samparke avazyai sava khavara rAkhena evaM sava dekhena|

ataHpara sei kitAvaTira uttarAdhikArI karechi Ami AmAra vAndAhadera madhye hate yAderake veche niYechi| ataHpara tAdera kataka nijedera prati atyAcAra kareche, Ara kataka madhyapanthI| tAdera kataka AllAhara nirdeze sat kAje agraNI| eTAi (mAnuSera prati AllAhara) khuvai var3a daYA|
sthAYI jAnnAte tArA praveza karave| yekhAne tAderake svarNa o muktAra kaGkaNe alaGkRta karA have| yekhAne tAdera pozAka have rezamera|
Ara tArA valave- yAvatIYa prazaMsA AllAhara yini AmAdera duHkha kaSTa dUra kare diYechena| AmAdera pratipAlaka avazyai parama kSamAzIla, (bhAla kAjera) var3ai maryAdAdAnakArI|
yini svIYa anugrahe AmAderake sthAYI AvAsa dAna karechena| sekhAne kleza AmAderake sparza kare nA, klAntio AmAderake sparza kare nA|

Ara yArA kuphurI kare, tAdera janya Ache jAhAnnAmera Aguna| tAdera janya kona samaYa nirdhAraNa karA have nA ye, tArA (nirdhArita samaYa Asale) mare yAve, Ara tAdera theke zAstio kamAno have nA| pratyeka akRtajJake Ami ebhAvei pratiphala diYe thAki|

sekhAne tArA citkAra kare valave- he AmAdera pAlanakartA! vera karuna AmAderake, AmarA satkAja karava, AmarA ye kAja karatAma tA karava nA| Ami ki tomAderake etaTA vaYasa deini ye, takhana keu nasIhata grahaNa karate cAile nasIhata grahaNa karate pArate? Ara tomAdera kAche satarkakArIo esechila| kAjei zAsti bhoga kara, yAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|
AllAha AsamAna yamInera adRzya viSaYa samparke avagata| antare yA Ache se samparke tini vizeSabhAve jJAta|

tini tomAderake pRthivIte (nijera) pratinidhi karechena| ataeva ye kuphurI karave tAra kuphurIra janya se nijei dAYI have| kAphiradera kuphara tAdera pratipAlakera ghRNAi vRddhi kare| kAphiradera kuphara tAdera kSatii vRddhi kare|
