vala- tomarA ki tomAdera zarIkaderake dekhecha AllAhara parivarte tomarA yAderake Deke thAka? tArA pRthivIte kI sRSTi kareche tA AmAke dekhAo; kiMvA AkAzamanDalIte tAdera kona zarIkAnA Ache ki? kiMvA Ami ki tAderake kona kitAva diYechi yAttheke kona suspaSTa pramANera upara tArA Ache? varaM sImAlaGghanakArIrA eke aparake pratAraNAmUlaka oYA‘dA diYe thAke|
AllAhai AsamAna o yamInake sthira rAkhena yAte o du’To Tale nA yAYa| o du’To yadi Tale yAYa tAhale tini chAr3A ke o du’Toke sthira rAkhave? tini parama sahiSNu, parama kSamAzIla|

Ara tArA (arthAt makkAra muzarikarA) zaktabhAve kasama kheYe valata ye, tAdera kAche satarkakArI Asale tArA anya ye kona sampradAYera ceYe avazya avazyai sat pathera adhika anusArI haYe yAve| kintu tAdera kAche yakhana satarkakArI Asala, tA vAr3iYei tulala tAdera ghRNA,

yamIne uddhata AcaraNa Ara ku-cakrAnta| ku-cakrAnta tAkei ghire dharave ye tA karave| tAhale tArA ki tAdera pUrvavartIdera upara (AllAhara pakSa hate) ye vidhAna praYoga karA haYeche tArai apekSA karache? tumi AllAhara vidhAne kakSano kona parivartana pAve nA| tumi AllAhara vidhAne kakSano kona vyatikrama pAve nA|

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kare nA? tAhale dekhata, tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kI haYechila| tArA to zaktite chila edera ceYeo zaktizAlI| AsamAna o yamInera kona kichui AllAhake apAraga karate pAre nA| tini sarvajJAtA, sakala zaktira adhikArI|

AllAha mAnuSake tAra kRtakarmera janya pAkar3Ao karate cAile bhUpRSThera ekaTi prANIkeo rehAi ditena nA| kintu tini tAdera janya ekaTA nirdhArita kAla paryanta samaYa vilamvita karena| ataHpara tAdera se nirdhArita samaYa yakhana ese yAYa, (takhana AllAhara phaYasAlA kAryakarI hate eka muhUrtao vilamva ghaTe nA), kAraNa AllAha (pratiTi muhUrte) tA~ra vAndAhadera paryavekSaNakArI|

tumi avazyai rasUlagaNera antarbhukta|
tumi sarala saThika pathe pratiSThita|
(e kuraAna) mahAparAkramazAlI parama karuNAmaYa (AllAha) hate avatIrNa|
yAte tumi satarka karate pAra emana eka sampradAYake yAdera piRtapuruSaderake satarka karA haYani, kAjei tArA (AllAhara nidarzana samparke) udAsIna|
(jene vujhe AllAhara avAdhya haoYAra kAraNe) tAdera adhikAMzera upara (tAdera antaHkaraNe sIla lAgiYe deYAra) vANI avadhArita haYe geche, kAjei tArA ImAna Anave nA|
Ami tAdera galadeze (tAdera jida o ahamikAra) ver3i pariYe diYechi Ara tA thutani paryanta (giYe Thekeche), kAjei tArA mAthA khAr3A kare rekheche|
tAdera sAmane Ami ekaTA (vAdhAra) prAcIra dA~r3a kariYe diYechi, Ara pechane ekaTA prAcIra, uparantu tAderake Dheke diYechi; kAjei tArA dekhate pAYa nA|
tumi tAderake satarka kara Ara nA kara, tAdera kAche du’Toi samAna, tArA ImAna Anave nA|
tumi to satarka kevala tAkei karate pAra ye loka upadeza mene cale Ara daYAmaYa (AllAha)-ke nA dekheo bhaYa kare| ataHpara ederake tumi kSamA o sammAnajanaka puraskArera susaMvAda dAo|
Amii mRtake jIvita kari, Ara likhe rAkhi yA tArA Age pAThiYe deYa Ara yA pechane cher3e yAYa| sava kichui Ami spaSTa kitAve saMrakSita kare rekhechi|
tAdera kAche dRSTAnta svarUpa eka janapadavAsIdera kathA zuniYe dAo yakhana tAdera kAche esechila rasUlagaNa|

yakhana tAdera kAche du’jana rasUla pAThiYechilAma takhana tArA se du’janake mithye va’le pratyAkhyAna karala| ataHpara Ami tRtIYa Arekajana dvArA tAdera zakti vRddhi karalAma| tArA valala- AmarA tomAdera prati prerita haYechi|
janapadavAsIrA valala- tomarA to AmAderai mata mAnuSa vatIta anya kichu nao| Ara daYAmaYa (AllAha) kona kichui nAyila karenani| tomarA zudhu mithyei valacha|
rasUlagaNa valala- AmAdera pAlanakartA jAnena AmarA avazyai tomAdera prati prerita haYechi|
spaSTabhAve (AllAhara vANI) pau~che deYAi AmAdera ekamAtra dAYitva|

janapadera lokerA valala- AmarA tomAderakei amaGgalera kAraNa mane kari| tomarA yadi (pracArakArya theke) nivRtta nA hao, tAhale AmarA avazya avazyai tomAderake pAthara mere hatyA karava evaM AmAdera pakSa theke var3ai marmAntika zAsti tomAdera upara avazya avazyai neme Asave|

rasUlagaNa valala- tomAdera amaGgalera kAraNa tomAdera sAthei Ache (Ara tA hala tomAdera apakarma)| tomAderake nasIhata karA halei ki (seTAke tomarA tomAdera amaGgalera kAraNa mane kara)? Asale tomarA haccha eka sImAlaGghanakArI jAti|
nagara prAnta theke eka loka chuTe Asalo| se valala- he AmAra jAtira lokerA! tomarA rasUladera mAnya kara|
tomarA mAnya kara ederake- yArA tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAYa nA| uparantu tArA saThika pathe paricAlita|
kena Ami tA~ra ‘ivAdAta karava nA yini AmAke sRSTi karechena, Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phire yete have?

Ami ki tA~ra parivarte (anya) sava ilAh grahaNa karava? karuNAmaYa AllAha yadi AmAra kona kSati karate cAna tave AmAra janya tAdera supAriza konai kAje Asave nA, Ara tArA AmAke uddhAra karateo pArave nA|
tA yadi kari, tAhale Ami spaSTa pathabhraSTatei patita hava|
Ami to tomAdera pAlanakartAra upara ImAna enechi, kAjei tomarA AmAra kathA zuna|
(lokerA tAke hatyA kare phelale AllAhara pakSa theke) tAke valA hala- jAnnAte praveza kara| (takhana) se valala- hAYa! AmAra jAtira lokerA yadi jAnata,
AmAra pAlanakartA kon jinisera vadaulate AmAke kSamA karechena Ara AmAke sammAnitadera antarbhukta karechena|
Ami tAra mRtyura para tAra jAtira viruddhe AsamAna theke kona sainyavAhinI pAThAini, Ara tA pAThAnora AmAra kona darakArao chila nA|
oTA chila mAtra ekaTA pracanDa zavda, phale tArA sahasAi nistavdha haYe gela|
vAndAhadera janya paritApa! tAdera kAche emana kona rasUlai Aseni yAke tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa kareni|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, tAdera pUrve Ami kata mAnavagoSThIke dhvaMsa kare diYechi? tArA tAdera kAche phire Asave nA|
tAdera savvAike ekatre AmAra kAche hAjira karA have|
mRta yamIna tAdera janya ekaTA nidarzana| tAke Ami jIvita kari Ara tA theke Ami utpanna kari zasya yA theke tArA khAYa|
Ara Ami tAte khejura o AGgurera vAgAna tairi kari, Ara tAte pravAhita kari jharNAdhArA|
yAte tArA tAra phala khete pAre- yA tArA tAdera hAta diYe vAnAYani| tAhale kena tArA kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA?
pUta pavitra sei sattA yini jor3A sRSTi karechena pratyekaTira yA utpanna kare yamIna, Ara tAdera nijedera bhitareo Ara se saveo yA tArA jAne nA|
tAdera janya ekaTi nidarzana hacche rAta, tAttheke Ami dinake sariYe nei, phale takhanai tArA andhakAre Duve yAYa|
Ara sUrya tAra janye nirdiSTa ka’re deYA jAYagAYa gatizIla, eTA mahA parAkramazAlI sarvajJera sunirUpita nirdhAraNa|
Ara cA~da-tAra janya Ami nirdiSTa karechi vibhinna mAnyila (yA se atikrama kare), emanaki zeSa paryanta seTi khejurera kA~dira purAno zukano danDera mata haYe phire Ase|
sUryera pakSe sambhava naYa cA~dake dhare phelA, Ara rAtera pakSe sambhava naYa dinake chAr3iYe Age ver3e yAoYA, pratyekei nija nija kakSa pathe sA~tAra kATache|
tAdera janya (AmAra kudarAtera) Aro ekaTi nidarzana ei ye, Ami tAdera vaMzadharaderake (mahA plAvaNera samaYa) bharA naukAYa ArohaNa kariYechi|
Ara tAdera janya ai dharanera Aro yAnavAhana tairi karechi yAte tArA ArohaNa kare thAke|
Ami icche karale tAderake DuviYe dite pAri, takhana (tAdera phariYAda zunAra janya) kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA, Ara tArA paritrANao pAve nA
AmAra rahamata nA hale, Ara kichu kAlera janya tAderake jIvana upabhoga karate nA dile|

tAderake yakhana valA haYa ‘‘tomAdera sAmane ye pariNAma Asache tAttheke Ara tomAdera pechanera (atIta jAtigulora upara ghaTe geche se rakama) ‘AyAva theke nijederake rakSA kara yAte tomAdera upara rahama karA haYa (takhana tArA mukha phiriYe neYa)|’’
tAdera kAche tAdera pratipAlakera nidarzana theke yakhanai kona nidarzana Ase takhanai tArA tAttheke mukha phiriYe neYa|

tAderake yakhana valA haYa ‘AllAha tomAderake ye riyaka diYechena tAttheke tomarA (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kara; takhana kAphirarA mu’minaderake vale, ‘‘AmarA ki emana lokake khAoYAvo AllAha icche karale yAke khAoYAte pAratena? tomarA to spaSTa pathabhraSTate par3e Acha|
Ara tArA vale, ‘‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale vala, (kviYAmatera) e o‘YAdA kakhana pUrNa have?’’
tArA ye janya apekSA karache seTAto ekaTA pracanDa zavda yA tAderake pAkar3Ao karave yakhana tArA nijedera madhye vAka-vitanDAYa lipta thAkave|
(kviYAmata emanai haThAt AkramaNa karave ye) tArA nA pArave osIYAta karate Ara nA pArave tAdera parivAra parijanera kAche phire yete|
Ara yakhana ziGgAYa phu~ka deYA have, takhanai tArA kvavara theke tAdera pAlanakartAra dike chuTe Asave|

tArA valave, ‘hAYa AmAdera durbhoga! AmAderake AmAdera ghumera jAYagA theke ke uThAlo? (tAderake javAva deYA have) ‘‘eTA hala tAi- daYAmaYa AllAha yAra o‘YAdA diYechilena, Ara rasUlagaNao satya kathAi valechilena|’
mAtra ekaTA pracanDa zavda have, takSuNi tAdera savvAike AmAra sAmane hAjira karA have|
Aja kAro prati kona yulama karA have nA, tomarA ye ‘AmAla karachile tomAderake kevala tArai pratiphala deYA have|
se dina jAnnAtIrA Anande mazagula haYe thAkave|
tArA Ara tAdera strIrA suzItala chAYAYa, u~cu u~cu Asane helAna diYe vasave|
tAdera janya sekhAne thAkave phalamUla Ara tAdera janya thAkave tArA yA kichu pete cAive|
daYAmaYa pratipAlakera pakSa theke tAderake ‘sAlAma’ vale sambhASaNa karA have|
(se dina valA have) ‘he aparAdhIrA! Aja tomarA AlAdA haYe yAo|’
‘he AdAma santAna! Ami ki tomAderake nirdeza deini ye, tomarA zaYatvAnera ‘ivAdAta karo nA, kAraNa se tomAdera prakAzya duzamana?
Ara AmArai ‘ivAdAta kara, eTAi sarala saThika patha|
(kintu tomAderake satarka kare deYA sattveo) zaYatvAna tomAdera vahu dalake vibhrAnta kare diYeche, tavuo ki tomarA vujha nA?
eTA sei jAhAnnAma ye viSaYe tomAderake bhaYa dekhAno haYechila|
Aja tAte praveza kara, kenanA tomarA eTAke avizvAsa karechile|’
Aja Ami tAdera mukhe sIla mohara lAgiYe deva, tAdera hAta AmAra saGge kathA valave, Ara tArA yA karata se samparke tAdera pAgulo sAkSya deve|
Ami icche karale tAdera dRSTizakti vilupta kare ditAma| takhana tArA pathera dike dau~r3e dekhate cAile kIbhAve tArA dekhate peta?
Ami icche karale tAdera nija nija jAYagAtei tAdera AkRti parivartana kare ditAma, takhana tArA nA sAmanera dike calate pArata, Ara nA pArata pechane phire yete|
Ami yAke dIrgha jIvana dei, tAke sRSTira kSetre pUrvera avasthAYa phiriYe Ani| tavuo ki tArA vujhe nA?
[kAphirarA rasUla (sA.)-ke uddezya kare vale, lokaTA ekaTA kavi| kintu) Ami rasUlake kavitA zikhAini, Ara tA tAra janya zobhanIYao naYa| tAto eka upadeza o spaSTa kuraAna vyatIta anya kichu naYa|
yAte se (AtmikabhAve) jIvitake satarka karate pAre Ara kAphiradera viruddhe akATya dalIla hate pAre|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye AmAra hAte tairi jinisagulora madhye Ami tAdera janya sRSTi karechi gRhapAlita pazu Ara ekhana tArA egulora mAlika!
Ami eguloke tAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechi, phale egulora kataka tAdera vAhana, Ara edera katakagulo tArA khAYa|
tAdera janya egulote Ache vahu upakAra Ara pAnIYa dravya| tavuo tArA kena zukariYA AdAYa kare nA?
tArA AllAhara parivarte aneka ilAha grahaNa kareche ei AzAYa ye, tArA (ai sava ilAha dvArA) sAhAyyaprApta have|
ai sava ilAha tAderake sAhAyya karate sakSama naYa, varaM (ulTo) e lokerAi (ai sava ilAhake sAhAyya karAra janya) sadA prastuta senAvAhinIra mata hAyira haYe Ache|
kAjei tAdera kathAvArtA tomAke yena duHkha nA deYa; Ami jAni tArA yA gopana kare, Ara yA prakAza kare|
mAnuSa ki dekhe nA ye Ami tAke sRSTi karechi zukravindu hate? ataHpara se haYe gela suspaSTa jhagar3ATe|
se (AmAra sRSTira sAthe) AmAra tulanA kare, athaca se tAra nijera sRSTira vyapAraTi bhule yAYa (ye tAke Amii sRSTi karechi)| se vale, ‘hAr3aguloke ke AvAra jIvanta karave yakhana tA pace gale yAve?’’
vala, ‘‘tAke tinii jIvanta karavena yini oguloke prathamavAra sRSTi karechena, Ara tini pratiTi sRSTi samparke savaceYe vezi avagata|
yini tomAdera janya savuja gAcha hate Aguna tairi karechena, ataHpara tomarA tAttheke Aguna jvAlAo|
yini AsamAna yamIna sRSTi karechena tini ki sei lokadera anurUpa (AvAra) sRSTi karate sakSama nana? hA~, avazyai| tini mahA sraSTA, sarvajJa|
tA~ra kAjakarma kevala e rakama ye, yakhana tini kona kichura icche karena takhana tAke hukuma karena ye haYe yAo, Ara amani tA haYe yAYa|
kAjei pavitra o mahAna tini yA~ra hAte sava kichura sarvamaYa kartRtva, Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAdera (sakalake) phiriYe AnA have|
zapatha tAdera yArA sArivaddhabhAve dA~r3Ano,
ataHpara yArA dhamaka diYe tiraskAra kare tAdera zapatha,
Ara yArA (AllAhara) yikara AvRttite lipta,
tomAdera prakRta ilAha avazya ekajana|
yini AsamAna, yamIna Ara e du’Yera mAjhe yA Ache evaM sakala udaYa sthalera mAlika|
Ami nikaTavartI AsamAnake tArakArAjira saundarya dvArA suzobhita karechi,
Ara (eTA karechi) pratyeka vidrohI zaYatvAna theke surakSAra vyavasthA hiseve|
yAra phale tArA uccatara jagatera kichu zunate pAre nA, caturdika theke tAdera prati nikSepa karA haYa (ulkApinDa)
(tAderake) tAr3Anora janya| tAdera janya Ache virAmahIna zAsti|
tave keu cho~ mere kichu zune phelale jvalanta ulkApinDa tAra pichu neYa|
tAderake jijJesa kara- sRSTira kSetre ki tArAi vezi pravala, nA Ami anya yA kichu sRSTi karechi tA (vezi pravala)? Ami to tAderake sRSTi karechi (ati nagaNya) mATi theke|
(AllAhara zakti-kSamatA-mahimA dekhe) tumi kara vismaYavodha, Ara tArA kare vidrUpa|
tAderake upadeza deYA hale tArA upadeza neYa nA|
tArA AllAhara kona nidarzana dekhale ThATTA kare|
Ara tArA vale- ‘eTA spaSTa yAdu chAr3A Ara kichui nA|’
AmarA yakhana marava evaM mATi o hAr3e pariNata hava, takhano ki AmAderake AvAra jIvita kare uThAno have?
evaM AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderakeo (uThAno have)?’
tAderake vala, ‘hA~, evaM tomarA have lAJchita|’
oTA (have) mAtra ekaTA pracanDa zavda, Ara takhanai tArA svacakSe (sava kichu) dekhate pAve|
tArA Aro valave- ‘‘hAYa AmAdera durbhAgya! eTAi to karmaphalera dina|’
eTAi phaYasAlAra dina yAke tomarA mithye vale asvIkAra karate|
(hukuma deYA have) ‘ekatra kara yAlimaderake Ara tAdera saGgIderake evaM tAderakeo, yAdera tArA ‘ivAdAta karata
AllAhara (‘ivAdAtera) parivarte, Ara tAderake jAhAnnAmera patha dekhAo|
ataHpara oderake thAmAo oderake to prazna karA have-
‘tomAdera haYeche kI, tomarA parasparake sAhAyya karacha nA kena?’
varaM Aja tArA (vicArera sAmane) AtmasamaparNa karave|
tArA eke aparera dike mukha kare paraspara jijJAsAvAda karave|
tArA (tAdera kSamatAzAlIderake) valave, ‘‘tomarA to tomAdera kSamatA niYe AmAdera kAche Asate|’
tArA (arthAt kSamatAra adhikArIrA) uttara dive- ‘‘tomarA to (vicAra divasera prati) vizvAsIi chile nA|
Ara tomAdera upara AmAdera kona kartRtvao chila nA, varaM tomarA chile sImAlaGghanakArI jAti|
AmAdera vipakSe AmAdera pAlanakartAra uktii satya haYeche, AmAderake avazyai zAstira svAda nite have|
Asale AmarAi tomAderake gomarAha karechilAma, kAraNa AmarA nijerAo gomarAha chilAma|’
sedina (durvala Ara savala) savAi ‘AyAve zarIka have|
aparAdhIdera prati Ami e rakamai (AcaraNa) kare thAki|
tAderake yakhana ‘AllAha chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei’ valA hata, takhana tArA ahaMkAra karata|
Ara tArA valata, ‘‘AmarA ki eka pAgalA kavira kathA mene AmAdera ilAhaguloke tyAga karava?
varaM se [arthAt muhAmmAda (sA.)] satya niYe eseche evaM (pUrve AgamanakArI) rasUladerake satyAYita kareche|
(ekhana tAderake valA have) ‘tomarA avazyai marmAntika zAstira svAda bhoga karave,
tomAderake kevala tArai pratiphala deYA have yA tomarA karate|’
kintu AllAhara ekaniSTha vAndArA naYa (tArA e sava ‘AyAva theke rakSA pAve)|
tAdera janya Ache nirdhArita riyaka-
phalamUla; Ara tArA have sammAnita|
(tArA thAkave) ni‘YAmAtera bharA jAnnAte
uccAsane mukhomukhI haYe
tAdera kAche cakrAkAre parivezana karA have svaccha pravAhita jharNAra surApUrNa pAtra|
nirmala pAnIYa, pAnakArIdera janya supeYa, susvAdu|
nei tAte dehera janya kSatikara kona kichu, Ara tArA tAte mAtAlao have nA|
tAdera kAche thAkave saMyata naYanA, satI sAdhvI, DAgara DAgara sundara cakSu viziSTA sundarIrA (huragaNa)|
tArA yena sayatne Dheke rAkhA Dima|
ataHpara tArA parasparera mukhomukhI haYe eke ‘aparera khavara jijJesa karave|
tAdera ekajana valave- ‘‘(duniYAYa) AmAra chila ekajana sAthI|
se valata- ‘‘tumi ki vizvAsa kara ye,
AmarA yakhana mare yAva Ara mATi o hADDite pariNata hava takhano satyii ki AmAderake puraskAra o zAsti deYA have?
AllAha valavena- ‘ tomarA ki tAke u~ki diYe dekhate cAo?’
tArapara se u~ki diYe dekhave evaM tAke jAhAnnAmera mAjhakhAne dekhate pAve|
se valave, ‘AllAhara kasama! tumi to AmAke prAYa dhvaMsai kare diYechile,
AmAra pratipAlakera anugraha nA hale Amio to (jAhAnnAmera bhitara) hAjira karA lokedera madhye zAmila thAkatAma|
ekhana AmAdera Ara mRtyu have nA
AmAdera prathama mRtyura para, Ara AmAderake zAstio deYA have nA|
eTAi to mahAsAphalya|
e rakama sAphalyera janyai ‘AmalakArIdera ‘Amala karA ucita|
ApyAYana hiseve eTA uttama, nA, (jAhAnnAmera) jAkkuma gAcha?
e gAchaTAke Ami yAlimadera parIkSA karAra janya (ekaTA upakaraNa) vAniYechi (kenanA, yAlimarA vale ye, jAhAnnAmera bhitara AvAra gAcha haYa kI kare?)
eTA emana ekaTA gAcha yA jAhAnnAmera taladeza theke vera haYa|
era cUr3Agulo yena zaYatvAnera mAthA (arthAt dekhate khuvai khArApa|)
jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIrA tAttheke khAve Ara tA diYe peTa pUrNa karave|
era upara tAderake deYA have phuTanta pAnira (pU~ja samvalita) mizraNa|
ataHpara tAdera pratyAvartana have jvalanta Agunera dike|
tArA tAdera pitRpuruSaderake vipathagAmI peYechila|
ataHpara tAderai padAMka anusaraNa kare chuTe calechila|
edera Agera lokedera adhikAMzai pathabhraSTa haYe giYechila|
Ami tAdera mAjhe satarkakArI (rasUla) pAThiYechilAma|
ekhana dekha, ei satarka kare deYA lokedera pariNAma kI haYechila!
kintu AllAhara ekaniSTa vAndAdera kathA bhinna (e sava khArApa pariNati theke sampUrNa mukta chila|)
(itopUrve) nUha AmAke Dekechila, ataHpara (dekha) Ami katai nA uttama sAr3AdAtA chilAma!
tAke Ara tAra parivAravargake Ami mahA vipada theke uddhAra karechilAma|
Ara tAra vaMzadharaderakei Ami vaMzAnukrame vidyamAna rAkhalAma|
Ara Ami tAke paravartIdera mAjhe smaraNIYa kare rAkhalAma|
vizvajagate nUhera prati sAlAma/zAnti varSita hoka|
satkarmazIladerake Ami ebhAvei pratidAna diYe thAki|
se chila AmAra mu’mina vAndAhadera ekajana|
ataHpara anyadera Ami DuviYe diYechilAma|
avazyai ivarAhIma chila tArai dalera loka|
se yakhana tAra pratipAlakera kAche vizuddha antara niYe hAjira hala,
se takhana tAra pitAke o tAra jAtike valala, ‘tomarA kisera ‘ivAdAta kara?
tomarA ki AllAhake vAda diYe mithye mA’vuda pete cAo?
vizva jagatera pratipAlaka samparke tomarA kI dhAraNA poSaNa kara?
ataHpara tArakArAjira dike se ekavAra tAkAla (arthAt cinte bhAvanA karala)
tArapara valala, ‘‘Ami asustha|’’
ataHpara tArA tAke pechane rekhe cale gela|
tArapara se cupe cupe tAdera upAsyadera kAche Dhuke par3ala Ara valala, (ApanAdera sammukhe rAkhA eta upAdeYa khAvAra) ApanArA khAcchena nA kena?
kI haYeche ApanAdera, kathA valachena nA kena?
ataHpara se tAdera upara jhA~piYe par3e sajore AghAta karala|
takhana lokerA (phire ese) tAra dike chuTe Asala|
se valala, ‘‘tomarA (pAthara) khodAi kare segulo nijerA vAnAo, segulorai AvAra ‘ivAdAta kara?
AllAhai sRSTi karechena tomAderake Ara tomarA yA tairi kara segulokeo|
tArA valala, ‘tAra janya ekaTA agnikunDa tairi kara, ataHpara tAke Agune nikSepa kara|’

he dAUda! Ami tomAke pRthivIte (AmAra) pratinidhi karechi, kAjei tumi mAnuSera madhye nyAYaparAYaNatAra saGge zAsana-vicAra paricAlanA kara, evaM pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA| kenanA, tA tomAke AllAhara patha hate vicyuta kare phelave| yArA AllAhara patha theke vicyuta haYa, tAdera janya Ache kaThina ‘AyAva, kAraNa tArA hisAva-nikAzera dinake bhule geche|

smaraNa kara AmAra vAndA AiYUvera kathA, yakhana se tAra pratipAlakake Deke valechila- zaYatvAna AmAke kaSTa Ara ‘AyAve pheleche (arthAt AmAra dhairyacyuti ghaTiYe AmAke AllAhara akRtajJa vAndAha vAnAnora janya kumantraNA diYe caleche)|

AmarA ki tAdera saGge ayathAi ThATTA-vidrupa karatAma, nA tAdera vyApAre AmAdera dRSTibhrama ghaTeche? (arthAt tArA haYata jAhAnnAmei Ache kintu AmAdera cokha tAderake dekhate pAcche nA)
eTA nizcita satya, jAhAnnAmera vAsindAdera ei vAgavitanDA|
vala- Ami to kevala ekajana satarkakArI, sArvabhauma apratirodhya eka o ekaka AllAha chAr3A satya kona ilAha nei|
yini AkAza o pRthivI evaM e du’era mAjhe yA Ache sava kichura pratipAlaka- yini mahA parAkramazAlI, var3ai kSamAzIla|
vala, eTA eka bhaYAnaka saMvAda|
yAttheke tomarA mukha phiriYe niccha|
(vala) Ami Urdhva jagatera kona jJAna rAkhi nA yakhana tArA (arthAt pherezatArA) vAdAnuvAda karachila|
AmAra kAche oYAhI karA haYeche ye, Ami kevala ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra pratipAlaka pherezatAderake valalena- Ami kAdA theke mAnuSa sRSTi karate yAcchi|
Ami yakhana tAke saThikabhAve vAniYe phelava Ara tAra bhitare AmAra rUha phu~ke deva, takhana tomarA tAra sAmane sAjadAhaYa par3e yAve|
takhana pherezatArA savAi sejadA karala|
ivalIsa chAr3A| se ahaGkAra karala Ara kAphiradera antarbhukta haYe gela|
AllAha valalena- he ivalIsa! Ami yAke nija hAte sRSTi karalAma tAke sejadA karate kise tomAke niSedha karala? tumi ki dambha dekhAle, nA tumi khuva ucca mAnera adhikArI haYecha?
se valala- Ami tAra ceYe uttama, Apani AmAke Aguna theke sRSTi karechena Ara tAke sRSTi karechena mATi theke|
tini valalena- tAhale tumi ekhAna theke veriYe yAo, tumi hale lAJchita, vitAr3ita|
vicAra divasa paryanta tomAra upara thAkala AmAra abhizApa|
se valala- he AmAra pratipAlaka! tAhale AmAke punarutthAnera dina paryanta samaYa dina|
tini valalena- tomAke samaYa deYA hala,
sedina paryanta yAra (Agamana) kAla sunirdhArita|
se valala- ApanAra kSamatAra kasama! Ami odera savvAike avazyai pathabhraSTa karava|
tAdera madhye ApanAra ekaniSTha vAndAdera vAde|
tini valalena- eTAi satya, Ami satyai vali ye,
Ami tomAke Ara tAdera (arthAt mAnuSadera) madhye yArA tomAke anusaraNa karave tAdera savvAike diYe avazyai jAhAnnAma pUrNa karava|
vala- Ami era (arthAt satya-saThika pathera dike DAkAra) janya tomAdera kAche pArizramika cAi nA, Ara Ami kona dho~kAvAja nai|
eTA to vizvajagatera janya kevala upadeza vANI|
kichukAla parei era saMvAda tomarA avazya avazyai jAnate pArave|
e kitAva nAyila haYeche mahAparAkramazAlI mahAvijJAnI AllAhara nikaTa hate|

Ami tomAra prati e kitAva avatIrNa karechi satyatA sahakAre, (ete nei kona prakAra mithye) kAjei AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara dvInake (arthAt Anugatya, hukuma pAlana, dAsatva o golAmIke) ekamAtra tA~rai janya nirdiSTa kare|

jene rekha, khAlesa dvIna kevala AllAharai janya| yArA tA~ke vAda diYe anyaderake abhibhAvaka vAniYe niYeche tArA vale- AmarA tAdera ‘ivAdAta ekamAtra e uddezyei kari ye, tArA AmAderake AllAhara naikaTye pau~che deve| (satya patha theke sare giYe mithye patha o matera janma diYe) tArA ye matabheda karache, AllAha tAra cUr3Anta phaYasAlA kare devena| ye mithyevAdI o kAphira AllAha tAke saThika patha dekhAna nA|
AllAha santAna grahaNa karAra icche karale tini tAra sRSTikula theke nija pachanda mata veche nitena| esava theke tini pavitra| apratirodhya kSamatAra adhikArI tini eka o ekaka AllAha|

tini AkAza o pRthivI sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAve| rAta dinake Dheke neYa, Ara dina Dheke neYa rAtake| tinii niYantraNa karena suruja Ara cA~dake, pratyekei calache nirdiSTa samaYa anusAre| jene rekha, tini mahAparAkramazAlI, parama kSamAzIla (mahAzaktidhara haoYA sattveo vAra vAra kSamA karena)|

tini tomAderake ekai vyakti theke sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tAra theke tini tAra jur3i sRSTi karechena| tini tomAdera janya vAniYechena ATa gRhapAlita pazu (cAra) jor3AYa jor3AYa| tini tomAderake sRSTi karechena tomAdera mAYedera garbhe, eka eka paryAYe eka eka AkRti diYe, tina tinaTi andhakAra AvaraNera madhye| ei hala tomAdera pratipAlaka, sarvamaYa kartRtva tA~rai, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, kAjei (bhuYo kSamatAra adhikArI, dAmbhika o svArthAnveSI mahala kartRka) tomAderake kon dike phiriYe neYA hacche?

tomarA yadi kuphurI kara tave (jene rekha), AllAha tomAdera mukhApekSI nana| tini tA~ra vAndAhadera janya kuphurI AcaraNa pachanda karena nA, tomarA yadi kRtajJa hao, tave tomAdera janya tA tini pachanda karena| ekera (pApera) vojhA anye vahana karave nA| zeSameSa tomAderake tomAdera pAlanakartAra kAchei phire yete have, takhana tini tomAderake jAniYe devena tomarA yA karachile| tini to antarera khavara paryanta jAnena|

duHkha-musivata yakhana mAnuSake sparza kare takhana se tAra pratipAlakake DAkate thAke tA~ra prati var3ai ekaniSTha haYe| ataHpara tini yakhana nija pakSa theke anugraha diYe tAke dhanya karena, takhana pUrve se yejanya tA~ke Dekechila tA bhule yAYa evaM anyaderake AllAhara samakakSa dA~r3a karAYa tA~ra patha theke pathabhraSTa karAra janya| vale dAo, kuphurIra jIvana kichukAla bhoga kare nAo, (ataHpara) tumi to have jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI| (e vyakti bhAla, nA ai vyakti)

ye rAtrira vibhinna prahare sejadA o danDAYamAna avasthAYa vinaYa o zraddhA-bhakti prakAza kare, AkhirAtake bhaYa kare, Ara tAra pratipAlakera anugraha pratyAzA kare? vala- yArA jAne Ara yArA jAne nA, tArA ki samAna? viveka-vuddhisampanna lokerAi kevala upadeza grahaNa kare thAke|

vala, he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kara| e duniYAYa yArA bhAla kAja karave, tAdera janya Ache kalyANa| AllAhara yamIna prazasta (eka elAkAYa ‘ivAdAta-vandegI karA kaThina hale anyatra cale yAo)| Ami dhairyazIladerake tAdera puraskAra aparimitabhAve diYe thAki|
vala- AmAke Adeza deYA haYeche AllAhara ‘ivAdAta karate tA~ra Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe|
AmAke Adeza deYA haYeche Ami yena sarvAgre musalima hai|
vala- Ami yadi AmAra pratipAlakera avAdhya hai, tave Ami bhaYaGkara dinera zAstira bhaYa kari|
vala- Ami ‘ivAdAta kari AllAhara vizuddhabhAve tA~ra prati AmAra Anugatyera mAdhyame|

ataeva, tA~ke vAda diYe tomarA yAra icche ‘ivAdAta kara (ete AllAhara kona kSati have nA, kSati tomAderai have)| vala- yArA nijederake Ara nijedera parivAra-parijanake kviYAmatera dine kSatigrasta kare, tArAi to kSatigrasta| jene rekha, eTAi hala spaSTa kSati|
tAdera upareo thAkave Agunera stara, Ara nIceo thAkave (Agunera) stara| e rakama pariNatira vyApAre AllAha tA~ra vAndAhaderake sAvadhAna karachena| kAjei he AmAra vAndAharA! AmAke bhaYa kara|
yArA tAgUtera dAsatva theke dUre thAke, Ara AllAhara abhimukhI haYa, susaMvAda tAderai janya| kAjei susaMvAda dAo AmAra vAndAderake
yArA manoyoga diYe kathA zune Ara era uttamagulo mene cale| orAi hala tArA AllAha yAderake satpathe paricAlita karena Ara orAi hala jJAna-vuddhisampanna|
zAstira phaYasAlA yAra upara avadhArita haYe geche, ye Ache jAhAnnAmera Agune tumi ki tAke rakSA karate pAra?

kintu yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare, tAdera janya raYeche prAsAdera para prAsAda, yegulora upara nirmANa karA haYeche prAsAda Ara prAsAda, yAra nica diYe jharNAdhArA pravAhita| eTA AllAhara o‘YAdA, AllAha oYAdA bhaGga karena nA|

tumi ki dekha nA AllAha AkAza hate vRSTi varSaNa karena Ara tA jharNA dhArAYa yamIne pravAhita karena, ataHpara tA diYe vicitra raGera phasala utpanna karena, ataHpara tA zukiYe yAYa, takhana tomarA tA haluda varNa dekha, zeSa paryanta tini oguloke khar3a-bhuSite pariNata karena| ete jJAna-vuddhisampanna lokedera janya avazyai nasIhata Ache|

isalAmera janya AllAha yAra vakSa unmocita kare diYechena, yAra phale se tAra pratipAlakera deYA Alora upara raYeche (se ki tAra samAna ye kaThora hRdaYera)? dhvaMsa tAdera janya yAdera antara AllAha smaraNera vyApAre Aro zakta haYe geche| tArA Ache spaSTa vibhrAntite|

AllAha sarvottama vANI avatIrNa karechena- emana kitAva yA sAmaJjasyapUrNa, yAra viSaYAvalI punarAvRtti karA haYeche| yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa kare tAdera gA ete ziure uThe| takhana tAdera deha-mana AllAhara smaraNera prati vinamra haYe yAYa| e hala AllAhara hidAYAta, yAke icche taddvArA hidAYAta karena| Ara AllAha yAke pathahArA karena, tAra kona pathapradarzaka nei|

kviYAmatera dina ye vyakti tAra (hAta pA vA~dhA thAkAra kAraNe) mukhamanDalera sAhAyye bhaYAnaka ‘AyAvera AghAta ThekAte cAive (se ki tAra mata ye esava theke nirApada)? yAlimaderake valA have- tomarA yA arjana karecha tAra svAda grahaNa kara|
tAdera pUrvavartIrAo (nuvuoYAtake) asvIkAra karechila| ataHpara tAdera kAche emana dika theke ‘AyAva esechila yA tArA ekaTu Terao pAYani|
kAjei AllAha tAderake duniYAra jindegitei lAJchanAra svAda bhoga karAlena| Ara avazyai AkhirAtera zAsti savaceYe kaThina| tArA yadi jAnata!
Ami e kuraAne mAnuSera janya sava rakamera dRSTAnta o upamA upasthita karechi yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
AravI bhASAYa (avatIrNa) kuraAna, ete nei kona vakratA (pecAno kathA), yAte tArA (anyAYa apakarma hate) ve~ce calate pAre|

AllAha ekaTA dRSTAnta dicchenaH eka vyakti yAra muniva aneka- yArA parasparera virodhI| Areka vyakti yAra sampUrNa mAlikAnA ekajanera (upara nyasta), tulanAYa e du’jana ki samAna? yAvatIYa prazaMsA AllAharai (ye tini AmAderake nAnAna devadevIra kavala theke rakSA ka’re ekamAtra tA~rai saGge sarAsari yogAyoga sthApana karAra janya AmAderake nirdeza diYechena), kintu mAnuSadera adhikAMza (e Asala satyaTA) jAne nA|
tumio marave Ara tArAo marave|
ataHpara kviYAmata divase tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera sammukhe vAdAnuvAda karave|
ye vyakti AllAhara prati mithyAropa kare Ara satya samAgata haoYAra para tA asvIkAra kare tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke Ache? (emana) kAphiradera AvAsasthala ki jAhAnnAme naYa?
yArA satya niYe AgamaNa kareche evaM satyake satya hiseve mene niYeche, tArAi to muttAkI|
tAdera janya tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache yA tArA icche karave| tA-i hala satkarmazIladera pratidAna|
yAte tArA ye sava manda kAja kareche AllAh tA muche dite pArena, Ara tArA ye sava sat kAja kareche tajjanya tAderake puraskRta karena|
AllAha ki tA~ra vAndAhara janya yatheSTa nana? athaca tomAke tArA AllAhara parivarte anyadera bhaYa dekhAYa| AllAha yAke pathahArA karena tAra janya keu patha dekhAvAra nei|
Ara AllAha yAke patha dekhAna, tAke pathabhraSTa karAra keu nei| AllAha ki mahAzaktidhara pratizodha grahaNakArI nana?

tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa kara- AkAza o pRthivI sRSTi kareche ke? tArA avazya avazyai valave, AllAha| tomarA ki cintA kare dekhecha ye, AllAha AmAra kSati karate cAile AllAhara parivarte tomarA yAderake DAka, tArA ki se kSati dUra karate pArave? athavA tini AmAra prati anugraha karate cAile, tArA ki tA~ra anugraha ThekAte pArave? vala, AmAra janya AllAhi yatheSTa, nirbharakArIrA tA~ra uparai nirbhara kare|
vala, he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA tomAdera patha o mata anuyAYI kAja kare yAo, Amio kAja kare yAcchi, acirei tomarA jAnate pArave
kAra upara Ase apamAnajanaka zAsti, Ara kAra upara patita haYa sthAYI ‘AyAva|

Ami tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa karechi mAnuSera (zikSA grahaNera) janya satya (dvIna) sahakAre| ataHpara ye saThika pathe calave, nijera kalyANera janyai calave| Ara ye vibhrAnta have, vibhrAnta have kevala nijera kSati karAra janya; tumi tAdera (kAjera) janya yimmAdAra nao|

AllAha prANa grahaNa karena segulora mRtyura samaYa, Ara yArA mareni tAdera nidrAkAle| ataHpara yAra mRtyura siddhAnta haYe geche tAra (prANa) rekhe dena, Ara anyagulo ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYera janya phiriYe dena| yArA cintA gaveSaNA kare tAdera janya ete vahu nidarzana Ache|
tArA ki AllAhake chAr3A (anyaderake nijedera muktira janya) supArizakArI vAniYe niYeche? vala- tArA kona kichura mAlika nA haoYA sattveo, Ara tArA nA vujhaleo?
vala- zAphA‘Ata sampUrNa AllAhara ikhatiYArabhukta| AkAza o pRthivIra rAjatva tA~rai, ataHpara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe AnA have|
eka AllAhara ullekha karA halei yArA kviYAmate vizvAsa kare nA, tAdera antara vitRSNAYa bhare yAYa| Ara AllAha chAr3A anyAnya upAsyera ullekha karA halei tArA Anande utphulla haYa|
vala- he AllAha! AkAza o pRthivIra sraSTA, dRzya o adRzyera jJAnera adhikArI, tumi tomAra vAndAhadera mAjhe mImAMsA kare deve ye viSaYe tArA matabheda karache.

yArA anyAYakArI duniYAte yA kichu Ache samasta kichu yadi tAderai haYa, Ara tAra sAthe Aro ata parimANa haYa, tArA kviYAmatera kaThina ‘AyAva theke vA~cAra janya muktipaNa svarUpa dite cAive| sekhAne AllAhara nikaTa theke tArA emana kichura sammukhIna have yA tArA kakSano anumAnao kareni|
tAdera kRtakarmera manda rUpa sedina prakAza haYe par3ave, Ara tArA yA niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata tAi tAderake ghire phelave|

mAnuSake vipadApada sparza karale AmAke DAke| ataHpara Ami yakhana tAke AmAra pakSa theke ni‘mAta diYe dhanya kari takhana se vale- AmAra jJAna garimAra vadaulatei AmAke tA deYA haYeche| nA, tA naYa| eTA ekaTA parIkSA (anugraha lAbha kare ke AllAhara kRtajJa haYa Ara ke nijera var3Ai prakAza kare tA dekhAra janya)| kintu (era gur3hatattva) tAdera adhikAMzai vujhe nA|
tAdera Age yArA chila tArAo e kathAi valata| kintu tArA yA karata tA tAdera konai kAje Aseni|
tAdera karmera khArApa pariNAma tAdera upara patita haYechila| Ara edera madhyeo yArA yulama kareche tAdera karmera manda pariNAma ederai upara patita have| erA tA vyartha karate pArave nA|
erA ki jAne nA ye, AllAha yAra janya icche riyaka prazasta karena Ara (yAra janya icche) saMkucita karena? mu’mina lokadera janya avazyai ete vahu nidarzana Ache|
vala- he AmAra vAndAgaNa! yArA nijedera upara vAr3AvAr3i karecha, tomarA AllAhara rahamata theke nirAza haYo nA| AllAha samasta gunAha kSamA kare devena| tini ati kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|
tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera abhimukhI hao Ara tA~ra anugata hao tomAdera kAche ‘AyAva AsAra pUrve| (‘AyAva ese gele) tomAderake sAhAyya karA have nA|

tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate tomAdera prati yA avatIrNa karA haYeche tAte yAke uttama AkhyAYita karA haYeche tomarA segulora anusaraNa kara tomAdera kAche akasmAt ‘AyAva ese yAoYAra pUrve ye viSaYe tomarA Terao pAve nA|
yAte kAuke valate nA haYa- hAYa Aphasosa! Ami AllAhara prati (AmAra kartavye) avahelA karechilAma, Ara Ami to ThATTA vidrUpakArIdera antarbhukta chilAma|
athavA e kathA yena valate nA haYa ye, AllAha yadi AmAke saThika patha dekhAtena, tAhale Ami avazyai muttAkvIdera antarbhukta hatAma|
athavA zAsti dekhAra para kAuke yena valate nA haYa, AmAke yadi ekavAra (pRthivIte) phire yAvAra suyoga deYA hata, tAhale Ami satkarmazIladera antarbhukta hatAma|
(tAke uttara deYA have) nA, varaM tomAra kAche AmAra nidarzana esechila, takhana tumi seguloke mithye vale asvIkAra karechile, ahaMkAra karechile Ara kAphiradera antarbhukta chile|
yArA AllAhara prati mithyAropa kare kviYAmatera dine tumi tAdera mukhagulo kAlo dekhate pAve. ahaMkArIdera AvAsasthala ki jAhAnnAme naYa?
Ara AllAha muttAkvIderake rakSA karavena tAdera saphalatAra kAraNe| kona khArAvI tAderake sparza karave nA, Ara tArA duHkhitao have nA|
AllAha sava kichura sraSTA Ara tini sava kichura abhibhAvaka evaM karma sampAdanakArI|
AsamAna Ara yamInera kuJji tA~rai hAte, Ara yArA AllAhara nidarzanaguloke asvIkAra kare, tArAi to kSatigrasta|
vala, ohe ajJarA! tomarA ki AmAke AllAha chAr3A anyera ‘ivAdAta karAra Adeza karacha?

kintu tomAra kAche Ara tomAdera pUrvavartIdera kAche oYAhI karA haYeche ye, tumi yadi (AllAhara) zarIka sthira kara, tAhale tomAra karma avazya avazyai nisphala haYe yAve, Ara tumi avazya avazyai kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|
nA, varaM AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, Ara zukaragujAradera antarbhukta hao|

tArA AllAhara yathAyogya maryAdA deYa nA| kviYAmatera dina samagra pRthivI tA~ra hAtera muSThite thAkave, Ara AkAzamanDalI thAkave bhA~ja karA avasthAYa tA~ra DAna hAte| mAhAtmya tA~rai, tArA yAderake tA~ra zarIka kare tini tAdera vahu Urdhve|

Ara yakhana ziGgAYa phu~tkAra deYA have takhana murchita haYe par3ave yArA Ache AkAze Ara yArA Ache yamIne, tave AllAhara iccheYa ettheke ye rehAi pAve tAra kathA bhinna| ataHpara ziGgAYa AvAra phu~ deYA have, takhana tArA uThe dA~r3iYe tAkAte thAkave|

pRthivI tAra pratipAlakera jyotite jhalamala kare uThave, Ara ‘AmAlanAmA sAmane AnA have| navIgaNa o sAkSIgaNake upasthita karA have| sakalera mAjhe nyAYaparAYaNatAra sAthe vicAra karA have, tAdera prati yulama karA have nA|
pratyekera kAjera pUrNa pratiphala deYA have| lokerA yA kare tA tini khuva bhAlabhAvei jAnena|

kAphiraderake dale dale jAhAnnAmera dike hA~kiYe niYe yAoYA have| zeSe yakhana tArA sekhAne po~chave, takhana tAra darajAgulo khule deYA have| takhana jAhAnnAmera rakSIrA tAderake valave- tomAdera kAche tomAderai bhitara theke ki rasUlagaNa Asenani yArA tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera AYAta par3e zonAtena Ara tomAderake ye e dinera sAkSAt karate have e samparke tomAderake satarka karatena? tArA valave- hA~, esechila| kintu (e svIkArokti sattveo) kAphiradera prati zAstira phaYasAlA avadhArita haYe geche|
tAderake valA have- jAhAnnAmera darajA diYe praveza kara, tomAderake cirakAla ekhAne thAkate have| ahaMkArIdera AvAsasthala katai nA nikRSTa!

yArA tAdera pratipAlakake bhaYa karata tAderake dale dale jAnnAtera dike niYe yAoYA have| yakhana tArA sekhAne ese pau~chave, jAnnAtera darajAgulo (pUrva thekei) unmukta (dekhate pAve)| jAnnAtera dvAra rakSIrA valave- tomAdera upara zAnti (varSita hoka), camatkAra kAja karecha tomarA, kAjei cirakAlera janya ete praveza kara|

(jAnnAte praveza kare) tArA valave- samasta prazaMsA AllAhara yini tA~ra o‘YAdAke satyikArabhAve pUrNa karechena, Ara AmAderake (jAnnAtera) yamInera adhikArI vAniYe diYechena| AmarA jAnnAtera yethAYa icche vasavAsera jAYagA ka’re nite pAri| satkarmazIladera pratiphala katai nA uttama!

tumi pherezatAderake ‘Arazera cArapAza ghire tAdera pratipAlakera mAhAtmya ghoSaNA o prazaMsA karate dekhate pAve| mAnuSera mAjhe nyAYaniSThAra saGge vicAra-phaYasAlA karA have| Ara ghoSaNA deYA have ye, yAvatIYa prazaMsA vizvajagatera pratipAlakera janya|
hA-mIma|
e kitAva nAyila haYeche mahA pratApera adhikArI sarvajJa AllAhara nikaTa hate|
yini pApa kSamAkArI, tAovAha kavUlakArI, kaThora zAstidAtA, var3ai anugrahazIla, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, pratyAvartana tA~rai kAche|
kAphirarA chAr3A anya keu AllAhara AYAta niYe jhagar3A kare nA| kAjei deze deze tAdera avAdha vicaraNa tomAke yena dho~kAYa nA phele|

edera pUrve nUhera jAti Ara tAdera pare vahu dala-goSThI (rasUladerake) asvIkAra karechila| pratyeka jAti tAdera rasUlera viruddhe cakrAnta karechila tAke pAkar3Ao karAra janya, Ara asAra astrera sAhAyye virodhitAYa lipta haYechila tA diYe satyake khanDana karAra janya| phale Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilAma| ataHpara dekha, kemana kaThora chila AmAra zAsti|
ebhAve kAphiradera vyApAre tomAra pratipAlakera vANI satya pramANita hala ye, tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

yArA ‘Araza vahana kare Ache, Ara yArA Ache tAra cArapAze, tArA tA~ra prazaMsAra sAthe tA~ra mAhAtmya ghoSaNA kare Ara tA~ra prati ImAna poSaNa kare Ara mu’minadera janya kSamA prArthanA ka’re vale- he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi tomAra rahamata o jJAna diYe sava kichuke veSTana kare rekhecha, kAjei yArA tAovAha kare o tomAra patha anusaraNa kare tAderake kSamA kara, Ara jAhAnnAmera ‘AyAva theke tAderake rakSA kara|

he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi tAderake Ara tAdera pitRpuruSa, svAmI-strI o santAnAdira madhye yArA satkAja kareche tAderakeo cirasthAYI jAnnAte praveza karAna yAra oYA‘dA tumi tAderake diYecha; tumi mahA parAkramazAlI, mahA vijJa|
samasta khArAvI theke tAderake rakSA kara| sedina tumi yAke samasta khArAvI theke rakSA karale, tAra upara to daYAi karale| oTAi hala virATa sAphalya|

yArA kuphurI karechila tAderake DAka diYe valA have- tomAdera nijedera prati tomAdera kSobhera ceYe (tomAdera prati) AllAhara kSobha adhika, (kenanA) tomAderake yakhana ImAnera dike AhavAna karA haYechila, takhana tomarA asvIkAra karechile|

tArA valave, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi du’vAra AmAdera mRtyu diYecha (janmera Agera mRta avasthA Ara jIvana zeSera mRtyu) Ara AmAderake du’vAra jIvana diYecha| AmarA AmAdera pApa svIkAra karachi, (ekhAna theke) vera haoYAra kona patha Ache ki?

(takhana tAderake uttara deYA have) tomAdera e zAstira kAraNa ei ye, yakhana eka AllAhake DAkA hata, takhana tomarA tA mene nite asvIkAra karate| Ara yakhana anyaderake tA~ra aMzIdAra gaNya karA hata, takhana tomarA tAte vizvAsa sthApana karate| hukuma deYAra mAlika AllAha- yini sarvocca, sarvazreSTha|
tini tA~ra nidarzanAvalI tomAderake dekhAna Ara AkAza theke tomAdera janya riyaka avatIrNa karena. AllAha-abhimukhIrA chAr3A keu upadeza grahaNa kare nA|
kAjei AllAhake DAka Anugatyake ekamAtra tA~rai janya nidiSTa karo, yadio kAphiragaNa tA apachanda kare|
tini sarvocca maryAdAra adhikArI, ‘Arazera adhipati| tini tA~ra nirdeze tA~ra vAndAdera yAra prati icche oYAhI preraNa karena yAte se sAkSAtera dina samparke satarka kare|

mAnuSa yedina (kvavara theke) vera haYe Asave, AllAhara kAche tAdera kona kichui gopana thAkave nA| (sedina ghoSaNA deYA have) Aja ekacchatra kartRtva kAra? (uttara Asave) eka o ekaka mahAparAkramazAlI AllAhara|
pratyeka vyakti ye karma kareche Aja tAra pratiphala deYA have| Aja nei kona yulama| AllAha ati druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

tAderake satarka kara sei ghaniYe AsA dina samparke yakhana oSThAgata prANa niYe tArA duHkha-kaSTa saMvaraNa karave| yAlimadera janya kona antaraGga vandhu thAkave nA, emana kona supArizakArIo thAkave nA yAra kathA grahaNa karA have|
AllAha cakSura anyAYa karma samparkeo avagata, Ara antara yA gopana kare se samparkeo|
AllAha hakva vicAra karena| tArA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAke tArA moTei vicAra karate pAre nA| AllAha sava kichu zonena, sava kichu dekhena|

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kare nA, tAhale dekhate peta tAdera pUrve yArA chila tAdera pariNAma kI haYechila| tArA zaktite Ara smRti cihne chila edera ceYe pravala| ataHpara tAdera pApera kAraNe AllAha tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilena, AllAhara zAsti theke tAderake vA~cAnora keu chila nA|

eTA ejanya ye, rasUlagaNa tAdera kAche spaSTa (nidarzana) niYe esechila| kintu tArA tAderake pratyAkhyAna karechila| takhana AllAha tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilena| tini pravala zaktidhara, zAstidAne kaThora|
Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzana o suspaSTa pharamAna diYe pAThiYechilAma
pherAuna, hAmAna o kArUnera kAche| kintu tArA valala (e lokaTA) eka yAdukara, ghora mithyuka|

tArapara yakhana mUsA tAdera kAche AmAra satyasaha Asala takhana tArA valala- era saGge yArA ImAna eneche tAdera putra santAnadera hatyA kara, Ara tAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkha| kAphiradera Sar3ayantra akAryakara chAr3A Ara kichui nA|
phiraAuna valala- cher3e dAo AmAke, Ami mUsAke hatyA karava, DAkuka se tAra ravvake| Ami AzaGkA karachi, se tomAdera jIvana paddhatike vadale deve kiMvA deze viparyaYa vizRGkhalA sRSTi karave|
mUsA valala- Ami AmAra o tomAdera pratipAlakera AzraYa grahaNa karachi sakala dAmbhika ahaMkArIdera hate, yArA vicAra divase vizvAsa kare nA|

pherAunera dalera eka mu’mina vyakti- ye tAra ImAnake gopana rekhechila- valala, tomarA ekajana lokake zudhu ki ejanya mere phelave ye, se vale, AllAha AmAra pratipAlaka| athaca se tomAdera kAche tomAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate suspaSTa pramANa niYe eseche| se yadi mithyAvAdI haYa tAhale tAra mithyA valAra pariNAma se nijei bhugave| Ara se yadi satyavAdI haYa, tAhale se tomAderake ye zAstira bhaYa dekhAcche tAra kichu nA kichu tomAdera upara par3avei| ye sImAlaGghana kare Ara mithye vale AllAha tAke saThika patha dekhAna nA|

he AmAra jAtira lokerA! Aja tomAderai kartRtva calache, deze Aja tomarAi vijaYI zakti| kintu AllAhara zAsti yadi esei par3e, tAhale tAttheke AmAderake ke rakSe karave? pherAuna valala- Ami tomAderake zudhu tA-i valachi, Ami nije yA vujhechi; Ami tomAderake satyapathai dekhAcchi|
ye lokaTi ImAna enechila se valala- he AmAra jAtira lokerA! Agera jAtigulora upara yemana (zAstira) dina esechila, Ami tomAdera uparao se rakama (viparyaYera) AzaGkA karachi
yA esechila nUha, ‘Ada, sAmUda jAti Ara tAdera paravartIdera upara| AllAha to vAndAhadera upara yulama karate cAna nA (varaM tAdera nijedera anyAYa apakarmera kAraNei AllAha tAderake zAsti dena)|
he AmAra jAti! Ami AzaGkA karachi tomAdera Arta citkAra Ara kAnnAkATi karAra ekaTi dinera|
yedina tomarA pichana phire pAliYe yAve| kintu AllAha (’ra kavjA) theke tomAdera rakSAkArI keu have nA, Ara AllAha yAke vipathagAmI karena, tAra janya kona pathapradarzanakArI nei|

itopUrve iusupha tomAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzana niYe esechila| kintu se tomAdera kAche yA niYe esechila, se vyApAre tomarA sandeha poSaNa karei calale| zeSa paryanta yakhana tAra mRtyu hala takhana tomarA valale- ora pare AllAha Ara kakSano kona rasUla pAThAvena nA| sImAlaGghanakArI o sandehavAdIderake AllAha ebhAvei pathabhraSTa karena|

yArA nijedera kAche kona yukti-pramANa nA Asaleo AllAhara nidarzanAvalIra vyApAre vAka-vitanDA kare| AllAhara dRSTite Ara mu’minadera dRSTite (e AcaraNa) khuvai ghRNita| AllAha ebhAve pratyeka dAmbhika svairAcArIra antarera upara mohara mere dena|
pherAuna valala- he hAmAna! tumi AmAra janya eka suucca imArata tairi kara yAte Ami upAYa peYe yAi

AkAze uThAra upAYa, yAte Ami mUsAra ilAhake dekhate pAi; Ami mUsAke avazyai mithyAvAdI mane kari| ebhAve pherAunera janya tAra manda kAjake suzobhita karA haYechila Ara saThika patha theke tAke virata rAkhA haYechila| pherAunera apakauzala kevala tAra dhvaMsai Deke enechila|
ye lokaTi ImAna enechila se Aro valala- he AmAra jAtira lokerA! tomarA AmAra anusaraNa kara, Ami tomAderake saThika patha dekhAcchi|
he AmAra sampradAYa! pArthiva e jIvana (asthAYI) bhogya vastu mAtra, Ara AkhirAtai hala cirakAlIna AvAsasthala|

ye khArApa kAja karave tAke kAjera anupAtei pratiphala deYA have| puruSa hoka Ara nArI hoka ye vyaktii sat kAja karave (uparantu) se mu’minao, tAhale tArAi jAnnAte praveza karave, tAra madhye tArA ve-hisAva riyaka prApta have|
he AmAra sampradAYa! var3ai Azcarya! Ami tomAderake DAkachi muktira dike, Ara tomarA DAkacho Agunera dike|
tomarA AmAke DAkacha yena Ami AllAhara sAthe kuphurI kari evaM tA~ra aMzI sthApana kari ye samparke AmAra kona jJAna nei| aparapakSe Ami tomAderake DAkachi mahAparAkrAnta kSamAzIla (AllAhara) dike|

kona sandeha nei tomarA AmAke DAkacha zudhu tAra dike ye AhavAna pAoYAra yogya naYa- nA duniYAte, nA AkhirAte| AmAdera pratyAvartana to hala AllAhara dike Ara sImAlaGghanakArIrA hala jAhAnnAmera vAsindA|

zIghrai tomarA smaraNa karave Ami tomAderake yA valachi| Ami AmAra nijera vyApAraTA AllAhara upara soparda karachi (AmAra vA~cA-marAra janya Ami moTeo bhAvi nA)| AllAha tA~ra vAndAhadera upara (sadAsarvadA) dRSTi rAkhena|
ataHpara AllAha tAke tAdera Sar3ayantrera khArAvI theke rakSA karalena, Ara kaThina zAsti pherAunera lokajanake caturdika theke ghire phelala|
(kvavare) tAderake sakAla-sandhyAYa jAhAnnAmera sAmane upasthita karA haYa Ara yedina kviYAmata saMghaTita have sedina (valA have) pherAunera jAti goSThIke kaThina ‘AyAve praviSTa kara|
jAhAnnAme tArA yakhana vAka-vitanDA karave, takhana durvalerA dApaTaoYAlAdera valave- AmarA to tomAderai anusArI chilAma, kAjei tomarA ki (ekhana) AmAdera Agunera zAstira kichuTA zeYAra neve?
dApaTaoYAlArA valave- Agune AmarA savAi to Achi, AllAha vAndAhadera vicAra to karei phelechena|
Agunera vAsindArA jAhAnnAmera rakSIdera valave- tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa du‘A kara, tini yena AmAdera theke ekadinera zAsti kamiYe dena|
rakSIgaNa valave- rasUlagaNa ki spaSTa pramANa niYe tomAdera kAche Aseni? tArA (uttare) valave, hA~ (esechila)| jAhAnnAmera rakSIrA valave- tAhale tomarAi du‘A kara, kAphiradera du‘A niSphalai haYa|
Ami AmAra rasUladerake Ara mu’minaderake avazyai sAhAyya karava duniYAra jIvane Ara (kviYAmate) ye dina sAkSIrA dA~r3Ave|
yedina yAlimadera ojara-Apatti kona upakAre Asave nA| tAdera janya Ache lA‘nata, tAdera janya Ache nikRSTa vAsasthAna|
itopUrve Ami mUsAke diYechilAma- patha nirdeza Ara vAnI isarAIlake karechilAma (mUsAra nikaTa pradatta) kitAvera uttarAdhikArI|
(se kitAva chila) jJAnavuddhisampanna lokedera janya saThika pathera dizArI o upadeza|

kAjei tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara, (tumi dekhate pAve) AllAhara o‘YAdA satya| tumi tomAra bhula-bhrAntira janya kSamA prArthanA kara Ara sakAla-sandhyA tomAra pratipAlakera prazaMsA sahakAre pavitratA varNanA kara|

kona suspaSTa pramANa nA peYei yArA AllAhara AYAta samparke tarka kare, tAdera vukera bhitara Ache kevala ahaMkAra, kintu tArA tA (arthAt prakRta var3atva o zreSThatva AllAhara daYA chAr3A) kakSano arjana karate pAre nA| kAjei AllAhara kAche AzraYa cAo, (kAraNa) tini sava kichu zonena, sava kichu dekhena|
avazyai AsamAna o yamInera sRSTi mAnuSa sRSTira ceYe var3a (vyApAra)| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa (ajJatA o cintA nA karAra kAraNe) tA jAne nA|
andha Ara cakSuSmAna samAna naYa, (samAna naYa) yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare Ara yArA anyAYakArI| upadeza theke zikSA tomarA sAmAnyai grahaNa kara|
kviYAmata avazyai Asave, ete kona sandeha nei, kintu adhikAMza loka (tA) vizvAsa kare nA|
tomAra pratipAlaka valena- tomarA AmAke DAko, Ami (tomAdera DAke) sAr3A deva| yArA ahaMkAravazataH AmAra ‘ivAdAta kare nA, nizcitai tArA lAJchita avasthAYa jAhAnnAme praveza karave|

AllAha yini tomAdera janya rAtri vAniYechena yAte tomarA tAte prazAnti lAbha karate pAra, Ara dinake karechena AlokamaYa| AllAha mAnuSadera prati var3ai anugrahazIla, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai (AllAhara anugraha lAbhera parao) kRtajJatA svIkAra kare nA|
e halena AllAha, tomAdera pratipAlaka, sava kichura sRSTikartA| tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei; ematAvasthAYa tomAderake satya theke kIbhAve vibhrAnta karA hacche?
vibhrAnta ebhAvei karA haYa tAderake yArA AllAhara AYAtake asvIkAra kare|

AllAha yini tomAdera janya yamInake karechena mejhe, Ara AkAzake karechena chAda| tini tomAderake AkRti diYechena, ataHpara tomAdera AkRtike sundara karechena| tini pavitra vastu theke tomAderake riyaka dAna karena| e halena AllAha tomAdera pratipAlaka| kAjei mahimA gaurava AllAhara yini vizva jagatera pratipAlaka|
ciraJjIva tini, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei| kAjei tA~ke DAka Anugatyake ekamAtra tA~rai janya vizuddha kare| yAvatIYa prazaMsA vizvajagatera pratipAlaka AllAharai janya|

vala, AmAra pratipAlakera kAcha theke AmAra kAche suspaSTa pramANa eseche, ematAvasthAYa AmAke tAdera ‘ivAdAta karate niSedha karA haYeche AllAhake vAda diYe yAderake tomarA AhavAna kara| Ara AmAke Adeza deYA haYeche vizvajagatera pratipAlakera nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karAra janya|

tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena mATi theke, ataHpara zukravindu theke, ataHpara jamATa vA~dhA rakta theke, ataHpara tomAderake vera kare enechena zizurUpe, ataHpara tini tomAdera vRddhi dAna karena yAte tomarA tomAdera pUrNa zaktira vaYase pau~chate pAra, ataHpara Aro vRddhi dena yAte tomarA vRddha hao| tomAdera madhye kAro kAro Agei mRtyu ghaTAna yAte tomarA tomAdera janya nirdiSTa samaYe pau~che yAo Ara yAte tomarA (AllAhara sRSTi kuzalatA) anudhAvana kara|
tinii jIvana dena o mRtyu ghaTAna| yakhana kona kichu karAra siddhAnta karena, tAra janya tini valena- hao, takhana tA haYe yAYa|
tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya kara nA yArA AllAhara nirdazanagulo samparke vAka-vitanDA kare? (satya theke) tAderake kIbhAve phiriYe neYA hacche?
yArA kitAvake Ara Ami AmAra rasUladerake yA diYe pAThiYechi tAke asvIkAra kare, tArA zIghrai jAnate pArave|
yakhana tAdera galAYa thAkave ver3i Ara zikala; tAdera Tene niYe yAoYA have
phuTanta pAnite, ataHpara tAderake Agune dagdha karA have|
ataHpara tAderake valA have- tArA kothAYa tomarA yAderake (AllAhara) zarIka gaNya karate

AllAhake vAda diYe? (uttare) tArA valave- tArA AmAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe geche| nA, AmarA Age (yAra astitva Ache emana) kona kichukei DAkini| ebhAve AllAha kAphiraderake pathabhraSTa haoYAra suyoga dena|
era kAraNa ei ye, tomarA asatya niYe ullAsa karate, Ara ejanya ye, tomarA garva ahaMkAra karate|
tomarA jAhAnnAmera darajAgulo diYe praveza kara, cirakAla tAra bhitare thAkAra janya| dAmbhikadera vAsasthAna katai nA nikRSTa!

ataeva tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara, (kenanA) AllAhara oYA‘dA satya| ataHpara Ami tAderake (zAstira) ye oYA‘dA diYechi tAra kichu yadi tomAke (e pRthivItei) dekhiYe dei athavA (tAderake zAsti deYAra pUrvei) tomAra mRtyu ghaTAi, (ubhaYa avasthAtei) tAderake AmAra kAchei phire Asate have| (AmAra zAsti theke tArA rehAi pAve nA)|

Ami tomAra pUrve aneka rasUla pAThiYechilAma| tAdera madhye kAro kAro kAhinI Ami tomAra kAche varNanA karechi, tAdera madhye kAro kAro kathA Ami tomAra kAche varNanA karini| AllAhara anumati chAr3A kona nidarzana niYe AsA kona rasUlera pakSe sambhava naYa| AllAhara nirdeza yakhana jArI haYe yAYa, takhana nyAYasaGgatabhAve (viSaYaTira) phaYasAlA karA haYa| Ara yArA mithyAra upara dA~r3iYechila tArA takhanakAra takhanai kSatigrasta haYe par3e|
AllAha- yini tomAdera janya gavAdi pazu sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA tAdera katakagulora upara ArohaNa karate pAra, Ara katakagulo theke AhAra karate pAra|
ogulote tomAdera janya Ache vahu upakAra| tomarA tomAdera antare ye praYojanavodha kara, yAte ogulora dvArA tA miTAte pAra| ogulora upara Ara nauyAne tomAderake vahana karA haYa|
tini tomAderake tA~ra nidarzana dekhAna| kAjei AllAhara kon nidarzanake tomarA asvIkAra kara?

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kare nA? karale tArA dekhata, tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNati kI haYechila| duniYAYa edera ceYe tArA saMkhyAYa adhika chila, Ara zakti sAmarthya o kIrti cihne vezi pravala chila| kintu tArA yA arjana karechila tA tAdera kona upakAre Aseni|

tAdera kAche yakhana tAdera rasUlagaNa spaSTa nidarzana niYe Asala, takhana tArA tAdera nijedera kAche ye jJAna o vidyA chila tAtei utphulla haYe uThala| ataHpara yA niYe tArA ThATTA vidrupa karata tA-i tAderake ghire phelala|
AmAra zAsti tArA yakhana dekhala takhana tArA valala- AmarA eka AllAhara prati ImAna AnalAma Ara yAderake AmarA (AllAhara) zarIka gaNya karatAma tAderake pratyAkhyAna karalAma|

tArA yakhana AmAra zAsti dekhala takhana tAdera ImAna (grahaNa) tAdera kona upakAre Asala nA| AllAhara (e) vidhAna tA~ra vAndAhadera upara (vahu) pUrva hatei (kAryakara haYe) cale Asache| Ara e kSetre kAphirarAi kSatigrasta haYa|
hA-mIma|
parama daYAmaYa, parama daYAlura nikaTa hate avatIrNa|
eka kitAva, yAra AYAtagulo vistAritabhAve vyAkhyAkRta, AravI bhASAra kuraAna, jJAnasampanna mAnuSadera janya|
susaMvAdavAhI o sAvadhAnakArI| kintu odera adhikAMzai (e kuraAna theke) mukha phiriYe niYeche, kAjei orA zunave nA|

tArA vale, tumi AmAderake yAra dike DAka diccha tAttheke AmAdera dila AvaraNe DhAkA Ache, Ara AmAdera kAne Ache vadhiratA, AmAdera Ara tomAdera mAjhe Ache eka pardA (arthAt tomAra dIna pracArera kAraNe AmAdera o tomAdera mAjhe viccheda ghaTe geche), kAjei tumi tomAra kAja kara, AmarA AmAdera kAja kari|

vala, Ami tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa| (pArthakya zudhu ei ye) AmAra kAche oYAhI karA haYa ye, tomAdera ilAha kevala eka ilAha; kAjei tomarA tA~rai sarala saThika pathe cala, tA~ra kAche kSamA prArthanA kara| dhvaMsa tAdera janya yArA AllAhara sAthe anyaderake zarIka gaNya kare|
yArA yAkAta deYa nA, Ara tArA AkhirAta amAnya kare|
yArA ImAna Ane Ara neka kAja kare, tAdera janya Ache emana puraskAra yA kona dinao vandha have nA|
vala- tomarA ki tA~ke asvIkArai karacha yini yamInake sRSTi karechena du’dine Ara tA~ra samakakSa vAnAccha? tinii to vizvajagatera ravva|

(yamIna sRSTira para) tAra vuke tini sRdRr3ha parvatamAlA sthApana karechena, yamInake varakatamanDita karechena Ara tAte prArthIdera praYojana mutAveka nirdiSTa parimANa khAdya saJcita karechena cAra dine|

tArapara najara diYechena AkAzera dike yakhana tA chila dho~YA (’ra mata)| takhana tini AkAza Ara pRthivIke valalena- AmAra anugata hao, icchAYa athavA anicchAYa| ubhaYe valala- AmarA svecchAYa anugata halAma|

ataHpara tini AkAzamanDalIke sAta AkAze vinyasta karalena du’dine Ara pratyeka AkAzake tAra vidhi-vyavasthA oYAhIra mAdhyame pradAna karalena| Ami AlokamAlAra sAhAyye duniYAra AkAzera zobhAvardhana karalAma Ara surakSAra (o vyavasthA karalAma)| e hala mahA parAkramazAlI sarvajJa AllAhara sunirdhArita (vyavasthApanA)|
eraparao tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale vala- Ami tomAderake akasmAt zAstira bhaYa dekhAcchi- ‘Ada o sAmUdera (upara neme AsA) akasmAt-zAstira mata|

tAdera kAche yakhana tAdera agre o pazcAte (ekera para eka) rasUlagaNa esechila (Ara valechila)- tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro ‘ivAdAta karo nA| (javAve) tArA valechila- AmAdera pratipAlaka icche karale to avazyai pherezatA nAyila karatena| kAjei tomAderake yA diYe pAThAno haYeche AmarA tA amAnya karachi|

Ara ‘Ada-era avasthA chila ei ye, duniYAte tArA nA-haka ahaMkAra karechila, Ara valechila- AmAdera ceYe vezi zaktizAlI Ara ke Ache? tArA ki cintA kare dekheni ye, AllAha- yini tAderake sRSTi karechena- zaktite tAdera ceYe pravala? kintu tArA AmAra AYAtagulo asvIkAra karatei thAkala|

ataHpara Ami azubha dinagulote tAdera viruddhe jhAJjhA vAYu pAThAlAma yAte tArA duniYAra jIvane apamAnajanaka zAsti AsvAdana kare| AkhirAtera zAsti avazyai adhika lAJchanAdAYaka Ara tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|

Ara sAmUdera avasthA ei ye, Ami tAderake saThika pathe calAra nirdeza diYechilAma| kintu tArA saThika pathe calAra parivarte andha haYe thAkAkei pachanda kare chila| takhana tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe apamAnajanaka zAstira vajrAghAta tAderake pAkar3Ao karala|
Ara Ami tAderake vA~ciYe dilAma yArA ImAna enechila Ara (AllAhake) bhaYa kare calata|
ye dina AllAhara duzamanaderake jAhAnnAmera dike samaveta karA have, tAderake vibhinna dale vinyasta karA have|
zeSa paryanta yakhana tArA jAhAnnAmera nikaTe pau~chave, takhana tArA yA karata se samparke tAdera kAna, tAdera cokha Ara tAdera cAmar3A tAdera viruddhe sAkSya deve|

tArA tAdera cAmar3Ake valave- AmAdera viruddhe kena sAkSya diccha? tArA uttara dive- AllAha AmAderake kathA valAra zakti diYechena, yini sava kichukei (Aja) kathA valAra zakti diYechena| tinii prathamavAra tomAderake sRSTi karechena, Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neYA have|

(duniYAYa nijedera zarIrera aMzaguloke tomarA) ei bheve gopana karate nA ye, nA tomAdera kAna, nA tomAdera cokha Ara nA tomAdera cAmar3A tomAdera viruddhe sAkSya deve| varaM tomarA mane karate ye, tomarA yA kara tAra adhikAMzai AllAha jAnena nA|
tomAdera ei (bhula) dhAraNAi- yA tomarA tomAdera pratipAlaka samparke poSaNa karate- tomAderake dhvaMsa kareche, phale tomarA kSatigrastadera dale zAmila haYe gecha|
ekhana yadi tArA dhairya dhAraNa kare tavuo jAhAnnAmai have tAdera AvAsa, Ara yadi tArA kSamA prArthanA kare tavuo tArA kSamAprApta have nA|

Ami tAderake prANera vandhu juTiYe diYechilAma, yArA tAderake tAdera sAmanera Ara pichanera pratyekaTi jinisake cAkacikyamaYa kare dekhAcchila| zeSa paryanta tAdera uparao temani ‘AyAvera phaYasAlA kAryakara hala, yA tAdera pUrvavartI jvina o mAnava dalera upara kAryakara haYechila| vAstavikai tArA kSatigrasta haYe gela|
kAphirarA vale- e kuraAna zuno nA, Ara tA par3Ara kAle zoragola kara yAte tomarA vijaYI hate pAra|
phalataH Ami kAphiraderake avazya avazyai kaThina zAsti AsvAdana karAva, Ara Ami avazya avazyai tAderake tAdera nikRSTatama kAjera anusAre pratiphala diva|
AllAhara duzamanadera janya pratiphala hala e jAhAnnAma| tAte Ache tAdera janya cirasthAYI AvAsa| (e hala tAdera) pratiphala, kAraNa tArA AmAra AYAtaguloke asvIkAra karata|

kAphirarA valave- he AmAdera pratipAlaka! jvina o mAnuSadera madhyekAra yArA AmAderake pathabhraSTa karechila tAdera ubhaYake dekhiYe dina, tAdera ubhaYake pAYera talAYa piSTa karava, yAte tArA nikRSTa adhamadera madhye gaNya haYa|

yArA vale- AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAha, ataHpara (se kathAra upara) sudRr3ha thAke, pherezatArA tAdera nikaTa avatIrNa haYa Ara vale, tomarA bhaYa karo nA, cintA karo nA, Ara jAnnAtera susaMvAda grahaNa kara yAra oYA‘dA tomAderake deYA haYeche|

pArthiva jIvane Ara AkhirAte AmarAi tomAdera saGgI-sAthI| Ara sekhAne (arthAt jAnnAte) tomAdera janya tomAdera mana yA cAYa tA-i Ache; tomarA ye jinisera AkAGkSA kara, tomAdera janya sekhAne tA-i Ache
parama kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu (AllAha)’ra pakSa theke ApyAYana hiseve|
kathAYa ai vyakti theke ke vezi uttama ye (mAnuSake) AllAhara dike AhavAna kare, Ara sat kAja kare evaM vale, ‘Ami (AllAhara prati) anugatadera antarbhukta’|
bhAla Ara manda samAna naYa| utkRSTa diYe mandake dUra kara| takhana dekhave, tomAra Ara yAra madhye zatrutA Ache se yena antaraGga vandhu|
e guNa kevala tArAi lAbha kare yArA dhairyazIla, e guNa kevala tArAi lAbha kare yArA mahA bhAgyavAna|
zaYatvAnera pakSa theke yadi tumi kumantraNA anubhava kara, tAhale AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA kara| tini sarvazrotA sarvajJa|

tA~ra nidarzanagulora madhye hala rAta, dina, sUrya Ara candra| sUryake sejadA karo nA, candrakeo nA| sejadA kara AllAhake yini oguloke sRSTi karechena yadi satyikArabhAve ekamAtra tA~rai tomarA ivAdAta karate cAo|

ataHpara tArA yadi ahaMkAra kare tave (tArA jene nika ye), tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTe yArA raYeche tArA dina-rAta tA~ra mAhAtmya varNanAYa lipta Ache, Ara tArA kakhanao klAntivodha kare nA|[sAjadAha]

tA~ra nidarzanagulora madhye hala ei ye, tumi yamInake dekha zuSka anurvara par3e Ache| ataHpara Ami yakhana tAra upara vRSTi varSaNa kari takhana tA sateja haYa o ver3e yAYa| yini e mRta yamInake jIvita karena, tini avazyai mRtaderake jIvita karavena| tini sakala viSaYera upara kSamatAvAna|

yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera arthake bhinnapathe paricAlita kare, tArA AmAra theke lukkAYita naYa| yAke jAhAnnAme nikSepa karA have sei uttama nA ai vyakti ye kviYAmatera dina sampUrNa nirApada haYe hAjira have? tomAdera yA icche haYa karate thAka| tomarA yA kara tA tini (khuva bhAlabhAvei) dekhena|
yArA tAdera kAche upadeza vANI AsAra para tA pratyAkhyAna kare (tArA AmAra theke lukkAYita naYa)| eTA hala avazyai eka mahA zaktizAlI grantha|
mithyA era kAche nA era sAmane diYe Asate pAre, nA era pichana diYe| eTA avatIrNa haYeche mahAjJAnI, sakala prazaMsAra yogya (AllAha)’ra pakSa hate|
tomAke tA-i valA hacche yA valA hata tomAra pUrvavartI rasUladerake| tomAra pratipAlaka avazyai kSamAra adhikArI, Ara yantraNAdAYaka zAstidAtA|

Ami yadi eke anArava bhASAYa (avatIrNa) kuraAna karatAma tAhale tArA avazyai valata- era AYAtagulo suspaSTabhAve varNanA karA hala nA kena? Azcarya vyApAra! kitAva hala anArava dezIYa Ara zrotArA hala AravIbhASI| vala- yArA ImAna Ane tAdera janya e kuraAna saThika pathera dizArI o Arogya (lAbhera upAYa)| yArA ImAna Ane nA tAdera kAne Ache vadhiratA, Ara e kuraAna tAdera janya andhatva| (yena) vahu dUra theke tAderake DAkA hacche|

(itopUrve) mUsAke Ami kitAva diYechilAma, kintu tAte matabheda karA haYechila| tomAra pratipAlaka yadi pUrvei ekaTi kathA ghoSaNA kare nA ditena, tAhale tAdera madhye (matabhedera vyApAre) phaYasAlA karei ditena| tArA e vyApAre eka asthiratApUrNa sandehe lipta|
ye satkAja karave nijera kalyANei karave. ye asat kAja karave tAra pariNati tAkei bhoga karate have| tomAra pratipAlaka vAndAdera prati yAlima nana|

kviYAmata kakhana saMghaTita have se samparkita jJAna ekamAtra tA~ra kAchei Ache| kona phalai tAra AvaraNa theke veriYe Ase nA, evaM kona nArI garbhadhAraNa kare nA Ara santAna prasava kare nA tA~ra ajJAte| ye dina tini tAderake Deke valavena- AmAra zarIkarA kothAYa (tomarA yegulo vAniYe niYechile)? tArA valave- ApanAke nizcaYatA dicchi ye, (Aja) AmAdera keu (ApanAra zarIka thAkAra vyApAre) sAkSya dAtA have nA|
pUrve tArA yAderake DAkata tArA tAdera theke udhAo haYe yAve, Ara tArA vujhate pArave ye, tAdera pAlAnora kona jAYagA nei|
mAnuSa nijera kalyANa kAmanAYa du‘A prArthanA karate klAnta haYa nA, Ara manda yakhana tAke sparza kare, takhana se nairAzye Duve yAYa|

duHkha-vipada mAnuSake sparza karAra para Ami yakhana tAke AmAra anugraha AsvAdana karAi takhana se avazya avazyai vale- eTA AmAra nyAyya pAonA| kviYAmata ye saMghaTita have Ami moTei tA mane kari nA| Ara yadi AmAke AmAra pratipAlakera nikaTa phiriYe neYA haYai, tave tA~ra kAche AmAra janya avazyai kalyANa Ache| ataHpara Ami kAphiraderake avazya avazyai jAniYe deva tArA (duniYAte) kI kAja karechila| Ara avazya avazyai tAderake Ami kaThina zAsti AsvAdana karAva|
Ami yakhana mAnuSake ni‘mAta dei takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa, Ara pAza keTe (AmAra theke dUre) sare yAYa| Ara yakhana manda tAke sparza kare, takhana se lamvA-caor3A du‘A karate thAke|

vala- tomarA ki bheve dekhecha e (kuraAna) yadi AllAhara pakSa thekei ese thAke, Ara tomarA seTAke asvIkAra karatei thAka, tAhale se vyakti chAr3A adhika pathabhraSTa Ara ke Ache, ye virodhitAYa vahu dUre cale geche?

Ami tAderake AmAra nidarzanAvalI dekhAva dUra digante (arthAt dUra paryanta isalAmera Alo vicchurita have) Ara tAdera nijedera madhyeo (arthAt kAphirarA natajAnu haYe isalAma kavUla karave) yakhana tAdera kAche spaSTa haYe yAve ye, e kuraAna satya| eTA ki yatheSTa naYa ye, tomAra pratipAlaka sava kichurai sAkSI|
zune rAkha, erA tAdera pratipAlakera saGge sAkSAtera vyApAre sandehe par3e Ache| zune rAkha, tini sava kichukei veSTana kare Achena|
hA-mIma|
‘Aina-sIna-kvApha|
ebhAvei mahAparAkramazAlI mahAjJAnI AllAha tomAra prati evaM tomAra pUrve yArA chila tAdera prati oYAhI nAyila karena|
AkAza o yamIne yA kichu Ache savai tA~ra, tini sarvocca, mahAna|

AkAza upara theke pheTe par3Ara upakrama haYa (sumahAna AllAhara prati zraddhApUrNa bhaYabhItite) Ara pherezatArA tAdera pratipAlakera prazaMsA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare evaM yArA pRthivIte Ache tAdera janya (AllAhara nikaTa) kSamA prArthanA kare| jene rekha, AllAha, tini var3ai kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|
yArA AllAhara parivarte anyaderake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa kare, AllAha tAdera prati nayara rAkhachena, tAdera (kAjera) dAYa-dAYitva tomAra upara nei|

ebhAve Ami tomAra prati kuraAna AravI bhASAYa nAyila karechi yAte tumi ummula kurA (makkA zahara) o tAra cAra pAze yArA Ache tAderake satarka karate pAra, Ara satarka kara ekatrita haoYAra dina samparke ye viSaYe kona sandeha nei| (ekatrita haoYAra para) eka dala yAve jAnnAte, Areka dala yAve jAhAnnAme|
AllAha icche karale tAderake ekai ummata karatena, kintu tini yAke icche tA~ra rahamAtera madhye dAkhila karena, Ara yAlimadera janya nei kona abhibhAvaka, nei kona sAhAyyakArI|
kI! tArA ki AllAhara parivarte anyaderake abhibhAvaka grahaNa kare niYeche? AllAhai to ekamAtra abhibhAvaka, tinii mRtake jIvita karena Ara tini sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
tomarA ye sava viSaYe matabheda kara tAra mImAMsA AllAhara upara soparda. sei AllAhai AmAra pratipAlaka, Ami tA~ra uparai nirbhara kari, Ara tA~rai abhimukhI hai|

AkAzasamUha o yamInera sraSTA| tini tomAdera janya tomAdera madhya hate yugala sRSTi karechena, catuspada jantudera madhyeo sRSTi karechena jor3A, ebhAvei tini tomAdera vaMzadhArA vistRta karena, kona kichui tA~ra sadRza naYa, tini sava zonena, sava dekhena|
AsamAna o yamInera cAvikAThi tA~rai hAte nivaddha| yAra janya icche tini riyaka prazasta karena o (yAra janya icche) sImita karena| sava viSaYei tini savaceYe jJAnI|

tini tomAdera janya dvInera sei vidhi-vyavasthAi diYechena yAra hukuma tini diYechilena nUhake| Ara sei (vidhi vyavasthAi) tomAke oYAhIra mAdhyame dilAma yAra hukuma diYechilAma ivarAhIma, mUsA o ‘IsAke- tA ei ye, tomarA dvIna pratiSThita kara, Ara tAte vibhakti sRSTi karo nA, vyApAraTi muzarikadera janya kaThina haYe dA~r3iYeche yAra dike tumi tAderake AhavAna jAnAccha| AllAha yAke icche karena tA~ra pathe veche nena, Ara tini tA~ra pathe paricAlita karena tAke, ye tA~ra abhimukhI haYa|

mAnuSera kAche ilama AsAra para (vibhinna aMze) vibhakta haYe gela nijedera madhye vAr3AvAr3i karAra kAraNe| pUrvei yadi tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa hate ekaTA nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta phaYasAlA mUlatavI rAkhAra kathA ghoSita nA hata, tAhale tAdera madhye (pUrvei) phaYasAlA kare deYA hata| AgekAra lokedera pare yArA (tAorAta o iJjila e du’) kitAva uttarAdhikAra sUtre pApta haYeche, tArA asvastikara sandehe patita haYeche|

avasthAra ei prekSApaTe (he navI!) tAderake AhavAna kara (dvInera prati), Ara tomAke ye hukuma deYA haYeche tumi tAra prati sudRr3ha thAka, Ara tAdera kheYAla khuzira anusaraNa karo nA| Ara vala, AllAha ye kitAvai avatIrNa karechena Ami tAra prati ImAna enechi| tomAdera mAjhe inasApha karAra janya AmAke nirdeza deYA haYeche| AllAha AmAderao pratipAlaka, tomAderao pratipAlaka| AmAdera kAjera pratiphala AmarA bhoga karava| Ara tomAdera kAjera pratiphala tomarA bhoga karave| AmAdera Ara tomAdera mAjhe kona jhagar3A nei| AllAha AmAdera savAike (ekadina) ekatrita karavena, Ara tA~ra kAchei (sakalake) phire yete have|
AllAhara AhavAne sAr3A deYAra para se samparke yArA vitarke lipta haYa, tAdera dalIla pramANa tAdera ravva-era kAche vAtila| tAdera prati (AllAhara) gayava Ara tAdera janya Ache kaThina zAsti|
tinii AllAha yini satya o inasAphera mAnadanDa sahakAre kitAva avatIrNa karechena| tumi ki jAna, sambhavataH cUr3Anta phaYasAlAra samaYa nikaTavartI haYe geche|

ye sava loka tAte vizvAsa kare nA, tArAi tAra (arthAt kviYAmatera) Agamanake tarAnvita karate cAYa| kintu yArA vizvAsI tArA tAke bhaYa kare Ara tArA jAne ye, tA satya| jene rekha, yArA kviYAmata samparke vitarka kare, tArA spaSTatai satya patha hate vahu dUre cale geche|
AllAha tA~ra vAndAhadera prati meheravAna, tini yAke yA icche riyaka dena| tini pravala, mahAparAkramazAlI|
ye loka parakAlera kSeta karate cAYa, Ami tAra janya tAra kSete vRddhi dAna kari| Ara ye loka duniYAra kSeta cAYa, Ami tAke tAttheke dei, kintu parakAle tAra aMze (vA bhAgye) kichui nei|

kI! tAdera ki emana zarIka Ache yArA tAdera janya dvInera vidhi-vidhAna diYeche yAra anumati AllAha denani? phaYasAlA samparkita (pUrva) ghoSaNA deYA nA hale tAdera madhye (tatkSaNAt) phaYasAlA kare deYA hata| yAlimadera janya Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

yAlimaderake tumi tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe bhIta-santrasta dekhate pAve| tAdera karmera zAsti avazyai tAdera upara patita have| Ara yArA ImAna eneche Ara satkarma kareche tArA jAnnAtera vAgicAYa avasthAna karave| tArA yA icche karave, tAdera janya tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa tA-i Ache| oTAi ati var3a anugraha|

eTA hala tAi AllAha yAra susaMvAda diYechena tA~ra se sava vAndAhadera janya yArA ImAna Ane Ara sat kAja kare| vala, e kAjera janya AtmIYatAra bhAlavAsA chAr3A tomAdera kAche kichui cAi nA| ye keu uttama kAja kare, Ami tAra janya tAte puNya vAr3iYe dei| AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, bhAla kAjera var3ai maryAdAdAnakArI|

tArA ki vale ye, e loka AllAhara nAme mithyA racanA kareche? AllAha cAile tomAra hRdaYe mohara mere ditena| vastutaH tini mithyAke miTiYe dena evaM nija vAkya dvArA satyake pratiSThita karena| tini (sakalera) antare nihita viSaYa samparke khuvai avagata|
tini tA~ra vAndAhadera tAovAha kvavUla karena, pApa kSamA karena Ara tini jAnena tomarA yA kara|
yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkarma kare tini tAdera AhavAna zunena, Ara tini tAdera prati nija anugraha vAr3iYe dena Ara kAphiradera janya Ache kaThina zAsti|

AllAha yadi tA~ra sakala vAndAhadera janya riyaka paryApta kare ditena, tAhale tArA avazyai yamIne vidroha sRSTi karata; kintu tini ekaTA nirdiSTa parimANe yataTuku icche nAyila karena| tini tA~ra vAndAhdera samparke pUrNa oYAkiphahAla, tini tAdera prati sarvadA dRSTi rAkhena|
mAnuSa nirAza haYe yAoYAra para tinii vRSTi varSaNa karena, Ara svIYa rahamata char3iYe dena, tini-i sakala guNe prazaMsita prakRta abhibhAvaka|
tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera antargata hala AsamAna o yamInera sRSTi, Ara e du’Yera bhitara ye prANIkula char3iYe diYechena tini| Ara yakhana icche tini tAderake ekatrita karate sakSama|
tomAdera upara ye vipadai upanIta haYa tA tomAdera hAtera upArjanera kAraNei, tini aneka aparAdhai kSamA kare dena|
tomarA yamIne (AllAhara karma o parikalpanAke) bhanDula (akSama) karate pArave nA| AllAha chAr3A tomAdera nA Ache kona abhibhAvaka, Ara nA Ache sAhAyyakArI|
tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye hala samudre nirvighne calamAna jAhAja- pAhAr3era mata|
tini yadi icche karena vAtAsake thAmiYe dite pArena, takhana jAhAjagulo samudra pRSThe gatihIna haYe par3ave| ete pratyeka ati dhairyazIla zukara AdAYakArIra janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
kiMvA tini oguloke dhvaMsa kare dite pArena tAdera upArjita pApera kAraNe, Ara prakRtapakSe tini to (tAdera) aneka doSa-truTii kSamA kare dena|
(Ara oguloke dhvaMsa karA haYa) ejanyao ye, AmAra AYAta niYe yArA vitarka kare tArA yena jene neYa ye, tAdera (AllAhara kAcha theke pAliYe anyatra AzraYa neYAra janya) kona AzraYasthala nei|

(ekhAne) tomAderake yA kichu deYA haYeche tA asthAYI duniYAra jIvanera (sAmAnya) bhogyavastu mAtra| AllAhara nikaTa yA Ache tA utkRSTa evaM sthAYI (Ara tA hala) tAdera janya yArA ImAna Ane evaM tAdera pratipAlakera upara nirbhara kare|
yArA var3a var3a pApa evaM azlIla kAryakalApa hate ve~ce cale evaM rAgAnvita haYeo kSamA kare|

yArA tAdera pratipAlakera (nirdeza pAlanera mAdhyame tA~ra) prati sAr3A deYa, niYamita nAmAya pratiSThA kare, pArasparika parAmarzera bhittite nijedera kAryAdi paricAlanA kare| Ara Ami tAderake ye riyaka diYechi tAttheke vyaYa kare|
Ara tAdera upara atirikta vAr3AvAr3i karA hale nijedera pratirakSAra vyavasthA kare|
anyAYera pratividhAna hala anurUpa anyAYa| ataHpara ye kSamA kare evaM samajhotA kare, tAra pratidAna deYA AllAhara yimmAYa| sImAGghanakArIderake AllAha pachanda karena nA|
keu atyAcArita haYe nijera pratirakSAra vyavasthA nile, tAra viruddhe kona abhiyoga nei|
abhiyoga to tAdera viruddhe yArA mAnuSera prati atyAcAra kare, Ara anyAYabhAve yamIne vidroha sRSTi kare; tAdera janya Ache yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
Ara ye vyakti (atyAcArita haoYAra parao) dhairya dhAraNa kare, Ara (atyAcArIke) kSamA kare deYa, tAhale tA avazyai dRr3ha cittatAra kAja|
AllAhai yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tAra janya tini chAr3A kona abhibhAvaka nei| tumi dekhave, yakhana yAlimarA ‘AyAva pratyakSa karave takhana valave- phire yAoYAra kona patha Ache ki?

tumi (Aro) dekhave, tAderake jAhAnnAmera sammukhe upasthita karA have, tArA thAkave apamAne avanata, tArA lukiYe tAkAve| Ara yArA ImAna eneche tArA valave, satyikAra kSatigrasta to tArAi yArA kviYAmatera dine nijederake evaM nijedera parivAra-parijanake kSatigrasta kareche| sAvadhAna! yAlimarA thAkave sthAYI ‘AyAve|
tAdera kona abhibhAvaka thAkave nA AllAh vyatIta yArA tAderake sAhAyya karate pAre| AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra (zAsti theke vA~cAra) kona rAstA nei|

tomarA tomAdera pratipAlakera kathAYa sAr3A dAo sei dina AsAra pUrve AllAha (’ra hukume yA saMghaTita haoYA) theke phiriYe rAkhAra keu nei| sedina tomAdera janya AzraYasthala thAkave nA, thAkave nA tomAdera janya kona pratirodhakArI|

etadasattveo tArA yadi mukha phiriYei neYa (tAhale phiriYe nika, kAraNa) Ami tomAke tAdera hiphAyAtakArI vAniYe pAThAini| kathA pau~che deYAi tomAra dAYitva| Ami yakhana mAnuSake AmAra rahamata AsvAdana karAi, takhana se utphulla haYa| Ara yakhana tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe tAdera kona aniSTa haYa, takhana mAnuSa akRtajJa haYe yAYa|
AsamAna o yamInera rAjatva AllAharai, yA cAna tini sRSTi karena| yAke cAna kanyA-santAna dena, yAke cAna putra santAna dena|
athavA tAderake dena putra o kanyA ubhaYai| Ara yAke icche vandhyA karena| tini sarva viSaYe sarvAdhika avahita o kSamatAvAna|

kona mAnuSera e maryAdA nei ye, AllAha tAra sAthe (sarAsari) kathA valavena oYAhIra mAdhyama vA pardAra Ar3Ala vA kona dUta preraNa chAr3A| ataHpara AllAhara anumatikrame se (manonIta mAnuSera kAche) oYAhI kare yA tini (AllAha) cAna| tini sumahAna o mahAvijJAnI|

ebhAve (uparokta 3Ti upAYei) AmAra nirdezera mUla zikSAke tomAra kAche Ami oYAhI yoge preraNa karechi| tumi jAnate nA kitAva kI, ImAna kI, kintu Ami eke (arthAt oYAhI yoge prerita kuraAnake) karechi Alo, yAra sAhAyye AmAra vAndAhadera madhya hate yAke icche Ami saThika pathe paricAlita kari| tumi nizcitai (mAnuSaderake) saThika pathera dike nirdeza karacha|
yA kichu AkAze Ache Ara yamIne Ache esavera mAlika yini sei AllAhara pathe| zune rAkha! AllAhara kAchei sava viSaYa phire yAYa|
hA-mIma|
zapatha suspaSTa kitAvera|
Ami oTAke karechi AravI bhASAra kuraAna yAte tomarA vujhate pAre|
AmAra kAche tA ummula kitAve (lAohe mAhaphuje) saMrakSita Ache, Ara tA hala ati ucca maryAdAsampanna jJAna-vijJAne pUrNa|
tomarA eka sImAlaGghanakArI jAti- e kAraNe ki Ami tomAdera kAcha theke kuraAna pratyAhAra kare neva?
pUrvekAra jAtigulora madhye Ami vahu rasUla pAThiYechilAma|
tAdera kAche emana kona navI Aseni yAke tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa kareni|
Ami tAderake dhvaMsa karechi- yArA chila edera ceYe aneka vezi zaktizAlI| pUrvera jAtigulora udAharaNa atIta haYe geche|
tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa kara- AkAza o yamIna ke sRSTi kareche? tArA avazya avazyai valave- ogulo pravala parAkramazAlI mahAjJAnI AllAha sRSTi karechena,
yini tomAdera janya yamInake karechena vistRta, Ara tAte tomAdera janya vAniYechena calAra patha- yAte tomarA saThika patha pete pAra|
yini AkAza theke parimita pAni varSaNa karena yA diYe tini mRta bhU-bhAgake saJjIvita karena| ebhAvei tomAderake vera karA have|
tini sava kichuke jor3A jor3A sRSTi karechena, Ara tomAdera janya nauyAna o gavAdi pazu sRSTi karechena yAte tomarA ArohaNa kara,

yAte tomarA yakhana tAdera piThe sthira haYe vasa, takhana yena tomAdera pratipAlakera anugrahera kathA smaraNa kara Ara vala- mahAna o pavitra tini yini, eguloke AmAdera (vyavahArera janya) vazIbhUta kare diYechena, AmarA eguloke vazIbhUta karate sakSama chilAma nA|
Ara AmAderake avazyai AmAdera pratipAlakera dike phire yete have|
Ara tArA AllAhara vAndAdera madhya hate katakake AllAhara aMza mane kare niYeche (yemana ‘IsA (AH)-ke tArA AllAhara putra mane kare)| mAnuSa avazyai spaSTataH akRtajJa|
ki! tini tA~rai sRSTi hate kanyA santAna grahaNa karechena Ara tomAdera janya manonIta karechena putra santAna?
tAdera kAuke yakhana saMvAda deYA haYa sei santAnera yA tArA daYAmaYa AllAhara prati Aropa kare, takhana tAra mukha manDale kAlimA cheYe yAYa, Ara mana duHkha vedanAYa bhare yAYa|
tArA ki AllAhara janya nirdhArita kare emana santAna ye alaMkAre lAlita pAlita haYa, Ara vitarkakAle vaktavyake spaSTa karate asamartha?
tArA daYAmaYera vAndAh pherezatAderake nArI gaNya kare| tArA ki pherezatAderake sRSTi sarAsari dekheche? tAdera sAkSya likhe rAkhA have evaM tArA jijJAsita have|
tArA Aro vale- daYAmaYa AllAha icche karale AmarA odera pU~jA karatAma nA| e viSaYe tAdera kona jJAnai nei| tArA zudhu AndAja anumAne kathA vale|
Ami ki tAderake era (arthAt kuraAnera) Age kona kitAva diYechi ataHpara tArA tA aA~kar3e dhare Ache?
varaM tArA vale- AmarA AmAdera pUrva puruSaderake eka dharmamata pAlanarata peYechi Ara AmarA tAdera padAGka anusaraNa kare pathaprApta haYechi|

ebhAve tomAra pUrve yakhanai Ami kona janapade satarkakArI (navI-rasUla) pAThiYechi, takhanai tAdera sampadazAlI lokerA valeche- AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake eka dharmamata pAlanarata peYechi Ara AmarA tAderai padAGka anusaraNa karachi|

takhana sei satarkakArI valata- tomarA tomAdera pitRpuruSake ye dharmamatera upara peYecha, Ami yadi tomAdera kAche tAra ceYe utkRSTa dharmamata niYe Asi (tavuo ki tomarA tAderai anusaraNa karave)? tArA valataH tomAderake yA diYe pAThAno haYeche AmarA tA pratyAkhyAna kari|
ataHpara Ami tAdera upara pratizodha grahaNa karalAma, ekhana dekha, mithyukadera pariNati kI haYechila|
smaraNa kara, ivarAhIma (A.) yakhana tAra pitAke o tAra jAtike valechila- tomarA yegulora pUjA kara, segulo theke Ami samparkahIna|
AmAra samparka Ache zudhu tA~ra sAthe yini AmAke sRSTi karechena, tinii AmAke saThika patha dekhAvena|
e kathATike se sthAYI vANIrUpe tAra paravartIdera madhye rekhe geche, yAte tArA (AllAhara pathe) phire Ase|
hyA~, Amii tAderake Ara tAdera pUrvapuruSake bhogera sAmagrI diYechilAma| avazeSe tAdera kAche Asalo satya evaM savakichu spaSTakArI rasUla|
satya yakhana tAdera kAche Asala takhana tArA valala- eTA yAdu, AmarA eTA mAni nA|
tArA valala- e kuraAna (makkA o tAYepha e) du’ janapadera kona gaNyamAnya vyaktira upara kena avatIrNa hala nA?

tomAra pratipAlakera rahamata ki tArA vaNTana kare (ye tAdera marjimata kuraAna nAyila karate have)? tAdera mAjhe tAdera jIvikA Amii vaNTana karechi pArthiva jIvane evaM maryAdAYa ekake anyera upara unnata kari yAte eke aparera sahAYatA grahaNa karate pAre| tArA yA saJcaYa kare, tomAra pratipAlakera rahamata tAttheke uttama

(satyake asvIkAra ka’re) sava eka jAtite pariNata have e AzaGkA nA thAkale yArA daYAmaYa AllAhake asvIkAra kare tAderake avazyai ditAma tAdera gRhera janya raupya nirmita chAda Ara si~r3i yAte tArA ArohaNa karata|
Ara tAdera gRhera janya ditAma darajA o pAlaGka yAte tArA helAna diYe vasata|
Ara svarNa nirmitao ditAma| egulo savai to pArthiva jIvanera bhogya sAmagrI mAtra| Ara AkhirAta tomAra pratipAlakera kAche tAderai janya yArA (AllAhake) bhaYa kare|
ye vyakti daYAmaYa AllAhara smaraNa theke nijeke phiriYe neYa, Ami tAra janya zaYatvAnake niYojita kari, ataHpara se haYa tAra ghaniSTha sahacara|
tArAi mAnuSake satpathe calate avazyai vAdhA deYa, Ara mAnuSa mane kare ye, tArA saThika pathe raYeche|
avazeSe se yakhana AmAra kAche Asave, takhana zaYatvAnake valave, hAYa! AmAra o tomAra mAjhe yadi pUrva o pazcimera vyavadhAna thAkata! katai nA nikRSTa sahacara se!
tomAdera hA-hutAza Aja tomAdera kona kAje Asave nA yehetu tomarA sImAlaGghana karechile| tomarA have zAstira aMzIdAra|
tumi ki vadhirake zunAte pArave athavA ye andha Ara ye Ache suspaSTa pathabhraSTera madhye tAke satpatha dekhAte pArave?
Ami yadi tomAke (duniYA theke) niYeo yAi, tavu Ami tAdera kAcha theke pratizodha grahaNa karava|
athavA Ami tAderake ye ‘AyAvera o‘YAdA diYechi tA yadi tomAke dekhiYe dei (AmAra pakSe savai sambhava), kAraNa tAdera upara AmAra pUrNa kSamatA Ache|
kAjei tomAra prati yA oYAhI karA haYa tumi tA dRr3habhAve A~kar3e dhara, kenanA tumi to Acha sarala saThika pathe|
kuraAna hala avazyai tomAra janya Ara tomAra jAtira janya upadeza vANI| Ara e samparke acirei tomAderake jaoYAvadihi karate have|

Ami tomAra pUrve ye sava rasUla pAThiYechilAma tAderake jijJesa kara (arthAt tAdera kitAva dekha o tAdera satyikAra anusArIdera nikaTa yAcAi kara) Ami ki daYAmaYa AllAha chAr3A kona ilAha sthira karechilAma yAdera ‘ivAdAta karate have?
