Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzanasaha pherAuna o tAra pradhAnadera nikaTa pAThiYechilAma| mUsA (A.) valechila- Ami vizvajagatera pratipAlakera rasUla|
yakhana se AmAra AYAtasamUha niYe tAdera kAche Asalo, takhana tArA tA niYe hAsi-ThATTA karate lAgala|
Ami tAderake ye nidarzanai dekhAtAma tA hata pUrvavartI nidarzana theke var3a| Ami tAderake zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karalAma yAte tArA (AmAra pathe) phire Ase|
(zAstite AkrAnta haYe) tArA valechila- ohe yAdukara! tumi AmAdera janya tomAra pratipAlakera kAche tA cAo yAra o‘YAdA tini tomAra kAche karechena| AmarA avazyai satpathe calava|
kintu yakhanai Ami tAdera theke zAsti sariYe dilAma, takhanai tArA aGgIkAra bhaGga kare vasala|
pherAuna tAra sampradAYera mAjhe ghoSaNA dila| valala- he AmAra sampradAYa! misarera rAjatva ki AmAra naYa? Ara e sava nadanadI AmAra nIca diYe vaYe yAcche, tomarA ki tA dekha nA?
Ami ki e loka theke zreSTha nai ye nIca, ye nijera kathATio spaSTa kare valate akSama!
(se yadi AllAhara rasUlai haYe thAke) tAhale tA~ke kena svarNa kaGkana deYA hala nA? athavA sArivaddhabhAve pherezatArA kena tAra sAthe Asala nA?
ebhAve se tAra jAtira lokedera vokA vAniYe dila| phale tArA tAra kathA mene nila| tArA chila eka pApAcArI sampradAYa|
tArA yakhana AmAke rAgAnvita karala, takhana Ami tAdera upara pratizodha nilAma, ataHpara savvAike DuviYe mAralAma|
ebhAve Ami tAderake karalAma atItera mAnuSa Ara paravartIdera janya dRSTAnta|
yakhana mAraiYAma-putra ‘IsAra dRSTAnta tule dharA haYa, takhana tomAra jAtira lokerA haTTagola zuru kare deYa,

evaM vale AmAdera upAsyarA uttama nA ‘IsA? (kAraNa khRsTAnarA ‘IsAke upAsya vAniYeche Ara AmarA makkAvAsIrA upAsya vAniYechi anyaderake)| tArA zudhu vitarka sRSTira uddezyei tomAra sAmane e dRSTAnta peza kare| Asale tArA hala eka jhagar3ATe jAti|
mAraiYAma-putra to zudhu ekajana vAndAha yAra prati Ami anugraha karechilAma Ara vAnI isarAIlera janya Ami tAke karechilAma (AmAra kudarAtera vizeSa eka) namunA|
Ami icche karale tomAdera madhya hate pherezatA paYadA karate pAri yArA para para uttarAdhikArI have|
‘IsA (’ra duniYAte punarAYa Agamana) kviYAmatera ekaTi nizcita nidarzana| ataeva tomarA kviYAmate sandeha poSaNa karo nA Ara AmAra anusaraNa kara, eTAi sarala saThika patha|
zaYatvAna tomAderake (sat pathe calate) kichutei yena vAdhAgrasta karate nA pAre, se tomAdera kholAkhuli duzamana|

‘IsA yakhana spaSTa nidarzana niYe esechila takhana se valechila- Ami tomAdera kAche hikamata niYe esechi Ara esechi katakagulo viSaYa spaSTa karAra janya yAte tomarA matabheda karacha| kAjei tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, Ara AmAra kathA mAnya kara|
AllAha tini to AmArao ravva Ara tomAderao ravva, kAjei tomarA tA~rai ‘ivAdAta kara, eTAi sarala saThika patha|
ataHpara tAdera vibhinna dala nijedera madhye matAnaikya karala| kAjei yAlimadera janya yantraNAdAYaka dinera ‘AyAvera durbhoga|
tArA ki tAdera upara kviYAmata akasmAt ese par3Ara apekSA karache yA tArA Terao pAve nA|
vandhurA sedina haYe yAve ekajana Arekajanera duzamana, tave muttAkIrA chAr3A|
(muttAkIderake valA have) he AmAra vAndAgaNa! Aja tomAdera kona bhaYa nei Ara tomarA duHkhitao have nA-
tomarA yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhe vizvAsa karechile evaM anugata chile|
sAnande jAnnAte praveza kara tomarA Ara tomAdera strIrA|
tAdera kAche cakrAkAre parivezana karA have svarNera thAlA o pAna pAtra| sekhAne tA-i Ache mana yA cAive, Ara cokha yAte tRpta have| tomarA tAte cirakAla thAkave|
ei hala jAnnAta tomAderake yAra uttarAdhikArI karA haYeche, kAraNa tomarA (sat) ‘AmAla karechile|
tomAdera janya sekhAne Ache pracura phala yAttheke tomarA khAve|
(Ara anyadike) aparAdhIrA jAhAnnAmera ‘AyAve cirakAla thAkave|
tAdera zAsti kamAno have nA, Ara tAte tArA hatAza haYe par3ave|
Ami tAdera upara yulama karini, varaM tArA nijerAi yAlima chila|
tArA cItkAra ka’re valave- he ‘mAleka (jAhAnnAmera dAr3oYAna)! tomAra pratipAlaka yena AmAdera daphAraphA ka’re dena| se jaoYAva dive- ‘tomarA (e avasthAtei par3e) thAkave’|
Ami to tomAdera kAche satya niYe giYechilAma, kintu tomAdera adhikAMzai chile satyake apachandakArI|
tArA ki (nijedera madhye salA-parAmarza kare kona) cUr3Anta siddhAnta niYeche? cUr3Anta siddhAnta to Amii niYe thAki (yAvatIYa vyApAre AllAha yA cAna tAi zeSe ghaTe)|
tArA ki mane kare ye, Ami tAdera gopana kathA, gopana parAmarza zuni nA? nizcaYai zuni, Ara AmAra pherezatArAha tAdera kAche theke likhe neYa|
vala- daYAmaYera kona santAna thAkale Amii tAra sarvaprathama ‘ivAdAtakArI hatAma|
tArA yA (tA~ra prati) Aropa kare tA hate AkAza o pRthivIra pratipAlaka ‘Arazera pAlanakartA mahAna, pavitra|
kAjei tAderake vAka-caturatA o krIr3A-kautuka karate dAo se dinera sAkSAt paryanta ye dinera o‘YAdA tAderake deYA haYeche|
AkAzamanDale tinii ilAha, yamIne tinii ilAha, tini mahAvijJa, sarvajJa|

ati mahAna o pavitra tini, AkAza, pRthivI o e du’Yera mAjhe yA Ache tAra ekacchatra kartRtva yA~ra hAte, kviYAmatera jJAna tA~ra kAchei Ache (ye tA kakhana ghaTave), Ara tomAderake tA~ra kAchei phire yete have|
AllAhara parivarte yAderake tArA DAke tArA supArizera adhikArI naYa, tave ye jJAnera bhittite satyera sAkSya deYa se chAr3A|
tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa kara- tAderake ke sRSTi kareche, tAhale tArA avazya avazyai valave, AllAha| ata:para tArA kothAYa phire yAcche?
rasUlera e uktira zapathaH ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! e jAtira lokerA ImAna Anave nA|’
kAjei tumi tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nAo Ara vala- (tomAdera prati) sAlAma| zIghrai tArA jAnate pArave (tAdera AcaraNera pariNati kI)|
hA-mIma|
suspaSTa kitAvera kasama!
Ami eke avatIrNa karechi eka varakatamaYa rAte, (kenanA) Ami (mAnuSake) satarkakArI|
e rAte pratiTi prajJApUrNa viSaYa sthira karA haYa
AmAra Adezakrame, Amii preraNakArI,
tomAra pratipAlakera anugraha svarUpa tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
AkAza o pRthivI evaM e du’Yera mAjhe yA kichu Ache sava kichura yini pratipAlaka, (tA~ra maryAdA ye kata mahAna e kathA upalavdhi kare nAo) yadi tomarA satyikArai vizvAsI haYe thAka|
tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, tinii jIvita karena o mRtyu ghaTAna| tinii tomAdera pratipAlaka evaM tomAdera pUrvavartI tomAdera pitRpuruSaderao pratipAlaka|
kintu tArA saMzaYera mAjhe khelAYa matta|
ataeva tumi apekSA kara se dinera yedina AkAza dho~YAYa Acchanna have yA suspaSTa (bhAve dekhA yAve)|
(yA) mAnuSake Dheke neve, tA have bhaYAvaha zAsti|
(takhana tArA Araya karave)- he AmAdera pAlanakartA! AmAdera theke zAsti sariYe dina, AmarA ImAna AnalAma|
tArA kIbhAve upadeza grahaNa karave? tAdera kAche to eseche suspaSTa varNanAkArI eka rasUla|
ekhana tArA tAra theke mukha phiriYe nicche Ara tArA valache (se hala eka) pAgala- yAke zikhiYe deYA haYeche|
Ami kichukAlera janya ‘AyAva sariYe neva, takhana tomarA Age yA karachile tAi AvAra karave|
yedina Ami tomAderake bhISaNabhAve pAkar3Ao karava, sedina Ami Avazyai pratizodha neva|
tAdera pUrve Ami pherAuna jAtike parIkSA karechilAma| tAdera kAche esechila eka sammAnita rasUla|
se valechila- AllAhara vAndAderake AmAra kAche arpaNa kara| Ami tomAdera janya prerita vizvasta rasUla|
Ara AllAhara viruddhe auddhatya dekhAio nA, Ami tomAdera kAche (AmAra rasUla haoYAra) suspaSTa pramANa peza karachi|
Ami AmAra o tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa AzraYa grahaNa karachi yAte tomarA AmAke pAtharera AghAte hatyA nA kara|
tomarA yadi AmAra prati vizvAsa nA Ano, kamapakSe AmAra kAcha theke dUre thAka|
(kintu tArA chila AkramaNamukhI) takhana se tAra pAlanakartAra nikaTa du‘A karala- erA aparAdhI jAti|
(takhana Ami valalAma) tumi AmAra vAndAhaderake niYe rAtera velAYa vera haYe par3a, tomAdera pichu dhAoYA karA have|

(mUsA vAnI isarAIlake niYe samudra pAra haYe giYe samudrake AvAra pravahamAna karAra janya svIYa lAThi nikSepa karale AllAha valalena) samudrake sthira thAkate dAo, tArA (arthAt pherAunI dala) emana eka vAhinI yArA nimajjita have|
tArA cher3e giYechila kata udyAna Ara jharNA,
zasya kSeta, Ara abhijAta sthAna,
Ara vilAsa sAmagrI- yA niYe tArA Ananda karata|
emanaTAi haYechila, ataHpara Ami anya jAtira lokaderake se savera uttarAdhikArI kare diYechilAma|
AsamAna Ara yamIna tAdera janya kA~deni, Ara tAderake ekaTu avasarao deYA haYani|
Ami vAnI isarAIlake rakSA karechilAma apamAnajanaka zAsti hate
pherAunera| se chila sImAlaGghanakArIdera zIrSe|
Ami jene vujhei vizvajagatera upara tAderake (arthAt vAnI isarAIlake) veche niYechilAma|
evaM tAderake Ami emana nidarzanAvalI diYechilAma yAte suspaSTa parIkSA nihita chila|
ei kAphirarA vale,
AmAdera prathama mRtyura para Ara kichu nAi Ara AmarA punarutthita hava nA|
(mRtyura para mAnuSake punarutthita karA have- tomAdera e kathAYa) tomarA yadi satya hao, tAhale AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake hAjira kara|
erAi zreSTha, nA tuvvA sampradAYa Ara tAdera Age yArA chila tArA? Amito oderake dhvaMsa kare diYechi| tArA chila aparAdhI|
Ami AkAza, yamIna Ara edera mAjhe yA Ache se sava khela-tAmAzAra phale sRSTi karini|
Ami odu’Tike satyikAra uddezye sRSTi karechi| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai (tA) jAne nA|
phaYasAlAra dinaTi tAdera savArai nirdhArita samaYa |
yedina vandhu vandhura kona upakAre Asave nA, Ara tAderake sAhAyyao karA have nA|
tave AllAha yAra prati rahamata karavena tAra kathA AlAdA| tini mahAparAkrAnta, var3ai daYAlu|
nizcaYai yAkkuma gAcha (have)
pApIra khAdya
galita tAmAra mata peTe phuTate thAkave|
phuTanta pAnira mata,
(valA have) oke dhara, Ara oke Tene niYe yAo jAhAnnAmera Agunera mAjhakhAne|
ataHpara tAra mAthAra upara phuTanta pAni Dhele ‘AyAva dAo|
(valA have) grahaNa kara svAda-tumi to chile kSamatAzAlI, sammAnI|
e hala tAi yAte tomarA sandeha karate|
nizcaYai muttAkIrA thAkave nirApada sthAne,
vAgAna Ara jharaNAra mAjhe
tArA paridhAna karave pAtalA o puru rezamI kApar3a, Ara vasave mukhomukhI haYe|
e rakamai have, Ara tAdera viYe diYe deva DAgara DAgara sundara ujjvala cokhaoYAlA kumArIdera (huradera) sAthe|
sekhAne tArA pUrNa zAnti o nirApattAra sAthe nAnAna phalamUla Anate valave|
sekhAne tArA mRtyu AsvAdana karave nA (sei) prathama mRtyura para, Ara tini tAderake Agunera zAsti theke rakSA karavena
tomAra pratipAlakera anugraha svarUpa, eTAi hala mahA sAphalya|
Ami tomAra bhASAYa kuraAnake sahaja kare diYechi yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
kAjei tumi apekSA kara (tAdera pariNati dekhAra janya) tArAo apekSA karache (tomAdera pariNati dekhAra janya)|
hA-mIma|
e kitAva avatIrNa haYeche mahA parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa AllAhara nikaTa hate|
AkAze evaM yamIne mu’minadera (zikSAra) janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|
tomAdera sRSTite, Ara prANIkula char3iYe deYAra mAjhe nidarzana Ache nizcita vizvAsIdera janya|
rAta o dinera Avartane, Ara AllAha AkAza theke ye vRSTi varSaNa karena tA diYe yamInake tAra mRtyura para AvAra jIvita karena Ara vAYura parivartane jJAnI sampradAYera janya nidarzana raYeche|
egulo hala AllAhara AYAta yA satyatA sahakAre tomAra kAche tilAoYAta karA hacche| kAjei tArA AllAha evaM tA~ra AYAtera (upara vizvAsa nA karale era) para Ara kon kathAYa vizvAsa karave?
dhvaMsa pratyeka mithyAvAdI pApAcArIra janya
ye AllAhara AYAta zone yA tAra sAmane pATha karA haYa, ataHpara ahamikAra sAthe (kuphurIra upara) thAke yena se tA zoneini; kAjei tAke bhaYAvaha zAstira saMvAda dAo|
AmAra AYAtagulora kona kathA yakhana se avagata haYa takhana tAke ThATTA vidrUpera viSaYa vAniYe neYa, tAdera janya Ache apamAnajanaka zAsti|

tAdera Ar3Ale Ache jAhAnnAma, tAdera kRtakarma tAdera kona kAje Asave nA| Ara AllAhara parivarte tArA yeguloke abhibhAvaka hiseve grahaNa kareche seguloo (kAje Asave) nA| tAdera janya Ache mahA zAsti|
e (kuraAna) saThika pathera dizArI| yArA tAdera pAlanakartAra nidarzanaguloke pratyAkhyAna kare, tAdera janya Ache kaThora yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

AllAha- yini samudrake tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena yAte tA~ra hukume tomAdera nauyAnasamUha tAte calAcala karate pAre, Ara yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha tAlAza kara evaM tomarA (tA~ra) zokara AdAYa kara|
Ara tini tomAdera kalyANe niYojita rekhechena yA Ache AkAze Ara yA Ache yamIne segulora sava kichuke| ete cintAzIla mAnuSadera janya avazyai aneka nidarzana Ache|

mu’minaderake vala ai lokaderake kSamA karate yArA AllAhara ‘AyAvera dina AsAra vyApAre kona AzaMkAvodha kare nA| kenanA AllAhai (bhAla vA manda) pratyeka sampradAYake tAdera kRtakarma anusAre pratiphala divena|
ye loka bhAla kAja karave, se tAra nijera kalyANei tA karave Ara ye manda kAja karave tAra kuphala se-i bhoga karave| ataHpara tomAderake tomAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa phiriYe neYA have|
Ami vAnI isarAIlake kitAva, rAjatva o nuvuoYAta diYechilAma Ara tAderake diYechilAma uttama riyaka, Ara tAderake vizvavAsIra upara zreSThatva diYechilAma|

Ara dvInera vyApAre tAderake diYechilAma suspaSTa nidarzana| kintu tAdera kAche (satya mithyA samparkita nirbhula) jJAna AsAra parao zudhu nijedera madhye vAr3AvAr3ira kAraNe tArA matabheda karechila| tArA ye viSaYe matabheda karata, tomAra pratipAlaka kiYAmAtera dina se viSaYe tAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare devena|

ataHpara (he navI sA.!) Ami tomAke dvInera (saThika) pathera upara pratiSThita karechi, kAjei tumi tArai anusaraNa kara, Ara yArA (dvInera vidhi-vidhAna) jAnenA tAdera kheYAlakhuzira anusaraNa karo nA|
AllAha hate tArA tomAra konai upakAra karate pArave nA| yAlimarA eke aparera vandhu, Ara AllAha muttAkIdera vandhu|
e (kuraAna) mAnuSera janya jJAnera Alo, Ara nizcita vizvAsIdera janya pathera dizArI evaM rahamata svarUpa|

yArA anyAYa kAja kare tArA ki e kathA bheve niYeche ye, Ami tAderake Ara ImAna grahaNakArI satkarmazIladerake samAna gaNya karava yAra phale tAdera ubhaYa dalera jIvana o mRtyu samAna haYe yAve? katai nA manda tAdera phaYasAlA!
AllAha AkAza o yamIna sRSTi karechena eka satyikAra lakSye yAte pratyeka vyaktike tAra kRtakarma anuyAYI pratiphala deYA yete pAre, Ara tAdera prati kona yulama karA have nA|

tumi ki lakSya karecha tAra prati ye tAra kheYAla-khuzike ilAha vAniYe niYeche? AllAha jene zunei tAke pathabhraSTa karechena Ara tAra kAne o dile mohara mere diYechena Ara tAra cokhera upara Tene diYechena pardA| ataHpara AllAhara para Ara ke (Ache ye) tAke saThika patha dekhAve? eraparao ki tomarA zikSAgrahaNa karave nA?

tArA vale- jIvana valate to zudhu AmAdera e duniYArai jIvana, AmarA mari Ara ve~ce thAki (ekhAnei)| kAlera pravAha chAr3A anya kichui AmAderake dhvaMsa kare nA| Asale e vyApAre tAdera kona jJAnai nei| tArA zudhu dhAraNA kare|

tAdera sAmane yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAtagulo pATha karA haYa, takhana tAdera kAche e kathA valA chAr3A Ara kona yukti thAke nA ye, tomarA yadi satyavAdIi haYe thAka, tAhale AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake hAjira kara|
vala- AllAhai tomAderake jIvana dAna karena ataHpara tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAna| ataHpara tini tomAderake kviYAmatera dina ekatrita karavena yAte kona sandeha nei| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa tA jAne nA|
AkAza o yamInera rAjatva AllAharai, ye dina kviYAmata saMghaTita have, sedina mithyAra anusArIrA dhvaMsa haYe yAve|
Ara pratyeka sampradAYake dekhave natajAnu haYe Ache| pratyeka sampradAYake tAra ‘AmAlanAmAra pAne AhavAna karA have| (Ara valA have) tomarA yA karate Aja tAra pratiphala deYA have|
AmAra e kitAva tomAdera vyApAre satya kathAi valave, tomarA yA karate Ami tAi-i likhe rAkhatAma|
yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkarma kare tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake tA~ra rahamAtera madhye dAkhila karavena| oTAi suspaSTa sAphalya|
Ara yArA kupharI karechila tAderake valA have- AmAra AYAtagulo ki tomAdera kAche pATha karA haYani? takhana tomarA ahaGkAra karechile Ara tomarA chile eka aparAdhI jAti|

yakhana valA haYa- AllAhara pratizruti satya Ara kviYAmatera Agamane konai sandeha nei, takhana tomarA valate- ‘AmarA jAni nA kviYAmata kI? AmarA mane kari tA zudhu dhAraNA mAtra, Ara (tAte) AmarA nizcita vizvAsI nai’|
tArA ye sava manda kAja karata segulo tAdera kAche prakAza haYe par3ave Ara tArA yA niYe ThATTA vidrUpa karata tA tAderake ghire phelave|
Ara valA have- ‘Aja Ami tomAderake bhule yAva yemana kare tomarA e dinera sAkSAtke bhule giYechile| tomAdera vAsasthAna have jAhAnnAma Ara tomAdera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|

eTA ejanya ye, tomarA AllAhara AYAtaguloke ThATTA vidrUpera viSaYa vAniYe niYechile, Ara duniYAra jIvana tomAderake dho~kAYa phele rekhechila| kAjei Aja tAderake jAhAnnAma theke vera karA have nA Ara tAovAha karAra suyoga deYA have nA|
ataeva prazaMsA AllAharai janya yini AsamAnera pratipAlanakArI, yamInera pratipAlanakArI, vizvajagatera pratipAlanakArI |
AkAza o yamIne tA~rai zreSThatva o prAdhAnya, Ara tini mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
hA-mIma|
kitAva avatIrNa haYeche mahA parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa AllAhara nikaTa hate|
Ami AkAza, yamIna o e du’Yera mAjhe yA Ache tA prakRta uddezye ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYera janya sRSTi karechi| kintu kAphiragaNa, ye viSaYe tAderake satarka karA haYa tAttheke mukha phiriYe neYa|

vala- tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAka, tAdera viSaYe cintA kare dekhecha ki? dekhAo AmAke tArA yamIne kI sRSTi kareche athavA AkAzamanDale tAdera kona aMzIdAritva Ache ki? era Agera kona kitAva athavA paramparAgata kona jJAna AmAra kAche upasthita kara yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|
tAra ceYe adhika gumarAha ke, ye AllAhara parivarte emana kichuke DAke yA kviYAmata paryanta tAke sAr3A deve nA, Ara tAdera DAkADAki samparkeo tArA (ekadama) vekhavara?
kviYAmatera dina mAnuSake yakhana ekatrita karA have, takhana aigulo (arthAt upAsyarA) have mAnuSera zatru Ara mAnuSa ye tAdera ‘ivAdAta karechila tA tArA asvIkAra karave|
tAdera kAche yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAta AvRtti karA haYa Ara satya yakhana tAdera kAche upasthita haYa, takhana kAphirarA vale- eTAto prakAzya yAdu|

tArA ki valate cAYa ye, rasUla nijei tA racanA kareche? vala, tA yadi Ami racanA kare thAki tAhale tomarA AllAhara zAsti hate AmAke kichutei vA~cAte pArave nA| AllAha bhAla karei jAnena ye viSaYe tomarA matta Acha| AmAra Ara tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve tinii yatheSTa, Ara tini var3ai kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

vala, Ami rasUladera madhye natuna nai, Ara Ami eo jAni nA ye, AmAra saGge kI vyavahAra karA have Ara tomAdera saGgeivA kemana (vyavahAra karA have), Ami kevala tAi mene cali yA AmAra prati oYAhI karA haYa| Ami to spaSTa satarkakArI mAtra|

vala- tomarA ki bheve dekhecha yadi e (kuraAna) AllAhara pakSa theke ese thAke Ara tA tomarA pratyAkhyAna kara athaca e dharanera kAlAma samparke vAnI isarAIlera ekajana [‘AvadullAha vina sAlAma (rAyi.)] sAkSyao diYeche| se ImAna Anala Ara tomarA ahaGkAra karale? AllAha yAlima lokaderake saThika patha dekhAna nA|

kAphirarA mu’minadera samparke vale, tA (arthAt kuraAna) yadi bhAla hata tAhale tArA AmAderake pechane phele oTAra dike egiYe yete pArata nA (AmarAi kuraAnake Age grahaNa kare nitAma) Ara yehetu tArA era dvArA (arthAt kAphirarA e kuraAna dvArA) saThika patha pAYani, se kAraNe tArA avazyai valave- eTA eka purano mithye|

athaca itopUrve mUsAra kitAva esechila pathapradarzaka o rahamata svarUpa| Ara (ekhana avatIrNa) e kitAva tAra samarthaka, AravI bhASAYa, yAlimaderake satarka karAra janya Ara satkarmazIladerake susaMvAda deYAra janya|
yArA vale, ‘AmAdera pratipAlaka AllAha’, ataHpara (tAdera kathAra upara) sudRr3ha thAke, tAhale tAdera kona bhaYa nei, Ara tArA duHkhita have nA|
tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI, tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave, tArA ye kAja karata tAra puraskAra svarUpa|

Ami mAnuSake nirdeza diYechi tAra pitAmAtAra prati sadaYa AcaraNera| tAra mA tAke vahana kareche kaSTera sAthe, Ara tAke prasava kareche kaSTera sAthe| tAke garbhe dhAraNa o dudhapAna chAr3AnoYa samaYa lAge triza mAsa| avazeSe se yakhana pUrNa zakti lAbha kare evaM calliza vachare pau~che yAYa, takhana se vale, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke Ara AmAra pitA-mAtAke ye ni‘mAta dAna karecha tajjanya kRtajJatA prakAza karAra zakti AmAke dAna kara, Ara AmAke emana satkarma karAra sAmartha dAo yAte tumi santuSTa hao, AmAra santAnaderake satkarmaparAYaNa ka’re AmAra prati anugraha kara, Ami anuzocanAbhare tomAra dike phire Asachi, Ara Ami anugata vAndAhadera antarbhukta|
ei lokadera hate Ami tAdera sarvottama ‘AmAlagulo grahaNa kari Ara tAdera manda kAjagulo kSamA kare dei, tArA jAnnAtavAsIdera antarbhukta| tAderake ye o‘YAdA deYA haYeche tA satya o‘YAdA|

Ara ye nija pitAmAtAke vale, ‘tomAdera janya Aphasosa! tomarA ki AmAke bhaYa dekhAo ye, (mRtura para) AmAke uThAno have athaca AmAra pUrve vahu mAnava goSThI atIta haYe geche (kai, keu to uThe Asala nA)| vApa-mA AllAhara kAche prArthanA jAniYe (santAnake tiraskAra kare) vale- durbhoga tomAra janya, tumi ImAna Ana, AllAhara o‘YAdA satya|’ takhana se vale- ‘e sava purAna kAlera kAhinI chAr3A Ara kichui nA|’
erA hala tArAi yAdera prati AllAhara ‘AyAvera siddhAnta haYe geche, tAdera mata jvina o mAnuSera madhye hate yArA tAdera pUrve gata haYe geche| erA caramabhAve kSatigrasta|
pratyekera janya maryAdA Ache tAra kRtakarma anusAre, yena AllAha tAdera karmera puropuri pratiphala dena| tAdera upara kakSano yulama karA have nA|

yedina kAphiraderake jAhAnnAmera sAmane hAjira karA have, (tAderake valA have)- ‘tomarA tomAdera pArthiva jIvanei tomAdera aMzera ni‘mAtagulo niHzeSa karecha Ara tA bhoga karecha| kAjei Aja tomAderake apamAnajanaka zAsti dvArA pratiphala deYA have, kenanA tomarA duniYAte anyAYabhAve ahaGkAra karechile Ara nA-pharamAnI karechile|

smaraNa kara ‘Ada jAtira bhrAtAra (hUda) kathA| se tAra AhakAphavAsI sampradAYake satarka karechila| (e dharanera) satarkakArIrA tAra pUrveo esechila Ara tAra pareo esechila (yArA valechila) ye, ‘tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro ‘ivAdAta karo nA| Ami tomAdera upara eka bhaYAvaha dinera ‘AyAvera AzaGkA karachi|’

lokerA valechila- ‘tumi ki AmAderake AmAdera upAsyagulo hate sariYe neYAra janya AmAdera kAche esecha| kAjei tumi AmAderake ye zAstira bhaYa dekhAccha tA niYe eso AmAdera kAche yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|’

se valala (‘AyAva kakhana Asave nA Asave) ‘se viSaYera jJAna to AllAhara nikaTa Ache| Ami yA niYe prerita haYechi tAi zudhu tomAdera kAche pau~che dicchi| kintu Ami dekhachi tomarA emana eka jAti yArA mUrkhera AcaraNa karache|

ataHpara tArA yakhana tAdera upatyakAra dike megha Asate dekhala takhana tArA valala- ‘e to megha, AmAderake vRSTi dive|’ nA, tA hala sei jinisa tomarA yA tAr3AtAr3i niYe Asate ceYechile| e hala jhar3a, yAte Ache bhaYAvaha ‘AyAva|

oTA tAra pratipAlakera nirdeze savakichu dhvaMsa kare deve| avasthA ei dA~r3Ala ye, tAdera (dhvaMsaprApta) vasatigulo chAr3A Ara kichu dekhA yAcchila nA| aparAdhI jAtike Ami ebhAvei pratiphala diYe thAki|

tAderake Ami yataTA sudRr3habhAve pratiSThita karechilAma, tomAderake (he kurAYaza!) temana sudRr3habhAve pratiSThita karini Ara tAderake diYechilAma kAna, cokha o hRdaYa| kintu tAdera kAna, tAdera cokha Ara tAdera hRdaYa tAdera kona upakAre Aseni yehetu tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karata| tArA yA niYe ThATTA vidrUpa karata tA-i tAderake ghire phelala|
Ami dhvaMsa karechilAma tomAdera cArapAzera janapada| Ami nAnAbhAve nidarzana dekhiYechilAma yAte tArA (saThika pathe) phire Ase|

AllAhara naikaTya lAbhera uddezye AllAha vyatireke yAderake tArA ilAharUpe grahaNa kareche tArA tAderake sAhAyya karala nA kena? varaM tArA (arthAt kalpita ilAha) tAdera theke hAriYe gela| Asale tA chila tAdera mithyAcAra Ara managar3A udbhAvana|

smaraNa kara, yakhana jvinadera ekaTi dalake tomAra prati phiriYe diYechilAma yArA kuraAna zunachila| tArA yakhana se sthAne upasthita hala, takhana tArA paraspare valala- cupa kare zuna| par3A yakhana zeSa hala takhana tArA tAdera sampradAYera kAche phire gela satarkakArIrUpe|

(phire giYe) tArA valala- he AmAdera sampradAYa! AmarA ekaTi kitAva (era pATha) zunechi yA mUsAra pare avatIrNa haYeche, tA pUrvekAra kitAvagulora satyatA pratipanna kare, satyera dike Ara saThika pathera dike paricAlita kare|
he AmAdera sampradAYa! AllAhara dike AhavAnakArIra prati sAr3A dAo evaM tAra prati ImAna Ana, AllAha tomAdera gunAha mApha kare devena Ara tomAderake yantraNAdAYaka ‘AyAva theke rakSA karavena|
Ara ye AllAhara dike AhavAnakArIra prati sAr3A dive nA, duniYAte se AllAhake vyartha karate pArave nA, Ara AllAhake vAda diYe nei tAra kona sAhAyyakArI, pRSThapoSaka| tArA Ache suspaSTa gumarAhIte|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, AllAha, yini AkAza o yamIna sRSTi karechena Ara ogulora sRSTite tini klAnta hanani, tini mRtaderake jIvana dite sakSama? niHsandehe tini sakala viSaYera upara kSamatAvAna|

kAphiraderake yedina jAhAnnAmera sAmane hAjira karA have (takhana tAderake valA have) eTA ki satya naYa? tArA valave, ‘kasama AmAdera pratipAlakera! eTA satya|’ tAderake valA have, ‘tAhale ‘AyAva AsvAdana kara, yehetu tomarA satyake amAnya karechile|

kAjei tumi dhairya dhara yemanabhAve dhairya dhAraNa karechila dRr3ha saMkalpera adhikArI rasUlagaNa| Ara ei lokedera vyApAre tAr3Ahur3A karo nA| kAraNa ye viSaYe tAderake sAvadhAna karA haYeche yedina tArA tA dekhave, sedina tArA mane karave ye, ekadinera kichu aMzera adhika tArA duniYAte avasthAna kareni| (tomAra dAYitva) pau~chAno, ataHpara pApAcArI sampradAYa chAr3A Ara ke dhvaMsa have?
yArA kuphurI kare evaM AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare, AllAha tAdera sakala karma vyartha kare dena|

Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare Ara muhAmmAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tAte vizvAsa sthApana kare- kAraNa tA tAdera pratipAlakera prerita satya- tini tAdera manda kAjagulo muche devena, Ara tAdera avasthAra unnati ghaTAvena|

era kAraNa ei ye, yArA kuphurI kare tArA mithyAra anusaraNa kare, Ara yArA ImAna Ane tArA tAdera pratipAlakera prerita satyera anusaraNa kare| emanibhAve AllAha mAnuSera janya tAdera (madhyekAra pApI evaM puNyavAnera) dRSTAnta varNanA karena|

ataHpara yakhana tomarA kAphiradera saGge yuddhe avatIrNa hao, takhana tAdera ghAr3e AghAta hAno, avazeSe yakhana tAderake pUrNarUpe parAsta kara, takhana tAderake zaktabhAve ve~dhe phela| ataHpara haYa tAdera prati anugraha kara, nA haYa tAdera theke muktipaNa grahaNa kara| tomarA yuddha cAliYe yAve, ye paryanta nA zatrupakSa astra samarpaNa kare| e nirdezai tomAderake deYA hala| AllAha icche karale (nijei) tAdera theke pratizodha nite pAratena| kintu tini tomAdera ekajanake anyera dvArA parIkSA karate cAna (ejanya tomAderake yuddha karAra suyoga dena)| yArA AllAhara pathe zahIda haYa tini tAdera karmaphala kakSano vinaSTa karavena nA|
tini tAderake saThika pathe paricAlita karena Ara tAdera avasthA bhAla kare dena|
ataHpara tini tAderake jAnnAte praviSTa karavena yA tAderake tini jAniYe diYechena|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yadi AllAhake sAhAyya kara, tini tomAderake sAhAyya karavena Ara tomAdera pAguloke dRr3hapratiSTha karavena|
yArA kupharI kare tAdera janya durbhoga Ara tini tAdera karmake vinaSTa kare devena|
tA ejanya ye, AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tArA tA apachanda kare, kAjei AllAha tAdera karma vyartha karena|
tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni ataHpara dekheni tAdera Age yArA chila tAdera pariNAma kI haYeche? AllAha tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechena, kAphiradera janya Ache anurUpa zAsti|
era kAraNa ei ye, yArA ImAna Ane AllAha tAdera abhibhAvaka Ara kAphiradera kona abhibhAvaka nei|

yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkAja kare AllAha tAderake praviSTa karavena jAnnAte yAra taladeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita| Ara yArA kuphurI kare tArA bhoga vilAse matta thAke Ara AhAra kare yebhAve AhAra kare jantu jAnoYArarA| jAhAnnAmai tAdera vAsasthAna|
tomAra ye janapada theke tArA tomAke vera kare diYeche tAra apekSA zaktizAlI kata janapadake Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi, ataHpara keu chila nA tAdera sAhAyyakArI|
ye vyakti tAra pratipAlaka theke Agata suspaSTa pramANera upara pratiSThita se ki tAra mata yAra kAche tAra manda karma suzobhita karA haYeche Ara tArA nijedera kheYAlakhuzira anusaraNa kare|

muttAkvIderake ye jAnnAtera o‘YAdA deYA haYeche tAra upamA halaH tAte Ache nirmala pAnira jharNA, Ara Ache dudhera nadI yAra svAda aparivartanIYa, Ache pAnakArIdera janya susvAdu madera nadI Ara parizodhita madhura nadI| tAdera janya sekhAne Ache sava rakama phalamUla Ara tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa hate kSamA| (erA ki) tAdera mata yArA cirakAla thAkave jAhAnnAme yAderake pAna karate deYA have garama pAnIYa yA tAdera nAr3ibhu~r3i chinna bhinna kare phelave?

tAdera madhye kataka loka tomAra kathA zune, ataHpara yakhana tArA tomAra kAcha theke veriYe yAYa, takhana yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche tAderake vale- ei mAtra se kI valala? edera antare AllAha mohara mere diYechena Ara tArA nijedera kheYAlakhuzira anusaraNa kare|
yArA saThika pathe cale AllAha tAdera satpatha prApti vRddhi kare dena Ara tAderake tAkvaoYA dAna karena|
tArA ki zudhu e apekSAYa Ache ye, kviYAmata tAdera kAche akasmAt ese par3uka? kviYAmatera lakSaNagulo to esei geche| kAjei tA ese par3ale tArA upadeza grahaNa karave kemana kare?
kAjei jene rekha, AllAha chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, kSamA prArthanA kara tomAra bhulatruTira janya Ara mu’mina o mu’minAdera janya, AllAha tomAdera gatividhi o avasthAna samparke avagata|

mu’minarA vale- ekaTi sUrAha nAyila haYa nA kena? ataHpara yakhana kona suspaSTa arthavodhaka sUrAha avatIrNa haYa Ara tAte yuddhera kathA ullekha thAke, takhana yAdera antare roga Ache tumi tAderake dekhave mRtyura bhaYe jJAnahArA lokera mata tomAra dike tAkAcche| kAjei dhvaMsa tAdera janya|
(AllAhara) Anugatya karA o nyAYasaGgata kathA valA| ataHpara yuddhera siddhAnta hale tArA yadi AllAhara nikaTa deYA aGgIkAra pUrNa karata, tave tA tAdera janya kalyANakara hata|
kSamatA pele sambhavataH tomarA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karave Ara AtmIYatAra vandhana chinna karave|
edera pratii AllAha abhisampAta karena, ataHpara tAderake vadhira karena Ara tAdera dRSTizaktike karena andha|
tArA ki kuraAna samvandhe gabhIrabhAve cintA kare nA, nA tAdera antare tAlA deYA Ache?
yAdera kAche saThika patha suspaSTa haoYAra para tArA pichane phire yAYa, zaYatvAna tAdera janya tAdera kAjake sundara kare dekhAYa, Ara tAderake deYa mithyA AzA|
e kAraNei AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tAke yArA apachanda kare tAderake tArA vale diYeche ye, kona kona vyApAre AmarA tomAderake mAnavo| AllAha tAdera gopana kathAvArtAke khuva bhAla karei jAnena|
takhana kemana dazA have yakhana pherezatArA tAdera mukhe Ara piThe mArate mArate tAdera jAna vera karave|
era kAraNa ei ye, tArA tArai anusaraNa kare yA AllAhake asantuSTa kare, Ara tArA tA~ra santoSake apachanda kare, phale tini tAdera samasta ‘AmAla naSTa kare diYechena|
yAdera antare roga Ache tArA ki mane kare ye, AllAha kakSano tAdera lukAno vidveSabhAva prakAza kare divena nA?

Ami yadi icche karatAma tAhale Ami tomAYa oderake dekhiYe ditAma| tumi tAdera mukha dekhe avazyai cinate pArave Ara tAdera kathAvArtAra dharana dekhe tumi tAderake avazyai avazyai cinate pArave| AllAha tomAdera ‘AmAla samparke bhAlabhAvei jAnena|
Ami tomAderake avazya avazyai parIkSA karava yatakSaNa nA Ami jene nite pAri tomAdera madhye mujAhida Ara dhairyazIladerake, Ara tomAdera avasthA yAcAi karate pAri|

yArA kuphurI kare Ara AllAhara pathe calate vAdhA sRSTi kare, Ara tAdera nikaTa satya patha spaSTa haYe yAoYAra parao rasUlera virodhitA kare, tArA AllAhara konai kSati karate pArave nA| AllAha tAdera yAvatIYa ‘AmAla naSTa kare divena|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhara Anugatya kara Ara rasUlera Anugatya kara Ara tomAdera ‘AmAlaguloke naSTa kare dio nA|
yArA kupharI kare Ara (mAnuSake) AllAhara pathe calate vAdhA deYa Ara ebhAve kAphira avasthAtei mRtyuvaraNa kare, AllAha tAderake kakSano kSamA karavena nA|
kAjei tomarA sAhasa-hArA haYe yeo nA Ara sandhira Avedana kare vaso nA, pravala to tomarAi| AllAha tomAdera saGge Achena, tini tomAdera ‘AmAla kakSano vinaSTa karavena nA|

duniYAra e jIvana to khelA Ara tAmAzA mAtra| tomarA yadi ImAna Ana, Ara AllAhake bhaYa kare cala, tini tomAderake tomAdera pratiphala divena (Ara era viparIte) tini tomAdera kAche tomAdera mAla dhana cAivena nA|
tini yadi tomAdera kAche tA cAitena Ara sejanya cApa ditena tAhale tomarA kRpaNatA karate Ara tAte tini tomAdera vidveSabhAva prakAza kare ditena|

dekha, tomarA to tArAi, tomAderake AllAhara pathe vyaYa karAra janya DAka deYA hacche, takhana tomAdera kichu loka kRpaNatA karache| ye kRpaNatA kare, se kRpaNatA kare kevala nijera AtmAra sAthe| AllAha to abhAvahIna Ara tomarAi abhAvI| tomarA yadi mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale tini tomAdera parivarte anya jAtike niYe Asavena, takhana tArA tomAdera mata have nA|
Ami tomAke diYechi spaSTa vijaYa|
yAte AllAha tomAra Agera o pichera yAvatIYa bhulabhrAnti kSamA karena, tomAra upara tA~ra ni‘mAta pUrNa karena evaM tomAke sarala saThika pathe paricAlita karena|
Ara AllAha tomAke pravala parAkrAnta sAhAyya dAna karena|
tinii mu’minadera dile prazAnti nAyila karena yAte tArA tAdera ImAnera sAthe Aro ImAna vAr3iYe neYa| AsamAna o yamInera yAvatIYa vAhinI AllAhara kartRtvera adhIna| AllAha sarvajJa o prajJAmaYa|

(tini e kAja karena ejanya) yAte tini mu’mina puruSa o mu’minA nArIke jAnnAte praviSTa karena yAra taladeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita| tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave| tini tAdera pApa mocana kare divena| AllAhara dRSTite eTAi virATa sAphalya|

Ara tini munAphika puruSa o munAphikA nArI, muzarika puruSa o muzarikA nArIke zAsti divena yArA AllAha samparke khArApa dhAraNA poSaNa kare| tAdera janya Ache azubha cakra| AllAha tAdera upara rAgAnvita haYechena Ara tAderake lA‘nAta karechena| tAdera janya prastuta kare rekhechena jAhAnnAma| tA katai nA nikRSTa AvAsasthala!
AsamAna o yamInera yAvatIYa vAhinI AllAhara kartRtvera adhIna| AllAha mahA parAkramazAlI, mahA prajJAmaYa|
(he rAsUla) Ami tomAke (satyera) sAkSyadAtA. (vizvAsIdera janya) susaMvAdadAtA o (avizvAsIdera janya) satarkakArI hiseve pAThiYechi|
yena (ohe mAnuSerA) tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati ImAna Ana, rasUlake zakti yogAo Ara tAke sammAna kara, Ara sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAhara mahimA ghoSaNA kara|

yArA tomAra kAche vAi‘Ata (arthAt Anugatya karAra zapatha) kare Asale tArA AllAhara kAche vAi‘Ata kare| tAdera hAtera upara Ache AllAhara hAta| ekSaNe ye e o‘YAdA bhaGga kare, e o‘YAdA bhaGgera kuphala tAra nijerai upara par3ave| Ara ye o‘YAdA pUrNa karave- yA se AllAhara saGge kareche- tini acirei tAke mahA puraskAra dAna karavena|

(yuddha theke) picha-par3A veduInarA tomAke valave- AmAdera mAladhana Ara AmAdera parivAra-parijana AmAderake vyasta rekhechila, kAjei (he navI) Apani AmAdera janya kSamA prArthanA karuna| tArA mukhe emana kathA vale yA tAdera antare nei| (tAderake) vala, AllAha tomAdera kona kSati vA kona kalyANa karAra icche karale tA~ra vipakSe tomAdera janya kichu karAra kSamatA kAra Ache? (kAro kona okAlatira darakAra nei) varaM tomarA yA kara se viSaYe AllAhai khavara rAkhena|

varaM tomarA dhAraNA karechile ye, rasUla o mu’minagaNa kakSano tAdera parivAra parijanera kAche phire Asate pArave nA, Ara e kheYAlaTA tomAdera mane khuvai camatkAra ka’re deYA haYechila| tomarA dhAraNA karechile var3ai ku-dhAraNA, Asale tomarA hale dhvaMsera yogya ekaTA sampradAYa|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana kare nA, Ami (se sava) kAphiradera janya prastuta kare rekhechi jvalanta Aguna|
AsamAna yamInera rAjatva AllAhara; yAke cAna tini kSamA karena, yAke icche ‘AyAva dena| AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|

tomarA yakhana gAnImAtera mAla saMgraha karAra janya yete thAkave takhana pichane theke yAoYA lokagulo valave- ‘AmAderakeo tomAdera saGge yete dAo| tArA AllAhara pharamAnake vadale dite cAYa| vala ‘tomarA kichutei AmAdera saGge yete pArave nA, (khAivAra abhiyAne aMzagrahaNa evaM sekhAne pAoYA gAnImAta kevala tAdera janya yArA itopUrve hudAiviYAra saphara o vAi‘Ate riyoYAne aMza niYeche) emana kathA AllAha pUrvei vale diYechena| takhana tArA valave- ‘tomarA varaM AmAdera prati hiMsA poSaNa karacha|’ (eTA ye AllAhara hukuma tA tArA vujhache nA) varaM tArA khuva kamai vujhe|

veduInadera yArA pechane raYe giYechila tAderake vala- ‘tomAderake yuddha karate DAkA have khuvai zaktizAlI eka jAtira viruddhe, tomarA tAdera viruddhe yuddha karave athavA tArA AtmasamarpaNa karave| tomarA yadi takhana tA mAnya kara, AllAha tomAderake uttama puraskAra divena| Ara yadi piTha phiriYe nAo yemana tomarA Age piTha phiriYe niYechile, tAhale AllAha tomAderake kaSTadAYaka zAsti divena|

andhera upara kona doSa nei, kho~r3Ara upara kona doSa nei, rogIra upara kona doSa nei| Ara ye keui AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya karave, AllAha tAke jAnnAte praviSTa karavena, yAra nIca diYe jharNAdhArA pravAhita| Ara ye vyakti piTha phiriYe nive, tini tAke kaSTadAYaka zAsti divena|

mu’minadera prati AllAha santuSTa halena yakhana tArA (hudAiviYAYa) gAchera tale tomAra kAche vAYa‘Ata nila| AllAha jAnatena tAdera antare kI Ache, ejanya tini tAdera upara prazAnti avatIrNa karalena Ara puraskAra hiseve tAderake dilena nikaTa Asanna vijaYa|
Ara vipula parimANa gAnImAta yA tArA lAbha karave| AllAha mahA parAkrAnta prajJAmaYa|

AllAha tomAderake vipula parimANa gAnImAtera o‘YAdA diYechena yA tomarA lAbha karave| eTA tini tomAderake Agei dilena Ara mAnuSadera (arthAt mAkkAra kurAYazadera) hAtake tomAdera (upara patita haoYA) theke saMyata kare rAkhalena yAte tA mu’minadera janya ekaTA nidarzana haYa (ye prakRta mu’minaderake AllAha ati saMkaTamaYa muhUrteo rakSA karate pArena), Ara tini tomAderake sarala saThika pathe paricAlita karena|
evaM Aro anya (sAhAyya, sampada o vijaYa) yA ekhanao tomAdera adhikAre Aseni, AllAha tA svIYa AYatte rekhechena, AllAha sakala viSaYe kSamatAvAna|
kAphiragaNa yadi tomAdera sAthe yuddha vA~dhAta, tAhale tArA avazyai piTha phiriYe nita, se avasthAYa tArA kona pRSThapoSaka o sAhAyyakArI peta nA|
(eTAi) AllAhara vidhAna, atIteo tAi haYeche, tumi AllAhara vidhAne kakSano kona parivartana pAve nA|
makkA upatyakAYa tinii tAdera hAta tomAdera theke Ara tomAdera hAta tAdera theke virata rekhechilena tomAderake tAdera upara vijaYI karAra para| tomarA yA kichu kara AllAha tA dekhena|

kuphurI to tArAi karechila Ara tomAderake mAsajidula hArAma theke vAdhA diYechila| vAdhA diYechila kuravAnIra pazuguloke kuravAnIra sthAne pau~chate| mu’mina puruSa Ara mu’mina nArIrA yadi (mAkkAYa kAphiradera mAjhe) nA thAkata yAdera samparke tomarA jAna nA Ara ajJatAvazatai tomarA tAderake paryudasta kare dive yAra phale tomAdera upara kalaGka lepana have-emana sambhAvanA nA thAkata, tAhale tomAderake yuddhera Adeza deYA hata| yuddhera Adeza deYA haYani yAte AllAha yAke icche tA~ra rahamAtera madhye zAmila kare nite pArena| (mAkkAYa aneka mu’mina Ara kAphirarA ekatrita nA theke) yadi tArA pRthaka haYe thAkata, tAhale Ami tAdera madhye kAphiraderake bhaYAvaha zAsti ditAma|

kAphirarA yakhana tAdera antare jida o haThakAritA jAgiYe tulala- ajJatAra yugera jida o haThakAritA- takhana AllAha tA~ra rasUla o mu’minadera upara svIYa prazAnti avatIrNa karalena Ara tAdera janya tAkaoYA avalamvanera nirdeza-vANI aparihArya (rUpe pAlanIYa) ka’re dilena; Ara tArAi chila era savaceYe vezi hakadAra o yogya adhikArI| AllAha sakala viSaYe sarvAdhika jJAnera adhikArI|

AllAha tA~ra rasUlake prakRta satya svapnai dekhiYechilena| AllAhara icchAYa tomarA avazya avazyai mAsajide hArAme praveza karave nirApade, mastaka munDita avasthAYa o cula keTe, bhaYabhItihIna haYe| AllAha jAnena, yA tomarA jAna nA| (sei svapna to pUrNa havei) tadupari tini dilena (hudAiviYAra cukti sampAdanera mAdhyame) nikaTAsanna vijaYa|
tinii tA~ra rasUlake pAThiYechena hidAYAta o satya dvIna sahakAre sakala dvInera upara seTike vijaYI karAra janya| (e vyApAre) sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

muhAmmAda AllAhara rasula| Ara ye sava loka tA~ra saGge Ache tArA kAphiradera prati atyanta kaThora, nijedera parasparera prati daYAzIla| tAderake tumi dekhave rukU‘ o sAjadAYa avanata avasthAYa, tArA AllAhara anugraha o santuSTi anusandhAne niYojita| tAdera cihna hala, tAdera mukhamanDale sejadAra prabhAva parisphuTa haYe Ache| tAdera emana dRSTAntera kathA tAorAte Ache, tAdera dRSTAnta iJjileo Ache| (tArA) yena ekaTA cArAgAcha tAra kacipAtA vera kare, tArapara tA zakta haYa, ataHpara tA kAnDera upara majavuta haYe dA~r3iYe yAYa- yA cASIke Ananda deYa| (ebhAve AllAha mu’minaderake durvala avasthA theke dRr3ha bhittira upara dA~r3a ka’re dena) yAte kAphiradera antara gosvAYa jvale yAYa| tAdera madhya theke yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkarma kare, AllAha tAdera janya kSamA o mahA puraskArera pratizruti diYechena|
ohe mu’minagaNa! tomarA (kona viSaYei) AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Age ver3e yeYo nA, AllAhake bhaYa kara, AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA navIra AoYAjera upara tomAdera AoYAja ucca karo nA| tomarA nijerA paraspare yemana ucca AoYAje kathA vala, tA~ra saGge se rakama ucca AoYAje kathA valo nA| tA karale tomAdera (yAvatIYa) kAjakarma nisphala haYe yAve, Ara tomarA ekaTu Terao pAve nA|
yArA AllAhara rasUlera sAmane tAdera AoYAja nIcu kare, AllAha tAdera antaraguloke tAkaoYAra janya yAcAi-vAchAi kare niYechena| tAdera janya Ache kSamA Ara virATa puraskAra|
yArA tomAke hujarAra vAire theke (uccaHsvare) DAke, tAdera adhikAMzerai kona jJAna nei|
tArA yadi dhairya dharata ye paryanta nA tumi tAdera kAche veriYe Asa, seTAi tAdera janya uttama hata| AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|

he mu’minagaNa! kona pApAcArI yadi tomAdera kAche kona khavara niYe Ase, tAhale tAra satyatA yAcAi kare lao, tA nA hale tomarA ajJatAvazataH kona sampradAYera kSati kare vasave, ataHpara tomarA yA karecha sejanya tomAderake anutapta hate have|

tomarA jene rekha ye, tomAdera madhye AllAhara rasUla vartamAna Ache| se yadi adhikAMza viSaYe tomAdera kathA mene nita, tAhale tomarA avazyai kSatigrasta hate| kintu AllAha tomAdera kAche ImAnake priYa kare diYechena| tomAdera antare seTike suzobhita karechena Ara tomAdera kAche kuphurI, pApAcAra o avAdhyatAke ghRNita karechena| tArAi satya pathaprApta|
(yA) AllAhara karuNA o anugraha| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

mu’minadera du’dala lar3AiYe jar3iYe par3ale tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dAo| ataHpara ekaTi dala aparaTira upara vAr3AvAr3i karale ye dalaTi vAr3AvAr3i kare, tAra viruddhe tomarA lar3Ai kara yatakSaNa nA se dalaTi AllAhara nirdezera dike phire Ase| ataHpara yadi dalaTi phire Ase, tAhale tAdera madhye inasAphera saGge phaYasAlA kara Ara suvicAra kara; AllAha suvicArakArIderake bhAlavAsena|
mu’minarA paraspara bhAi bhAi, kAjei tomAdera bhAidera madhye zAnti-samajhotA sthApana kara, Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA daYA prApta hao|

he mu’minagaNa! kona sampradAYa yena anya sampradAYake ThATTA-vidrUpa nA kare, hate pAre tArA vidrUpakArIdera ceYe uttama| Ara nArIrA yena anya nArIderaka ThATTA-vidrUpa nA kare, hate pAre tArA vidrUpakAriNIdera ceYe uttama| tomarA eke anyera nindA karo nA, eke aparake manda nAme Deko nA| ImAna grahaNera para (ImAnera Age kRta aparAdhake yA mane kariYe deYa sei) manda nAma katai nA manda! (e sava hate) yArA tAovAha nA kare tArAi yAlima|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA adhika dhAraNA hate virata thAka| kataka dhAraNA pApera antarbhukta| tomarA anyera doSa kho~jAkhu~ji karo nA, eke anyera anupasthitite doSa-truTi varNanA karo nA| tomAdera keu ki tAra mRta bhAiYera gozata khete pachanda karave? tomarA to seTAke ghRNAi kare thAka| AllAhake bhaYa kara, AllAha khuva vezi tAovAha kvavUlakArI, ati daYAlu|

he mAnuSa! tomAderake eka puruSa o eka nArI theke sRSTi karechi evaM tomAderake vibhinna jAti o goSThIte vibhakta karechi yAte tomarA parasparake cinate pAra| tomAdera madhye AllAhara nikaTa sei lokai adhika sammAnIYa ye loka adhika muttAkvI| AllAha sarvajJa, sava khavara rAkhena|

veduInarA vale, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’| vala- ‘tomarA ImAna Anani, varaM tomarA vala, ‘AmarA (maukhika) Anugatya svIkAra karechi’, ekhana paryanta tomAdera antare ImAna praveza kareni| tomarA yadi AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake mAnya kara tAhale tomAdera kRtakarmera kichui kamati karA have nA| AllAha ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
mu’mina tArAi yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera upara ImAna Ane, ataHpara konarUpa sandeha kare nA, Ara tAdera mAla diYe o jAna diYe AllAhara pathe jihAda kare; tArAi satyavAdI|
vala, ‘tomarA ki tomAdera dvIna samparke AllAhake avagata karate cAo’? AllAha to jAnena yA Ache AsamAne Ara yA Ache yamIne| AllAha pratiTi viSaYa samparke savizeSa avagata|

ei lokerA mane kare ye, tArA isalAma kavUla ka’re tomAra prati anugraha kareche| tAderake vale dAo, ‘tomarA tomAdera isalAma kavUlera dvArA AmAra prati kona anugraha karani varaM AllAhi tomAderake ImAnera pathe paricAlita ka’re tomAdera prati anugraha karechena, tomarA yadi (tomAdera ImAna AnAra dAvIte) satyavAdI haYei thAka|
AsamAna o yamInera gopana viSaYera khavara AllAhai jAnena| tomarA yA kara AllAha tA dekhena|
kvApha, zapatha mAhAtmyapUrNa kuraAnera (ye tumi AllAhara rasUla|)
varaM e lokerA vismita hacche ye, tAdera kAche tAderai madhya hate ekajana sartakakArI eseche| yAra kAraNe kAphirarA vale- ‘eto var3ai Azcaryajanaka vyApAra!
AmarA yakhana mare yAva Ara mATi haYe yAva (takhana AmAderake AvAra AllAhara kAche phire yete have)? e phire yAoYATA to vahu dUrera vyApAra|
Ami jAni mATi tAdera kataTuku kSaYa kare Ara AmAra kAche Ache eka kitAva yA (sava kichura pUrNa vivaraNa) saMrakSaNa kare|
tAdera kAche satya AsAra para tArA tA asvIkAra kareche, kAjei ekhana tArA saMzaYera madhye par3e Ache|
tArA ki tAdera upare avasthita AkAzera dike tAkAYa nA, kIbhAve Ami tAke vAniYechi, tAke suzobhita karechi Ara tAte nei kona phATala?
Ara pRthivI- tAke karechi vistRta Ara tAte saMsthApita karechi parvatarAji Ara tAte udgata karechi yAvatIYa sudRzya udbhidarAji|
pratiTi (AllAha) abhimukhI vAndAhara janya cakSu unmocanakArI o upadeza hiseve|
Ami AkAza theke varSaNa kari kalyANakara vRSTi Ara tA diYe sRSTi kari vAgAna Ara mAr3Aiyogya zasyadAnA,
Ara u~cu khejura gAcha yAte Ache khejura guccha stare stare sAjAno|
vAndAhadera riyaka hiseve| Ara Ami pAni diYe jIvanta kare tuli mRta yamInake| ebhAvei vera karA have (kvavara theke mAnuSadera)|
edera Age satyake mene nite asvIkAra karechila nUhera jAti, rAs‌sa o sAmuda jAti,
‘Ada, pherAuna o lUta jAti,
AikAvAsI o tuvvAra jAti| tArA sakalei rasUladerake mithyA vale asvIkAra karechila, phale tAdera upara AmAra zAsti avadhArita haYechila|
AmarA ki prathamavAra sRSTi kare klAnta haYe par3echi? vastutaH tArA natuna sRSTi viSaYe sandehe par3e Ache|
Amii mAnuSake sRSTi karechi, Ara tAra pravRtti tAke (nitya natuna) kI kumantraNA deYa tAo Ami jAni| Ami tAra galAra zirA thekeo nikaTavartI|
(tadupari) du’jana lekhaka DAne o vAme vase (mAnuSera ‘AmAla) likhache|
ye kathAi mAnuSa uccAraNa kare (tA saMrakSaNera janya) tAra nikaTe ekajana sadA tatpara praharI Ache|
mRtyura yantraNA prakRtai Asave yAttheke avyAhati pAoYAra janya tumi ceSTA karate|
ataHpara siGgAYa phu~ka deYA have| seTAi hala zAstira dina (ye samparke mAnuSake satarka karA haYechila)|
(sedina) pratyeka vyakti Asave emana avasthAYa ye ekajana (pherezatA) tAke hA~kiYe niYe Asave Ara ekajana (pherezatA) thAkave sAkSyadAtA hiseve|
(valA have) ‘e dina samparke tumi chile udAsIna| tomAra sAmane ye pardA chila tA Ami sariYe diYechi| (se kAraNe) tomAra dRSTi Aja khuva tIkSma|
tAra saGgI (pherezatA) valave ‘ei ye AmAra kAche (‘AmAlanAmA) prastuta|’
(nirdeza deYA have) tomarA ubhaYe pratyeka avAdhya kAphirake nikSepa kara jAhAnnAme|
(yArA chila) kalyANera prativandhaka, sImAlaGghanakArI o sandigdha citta|
ye AllAhara saGge anyake ilAh vAniYe niYechila| kAjei tomarA ubhaYe tAke kaThina ‘AyAve nikSepa kara|
tAra saGgI valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! Ami tAke vidrohI vAnAini varaM se nijei chila sudUra gumarAhIra madhye|’
AllAha valavena, ‘AmAra sAmane vAdAnuvAda karo nA, Ami Agei tomAderake satarka kare diYechilAma|
AmAra kathA kakSano vadale nA, Ara Ami AmAra vAndAhadera prati yulamakArIo nai|
se dina Ami jAhAnnAmake jijJesa karava, ‘tumi ki paripUrNa haYecha’? se valave, ‘Aro vezi Ache ki?’
muttAkvIdera janya jAnnAtake nikaTe AnA have- tA moTei dUre thAkave nA|
(valA have) ‘e hala tAi yAra o‘YAdA tomAderake deYA haYechila- pratyeka AllAha abhimukhI o (gunAha theke) khuva vezi hiphAyAtakArIra janya|
ye nA dekhei daYAmaYa (AllAhake) bhaYa karata, Ara AllAhara nirdeza pAlanera janya vinaYe avanata antara niYe upasthita hata|
(tAderake valA have) ‘zAntira saGge ete praveza kara, eTA cirasthAYI jIvanera dina|’
sekhAne tAdera janya tA-i Ache yA tArA icche karave, Ara AmAra kAche (tAchAr3Ao) Aro vezi Ache|
tAdera pUrve Ami kata jAtike dhvaMsa kare diYechi yArA zaktite chila tAdera ceYe pravala, yAra phale tArA duniYA caSe ver3Ata; tArA pAlAnora kona jAYagA peYechila ki?
ete avazyai upadeza raYeche tAra janya yAra Ache (vodhazaktisampanna) antara kiMvA ye khuva mana diYe kathA zune|
AkAza, yamIna Ara e du’Yera mAjhe yA Ache tA Ami cha’ dine sRSTi karechi; klAnti AmAke sparza kareni| (Ami sakala mAnuSake vicArera janya hAjira karavai)|
kAjei tArA (mithyA, upahAsapUrNa o apamAnajanaka kathA) yA vale tAte tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara Ara sUryodaYera pUrve Ara sUryAstera pUrve tomAra pratipAlakera mahimA o prazaMsA ghoSaNA kara|
Ara tA~ra prazaMsA ghoSaNA kara rAtrira ekAMze Ara nAmAyera pare|
Ara zona, yedina eka ghoSaNAkArI (pratyeka vyaktira) nikaTavartI sthAna theke DAka dive,
yedina samasta mAnuSa prakRtai zunate pAve eka (bhaYaMkara) dhvani| sedinaTi have (bhUgarbha theke sakala AtmAra) vera haoYAra dina|
Amii jIvana dei, Amii mutyu dei, Ara AmAra kAchei (savvAike) phire Asate have|
yedina pRthivI dIrNa vidIrNa have, Ara mAnuSa chuTe yAve (hAzarera pAne)| ei ekatrIkaraNa AmAra janya khuvai sahaja|
tArA (tomAra viruddhe) yA vale tA Ami bhAla karei jAni, tumi tAdera upara javaradastikArI nao| kAjei ye AmAra zAstira bhaYapradarzanake bhaYa kare, tAke tumi kuraAnera sAhAyye upadeza dAo|
zapatha sei vAtAsera yA dhUlAvAli ur3AYa,
Ara yA uThiYe neYa Ara vahana kare bhArI vojhA,
Ara yA dhIra o zAnta gatite vaYe cale
Ara yArA karma vaNTana kare,
tomAderake yAra o‘YAdA deYA haYeche tA avazyai satya|
karmaphala divasa avazyai Asave|
vahu patha viziSTa AkAzera zapatha|
(parakAla samparke) tomarA avazyai raYecha matabhedera madhye|
yArA sei (satya) mAnate bhula kare tArAi gumarAha|
anumAnakArIrA dhvaMsa hoka,
yArA ajJatA o udAsInatAra madhye raYeche|
tArA jijJesa kare- ‘pratiphala divasa kave have?’
(tA have sedina) yedina tAderake Agune zAsti deYA have|
(tAderake valA have) tomarA tomAdera (kRtakarmera) zAsti bhoga kara, eTA hacche tAi yAra janya tomarA tAr3Ahur3A karachile|
muttAkIrA thAkave jAnnAta Ara jharNAdhArAra mAjhe|
tAdera pratipAlaka yA tAderake divena tA tArA bhoga karave, kAraNa tArA pUrve (duniYAra jIvane) chila satkarmazIla,
tArA rAtrikAle khuva kamai zaYana karata|
Ara tArA rAtrira zeSa prahare kSamA prArthanA karata|
evaM tAdera dhana-mAle Ache yAJjhAkArI o vaJcitadera adhikAra (yA tArA AdAYa karata)|
nizcita vizvAsIdera janya pRthivIte Ache nidarzana,
Ara (nidarzana Ache) tomAdera mAjheo, tomarA ki dekha nA?
evaM AkAze Ache tomAdera riyaka Ara Ache yAra o‘YAdA tomAderake deYA haYeche|
AkAza o yamInera pratipAlakera zapatha! e sava avazyai satya, emanai dRr3ha satya yemana tomarA (ye kathAvArtA) vale thAka (sei kathAvArtA valAra vyApAraTA yemana niHsandehe satya)|
tomAra kAche ivarAhImera sammAnita mehamAnadera khavara pau~cheche ki?
yakhana tArA tAra sAmane upasthita hala takhana valala, ‘sAlAma’| se uttara dila- ‘sAlAma’| (ivarAhIma mane mane bhAvala ederake to dekhachi) aparicita loka|
takhana se tAr3AtAr3i tAra gharera lokedera nikaTa cale gela evaM ekaTi moTAtAjA (bhAjA) vAchura niYe Asala|
ataHpara seTike tAdera sAmane rekhe dila evaM valala- ‘tomarA khAccha nA kena?’
(yakhana tArA khela nA) takhana se tAdera vyApAre mane bhaYa peYe gela| tArA valala- ‘tumi bhaYa peo nA’, ataHpara tArA tAke eka jJAnavAna putrera susaMvAda dila|
takhana tAra strI citkAra karate karate egiYe Asala| se nijera kapAle AghAta kare valala ‘(Ami) eka vRddhA, vandhyA’ (AmAra kIbhAve santAna have?)
tArA valala- ‘‘tomAra pratipAlaka e rakamai valechena, tini mahA prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa"|
ivarAhIma valala- ‘ohe AllAhara dUtagaNa (pherezatArA)! tomAdera kAja kI (ekhana)?’
tArA valala- ‘AmAderake eka aparAdhI jAtira kAche pAThAno haYeche'|
yena tAdera upara mATira pAthara varSaNa kari
yA tomAra pratipAlakera nikaTa cihnita haYe Ache sImAlaGghanakArIdera janya|
sekhAne yArA mu’mina chila Ami tAderake vera kare enechilAma,
Ami sekhAne musalimadera ekaTi parivAra chAr3A Ara pAini|
Ara tAdera janya sekhAne ekaTA nidarzana rekhe dilAma yArA atyanta pIr3AdAYaka ‘AyAvera bhaYa kare|
Ara mUsAra ghaTanAteo (nidarzana Ache) yakhana Ami tAke spaSTa pramANasaha pherAunera kAche pAThiYechilAma,
takhana se tAra kSamatAra dApaTe mukha phiriYe nila Ara valala- ‘e loka ekaTA yAdukara nA haYa pAgala|’
zeSe Ami tAke Ara tAra sainya sAmantake pAkar3Ao karalAma Ara tAderake samudre nikSepa karalAma| se chila dhikRta nindita|
Ara ‘Ada-era ghaTanAteo (nidarzana Ache)| Ami tAdera kAche pAThiYechilAma akalyANera vAtAsa|
tA yA kichura upara diYe vaYe giYechila tAke cUrNa-vicUrNa o dhvaMsastupe pariNata nA kare chAr3eni|
Ara sAmUdera ghaTanAteo (nidarzana Ache) yakhana tAderake valA haYechila, ‘ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta bhoga kare lao|’
kintu tArA dhRSTatAra saGge tAdera pratipAlakera Adeza amAnya karala| phale vajrAghAta tAderake pAkar3Ao karala yA tArA ceYe ceYe dekhachila|
tArA (pAYera bhare) uThe dA~r3Ateo pArala nA Ara AtmarakSA karateo pArala nA|
itopUrve Ami nUhera jAtike dhvaMsa karechilAma, tArA chila eka pApAcArI jAti|
Ami nija hAta dvArA AsamAna sRSTi karechi Ara Ami avazyai mahA prazastakArI|
Ara yamIna- tAke Amii vichiYechi, Ami katai nA sundara (samatala) prasAraNakArI!
Ami pratyekaTi vastu sRSTi karechi jor3AYa jor3AYa, yAte tomarA zikSA grahaNa kara|
ataeva daur3Ao AllAhara dike, Ami tomAdera janya tA~ra pakSa hate spaSTa satarkakArI|
tomarA AllAhara saGge kona ilAha sthira karo nA, Ami tA~ra pakSa theke tomAdera janya spaSTa satarkakArI|
ebhAve yakhanai tAdera Agera lokedera madhye kona rasUla eseche, takhanai tArA valeche- ‘se yAdukara nA haYa unmAda|’
tArA ki vaMza paramparAYa erai asiYata (arthAt antima savaka) diYe Asache, varaM tArA sImAlaGghanakArI jAti|
kAjei tumi tAdera dika theke mukha phiriYe lao, tAra janya tumi tiraskRta have nA|
Ara tumi upadeza dite thAka, kenanA upadeza mu’minadera upakAra karave|
Ami jvina o mAnavake sRSTi karechi ekamAtra e kAraNe ye, tArA AmArai ‘ivAdAta karave|
Ami tAdera theke riyaka cAi nA, Ara Ami eo cAi nA ye, tArA AmAke khAoYAve|
AllAhai to riyakadAtA, mahA zaktidhara, pravala parAkrAnta|
kAjei yArA yulama kareche tAdera prApya tAi ye prApya pUrve chila tAdera mata lokedera; kAjei (nijedera prApya pAoYAra janya) tArA yena tAr3Ahur3A nA kare|
kAphiradera janya dhvaMsa (neme Asave) tAdera sedinera yedinera bhaYa tAderake dekhAno haYeche|
zapatha tUra (parvata) era,
zapatha kitAvera yA likhita
kholA pRSThAYa,
zapatha vezi vezi AvAdakRta gharera,
zapatha suucca chAdera,
zapatha taraGgAYita samudrera,
tomAra pratipAlakera ‘AyAva avazyai saMghaTita have|
tAra pratirodhakArI keu nei|
yedina AkAza pracanDabhAve kA~pave,
Ara parvata have druta calamAna,
dhvaMsa sedina satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera janya|
yArA nirarthaka kathAra khelAYa magna Ache|
yedina tAderake jAhAnnAmera Agunera dike tAr3iYe neYA have dhAkkAte dhAkkAte,
(valA have) eTA hala jAhAnnAmera sei Aguna tomarA yAke mithye jAnate|
eTA ki yAdu, nAki tomarA dekhate pAccha nA?
ekhana era bhitara jvalate thAka, ataHpara dhairya dhara kiMvA dhairya nA dhara, tomAdera janya dui-i samAna| tomAderake sei pratiphalai deYA have yA tomarA ‘AmAla karate|
muttAkvIrA thAkave jAnnAte Ara ni‘mAta sambhArera mAjhe,
tArA bhoga karave tAdera pratipAlaka yA tAderake divena, Ara tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake jAhAnnAmera ‘AyAva theke rakSA karavena|
(tAderake valA have) khAo Ara pAna kara khuva majA kare- tomarA ye ‘AmAla karate tAra pratiphala hiseve|
tArA sArivaddhabhAve sAjAno Asane helAna diYe vasave, Ara Ami tAdera viYe diYe deva sundara var3a var3a ujjvala cakSu viziSTA kumArIdera saGge|

yArA ImAna Ane Ara tAdera santAna santatirA ImAnera sAthe pitAmAtAke anusaraNa kare, Ami tAdera sAthe tAdera santAna santatike milita karava| tAdera ‘AmAlera kona kichu thekei Ami tAderake vaJcita karava nA| pratyeka vyaktii nija kRtakarmera janya dAYavaddha|
Ami tAderake diva phalamUla Ara gozata yA tArA pachanda karave|
tArA sekhAne parasparera madhye vinimaYa karave pAnapAtra, thAkave nA sekhAne kona vehudA vakavakAni, thAkave nA kona pApera kAja|
tAdera caturdike ghura ghura ka’re tAdera sevAYa niYojita thAkave kizorerA (yArA etai sundara) yena sayatne lukiYe rAkhA maNimuktA|
tArA parasparera nikaTa egiYe giYe eke aparake jijJesa karave,
tArA valave, ‘pUrve AmarA AmAdera parivAre (duniYAvI nAnA kAraNe o AkhirAtera ‘AyAvera AzaMkAYa) bhaYa bhItira madhye chilAma|
avazeSe AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha karechena Ara AmAderake jhalase deYA vAtAsera ‘AyAva theke rakSA karechena|
pUrve AmarA tA~ra kAchei du‘A karatAma, tini ati anugrahakArI, parama daYAvAna|
kAjei tumi upadeza dite thAka, tomAra pratipAlakera anugrahe tumi gaNakao nao, Ara pAgalao nao|
tArA ki vale se ekajana kavi, yAra janya AmarA kAlacakrera (vipadApadera) apekSA karachi|
oderake vala- tomarA apekSA kara, Amio tomAdera saGge apekSA karachi| (ataHpara ubhaYa pakSai dekhate pAve kAra kI pariNati haYa)|
tAdera vuddhi viveka ki tAderake e nirdeza deYa, nAki tArA mUlataHi eka sImAlaGghanakArI jAti?
tArA ki vale- ‘se nijei (kuraAna) racanA kare niYeche? Asale tArA ImAnai Aneni|
tArA satyavAdI hale e rakama ekaTA kAlAma tArA niYe Asuka nA kena|
tArA ki sRSTi haYeche, nAki tArA nijerAi sRSTikartA?
nAki tArA AsamAna o yamIna sRSTi kareche? Asale tArA nizcita vizvAsI naYa|
nAki tomAra pratipAlakera dhanabhAnDAragulo tAdera hAte, nA tArA era niYantraka?
nAki tAdera kAche, si~r3i Ache yAte tArA (AkAze uThe yAYa Ara gopana kathA) zune thAke? thAkale tAdera (sei) zrotA spaSTa pramANa hAjira karuka|
nAki AllAhara janya kanyA santAna, Ara tomAdera janya putra santAna?
nAki tumi tAdera kAche pArizramika cAccha, yAra phale tArA RNe bhArAkrAnta haYe par3ache?
nAki tAdera kAche adRzyera jJAna Ache, Ara tArA tA likhache?
nAki tArA (tomAra viruddhe) cakrAnta karate cAYa? tAhale kintu kAphirarAi cakrAntera phA~de ATakA par3ave|
nAki AllAha chAr3A tAdera janya ilAh Ache? tArA yAke zarIka gaNya kare AllAha tA theke pavitra|
AkAzera kona khanDa bheGge par3ate dekhale tArA valata- ‘eTA to puJjIbhUta megha| (tAderake AllAhara yatai vismaYakara nidarzana dekhAno hoka nA kena, tArA ImAna Anave nA|)
kAjei tAderake upekSA kara yatakSaNa nA tArA sAkSAt kare tAdera sedinera yedina tArA have vajrAhata|
sedina tAdera Sar3ayantra tAdera kona kAje Asave nA, Ara tArA sAhAyyaprAptao have nA|
yAlimadera janya echAr3A Aro ‘AyAva raYeche, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

tumi dhairya dhare tomAra pratipAlakera hukumera apekSAYa thAka, kAraNa tumi AmAra cokhera sAmanei Acha| Ara tumi tomAra pratipAlakera prazaMsA ghoSaNA kara yakhana tumi uTha (mAjalisa zeSe, athavA vichAnA cher3e kiMvA nAmAyera janya)|
Ara rAtrikAle tA~ra prazaMsA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara Ara (rAtera zeSabhAge yakhana) tArakArAji astamita haYe yAYa|
zapatha tArakAra yakhana tA asta yAYa,
tomAdera (mAjhe choTa theke var3a haYeche sei) saGgI gumarAhao naYa Ara bhulapathe paricAlitao naYa,
Ara se managar3A kathAo vale nA|
tAto oYAhI yA tAra prati pratyAdeza karA haYa,
tAke zikSA deYa zaktizAlI,
prajJAra adhikArI (jivarAIla) se nija AkRtite sthira haYe chila,
Ara se chila Urdhva digante,
ataHpara se (navIra) nikaTavartI hala, ataHpara Asalo Aro nikaTe,
phale [navI (sAH) o jivarAIlera mAjhe] dui dhanukera vyavadhAna raila athavA Aro kama|
takhana (AllAha) tA~ra vAndAhara prati oYAhI karalena yA oYAhI karAra chila|
(navIra) antaHkaraNa mithye mane kareni yA se dekhe chila|
se yA dekheche se viSaYe tomarA ki tAra saGge vitarka karave?
avazyai se [arthAt navI (sA.)] tAke [arthAt jivarAIla (AH)-ke] ArekavAra dekhechila
zeSasImAra varai gAchera kAche,
yAra kAche avasthita vasavAsera jAnnAta|
yakhana gAchaTi yA diYe Dheke thAkAra tA diYe DhAkA chila, (yAra varNanA mAnuSera vodhagamya naYa)
(navIra) dRSTi bhramao ghaTeni, sImA chAr3iYeo yAYani|
se tAra pratipAlakera var3a var3a nidarzana dekhechila|
tomarA ki lAta o uyayA samparke bheve dekhecha?
Ara tRtIYa ArekaTi mAnAt samparke? (e sava akSama, vAkazaktihIna, nar3A-car3Ara zaktihIna mUrtigulora pUjA karA kataTA yuktiyukta)
kI! tomAdera janya putra santAna Ara AllAhara janya kanyA santAna?

yA kakhanao zeSa have nA, kakSano niSiddhao have nA|
Ara u~cu u~cu vichAnAYa|
tAderake (arthAt ai huraderake) Ami sRSTi karechi eka abhinava sRSTite,
Ara tAderake karechi kumArI,
svAmI bhaktA, anuraktA Ara samavaYaskA,
(e sava hala) DAna dikera lokadera janya,
(yArA have) pUrvavartIdera madhya hate vahu saMkhyaka
Ara paravartIdera madhya theke vahusaMkhyaka
Ara vAma dikera dala, kata hatabhAgya vAmadikera dala!
(tArA thAkave) atyadhika garama hAoYA, phuTanta pAni
Ara kAlo dho~YAra chAYAYa,
yA zItalao naYa, tRptidAYakao naYa|
itopUrve tArA bhoga vilAse matta chila,
Ara avirAma ka’re yeta var3a var3a pApera kAja,
Ara tArA valata- ‘AmarA yakhana mare yAva Ara mATi o hAr3e pariNata hava, takhana ki AmAderake (natuna jIvana diYe) AvAra uThAno have?
Ara AmAdera vApadAdAderakeo?
vala- ‘pUrvavartI Ara paravartI
avazyai sakalake ekatrita karA have ekaTA nirdhArita dine yA (AllAhara) jAnA Ache|
takhana he gumarAha (satya) pratyAkhyAnakArIrA!
tomarA avazyai jAkkuma gAcha theke AhAra karave,
tA diYe tomarA tomAdera peTa bharti karave,
Ara tAra upara pAna karave phuTanta pAni,
Ara tA pAna karave pipAsA-kAtara uTera mata
pratiphala deYAra dine ei have tAdera ApyAYana
Amii to tomAderake sRSTi karechi, tAhale tomarA satyake vizvAsa karave nA kena?
tomarA ki bheve dekhecha- tomarA ye vIrya nikSepa kara,
tA ki tomarA sRSTi kara, nA tAra sRSTikartA Amii|
tomAdera madhye mRtyu Amii nirdhAraNa kari, Ara Ami kichumAtra akSama nai
tomAdera AkAra AkRti parivartana karate Ara tomAderake (natunabhAve) emana eka AkRtite sRSTi karate yA tomarA jAna nA|
tomarA tomAdera prathama sRSTi samvandhe avazyai jAna tAhale (AllAha ye tomAderake punarAYa sRSTi karate sakSama e kathA) tomarA anudhAvana kara nA kena?
tomarA ki bheve dekhecha tomarA ye vIja vapana kara se samparke?
tomarAi ki tA utpanna kara, nA Amii utpannakArI?
Ami icche karale tAke avazyai khar3akuTA kare dite pAri, takhana tomarA haYe yAve vismaYe hatavAka|
(Ara valave ye) ‘AmarA to dAYagrasta haYe par3alAma,
varaM AmarA vaJcita haYe gelAma|
tomarA ki pAni samparke cintA kare dekhecha yA tomarA pAna kara?
tA ki tomarAi megha theke varSaNa kara, nAki tAra vaSarNakArI Amii?
Ami icche karale tAke lavaNAkta kare dite pAri, tAhale kena tomarA zokara AdAYa kara nA?
tomarA ye Aguna jvAlAo se samparke ki tomarA cintA kare dekhecha?
tAra (jvAlAnora) gAcha (arthAt kATha) ki tomarAi vAniYecha, nAki Amii vAniYechi?
Ami tAke (arthAt Agunake) karechi smAraka (yA jAhAnnAmera Agunera kathA smaraNa kariYe deYa) Ara marura adhivAsIdera janya darakArI o ArAmera vastu|
kAjei (he navI!) tumi tomAra mahAna pratipAlakera mahimA o gaurava ghoSaNA kara|
uparantu Ami zapatha karachi tArakArAjira astAcalera|
tA avazyai ati var3a zapatha yadi tomarA jAnate!
avazyai tA sammAnita kuraAna,
(yA likhita Ache) surakSita kitAve,
pUta-pavitra (pherezatA) chAr3A (zaYatvAnerA) tA sparza karate pAre nA,
jagat samUhera pratipAlakera nikaTa theke avatIrNa,
tavuo ki tomarA e vANIke tuccha mane karacha?
Ara tAke mithye valAkei tomarA tomAdera jIvikA vAniYe niYecha|
tAhale kena (tomarA vAdhA dAo nA) yakhana prANa ese yAYa kaNThanAlIte?
Ara tomarA tAkiYe tAkiYe dekha,
Ara Ami tomAdera ceYe tAra (arthAt prANera) nikaTavartI, kintu tomarA dekhate pAonA|
tomarA yadi (AmAra) kartRtvera adhIna nA hao
tAhale tomarA tAke (arthAt tomAdera prANake mRtyura samaYa) phiriYe nAo nA kena yadi tomarA (tomAdera dAvIte) satyavAdI haYei thAka?
ataeva se yadi (AllAhara) naikaTya prAptadera ekajana haYa
tAhale (tAra janya Ache) ArAma-zAnti, uttama riyaka Ara ni‘mAte-bharA jAnnAta|
Ara yadi se DAna dikera ekajana haYa
tAhale he DAnera vAsindA! tomAra janya Ache zAnti o nirApattA|
Ara se yadi satya asvIkArakArI gumarAhadera antargata haYa,
tave tAra ApyAYana have phuTanta pAni diYe|
Ara (tAra janya Ache) jAhAnnAmera Agunera dahana,
eTA sunizcita satya|
kAjei tumi tomAra mahAna pratipAlakera gaurava o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|
AsamAna o yamIne yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara gaurava o mahimA ghoSaNA kare, tini pravala parAkrAnta, mahA prajJAvAna|
AsamAna o yamInera rAjatva tA~rai, tinii jIvana dena, Ara tinii mRtyu dena, tini sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
tinii prathama, tinii zeSa, tini prakAzita AvAra gupta, tini sakala viSaYa pUrNarUpe jJAta|

tini AsamAna o yamInake chaYa dine sRSTi karechena ataHpara Araze samunnata haYechena| tini jAnena yA yamIne praveza kare, Ara yA tAttheke vera haYa, Ara yA AkAza theke avatIrNa haYa, Ara yA tAte uThe yAYa, tomarA yekhAnei thAka tini tomAdera saGge Achena, tomarA ye kAjai kara nA kena, AllAha tA dekhena|
AsamAna o yamInera rAjatva tA~rai, yAvatIYa viSaYa tA~rai dike phire yAYa (cUr3Anta phaYasAlAra janya)|
tinii rAtake praveza karAna dinera bhitara, Ara dinake DhukiYe dena rAtera bhitara, antarera gopanatattva samparke tini pUrNarUpe avagata|

tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati ImAna Ano, Ara tini tomAderake yAra uttarAdhikArI karechena tAttheke (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kara | kAraNa tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna Ane Ara vyaYa kare, tAdera janya Ache virATa pratiphala|

tomAdera kI hala ye, tomarA AllAhara prati ImAna Anave nA yakhana rasUla tomAderake tomAdera pratipAlakera upara ImAna AnAra janya DAkache Ara tini tomAdera kAcha theke pratizruti grahaNa karechena, yadi tomarA vizvAsI haYei thAka|
tinii tA~ra vAndAhara upara suspaSTa AYAta avatIrNa karena tomAderake ghora andhakAra theke Alote AnAra janya, AllAha avazyai tomAdera prati var3ai karuNAzIla, ati daYAlu|

tomAdera hala kI ye tomarA AllAhara pathe vyaYa karave nA! AkAza o pRthivIra uttarAdhikAra to AllAharai janya (kAjei tA~ra pathe vyaYa karale tomarA garIva haYe yAve e AzaGkAra kona kAraNa nei)| tomAdera madhye yArA (makkA) vijaYera pUrve vyaYa kareche Ara yuddha kareche tArA samAna naYa (tAdera, yArA tA vijaYera pare kareche); tAdera maryAdA aneka var3a tAdera tulanAYa yArA pare vyaYa kareche o yuddha kareche| ubhaYera janyai AllAha kalyANera o‘YAdA diYechena| tomarA yA kichu kara se samparke AllAha pUrNabhAve avagata|
emana ke Ache ye, AllAhake uttama RNa dive? tAhale tini tA tAra janya kaYekaguNa vAr3iYe divena Ara tAra janya Ache sammAnajanaka pratiphala|

se dina tumi mu’mina o mu’minAdera dekhave, tAdera sAmane Ara tAdera DAne tAdera jyoti chuTate thAkave| (tAderake valA have) ‘Aja tomAdera janya jAnnAtera susaMvAda yAra nIca diYe jharNAdhArA pravAhita, tAte (tomarA) cirakAla thAkave| eTAi hala virATa saphalatA|

sedina munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArIrA mu’minaderake valave- ‘tomarA AmAdera janya apekSA kara, tomAdera jyoti theke AmarA kichuTA niYe nei|’ tAderake valA have- ‘tomarA tomAdera pechane phire yAo, ‘Ara Alora kho~ja kara|’ takhana tAdera mAjhe ekaTi Ar3Ala khAr3A kare deYA have yAra thAkave ekaTi darajA| tAra bhitara bhAge thAkave rahamata Ara vahirbhAgera sarvatra thAkave ‘AyAva|

tArA mu’minaderake Deke valave- ‘AmarA ki tomAdera saGge chilAma nA?’ tArA uttara dive, ‘hA~, kintu tomarA nijerAi nijederake vipade phele diYecha, tomarA apekSA karechile (AmAdera dhvaMsera janya), tomarA sandehe patita chile, Ara mithye AzA AkAGkSA tomAderake pratArita karechila| zeSa paryanta AllAhara hukuma ese gela, Ara var3a pratAraka (zAitvana) tomAderake AllAhara vyApAre pratArita karala|

Aja tomAdera kAcha theke kona muktipaNa grahaNa karA have nA, Ara yArA kuphurI karechila tAdera kAcha thekeo nA| tomAdera vasavAsera jAYagA jAhAnnAma, seTAi tomAdera yathAyogya sthAna| katai nA nikRSTa sei AzraYasthala!

yArA ImAna eneche tAdera janya se samaYa ki ekhanao Aseni ye AllAhara smaraNe Ara ye prakRta satya avatIrNa haYeche tAte tAdera antara vigalita haYe yAve? Ara tArA yena sei lokadera mata nA haYe yAYa yAderake pUrve kitAva deYA haYechila, ataHpara tAdera upara ativAhita haYe gela vahu vahu yuga Ara tAdera antara kaThina haYe par3ala| tAdera adhikAMzai pApAcArI|
jene rekha, AllAhai yamInake tAra mRtyura para AvAra jIvita karena| Ami tomAdera kAche suspaSTabhAve nidarzana varNanA karechi yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
dAnazIla puruSarA Ara dAnazIlA nArIrA Ara yArA AllAhake RNa deYa- uttama RNa, tAdera janya vahuguNa vAr3iYe deYA have, Ara tAdera janya Ache maryAdApUrNa pratidAna|

Ara yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati ImAna Ane tArAi tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa siddIka o zahIda| tAdera janya Ache tAdera pratidAna o tAdera nUra| Ara yArA kuphurI kare Ara AmAra nidarzanake asvIkAra kare, tArAi jAhAnnAmera vAsindA|

tomarA jene rekha, duniYAra jIvana krIr3A-kautuka, zobhA-saundarya, pArasparika garva-ahaGkAra Ara dhana-mAla o santAnAdite Adhikyera pratiyogitA mAtra| tAra udAharaNa hala vRSTi, Ara tA hate utpanna zaSyAdi kRSakera manake Anande bhare deYa, tArapara tA peke yAYa, takhana tumi tAke haluda varNa dekhate pAo, pare tA khar3a bhuSi haYe yAYa| (Ara AkherAtera citra anyarakama, pApAcArIdera janya), AkherAte Ache kaThina zAsti, (Ara nekakAradera janya Ache) AllAhara kSamA o santuSTi| Ara duniYAra jIvanaTA to dho~kAra vastu chAr3A Ara kichui nA|

tomarA egiYe yAo tomAdera pratipAlakera kSamA o jAnnAta lAbhera janya, yAra prazastatA AsamAna o yamInera prazastatAra mata| tA prastuta rAkhA haYeche tAdera janya yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUladera prati ImAna eneche| eTA AllAhara anugraha, tini tA dena yAke icche karena, AllAha var3ai anugrahazIla|
pRthivIte athavA tomAdera nijedera upara emana kona musIvata Ase nA yA Ami saMghaTita karAra pUrve kitAve lipivaddha rAkhi nA| eTA (karA) AllAhara janya khuvai sahaja|

eTA ejanya ye, tomAdera ye kSati haYeche tAra janya tomarA yena hatAzAgrasta nA hao, Ara tomAderake yA dAna karA haYeche tAra janya tomarA yena utphulla nA hao, kenanA AllAha ahaMkArI o adhika garvakArIke pachanda karena nA-
yArA kRpaNatA kare Ara mAnuSake kRpaNatA karAra Adeza deYa evaM ye vyakti (AllAhara patha hate) mukha phiriYe neYa (se jene rAkhuka) AllAha abhAva mukta, prazaMsita|

Ami AmAra rasUladerake suspaSTa pramANasaha pAThiYechi Ara tAdera saGge avatIrNa karechi kitAva o (satya mithyAra) mAnadanDa yAte mAnuSa inasApha o suvicArera upara pratiSThita hate pAre| Ami avatIrNa karechi lohA yAte Ache pracanDa zakti Ara mAnuSera janya nAnAvidha upakAra yAte AllAha parIkSA karate pArena AllAhake nA dekhei tA~ke Ara tA~ra rasUladerake kArA (ei lohAra zakti diYe o yAvatIYa upAYe) sAhAyya kare| AllAha var3ai zaktimAna, mahAparikramazAlI|

Ami nUha (AlAihisa sAlAma) Ara ivrAhIma (AlAihisa sAlAma)-ke pAThiYechilAma Ara tAdera vaMzadharadera madhye nuvuoYAta o kitAvera vyavasthA pratiSThA karechilAma| tAdera madhye keu keu saThika patha avalamvana karechila Ara tAdera adhikAMzai chila pApAcArI|

ataHpara tAdera patha dhare Ami AmAra rasUladerake pAThiYechilAma, ataHpara tAdera pechane Ami mAraiYAma-putra ‘IsA (AlAihisa sAlAma)-ke pAThiYechilAma Ara tAke diYechilAma iJjIla| Ara yArA tAke anusaraNa karechila tAdera antare diYechilAma karuNA o daYAmAYA| Ara vairAgyavAda- tA tArA nijerAi natunabhAve cAlu kareche AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera AzAYa| Ami tAdera upara e vidhAna aparihArya karini| Ara seTAo tArA lAlana karate pAreni yebhAve tA lAlana karA praYojana chila| tAdera madhye yArA ImAna grahaNa karechila tAderake Ami tAdera prApya puraskAra diYechilAma| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai chila pApAcArI|

ohe mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara Ara tA~ra rasUlera prati ImAna Ana, tini tA~ra anugrahe tomAderake dviguNa puraskAra divena Ara tini tomAdera janya Alora vyavasthA karavena yA diYe tomarA patha calave, Ara tini tomAderake kSamA kare divena| AllAha var3ai kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|

(Ami Ahale kitAva chAr3A anyatra nuvuoYAta dilAma) e janya ye, Ahale kitAvagaNa yena jene nite pAre ye, AllAhara anugrahera kona kichukei tAdera niYantraNa karAra kona kSamatA nei, Ara (tArA yena Aro jene nite pAre ye) anugraha ekamAtra AllAhara hAtei, yAke icche tinii tA dena| AllAha vizAla anugrahera adhikArI|

AllAha tAra kathA zunechena ye nArI (khAolAha vinata sA‘lAvAha) tAra svAmIra viSaYe tomAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda karache Ara AllAhara kAche phariYAda jAnAcche, AllAha tomAdera du’janera kathA zunachena, AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

tomAdera madhye yArA tAdera strIdera sAthe jihAra kare (arthAt strIke vale ye, tumi AmAra janya AmAra mAYera piThera mata) tAdera strIrA tAdera mA naYa| tAdera mA to kevala tArAi yArA tAdera janma diYeche| tArA avazyai ghRNya o mithye kathA vale, nizcaYai AllAha pApa mocanakArI, var3ai kSamAzIla|

yArA nijedera strIdera sAthe jihAra kare, ataHpara tArA ye kathA valeche tA pratyAhAra kare neYa tave parasparake sparza karAra pUrve tAderake ekaTi dAsa mukta karate have, era dvArA tomAderake upadeza deYA hacche| tomarA yA kara, AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

kintu yAra (dAsa saMgraha karAra) sAmarthya nei, se eka nAgAr3e du’mAsa royA rAkhave parasparake sparza karAra pUrve| Ara ye tA karate pArave nA, se SATa jana misakInake khAvAra khAoYAve| e nirdeza deYA hacche e janya yAte tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati ImAna Ano| egulo AllAhara nirdhArita sImA| (yArA eTA asvIkAra karave sei) kAphiradera janya Ache marmAntika zAsti|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera virodhitA kare tAderake lAJchita karA have yemana lAJchita karA haYechila tAdera pUrvavartIderake| Ami suspaSTa AYAta avatIrNa karechi Ara (asvIkArakArI) kAphiradera janya Ache apamAnajanaka zAsti,

sedina, yedina AllAha tAdera sakalake AvAra jIvita kare uThAvena evaM tAdera kRtakarmera saMvAda tAderake jAniYe divena, AllAha tA hiseva kare rekhechena yadio tArA (nijerA) bhule geche| AllAha pratiTi viSaYera pratyakSadarzI|

tumi ki jAna nA ye, yA AkAze Ache Ara yA yamIne Ache AllAha sava jAnena| tinajanera madhye emana kona gopana parAmarza haYa nA yAte caturthajana AllAha hana nA, Ara pA~cajaneo haYa nA, SaSThajana tini chAr3A, era kama saMkhyakeo haYa nA, Ara vezi saMkhyakeo haYa nA, tini tAdera saGge thAkA vyatIta, tArA yekhAnei thAkuka nA kena| ataHpara kviYAmata divase tini jAniYe devena yA tArA ‘AmAla karechila| AllAha sakala viSaYe pUrNabhAve avagata|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani yAderake gopana parAmarza karate niSedha karA haYechila, ataHpara tArA AvAra tAi karala yA karate tAderake niSedha karA haYechila, tArA gopane parAmarza karala pApAcAra, sImAlaGghana Ara rasUlake amAnya karA niYe| tArA yakhana tomAra kAche Ase takhana tArA tomAke emanabhAve sambhASaNa kare yemanabhAve AllAha tomAke sambhASaNa karenani| tArA mane mane vale- ‘AmarA yA vali tAra janya AllAha AmAderake ‘AyAva dena nA kena? jAhAnnAmai tAdera janya yatheSTa, tAte tArA jvalave, katai nA nikRSTa sei gantavyasthala!

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yakhana gopana parAmarza kara, takhana pApAcAra, sImAlaGghana Ara rasUlake amAnya karAra parAmarza kara nA| tomarA satkarma o tAkaoYA avalamvanera vyApAre parAmarza karo| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara yA~ra kAche tomAderake samaveta karA have|

gopana parAmarza hala mu’minaderake duHkha deYAra janya zaYatvAna prarocita kAja| tave AllAhara anumati chAr3A tA tAdera kona kSati karate pAre nA| mu’minadera kartavya hala ekamAtra AllAharai upara bharasA karA|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAderake yakhana valA haYa- ‘vaiThaka prazasta kare dAo’, takhana tomarA tA prazasta kare dive, AllAha tomAderake prazastatA dAna karavena| Ara yakhana valA haYa- ‘tomarA uThe yAo’, takhana tomarA uThe yAve| tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche Ara yAderake jJAna dAna karA haYeche, AllAha tAderake maryAdAYa ucca karavena| tomarA yA kara AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yakhana rasUlera saGge gopane kathA vala, takhana gopane kathA valAra Age sadAkvAha dAo, eTAi tomAdera janya uttama o ati pavitra panthA| Ara yadi sadAkvAha jogAr3a karate nA pAra, tAhale AllAha ati kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|

tomarA ki bhaYa peYe gele ye, tomAderake (navIra saGge) gopane kathAvArtA valAra Age sadAkvAha dite have? tomarA yadi tA nA kara, tAhale AllAha tomAderake kSamA kare dilena, kAjei tomarA nAmAya kAYima kara, yAkAta dAo evaM AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kara| tomarA yA kara se viSaYe AllAha puropuri avagata|
tumi ki tAderake dekhani yArA sei sampradAYera saGge vandhutva kare yei sampradAYera prati AllAha rAgAnvita? tArA nA tomAdera loka, Ara nA tAdera loka Ara tArA jene zune mithye zapatha kare|
AllAha tAdera janya prastuta kare rekhechena kaThina zAsti, tArA yA kare tA katai nA manda!
tArA tAdera zapathaguloke DhAla vAniYe niYeche, era sAhAyye tArA mAnuSake AllAhara patha theke phiriYe rAkhe, e kAraNe tAdera janya Ache apamAnajanaka zAsti|
tAdera dhana-sampada Ara santAnAdi AllAhara zAsti theke tAderake vA~cAnora vyApAre kona kAje Asave nA, tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|

AllAha yedina tAdera savAike AvAra jIvita kare uThAvena, takhana tArA AllAhara kAche Thika se rakama zapathai karave, yemana zapatha tArA tomAdera nikaTa kare, Ara tArA mane kare ye, tAdera kichu (kona bhitti) Ache| jene rekha, tArA khuvai mithyevAdI|
zaYatvAna tAdera upara prabhAva khATiYe vaseche, Ara tAderake AllAhara smaraNa bhuliYe diYeche| tArA zaYatvAnera dala| jene rekha, zaYatvAnera dalai kSatigrasta|
yArA AllAhara o tA~ra rasUlera virodhitA kare, tArAi savaceYe vezI lAJchitadera antarbhukta|
AllAha likhe diYechena ye, avazya avazyai Ami o AmAra rasUlagaNa vijaYI thAkava| AllAha mahA zaktimAna o parAkramazAlI|

AllAha o parakAle vizvAsI emana kona sampradAYa tumi pAve nA yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera virodhitAkArIderake bhAlavAse- hoka nA ei virodhIrA tAdera pitA athavA putra athavA tAdera bhAi athavA tAdera jJAti goSThI| AllAha edera antare ImAna vaddhamUla kare diYechena, Ara nijera pakSa theke rUha diYe tAderake zaktizAlI karechena| tAderake tini dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra taladeza diYe vaYe caleche nadI-nAlA, tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa Ara tArAo tA~ra prati santuSTa| erAi AllAhara dala; jene rekha, AllAhara dalai sAphalyamanDita|
AsamAna o yamIne yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara gaurava o mahimA ghoSaNA kare| Ara tini (AllAha) parAkramazAlI prajJAmaYa|

kitAvadhArIdera antarbhukta kAphiraderake AkramaNera prathama dhApei tinii tAdera vAr3I theke vera ka’re dilena| tomarA dhAraNAo karani ye, tArA vera have| Ara tArA mane karechila ye, tAdera dUrgagulo tAderake AllAha (’ra kavala) theke rakSA karave| kintu AllAha tAderake emana dika theke pAkar3Ao karalena yA tArA bhAvateo pAreni| tini tAdera antare bhItira saJcAra karalena| tArA tAdera nijedera hAta diYei nijedera gharavAr3I dhvaMsa karala, Ara mu’minadera hAteo (dhvaMsa karAla)| ataeva he dRSTisampanna mAnuSerA! tomarA zikSA grahaNa kara|
AllAha yadi tAdera janya nirvAsana nA likhe ditena, tAhale tini tAderake duniYAtei avazya avazyai (anya) zAsti ditena, parakAle to tAdera janya jAhAnnAmera zAsti Achei|
era kAraNa ei ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera pravala virodhitA kareche; Ara ye-i AllAhara virodhitA karave, AllAha tAke zAstidAne var3ai kaThora|

tomarA khejurera ye gAchagulo keTecha Ara yeguloke tAdera mUlakAnDera upara dA~r3iYe thAkate diYecha, tA AllAhara anumatikramei (karecha)| Ara (e anumati AllAha ejanya diYechena) yena tini pApAcArIderake apamAnita karena|

AllAha tA~ra rasUlake tAdera kAcha theke ye phAYa (vinA yuddhe pAoYA sampada) diYechena tAra janya tomarA ghor3Ao daur3Aoni, Ara uTeo car3ani, varaM AllAha tA~ra rasUlagaNake yAra upara icche Adhipatya dAna karena; AllAha sarvaviSaYe kSamatAvAna|

ye dhana-sampada AllAha janapadavAsIdera kAcha theke niYe tA~ra rasUlake dilena tA AllAhara janya tA~ra rasUlera janya Ara rasUlera AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma, misakIna o pathikadera janya yAte tA tomAdera madhyakAra sampadazAlIdera madhyei Avartita nA haYa| rasUla tomAderake yA deYa tA grahaNa kara, Ara tomAderake yAttheke niSedha kare tAttheke virata thAka, AllAhake bhaYa kara, AllAha kaThina zAstidAtA|

(Ara e sampada) se sava daridra muhAjiradera janya yAderake tAdera vAr3Ighara o sampatti-sampada theke utkhAta karA haYeche| yArA AllAhara anugraha o santuSTi kAmanA kare, Ara tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake sAhAyya kare| erAi satyavAdI|

(Ara e sampada tAdera janyao) yArA muhAjiradera AsAra Age thekei (mAdInAha) nagarIra vAsindA chila Ara ImAna grahaNa kareche| tArA tAderake bhAlavAse yArA tAdera kAche hijarAta kare eseche| muhAjiraderake yA deYA haYeche tA pAoYAra janya tArA nijedera antare kona kAmanA rAkhe nA, Ara tAderake (arthAt muhAjiraderake) nijedera upara agrAdhikAra deYa- nijerA yatai abhAvagrasta hoka nA kena| vastuta: yAderake hRdaYera saMkIrNatA theke rakSA karA haYeche tArAi saphalakAma|

(e sampada tAdera janyao) yArA agravartIdera pare (isalAmera chAYAtale) eseche| tArA vale- ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake Ara AmAdera bhAiderake kSamA kara yArA ImAnera kSetre AmAdera agravartI haYeche, Ara yArA ImAna eneche tAdera vyApAre AmAdera antare kona hiMsA vidveSa rekho nA| he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi var3ai karuNAmaYa, ati daYAlu|’

tumi ki tAderake dekhani yArA munAphikI karechila? Ahale kitAvera madhye yArA kuphurI karechila tAdera sei bhAiderake tArA (arthAt munAphikarA) valechila- ‘tomarA yadi vahiskRta hao, tAhale avazya avazyai AmarAo tomAdera sAthe veriYe yAva, Ara tomAdera vyApAre AmarA kakSano kAro kathA mene neva nA| Ara yadi tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karA haYa, tAhale AmarA avazya avazyai tomAderake sAhAyya karava| AllAha sAkSya dicchena, tArA avazyai mithyevAdI|
