tArA vahiskRta haleo erA tAdera sAthe veriYe yAve nA| tAdera upara AkramaNa karA haleo erA tAderake kakSano sAhAyya karave nA| Ara erA sAhAyya karaleo tArA (arthAt munAphikarA) avazya avazyai pRSThapradarzana karave, ataHpara tArA (arthAt kAphirarA) Ara kona sAhAyyai pAve nA|
tAdera antare AllAhara ceYe tomAdera bhaYai vezi pravala| era kAraNa ei ye, tArA eka viveka-vuddhihIna sampradAYa|

tArA aikyavaddha haYe tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karate samartha naYa, surakSita janapade vA deYAlera Ar3Ale avasthAna chAr3A| tAdera nijedera madhyei Ache bhISaNa zatrutA| tumi tAderake aikyavaddha mane kara kintu tAdera antaragulo bhinna bhinna| era kAraNa ei ye, tArA eka nirvodha sampradAYa|
erA tAdera (arthAt iYAhUdI vAnu kAinukAra) mata yArA edera pUrve nikaTavartI samaYei tAdera kRtakarmera kuphala AsvAdana kareche| tAdera janya Ache marmAntika zAsti|

(tAdera mitrarA tAderake pratArita kareche) zaYatvAnera mata| yakhana mAnuSake se vale- ‘kuphurI kara’| ataHpara mAnuSa yakhana kuphurI kare takhana zaYatvAna vale- ‘tomAra sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei, Ami vizvajagatera pratipAlaka AllAhake bhaYa kari|’
kAjei tAdera ubhaYera pariNAma have ei ye, tArA cirakAla jAhAnnAme thAkave, Ara yAlimadera eTAi pratiphala|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| pratyekei cintA kare dekhuka, AgAmIkAlera janya se kI (puNya kAja) agrima pAThiYeche| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, tomarA yA kara AllAha se samparke puropuri khavara rAkhena|
tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA yArA AllAhake bhule geche, phale AllAhao tAderake karechena AtmabholA| erA pApAcArI loka|
jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI Ara jAnnAtera adhivAsI samAna hate pAre nA, jAnnAtera adhivAsIrAi saphala|

Ami yadi e kuraAnake pAhAr3era upara avatIrNa karatAma, tAhale tumi AllAhara bhaYe tAke vinIta o vidIrNa dekhate| e sava udAharaNa Ami mAnuSera janya varNanA kari yAte tArA (nijedera vyApAre) cintA-bhAvanA kare|
tinii AllAha, yini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, adRzya o dRzera jJAnera adhikArI, parama daYAmaYa, parama daYAlu|

tinii AllAha yini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, tinii vAdazAha, ati pavitra, pUrNa zAntimaYa, nirApattA dAnakArI, pratApazAlI, paryavekSaka, mahA parAkramazAlI, apratirodhya, prakRta garvera adhikArI| tArA yAke (tA~ra) zarIka kare tAttheke tini pavitra, mahAna|

tinii AllAha sRSTikArI, udbhAvanakArI, AkAra AkRti pradAnakArI| samasta uttama nAmera adhikArI| AsamAna o yamIne yA Ache savai tA~ra gaurava o mahimA ghoSaNA kare| tini pravala parAkrAnta mahA prajJAvAna|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AmAra o tomAdera zatruderake vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA, tomarA tAdera kAche vandhutvera khavara pAThAo, athaca ye satya tomAdera kAche eseche tArA tA pratyAkhyAna kareche| tArA rasUlake Ara tomAderake zudhu e kAraNe vera kare diYeche ye, tomarA tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAhaYa vizvAsa kara| tomarA yadi AmAra santuSTi kAmanAYa AmAra pathe jihAde vera haYe thAka, tAhale tomarA kena gopane tAdera sAthe vandhutva karacha? tomarA yA gopana kara Ara tomarA yA prakAza kara, tA Ami khuva bhAla karei jAni| tomAdera madhye ye tA kare se sarala patha theke bhraSTa haYe geche|
tArA tomAderake javda karate pAralei zatrura AcaraNa karave, Ara tomAdera aniSTa karAra janya tArA tAdera hAta o mukhera bhASA samprasArita karave Ara tArA cAive ye, tomarAo yena kuphurI kara|
kviYAmatera dina tomAdera AtmIYa-svajana o santAnAdi tomAdera konai upakAre Asave nA| (nija nija ‘AmAlera bhittite) AllAha tomAdera madhye phaYasAlA kare divena; tomarA yA kara AllAha tA dekhena|

ivarAhIma o tAra saGgI-sAthIdera madhye tomAdera janya Ache uttama Adarza| yakhana tArA tAdera sampradAYake valechila- ‘tomAdera saGge Ara AllAhake vAda diYe tomarA yAdera ‘ivAdAta kara tAdera saGge AmAdera kona samparka nei| AmarA tomAderake pratyAkhyAna karachi| AmAdera Ara tomAdera mAjhe cirakAlera janya zatrutA o vidveSa zuru haYe geche yatakSaNa tomarA eka AllAhara prati ImAna nA Anave| tave ivarAhIma ye tAra pitAke valechila- ‘Ami avazya avazyai tomAra janya kSamA prArthanA karava Ara Ami tomAra janya AllAhara kAcha theke kona kichu karArai adhikAra rAkhi nA’’- eTA ekaTA vyatikrama| (Ara ivarAhIma o tAra saGgI sAthIrA prArthanA karechila) ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmarA tomArai upara nirbhara karachi, tomArai abhimukhI hacchi, Ara (sava kichura) pratyAvartana to tomArai pAne|
he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAderake kAphiradera utpIr3anera pAtra karo nA, he AmAdera pratipAlaka! tumi AmAderake kSamA kara, tumi mahA parAkrAnta, mahA vijJAnI|

tomarA yArA AllAha (’ra rahamata) o zeSa divasera (sAphalyera) pratyAzI tAdera janya uttama Adarza raYeche tAdera [arthAt ivarAhIma (AH) tA~ra anusArIdera] madhye| Ara keu mukha phiriYe nile (se jene rAkhuka) AllAha amukhApekSI, prazaMsita|

sambhavata AllAha tomAdera madhye Ara tAdera madhyekAra yAderake tomarA zatru vAniYe niYecha tAdera madhye vandhutva sRSTi kare divena (tAdera musalima haYe yAoYAra mAdhyame)| AllAha var3ai zaktimAna, AllAha ati kSamAzIla, atIva daYAlu|

dInera vyApAre yArA tomAdera sAthe yuddha kareni, Ara tomAderake tomAdera ghara-vAr3I theke vera ka’re deYani tAdera saGge sadaYa vyavahAra karate Ara nyAYaniSTha AcaraNa karate AllAha niSedha karena ni| AllAha nyAYaparAYaNaderake bhAlavAsena|

AllAha tomAderake kevala tAdera saGge vandhutva karate niSedha karechena yArA tomAdera saGge dInera vyApAre yuddha kareche, tomAderake tomAdera ghara-vAr3I theke vera kare diYeche Ara tomAderake vera kare deYAra vyApAre sAhAyya kareche| yArA tAdera saGge vandhutva kare tArAi yAlima|

he mu’minagaNa! ImAnadAra nArIrA yakhana tomAdera kAche hijarAta kare Ase takhana tAderake parakha kare dekha (tArA satyii ImAna eneche ki nA)| tAdera ImAna samvandhe AllAha khuva bhAlabhAvei jAnena| ataHpara tomarA yadi jAnate pAra ye, tArA mu’minA, tAhale tAderake kAphiradera kAche pherata pAThio nA| mu’minA nArIrA kAphiradera janya hAlAla naYa, Ara kAphirarAo mu’minA nArIdera janya hAlAla naYa| kAphira svAmIrA (mohara svarUpa) yA tAdera janya kharaca karechila tA kAphiraderake pherata diYe dAo| ataHpara tomarA tAderake mohara pradAna karataH viYe karale tAte tomAdera kona aparAdha have nA| tomarA kAphira nArIderake (vivAhera) vandhane ATake rekha nA| tomarA (tAdera mohara svarUpa) yA vyaYa karecha tA pherata ceYe nAo, Ara kAphirarAo pherata ceYe nive yA tArA vyaYa kareche (tAdera mu’minA strIdera mohara svarUpa)| eTA AllAhara nirdeza| tini tomAdera mAjhe phaYasAlA kare dena| AllAha sarva jJAnera adhikArI, mahA vijJAnI|

tomAdera strIdera madhye keu yadi (kAphira haoYAra kAraNe tomAdera) hAtachAr3A haYe kAphiradera nikaTa theke yAYa evaM (tAdera kona strIloka tomAdera kAche cale AsAra phale) tomAdera yadi suyoga Ase, takhana (tomAdera madhye) yAdera strIgaNa hAtachAr3A haYe geche tAderake tArA (tAdera strIdera mohara svarUpa) yA vyaYa kareche tAra samaparimANa artha pradAna karave| tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara yAra prati tomarA ImAna enecha|

he navI! yakhana mu’minA nArIrA tomAra kAche ese vAi‘Ata kare ye, tArA AllAhara saGge kona kichuke zarIka karave nA, curi karave nA, yinA karave nA, nijedera santAna hatyA karave nA, jene zune kona apavAda racanA ka’re raTAve nA evaM kona bhAla kAje tomAra avAdhyatA karave nA- tAhale tumi tAdera vAi‘Ata (arthAt tomAra prati Anugatyera zapatha) grahaNa kara evaM tAdera janya AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara; AllAha ati kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA emana sampradAYera saGge vandhutva karo nA AllAha yAdera prati rAgAnvita| tArA parakAla samparke temani nirAza yemana kavaravAsI kAphirarA nirAza (kAraNa tArA parakAlake avizvAsa karAra kAraNe tAra janya kona prastuti grahaNa kareni|)
AsamAne yA kichu Ache Ara yamIne yA kichu Ache (savai) AllAhara prazaMsA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare; tini mahAparAkrAnta mahAvijJAnI|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA emana kathA kena vala yA tomarA kara nA|
AllAhara dRSTite eTA atyanta nindanIYa vyApAra ye, tomarA valave emana kathA yA tomarA kara nA|
AllAha tAderake bhAlavAsena yArA tA~ra pathe sArivaddha haYe yuddha kare- yena tArA sIsA-galAno prAcIra|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mUsA tAra sampradAYake valechila, ‘he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AmAke kena kaSTa diccha, tomarA to jAnai ye, Ami tomAdera nikaTa AllAhara rasUla!’ ataHpara tArA yakhana vA~kA patha dharala, AllAha tAdera hRdaYake vA~kA kare dilena| AllAha pApAcArIderake saThika pathe paricAlita karena nA|

smaraNa kara, yakhana mAraiYAmera putra ‘IsA valechila, ‘he vAnI isarAIla! Ami tomAdera prati AllAhara rasUla, AmAra pUrvavartI tAorAtera Ami satyAYanakArI evaM Ami ekajana rasUlera susaMvAdadAtA yini AmAra pare Asavena, yAra nAma AhamAda|’ ataHpara se [arthAt ‘IsA (AH) yA~ra samparke susaMvAda diYe chilena sei navI] yakhana tAdera kAche suspaSTa nidarzana niYe Asala, takhana tArA valala, ‘eTA to spaSTa yAdu|’

tAra ceYe adhika yAlima Ara ke ye AllAha samvandhe mithye racanA kare- athaca tAke isalAmera patha avalamvana karAra janya AhavAna jAnAno haYa| (e rakama) yAlima sampradAYake AllAha saThika pathe cAlita karena nA|
tArA tAdera mukhera phu~tkAre AllAhara nUrake nibhiYe dite cAYa, kintu AllAha tA~ra nUrake paripUrNa karavenai yadio kAphirarA (tA) apachanda kare|
tinii tA~ra rasUlake hidAYAta o satya dInasaha pAThiYechena tAke sakala dInera upara vijaYI karAra janya- yadio muzarikarA (tA) apachanda kare|
he mu’minagaNa! Ami ki tomAderake emana eka vyavasAYera sandhAna deva yA tomAderake marmAntika ‘AyAva theke rakSA karave?
(tA ei ye) tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati ImAna Ano Ara tomarA tomAdera mAla o jAna diYe AllAhara pathe jihAda kara; eTAi tomAdera janya ati uttama, yadi tomarA jAnate!

(tomarA yadi AllAhara sandhAna deYA vyavasA kara tAhale) tini tomAdera pApa kSamA kare devena Ara tomAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra taladeze jharNAdhArA pravAhita| Ara cirasthAYI AvAsasthala jAnnAte ati uttama ghara tomAderake dAna karavena| eTAi virATa sAphalya|
Ara anya ArekaTio (tini tomAderake divena) yA tomarA pachanda kara (Ara tA hala) AllAhara sAhAyya o Asanna vijaYa| (he navI!) ImAnadAra lokederake tumi susaMvAda dAo|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhara sAhAyyakArI hao, yemana mAraiYAmera putra ‘IsA hAoYArIderake valechila- ‘AllAhara pathe ke AmAra sAhAyyakArI have?’ hAoYArIrA uttare valechila- ‘AmarAi AllAhara sAhAyyakArI (hava)|’ ataHpara vAnI isarAIlera ekadala ImAna Anala, Areka dala pratyAkhyAna karala| takhana yArA ImAna Anala tAderake Ami tAdera zatrudera upara zaktizAlI karalAma| phale tArA vijaYI hala|
yA kichu AsamAne Ache Ara yA kichu yamIne Ache sava kichui prazaMsA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare AllAhara yini sarvamaYa kSamatAra adhikArI, ati pavitra, mahAparAkrAnta, mahAvijJAnI|

tinii nirakSaradera mAjhe pAThiYechena tA~ra rasUlake tAderai madhya hate, ye tAdera kAche AllAhara AYAta pATha kare, tAderake pavitra kare, Ara tAderake kitAva o hikamata zikSA deYa athaca itopUrve tArA chila spaSTa gumarAhIte nimajjita|
Ara (ei rasUlake pAThAno haYeche) tAdera anyAnyadera janyao yArA ekhanao tAdera sAthe milita haYani (kintu tArA bhaviSyate Asave)| AllAha mahAparAkrAnta, mahAvijJAnI|
oTA AllAhara anugraha yA tini yAke icche dAna karena; AllAha mahA anugrahera adhikArI|

yAdera upara tAorAtera dAYitvabhAra deYA haYechila, ataHpara tA tArA vahana kareni (arthAt tArA tAdera upara nyasta dAYitva pAlana kareni) tAdera dRSTAnta hala gAdhAra mata, ye vahu kitAvera vojhA vahana kare (kintu tA vujhe nA)| ye sampradAYa AllAhara AYAtaguloke asvIkAra kare, tAdera dRSTAnta katainA nikRSTa! yAlima sampradAYake AllAha saThika pathe paricAlita karena nA|
vala- ‘he iYAhUdI haYe yAoYA lokerA! tomarA yadi mane kara ye, anya sava lokake vAda diYe kevala tomarAi AllAhara vandhu, tAhale tomarA mRtyu kAmanA kara, yadi tomarA satyavAdI haYe thAko|
kintu tAdera hAta ye sava (kRtakarma) Age pAThiYeche, se kAraNe tArA kakSano mRtyura kAmanA karave nA| Ara AllAha yAlimaderake khuva bhAla karei jAnena|

vala- ‘tomarA ye mRtyu theke pAlAccha tA avazyai tomAdera sAthe sAkSAt karave| ataHpara tomAderake dRzya o adRzyera jJAnera adhikArI (AllAha)’ra nikaTa phiriYe neYA have; ataHpara tomAderake jAniYe deYA have yA tomarA karate|
he mu’minagaNa! jumu‘Ahara dine yakhana nAmAyera janya DAkA haYa, takhana AllAhara smaraNera dike zIghra dhAvita hao, kraYa-vikraYa parityAga kara, eTAi tomAdera janya ati uttama, yadi tomarA jAnate!
ataHpara yakhana nAmAya samApta haYa, takhana yamIne char3iYe par3a, Ara AllAhara anugraha sandhAna kara evaM AllAhake vezi vezi smaraNa karate thAka- yAte tomarA sAphalya lAbha karate pAra|

tArA yakhana vyavasAYa athavA krIr3A kautuka dekhe takhana tArA sedike chuTe yAYa Ara tomAke rekhe yAYa dA~r3Ano avasthAYa| vala- ‘AllAhara kAche yA Ache tA krIr3A-kautuka o vyavasAra ceYe uttama|’ Ara AllAha sarvApekSA uttama riyakadAtA|

munAphikarA yakhana tomAra kAche Ase takhana tArA vale- ‘AmarA sAkSya dicchi ye, Apani avazyai AllAhara rasUla|’ AllAha jAnena, avazyai tumi tA~ra rasUla Ara AllAha sAkSya dicchena ye, munAphikarA avazyai mithyevAdI|
tArA tAdera zapathaguloke DhAla hiseve vyavahAra kare Ara e upAYe tArA mAnuSake AllAhara patha theke nivRtta kare| tArA yA kare tA katai nA manda!
tAra kAraNa ei ye, tArA ImAna Ane, ataHpara kuphurI kare| ejanya tAdera antare mohara lAgiYe deYA haYeche| yAra phale tArA kichui vujhe nA

tumi yakhana tAdera dike tAkAo takhana tAdera zArIrika gaThana tomAke camatkRta kare| Ara yakhana tArA kathA vale takhana tumi tAdera kathA Agraha bhare zuna, athaca tArA deYAle Thesa deYA kAThera mata (dekhana- surata, kinta kAryakSetre kichui nA)| kona zoragola halei tArA seTAke nijedera viruddhe mane kare (kAraNa tAdera aparAdhI mana sava samaYe zaGkita thAke- ei vujhi tAdera kukIrti phA~sa haYe gela)| erAi zatru, kAjei tAdera vyApAre satarka thAka| edera upara Ache AllAhara gayava, tAderake kIbhAve (satya patha theke) phiriYe neYA hacche!
tAderake yakhana valA haYa, ‘eso, AllAhara rasUla tomAdera janya kSamA prArthanA karavena, takhana tArA mAthA ner3e asvIkRti jAnAYa, takhana tumi dekhate pAo tArA sadambhe tAdera mukha phiriYe neYa|
tumi tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kara Ara nA kara, ubhaYai tAdera janya samAna| AllAha tAderake kakSano kSamA karavena nA| AllAha pApAcArI jAtike kakSano saThika pathe paricAlita karena nA|
tArA vale- ‘rasUlera saGgI sAthIdera janya artha vyaYa karo nA, zeSe tArA emanitei sare par3ave|’ AsamAna o yamInera dhana bhAnDAra to AllAharai, kintu munAphikarA tA vujhe nA|

tArA vale- ‘AmarA yadi mAdInAYa pratyAvartana kari, tAhale sammAnIrA avazya avazyai hInaderake sekhAne theke vahiSkAra karave|’ kintu samasta mAna maryAdA to AllAhara, tA~ra rasUlera evaM mu’minadera; kintu munAphikarA tA jAne nA|
he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera dhana-sampada Ara tomAdera santAnAdi tomAderake yena AllAhara smaraNa hate gAphila kare nA deYa| yArA emana karave tArAi kSatigrasta|

ye riyaka Ami tomAderake diYechi tAttheke (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kara tomAdera kAro mRtyu AsAra pUrve| nacet (mRtyu ese gele) se valave, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAke Aro kichukAlera avakAza dile nA kena? tAhale Ami sadAkvAha karatAma Ara satkarmazIladera madhye zAmila haYe yetAma|’
AllAha kAuke kakSano avakAza dena nA yakhana tAra nirdhArita samaYa ese yAYa| tomarA yA kara se samparke AllAha puropuri khavara rAkhena|
yA kichu AsamAne Ache Ara yA kichu yamIne Ache savai AllAhara prazaMsA o mahimA ghoSaNA karache| rAjatva tA~rai, prazaMsA tA~rai, Ara tini sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tomAdera madhye keu kAphira, keu mu’mina; tomarA yA kara AllAha tA dekhena|
tini (vizeSa uddezye) satyikArabhAve AsamAna o yamIna sRSTi karechena, tini tomAderake AkRti diYechena, ataHpara tomAdera AkRti sundara karechena Ara (savvAike) phire yete have tA~rai dike|
tini jAnena yA kichu AsamAna o yamIne Ache, Ara tini jAnena yA tomarA gopana kara Ara prakAza kara| antarera viSaYAdi samparke tini pUrNarUpe avagata|
itopUrve yArA kupharI karechila tAdera khavara ki tomAra kAche pau~cheche? tArA tAdera manda karmera phala AsvAdana kareche, Ara tAdera janya Ache marmAntika ‘AyAva|

era kAraNa ei ye, tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa spaSTa nidarzanasaha esechila, takhana tArA valechila, ‘(AmAdera matai) mAnuSa ki AmAderake saThika patha dekhAve?’ kAjei tArA asvIkAra karala Ara mukha phiriYe nila| takhana AllAhao tAdera vyApAre veparoYA haYe gelena, AllAha amukhApekSI, prazaMsita|

kAphirarA dhAraNA kare ye, tAderake kakSano AvAra jIvita kare uThAno have nA| vala, nizcaYai (uThAno) have, AmAra pratipAlakera zapatha! tomAderake avazya avazyai AvAra jIvita kare uThAno have, ataHpara tomAderake avazya avazyai jAniYe deYA have tomarA (duniYAYa) kI kAja karecha| e kAja (karA) AllAhara janya khuvai sahaja|

kAjei (e avasthAra kathA cintA ka’re) tomarA ImAna Ano AllAhara prati o tA~ra rasUlera prati Ara sei nUra (kuraAna)-era prati yA Ami avatIrNa karechi| tomarA yA kara se vyApAre AllAha puropuri avagata|

yakhana ekatra karAra dina tini tomAderake ekatrita karavena, se dinaTi have tomAdera hAra jitera dina| yArA AllAhara prati ImAna Anave Ara sat kAja karave, AllAha tAra pApa mocana kare divena, Ara tAke jAnnAte dAkhila karavena yAra nIca diYe nirjhariNI pravAhita| sekhAne tArA thAkave cirakAla sarvakAla| eTAi mahA sAphalya|
Ara yArA kuphurI kare Ara AmAra nidarzanaguloke asvIkAra kare, tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave| katai nA nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala!
AllAhara anumati chAr3A kona vipada Ase nA| ye vyakti AllAhara prati ImAna Ane, AllAha tAra antarake saThika pathe paricAlita karena| AllAha sakala viSaYera sarvazreSTha jJAnI|

tomarA AllAhara Anugatya kara o rasUlera Anugatya kara| ataHpara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe lao (tAhale tomAderake saThika pathe phiriYe AnAra janya jora javaradasti karA have nA) kenanA, AmAra rasUlera dAYitva kevala (AmAra vANI) spaSTabhAve pau~che deYA|
AllAha tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei| kAjei mu’minarA AllAharai upara nirbhara karuka|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera strI Ara santAnadera madhye kataka tomAdera zatru| kAjei tomarA tAdera hate satarka hao| tomarA yadi tAdera prati kSamAsulabha AcaraNa kara, tAdera doSa-truTi upekSA kara, Ara tAderake kSamA kara, tAhale (tomAdera se kAja have AllAhara nikaTa pachandIYa kAraNa) AllAha ati kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|

tomAdera dhana-sampada Ara santAnAdi parIkSA (’ra vastu) mAtra (yArA e du’Tike saThikabhAve vyavahAra ka’re AllAhara pathe aTala thAkave tArA kRtakArya have, Ara yArA e du’Tike AllAhara ceYe adhika bhAlavAsave tArA vyartha haYe yAve)| Ara AllAha emana yA~ra kAche Ache mahA puraskAra|

kAjei tomarA AllAhake tomAdera sAdhyamata bhaYa kara, tomarA (tA~ra vANI) zuna, tomarA (tA~ra) Anugatya kara evaM (tA~ra pathe) vyaYa kara, eTA tomAdera nijederai janya kalyANakara| yArA antarera saMkIrNatA theke rakSA pela, tArAi saphalakAma|
tomarA yadi AllAhake uttama RNa dAo, tave tini tA tomAdera janya dviguNa kare devena, Ara tomAderake kSamA karavena, AllAha (kAro kAjera) ati maryAdAdAnakArI, sahanazIla|
tini adRzya o dRzyera jJAnera adhikArI, mahAparAkrAnta, mahAvijJAnI|

he navI! tomarA yakhana strIderake tAlAka dite cAo takhana tAderake tAlAka dAo tAdera ‘iddAtera prati lakSya rekhe, Ara ‘iddAtera hisAva saThikabhAve gaNanA karave, (tAlAka deYA o ‘iddAta pAlana saMkrAnta zArI‘Atera vidhi-vidhAna pAlane) tomarA tomAdera pratipAlaka AllAhake bhaYa kara| tAderake tAdera vAsagRha theke vera kare dio nA, Ara tArA nijerAo yena vera haYe nA yAYa, yadi nA tArA spaSTa azlIlatAYa lipta haYa| egulo AllAhara sImArekhA| ye keu AllAhara sImArekhA laGghana kare, se nijera uparai yulama kare| tomarA jAna nA, AllAha haYato eraparao (svAmI-strIra madhye samajhotAra) kona upAYa vera kare divena|

ataHpara yakhana tAdera (‘iddAtera) samaYakAla ese yAYa, takhana tAderake bhAlabhAve (strI hiseve) rekhe dAo, athavA bhAlabhAve tAderake vicchinna kare dAo| Ara tomAdera madhyekAra du’jana nyAYaparAYaNa lokake sAkSI rAkha| tomarA AllAhara janya saThikabhAve sAkSya dAo| era dvArA tomAderake upadeza deYA hacche yArA AllAha o AkhirAta divasera prati ImAna rAkhe| ye keu AllAhake bhaYa kare, AllAha tAra janya (samasyA theke uddhAra pAoYAra) kona nA kona patha vera kare divena|

Ara tAke riyaka divena (emana utsa) theke yA se dhAraNAo karate pAre nA| ye keu AllAhara upara bharasA kare, tave tAra janya tinii yatheSTa| AllAha nijera kAja sampUrNa karavenai| AllAha pratiTi jinisera janya karechena ekaTA sunirdiSTa mAtrA|

tomAdera ye sava strIgaNa mAsika Rtu AsAra vaYasa atikrama kareche tAdera (‘iddAtera) vyApAre yadi tomAdera sandeha sRSTi haYa, sekSetre tAdera ‘iddAtakAla tina mAsa, Ara yArA (alpa vaYaskA haoYAra kAraNe) ekhanao RtuvatI haYani (e niYama) tAdera janyao| Ara garbhavatI strIdera ‘iddAtakAla tAdera santAna prasava paryanta| ye AllAhake bhaYa kare, AllAha tAra kAja sahaja kare dena|
eTA AllAhara hukuma yA tini tomAdera upara avatIrNa karechena| ye keu AllAhake bhaYa kare, AllAha tAra pApa mocana kare divena, Ara tAra pratiphalake vizAla vistRta kare divena|

(‘iddAtakAle) nArIderake sebhAvei vasavAsa karate dAo yebhAve tomarA vasavAsa kara tomAdera sAmarthya anuyAYI, tAderake saMkaTe phelAra janya tAderake jvAlAtana karo nA| tArA yadi garbhavatI haYe thAke, tave tArA santAna prasava nA karA paryanta tAdera vyaYabhAra vahana kara| ataHpara tArA yadi tomAdera santAnake dudha pAna karAYa, tave tAderake tAdera pArizramika dAo| (dudha pAna karAnora vyApAre) nyAYasaGgatabhAve nijedera madhye parAmarza kare lao| Ara (dudha pAna karAnora vyApAra niYe) tomarA yadi eke aparera prati kar3Akar3i karatei thAka, tAhale (e avasthA theke rehAi pAoYAra janya) apara kona strIloka santAnake dudha pAna karAve|

sacchala vyakti tAra sacchalatA anusAre vyaYa karave| Ara yAra riyaka sImita karA haYeche, se vyaYa karave AllAha tAke yA diYechena tAttheke| AllAha yAke yataTA diYechena tAra atirikta vojhA tAra upara cApAna nA| AllAha kaSTera para ArAma divena|
kata janapada tAdera pratipAlakera Ara tA~ra rasUladera hukuma amAnya kareche| phale AmarA tAdera theke kaThinabhAve pratizodha niYechi Ara tAderake ‘AyAva diYechi kaThina ‘AyAva|
tArA tAdera kRtakarmera khArApa pratiphala AsvAdana karala, dhvaMsai hala tAdera kAjera pariNati|
AllAha tAdera janya kaThina zAsti prastuta kare rekhechena| ataeva he jJAnavuddhisampanna mAnuSerA! yArA ImAna enecha tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| AllAha tomAdera prati avatIrNa karechena upadeza|

(tadupari tini pAThiYechena) ekajana rasUla ye tomAdera kAche AllAhara spaSTa AYAta pATha kare, yArA ImAna Ane Ara sat kAja kare tAderake gAr3ha andhakAra theke Alote AnAra janya| Ara ye vyakti AllAhara prati ImAna Anave Ara sat kAja karave, tini tAke dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra nIca diYe vaYe caleche nirjhariNI| tAte tArA cirakAla sarvakAla thAkave| AllAha tAra janya ati uttama riyakera vyavasthA kare rekhechena|

AllAhai sAta AsamAna vAniYechena Ara ogulora mata pRthivIo, savagulora mAjhe (arthAt sakala AsamAne Ara sakala yamIne) neme Ase AllAhara nirdeza yAte tomarA jAnate pAra ye, AllAha sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna Ara AllAha (svIYa) jJAne sava kichuke ghire rekhechena|

he navI! AllAha yA tomAra janya hAlAla karechena tA tumi kena hArAma karacha? (era dvArA) tumi tomAra strIdera santuSTi pete cAo, (AllAha tomAra e truTi kSamA kare dilena kenanA) AllAha ati kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|
AllAha tomAdera janya nijedera kasamera vAdhyavAdhakatA theke niskRti pAoYAra vyavasthA karechena, AllAha tomAdera mAlika-maniva-rakSaka, Ara tini sarvajJAtA, mahA prajJAra adhikArI|

smaraNa kara- yakhana navI tAra strIdera kona ekajanake gopane ekaTi kathA valechila| ataHpara se strI yakhana tA (anya ekajanake) jAniYe dila, takhana AllAha e vyApAraTi navIke jAniYe dilena| takhana navI (tAra strIra kAche) kichu kathAra ullekha karala Ara kichu kathA cher3e dila| navI yakhana tA tAra strIke jAnAla takhana se valala, ‘ApanAke eTA ke jAniYe dila?’’ navI valala, ‘‘AmAke jAniYe dilena yini sarvajJAtA, oYAkiphahAla|’’

tomarA du’jana yadi anuzocanAbhare AllAhara dike phire Asa (tave tA tomAdera janya uttama), tomAdera antara (anyAYera dike) jhu~ke par3eche, tomarA yadi navIra viruddhe eke aparake sahayogitA kara, tave (jene rekha) AllAha tAra mAlika-maniva-rakSaka| Ara e chAr3Ao jivarIla, nekakAra mu’minagaNa Ara pherezatAgaNao tAra sAhAyyakArI|

navI yadi tomAdera savAike tAlAka diYe deYa tave sambhavataH tAra pratipAlaka tomAdera parivarte tAke divena tomAdera ceYe uttama strI- yArA have AtmasamaparNakAriNI mu’minA anugatA, tAovAhakAriNI, ‘ivAdAtakAriNI, royA pAlanakAriNI, akumArI o kumArI|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA tomAdera nijederake Ara tomAdera parivAra-parijanake jAhAnnAmera Aguna theke rakSA kara yAra indhana have mAnuSa o pAthara, yAte motAYena Ache pASANa hRdaYa kaThora svabhAva pherezatA| AllAha yA Adeza karena, tA tArA amAnya kare nA, Ara tArA tAi kare, tAderake yA karAra janya Adeza deYA haYa|
(sekhAne valA have) ohe yArA kuphurI karecha! Aja oyara peza karo nA, tomarA yA karate tomAderake tArai pratiphala deYA have|

ohe yArA ImAna enecha! tomarA AllAhara kAche tAovAha kara- Antarika tAovAha| sambhavataH tomAdera pratipAlaka tomAdera manda kAjaguloke tomAdera theke muche divena, Ara tomAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra taladeza diYe vaYe caleche jharNAdhArA| se dina AllAha navIke Ara tAra saGge yArA ImAna enechila tAderake lajjita karavena nA| (sedinera bhaYAvaha andhakAra theke mu’minadera rakSAra vyavasthA hiseve) tAdera nUra daur3Ate thAkave tAdera sAmane Ara tAdera DAna pAze| tArA valave, ‘he AmAdera pratipAlaka! AmAdera nUrake AmAdera janya paripUrNa kare dAo Ara AmAderake kSamA kara; tumi sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|’
he navI! kAphira o munAphikadera viruddhe jihAda kara, tAdera prati kaThora hao| tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma, katai nA nikRSTa sei pratyAvartanasthala!

yArA kuphurIra nIti avalamvana kare tAdera vyApAre AllAha nUhera strI Ara lUtera strIra dRSTAnta peza karachena| erA chila AmAra du’nekakAra vAndAra adhIne| kintu tArA du’janei tAdera svAmIdvaYera prati vizvAsaghAtakatA karechila| phale nUha o lUta tAderake AllAhara zAsti theke rakSA karate pArala nA| tAderake valA hala, ‘‘tomarA du’jana jAhAnnAme praveza kara (anyAnya) pravezakArIdera saGge|’’

Ara yArA ImAna Ane tAdera vyApAre AllAha pherAunera strIra dRSTAnta dicchena| se prArthanA karechila, ‘‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tumi AmAra janya tomAra nikaTa jAnnAte ekaTi ghara vAniYe dAo Ara AmAke tumi pherAuna o tAra (anyAYa) kAryakalApa theke rakSA kara, uddhAra kara AmAke yAlima sampradAYa theke|’’

Ara (dRSTAnta dicchena) ‘imarAna-kanyA mAraiYAmera ye tAra lajjAsthAna saMrakSaNa karechila, phale Ami tAra madhye AmAra rUha phu~ke diYechilAma| se tAra pratipAlakera vANI o tA~ra kitAvasamUhe (tAorAta, yavUra o iJjIle) vizvAsa sthApana karechila| se chila anugata o vinatadera antarbhukta|
ati mahAna o zreSTha tini, sarvamaYa kartRtva o rAjatva yA~ra hAte; tini sava kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
yini sRSTi karechena maraNa o jIvana yAte tomAderake parIkSA karena- ‘AmAlera dika diYe tomAdera madhye kon vyakti sarvottama? tini (ekadike yemana) mahA zaktidhara, (AvAra anyadike) ati kSamAzIla|
yini sRSTi karechena sAta AsamAna- ekaTira upara ArekaTi| tomarA mahA daYAmaYera sRSTikArye konarUpa asAmaJjasya dekhate pAve nA| tomarA AvAra dRSTi phiriYe dekha, kona doSa-truTi dekhate pAo ki?
ataHpara tomarA vAravAra dRSTi phiriYe dekha; klAnta, zrAnta o vyartha haYe dRSTi tomAra dike phire Asave|
Ami nikaTavartI AkAzake pradIpamAlA diYe susajjita karechi Ara zaYatvAnake tAr3iYe deYAra janya, evaM prastuta kare rekhechi jvalanta Agunera zAsti|
yArA tAdera pratipAlakake asvIkAra kare tAdera janya Ache jAhAnnAmera zAsti; katai nA nikRSTa se pratyAvartanasthala!
tAderake yakhana tAte nikSepa karA have takhana tArA jAhAnnAmera zvAsa grahaNera (bhaYAvaha) garjana zunate pAve Ara tA have udvelita|
krodhe Akroze jAhAnnAma pheTe par3Ara upakrama have| yakhanai kona dalake tAte phelA have takhana tAra rakSIrA tAderake jijJesa karave, ‘tomAdera kAche ki kona satarkakArI Aseni?’

tArA javAva dive, ‘hyA~, avazyai AmAdera kAche satarkakArI esechila, kintu AmarA tAderake asvIkAra karechilAma Ara AmarA valechilAma, ‘AllAha kona kichui avatIrNa karenani, tomarA to ghora vibhrAntite par3e Acha|’
tArA Aro valave, ‘AmarA yadi zunatAma athavA vujhatAma tAhale AmarA jvalanta Agunera vAsindAdera madhye zAmila hatAma nA|
tArA tAdera aparAdha svIkAra karave, ataeva dUra hoka jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIrA!
yArA tAdera pratipAlake nA dekhei bhaYa kare tAdera janya Ache kSamA Ara mahA puraskAra|
tomarA tomAdera kathA cupecApei vala Ara uccaiHsvarei vala, tini (mAnuSera) antarera gopana kathA samparke puropuri avagata|
yini sRSTi karechena tinii ki jAnena nA? tini ati sUkSmadarzI, oYAkiphahAla|

tini tomAdera janya yamInake (tomAdera icchAra) adhIna kare diYechena, kAjei tomarA tAra vukera upara diYe calAcala kara, Ara AllAhara deYA riyaka hate AhAra kara, punarAYa jIvita haYe tA~ra kAchei yete have|
tomarA ki tomAderake nirApada mane kare niYecha ye, yini AkAze Achena tini tomAderake yamIne vidhvasta kare divena nA yakhana tA haThAt thara thara kare kA~pate thAkave?
kiMvA tomarA ki nirApada haYe gecha ye, yini AkAze Achena tini tomAdera upara pAthara varSaNakArI jhar3o hAoYA pAThAvena nA? yAte tomarA jAnate pArave ye, kemana (bhaYAnaka) chila AmAra satarkavANI|
tAdera Agera lokerAo (AmAra satarkavANI) pratyAkhyAna karechila, phale kemana (kaThora) haYechila AmAra zAsti!
tArA ki tAdera upara dike pAkhIgulora prati lakSya kare nA yArA DAnA mele deYa AvAra guTiYe neYa? daYAmaYa chAr3A anya keui tAderake (upare) dhare rAkhe nA| tini savakichura samyaka draSTA|
daYAmaYa chAr3A ke tomAderake sAhAyya karave tomAdera senAvAhinI haYe? kAphirarA to kevala dho~kAra madhye par3e Ache|
athavA emana ke Ache ye tomAderake riyaka dive yadi tini tA~ra riyaka vandha kare dena? Asale tArA ahamikA o anIhAYa Duve Ache|
ye loka upur3a haYe mukhera bhare cale sei ki adhika satpathaprApta, nA sei loka ye sojA haYe sarala saThika pathe cale?
vale dAo, ‘tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena Ara tomAderake diYechena zonAra o dekhAra zakti Ara antaHkaraNa; tomarA zokara AdAYa khuva alpai kare thAka|’
vale dAo, ‘tinii tomAderake yamIne char3iYe diYechena Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake samaveta karA have|
tArA vale, ‘tomarA yadi satyavAdI haYei thAka tAhale vala (kviYAmata saMghaTita haoYAra) o‘YAdA kakhana (vAstavAYita have)?
vala, ‘se jJAna to kevala AllAhara kAchei Ache, Ami zudhu ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI|

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAke (arthAt kviYAmatake) nikaTe upasthita dekhate pAve, takhana kAphiradera mukha malina haYe yAve, Ara (tAderake) valA have, ‘ei to (o‘YAdA vAstavAYita haYeche) yA tomarA cAcchile|’

vala, ‘‘tomarA bheve dekhecha ki AllAha yadi AmAke Ara AmAra saGgI sAthIderake dhvaMsa kare dena athavA AmAdera upara daYA karena (tAte tomAdera lAbhaTA kI?) marmAntika zAsti theke kAphiderake vA~cAve ke?
vala, ‘tinii daYAmaYa, AmarA tA~ra uparei ImAna rAkhi, Ara tA~ra uparei nirbhara kari| tomarA zIghrai jAnate pArave ke suspaSTa gumarAhIte Ache (AmarA nA tomarA)|’
vala, ‘‘tomarA bheve dekhecha ki yadi tomAdera pAni bhUgarbhera taladeze cale yAYa, tAhale tomAderake ke ene deve pravahamAna pAni?’’
nUna, kalamera zapatha Ara lekhakerA yA lekhe tAra zapatha|
tomAra pratipAlakera anugrahe tumi pAgala nao|
tomAra janya avazyai Ache aphuranta puraskAra,
nizcaYai tumi mahAna caritrera uccamArge unnIta|
zIghrai tumi dekhate pAve Ara tArAo dekhave,
tomAdera madhye ke pAgalAmite AkrAnta|
tomAra pratipAlaka vezi jAnena ke tA~ra patha theke gumarAha haYe geche, Ara saThika pathaprAptaderakeo tini bhAla kare jAnena|
kAjei tumi mithyAvAdIdera kathA mAnya kara nA|
tArA cAYa ye, tumi yadi namanIYa hao, tave tArAo namanIYa have,
tumi tAra anusaraNa kara nA, ye vezi vezi kasama khAYa Ara ye (vAra vAra mithyA kasama khAoYAra kAraNe mAnuSera kAche) lAJchita|
ye pazcAte nindA kare ekera kathA aparera kAche lAgiYe phire,
ye bhAla kAje vAdhA deYa, sImAlaGghanakArI, pApiSTha,
kaThora svabhAva, tAra upare AvAra kukhyAta|
kAraNa se sampada Ara (aneka) santAnAdira adhikArI|
tAra kAche yakhana AmAra AYAta pATha karA haYa takhana se vale, ‘‘eto Age kAlera lokedera kisasA kAhinI mAtra|
Ami tAra zu~r3era upara dAga diYe diva (arthAt tAke lAJchita karava)|

Ami ederake (arthAt makkAvAsIderake) parIkSA karechi yemana Ami vAgAnera mAlikaderake parIkSA karechilAma| yakhana tArA kasama kare valechila ye, tArA sakAla velAYa avazyai vAgAnera phala saMgraha kare neve|
tArA ‘inazAAllAha’ valeni|
ataHpara tomAra pratipAlakera pakSa theke vAgAne eka vipada ese par3ala yakhana tArA chila nidrita|
yAra phale tA haYe gela vivarNa kATA phasalera mata|
sakAle eke aparake Deke valala,
‘tomarA yadi phala saMgraha karate cAo tave sakAla sakAla kSete cala|
tArA cupi cupi kathA valate valate calala|
‘Aja yena sekhAne tomAdera kAche misakInarA avazyai Dhukate nA pAre|’
tArA eka (anyAYa) siddhAnte saMkalpavaddha haYe sakAla karala|
ataHpara tArA yakhana vAgAnaTi dekhala takhana tArA valala, ‘‘AmarA avazyai patha hAriYe phelechi,
(ataHpara vyApAraTi vujhate pArAra para tArA vale uThala) varaM AmarA to kapAla por3A|’’
tAdera madhyekAra savaceYe bhAla lokaTi valala, ‘Ami ki tomAderake valini ye, tomarA AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karacha nA kena?’
tArA valala, ‘AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karachi, AmarA sImAlaGghanakArIi chilAma|’
ataHpara tArA eke aparera dike egiYe giYe parasparera prati doSAropa karate lAgala|
tArA valala, ‘durbhoga AmAdera, AmarA chilAma sImAlaGghanakArI,
sambhavataH AmAdera pratipAlaka era parivarte AmAderake uttama (vAgAna) divena, AmarA AmAdera pratipAlakera abhimukhI halAma|’
‘AyAva e rakamai haYe thAke| Ara AkhirAtera ‘AyAva to savaceYe kaThina| yadi tArA jAnata!
muttAkvIdera janya tAdera pratipAlakera nikaTa Ache ni‘mAte paripUrNa jAnnAta|
Ami ki AtmasamarpaNakArIderake aparAdhIdera mata gaNya karava?
tomAdera kI haYeche, tomarA kemanabhAve vicAra kare siddhAnta diccha?
tomAdera kAche ki (AllAhara nAyilakRta) kona kitAva Ache yA par3e tomarA jAnate pAra ye,
tomAdera janya sekhAne tAi Ache yA tomarA pachanda kara?
athavA tomAdera janya AmAra upara ki kviYAmata paryanta valavat kona dAYavaddhatA Ache ye, tomarA yA dAvI karave tAi pAve?
tumi tAderake jijJesa kara (AllAha ye tAdera saGge pratizrutite dAYavaddha) e vyApAre tAdera madhye kon vyakti jAminadAra (gyArAnTara)?
athavA tAdera ki zarIka upAsya Ache, thAkale tAdera zarIka upAsyaderake hAjira karuka- tArA yadi satyavAdI haYe thAke|
yedina (kviYAmate) pAYera gochA (hA~Tura nimnabhAga) unmocita have Ara tAderake DAkA have sejadA karAra janya, kintu tArA sejadA karate sakSama have nA|
tAdera dRSTi have avanata, apamAna lAJchanA tAdera upara cepe vasave| (duniYAte) tArA yakhana sustha o nirApada chila takhanao tAderake sejadA karAra janya DAkA hata (kintu tArA sejadA karata nA)
kAjei cher3e dAo AmAke Ara tAderake yArA e vANIke asvIkAra kareche| Ami tAderake krame krame Aste Aste emanabhAve dhare TAna diva ye, tArA ekaTu Terao pAve nA|
Ami tAderake (lamvA) samaYa dei, AmAra kauzala var3ai majavuta|
tumi ki tAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAccha ye, denAra dAYabhAra vahana karA tAdera janya kaThina haYe par3eche?
nAki tAdera kAche gAYavera khavara Ache yA tA tArA likhe rAkhe|

kAjei tumi tomAra pratipAlakera hukumera janya dhairya dhare apekSA kara, Ara mAchaoYAlA [iunusa (AH)] era mata (adhairya) haYo nA| smaraNa kara yakhana se (tAra pratipAlakake DAka diYechila cintAYa duHkhe Acchanna haYe|
tAra pratipAlakera anugraha yadi tAra kAche nA pau~chata, tAhale se lAJchita avasthAYa dhu~dhu~ vAlukAmaYa tIre nikSipta hata|
ebhAve tAra pratipAlaka tAke veche nilena Ara tAke satkarmazIladera antarbhukta karalena|
kAphirarA yakhana kuraAna zune takhana tArA yena tAdera dRSTi diYe tomAke Achar3e phelave| Ara tArA vale, ‘‘se to avazyai pAgala|’’
athaca e kuraAna vizvajagatera janya upadeza chAr3A anya kichui naYa|
nizcita saMghaTitavya viSaYa,
kI sei nizcita saMghaTitavya viSaYa?
Ara tumi ki jAna kI sei nizcita saMghaTitavya viSaYa?
‘Ada o sAmUda jAti sei AkasmikabhAve saMghaTitavya mahAvipadake mithye valechila|
ataHpara sAmUda jAtike dhvaMsa karA haYechila eka pralaYaMkara viparyaYa diYe|
Ara ‘Adake dhvaMsa karA haYechila eka pracanDa jhar3o hAoYA diYe|
yA tAdera upara pravAhita haYechila sAta rAta ATa dina virAmahInabhAve, tumi dekhate tArA par3e Ache itastata vikSipta, yena tArA purAtana zukano khejura gAchera kAnDa|
tumi tAdera kAuke rakSA peYe ve~ce thAkate dekhacha ki?
pherAuna Ara tAra pUrvavartIrA Ara ulTe deYA janapadavAsIrA gurutara pApe lipta chila|
tArA tAdera pratipAlakera rasUlake amAnya karechila, takhana tini tAderake pAkar3Ao karalena- atyanta kaThina pAkar3Ao|
(nUhera vAnera) pAni yakhana kUla chApiYe sImA chAr3iYe gela, takhana Ami tomAderake calanta nauyAne ArohaNa karAlAma|
yena e ghaTanATike Ami tomAdera janya zikSAprada-smAraka kare rAkhi Ara saMrakSaNakArI kAna tA saMrakSaNa kare|
ataHpara yakhana siGgAYa phu~tkAra deYA have- mAtra ekaTi phu~tkAra|
pRthivI Ara parvatamAlA utkSipta have Ara ekai AghAte tAderake cUrNa vicUrNa karA have|
sedina ghaTave sei saMghaTitavya (mahA) ghaTanA|
AkAza haYe yAve dIrNa vidIrNa Ara sedina tA have vA~dhana-hArA-vikSipta|
pherezatArA thAkave AkAzera Aze pAze| ATajana pherezatA sedina tomAra pratipAlakera ‘Araza nijedera Urdhve vahana karave|
sedina tomAderake (vicArera janya) hAjira karA have Ara tomAdera kona kAjai- yA tomarA gopana kara- gopana thAkave nA|
takhana yAke tAra ‘AmAlanAmA tAra DAna hAte deYA have se valave, ‘ei ye AmAra ‘AmAlAnAmA par3e dekha,
Ami jAnatAma ye, AmAke AmAra hisAvera sammukhIna hate have|’
ataHpara se AnandamaYa jIvana yApana karave,
uccatama maryAdAra jAnnAte,
tAra phalasamUha (jhule thAkave) nIce-nAgAlera madhye|
(tAderake valA have) paripUrNa tRptira saGge khAo evaM pAna kara vigata dine tomarA yA (neka ‘AmAla) karechile tAra pratidAna svarUpa|
kintu yAra ‘AmAlanAmA vAma hAte deYA have se valave, ‘hAYa! AmAke yadi AmAra ‘AmAlanAmA nA deYA hata,
Ara AmAra hisAva kI tA yadi Ami nA-i jAnatAma,
‘hAYa! (duniYAra) mRtyui yadi AmAra zeSa (avasthA) hata!
AmAra dhana-sampada AmAra kona kAje Asala nA,
AmAra (sava) kSamatA Adhipatya niHzeSa haYe geche,
(takhana nirdeza Asave) dhara oke, ora galAYa phA~sa lAgiYe dAo,
tArapara chur3e phela oke jAhAnnAme,
tArapara oke zikala diYe vA~dha- sattara hAta dIrgha eka zikale,
se mahAna AllAhara upara ImAna Aneni,
Ara nA se misakInake khAvAra khAoYAte utsAha dita,
kAjei Aja ekhAne tAra kona vandhu nei,
kSata hate par3A pu~ja chAr3A kona khAdya nei,
yA aparAdhIrA chAr3A anya keu khAYa nA|
Ami kasama karachi se sava jinisera yA tomarA dekhate pAo,
Ara (se sava jiniserao) yA tomarA dekhate pAo nA
ye, avazyai e kuraAna eka mahA sammAnita rasUla [jivarIla (AH)]-era (vahana kare AnA) vANI|
tA kona kavira kathA naYa, (kavira kathA to) tomarA vizvAsa karo nA,
eTA kona gaNakera kathAo naYa, (gaNakera kathAYa to) tomarA nasIhata lAbha karo nA|
eTA vizva jagatera pratipAlakera nikaTa theke avatIrNa,
navI yadi kona kathA nije racanA kare AmAra nAme cAliYe dita,
Ami avazyai tAra DAna hAta dhare tAke pAkar3Ao karatAma,
tArapara avazyai keTe ditAma tAra hRtpinDera zirA,
ataHpara tomAdera madhye emana keu nei ye, (AmAra gosvA theke tAke rakSA karAra janya) vAdhA sRSTi karate pAre|
muttAkvIdera janya e kuraAna avazyai eka upadeza,
Ami avazyai jAni ye, tomAdera madhye kataka loka (kuraAnake) asvIkAra karave|
Ara e kuraAna kAphiradera janya avazyai duHkha o hatAzAra kAraNa have (yakhana kuraAne varNita zAsti tAderake ghire dharave)|
eTA ekevAre nizcita satya|
ataeva tumi tomAra mahAna pratipAlakera nAmera pavitratA o mahimA varNanA kara|
eka vyakti cAila se ‘AyAva yA avazyai saMghaTita have|
kAphiradera janya tA pratirodha karAra keu nei
(ye zAsti Asave) AllAhara nikaTa hate yini AsamAne uThAra si~r3igulora mAlika,
pherezatA evaM rUha (arthAt jivarIla) AllAhara dike ArohaNa kare emana eka dine, yAra parimANa paJcAza hAjAra vachara|
sutarAM (he navI!) dhairya dhara- sundara saujanyamUlaka dhairya|
tArA ai dinaTike sudUra mane karache,
kintu Ami tA nikaTe dekhate pAcchi|
sedina AkAza have galita rUpAra mata,
Ara pAhAr3agulo have raGgINa pazamera mata,
vandhu vandhura khavara nive nA,
yadio tAderake rAkhA have parasparera dRSTira sAmane, aparAdhI sedinera ‘AyAva theke vA~cAra janya vinimaYe dite cAive tAra santAnAdike,
tAra strI o bhAike,
Ara tAra AtmIYa goSThIke yArA tAke AzraYa dita,
Ara duniYAra savvAike, yAte tA tAke rakSA karate pAre|
nA, kakSano naYa, oTA jvalanta agnizikhA,
yA cAmar3A tule dive,
jAhAnnAma sei vyaktike DAkave ye pechane phire giYechila evaM satya theke mukha phiriYe niYechila|
se mAladhana jamA karata, ataHpara tA Agale rAkhata,
mAnuSake sRSTi karA haYeche khuvai asthira-manA kare,
vipada tAke sparza karale se haYa utkaNThita,
kalyANa tAke sparza karale se haYe par3e ati kRpaNa,
tave nAmAya AdAYakArIrA e rakama naYa,
yArA tAdera nAmAye sthira saMkalpa
yAdera dhana-sampade ekaTA suvidita adhikAra Ache,
prArthI evaM vaJcitadera,
yArA vicAra divasake satya mAne|
yArA tAdera pratipAlakera zAsti samparke bhIta kampita,
tAdera pratipAlakera zAsti emana ye tAttheke nijeke nirApada bhAvA yAYa nA,
yArA nijedera lajjAsthAna saMrakSaNa kare
tAdera strI athavA adhikArabhukta dAsI chAr3A, kenanA tAte tArA tiraskRta have nA,
tave era vAire yArA anya kAuke kAmanA karave, tArAi sImAlaGghanakArI|
yArA tAdera AmAnAta o o‘YAdA rakSA kare,
yArA tAdera sAkSyadAne (satyatAra upara) supratiSThita,
yArA tAdera nAmAye yatnavAna,
tArAi have jAnnAte sammAnita|
kAphiradera kI hala ye, tArA tomAra dike chuTe Asache (tomAra kuraAna pATha zune tomAke ThATTA-vidrUpa karAra janya),
DAna dika Ara vAma dika theke dale dale,
tAdera pratyekei ki ei lobha kare ye, tAke ni‘mAta-bharA jAnnAte dAkhila karA have?

kakSano nA, Ami tAderake kI theke sRSTi karechi tA tArA jAne (emana nagaNya vastu theke sRSTa mAnuSa kevala mAnuSa haYe janma neYAra kAraNei jAnnAte cale yAve e rakama lobha karA var3ai avivecanAprasUta vyApAra)|
Ami zapatha karachi udaYasthAnasamUhera o astAcalasamUhera ravvera-Ami avazyai sakSama,
tAdera parivarte tAdera ceYe utkRSTa mAnuSa vAnAte, AmAke parAsta karave emana keu nei|
kAjei tAderake anarthaka kathAvArtA o khela tAmAzAYa matta thAkate dAo yatakSaNa nA tArA tAdera sedinera sAkSAt lAbha kare ye dinera o‘YAdA tAderake deYA haYechila|
yedina tArA kavara theke vera have drutatAra sAthe- yena tArA kona lakSyasthalera dike chuTe caleche|
tAdera dRSTi have avanamita, lAJchanA tAderake Acchanna karave| eTAi hala sei dina yAra o‘YAdA tAderake deYA hacchila|
Ami nUhake tAra jAtira kAche pAThiYechilAma (ei nirdeza diYe) ye, tumi tomAra jAtike satarka kara tAdera kAche marmAntika ‘AyAva AsAra pUrve|
se valechila, ‘‘he AmAra jAtira lokerA! Ami tomAdera janya eka suspaSTa satarkakArI,
e viSaYe ye, tomarA AllAhara ‘ivAdAta kara, tA~kei bhaYa kara, Ara AmAra kathA mAnya kara|

tAhale tini tomAdera pApa kSamA kare devena evaM ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta tomAderake avakAza devena| AllAha kartRka nidiSTa samaYa yakhana Asave takhana Ara tA vilamvita have nA| tomarA yadi jAnate!’
se valechila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! Ami AmAra jAtike rAta-dina Dekechi,
kintu AmAra DAka kevala tAdera palAYanI manovRttikei vAr3iYe diYeche,
Ami yakhanai tAderake DAki yena tumi tAderake kSamA kare dAo, takhanai tArA tAdera kAne AGgula DukiYe diYeche, kApar3e mukha Dheke niYeche, jida kareche Ara khuva vezi ahaGkAra kareche|
ataHpara tAderake Ami uccaiHsvare Dekechi,
era para Ami prakAzyabhAveo tAdera kAche pracAra karechi, Ara gopane gopaneo tAderake vujhiYechi|
Ami valechi- ‘tomarA tomAdera ravvera kAche kSamA cAo, tini var3ai kSamAzIla|
(tomarA tA karale) tini ajasra dhArAYa tomAdera upara vRSTi varSaNa karavena,
tomAdera dhana sampada o santAnAdi vAr3iYe devena, tomAdera janya vAgAna sRSTi karavena evaM tomAdera janya nadInAlA pravAhita karavena|
‘tomAdera hala kI ye, tomarA AllAhara zreSThatva mene nite asvIkAra karacha?
athaca tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena nAnAna stara atikrama kariYe|
tomarA ki dekha nA, kIbhAve AllAha sAta AsamAna sRSTi karechena ekera upare ArekaTike (sthApana kare)?
Ara tAdera mAjhe cA~dake vAniYechena Alo evaM sUryake karechena pradIpa|
AllAha tomAderake mATi theke udagata karena (evaM kramazaH vAr3iYe tolena yemana vAr3iYe tolena vRkSake)
ataHpara ei mATitei tomAderake phiriYe Anavena evaM tomAderake punarutthita karavena|
AllAha tomAdera janya yamInake karechena samprasArita,
yAte tomarA tAra prazasta patha-ghATa diYe calAcala karate pAra|’

nUha valechila, ‘he AmAra pratipAlaka! tArA AmAra kathA pratyAkhyAna kareche Ara Anugatya karache tAdera (arthAt emana sava lokadera) yAdera mAladhana Ara santAnAdi tAdera kSati chAr3A anya kichui vRddhi kareni,
Ara tArA Sar3ayantra karechila sAMghAtika Sar3ayantra|
Ara tArA valechila, tomAdera devadevIdera kakSano parityAga karo nA, Ara avazyai parityAga karo nA oYAda suA‘Ake, Ara nA ‘iYAgusa, iYA‘Uka o nAsarake|
tArA gumarAha kareche anekake, tumi yAlimadera gumarAhI chAr3A Ara kichui vRddhi karo nA|
pApera kAraNe tAderake DuviYe deYA haYeche, pare tAderake dAkhila karA haYeche Agune, ata:para tArA AllAhake chAr3A kAuke sAhAyyakArI pAYani|
nUha valala, ‘he AmAra ravva! bhUpRSThe vasavAsakArI kAphiradera ekajanakeo tumi rehAi dio nA|
tumi yadi tAderake rehAi dAo, tAhale tArA tomAra vAndAhaderake gumarAha kare deve Ara kevala pApAcArI kAphira janma dite thAkave|

he AmAra ravva! tumi kSamA kara AmAke, AmAra pitAmAtAke yArA AmAra gRhe mu’mina haYe praveza kare tAderake Ara mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina nArIderake; Ara yAlimadera janya dhvaMsa chAr3A Ara kichui vRddhi karo nA|’
vala, ‘‘AmAra kAche oYAhI karA haYeche ye, jinnadera ekaTi dala manoyoga diYe (kuraAna) zuneche ataHpara tArA valeche ‘AmarA eka ati Azcaryajanaka kuraAna zunechi
yA satya-saThika patha pradarzana kare, yAra kAraNe AmarA tAte ImAna enechi, AmarA kakSano kAuke AmAdera pratipAlakera aMzIdAra gaNya karava nA|
Ara AmAdera pratipAlakera maryAdA ati ucca, tini grahaNa karenani kona strI Ara kona santAna|
Ara AmAdera madhyekAra nirvodherA tA~ra samparke sImAtirikta kathAvArtA valata|
Ara AmarA dhAraNA karatAma ye, mAnuSa o jvina AllAha samparke kakSano mithye kathA valave nA|
Aro ei ye, kataka mAnuSa kataka jvinera AzraYa nita, era dvArA tArA jvinadera garva ahaGkAra vAr3iYe diYeche|
Aro ei ye (jvinerA valechila) tomarA (jvinerA) yemana dhAraNA karate temani mAnuSerA dhAraNA karata ye, (mRtyura para) AllAha kAuke punarutthita karave nA|
Ara AmarA AkAzera khavara nite ceYechilAma kintu AmarA seTAke pelAma kaThora praharI veSTita o jvalanta ulkApinDe paripUrNa|
AmarA (Age) saMvAda zunAra janya AkAzera vibhinna ghA~Tite vasatAma, kintu ekhana keu saMvAda zunate cAile tAra upara nikSepera janya se jvalanta agnikunDake lukiYe thAkate dekhe|
AmarA jAni nA (ei parivartita avasthAra mAdhyame) pRthivIvAsIra akalyANai cAoYA hacche, nA tAdera pratipAlaka tAderake sarala saThika patha dekhAte cAna|
Ara AmAdera kichu saMkhyaka satkarmazIla, Ara kataka emana naYa, AmarA chilAma vibhinna mata o pathe vibhakta|
AmarA vujhate perechi ye, AmarA pRthivIte AllAhake parAsta karate pArava nA, Ara pAliYeo tA~ke apAraga karate pArava nA|
Aro ei ye, AmarA yakhana hidAYAtera vANI zunate pelAma, takhana tAra upara ImAna AnalAma| ye vyakti tAra pratipAlakera upara ImAna Ane tAra kona kSati vA yulamera bhaYa thAkave nA|
AmAdera madhye kichu saMkhyaka (AllAhara prati) AtmasamarpaNakArI Ara kichu saMkhyaka anyAYakArI| yArA AtmasamarpaNa kare tArA saThika patha veche niYeche|
Ara yArA anyAYakArI tArA jAhAnnAmera indhana|
Aro (AmAra kAche oYAhI karA haYeche ei) ye, tArA yadi satya-saThika pathe pratiSThita thAkata, tAhale Ami tAderake pracura pAni pAna karAtAma|

yena Ami tA diYe tAderake parIkSA karate pAri (ye ni‘mAta pAoYAra para tArA zukara-gujAra haYa, nA nA-pharamAna haYa)| ye vyakti tAra pratipAlakera smaraNa theke mukha phiriYe neYa, tini tAke kaThina ‘AyAve praveza karAvena|
Aro ei ye, mAsajidagulo kevalamAtra AllAharai janya, kAjei tomarA AllAhara saGge anya Ara kAuke Deko nA|
Aro ei ye, yakhana AllAhara vAndA [rasUlullAha (sA.)] yakhana tA~ke AhavAna karAra janya dA~r3Ala takhana tArA (arthAt kAphirarA) tAra cArapAze bhir3a jamAla|
vala: Ami zudhu AmAra pratipAlakakei DAki, Ara anya kAuke tA~ra aMzIdAra gaNya kari nA|
vala- ‘Ami tomAdera kona kSati vA kalyANa karAra kSamatA rAkhi nA|
vala- AllAhara (zAsti) theke keu AmAke rakSA karate pArave nA (yadi Ami tA~ra avAdhya hai) evaM tA~ra AzraYa chAr3A Ami kona AzraYao pAva nA|
AllAhara vANI pau~chAno o tA~ra pAYagAma pracAra karAi AmAra kAja| ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake amAnya kare, tAra janya Ache jAhAnnAmera Aguna; tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave|
avazeSe tArA yakhana pratizruta zAsti dekhate pAve, takhana tArA jAnate pArave ye, sAhAyyakArI hiseve ke savaceYe durvala, Ara saMkhyAYa kArA savaceYe kama|
vala- ‘Ami jAni nA tomAderake yAra pratizruti deYA haYeche tA ki nikaTavartI, nA tAra janya AmAra pratipAlaka kona dIrgha meYAda nirdiSTa karavena|’
ekamAtra tinii adRzyera jJAnI, tini tA~ra adRzyera jJAna kAro kAche prakAza karena nA|
tA~ra manonIta rasUla vyatIta| kenanA tini takhana tA~ra rasUlera Age-piche pAhArAdAra niyukta karena|

eTA jAnAra janya ye, rasUlagaNa tAdera pratipAlakera vANI satyii pau~che diYeche kinA| rasUladera kAche yA Ache tA tini (svIYa jJAna dvArA) pariveSTana kare rekhechena Ara pratyekaTi jinisake guNe guNe rekhechena|
ohe cAdare AvRta (vyakti)!
rAte nAmAye dA~r3Ao tave (rAtera) kichu aMza vAde,
rAtera ardheka (samaYa dA~r3Ao) kiMvA tAra theke kichuTA kama kara,
athavA tAra ceYe vAr3Ao, Ara dhIre dhIre suspaSTabhAve kuraAna pATha kara|
Ami tomAra upara gurubhAra kAlAma nAyila karava (vizvera vuke yAra pracAra o pratiSThA karAra dAYitvabhAra ati var3a kaThina kAja)|
vAstavikai rAte vichAnA cher3e uThA AtmasaMyamera janya vezi kAryakara evaM (kuraAna) spaSTa uccAraNera anukUla|
dinera velAYa tomAra janya Ache dIrgha karmavyastatA|
kAjei tumi tomAra pratipAlakera nAma smaraNa kara evaM ekAgracitte tA~ra prati magna hao|
(tini) pUrva o pazcimera sarvamaYa kartA, tini chAr3A satyikArera kona ilAha nei, ataeva tA~kei tumi tomAra kArya sampadAnakArI vAniYe lao|
tArA yA vale se vyApAre dhairya dhAraNa kara Ara bhadratAra saGge tAderake parihAra ka’re cala|
Ara cher3e dAo AmAke Ara nAnAna vilAsa sAmagrIra mAlika ai mithyukaderake evaM tAderake kichuTA samaYa avakAza dAo|
AmAra kAche Ache zekala Ara dAu dAu kare jvalA Aguna,
Ara galAYa ATake yAYa emana khAvAra Ara marmAntika zAsti|
(esava zAsti deYA have) yedina yamIna Ara pAhAr3agulo ke~pe uThave, Ara pAhAr3agulo have calamAna vAlukArAzi|

Ami tomAdera kAche temanibhAve ekajana rasUlake tomAdera prati sAkSyadAtA hiseve pAThiYechi (yini kviYAmate sAkSya divena ye, dvInera dAoYAta tini yathAyathabhAve mAnuSera kAche pau~che diYechena) yemanabhAve Ami pherAunera kAche pAThiYechilAma ekajana rasUlake|
takhana pherAuna sei rasUlake amAnya karala| phale Ami tAke zakta dharAYa dharalAma|
ataeva tomarA yadi (ei rasUlake) asvIkAra kara, tAhale tomarA kIbhAve sedina AtmarakSA karave yedinaTi (tAra bhISaNatA o bhaYAvahatAYa) vAlakake ka’re deve vur3o|
yAra kAraNe AkAza pheTe yAve, AllAhara oYA‘dA pUrNa haYe yAve|
eTA upadeza| kAjei yAra mana cAYa se tAra pratipAlakera dike patha dharuka|

tomAra pratipAlaka jAnena ye, tumi kakhanao rAtera du’tRtIYAMza ‘ivAdAtera janya dA~r3Ao, kakhanao ardheka, kakhanao rAtera eka tRtIYAMza, tomAra saGgI-sAthIdera ekaTi dalao (tAi kare)| AllAhi rAta Ara dinera parimANa nirdhAraNa karena| tini jAnena, tomarA tA yathAyatha hisAva rekhe pAlana karate pArave nA| kAjei tini tomAdera prati kSamAparavaza haYechena| kAjei kuraAnera yataTuku par3A tomAra janya sahaja haYa, tumi tataTuku par3a| tini jAnena, tomAdera madhye keu keu asustha have, Ara kataka AllAhara anugraha sandhAne yamIne bhramaNa karave, Ara kataka AllAhara pathe yuddha karave| kAjei tomAdera janya yataTuku sahajasAdhya haYa tAi tAttheke pATha kara, Ara nAmAya pratiSThA kara, yAkAta dAo Ara AllAhake RNa dAo uttama RNa| tomarA yA kichu kalyANa nijedera janya Age pAThAve, tA AllAhara nikaTa (saJcita) pAve, tAi uttama evaM puraskAra hiseve khuva var3a| tomarA AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara, AllAha ati kSamAzIla, var3ai daYAlu|
ohe vastra AvRta (vyakti)!
oTha, satarka kara|
Ara tomAra pratipAlakera zreSThatva ghoSaNA kara|
tomAra pozAka paricchada pavitra rAkha|
(yAvatIYa) apavitratA theke dUre thAka|
(kAro prati) anugraha karo nA adhika pAoYAra uddezye|
tomAra pratipAlakera (santuSTira) janya dhairya dhara|
yedina ziGgAYa phu~ deYA have,
sedinaTi have var3ai kaThina dina,
(yA) kAphiradera janya moTei sahaja naYa|
cher3e dAo AmAke (tAra saGge vujhApar3A karAra janya) yAke Ami ekakabhAve sRSTi karechi|
Ara tAke (oYAlIda vina mugIrAhake) diYechi aDhela dhana-sampada,
Ara aneka chele yArA sava samaYa tAra kAchei thAke|
evaM tAra jIvanake karechi sacchala o sugama|
era parao se lobha kare ye, Ami tAke Aro dei|
kakSano nA, se chila AmAra nidarzanera viruddhAcArI|
zIghrai Ami tAke uThAva zAstira pAhAr3e (arthAt tAke diva vipadera upara vipada)|
se cintA bhAvanA karala evaM siddhAnta nila,
dhvaMsa hoka se, kIbhAve se (kuraAnera alaukikatA svIkAra karAra parao kevala ahamikAra vazavartI haYe navuoYAtake asvIkAra karAra) siddhAnta nila!
AvAro dhvaMsa hoka se, se siddhAnta nila kIbhAve!
tArapara se tAkAlo|
tArapara bhru ku~cakAlo Ara mukha vA~kAlo|
tArapara se pichane phirala Ara ahaMkAra karala|
tArapara valala- ‘e to yAdu chAr3A Ara kichu naYa, eto pUrve thekei cale Asache|
eTA to mAnuSera kathA mAtra|’
zIghrai Ami tAke jAhAnnAmera Agune nikSepa karava|
tumi ki jAna jAhAnnAmera Aguna kI?
tA kAuke jIvitao rAkhave nA, Ara mRta avasthAYao cher3e deve nA|
cAmar3A jhalase deve|
sekhAne niYojita Ache Uniza jana pherezatA|

Amii kevala pherezatAderake jAhAnnAmera tattvAvadhAYaka karechi| Ara tAdera (ei) saMkhyAke kAphiradera janya ekaTA parIkSA vAniYe diYechi (kenanA tArA e kathA vizvAsai karate pArave nA ye mAtra Uniza jana pherezatA vizAla jAhAnnAmera yAvatIYa dAYitva pAlana karave) Ara yena kitAvadhArIgaNa tA dRr3habhAve vizvAsa kare Ara ImAnadAradera ImAna Aro vRddhi pAYa evaM kitAvadhArIgaNa o ImAnadAragaNa yena kona rakama sandehera madhye nA thAke| yAdera antare roga Ache tArA Ara kAphirarA yAte vale uThe, ‘‘ e dharaNera kathA diYe AllAha kI vojhAte ceYechena?’’ ebhAve AllAha yAke cAna gumarAha karena Ara yAke cAna saThika pathe paricAlita karena| tomAra pratipAlakera vAhinI (kArA evaM era syakhyA kata se) samparke tini chAr3A keu jAne nA| (jAhAnnAmera) e (varNanA deYA hala) kevala mAnuSera nasIhata lAbhera janya|
(eTA) kakSano (bhittihIna) nA, cA~dera kasama,
rAtera kasama yakhana tAra avasAna haYa,
prabhAtera kasama- yakhana tA ujjvala haYe oThe,
ei jAhAnnAma var3a var3a vipadagulora ekaTi,
mAnuSera janya satarkakArI,
tomAdera madhye ye (kalyANera pathe) egiYe yete cAYa athavA pechane par3e thAkate cAYa tAra janya
pratyeka vyakti nija kRtakarmera dAYe Avaddha|
kintu DAna pAzera lokerA naYa|
tArA thAkave jAnnAte| tArA parasparake jijJesa karave
aparAdhIdera samparke
‘kise tomAderake jAhAnnAme niYe geche?
tArA valave, ‘AmarA nAmAya AdAYakArI lokedera madhye zAmila chilAma nA,
Ara misakInaderake khAvAra khAoYAtAma nA,
Ara AmarA (satya pathera pathikadera) samAlocanA karatAma samAlocanAkArIdera saGge (theke)|
AmarA pratiphala divasake asvIkAra karatAma|
AmAdera nikaTa nizcita vizvAsa (arthAt mRtyu) nA AsA paryanta|’
takhana supArizakArIdera supAriza tAdera kona kAje Asave nA|
tAdera haYeche kI ye tArA upadeza theke mukha phiriYe niYeche?
tArA yena bhaYe santrasta gAdhA,
siMhera sAmane theke pAlAcche|
vastutaH tAdera pratyekei cAYa, tAke (AllAhara pakSa theke) kholA ciThi deYA hoka (ei marme ye, tomarA ei navIke mene nAo)|
nA, tA kakSano hate pAre nA, varaM (kathA ei ye) tArA AkhirAtake bhaYa kare nA|
nA, tA hate pAre nA, eTA (arthAt kuraAna sakalera janya) upadezavANI|
ekSane yAra icche tAttheke zikSA grahaNa karuka|
AllAhara icche vyatIta keu upadeza grahaNa karave nA, tinii bhaYera yogya, tinii kSamA karAra adhikArI|
Ami kasama karachi kviYAmatera dinera,
Ami Aro kasama karachi sei manera ye (anyAYa kAja ka’re vasale) nijeke dhikkAra deYa (ye tomAderake avazyai AvAra jIvita kare uThAno have)|
mAnuSa ki mane kare ye, Ami tAra hAr3aguloke ekatrita karate pArava nA|
kena naYa, Ami tAra AGgulera DagA paryanta saThikabhAve vAniYe dite sakSama
kintu mAnuSa tAra AgAmI dinaguloteo pApAcAra karate cAYa|
se jijJesa kare, ‘kviYAmata divasa kave?’
yakhana cokha dhA~dhiYe yAve,
cA~da haYe yAve AlokahIna
suruja Ara cA~dake ekatre jur3e deYA have,
sedina mAnuSa valave- ‘Aja pAlAnora jAYagA kothAYa?’
moTei nA, AzraYera kona jAYagA nei|
sedina ThA~i have (ekamAtra) tomAra pratipAlakerai nikaTa|
sedina mAnuSake jAniYe deYA have se kI (‘AmAla) Age pAThiYeche Ara kI pechane cher3e eseche|
Asale mAnuSa nijei nijera samparke cAkSusabhAve avagata|
yadio se nAnAna ajuhAta peza kare|
(e sUrAha avatIrNa haoYAra samaYa AllAhara rasUla tA mukhastha karAra janya vyasta haYe par3ale AllAha abhaYa diYe valalena) tumi tAr3AtAr3i oYAhI AYatta karAra janya tomAra jibha nAr3Ave nA|
era saMrakSaNa o par3Anora dAYitva AmArai|
kAjei Ami yakhana tA pATha kari, takhana tumi se pAThera anusaraNa kara|
ataHpara tA (oYAhIYe khaphI vA pracchanna oYAhIra mAdhyame) vizadabhAve vyAkhyA karA AmArai dAYitva|
(AvAra pUrvera prasaGge phire giYe AllAha valachena) nA, prakRtapakSe tomarA ihajIvanakei bhAlavAsa,
Ara AkhirAtake upekSA kara|
kataka mukha sedina ujjvala have|
tArA tAdera pratipAlakera dike tAkiYe thAkave|
kataka mukha sedina vivarNa have|
tArA dhAraNA karave ye, tAdera saGge komara-bhAGgA AcaraNa karA have|
(tomarA ye bhAvacha kviYAmata have nA seTA) kakSano naYa, prANa yakhana kaNThe ese pau~chave,
takhana valA have, (tAke vA~cAnora janya) jhAr3aphu~ka deYAra keu Ache ki?
se (arthAt mumUrSu vyakti) mane karave ye, (duniYA hate) vidAYera kSaNa ese geche|
Ara jar3iYe yAve eka pAYera nalA Areka pAYera nalAra sAthe|
sedina (sava kichura) yAtrA have tomAra pratipAlakera pAne|
kintu nA, se vizvAsao kareni, nAmAyao AdAYa kareni|
varaM se pratyAkhyAna karechila Ara mukha phiriYe niYechila|
ataHpara se ati dambhabhare tAra parivAravargera kAche phire giYechila|
durbhoga tomAra janya, durbhoga,
ataHpara tomAra janya durbhogera upara durbhoga|
mAnuSa ki mane kare niYeche ye tAke emani cher3e deYA have| (tAke punarjIvita karAo have nA, Ara vicArera janya hAjira karAo have nA)?
(tAra mRtyura para AllAha punarAYa tAke jIvita karate pAravena nA se eTA kI bhAve dhAraNA karache?) se ki (mAYera garbhe) nikSipta zukravindu chila nA?
tArapara se hala raktapinDa, ataHpara AllAha tAke sRSTi karalena o suvinyasta karalena|
ataHpara tA theke tini sRSTi karalena jur3i- puruSa o nArI|
ehena sraSTA ki mRtake AvAra jIvita karate sakSama nana?
mahAkAlera madhya hate mAnuSera upara ki emana ekaTA samaYa ativAhita haYani yakhana se ullekha karAra yogya kona vastui chila nA?
Ami mAnuSake sRSTi karechi saMmizrita zukravindu theke tAke parIkSA karAra janya, ejanya tAke karechi zravaNazakti o dRSTizaktira adhikArI|
Ami tAke patha dekhiYe diYechi, haYa se kRtajJa have, nA haYa se akRtajJa have|
Ami (akRtajJa) kAphiradera janya prastuta kare rekhechi zekala, ver3i Ara jvalanta Aguna|
(aparadike) nekakAra lokerA emana pAnapAtra theke pAna karave yAte karpurera saMmizraNa thAkave|
AllAhara vAndArA ekaTi jharNA theke pAna karave| tArA ei jharNAke (tAdera) icchemata pravAhita karave|
yArA mAnata pUraNa kare Ara sei dinake bhaYa kare yAra aniSTa have sudUraprasArI|
Ara tArA AllAhara prati tAdera bhAlavAsAra kAraNe misakIna, iYAtIma o kaYedIke khAvAra khAoYAYa|
tArA vale- ‘AmarA tomAderake khAvAra khAoYAcchi kevala AllAhara cehArA (santuSTi) lAbhera janya, AmarA tomAdera theke kona pratidAna cAi nA, cAi nA kona kRtajJatA (jJApana o dhanyavAda)|
AmarA kevala bhaYa kari AmAdera pratipAlakera pakSa hate eka bhItiprada bhaYAnaka dinera|
yAra phale AllAha tAderake se dinera aniSTa hate rakSA karavena Ara tAderake divena sajIvatA o Ananda|
Ara tAdera dhairya sahiSNutAra vinimaYe tAderake divena jAnnAta o rezamI pozAka|
sekhAne tArA ucca Asanagulote helAna diYe vasave, sekhAne tArA dekhave nA ati garama, Ara ati zIta|
jAnnAtera vRkSarAjira chAYA tAdera upara thAkave, Ara phalera guccha ekevAre tAdera nAgAlera madhye rAkhA have|
tAdera sAmane ghure ghure rupAra pAtra parivezana karA have Ara sAdA pAtharera pAnapAtra|
sei sAdA pAtharao have rupAra tairI| tArA eguloke yathAyatha parimANe bharti karave|
tAderake pAna karAnora janya emana pAtra parivezana karA have yAte AdAra mizraNa thAkave|
sekhAne Ache ekaTA jharNA, yAra nAma sAlasAvIla|
ghure ghure tAdera sevAdAna kArye niYojita thAkave cirakizoragaNa| tumi yakhana tAderake dekhave, tumi mane karave, tArA yena char3Ano muktA|
tumi yakhana dekhave takhana dekhate pAve bhoga vilAsera nAnAna sAmagrI Ara eka vizAla rAjya|
tAdera AvaraNa have cikana savuja rezama o moTA rezama, Ara tAderake alaMkAre sajjita karA have rupAra kaGkaNa dvArA, Ara tAdera ravva tAderake pAna karAvena pavitra paricchanna pAnIYa|
‘eTAi tomAdera pratidAna, tomAdera ceSTA-sAdhanA sAdare gRhIta haYeche|’
(he navI!) Ami tomAra kAche kuraAna avatIrNa karechi krame krame (alpa alpa kare)|
kAjei tumi dhairya dha’re, tomAra pratipAlakera nirdezera apekSA kara Ara tAdera madhyekAra pApAcArI athavA kAphirera Anugatya kara nA|
Ara sakAla-sandhyAYa tomAra ravva era nAma smaraNa kara|
Ara rAtera kichu aMze tA~ra janya sejadAYa avanata hao Ara rAtera dIrgha samaYa dhare tA~ra mahimA varNanA kara|
e lokerA to pArthiva jIvanake bhAlavAse Ara tAdera Ar3Ale ye (kiYAmAtera) kaThina dina (Asache) tAke upekSA kare|
Amii tAderake sRSTi karechi Ara tAdera gaThana majavuta karechi| Ami yakhana cAiva takhana tAdera sthale tAdera mata anya loka Anava|
eTA eka upadeza, kAjei yAra icche se (e upadeza mAnya ka’re) tAra pratipAlakera patha dharuka|

tomarA icche kara nA AllAhara icche vyatIta| (arthAt AllAha kona kichu kAryakara karate cAile tomAdera mAjhe icche o zakti saJcAra karataH tomAdera mAdhyame tA kAryakara karena)| AllAha sarvajJAtA mahAvijJAnI|
tini yAke icche tA~ra rAhamAte dAkhila karena| Ara yAlimarA- tAdera janya tini prastuta kare rekhechena var3ai pIr3AdAYaka zAsti|
para para pAThAno vAtAsera zapatha yA upakAra sAdhana kare,
ataHpara tA pracanDa jhar3era vege vaite thAke,
zapatha sei vAYura yA (meghamAlAke) char3iYe deYa dUra dUrAnte,
Ara vicchinnakArI vAtAsera zapatha yA (meghamAlAke) vicchinna kare,
ataHpara (mAnuSera antare) pau~che deYa (AllAhara) smaraNa,
(vizvAsI lokaderake) kSamA cAoYAra suyoga deYAra janya Ara (kAphiraderake) satarka karAra janya|
tomAderake yAra o‘YAdA deYA haYeche tA avazyai saMghaTita have|
yakhana nakSatrarAjira Alo vilupta have,
yakhana AkAza vidIrNa have,
yakhana pavartamAlA dhunita have|
yakhana (hAzarera mAThe) rasUlagaNera ekatrita haoYAra samaYa ese par3ave|
(e sava viSaYa) kona dinera janya sthagita rAkhA haYeche?
cUr3Anta phaYasAlAra dinera janya|
sei cUr3Anta phaYasAlAra dinaTi kI tA tomAke kise jAnAve?
se dina durbhoga satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera janya|
Ami ki AgekAra lokederake dhvaMsa kare deini?
ataHpara paravartI lokederakeo Ami tAdera anugAmI karava|
aparAdhIdera prati Ami erakamai kare thAki|
se dina durbhoga satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera janya|
Ami ki nagaNya pAni theke tomAderake sRSTi karini?
ataHpara Ami tA rekhechi eka susaMrakSita sthAne|
ekaTA nirdhArita samaYa paryanta,
ataHpara Ami tAke gaThana karechi susAmaJjasyapUrNarUpe, Ami katai nA uttama kSamatAra adhikArI!
se dina durbhoga satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera janya|
Ami ki pRthivIke (sava kichuke Tene guTiYe) dhAraNakArIrUpe sRSTi karini?
jIvita o mRtaderake (bhAla Ara mandake nekakAra Ara pApAcArIke)|
Ara Ami tAte sthApana karechi anar3a suucca pavartamAlA Ara tomAderake pAna kariYechi sumiSTa supeYa pAni|
sedina durbhoga satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera janya|
(tAderake valA have) ‘calo tAra dike tomarA yAke mithye va’le pratyAkhyAna karate|

kakSano nA, tAke avazyai cUrNa-vicUrNakArIra madhye nikSepa karA have,
tumi ki jAna cUrNa-vicUrNakArI kI?
tA AllAhara prajjvalita Aguna,
yA hRdaYa paryanta pau~che yAve|
tA tAderake caturdika theke pariveSTana kare rAkhave,
(lelihAna agnizikhAra) u~cu u~cu stambhe|
tumi ki dekhani (kA‘vA ghara dhvaMsera janya Agata) hAtIoYAlAdera saGge tomAra pratipAlaka kIrUpa vyavahAra karechilena?
tini ki tAdera cakrAnta vyartha kare denani?
tini tAdera viruddhe pAThiYechilena jhA~ke jhA~ke pAkhi|
yArA tAdera upara pAtharera kA~kara nikSepa karechila|
ataHpara tini tAderake kare dilena bhakSita tRNa-bhuSira mata|
kurAizadera abhyasta haoYAra kAraNe,
(arthAt) zIta o grISme tAdera videza saphare abhyasta haoYAra (kAraNe)
tAdera kartavya hala ei (kA‘vA) gharera ravera ‘ivAdAta karA,
yini tAderake (kA‘vA gharera khAdima haoYAra kAraNe nirvighne vyavasA-vANijyera mAdhyame) kSudhAYa khAdya dicchena evaM tAderake bhaYa-bhIti hate nirApada karechena|
tumi ki tAke dekhecha, ye karmaphala (divasake) asvIkAra kare?
se to sei (loka) ye iYAtImake dhAkkA diYe sariYe deYa,
evaM misakInake anna dite utsAha deYa nA
ataeva durbhoga se sava nAmAya AdAYakArIra
yArA nijedera nAmAyera vyApAre udAsIna,
yArA loka dekhAnora janya tA kare,
evaM praYojanIYa gRhasAmagrI dAnera choTa khATa sAhAyya karA thekeo virata thAke|
Ami tomAke (hAoye) kAosAra dAna karechi|
kAjei tumi tomAra pratipAlakera uddezye nAmAya AdAYa kara evaM kuravAnI kara,
(tomAra nAma-cihna kona dina muchave nA, varaM) tomAra prati vidveSa poSaNakArIrAi nAma cihnahIna- nirmUla|
vala, ‘he kAphirarA!’
tomarA yAra ‘ivAdAta kara, Ami tAra ‘ivAdAta kari nA,
Ara Ami yAra ‘ivAdAta kari tomarA tAra ‘ivAdAtakArI nao,
Ara Ami tAra ‘ivAdAtakArI nai tomarA yAra ‘ivAdAta kare thAka,
Ara Ami yAra ‘ivAdAta kari tomarA tAra ‘ivAdAtakArI nao,

tomAdera patha o panthA tomAdera janya (se pathe calAra pariNati tomAderakei bhoga karate have) Ara AmAra janya AmAra patha (ye satya pathe calAra janya AllAha AmAke nirdeza diYechena, e patha cher3e Ami anya kona patha grahaNa karate moTei prastuta nai)|
yakhana Asave AllAhara sAhAyya o (isalAmera cUr3Anta) vijaYa,
Ara tumi mAnuSadera dekhave dale dale AllAhara dIne praveza karate,
takhana tumi (zukariYA AdAYera uddezye) tomAra pratipAlakera prazaMsA sahakAre tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karave Ara tA~ra kAche kSamA prArthanA karave| tini var3ai tAovA kavUlakArI|
AvU lAhAvera hAta du‘To dhvaMsa hoka, dhvaMsa hoka se nije,
tAra dhana-sampada Ara se yA arjana kareche tA tAra kona kAje Asala nA,
acire se praveza karave lelihAna zikhAyukta Agune,
Ara tAra strIo- ye kAThavahanakAriNI (ye kA~TAra sAhAyye navI-ke kaSTa dita evaM ekajanera kathA anyajanake va’le pArasparika vivAdera Aguna jvAlAta)|
Ara (duniYAte tAra vahanakRta kATha-khar3ira parivarte jAhAnnAme) tAra galAYa zakta pAkAno razi vA~dhA thAkave|
vala, tini AllAha, eka advitIYa,
AllAha kona kichura mukhApekSI nana, savai tA~ra mukhApekSI,
tini kAuke janma dena nA, Ara tA~keo janma deYA haYani|
tA~ra samakakSa keu naYa|
vala, ‘Ami AzraYa cAcchi sakAla velAra rava-era,
tini yA sRSTi karechena tAra aniSTa hate,
Ara andhakAra rAtera aniSTa hate yakhana tA Acchanna haYe yAYa|
evaM (jAdu karAra uddezye) girAYa phutkArakAriNIdera aniSTa hate,
evaM hiMsukera aniSTa hate, yakhana se hiMsA kare|
vala, ‘Ami AzraYa cAcchi mAnuSera pratipAlakera,
mAnuSera adhipatira,
mAnuSera prakRta ilAhara,
ye nijeke lukiYe rekhe vAra vAra ese kumantraNA deYa tAra aniSTa hate,
ye kumantraNA deYa mAnuSera antare
(ei kumantraNAdAtA hacche) jinnera madhya hate evaM mAnuSera madhya hate|
